modules.name: 运营商 DM 出站阻断
modules.author: 躺平老咸鱼
modules.description: 三家运营商预装 DM 合集：按 uid 阻断 联通 com.mobiletools.systemhelper / 移动 com.coloros.regservice / 电信 com.oppo.ctautoregist 的全部 IPv4+IPv6 出站，每 60 秒自愈重加规则，并自动补齐 LSPosed 作用域。与 CarrierDMBlocker（Xposed）联动。点击「操作」一键体检三家的状态。
modules.readme:
Carrier DM Blocker
一次拦掉三家运营商预装的 DM（Device Management） 组件：不采集、不定位、不落库、不发短信、不出网。

背景

运营商定制机普遍预装了一套 DM 组件，把设备的 **IMEI / IMSI / ICCID / 基站信息 / 经纬度 /
已装应用使用时长 / 流量明细** 定时上报到各自的管理平台。它们在设置里几乎不可见，也没有开关：

| 现象 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 设置的应用列表里找不到 | 无 activity，或 PMS 层被 ROM 直接过滤 |
| 找不到"关闭"开关 | 有些分支只读系统开机向导状态（过完就开始上报） |
| 停用后仍会拉起 | manifest 里写着 ForbidStop=true |

本项目把三家的采集与上报链路同时掐断，全部离线、不联网、不采集任何数据。

覆盖的三个组件

| 厂商 | 包名 | 实测版本 | 上报/注册地址 | 采集内容 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 联通 | com.mobiletools.systemhelper | 3.0.1-20250822 | http://dm.wo.com.cn:18080/register | IMEI / ICCID / IMSI / 基站 / 经纬度 / 应用使用时长 / 流量 |
| 移动 | com.coloros.regservice | 16.0.20 | https://a.fxltsbl.com（可被云端改写） | IMEI / IMSI / ICCID / 网速 / 锁机信息 / 应用清单 |
| 电信 | com.oppo.ctautoregist | 16.1.5 | https://zzhc.vnet.cn、https://typdm.tydevice.com | IMEI / IMSI / ICCID，另有卫星/IMS 注册短信 |

三家的共同点：都是 priv-app，都有 ForbidStop=true，都只在插对应运营商卡时才真正工作。
区别在于出网方式——联通是单出口 HTTPS+自定义加密，移动是三出口（volley / HttpURLConnection / 无权限 Provider），
电信则多一条 SmsManager.sendDataMessage 的短信注册通道。

架构

┌─ 内核层 ── KernelSU 模块 carrier_dm_blocker
│             按 uid 阻断三家的全部 IPv4/IPv6 出站（连 JNI / 短信之外的 native 路径一起拦）
│             每 60 秒自愈，另负责补写 LSPosed 的 scope 表
└─ 应用层 ── LSPosed 模块 CarrierDMBlocker
              三个入口类，各自只管自己那个包：
                ShHook   联通 SystemHelper
                RgsHook  移动 RegService
                CtaHook  电信 CTAutoRegist

两层互相独立：只装内核层就已经断网；装应用层则把采集动作本身也停掉（不产生数据、不写库、不发短信）。
两层通过共享目录联动，内核模块的「操作」按钮能一次性体检三家的状态。

| 层 | 组件 | 拦什么 | 能单独用吗 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 内核 | KernelSU 模块 carrier_dm_blocker | 三个 uid 的全部出站（含 native 层） | ✅ |
| 应用 | LSPosed 模块 com.example.carrierdmblocker | 出口 / 采集 / 定位 / 落库 / 短信 / 第三方调用 | ✅ |

拦截点

联通 com.mobiletools.systemhelper

全 App 只有一个 HTTP 出口，所以把出口掐住即可；再配合总闸连采集都不做。

| 层 | 目标（混淆名） | 动作 |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | g1.f.b(String, byte[], byte[]) : boolean | 返回 true（伪装上报成功） |
| L2 总闸 | e1.b.a(Context, String) : e1.b | 返回空对象，立即短路 |
| L2 门控 | f1.a.c / g1.l.a / GetSignalInfoReceiver.b,c | 返回 false |
| L3 | GetSignalInfoReceiver.d(回调) : void | 不执行，百度定位不启动 |
| L4 | g1.m.c(String) / g1.e.b(String) : void | 不执行 + 启动时清库 |
L1 必须返回 true 而不是 false：返回 false 会让上层走"落库补报"分支并反复重试。

移动 com.coloros.regservice

供应商是神州泰岳（Richinfo）的 DM SDK，三处出网 + 一个无权限 Provider。

| 层 | 目标 | 动作 |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | 三处出口（volley / 裸 HttpURLConnection） | 直接返回成功，不发包 |
| L2 | 补丁与下载通道 | 关掉动态加载开关，拒绝 patch.jar 下载 |
| L3 | 采集入口（SIM 变化 / 网络变化 / 定时） | 不执行 |
| L4 | cmcc_dm.db 落库 | 不执行 + 启动清库 |
| L5 | cn.richinfo.dm.provider.DMProvider.call() | 返回 null（第三方驱动不了它） |
| UNHIDE | ColorOS 设置侧 getInstalledPackages / AppManagerUtils.isHideApp 等 6 处 | 让隐藏的包在应用列表里可见 |

电信 com.oppo.ctautoregist

唯一一条还带短信通道的，所以单独拦了发短信的几个方法。

| 层 | 目标 | 动作 |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | t.j.c(String, byte[]) / u.a.c(String) : JSONObject | 返回 null |
| L2 | ImsSmsSim{1,2}RegisterService / SatelliteSmsSim{1,2}RegisterService 的发短信方法 | 不执行（不发注册短信） |
| L3 | t.t 全部 17 个实例方法（IMEI / ICCID / IMSI …） | 返回类型默认值 |
| L4 | RegisterReceiver.onReceive + 4 个服务的 onStartCommand | 不执行 / START_NOT_STICKY |

目录结构

.
├── CarrierDMBlocker/                 # LSPosed 模块（libxposed API 102）
│   └── app/src/main/
│       ├── java/.../ShHook.java      # 联通
│       ├── java/.../RgsHook.java     # 移动
│       ├── java/.../CtaHook.java     # 电信
│       └── resources/META-INF/xposed/
│           ├── java_init.list        # 三个入口类
│           ├── module.prop
│           └── scope.list            # 三个目标包
├── carrier_dm-module/                # KernelSU 模块
│   ├── service.sh                    # 探测 3 个 uid → REJECT → 60s 自愈 → 补 scope
│   ├── action.sh                     # 「操作」按钮：三合一一体检
│   ├── dbfix.dex                     # 直接写 LSPosed 的 scope 表（源码在 dbfix/src）
│   └── post-fs-data.sh / uninstall.sh / skip_mount
├── build_carrier_zip.py              # 打包成可刷入的 zip
│
├── SystemHelperXposed/               # v1.x 联通专用版源码（已归档）
└── kernel-module/                    # v1.x 联通专用版内核模块（已归档）

安装

1. 应用层

adb install -r CarrierDMBlocker-Xposed-2.0.apk

装完到 LSPosed 里启用，作用域勾上三个包（移动那个如果界面里看不到，把模块装好后重启一次，
内核模块会自动把 scope 写进 LSPosed 的配置库）。

2. 内核层

adb push CarrierDMBlocker-KernelSU-2.0.zip /data/local/tmp/
adb shell su -c "ksud module install /data/local/tmp/CarrierDMBlocker-KernelSU-2.0.zip"
重启生效

Magisk 用户把 ksud module install 换成在 Magisk 里刷 zip 即可。

体检

KernelSU 管理器里点该模块的「操作」，或：

adb shell su -c "sh /data/adb/modules/carrier_dm_blocker/action.sh"

[1] LSPosed 作用域（直读 modules_config.db）
    exists  com.mobiletools.systemhelper
    exists  com.coloros.regservice
    exists  com.oppo.ctautoregist
    exists  com.android.settings
    状态 : ✅ 完整

[目标] 联通 SystemHelper      uid 10100   IPv4/IPv6 OK   连接: 无   Hook L1=1 L2e=1 L2g=4 L3=1 L4=2
[目标] 移动 RegService        uid 10271   IPv4/IPv6 OK   连接: 无   Hook L1=1 L2=2 L3=40 L4=13 L5=6 UNHIDE=6
[目标] 电信 CTAutoRegist      uid 10104   IPv4/IPv6 OK   连接: 无   Hook L1=2 L2=8 L3=17 L4=5

[结论] ✅ 三家规则在位，当前零外连

怎么读：

| 现象 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 规则在、命中数 0、连接表空 | ✅ 最理想：应用层就拦住了，一个包都没发出去 |
| 命中数在涨 | ⚠️ 有路径绕过应用层，被内核兜住（可查 events.log） |
| 规则不见了 | ❌ 被 netd 清了，60 秒守护会补回来 |
| status.json 心跳超 10 分钟 | ❌ Xposed 层没工作（进程没跑 / 模块没启用 / 目标已停用） |

配置

三个开关文件分别在各自目标的媒体目录，改完重启目标进程即可，不用重刷模块：

/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/com.mobiletools.systemhelper/SHBlocker/config.conf
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/com.coloros.regservice/SHBlocker/config.conf
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/com.oppo.ctautoregist/SHBlocker/config.conf

| 目标 | 键 |
|---|---|
| 联通 | BLOCK_EGRESS / BLOCK_COLLECT / BLOCK_LOCATION / BLOCK_DB / WIPE_DB |
| 移动 | BLOCK_EGRESS / BLOCK_DOWNLOAD / BLOCK_COLLECT / BLOCK_DB / BLOCK_PROVIDER / BLOCK_PATCH / WIPE_DB |
| 电信 | BLOCK_NET / BLOCK_SMS / BLOCK_COLLECT / BLOCK_TRIGGER |

同目录下的 status.json 是模块写的心跳与统计，events.log 是事件流，内核侧体检读它们。

构建

Xposed 模块（JDK 17 + Android SDK 34）：

cd CarrierDMBlocker
echo "sdk.dir=/path/to/android-sdk" > local.properties
./gradlew assembleDebug
产物：app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

KernelSU 模块：

python build_carrier_zip.py    # 输出 dist/CarrierDMBlocker-KernelSU-.zip

dbfix.dex 的重编译（改了模块名或目标包时必须做）：...
modules.changelog:
v2.0 — 三合一

从这一版起，联通 / 移动 / 电信 三套预装 DM 组件由同一对模块处理，不再需要装三份。

合并

| 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|
| SystemHelperBlocker + sh_blocker（联通） | CarrierDMBlocker + carrier_dm_blocker |
| RegServiceBlocker + rgs_blocker（移动） | 同上 |
| CTAutoRegistBlocker + cta_blocker（电信） | 同上 |
- Xposed 侧：一个 APK 里三个入口类（ShHook / RgsHook / CtaHook），各自只处理自己那个包，
  hook 逻辑与原模块完全一致。
- KernelSU 侧：一次探测三个 uid、一次加规则、一次 60 秒自愈；dbfix.dex 开机补写 4 条 LSPosed 作用域。

新增
- 电信 com.oppo.ctautoregist（16.1.5）完整拦截：
  L1 两个 HTTP 出口、L2 四个服务的注册短信（IMS / 卫星 × SIM1/SIM2）、L3 设备信息采集（17 个方法）、L4 广播与服务启动。

改进
- 体检脚本重写：一条命令打印三家状态，包含每个目标的 hook 摘要、内核规则、当前连接与拦截统计。
- 作用域检查改为直读 modules_config.db——lspctl 只允许在电脑的 ADB root shell 里用，
  手机端调用会把英文拒绝信息打到 stdout，旧脚本会误报「缺少作用域」。
- dbfix.dex 支持 list 参数，可在任何 root shell 里只读查看作用域。

升级说明

先停用并卸载旧的三个模块，再装本版：

adb install -r CarrierDMBlocker-Xposed-2.0.apk
adb push CarrierDMBlocker-KernelSU-2.0.zip /data/local/tmp/
adb shell su -c "ksud module install /data/local/tmp/CarrierDMBlocker-KernelSU-2.0.zip"

LSPosed 里启用 CarrierDMBlocker，作用域勾上三个包（移动那个在界面里可能看不到，
重启一次由内核模块自动写库）。之后重启生效。
v1.0（联通专用版）的 Release 仍保留在 Releases 列表里，需要旧版可直接下载。

已知限制
- 混淆类名与目标版本绑定，OTA 升级后需要重新定位。
- 内核层按 uid 全量阻断，目标换 uid 需重启重新探测。
- 只覆盖这三个包，不针对任何其他应用。

modules.name: Facebook App Ads Remover
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Facebook App Ads Remover
modules.readme:
Facebook App Ads Remover

An Xposed module that removes ads and unwanted content from the Facebook Android app, with media downloads, playback controls and account tools.

Current version: 1.27 (versionCode 28).

Requirements
- Android 8.1 or newer.
- A compatible Xposed framework supporting the modern libxposed API 101 or newer. Development testing uses Vector with API 102.
- The main Facebook app, com.facebook.katana. Facebook Lite and Messenger are not supported.

Development and device testing have covered Facebook 576.0.0.42.73, 580.0.0.51.74, 587.0.0.39.55 and 588.0.0.7.55. Facebook 571 and earlier are unsupported. Facebook updates can change individual features; compatibility with arbitrary versions is not guaranteed.

The new account-capture integration was checked on Facebook 587. Startup capture was observed on device; account switching, token refresh and logout have regression-test coverage but have not been verified on device. This integration has not been verified against older Facebook APKs.

Install

1. Download and install the APK from Releases.
2. Enable the module in your Xposed manager and select Facebook as its scope.
3. Fully close Facebook and reopen it so the module loads.
4. Open Facebook App Ads Remover from its launcher icon or your Xposed manager's module settings button.

Feature switches stay disabled until the settings app connects to the framework. The first Facebook launch after a module or Facebook update can take longer while features are discovered.

Features
- Ads: block sponsored News Feed posts, Story and Reels ads, Marketplace promotions and Instant Games ads. Extra feed protection also covers supported cached-feed paths. Supported rewarded games can still grant rewards after an ad is skipped.
- Feed filters: hide Threads posts, Reels, suggestions, People You May Know, Stories blocks and detected Facebook-labeled AI content. Filter posts by keywords and optionally block automatic feed refreshes.
- Stories: watch without marking stories as seen, or hide the Stories tray.
- Appearance: force dark mode, use true-black AMOLED backgrounds, and optionally replace Facebook's blue accents with your wallpaper's Material You colors on Android 12 or newer. AMOLED mode requires Facebook's dark theme or Force dark mode. Turn off HDR requests normal-brightness photo and video output where Android supports it; actual HDR suppression still needs verification on an HDR-capable phone.
- Privacy: allow screenshots and recording, and block Facebook's capture detection.
- Navigation: hide Reels, Marketplace or Gaming tabs while keeping their destinations accessible elsewhere.
- Menu: hide Facebook side-menu entries individually or by section, hide Your shortcuts, and optionally show all entries without the See more button. Includes controls for Settings & privacy, Help & support and Other Meta products, with support for both list and tile-grid menus.
- Links: use an external browser and optionally remove Facebook redirect tracking. Facebook pages and login flows stay in the app.
- Media: download the active Reel or Story, choose media quality, use a browser or the built-in downloader, and optionally trigger downloads from copied links. Repost active Reels and Stories through the Facebook Page posting flow.
- Video: resume playback position and optionally keep the current video playing in the background.
- Account: export and restore Facebook login-session files.
- Module: show or hide the launcher icon without disabling the module.

Ad blocking, external browsing, browser downloads and contextual download buttons default ON. Other optional switches default OFF.

Ad-family settings are independent, but methods shared by Stories and Reels may require both ad switches to be enabled. Feed-filter coverage depends on the hooks available in your Facebook version; hiding many suggestions can slow feed loading.

Settings and restarting Facebook

The settings app has a home/status screen, separate feature pages, Diagnostics and About. It follows your system light/dark theme and uses wallpaper colors on Android 12 or newer.

After changing a feature setting or successfully importing a session, tap Restart in the bottom bar on Home or any feature page. The module waits for participating Facebook processes to exit before reopening Facebook. Pending changes survive closing or recreating the settings app; edits made during a restart remain pending.

If a restart cannot be confirmed, changes remain pending. Open Facebook and retry, or force-stop Facebook manually before reopening it.

Account backups

Export saves Facebook's live authentication/login-session files to Download/FacebookAppAdsRemover as FBAR-Session-*.json. Separately captured tokens and cookies are not added to the export.

Import latest restores the newest backup. Import from file lets you select a backup, including one copied from another device. After a successful import, tap Restart in the bottom bar.

Backups contain login credentials and can give access to your account. Keep them private and do not attach them to issue reports.

Diagnostics

Open Facebook before using Save report or Share report. Reports contain sanitized configuration and hook-discovery diagnostics, excluding raw activity and media payloads. Pending requests and private cached reports survive settings recreation, including while the system save picker is open.

When reporting a problem, include your Facebook version, framework version, the affected feature and a diagnostics report.

Hide the launcher icon

The Module page can hide the launcher icon. You can still reopen settings from the Xposed manager's module list. Hiding the icon does not disable Facebook's hooks.

On Pixel Launcher, searching for the module can still show an App Info entry even when its drawer icon is hidden.

Support and source
- Report a problem or request a feature
- Source code and technical documentation
- Support development...
modules.changelog:
Changes
- Added a Menu page in the module settings to hide Facebook menu entries, shortcuts, and sections, or show all entries.
- Added Material You accent colors for Facebook on Android 12+.
- Added Turn off HDR with decoder tone mapping and video-surface brightness limits where supported.
- Improved Block auto-refresh compatibility with Facebook 588.
- Added a Restart bar on Home and feature settings pages, and grouped related settings.
- Reduced the release APK size by shrinking unused UI libraries.

Version: 1.27 (versionCode 28).

All 266 unit tests passed. Actual HDR suppression still needs testing on an HDR-capable phone.

modules.name: Github-direct
modules.author: FxxkLocation
modules.description: Android Root/LSPosed networking module with fail-open DNS/TLS routing, IPv4/IPv6 support, and strict security boundaries.
modules.readme:
Github-direct

English | 简体中文

Github-direct is a selective network-connectivity module for Android Root and LSPosed environments. It combines pollution-resistant DNS, verified endpoint candidates, transparent TCP/TLS relaying, and fail-open protection in a data plane that is authorized per application.

GitHub is the stable baseline with completed end-to-end device validation. Google, YouTube, Discord, and OpenAI / ChatGPT are integrated into the same profile and routing system, but remain experimental, disabled by default, and require separate validation on each device and network.

Highlights
- Modern LSPosed module: built with LibXposed API 102 and compatible with API 101 or later.
- Explicit application scope: LSPosed hooks and the Root data plane are authorized separately; an empty Root scope never expands into global interception.
- Dynamic candidate system: combines trusted DNS, bundled safety snapshots, and bounded historical results, then verifies candidates with TCP, the system trust store, hostname checks, and endpoint semantics.
- Root transparent mode: intercepts only target DNS, TCP/443, and required QUIC fallback traffic for selected UIDs; IPv4 and IPv6 rules are probed and installed independently but roll back as one transaction.
- Original-destination recovery: reads SO_ORIGINAL_DST through JNI. Related redirection is disabled when the native capability is unavailable.
- TLS relay: parses multi-record ClientHello messages and routes by virtual IP, allowed SNI, or original destination; traffic is passed through unchanged when it cannot be classified safely.
- Optional browser TLS termination: restricted to browser/host UIDs explicitly authorized a second time, with a per-device CA, strict upstream certificate and hostname validation, and controlled suffix boundaries.
- Fail-open lifecycle: removes this module's GHD_* rules when capability probing, listeners, installation, or verification fails; an independent guardian cleans stale state after abnormal termination.
- Observability: displays the active generation, Root UID, candidate counts, hook heartbeat, DNS hits, and stable failure stages.

How it works

1. Managed DNS returns virtual or verified real addresses only for domains in enabled profiles.
2. Root rules redirect only matching connections from selected applications to local listeners and always exclude the module's own UID.
3. The relay reads the ClientHello and original destination, then selects candidates from the current immutable route snapshot.
4. Candidate connections preserve the real target hostname and enforce the public certificate chain and hostname checks. The normal path neither decrypts nor rewrites HTTPS content.
5. A new rule generation is published only after the listeners, iptables rules, and snapshot pass verification; failures roll back to the native network path.

Compatibility

| Component | Current scope |
| --- | --- |
| Android | Android 8.0+; initial device-validation range is Android 12–16; minSdk=26, targetSdk=36 |
| LSPosed | Modern API 101+; compiled against API 102 |
| Root | Magisk / KernelSU with working su, iptables, owner matching, and REDIRECT |
| IPv6 | Intercepted only when ip6tables nat/OUTPUT, owner, REDIRECT, save/restore, and the IPv6 listener all pass capability checks |
| ABI | arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 |
| Native page size | 16 KiB ELF LOAD alignment |
| Network scope | HTTPS/TCP 443; UDP/443 is handled only to make selected targets fall back from QUIC to TCP |

Installation and use

1. Download and install the APK from Releases.
2. Enable the module in LSPosed, select only the applications that need it, then force-stop and restart those applications.
3. Open Github-direct and grant Root access. Select the same applications in the Root scope.
4. Prefer Auto (Root first). Devices without Root can use VPN mode.
5. Enable embedded-runtime full TLS capture for a host only when its WebView, Cronet, or embedded Chromium traffic is not covered by the normal path.
6. Enable platform profiles as needed and confirm that the status page shows a running Root service, an active generation, usable candidates, and no failure stage.

Backend modes
- Auto: prefers the transparent Root backend when all required capabilities pass, otherwise falls back to an available mode.
- Root transparent: installs bounded per-UID iptables rules without occupying Android's VPN slot.
- VPN: uses Android VpnService for devices without Root or with incomplete Root netfilter support.
- Xposed (DNS + Root relay): the hook provides in-process DNS handling while the Root backend handles transparent connection relaying.

Platform status

| Profile | Status | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GitHub | Validated baseline | Browser, HTTPS Git, API, Raw, static assets, and Release downloads have completed device validation |
| Google | Experimental | Disabled by default; sign-in and individual clients require separate validation |
| YouTube | Experimental | Disabled by default; page assets and video-media paths must be validated separately |
| Discord | Experimental | Discord Web and QR-login WebSocket have device results; the native client has not completed end-to-end acceptance |
| OpenAI / ChatGPT | Experimental | Disabled by default; network reachability does not guarantee account or regional-policy acceptance |

Optional CA and TLS termination

The normal candidate and ClientHello-fragmentation paths do not require a CA. Consider TLS termination only for browser traffic when visible-SNI and pass-through relaying are insufficient:
- The CA is generated per device; its private key remains in app-private storage, is Root-owned, and uses mode 0600.
- The public CA must be read back and verified from the Android trust store before use.
- Termination is bounded simultaneously by selected UIDs, enabled profiles, and explicit domain suffixes.
- Upstream connections must still pass public-chain, real-hostname, and profile-required ECH or semantic validation....

- 修复部分 legacy/nft iptables -S 实现重排 owner、目标地址与协议参数时，Root 透明后端将已安装规则误判为缺失的问题。
- 防火墙校验与健康检查改为比较规则语义字段：链、UID、目标地址、协议、端口和跳转目标。

modules.name: HOOKUI,No Code, dyamic analaysis
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: HOOKUI,No Code, dyamic analaysis
modules.readme:
HOOKUI
有精简版和完整版，支持js 动态hook。
最近更新

最近更新的版本在看雪论坛,支持 ai 玩法,能通过腾讯的codebuddy直接 言出法随的分析,无需学习成本,就能动态修改界面文字  写hook代码 .
https://bbs.kanxue.com/thread-288882.htm

是什么
是一款xposed插件,必须依赖xposed框架环境,root机环境有LSxposed,xposed framework,edposed,,非root有virtual app,以及类似多开平行空间的一些软件 ,基于app直接修改植入xposed framework的有太极,还有我开发的神之手.goodhand文档 （不再更新，篡改软件原理不推荐!不过在愿景来看可以对流氓软件做载入xposed内置的操作行为）
它能快速跟踪一些行为从而找到破解的思路,就像window破解一样,也有类似的 如hook window api 的某些函数,hook io文件打开,注册表行为.而这个hookui也类似,对一些敏感行为可进行追踪拦截,可追踪调用堆栈,另外还支持hook 记忆，内存窥探，动态修改，还支持js hook
1.9.0已经支持，但是由于作者资金不足，身体等各方面原因 已经放弃操作了1年,老版本的hook api作废，新版本将尽力保持和xposed api一样，这样减少学习成本。
2024年12月重启项目，现在已经跑通的hook代码如下：
XposedBridge.hookMethod("android.view.View", "onTouchEvent", function(param, phase) {
    if (phase === "before") {

		log.v("before");
		var Arrays = Packages.java.util.Arrays;
		let xparam= param.getArguments();
		log.v(xparam);
		    let args = param.getArguments();
       log.v("onTouchEvent 调用前 ,ARG LEN:"+Arrays.toString(args));

     // args[0] = "Modified Arg";
      param.setArguments(args);
	    log.v("onTouchEvent 调用前 ,--------"+args.length);
    } else if (phase === "after") {
        log.v("onTouchEvent 调用堆栈"+ log.getStackTraceString());
    }
});

HOOKUI作者本人喜欢拿来做什么
1.作者曾经通过HOOKUI做了很多不可告人的事情,作者本人常用的爆破策略是追踪点击,布局事件,和敏感字符串的源头来针对性的做hook功能.
2.作者也曾经通过HOOKUI随性破解破解一些没什么验证的收费SE直播,倒计时自动关闭视频直接拦截对方法进行屏蔽的操作.也通过它直接改手机余额,来告诉那些拜金女小心骗子.
3.作者因为对某些共享wifi软件没有记忆功能从而导致下次连接需要网络才能连接,还针对性的研发了wifi密码记忆功能.这样连一个记住一个还能看到密码

支持的功能
hook和字段编辑
支持自定义填写要hook的类,支持方法参数调用,支持批量修改列表数据,支持修改字段,实例,内存漫游字段修改,支持字符串,触摸事件,窗口创建,布局设置堆栈追踪打印.
支持开启web服务,下载任意应用内数据,支持web端做一些hook操作(此功能是移植inspect,不过兼容没有root的手机)
其它功能
支持webview注入,显示webview hook菜单(调用js,查看源码)
支持activity序列化保存,

愿景

modules.name: BBZQ
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: BBZQ
modules.readme:
BBZQ
使用 Modern API、由 Kotlin 全量编写的哔哩哔哩增强 Xposed 模组

简介
BBZQ 是一款适配 Modern API 的哔哩哔哩功能增强模组，采用 Kotlin 完整实作，旨在去除不必要内容、优化核心体验，同时提供各类实用功能。
模组通过 META-INF/xposed/java_init.list 完成入口注册，核心逻辑入口为 io.github.bbzq.BbzqModule；配套设置页面内嵌于哔哩哔哩宿主应用外，方便快捷开关各项功能、调整个性化参数，整体架构便于后续迭代维护与功能扩展。

版本适配说明

本模组要求 Android 9.0（API 28）及以上，仅适配哔哩哔哩 9.0.0 及以上版本（包括概率版）。

| 模块版本    | 哔哩哔哩版本 |
| ------- | ------ |
| v1.0.1  | 8.97.0 |
| v1.0.2  | 8.98.0 |
| v1.0.3  | 8.99.0 |
| v1.1.0+ | 9.0.0+ |
| v1.5.0+ | 9.15.0（9.10.0 以前版本不再重点适配） |
说明：
v1.0.3 的 CI 构建版本推荐 9.0.0。
从 v1.1.0 开始，模组将仅适配 9.0.0 及以上版本。

v1.5.0 更换了签名密钥，无法直接覆盖安装 v1.4.1 及更早版本。请先在旧版「关于 → 配置备份」中导出配置，卸载旧版后安装新版，再导入配置。

使用方式

1. 安装模组 APK
2. 在支持 Modern API 的 Xposed 框架中启用该模组
3. 将哔哩哔哩加入作用域
4. 重启目标应用
5. 进入 我的 → 设置 → 关于哔哩哔哩 → BBZQ 设置
6. 启用需要的功能

避坑提示： 请勿使用 Hide My Applist (HMA) 等应用隐藏模组去对「哔哩哔哩」或「BBZQ」启用隐藏列表，否则会导致功能失效或应用崩溃。
參考 https://github.com/HSSkyBoy/BBZQ/issues/5 和 https://github.com/HSSkyBoy/BBZQ/issues/17
桌面图标是模组自身介绍页，不是独立的调试工具。
双击 版本 有隐藏的秘密。

免 Root 支援

本模组已集成 NPatch-Remote-API：
- 免 Root 环境下推荐使用 NPatch（v1.0.7 或更高版本）。
- 支持直接在桌面打开 BBZQ 独立应用修改各项设置，配置将通过 NPatch 管理器的 Remote Store 自动双向同步至目标应用，无需重新打包或每次进入宿主应用设置。

功能
反正就是非常多, 具体请前往 HSSkyBoy/BBZQ 查看

已知限制
- 不再适配旧国际版(白色图示版)，9.10.0 以前版本不再重点适配
- 设置入口依赖宿主设置页结构，大版本更新后可能不会及时适配

许可证

本项目使用木兰公共许可证，第 2 版（Mulan PubL v2）。
完整授权见 LICENSE。

modules.readme:
Bypasser

This is a developing rooting-layer system module for systematically bypassing environment detection related to LRFP for Android devices, where the abbreviation "LRFP" stands for Low-level, Rooting, Frameworks, and Plugins.

This module will only take effect when users install it or click the action button. The currently supported features are as follows.
- Welcome (0b00000X): Perform built-in configurations for this module.
- Update (0b0000X0): Perform regular dynamic updates for actionA.sh/actionB.sh, the specified generator, and the web UI, including the database. Network access to GitHub is required.
- Zygisk Traces (0b000X00): Deploy correct configurations for different Zygisk solutions according to the Zygisk implementation, Shamiko, NoHello, and Zygisk Assistant modules used.
- HMA Configurations (0b00X000): Generate relevant configurations for HMA and its variants based on the cloud database and local packages. Remove old configuration directories of HMA and its variants if the action is confirmed by users. Users are required to manually import the configurations via HMA or one of its variants.
- Tricky Store Configurations (0b0X0000): Generate configurations for Tricky Store and its variants, including TEESimulator 4.x that uses a JSON file, based on the cloud database. The configurations will be written directly to the corresponding files.
- Shell (0bX00000): Perform some shell commands. Please check actionA.sh for details.
- Disable sensitive applications automatically installed by Google.
- Handle sensitive policies and properties.
- Disable adb_root and enable selinux_hide if ksud is available.
- Check whether the kernel version involves banned strings.
- Check whether the ROM is signed with release keys.
- Check whether the build type is user.
- Patch /etc/compatconfig/services-platform-compat-config.xml.
- Enable the feature to hide desktop icons on devices running Android 10 or above.
- Enforce SELinux (Use setenforce 0 to switch to permissive temporarily if necessary).

Please be aware that this module will only optimize the rooting and injection environments based on the current environments.
This module will not include, install, enable, disable, or uninstall any other modules or plugins.
It is highly recommended to handle the environments according to https://github.com/LRFP-Team/LRFP/tree/main/Bypassers before using this module.
For users using KernelSU or one of its variants, patching /etc/compatconfig/services-platform-compat-config.xml will only take effect if a metamodule is installed.
Meanwhile, please only install a metamodule when other rooting-layer system modules require modification of the /system partition.

The implementation and bypassing of these environments should be challenging and complex procedures.
Users should learn related knowledge before taking these actions.
Relying on one-key solutions or paying others for remote or onsite LRFP environment implementation, detection, or bypassing without knowing the principles is incorrect.

The updates for this module can be divided into module updates and regular updates. All module updates are written in ./Release instead of GitHub releases.
Unless otherwise specified, regular updates by pressing the action button in the root manager are adequate to keep up with the latest bypassing solutions.
Users can also use the web UI to update the specified shell script, which is also part of regular updates.
Whether an update commit is a module update or a regular update, the time in the commit message is always based on HKT (UTC+8).

Build

If you want to build the module for testing purposes on your own, please use git clone to clone this repository to your local device.
Execute ./build.sh in the root directory of the local repository after you check carefully and grant suitable execution permissions.
Submit modifications via a pull request (PR) if you wish to.

Regarding the C++ compilation, Android C++ compilers (that are adapted to your Android device) should be used to compile.
For additional compilation warnings and information, please consider g++ with -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic or Visual Studio with /W4. However, the binaries produced may not run on Android devices.
Anyway, no matter what the compiler is, please ensure that C++17 (e.g., -std=c++17) or later is used during the compilation, as the code depends on the filesystem library and the inline feature.

Acknowledgement

Here, we express our faithful gratitude to all LRFP-related developers, especially the developers of different rooting solutions and the detailed guidelines for rooting-layer system module development.

We also sincerely thank @pumPCin for providing old configuration directories of HMA and its variants in https://github.com/pumPCin/HMAL/issues/50.

Licensing

This repository is under the GPL-3.0 license.
You can regard this repository as an alternative rooting-layer system module template or a template GitHub repository for rooting-layer system module development.
The A/B architecture is implemented for the dynamic updating of action.

Warning

Since the project is still developing, please do not install this module for daily use until this warning is removed.

modules.readme:
Dialer Framework
Dialer Framework Magisk Module for using Google Dialer / Google Phone.
This module should work on almost any version of Android.

This is not associated with Google Inc. in any way.

This Magisk module installs the Dialer Framework for Google Phone.
It will NOT install the Google Dialer / Google Phone application, but you can then easily install it through the Play Store.
If you're already able to install the Google Phone app from the Play Store and are not getting an error message when opening the app, then you don't need this module.
Updates for Google Phone can also be installed through the Play Store when using this module.

After version 4, it also features the "PIXEL_EXPERIENCE" feature for the device, in order to remove the "This device is unsupported and calls may not work correctly" message.

Downloading
The downloads can be found at: https://github.com/Magisk-Modules-Repo/GoogleDialerFramework/releases
To download the latest release as an installable ZIP file, expand the "Assets" section and click GoogleDialerFramework-v**.zip to download the ZIP.
After you've downloaded the ZIP, you can install it using the Magisk app.
Please also see the *Instructions* below for how to install the module and setup Google Dialer.

Instructions
- Download the Dialer Framework Magisk Module using the instructions above
- Install the Dialer Framework Magisk Module using the Magisk app
- Clear Google Play Store Data (if Google Phone can't be installed via the Play Store)
- (Possibly also clear Google Play Services Data)
- Restart Phone or Restart Play Store
- Install Google Phone from Play Store
- Set Google Phone as the Default Dialer

Installing Google Phone
After you've installed the Magisk module, you can easily install Google Phone from the Play Store:\
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.dialer \
If the Play Store says that the app isn't compatible with your device, then clean your Play Store data and restart your phone.

You can also install the Google Phone APK from APKMirror: https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/google-inc/google-phone/

Issues
- Some people reported that the voicemail tab isn't showing for them: https://github.com/Magisk-Modules-Repo/GoogleDialerFramework/issues/11
- Some people reported that the module causes Bluetooth audio to fail: https://github.com/Magisk-Modules-Repo/GoogleDialerFramework/issues/6

modules.name: Unicode Font Set - 字体集
modules.author: Losketch
modules.description: Expand Android font fallback coverage for Unicode characters. / 扩充 Android 字体回退，实现 Unicode 字形覆盖。 GitHub project URL: https://github.com/Losketch/UnicodeFontSet-magisk-module.
modules.readme:
Magisk 模块：扩展 Unicode 字体合集（UFS-Magisk）

UFS 是一个面向已 Root 设备的字体扩展模块。它整合了多套开源字体并无缝接入 Android 系统的字体回退（fallback）链中，用于补全系统中大量缺失的字符（涵盖冷僻汉字、古文字、符号及最新 Emoji 等）。

模块原生支持 Magisk、KernelSU 及 APatch，并针对其它字体模块共存与系统 OTA 更新做了自动兼容适配。

安装指引

1. 下载模块
前往 Releases 页面 下载对应版本的安装包：
- CBDT 格式：适用于 Android 8.0+ (API 26+)
- COLRv1 格式：适用于 Android 13+ (API 33+)，推荐较新系统使用以获得更好的彩色 Emoji/符号渲染

2. 刷入并配置
在模块管理器（Magisk / KernelSU / APatch）中选择安装包进行刷入：
- 音量上键：跳过 cmap 清理（推荐普通用户选择，耗时极短）。
- 音量下键：执行 cmap 清理（深度去重，降低字符被意外字体截胡的概率）。
- 15 秒无操作：默认自动跳过清理。

3. 重启生效
刷入完成后，重启手机即可生效。

基础配置

绝大多数用户开箱即用，无需修改任何配置。如需微调，可通过以下配置文件实现：

1. 特殊分区 XML 模式 (SPECIAL_PARTITION_XML_MODE)
配置文件路径：/data/adb/ufs/config.conf

在 KernelSU 或 APatch 环境下，系统中的 /system/product 或 /system/system_ext 可能为符号链接（Symlink）。为避免模块目录遮蔽符号链接导致系统启动异常，模块默认采用安全策略：
- safe（默认）：检测到目标为符号链接时自动安全降级，跳过在特殊分区挂载 UFS 专有 XML。
- force：强制使用标准 Magisk 布局挂载特殊分区。仅在你确认所用的挂载方式/Metamodule 能够安全处理特殊分区时启用，否则可能导致 Bootloop。

快速切换命令：
切换为强制模式（需 Root 权限）
su -c 'mkdir -p /data/adb/ufs && echo "SPECIAL_PARTITION_XML_MODE=force" > /data/adb/ufs/config.conf'

恢复默认安全模式
su -c 'mkdir -p /data/adb/ufs && echo "SPECIAL_PARTITION_XML_MODE=safe" > /data/adb/ufs/config.conf'
修改后执行一次模块 Action 或重启设备即可生效。

2. 字体策略文件 (font-policy.tsv)
文件路径：模块目录/config/font-policy.tsv

用于指定具体字体的映射保留与删除规则。每行一个字体，采用 TAB（制表符） 分隔：
rolefont filenameprotectremove

| 字段 | 说明 | 示例 |
|---|---|---|
| role | normal-fallback（普通补字） / terminal-fallback（最终兜底） / system-overlay（同名替换原厂字体） | normal-fallback |
| font filename | 字体文件名 | PlangothicP2-Regular.otf |
| protect | 保留指定字符映射，不被前序字体去重清除（- 为空，* 为全选） | [U+0080-U+009F] |
| remove | 强制删除指定字符的 cmap 映射（与 protect 冲突时 remove 优先） | [e000-f8ff] |
仅高级用户需要调整此文件。修改后建议重新运行 Action 或重新刷入模块。

兼容性与故障排查

模块未生效？
1. 重启设备一次。
2. 在模块管理器中找到 UFS，点击执行 Action（重新整理字体 XML 配置）。
3. 检查排查日志：
      /data/adb/modules/unicode_font_set/ufs.log
   4. 如果是 KernelSU / APatch 用户且日志显示“挂载安全降级”，表明已自动保护系统符号链接。

Magisk DenyList（排除列表）与应用闪退/缺字
若某个被加入 DenyList 的应用开启了「模块挂载隔离（Mount Isolation）」，Magisk 会在该应用的挂载空间内隐藏模块文件。这可能导致该 App 读取到了系统的字体配置文件，却无法访问模块内的字体文件，进而产生缺字、乱码或启动闪退。

排查建议：
1. 检查异常应用是否加入了 DenyList。
2. 尝试临时调整隔离策略或使用 FontLoader 等辅助方案。

其它字体模块冲突
- UFS 会自动检测并与其它字体模块共存。在发生冲突时，UFS 会自动备份冲突文件。
- 请勿直接“禁用”模块：如果不想继续使用 UFS，请执行标准卸载，以便模块卸载脚本恢复此前备份的其它模块文件。

常见问题 (FAQ)

Q: 如何验证模块是否生效？
可以在浏览器或笔记应用中直接查看扩展字符（例如生僻古籍字、Unicode 扩展汉字、特殊表情符号）。如果原先显示的“豆腐块”（□）已正确渲染为相应字形，即表示生效。

Q: cmap cleaner（清理器）是否有必要运行？
对于大多数用户，直接按音量上键跳过即可。只有当你发现某些特定字符/Emoji 的样式被不喜欢的字体抢先匹配显示时，再在刷入时按音量下键执行深度清理。

Q: 卸载后提示有残留锁文件？
正常卸载通常会自动清理。如需手动重置状态，可执行：
su -c rm -rf /data/adb/ufs_lock /data/adb/ufs

文档与支持
- 📄 字体来源与许可协议
- 🙏 致谢与第三方项目
- 🛠️ 开发与编译指南
免责声明：本模块按“原样”提供。替换系统字体及修改系统配置存在一定风险，刷入前请自行做好系统备份，并自行承担使用风险。

modules.readme:
XPrivacyLua
===========

Really simple to use privacy manager for Android 6-12 (successor of XPrivacy).

Revoking Android permissions from apps often let apps crash or malfunction.
XPrivacyLua solves this by feeding apps fake data instead of real data.

Features
- Simple to use
- Manage any user or system app
- Extensible
- Multi-user support
- Free and open source

Restrictions
- Determine activity (fake unknown activity, see here)
- Get applications (hide installed apps and widgets)
- Get calendars (hide calendars)
- Get call log (hide call log)
- Get contacts (hide contacts with the pro option to allow (non) starred contacts, hide blocked numbers)
- Get location (fake location, hide NMEA messages)
- Get messages (hide MMS, SMS, SIM, voicemail)
- Get sensors (hide all available sensors)
- Read account name (fake name, mostly e-mail address)
- Read clipboard (fake paste)
- Read identifiers (fake build serial number, Android ID, advertising ID, GSF ID)
- Read notifications (fake status bar notifications)
- Read network data (hide cell info, Wi-Fi networks, fake Wi-Fi network name)
- Read sync data (hide sync data)
- Read telephony data (fake IMEI, MEI, SIM serial number, voicemail number, etc)
- Record audio (prevent recording)
- Record video (prevent recording)
- Send messages (prevent sending MMS, SMS, data)
- Use analytics (Fabric/Crashlytics, Facebook app events, Firebase Analytics, Google Analytic, Mixpanel, Segment)
- Use camera (fake camera not available and/or hide cameras)
- Use tracking (fake user agent for WebView only, Build properties, network/SIM country/operator)

The tracking restrictions will work only if the code of the target app was not obfuscated.
The other restrictions will work always.

Hide or fake?
- Hide: return empty list
- Fake: return empty or fake value

It is possible to add custom restriction definitions, see this FAQ for details.

You can see all technical details here.

Notes
- Some apps will start the camera app to take pictures. This cannot be restricted and there is no need for this, because only you can take pictures in this scenario, not the app.
- Some apps will use OpenSL ES for Android to record audio, an example is WhatsApp. Xposed cannot hook into native code, so this cannot be prevented.
- The get applications restriction will not restrict getting information about individual apps for stability and performance reasons.
- The telephony data restriction will result in apps seeing a fake IMEI. However, this doesn't change the IMEI address of your device.
- Restricting activity recognition (location) results for recent Google Maps versions and possibly other apps in the error *... java.lang.ClassNotFoundException ...* for unknown reasons.

Compatibility

XPrivacyLua is supported on Android 6.0 Marshmallow and later.
For Android 4.0.3 KitKat to Android 5.1.1 Lollipop you can use XPrivacy (unsupported though).

XPrivacyLua is supported for smartphones and tablets only. XPrivacyLua is not supported on emulators.

Hooking *com.google.android.gms.location.ActivityRecognitionResult.extractResult* (restriction *Determine activity*)
is known to fail with *script:25 vm error: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: com.google.android.gms.location.DetectedActivity*
and *script:28 attempt to call nil* for some apps, like Google Maps and NetFlix, for yet unknown reasons.

Installation
- Install Magisk
- Android 6-7: download, install, and activate Xposed
- Android 8-12: download, install, and activate LSPosed ~~or EdXposed~~
- Download, install, and activate XPrivacyLua

LSPosed: please make sure that any app you want to restrict is in the 'scope' of LSposed.

- MD5: 42:93:4F:A4:D5:AC:53:7B:04:97:3B:29:A6:6E:7B:B3
- SHA1: 10:62:0A:E9:61:D7:88:54:F6:C9:CD:87:2C:43:88:23:28:49:C7:99
- SHA256: 5E:69:9C:5D:AF:61:2C:AB:71:3A:35:BB:38:7C:F6:A8:86:8C:A0:DD:5D:CE:B4:CE:C1:53:8E:82:65:21:95:77

Frequently Asked Questions

See here for a list of often asked questions.

Support

Only the XPrivacyLua version released in the Xposed repository is supported.

XPrivacyLua with Island, etc is not supported.
- For support on Xposed, please go here
- For support on XPrivacyLua, please go here

Donations

See here about how you can donate.

Contributing

*Documentation*

Contributions to this document and the frequently asked questions
are prefered in the form of pull requests.

*Translations*
- You can translate the in-app texts of XPrivacyLua here
- You can download the in-app texts of XPrivacyLua Pro for translation here
- If your language is not listed, please send a message through this contact form

*Source code*

Building XPrivacyLua from source code is straightforward with Android Studio.
It is expected that you can solve build problems yourself, so there is no support on building.

Source code contributions are prefered in the form of pull requests.
Please contact me first to tell me what your plans are.

Please note that you agree to the license below by contributing, including the copyright.

modules.readme:
抖仙人

面向抖音 Android 客户端的 LSPosed Modern API 102 纯净播放模块。播放视频时只保留视频画面，
暂停后恢复完整界面，并支持下载当前无水印视频或 MP3 音频和自定义内容跳过规则。

主要功能
- 功能总开关：关闭后停止所有模块功能，并恢复抖音原有界面和操作；各子开关配置保留。
- 独立的“沉浸式播放”开关：关闭后保留原界面，内容过滤、双击拦截和暂停下载仍可使用。
- 可选“禁用屏幕双击”：拦截视频画面的原生双击事件，保留单击、滑动及侧边长按。
- 可选“双击打开评论区”：双击视频画面直接展开抖音原生评论区，同时拦掉点赞与爱心动画。
- 播放视频时隐藏视频画面以外的抖音界面和系统栏。
- 沉浸播放时屏蔽隐藏按钮及其子控件的触摸响应；点击原按钮位置也只会暂停并恢复完整界面。
- 保留侧面长按的原生快进／快退手势及上下滑动切换视频，屏蔽中间长按菜单。
- 可选择在纯净播放时保留抖音原生弹幕；40.8 起弹幕由 Compose、Functor、Canvas 多个渲染层
  组成，模块按整层保留，不再只放行其中一层。
- 暂停视频时立即恢复完整界面和视频页原始布局，避免介绍被底部菜单栏遮挡；继续播放后再次进入纯净模式。
- 暂停后在右侧操作栏顶部显示半透明下载按钮：普通视频可选择“视频（无水印 MP4）”或
  “音频（MP3）”，图文作品可选择“图片（无水印）”，全部保存到系统 Download 目录。
- 可在模块设置页分别配置是否跳过广告、图文、直播和普通视频。
- 可选“视频清晰度”：固定每个视频播放的清晰度（自动／360P／480P／540P／720P／1080P／2K／4K／最高），
  选定后抖音不再根据网络或其他条件自动升降清晰度档位；视频没有该档位时就近选择。
  无水印下载同样按该清晰度取对应码率档位的视频，并优先选 H.264／HEVC 等系统播放器能解码的
  编码，避免最高档只有抖音私有 ByteVC1 编码时下载出“只有声音没有画面”的文件。
- 支持按关键词匹配普通视频的标题或介绍，命中后自动切换到下一条；关键词忽略英文大小写，
  可使用换行、逗号或分号分隔。
- 默认跳过广告、图文和直播，保留普通视频；关键词默认为空。

兼容范围

| 项目 | 当前支持 |
| --- | --- |
| LSPosed API | Modern API 102 |
| 已验证抖音版本 | 39.7.0（versionCode 390701） |
| 本次触摸回归验证 | 抖音 40.3.0（versionCode 400301）／Android 16 |
| 暂停布局回归验证 | 抖音 40.4.0（versionCode 400401）／Android 16 |
| Android | 9（API 28）及以上 |
| 默认作用域 | com.ss.android.ugc.aweme |
| 模块包名 | com.zz.douyin |
| 本次适配设备 | 抖音 41.0.0（versionCode 410001）／Android 17 |
| 模块版本 | 1.7.6 |

模块基于抖音 39.7.0 的运行时结构适配，并针对 40.5.0 补充双击拦截、40.8.0 补充弹幕分层、
广告标记与图文渲染适配、40.9.0 补充图文图片下载、41.0.0 适配固定清晰度（模型类直挂 +
预加载层钉死）。抖音升级后，播放器类、数据模型或界面层级
可能变化，届时需要重新适配。

安装

1. 从 dist 目录下载最新版
   douxianren-lsp-api102-v1.7.6.apk。
2. 在手机上安装 APK。
3. 在 LSPosed 中启用“抖仙人”模块。
4. 保持默认作用域“抖音”，然后强制停止并重新打开抖音。

从 1.4.1 起模块包名调整为 com.zz.douyin。它会作为新应用与旧包名版本并存，升级后请在
LSPosed 中重新启用新包名模块并确认作用域。

最新版 APK 的 SHA-256：

c3d8e261c723f865127384f220ce39ecf598a245769c5bfa9e24ef47659e0c4d

使用方式
- “功能总开关”和“沉浸式播放”默认开启，“禁用屏幕双击”和“双击打开评论区”默认关闭。
  关闭总开关时，内容过滤、自动切换、沉浸隐藏、手势拦截和下载入口全部停止生效；后台 MP3
  转换会取消。
- 开启“双击打开评论区”后，双击画面等价于点击右侧评论按钮；它优先于“禁用屏幕双击”，
  两个开关同时打开时按打开评论区处理。
- 单独关闭“沉浸式播放”只恢复抖音原有界面，不影响其他功能。开启时“播放弹幕”设置才影响画面。
- 正常播放视频时，模块自动进入纯净播放模式；可在模块设置页开启或关闭“播放弹幕”。
- 点击视频暂停后，完整界面与右侧下载按钮会恢复显示。
- 沉浸播放时，在屏幕左右各四分之一范围长按可继续使用抖音原生快进／快退手势；
  隐藏的点赞、评论、收藏、分享、导航等按钮不会响应点击，暂停恢复界面后可正常使用。
- 打开“抖仙人”应用，可分别开关播放弹幕，以及广告、图文、直播和视频过滤；设置通过
  LSPosed Remote Preferences 同步到抖音进程。
- “视频清晰度”默认为“自动”，即抖音原生行为。选择具体档位后，每个视频按该清晰度播放：
  优先精确匹配，没有该档位时选不高于它的最大档，再没有就选可用的最低档；“最高”始终选
  当前视频支持的最高清晰度。修改后从下一条视频起生效，播放中的视频不强制重载。
  无水印下载使用同一套选档规则：从作品的 bit_rate 码率档位里取目标档位的无水印地址，
  下载弹窗会显示将要使用的清晰度（如“视频（无水印 MP4 · 540p）”）；清晰度为“自动”时
  下载行为与旧版一致。选定档位时会先排除没有画面尺寸的音轨条目和只有 ByteVC1 的档位，
  再在同档位里按 H.264 → HEVC → ByteVC1 的顺序取地址；如果最高档只有 ByteVC1，会退到
  低一档的系统可播放编码，下载弹窗显示实际使用的清晰度。
- 在“视频关键词”中填写不想观看的词语并保存，普通视频的 item_title、title 或 desc
  包含任意关键词时会自动跳过。
- 点击“下载”按钮选择视频、音频或图片。音频从当前视频的完整音轨解码为 PCM 后编码为 MP3，
  保留当前视频实际声音；不直接下载背景音乐，也不通过修改扩展名伪装格式。
- 图文作品只提供图片入口：它会带一个用于背景音乐和过渡动画的占位 video，按视频或音频
  下载只会得到无效数据。图集图片优先取 watermark_free_download_url_list 的原图链，
  按原始顺序保存为 douyin___.jpg（PNG／GIF 保留原扩展名）；
  AVIF／HEIC／WebP 会先校验并转成 JPEG，避免相册显示“格式乱码”。
- 下载和转码在后台执行，开始、转换阶段及完成结果通过 Toast 提示。失败时清理未完成文件。
- 下载完成的文件位于系统 Download 目录。

实现说明
- 播放状态通过 TTVideoEngine、TTVideoEngineImplV2 及其
  VideoEngineListener 回调进行跟踪。
- 清晰度锁定分两层实现。引擎层：TTVideoEngine.setVideoModel 等模型入口把
  VideoModel 交给引擎后，模块把 getVideoInfoList、getSupportResolutions 及所有返回
  VideoInfo 的查询（含混淆名方法）统一钉到目标清晰度对应的档位，并尽量保持引擎原本
  要求的编码格式，同时关闭 VideoRef.mEnableAdaptive。模型层：VideoModel 类在安装期
  直接挂钩，不依赖引擎入口触发（抖音 41.0 的预加载路径不再调用 setVideoModel，只有
  直接挂钩才能覆盖）。应用层：预加载的画质在 SimVideoUrlModel 里就被预选，模块在其
  首次方法调用时把 bitRate 列表替换成目标档位并同步 hitBitrate，预加载与播放共用这一份
  钉死结果。三层数据一致，抖音无论因网络还是预加载都无法选到其他档位。
  档位识别优先用 VideoInfo.mVHeight／SimVideoUrlModel 条目的 getVideoHeight()，
  缺失时依次解析 mResolutionStr／mDefinition／mQualityDesc 等分辨率字符串，
  不做 mQualityType 粗映射兜底。DASH 视频的音轨条目（mMediaType=1、宽高为 0、
  带误导性的 mResolution="360p" 字符串）会先被识别出来并原样保留、绝不参与档位
  竞争或被查询替换——过滤音轨会导致 DASH 视频完全无声。所有反射步骤独立容错，
  任何一步失败都退回抖音原生行为；日志输出每次钉死的可用档位与选择结果
  （quality pinned，音轨条目显示为 nonvideo/.../audio）。
- 1.7.3 修复部分 DASH 视频播放无声的问题：抖音 41.0 的 VideoModel.getVideoInfoList()
  把音轨和视频档位混在同一列表里，音轨条目带 mResolution="360p" 字符串，旧版把它
  误判成 360P 视频档位并按清晰度规则过滤掉，引擎拿到“无音轨”的列表就不会初始化音频
  输出。现在按 mMediaType 区分音轨并保留，声音恢复正常。
- 1.7.4 调整“视频清晰度”档位选择器为三行三列网格平铺，去掉横向滑动，所有档位直接可见。
- 1.7.6 修复开启“最高”画质后部分下载视频只有声音、图文图片格式乱码：
  ① video.bit_rate[] 里的 DASH 音轨条目高度为 0、宽度为 0，但 gear_name 仍带
  normal_1080_0 之类字样，旧版按 gear_name 解析高度会把音轨当成最高视频档位，
  下载到的自然只有声音；现在高度优先取 BitRate.getVideoHeight()／play_addr.height，
  宽高都为 0 的条目直接排除，并过滤 URL 带 /audio/、media-audio 的地址。
  ② 最高档常常只有抖音私有 ByteVC1 编码，系统相册和第三方播放器只能解出声音；现在先
  在没有 ByteVC1 的档位里选，同一档位内按 H.264 → HEVC → ByteVC1 排序。
  ③ 视频先写缓存文件，用 MediaExtractor 确认同时有视频轨和音轨、且系统有对应解码器
  后再写入 Download；缺轨道的候选自动尝试下一个地址，不会再保存“只有声音”的 mp4。
  ④ 图片优先用 watermark_free_download_url_list 原图链，下载后先用 BitmapFactory
  校验能否解码；AVIF／HEIC／WebP 转成 JPEG，PNG／GIF 保持原格式，避免把 CDN 返回的
  非 JPEG 数据直接存成 .jpg 造成“格式乱码”。
- 1.7.5 无水印下载按“视频清晰度”配置取流：从作品 video.bit_rate[] 码率档位（高度取
  BitRate.getVideoHeight()，缺失时回退 gear_name；bit_rate 为码率）读取各自的
  play_addr，用与播放一致的选档规则（精确 > 不超过目标的最大档 > 高于目标的最小档，
  同高度取码率高者）把目标档位排到下载候选最前；原有顶层 play_addr／
  play_addr_h264／play_addr_265／play_addr_bytevc1 作为兜底，其余档位按与目标的
  差距排后，目标档地址失效时自动降级重试。“自动”档保持原有行为。
- 视频地址依次从 play_addr、play_addr_h264、play_addr_265、play_addr_bytevc1
  中选择（配置清晰度后按上述规则优先取码率档位地址），不使用带水印的下载地址链。

modules.name: GramSieve-Telegram 过滤;跳转;编辑历史查看

modules.description: GramSieve-Telegram 过滤;跳转;编辑历史查看
modules.readme:
GramSieve

  面向 Telegram 官方 Play 版与官网 Android 客户端的增强 LSPosed/Xposed 模块

  An enhancement LSPosed/Xposed module for the official Telegram Play and website Android clients

  如果 GramSieve 对你有帮助，欢迎点一个 Star 支持项目 ⭐

  If GramSieve helps you, please consider leaving a Star.

现已支持 NPatch 加载！已在改包名 Telegram 13.2.2 上实测模块加载、登录后重开、文字防撤回与连续编辑历史。
NPatch loading is now supported! Device tests on a renamed Telegram 13.2.2 client cover module loading, reopening after login, text anti-recall and consecutive edit history.

安装与启动Setup

GramSieve 88 适配官方 Telegram 13.3.0（Play 版 73411、官网版 73419），并保留官方 13.2.2 的适配。请使用支持 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed 或兼容加载环境。
GramSieve 88 supports official Telegram 13.3.0 (Play build 73411 and website build 73419) and retains compatibility with official 13.2.2. Use LSPosed supporting libxposed API 102 or a compatible loading environment.

官方 13.2.2 已补齐 Premium 贴纸标签隐藏的映射依赖，但仍缺少符合条件的可见标签实测；未单独验证的可选功能不能视为全部通过。
Official 13.2.2 includes the missing mapping dependencies for hiding the Premium sticker tab, but a qualifying visible tab has not been tested on a device; optional features not individually verified are not certified as passing.

从 GramSieve 88 起，停止为 entinyGram、Plus Messenger、Nagram 等第三方 Telegram 客户端更新适配。官方 Telegram Play 和官网 Android 客户端继续适配。
GramSieve 88 ends compatibility updates for third-party Telegram clients such as entinyGram, Plus Messenger and Nagram. Compatibility updates continue for the official Telegram Play and website Android clients.

最后支持第三方客户端的模块版本为 GramSieve 13.2.2（构建号 85）。GramSieve 88 会在第三方客户端中显示停止支持提示和对应的历史版本。
The last module supporting third-party clients is GramSieve 13.2.2 (build 85). GramSieve 88 displays a discontinued-support notice and the corresponding historical versions in third-party clients.

安装模块后，在 LSPosed 中启用 GramSieve，并勾选使用的受支持客户端，然后重新打开该客户端。
After installing the module, enable GramSieve in LSPosed, select the supported client you use, and reopen that client.

使用 NPatch 时，在目标客户端的模块配置中选择 GramSieve，再重新打开该客户端。88 已在现有的改包名 Telegram 13.2.2 宿主验证加载；本次改包名 13.3.0 测试宿主未通过启动验收。
With NPatch, select GramSieve in the target client's module configuration, then reopen that client. Build 88 was verified to load in the existing renamed Telegram 13.2.2 host. The renamed 13.3.0 test host failed the startup check.

模块随 Telegram 运行，无需允许 GramSieve 自启动，也无需为本模块勾选“系统框架”作用域。
The module runs within Telegram; GramSieve autostart and the System Framework scope are not required.

“日志”页面提供性能记录，支持导出或通过系统分享发送日志文件；
The Logs page provides performance records and lets you export files or open the system share sheet.

预览、复制、导出和分享均自动脱敏，分享前仍可检查文件。
Previews, copies, exports, and shared files are automatically redacted; you can still review files before sharing.

使用教程Usage guide

在 Telegram 设置 → GramSieve → 使用教程，或当前聊天右上角 ⋮ → 聊天过滤规则 → 使用教程中查看中英文教程。
Open Telegram Settings → GramSieve → Usage guide, or a chat’s ⋮ → Chat filtering rules → Usage guide.

目录包含规则、搜索去杂、防撤回、编辑历史、翻译、媒体保存、空间与流量、消息标记、临时清理、配置迁移等专题；
The bilingual topics cover rules, focused search, anti-recall, edit history, translation, saving media, storage and data use, marks, temporary cleanup and configuration transfer.

界面语言可在“通用与诊断”选择跟随 Telegram、简体中文、English 或 Русский。
Under General & diagnostics, choose Follow Telegram, 简体中文, English or Русский for the module interface.

在“界面与菜单 → 菜单项目 → 消息长按菜单”中可开关“标记此消息”；默认显示，关闭后仍保留已有标记和跳转功能。
Under Interface & menus → Menu entries → Message long-press menu, toggle Mark this message; it is shown by default, and hiding it preserves existing marks and navigation.

先按自己的需要开启独立功能。
Enable the separate features you need.

消息过滤在本机执行；搜索、翻译、主动加载和媒体下载会使用网络。
Message filtering is local; search, translation, proactive loading and media downloads use the network.

防撤回与编辑历史只能保留实际收到并成功缓存的内容，开启设置不会补回所有已消失的记录。
Anti-recall and edit history retain content actually received and cached; enabling them does not recover every record already gone.

功能Features
- 仅本地过滤 — 所有过滤在设备上完成，无网络请求，数据不离开手机
  Local-only filtering — all filtering happens on-device; no network requests, no data leaves your phone
- 全局 + 单聊规则 — 全局设置宽泛规则，再针对特定聊天覆盖或排除
  Global + per-chat rules — set broad filters globally, then override or exclude specific chats
- 丰富的匹配目标 — 消息文字、媒体说明、内联按钮文字/链接、发送者名称/ID、聊天名称/ID
  Rich match targets — message text, media captions, inline button labels/URLs, sender names/IDs, chat names/IDs
- 白名单优先 — 排除规则始终优先于过滤规则，适合管理员、公告或信任联系人
  Whitelist wins first — exclusion rules always override filter rules; use them for admins, notices, or trusted contacts
- 一键重置规则 — 可一次清空全局与所有聊天的过滤规则，同时保留防撤回、编辑历史、消息标记、日志和功能设置
  One-tap rule reset — clear global and per-chat filter rules at once while preserving anti-recall, edit history, message marks, logs, and feature settings
- 三种过滤动作 — 本地隐藏、连续折叠合并计数、调试标记（测试用）
  Three filter actions — hide locally, merge consecutive collapsed messages with a count, or debug-mark (for testing)
- 屏蔽消息自动已读 — 新消息到达时，在能确认不会连带读掉正常消息的情况下自动推进已读；有其他正常未读或无法确认范围时保留未读，排除规则和调试标记不触发自动已读
  Auto-read filtered messages — advance the read position on incoming filtered messages only when normal unread messages will remain untouched; preserve unread state when other normal unread messages exist or the range cannot be verified, and never auto-read keep-rule or debug-mark matches
- 完全宿主化设置 — 不提供独立应用界面；全局配置和聊天配置都在 Telegram 内完成，界面跟随宿主主题，修改后自动保存并立即生效
  Fully host-native settings — provides no standalone app UI; global and per-chat settings live inside Telegram, follow the host theme, and save and apply changes automatically
- 分类设置与规则列表 — 按功能分类导航，屏蔽规则和保留例外分别管理，支持逐条启停、搜索、编辑和批量添加
  Categorized settings and rule lists — navigate by feature and manage block rules and keep exceptions separately, with individual toggles, search, editing and batch input
- 消息翻译 — 使用 Telegram 原生翻译服务，优先处理屏幕内消息；支持单条翻译、自动翻译及全局/群组/频道设置，原文在上、译文在下，目标语言可跟随界面或手动指定；翻译会向 Telegram 服务提交待翻译文本...

modules.name: Hide UserDebug, Test-Keys and LineageOS
modules.author: ez-me
modules.description: Change some props and "remove" LineageOS ones
modules.readme:
Hide UserDebug, Test-Keys and LineageOS

Change some props and "remove" LineageOS ones.

Description

Some Custom ROMs (like LineageOS) build their systems as userdebug which allows for easier debugging and ADB usage.

However, if you want to pass SafetyNet or any alternative, that can be a pain, due to Certified ROMs using user builds.

Also, some developers may use test-keys to sign their builds as opposed to release-keys, which is more of a security concern than anything. (Anyone can use the default test-keys to sign stuff, with the system just accepting those).

So, this module dynamically gets system props from the device and patches them to change userdebug to user and test-keys to release-keys.

Additionally, this module removes all LineageOS specific props, to prevent apps from identifying it by using them. This has a known issue; Over-the-Air updates don't work, which in my opinion is a small price to pay (and you can always just disable the module before tyring to update).

The module is confirmed to work in LineageOS 19 (Android 12L) with Magisk 25+.

Attribution

I took great inspiration from HuskyDG's hide_userdebug module which seems to be abandoned, and didn't seem to work for some prop values, so I made my own version.

modules.author: mexus
modules.description: Enables Leica camera features on Xiaomi 17 Ultra (nezha). Sets the Leica props and installs an LSPOSED companion that removes the non-working gallery frames, hides the Leica camera-ring settings, and renames the watermark to "XIAOMI 17 Ultra by Leica". modules.readme:
Leica Camera Enabler (Safe)

A Magisk/KernelSU module (+ bundled LSPOSED companion) that enables Leica features
for the Xiaomi 17 Ultra (nezha).

Features

Module (system props):
- Sets ro.theme_customize=LCC
- Sets ro.theme_leica=true
- Sets camera.debug.safe.check.disable=true

Bundled LSPOSED module (LeicaFramePatcher.apk, installed automatically on flash — see lsposed-module/):
- Removes the non-working Leica gallery frames from the picker (their working duplicates remain further down the list, so nothing is lost)
- Hides the Leica camera-island "Camera ring" settings this variant has no hardware for — both in the camera and in system Settings (the Photography Kit "Camera Grip" is left working)
- Renames the watermark device name to "XIAOMI 17 Ultra by Leica" in both the camera and the gallery editor
Requires ticking scope Camera + Gallery editor + Settings in the LSPOSED manager after install.

Project structure
- module/ — Magisk/KernelSU module payload (props, customize.sh, Magisk installer). The release zip is built from here.
- lsposed-module/ — the LSPOSED/Xposed companion (Gradle project). CI builds its APK and bundles it into the zip.
- .github/workflows/release.yml — builds the APK, assembles and verifies the flashable zip, and attaches it to tagged releases.

Credits & Attribution
- Discovery: Special thanks to Max Weinbach for discovering these flags.
- Original X Post by Max Weinbach
- Author: mexus

Requirements
- Xiaomi 17 Ultra (nezha), rooted with Magisk or KernelSU / KSU-Next
- A recent LSPOSED (Xposed API 100+ — the companion is a modern libxposed module)

Installation

1. Download the zip from the Releases page
   (use the Release asset, not the Actions "artifact" — that one is double-zipped by GitHub and won't flash).
2. Flash it in the Magisk app or KernelSU / KSU-Next manager. This applies the props
   and auto-installs the bundled LSPOSED APK (flashing runs inside Android, where pm is available).
3. Open LSPOSED → enable Leica Frame Patcher → set its scope to Camera + Gallery editor + Settings.
4. Reboot.
5. Clear Camera app data.
The LSPOSED enable + scope step (3) is manual — LSPOSED has no supported way to auto-enable a module.
If auto-install didn't run (e.g. recovery flash), install /data/adb/modules/leica_camera_enabler/LeicaFramePatcher.apk manually.

The LSPOSED module source and build details are in lsposed-module/.

modules.name: NoVPNDetect Enhanced
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: NoVPNDetect Enhanced
modules.readme:
English
NoVPNDetect Enhanced

Скрытие различных локальных обнаружений VPN через публичный API от приложений на android устройствах.

Описание:
Модуль использует методики данного модуля со значительным расширением возможностей. Перехватывается значительно большее количество публичных API, а так же C++ подход.
Модуль выводит в LSPosed лог все виды API к которому обращается приложение. Применяется к целевым приложениям в менеджере LSPosed.

Благодарности разработчикам ниже за нахождение различных путей обнаружений:
- VPN Detector
- YourVPNDead
- RKNHardering

Вы так же можете проверять эффективность модуля на этих приложениях, однако помните что практика(реальные приложения) это лучший путь тестирования.

Обратите внимание:
- Модуль не будет работать если у вас на устройстве установлен zygisk модуль PMPatch из Lucky Patcher для патчинга PackageManager. Приложения будут вылетать. Убедитесь что он не установлен на устройстве, можно заменить на lsposed вариант патчинга.
- Модуль не будет работать если у подключаемого приложения есть защита от LSPosed, проверка на инъекции в память. Например MirPay, Т-Банк.
- Модуль может не перехватывать некоторые низкоуровневые методики используемые приложениями построенными на кроссплатформенных фреймворках, включая webview(чистый web интерфейс).
- Модуль имеет возможность работать в режиме LSPatch. Не имеет настроек, достаточно пересобрать приложение. Приложение не должно иметь защиту по подписи или пересборки.

Скрываемые публичные API:
- NetworkCapabilities: hasTransport(), getCapabilities(), hasCapability(), toString(), getTransportInfo()
- NetworkInterface: isVirtual(), getName(), getByName(), isUp(), getNetworkInterfaces(), getMTU()
- LinkProperties: getInterfaceName(), getRoutes()
- ConnectivityManager: getNetworkInfo()
- NetworkInfo: getType(), getSubtype(), getTypeName(), getSubtypeName(), isConnectedOrConnecting(), isConnected()
- ConnectivityManager: getNetworkCapabilities(), registerNetworkCallback(), registerDefaultNetworkCallback(), registerBestMatchingNetworkCallback(), requestNetwork()

Скрываемые Native(C++):
- getifaddrs() > libc.so

modules.name: Py2Droid
modules.author: Mrakorez
modules.description: Magisk/KernelSU/APatch module to install Python 3 on Android.
modules.readme:
Py2Droid

System-level Python 3 for Android via Magisk/KernelSU/APatch
- * *

What is Py2Droid?

Py2Droid is CPython 3 compiled for Android and packaged as a Magisk module.
It provides system-level Python access without requiring Termux or other userland environments.

Built following official
Python for Android guidelines,
stripped of unnecessary components for minimal size.

Project Status

This project is in pre-1.0 development.

Current focus has moved to other projects, so updates here are mostly limited to keeping CPython
builds fresh and fixing critical bugs on a spare-time basis.
Breaking changes may land in minor releases.

In the future, I plan to rewrite the build and repository automation scripts to make the codebase
cleaner and improve Py2Droid for module developers.
However, since this was one of my first projects where I gained hands-on Python experience, the
codebase might be pretty terrible in places for now :D

Quick Start

1. Download the latest release from Releases
2. Install via your root manager (Magisk/KernelSU/APatch)
3. Reboot your device
4. Start using Python:
      python3 --version
   pip3 install --user requests

Why Py2Droid?

For Magisk Module Developers

Use Python instead of shell scripts in your modules.
Python is available as a dependency or runtime for complex logic.

For System Scripts

Get lightweight Python access at boot time without Termux overhead.
Perfect for automation scripts and utilities.

vs Termux

| Feature          | Py2Droid                        | Termux Python                |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
| Version          | Latest stable Python 3          | May lag behind               |
| Installation     | Single module                   | App + packages               |
| Size (aarch64)   | ~44 MB installed                | ~60 MB installed             |
| Boot-time access | ✅ Available during early boot   | ❌ Unavailable until unlock   |
| Location         | /data/adb (always accessible) | /data/user (encrypted)     |
| Use case         | System scripts, Magisk modules  | Full development environment |

Note: Py2Droid is not a Termux replacement.
They serve different purposes.

System Requirements
- Android: 5.0+
- Architecture: ARM64 or x86_64
- Root: Magisk/KernelSU/APatch

Limitations

Py2Droid runs in a bare Android environment (device with minimal shell, without Linux userland
tools):
- No GUI support - No X11/Wayland, so no Tkinter
- Limited native extensions - Most packages with C/C++/Rust code don’t provide Android wheels,
  and you can’t compile them on-device
- Some stdlib modules unavailable - Modules requiring missing system libraries may not work
- Root required - System directory access needed

Breaking Changes
⚠️ Upgrading from v0.2? Read this before updating to v0.3+

 v0.2 → v0.3 Migration Guide

1. Automatic Wrapper Syncing

The py2droid-update-bin command has been removed.
Wrappers now sync automatically at boot.

What to do:
- Remove any py2droid-update-bin calls from your scripts
- Use . /data/adb/py2droid/env.sh at the start of your scripts instead
- Or just reboot to sync wrappers

2. Python Prefix Cleanup on Updates

The Python installation directory (/data/adb/py2droid/usr) is now cleaned during updates.
This removes globally-installed pip packages.

What happens:
- Packages installed without --user flag will be deleted
- The installer creates a backup: /sdcard/py2droid-packages.txt

What to do:
- After updating, check py2droid-packages.txt for your packages
- Reinstall: pip3 install --user -r /sdcard/py2droid-packages.txt
- Always use --user flag: pip3 install --user

Usage

Basic Commands

Check Python version
python3 --version

Run a script
python3 script.py

Install packages (always use --user!)
pip3 install --user requests beautifulsoup4

Installing pip

Pip is included since v0.3.0. If you need to reinstall it:

python3 -m ensurepip --user
Reboot or source the environment
pip3 --version

Virtual Environments

Create venv
python3 -m venv venv

Activate (must load env.sh first!)
. /data/adb/py2droid/env.sh
. venv/bin/activate

Install packages
pip3 install -r requirements.txt

Run your app
python3 main.py

In Magisk Modules

customize.sh, service.sh, action.sh

Wrappers are available:

customize.sh example
cd "${MODPATH}" || exit 1
python3 main.py

post-fs-data.sh, uninstall.sh

Wrappers aren’t mounted yet.
Load the environment manually:

post-fs-data.sh example
. /data/adb/py2droid/env.sh  # Load Py2Droid environment

cd "${0%/*}" || exit 1
python3 main.py

Customization

Create /data/adb/py2droid/.shrc to customize the environment:

Example .shrc
export NAME="Mrakorez"
hello() { echo "Hello, ${NAME}!"; }

This file is sourced when loading env.sh (not during module installation).

How It Works

Directory Structure

Py2Droid uses /data/adb/py2droid as its home directory:

/data/adb/py2droid/
├── .cache/           # Cache directory (XDG_CACHE_HOME)
├── .config/          # Config directory (XDG_CONFIG_HOME)
├── .local/
│   ├── bin/          # User binaries (XDG_BIN_HOME)
│   ├── share/        # Shared data (XDG_DATA_HOME)
│   └── state/        # State files (XDG_STATE_HOME)
├── .tmp/             # Temporary files (TMPDIR)
├── env.sh            # Environment loader
└── usr/              # Python installation (PREFIX)
    ├── bin/          # python3, pip3, etc.
    └── lib/          # Python libraries

Command Wrappers

Commands like python3 in /system/bin are wrapper scripts:

#!/system/bin/sh
. "/data/adb/py2droid/env.sh" && exec python3 "$@"

These wrappers:
- Load the Py2Droid environment
- Execute the actual command
- Are created automatically at boot for new commands
- Are removed if the underlying command is uninstalled

Two Ways to Use Python

1. Wrappers (Quick & Isolated)

Use Python commands directly from any shell:

python3 -c "print('Hello')"
pip3 install --user requests

Pros:
- Works from anywhere...

modules.description: Patch `floating_feature.xml` to enable Samsung Dex standalone mode, available on devices supporting at least one Dex mode.
modules.readme:
magisk-samsung-dex-standalone-mode

Magisk module to systemlessly enable Samsung DeX standalone mode by patching floating_feature.xml, it adds standalone value to SEC_FLOATING_FEATURE_COMMON_CONFIG_DEX_MODE key. Works on One UI prior to version 8.

✅ Enables DeX standalone mode on supported phones.

✅ Compatible with magisk and kernelsu.

[[Download latest release]](https://github.com/supermarsx/magisk-samsung-dex-standalone-mode/releases/latest/download/magisk-samsung-dex-standalone-mode.zip)

[[Download repository]](https://codeload.github.com/supermarsx/magisk-samsung-dex-standalone-mode/zip/refs/heads/main)

Table of Contents
- Requirements
- Installation
- Troubleshooting
- FAQ
- Development
- Building
- Testing
- Release Workflow
- Changelog
- License

Requirements
- Samsung One UI ROM (stock or custom)
- Root access via Magisk or KernelSU
- No conflicting modules that modify floating_feature.xml

Installation

Via Magisk/KernelSU App

1. Download the latest release
2. Open Magisk or KernelSU app
3. Go to Modules → Install from storage
4. Select the downloaded ZIP
5. Reboot

Via Terminal

magisk --install-module path/to/magisk-samsung-dex-standalone-mode.zip

Verify Installation

Check the patched value with root access:

su -c "cat /system/etc/floating_feature.xml | grep DEX_MODE"

On some devices the file may be at /system/vendor/etc/ or /vendor/etc/ instead. The module automatically detects and patches all locations.

Troubleshooting

Gesture Issues After Exiting DeX

See Issue #2

DeX Ignoring the Notch / Desktop Not Full Width

See Issue #3

Fix: Change display cutout simulation to "Double cutout"
*Thanks to @admiralsym*

1. Enable Developer Options: Settings → About phone → Software information → Tap "Build number" 7 times
2. Go to Settings → Developer options
3. Find Simulate display with a cutout → Select Double cutout

ZIP Install Error

See Issue #4

Fix: Install manually via Termux
*Thanks to @hzykiss*

su
magisk --install-module /path/to/module.zip

FAQ

Does this require a Samsung device?

Yes. Specifically a Samsung device running One UI with DeX support.

What does "standalone mode" mean?

It allows starting DeX directly on your phone screen without connecting to an external display via HDMI or wireless.

Can DeX be screen-shared to another Android device?

Not with this module. That would require a different solution.

Will this work on non-Samsung devices?

No. This module is specifically for Samsung devices with DeX.

Will this work on custom ROMs?

Only if the custom ROM is One UI-based and includes DeX.

Will this add DeX to my phone?

No. This only enables standalone mode on phones that already have DeX.

I have an S23 Ultra, does standalone work without this module?

No. Standalone mode isn't enabled by default on any Samsung phone, regardless of how high-end it is.

Will this work on OneUI 8?

Apparently not, as reported by @DudeThat, so i'm not using OneUI 8 with root at the time and won't be working on it for the foreseeable future. If you have any new point it out in an issue and I might look at it.

*Thanks to @WilsonBradley and @foxypiratecove37350 for their questions.*

Development

Prerequisites
- bash and zip in PATH
- Linux, WSL, or Git Bash on Windows

Building

make build    # Create magisk-samsung-dex-standalone-mode.zip
make clean    # Remove generated ZIP

Or use the scripts directly:

bash build-tools/build-create-module.sh    # Create ZIP
bash build-tools/build-delete-module.sh    # Delete ZIP

The file list for the ZIP is defined in build-tools/build-filelist.txt.

Testing

make test     # Run all tests
make lint     # Run shellcheck on all scripts

Tests run automatically in CI on every push.

Debugging

A log file post-fs-data.log is generated on each boot at:
/data/adb/modules/samsung-dex-standalone-mode/post-fs-data.log

To unmount the patched file during development:

sh debug/debug-unmount.sh

Release Workflow

Releases are automated via GitHub Actions when a tag is pushed.

Version Management Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
|--------|---------|
| build-tools/set-version.sh | Update version in module.prop and update.json |
| build-tools/update-changelog.sh | Prepend new entry to changelog.md |
| build-tools/release.sh | Full release: version, changelog, lint, test, package, tag, publish |
| scripts/check-version.sh | Verify module.prop and update.json are in sync |
| scripts/build-and-commit.sh | Auto-increment version, build, commit, and tag |

Release Commands

Full release (recommended):
VERSION=2026.3 VERSION_CODE=6 CHANGELOG_NOTES_FILE=notes.txt bash build-tools/release.sh

Auto-increment release:
bash scripts/build-and-commit.sh

Manual version update:
bash build-tools/set-version.sh 2026.3 6
bash build-tools/update-changelog.sh 2026.3 notes.txt

Verify version sync:
bash scripts/check-version.sh

Changelog

2026.3
- Hotfix: revert multi-path mount that caused boot failure, restore single-target bind mount
- Keep path detection logging for diagnostics
- Add /system/etc/ as additional path fallback

2026.2
- Fix patching on devices where floating_feature.xml exists at multiple paths (e.g. Galaxy S20+) — *thanks to @parkerlreed*
- Mount patched file to all detected locations instead of only the first one found
- Add path detection logging for easier debugging
- Installation checks now validate across all known paths

2026.1
- Add support for older phones (S9, S10, Note 9) with "system-as-root" partition layout — *thanks to @serifpersia*
- Minor fixes

2025.1
- Add release automation scripts
- Resolve shellcheck warnings

2024.2
- Restructure build/debug scripts
- Fix module status bug (was appending to old statuses on reboot)

2024.1
- Initial release

License

MIT License — see license.md

No warranties whatsoever.

modules.readme:
Wtonec

微信 / QQ / 小红书 / 抖音的语音与表情包工具：把文字变成语音，在聊天中轻松使用。

支持文字转语音、语音包、语音播报、克隆音色、表情包等功能，上百款音色可选。所有音色和功能均免费使用，无需充值。

⬇ 下载 1.7.6 · 官网 · 简单使用教程 · 原使用教程

有哪些功能
- 文字转语音：选择喜欢的音色，输入文字，试听后生成并发送。
- 语音包：导入、收藏、管理常用语音，聊天时快速发送。
- 语音播报：按设置朗读通知消息。
- 克隆音色：创建或使用自己的克隆音色。
- 表情包：管理常用表情，在私聊和群聊中使用。
- 个性化面板：液态玻璃、多种主题、悬浮球和自定义图标。

1.7.6 更新一览

1. 原「安全」页改为「适配」，按应用展示 89 项版本，每行 3 个。
2. 趣味语音盒内置 182 个语音包目录和音频直链，打开目录更快。
3. 新增 tiax 表情来源，收录 217 个合集和 43,365 条图片关系；分类直接显示，支持关键词搜索。
4. 表情包新增「最近使用」，方便快速再次发送，并增加 tiax 搜索推荐提示。
5. 修复小红书群聊面板绑定问题，优化在线素材异常提示。

目录内置，音频和图片按需联网下载并缓存；部分远程素材可能失效。

软件演示

以下保留 1.7.4 的 MuMu 界面截图，供功能入口参考。

简单使用教程

1. 安装并启用：准备 Android 9+ 和已配置的 LSPosed/Xposed，下载 APK 安装；启用 Wtonec，勾选要使用的应用。
2. 打开悬浮窗：使用抖音、小红书时，先到 Wtonec「设置」开启对应应用的悬浮窗入口。
3. 进入聊天：完全关闭并重启对应应用，按提示完成匹配；进入私聊或群聊，点击悬浮球打开面板。
4. 选音色、输文字：在线音色按提示保存自己的 API Key；想先试用可选择无需 Key 的系统 TTS。
5. 试听并发送：试听满意后，确认当前聊天对象，再点击「生成并发送」。

语音包：导入或选择音频 → 试听 → 发送。表情包：先确认当前聊天 → 选择「在线 / 本地 / 最近使用」→ 单击图片直接发送，长按本地图片管理。

查看完整的简单教程：安装、开面板、发语音及常见问题 →

抖音、小红书必须先在 Wtonec「设置」页面开启对应应用的悬浮窗入口，才能在聊天页点击悬浮球使用。

升级提示：从 1.7.4 / 1.7.5（dev.wtonec.final）升级可直接覆盖安装，保留原有设置和素材，无需卸载。更早的不同包名版本请先导出重要语音，再启用新版、停用旧模块。

小红书适配 9.49.1、9.50.0，抖音适配 40.7.0；更多版本可在「适配」页查看，目录不代表逐版本实测。完整安装步骤见快速入门，文件校验见更新说明。

数据与配置
- 模块配置：/data/user/0/dev.wtonec.final/shared_prefs/ 与 files/wtonec_shared_bridge/。
- 共享表情：/data/user/0/dev.wtonec.final/files/wtonec/shared-stickers/。
- 共享语音：/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/dev.wtonec.final/files/Wtonec/voices/。

各宿主的配置、素材、缓存与备份注意事项见 数据与配置目录。

链接与说明
- GitHub 发布仓库 · Xposed 模块仓库
- 使用文档 · 常见问题 · 隐私说明

本仓库用于发布安装包、说明文档和演示图片。本次更新不包含应用源码、签名私钥、API Key 或私人备份。

本项目与微信、QQ、小红书、抖音官方无隶属关系。请遵守平台规则，并在分享截图或日志前遮盖账号、聊天内容和密钥。

modules.readme:
WaEnhancer X

UI customization, automation, and privacy engine for WhatsApp on Android

WaEnhancer X is an open-source Xposed/LSPosed module for rooted Android that enhances WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business with privacy controls, anti-delete recovery, view-once media tools, interface customization, and productivity features—without repackaging the official app.

👉 [](https://github.com/WaEnhancerX/WaEnhancerX) 👈

Latest Release · Telegram Community · Documentation · Report Bug

Star History

Contents
- Star History
- Why WaEnhancerX
- About V2 Architecture
- Key Features
- Compatibility & Supported Clients
- Requirements
- Installation Guide
- Building from Source
- Architecture & Design Principles
- Contributors
- Community & Policies
- Important Notice & Disclaimer
- License

Why WaEnhancerX

Most WhatsApp modifications require replacing your official application with suspicious, closed-source third-party repackaged APKs. These third-party APKs pose major account security risks, break safety attestation, and often bundle unwanted bloatware or trackers.

WaEnhancerX takes the native Xposed framework approach:
- Zero Client Tampering: Works directly on top of the unmodified, genuine WhatsApp client from Google Play.
- Deep System-Level Integration: Injects settings natively into WhatsApp's internal preferences screen with full search engine support.
- Dynamic CSS Theme Engine: Style message bubbles, action bars, backgrounds, and UI layouts without decompiling or patching XML assets.
- Local History and Exports: Stores preserved-message history and media exports on the device. Network-dependent features and update checks have their own settings and behavior.

About V2 Architecture

The public manager and hooks use Kotlin/Java, Jetpack Compose, Hilt and Android
framework APIs. Features are grouped into packages inside :app, with a required
private :licensing module. The architecture guide
maps the implemented components and their responsibilities.

The APK declares minSdk 24 and targetSdk 36. These build settings do not imply
that every feature has been verified on every Android version or future host
release. Compatibility depends on the target APK, loaded hook framework and
individual hook behavior.

Key Features

🛡️ Privacy & Security
- Anti-Delete Protection: Prevent incoming messages from disappearing when sender deletes them.
- View-Once Tools: Controls for viewing and exporting view-once media on compatible host builds.
- Self-Delete History: Maintain local archives of messages you delete for yourself.
- Receipt Control: Granular control over blue ticks and delivered receipts.

🎨 Customization & UI
- CSS-like View Engine: Fine-tune bubble colors, radiuses, and backgrounds with declarative rules.
- Meta AI Cleanup: Hide intrusive Meta AI icons, floating action buttons, and chat entries.
- Material You (Monet): Dynamic color theming aligned with system wallpaper palettes.

⚡ System & Integration
- Native Settings Injection: Integrated right inside WhatsApp’s official settings hierarchy.
- Built-in Search: Instantly locate any tweak via native search bar indexing.
- Safe Restart Policy: Graceful, reliable WhatsApp process restart directly from the dashboard.
- Tasker Integration: Open a selected WhatsApp chat through the supported, user-confirmed automation flow.

Compatibility & Supported Clients

WAEX targets exact package names and evaluates configured version-name rules
before initializing its feature registry.

| Target package | Client | Scope of the declaration |
|---|---|---|
| com.whatsapp | WhatsApp Messenger | Declared target; version rules and feature-specific acceptance still apply. |
| com.whatsapp.w4b | WhatsApp Business | Declared target; version rules and feature-specific acceptance still apply. |
| Other explicitly listed packages | Alternative clients | Exact allowlist membership only; no authenticity or compatibility guarantee. |

See the Client Compatibility Guide for the actual
allowlist, built-in/custom rules, explicit bypass and unavailable-input states.
A matching rule or a green source test does not prove that every feature works.

Requirements

1. A rooted Android device with a working Xposed-compatible framework such as
   LSPosed, configured for that device.
2. An installed target client listed in the module's scope and admitted by its
   configured version rules.
3. An Android version allowed by the APK's declared minimum SDK (currently API 24),
   plus framework and target-client compatibility. This is not a device test matrix.

The manifest declares the Xposed metadata and
arrays.xml declares the recommended scope.

Installation Guide

1. Download: Select the desired Debug or Release APK from
   GitHub Releases and read
   that release's notes.
2. Install: Install the APK on the Android device.
3. Activate: Enable WaEnhancerX in the loaded framework's manager.
4. Set scope: Enable WaEnhancerX (com.waenhancer) and the installed
   target, such as com.whatsapp or com.whatsapp.w4b. System Framework (android)
   is not part of the declared scope in this source tree.
5. Restart and inspect: Restart the selected processes as required by the
   framework, open the WAEX manager, and inspect its compatibility and injection
   diagnostics. Then check the configured entry point in the target app.

The current build configuration enables code minification and resource shrinking
for Release. Debug uses a different optimization configuration; it is still an APK
archive. A feature working in Debug must also be checked in optimized Release
before a release-specific issue is considered resolved.

Building from Source

The repository currently declares SDK 36, JDK/toolchain 17, Android Gradle Plugin
9.0.1 and a Gradle distribution of 9.1.0 in the wrapper properties. Use an Android Studio version compatible with that
AGP release. The Kotlin catalog entry is 2.0.20; the resolved Gradle plugin/compiler...
