modules.readme:
⚡ FastCharge Next

Boost your charging speed on rooted Android devices with this simple Magisk module.
FastCharge Next tweaks kernel and system parameters to optimize charging current, reducing charge time while staying safe. 🚀

✨ Features
- ⚡ Increases charging current for faster charging
- 🔋 Works on most rooted Android devices (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch)
- 🛡️ Safe limits applied to prevent overheating or battery damage
- 🔧 Easy install & uninstall via Magisk Manager
- 📂 Open source & customizable script

📥 Installation
1. Download the latest release from Releases
2. Flash the .zip in Magisk Manager (or KernelSU/APatch)
3. Reboot your device
4. Enjoy faster charging ⚡

🧑‍💻 Usage
- Module is automatic — just install & reboot
- Config file located at: /data/adb/modules/fastcharge-next/config.sh
- You can edit limits to suit your device (default = safe values)

🛠️ Compatibility
- ✅ Magisk 24+
- ✅ KernelSU (Compatible with latest Releases)
- ✅ Android 9 – 16
- ❌ Non-rooted devices are not supported

📜 How It Works
- Writes safe charging values to:
- /sys/class/power_supply/battery/
- /sys/class/power_supply/usb/
- Optimizes kernel fast-charge settings if available
- Ensures no permanent modification — removing module restores defaults

modules.readme:
HyperLight

  Light up your HyperOS
  可高度自定义的 HyperOS 柔光玻璃 · 系统美化模块

  简体中文 ·
  English

简介

HyperLight 是一个可高度自定义 HyperOS 柔光玻璃、且集成众多独有特色功能的 系统美化模块。
面向通知栏、控制中心、锁屏等系统界面，带来统一、精致的视觉体验。

| 核心能力 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 柔光玻璃 | 模糊、光影、折射、混色、预设等全参数可调（主推稳定能力） |
| 高光材质 | 补全 / 强制启用高光，厚度与描边分档，混色独立配置 |
| 液态玻璃 | 真液态玻璃渲染，长期 Beta，功耗与性能需自行权衡 |
| 界面定制 | 时钟、堆叠通知、音量条、锁屏、图标配色等 |

功能

柔光玻璃 / 高光材质
- 柔光玻璃：模糊半径、柔光强度、饱和度、亮度、折射、反射、方向光、内部着色、烧灼等
- 分场景亮度：锁屏、悬浮通知、侧边音量条、侧边栏与负一屏
- 自定义混色（通知中心 / 控制中心磁贴与组件）
- 内置预设 + 自定义预设保存 / 导入 / 分享
- 高光材质：超轻 ~ 超厚分档；纯净 / 叠加 / 信息系列
- 描边：小 / 中 / 大；可启用实时动态描边与高阶自定义
- 材质混色：浅色 / 深色分组，可按组件单独管理

液态玻璃 · 长期 Beta
- 折射、色散、景深、高光描边等渲染参数可调
- 触摸光晕、光学边距、捕获缩放与刷新档位
- 启用时会引导推荐配置，并提醒功耗上升与短期卡顿

通知 / 锁屏 · com.android.systemui
- 柔光玻璃统一、背景模糊混色、头部渐变模糊
- 长文本自动展开、禁止收纳为通知组 / 历史
- 堆叠通知：起始线、模糊透明度渐变、时钟跟随
- 居中大时钟：字重、布局、玻璃、日期格式、标题行
- 锁屏：快捷按钮背景（高光 / 液态 / 柔光）、指纹图标、堆叠下沉、景深避让
- 通知文本与悬浮通知文本颜色；Toast 模糊

控制中心 · miui.systemui.plugin
- 柔光玻璃 / 高光材质 / 液态玻璃
- 磁贴圆角；图标颜色（浅 / 深 / 跟随 / 反跟随 / 自定义）
- 细音量条与按压动画（可实时调参）
- 阴影、手电筒通知混色

其他
- 负一屏组件、安全中心侧边栏接入柔光玻璃与混色
- 背屏左滑手势注入
- 息屏与锁屏编辑景深相关调整
- 系统设置模块入口；强制色彩风格高级模式 / 高光材质
- 配置备份：剪贴板与 JSON 导入导出

兼容性

| 项目 | 要求 |
| :--- | :--- |
| 系统 | HyperOS 4（本分支 1.2.0+） |
| Android | 16+（minSdk 36 / targetSdk 37） |
| 框架 | 支持 Xposed API 101 的 LSPosed |
| 前提 | 解锁 Bootloader + Root（Magisk / KernelSU） |
| 设备 | 仅手机；平板不适配且不接受相关反馈 |
HyperOS 3 请使用最后适配版本 1.1.7-LiquidGlass)。

安装

1. 解锁 Bootloader，并获取 Root
2. 安装支持 API 101 的 LSPosed
3. 安装 HyperLight APK
4. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块，并勾选作用域：

   | 包名 | 组件 |
   | :--- | :--- |
   | com.android.systemui | 通知 / 锁屏 |
   | miui.systemui.plugin | 控制中心 |
   | com.miui.securitycenter | 安全中心 |
   | com.miui.personalassistant | 智能助理（负一屏） |
   | com.android.settings | 系统设置 |
   | com.xiaomi.subscreencenter | 背屏 |
   | com.miui.aod | 息屏与锁屏编辑 |

5. 重启设备或相关应用
6. 打开 HyperLight，按需启用柔光玻璃 / 高光 / 液态玻璃并调参

反馈

请通过 Issues 提交，并附上：

1. LSPosed 详细日志（设置 → 日志 → 详细日志）
2. 机型与系统版本
3. 复现步骤与预期 / 实际行为
4. 相关截图

技术栈
- Kotlin · Java · Jetpack Compose
- Xposed API 101 · libxposed
- MiuiX · Haze · Capsule

许可证

本项目仅供学习交流使用。

Star History

社区
- Telegram 群组：HyperLight
- 开发者：愛君の名は / KiminonawaResa
- 液态玻璃渲染代码：Aymon

modules.name: Inter Font Pack
modules.author: kdrag0n
modules.description: Font pack that replaces the system fonts with Inter (sans-serif), Fira Code (monospace), and Source Serif Pro (serif).
modules.readme:
Inter Font Pack

This is a Magisk module that replaces Android's system fonts with:
- Inter for most text
- Fira Code for monospace text
- Source Serif for serif text

Inter was chosen as the UI font for its cleanliness and legibility; it is neutral and looks similar to Apple's San Francisco UI font. Because it was specifically designed for use in GUIs, it is a great replacement for Roboto on Android.

Source Serif was chosen as the serif font because it is one of the best open-source fonts that complement Inter's style.

All fonts included in this module are open-source and licensed under the SIL Open Font License.

Compatibility

Both Roboto and Google Sans have been replaced with Inter for more consistent typography on the stock Pixel ROM.

To maximize compatibility, all font names have been patched to match the original fonts. This fixes some issues in third-party apps, such Firefox falling back to Fira Sans instead of using the new fonts.

Additionally, Roboto will be used as a fallback for characters not supported by Inter. This is done by patching Roboto (which is included as a variable font to save space) to create a fallback variant and registering it as a proper fallback rather than modifying the Inter font itself. As a result, most text will be rendered with the original Inter font, and unsupported characters will still be displayed with proper metrics and hinting.

Support

If you found this module helpful, please consider supporting development with a recurring donation on Patreon for benefits such as exclusive behind-the-scenes development news, early access to updates, and priority support. Alternatively, you can also buy me a coffee. All support is appreciated.

modules.readme:
Samsung Feature Extension / 三星功能扩展

Samsung / One UI 设备的 LSPosed 功能扩展模块。
- 应用名 / App name: 三星功能扩展
- 包名 / Package name: com.samsung.feature.extension
- 版本 / Version: 1.30 (versionCode 194)
- GitHub: fvffv/samsung-feature-extension

中文功能
- 三星录屏原画
- 在三星截屏的“视频质量”中增加“原画”，保留原有画质选项。
- 全屏按当前系统分辨率采集，区域录制按选区像素输出，并按编码器要求对齐尺寸。
- 查询硬件支持的最高帧率和码率；需要新增作用域 com.samsung.android.app.smartcapture。
- 已验证硬件编码器接受配置；三星实际输出文件和持续录制稳定性仍需实录确认，见实现与验证说明。
- S Pen 空中鼠标
- 使用带蓝牙隔空操作的 S Pen 控制系统原生鼠标；按钮支持点击、长按和按住拖动。
- 支持灵敏度与防抖/平滑强度调节，需要 Root 和 Air command 作用域。
- 小窗等比例缩放
- 缩小普通弹出式小窗时同步缩小应用内容，提供独立开关。
- 需要系统框架作用域，首次安装后重启；全屏、分屏、画中画和 DeX 保持原有行为。
- 双语与图标形状兼容
- S Pen 与小窗页面支持模块中英文切换，包括实时状态、数值与错误提示。
- 为 One UI Home 中没有透明圆角的方形位图补上系统图标蒙版，已在真机核对。
- WebDAV 网络存储
- 在“我的文件”网络存储中添加 WebDAV。
- 支持服务器地址、账户信息和网络存储列表管理。
- 支持浏览目录、预览、重命名、新建文件夹、删除、上传、下载、复制和移动。
- Expert RAW 200MP RAW
- 在 Galaxy S24 Ultra 与 S23 Ultra 机型的 Expert RAW 中提供 200MP RAW 拍摄选项。
- 可在高分辨率模式下拍摄和保存 RAW 照片。
- 音频橡皮擦
- 让 S24 Ultra 以下机型也可使用音频橡皮擦功能。
- 在视频编辑工作室中使用音频分析、人声和环境声分离、音频清除及保存副本。
- 在系统下拉面板中使用音频橡皮擦，并调节清除强度和人声模式。
- 相机视频功能
- 在专业视频中使用 HDR10+、4K120、FHD120 和 8K 录制选项。
- 选择 8K 24/30/60fps 视频帧率。
- 在慢动作模式中使用 UHD 240fps。
- 读取当前视频码率，并设置 8K、4K、FHD 视频码率。
- NFC 息屏刷卡
- 通过独立开关设置息屏状态下的 NFC 刷卡行为。
- 应用兼容策略保持
- 保持开发者选项中的 Disable app compatibility policies 持续开启。
- One UI 主屏幕自定义
- 自定义应用图标、图标形状、圆角、应用名称和名称字体。
- 支持图片选择与裁剪、字体颜色、渐变、粗体和斜体。
- 提供快速重启 One UI 主屏幕。
- 系统字体
- 导入、切换、删除和管理本地 TTF 字体。
- 指纹图标
- 自定义锁屏和系统验证界面的指纹图标。
- 支持内置或本地导入的 Lottie 动画、静态图片、循环播放和单次播放。
- 触控高采样率
- 设置手指触控采样策略，并在页面中查看实时刷新率。
- 全局旁路供电
- 设置游戏时暂停 USB PD 充电的旁路供电状态。
- 支持模块页面和桌面图标快捷切换。
- 充电显示与提示音
- 自定义充电显示文本和变量模板。
- 分别设置插入、拔出充电器时的提示音，并预览系统音频。
- 设备健康管理
- 查看 Thermal Status、温控、电池、异常检测和后台限制状态。
- 提供温控和后台限制等常用设备健康控制开关。
- 文本通话
- 自定义两种文本通话开场语。
- 设置文本通话时是否播放对方声音，同时显示对方语音转文字。
- 应用分身列表
- 在应用分身页面扩展并查看可用应用列表。

English Features
- Original-quality screen recording
- Adds Original to Samsung Capture's Video quality selector.
- Uses the current native display resolution or selected-area pixels, with encoder-required alignment and the highest hardware-supported frame rate and bitrate.
- Requires the com.samsung.android.app.smartcapture scope. Hardware codec configuration has been checked; actual Samsung recording output and sustained performance still require recording validation.
- S Pen air mouse
- Controls the native system pointer with a Bluetooth Air Actions S Pen, including clicks, long presses, dragging, sensitivity and adaptive smoothing.
- Requires root access and the Air command scope.
- Proportional pop-up scaling
- Scales app content with a standard pop-up window using an independent toggle; requires the System Framework scope and an initial restart.
- Bilingual pages and icon shapes
- Chinese and English support for S Pen and pop-up settings, including live status and controls.
- Applies the system icon mask to opaque square bitmap icons in One UI Home while preserving already-shaped icons.
- WebDAV network storage
- Adds WebDAV to Samsung My Files network storage.
- Manages server addresses, account details, and network-storage entries.
- Supports directory browsing, preview, rename, folder creation, delete, upload, download, copy, and move.
- Expert RAW 200MP RAW
- Provides a 200MP RAW capture option in Expert RAW on Galaxy S24 Ultra and S23 Ultra devices.
- Captures and saves RAW photos in high-resolution mode.
- Audio Eraser
- Makes Audio Eraser available on models below Galaxy S24 Ultra.
- Provides audio analysis, voice and ambient sound separation, audio removal, and Save Copy in Video Editor Studio.
- Provides Audio Eraser controls in the system quick panel, including removal strength and voice focus.
- Camera video features
- HDR10+, 4K120, FHD120, and 8K options for Pro Video.
- 8K recording at 24/30/60fps.
- UHD 240fps slow motion.
- Read the current bitrate and set 8K, 4K, and FHD video bitrates.
- NFC screen-off card tapping
- Uses a dedicated switch to control NFC card tapping while the screen is off.
- App compatibility policy control
- Keeps Android's Disable app compatibility policies developer option enabled.
- One UI Home customization
- Customize app icons, icon shapes, corner radius, app labels, and label fonts.
- Supports image selection and cropping, font colors, gradients, bold, and italic styles.
- Provides a quick One UI Home restart action.
- System fonts
- Import, select, delete, and manage local TTF fonts.
- Fingerprint icon
- Customize the fingerprint icon used by the lock screen and system authentication UI.
- Supports built-in or locally imported Lottie animations, static images, looping, and one-shot playback.
- Touch high sampling rate
- Set the finger-touch sampling policy and view the live refresh rate in the settings page.
- Global pass-through charging
- Set the USB PD pass-through charging state used while gaming.
- Includes module-page and launcher shortcuts for quick toggling.
- Charging display and sounds
- Customize charging text and variable templates.
- Set plug-in and unplug sounds separately, and preview system audio.
- Device Health Manager
- View Thermal Status, temperature control, battery, anomaly detection, and background restriction states.
- Provides common temperature-control and background-restriction controls.
- Text Call
- Customize both Text Call greeting messages.
- Choose whether the other party's voice is played while their speech transcript remains visible.
- Dual app list
- Expand and view the available application list for dual apps.

Main Source Files
- ScreenRecorderNativeHook.java
- NativeRecordingProfile.java
- SpenMouseHook.java
- FreeformScaleHook.java
- LauncherIconShapeHook.java
- LanguageManager.java
- SettingsActivity.java
- MyFilesWebDavHook.java
- GalaxyRaw200MpHook.java
- CameraOneUi85VideoUnlockHook.java
- VideoEditorAudioEraserHook.java
- SystemUiAudioEraserHook.java
- TextCallGreetingHook.java

Manual Build / 手动构建...
modules.changelog:
三星功能扩展 v1.30 更新日志
Samsung Feature Extension v1.30 Changelog

新增 / New Features

三星录屏原画 / Original-quality Screen Recording
- 在三星截屏的“视频质量”中新增“原画”选项，保留原有画质选项。
  Added Original to Samsung Capture’s Video quality selector while retaining existing presets.
- 全屏录制使用当前系统分辨率，区域录制按选区像素输出。
  Full-screen recording uses the current native display resolution; partial recording uses the selected area’s pixel dimensions.
- 根据硬件编码器能力选择最高可用帧率与码率。
  Selects the highest available frame rate and bitrate supported by the hardware encoder.

S Pen 空中鼠标 / S Pen Air Mouse
- 使用蓝牙 S Pen 控制系统原生鼠标光标，支持点击、长按和按住拖拽。
  Control the native system pointer with a Bluetooth S Pen, including clicks, long presses and dragging.
- 支持灵敏度调节、自适应防抖和平滑强度设置。
  Includes adjustable sensitivity, adaptive stabilization and smoothing strength.
- 插笔、锁屏或息屏时自动暂停鼠标。
  Automatically pauses when the pen is docked, the phone is locked or the screen turns off.

小窗等比例缩放 / Proportional Pop-up Scaling
- 缩小弹出式小窗时，同步缩小应用内的文字、图片和控件。
  Scales text, images and controls together as a pop-up window shrinks.
- 提供独立开关，关闭后恢复系统默认显示。
  Includes an independent toggle that restores the default display behavior when disabled.
- 不干预全屏、分屏、画中画及 DeX。
  Leaves fullscreen, split screen, picture-in-picture and DeX unchanged.

修复与优化 / Fixes and Improvements
- 补齐 S Pen 空中鼠标、小窗缩放页面的中英文支持，包括实时状态、滑块数值和错误提示。
  Added complete Chinese and English support to the S Pen Air Mouse and pop-up scaling pages, including live status, slider values and error messages.
- 修复部分桌面图标保留方形边角的问题，为未裁剪的方形位图补上系统图标蒙版。
  Fixed square corners on some launcher icons by applying the system icon mask to unshaped square bitmaps.
- 修复按住 S Pen 按钮时无法移动鼠标的问题。
  Fixed pointer movement being blocked while holding the S Pen button.
- 保留微小位移累积，改善移动分段感，并清理松开按钮后的待处理位移。
  Preserves subpixel movement, reduces stepped pointer motion and clears pending drag movement before button release.

使用说明 / Setup Notes
- S Pen 空中鼠标：需要 Root，并勾选 Air command 作用域。
  S Pen Air Mouse: Requires root access and the Air command scope.
- 小窗缩放：勾选 系统框架 / android，首次安装后重启手机。
  Pop-up Scaling: Enable the System Framework / android scope and restart the phone after first installation.
- 录屏原画：勾选 三星截屏 / com.samsung.android.app.smartcapture，随后重启三星截屏应用。
  Original-quality Recording: Enable the Samsung Capture / com.samsung.android.app.smartcapture scope, then restart Samsung Capture.
- 实验性功能说明：“原画”指原生像素分辨率，仍使用视频压缩编码。实际帧率、码率和稳定性受设备能力与录制负载影响，选区尺寸可能需要最小像素对齐。
  Experimental Feature: Original refers to native pixel resolution; video compression is still used. Actual frame rate, bitrate and stability depend on device capabilities and recording workload. Selected-area dimensions may require minimal pixel alignment.

modules.name: discover-ads-filter
modules.author: hxreborn
modules.description: Xposed module that removes ads, sponsored cards and clickbait from Google Discover.
modules.readme:
An Xposed module that removes ads, sponsored cards and clickbait from the Google Discover feed, in the Pixel Launcher -1 screen and inside the Google app itself. Hide stories by headline or source with your own filters, and share articles with their real link instead of Google's redirect.

Requirements
- Android 11+
- An Xposed manager with libxposed API 101 support, such as LSPosed or Vector

Installation

1. Grab the APK:

2. Enable the module in LSPosed and scope it to com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.
3. Open the Discover Feed Filter app and tap Scan to resolve hook targets.
4. Force-stop Google App and relaunch.

Filter packs

Starter filters you can import from News filters, menu, Import:
- clickbait-en.json, general English clickbait, the same set as the in-app presets but switched on
- clickbait-es.json, general Spanish clickbait
- clickbait-de.json, general German clickbait, contributed by @hanschke

Clickbait looks different in every language. If yours is missing, open a PR with a pack and I'll include it.

How It Works

The app scans the installed Google App with DexKit, resolving hook targets via protobuf extension field numbers and type signatures, and stores the result in a versioned cache. The hooked process uses the cached targets to filter ad items from the Discover feed.

Related

Also dislike ads in the Google Play Store? Try  playstore-adblock, a sister module.

License

modules.name: NFC Screen Off
modules.author: lapwat
modules.description: Read NFC tags when screen is off. Disable NFC tagging sound.
modules.readme:
NFCScreenOff

Read NFC tags when screen is off. Disable NFC tagging sound.

_Useful integrations: NFC Card Emulator Pro - Tasker_

How does it work?

The NFC app is patched during installation into a modded version. This modded version is injected at boot time by service.sh so that the phone thinks the screen is always on and unlocked. This patch only applies to NFC Service so it does not impact any other functionality of the phone that involves screen state detection.

The modded app was generated using this method.

Help section

I AM STUCK IN A BOOTLOOP

Remove the module manually.

1. Boot into TWRP
1. Advanced -> File Manager
1. Delete /adb/modules/NFCScreenOff
1. Reboot

THE MODULE IS NOT WORKING SINCE LAST UPDATE

Perform a clean reinstallation.

1. Uninstall the module
1. Reboot
1. Install the module
1. Reboot

If it does not solve your problem, you can create an issue.

MY NFC IS NOT DETECTED ANYMORE

If you did not unlock your device since last boot, unlock it and wait 30 seconds for the module to be loaded.

After that time, if NFC does not start automatically or manually, it means that the patch does not work for your device. You can uninstall the module and create an issue.

modules.name: NoEmulator
modules.author: ymuu
modules.description: Hides Android emulator artifacts from apps using SUSFS kernel rules. Requires susfs4ksu-lkm-x64. x86_64 only.
modules.readme:
NoEmulator

Hides Android emulator artifacts from apps, using kernel rules rather than hooks.

Status: early, but measured end to end. Tested on one reference device, a rooted
Android 16 Pixel 9 x86_64 AVD (Android Studio emulator). It depends on the requirements
below, and some apps need a per-app setting. Read LIMITATIONS.md before
installing.

What it does

Apps can tell an emulator from a phone. On the reference device with nothing installed,
a detector finds 12 clear signals and 7 more worth reviewing: the build fingerprint says
sdk_gphone64_x86_64, /dev/goldfish_pipe_dprctd is open in the process, the ARM
translation layer is loaded, and 111 system properties mention the emulator.

Existing modules fix this by hooking into every app and rewriting what it reads.
That is detectable: compare a result from the C library against the same result from
a raw syscall and the two disagree. Detectors run that comparison today.

NoEmulator ships rules instead. The kernel answers both paths identically, so there
is nothing to compare. Nothing on disk is edited, so there is no edit mark to find.
- Build identity: the build properties name one Pixel coherently: fingerprint,
  device, build id and every partition's copy agree. The Pixel 8 by default; pick the
  Pixel 7 Pro, 8 Pro, 9 Pro or 9 Pro XL under Phone to claim in the WebUI's Options
  tab, or with a device  line in the user config.
- Emulator properties: deleted, or given a Pixel value. The emulator's service
  states are hidden from apps alone.
- Emulator-named HAL files in /vendor/lib64/hw: hidden from apps.
- Battery directory: relabelled as on a phone, so apps find power_supply.
- Emulator device nodes and the gralloc mapper: redirected to neutral names, so an
  app's file descriptors and memory map carry no goldfish or ranchu. The device is
  the same, so graphics keep working.
- GPU driver names: the Vulkan and EGL drivers are presented under the name mali.
- The ARM native bridge: removed by default, so ARM-only apps break unless you turn
  on Run ARM apps. With it on, apps see the bridge's property and ABI keys hidden,
  arm64 apps read aarch64 from uname(), and the bridge is loaded as libsysglue.so
  (LIMITATIONS.md).

Requirements
- susfs4ksu-lkm-x64 v0.0.8 or later installed and loaded. NoEmulator does not bundle it and refuses to install without it. On v0.0.7 it installs with a warning, and the rules that need v0.0.8 are skipped: the app-only property hiding, the uname() answer and the libc.so header redirect.
- x86_64. The install aborts on other architectures.
- KernelSU-Next, which loads the susfs kernel module.
- NoMount, recommended.

What it does not hide

See LIMITATIONS.md: the GL renderer until you name the app, the x86_64
hardware, the ARM translator when ARM apps are on, and a few more.

Layout

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| module/ | the KernelSU module: artifacts.conf, customize.sh, post-fs-data.sh, post-mount.sh, service.sh, action.sh, lib/, webroot/ |
| update.json | the update channel module.prop names |
| scripts/ | packaging and the pre-commit check |
| tests/ | host tests for rule generation, no device needed |

Configuration

The WebUI covers the common choices: open NoEmulator in the KernelSU manager. Its
Options tab has Run ARM apps and Sync the host clipboard; its ANGLE tab
hides the GL renderer per app (ANGLE.md).

Anything else goes in the user config, /data/adb/noemulator-user.conf, which updates
keep and uninstall removes. It takes the same directives as module/artifacts.conf,
which documents each one in its comments. A bad line stops every rule from applying, so
check a change first:

sh module/lib/generate_rules.sh module/artifacts.conf /data/adb/noemulator-user.conf

Reporting a problem

Tap Action on NoEmulator's card in the KernelSU manager, or **Export for a bug
report** on the WebUI's Log page. Either saves noemulator-logs-.txt to
/sdcard/Download. It holds the versions of NoEmulator, the kernel, Android and ksud;
the installed modules; the last boot's apply.log; the user config; the susfs redirect
list; and the emulator properties still set. Values of properties named for a timezone,
an ADB key, a serial or a guid are replaced with redacted. Times are UTC. Read the
file, then attach it to a bug report.

Licence

GPL-3.0. See LICENSE.
modules.changelog:
Hides more from apps: the emulator's service states, its HAL file names and the ARM
translator's properties, plus a choice of five Pixel identities. Needs
susfs4ksu-lkm-x64 v0.0.8.
- Pick the phone: Pixel 8 (default), 7 Pro, 8 Pro, 9 Pro or 9 Pro XL, under
  Phone to claim in the Options tab or with device  in the user config.
- App-only property hiding: the emulator's init.svc.* service states are hidden
  from apps, kept current as services change. Root and adb shell still see them.
- Emulator-named HAL files in /vendor/lib64/hw (audio, sensors, mapper, Vulkan)
  are hidden from apps.
- Battery: the power_supply directory is relabelled as on a phone, so apps find it.
- With Run ARM apps on: apps no longer read the native bridge property or the ABI
  list keys, arm64 apps read aarch64 from uname(), the bridge loads as
  libsysglue.so, and libc.so, linker64 and libandroid_runtime.so read arm64. The
  libc.so redirect keeps the original file's identity, so Native Detector reports no
  inconsistent mount.
- Home, health and the log export show the app property view.
- Requires susfs4ksu-lkm-x64 v0.0.8. On v0.0.7 the rules that need it are skipped with

Installation • Features • Changelog • Community

Overview

PurrfectSnap is built on the foundation of SnapEnhance, pushing boundaries with innovative features and a refined user experience. This isn't just another fork; it's a complete reimagining of what's possible.

We're committed to active development, bringing you powerful tools that actually matter. Every feature is designed with real users in mind, not just for the sake of adding to a feature list.

Philosophy

This project exists because we believe in continuous innovation. We're grateful to the original SnapEnhance team for their groundbreaking work, and we're building on that legacy by exploring new possibilities and listening to what the community actually wants.

No aggressive donation requests. No minimal changes disguised as “major updates.” Just genuine development driven by a passion for creating something exceptional.

modules.name: Resampling for cheapies
modules.author: zyhk
modules.description: For avoiding "cheapie sound" distortion like a thin veiling smokescreen specific to LDAC Bluetooth earphones and DAC's under $30 (probably), this module sets near ideal re-sampling which involves special digital filtering at the system-wide mixer.
modules.readme:
A Magisk module resampling for cheapies

This module has been developed for casual users to overide re-sampling parameters of AudioFlinger (the system-wide mixer) in my other modules ("Audio misc. settings" and "Hifi Maximizer") so as to significantly improve audio quality of LDAC Bluetooth earphones and DAC's under $30 (probably) especially when replaying 48 kHz tracks up-sampled over or equal to 96 kHz & 24 or 32 bits by AudioFlinger except the quality of internal speakers and a 3.5 mm jack receiving 48 kHz audio data without re-sampling by AudioFlinger. If you are an audiophile expert, please use "extras/change-resampling-quality.sh" in "USB SampleRate Changer" which can change the parameters on the fly flexibly.

By the way, although most people might wonder how this module improve the audio quality of such devices, it is accomplished by very long filter length re-sampling near ideally (almost without pre-echo, ringing (post-echo) and aliasing noise) cutting off a frequency zone from just above 20 kHz filled with ultrasonic noise (although most people believe part of natural sound) generated by high frequency dithering (also called delta-sigma modulation, noise-shaping, super bit-mapping, etc.) at recording time and even 16 bits noise-shaping rounding output time (e.g., Opus decoders), and deteriorating audible sound like a thin veiling smokescreen by intermodulation significantly amplified by large amplification non-linearity of LDAC Bluetooth earphones and DAC's under $30. Furthermore this can be considered to be a kind of decimation filtering from 48 kHz & 16 bits samples (having dynamic range larger than usual 16 bits limit with ultrasonic noise) to 40 kHz & 24 or 32 bits ones except the ultrasonic noise by hight frequency dithering. So it has little effect when using AAC and SBC codecs which transmit audio data by 44.1 kHz & 16 bits.

However, as the noise has a merit adding mellowness into audible sound in the case of none cheap DAC's having very small amplification non-linearity, please use this module only when using LDAC Bluetooth earphones (any devices, as far as I know) and DAC's under $30 (typically using DAC chip CX31993, ALC5686, KT0210, etc.).

Finally, this module is designed to override re-sampling parameters set by my other modules, but can be used by itself only. You can install this module and enjoy its effect whether you are using one of them together or not.

Notes:
- If you feel your LDAC earphones or "cheapie" DAC wouldn't become to sound good at all, try editting "service.sh" script in the installed place or its ZIP archive so as to replace "83" in it with "84" or "85" for appropriately cutting off ultrasonic noise causing intermodulation.
- This module doesn't have the effect for Hires. tracks (greater than 48 kHz sample rate) which not having large pre-echo and ringing, and high frequency dithering noise, except ultrasonic noise added on purpose for mellowness. Anyhow, if you want to improve the quality of only Hires. tracks on "cheapie" devices, edit "service.sh" script in the installed place or its ZIP archive as described in the script.
- LDAC earphones and DAC's deteriorate the quality more or less by their internal over-sampling filtering when receiving low sample rate data.
- Don't forget disabling "A2DP hardware offload" on Snapdragon devices (if you can), because it forces post re-sampling (48 kHz to 96 kHz) and it is so much worse than this re-sampling.
- Also don't forget disabling "Absolute Volume" of Bluetooth devices in developer settings and setting a volume at the device side to be maximum for the best audio quality by avoiding analog low-pass filtering on portable devices having very large input parasitic capacitance.
- Appendix A. Examples of Re-sampling Parameters :

    | Stop band attenuation (dB) | Half filter length | Cut-off (%) | Stop band (%) | Memo |
    | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---- |
    | AOSP parameters: | - | - | - | - |
    | 90 | 32 | 100 | | Default Quality|
    | 80 | 16 | 100 | | LOW Quality |
    | 84 | 16 | 100 | | MED Quality |
    | 98 | 32 | 100 | | HIGH Quality |
    | Parameters of Audio misc. settings: | - | - | - | - |
    | 159 | 480 | 92 | | Old devices of A11 and earlier |
    | 165 | 360 | | 104 | Low performance devices of A12 and later with audio ones having small amp. non-linearity |
    | 179 | 408 | | 99 | General purpose on A12 and later for audio devices having small amp. non-linearity |
    | 194 | 520 | | 98 | Ultra Hi-Fi for audio devices having small amp. non-linearity |
    | Parameters of this module: | - | - | - | - |
    | 194 | 520 | 91 ~ 94 | | AAC or Flac 44.1kHz; for LDAC BT earphones and DAC's under $30 both having large amp. non-linearity |
    | 194 | 520 | 83 ~ 86 | | Opus 48kHz; for LDAC BT earphones and DAC's under $30 both having large amp. non-linearity |
    | 194 | 520 | 42,43 | | Hires. 96kHz; for LDAC BT earphones and DAC's under $30 both having large amp. non-linearity |
    | External examples: | - | - | - | - |
    | 100 | 29 | (91) | 109 | AK4493 (Sharp roll-off N-fold over-sampling) |
    | 150 | 42 | (91) | 109 | AK4191EQ (Sharp roll-off N-fold over-sampling) |
    | 120 | 35 | (97) | 110 | ES9038PRO (Fast roll-off N-fold over-sampling) |
    | vary 50 ~ 118 | 34 | 96 | (398) | ES9039PRO (Fast roll-off N-fold over-sampling) |
    | 110 | 40 | (96) | 109 | CS43131 (Fast roll-off N-fold over-sampling) |
    | 110 | 40 | (96) | 109 | CS43198 (Fast roll-off N-fold over-sampling) |
    | 98 | 130 | 98.5 | | MacOS Leopard (guess) |
    | 159 | 240 | | 99 | iZotope, No-Alias (guess) |
    | 100 | 64 | | 99 | SoX HQ linear phase (guess) |
    | 170 | 520 | | 99 | SoX VHQ linear phase (guess) |
- % in "Cut-off" and "Stop band" (starting from) fields means the proportion to the Nyquist frequency.
- Appendix B. Characteristics of Re-sampling Parameters :

    | Category | Background opaqueness (aliasing noise) | Pre-echo and ringing | Mellowness (intermodulation) | Memo |...

modules.name: Samsung Camera Experiments (A20) (R)
modules.author: TBM13
modules.description: Enables Raw Capture and sets the camera Hardware Level to Full
modules.readme:
Samsung Camera Experiments
This repository contains two Python scripts that can patch the camera lib of Exynos devices and enable/modify different features:
- patch_libexynoscamera3.py is for older Exynos devices that use the libexynoscamera3.so lib.
- Located at /vendor/lib/ and/or /vendor/lib64/.
- If both libs are present, I suggest patching the two of them
- patch_s5e.py is for newer Exynos devices that use the camera.s5eXXXX.so lib.
- Located at /vendor/lib64/hw/.
- The exact file name varies depending on your device. Look for something similar to camera.s5e8835.so.

Both scripts require Python 3.11 or higher. \
Make sure to download the whole repository (and not just the patch_*.py script) & install the dependencies too (pip install -r requirements.txt).

If the script fails to patch your lib, open an issue with your device model and attach the lib(s).

Usage, features & troubleshooting

Enabling or modifying something doesn't mean it will work as expected. It's up to you to test everything. \
In any case, feel free to open an issue if you encounter any problem.

libexynoscamera3.so

usage: patch_libexynoscamera3.py [-h] [--hardware-level HARDWARE_LEVEL] [--enable-cap CAPABILITY [CAPABILITY ...]]
                                 [--disable-cap CAPABILITY [CAPABILITY ...]] [--skip-depth] [--model MODEL] [--android-version ANDROID_VERSION]
                                 [--version VERSION]
                                 libs [libs ...]

positional arguments:
  libs                  Path(s) of the lib(s) that will be patched

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Lib Modifications:
  --hardware-level HARDWARE_LEVEL
                        The hardware level that will be set
  --enable-cap CAPABILITY [CAPABILITY ...]
                        The capabilities that will be enabled, separated by space.
  --disable-cap CAPABILITY [CAPABILITY ...]
                        The capabilities that will be disabled, separated by space.
  --skip-depth          Skips modifications on cameras with the "Depth Output" capability. Recommended if your device has a depth camera.

Magisk Module:
  If all the following args are provided, a Magisk module with the patched lib(s) will be created

  --model MODEL         The device the lib comes from (e.g. Galaxy A20)
  --android-version ANDROID_VERSION
                        The Android version the lib comes from (e.g. 11)
  --version VERSION     The module version (e.g. 1)

Hardware Level
- LIMITED - default level on pretty much every lib
- FULL - enables some capabilities, more info below
- LEVEL_3 - the lib doesn't seem to expect this level, it'll probably behave like LIMITED
- These are worse than LIMITED so you shouldn't use them:
- LEGACY
- EXTERNAL

Example: \
python3 ./patch_lib.py libexynoscamera3.so --hardware-level FULL will set the Hardware Level to FULL on all cameras.

Capabilities
- These are enabled by the lib if the Hardware Level is set to FULL:
- ManualSensor_ReadSensorSettings (MANUAL_SENSOR and READ_SENSOR_SETTINGS)
- ManualPostProcessing (MANUAL_POST_PROCESSING)
- BurstCapture (BURST_CAPTURE)
- Others
- RAW
- If disabled, GCam doesn't work and shows a black screen in photo mode. Enabling it should be enough to make it work on some devices.
- ZSL_PrivateReprocessing (Zero Shutter Lag and PRIVATE_REPROCESSING)
- Enabling this causes issues with some apps on the A20, A20e and A30 since these devices don't support ZSL. You can use this app to test ZSL.
- YUVReprocessing (YUV_REPROCESSING)
- DepthOutput (DEPTH_OUTPUT)
- ConstrainedHighSpeedVideo (CONSTRAINED_HIGH_SPEED_VIDEO)
- MotionTracking (MOTION_TRACKING)
- LogicalMultiCamera (LOGICAL_MULTI_CAMERA)
- SecureImageData (SECURE_IMAGE_DATA)

Examples: \
python3 ./patch_lib.py libexynoscamera3.so --enable-cap RAW enables the RAW capability on all cameras. \
python3 ./patch_lib.py libexynoscamera3.so --enable-cap RAW YUVReprocessing enables the RAW and YUV_REPROCESSING capabilities. \
python3 ./patch_lib.py libexynoscamera3.so --disable-cap BurstCapture disables the BURST_CAPTURE capability.

Troubleshooting
If Android doesn't show show any cameras, it means the lib crashed:
- Try patching with --skip-depth. Some devices have depth cameras and enabling capabilities on them breaks the lib.
- Someone reported they had to move the lib to /vendor/lib64/hw/. Try it if you see something like dlopen failed: library "libexynoscamera3.so" not found in the logs.

camera.s5eXXXX.so

usage: patch_s5e.py [-h] [--hardware-level HARDWARE_LEVEL] [--enable-cap CAPABILITY [CAPABILITY ...]]
                    [--lib-name LIB_NAME] [--model MODEL] [--android-version ANDROID_VERSION] [--version VERSION]
                    libs [libs ...]

positional arguments:
  libs                  Path(s) of the lib(s) that will be patched

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

Lib Modifications:
  --hardware-level HARDWARE_LEVEL
                        The hardware level that will be set
  --enable-cap CAPABILITY [CAPABILITY ...]
                        The capabilities that will be enabled, separated by space.

Magisk Module:
  If all the following args are provided, a Magisk module with the patched lib(s) will be created

  --lib-name LIB_NAME   The name of the lib (e.g. camera.s5e9925.so)
  --model MODEL         The device the lib comes from (e.g. Galaxy A54)
  --android-version ANDROID_VERSION
                        The Android version the lib comes from (e.g. 15)
  --version VERSION     The module version (e.g. 1)
Hardware Level
- LIMITED
- FULL
- LEVEL_3
- These are worse than LIMITED so you shouldn't use them:
- LEGACY
- EXTERNAL

Example: \
python3 ./patch_lib.py camera.s5e8835.so --hardware-level FULL will set the Hardware Level to FULL on all cameras.

Capabilities
- These are enabled by the lib if the Hardware Level is set to FULL or LEVEL_3:
- ManualSensor_ReadSensorSettings (MANUAL_SENSOR and READ_SENSOR_SETTINGS)...
modules.changelog:
These are Magisk modules with pre-patched camera libs for some devices where GCam is usable. \
I made them so I could share them on XDA, but if possible I suggest patching your own libs yourself.
- A20, A20e and A30:
- Disabled ZSL and Private Reprocessing. This was making the camera freeze in some apps.

modules.name: XBlocker
modules.author: bileizhen
modules.description: LSPosed module filtering spam replies in the Android X client (Miuix + Compose UI)
modules.readme:
XBlocker

Android 原生 X 客户端的 LSPosed 过滤模块

简体中文 | English

项目简介

XBlocker 是一个面向 Android 原生 X 客户端的 LSPosed 过滤模块。它在设备本地匹配规则，隐藏垃圾回复、推广内容和指定分类，整个过程都发生在 X 进程内，不需要把内容发到任何服务器。

模块优先检测 OkHttp GraphQL 入口，固定入口不可用时通过 DexKit 按特征定位并缓存，必要时回退 Jackson / LoganSquare；未识别的数据结构原样透传。

“屏蔽推广广告”同时接入 SSP 广告策略禁用、视频广告位过滤和共享时间线状态过滤，记录页新增“视频广告”分类，诊断页显示适配状态和实际移除的广告位数。当前在 X 12.35.0 验证了入口定位、钩子加载及策略拦截；完整视频流和缓存广告位移除的实机验收尚未完成。

媒体菜单、当前媒体模型及字段通过 DexKit 按稳定特征动态定位，不设宿主版本白名单；扫描结果按 APK 指纹缓存，更新或特征规则变化后失效。已验证 12.16.3、12.19.1、12.23.1、12.35.0 的 APK 定位，12.35.0 完成图片/视频实机下载验证；更早或未来架构变化仍可能需要补充适配，未匹配的入口保留原样。

媒体查看器原生菜单支持“下载图片 / 下载视频”（部分旧版沿用原生“保存”入口）：图片保存原图，视频选择最高码率的可用 MP4，保存到 /storage/emulated/0/Download/X/，使用 X 自带的下载图标。Android 10 及以上无需存储权限，支持后台下载和完成通知；当前不支持直播、YouTube 外链及只有 HLS 的媒体。单个图片上限 32 MiB、视频上限 512 MiB。

覆盖更新后自动定位入口，并显示宿主/模块版本、扫描或缓存结果及生效状态。模块代码更新后仍需彻底关闭并重新打开 X；本功能不请求 Root。

代码托管于 GitHub，同时发布到 LSPosed 模块仓库。

XBlocker 与 X、LSPosed 及词库维护者没有隶属关系。过滤效果依赖 X 客户端的内部接口，部分适配可能随 X 版本更新而变化。

功能特性

过滤规则
- 默认过滤回复，也可开启首页和搜索时间线
- “屏蔽包含关键词的推文”默认关闭；开启后，即使“仅过滤回复”开启，现有词库也会匹配普通推文正文及展开链接，仍遵循白名单和云端分类开关，不检查引用帖内部内容
- 昵称、用户名、推广内容和规则分类可分别开关
- 可独立开启“屏蔽时间线转帖”（默认关闭），移除转帖并保留引用帖；不受“仅过滤回复”、关键词和白名单影响
- “保留用户主页转帖”默认开启，屏蔽时间线转帖时仍保留用户主页转帖；关闭后用户主页转帖也会被屏蔽
- 支持关键词、/正则/flags 和 @用户名白名单
- 规则支持导入导出，并可在应用内直接测试
- 云端词库同步 x-comment-blocker，内置离线快照，支持手动同步和定时更新

多版本适配
- 按宿主接口自动选择过滤入口，不依赖单一版本号
- 优先 OkHttp GraphQL，必要时回退 Jackson / LoganSquare
- 未识别的数据结构原样透传，避免误伤时间线

实时拦截状态
- 原生通道使用 Android 16 实时通知接口，由系统决定展示为小米超级岛或 O 系流体云
- 原生通道不写入焦点通知参数，焦点通知转换另有独立开关
- 实时状态由 X 进程直接回报和发布，系统自动超时清理，无需常驻后台监控

诊断与更新
- 查看模块连接、数据入口、拦截计数和最近 1000 条记录
- 记录支持按账号或规则搜索、按类型筛选和按日期浏览，展开可查看完整规则并对规则命中的账号加入白名单
- 可导出诊断 ZIP，便于反馈问题
- 启动时自动检查 GitHub 正式版，也可随时手动检查
- 下载时可选 GitHub 原站或 gh.dpik.top 镜像，完成后请求系统安装

界面与语言
- Miuix 界面，支持浅色、深色、Monet、模糊、液态玻璃、预测性返回和全局缩放
- 设置中可隐藏桌面图标；隐藏后可从 LSPosed 打开 XBlocker，关闭开关恢复图标
- 支持简体中文、繁体中文、英文和跟随系统，可在设置中切换；Android 13 及以上也支持系统应用语言设置

兼容性

| 项目 | 支持情况 |
| --- | --- |
| Android | 9（API 28）及以上 |
| 框架 | LSPosed API 101 |
| FPA 内嵌 | 独立版本 0.3.5-fpa.1，用户已反馈可用；安装方法、验证范围及功能边界见 FPA.md |
| 已验证 X | 12.16.3-release.0、12.23.1-prod.01、12.35.0-prod.01（本次媒体下载实机验证） |

安装

1. 从 Releases 下载并安装 APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用 XBlocker，勾选 X（com.twitter.android）。只有启用“焦点通知转换”或小米焦点解锁 Hook 时才需要额外勾选 系统界面（com.android.systemui）；原生超级岛 / 流体云通道不依赖焦点通知。
3. 强行停止 X，再重新打开。
4. 打开 XBlocker，在“运行诊断”确认模块连接和时间线计数。

首次进入时 XBlocker 会弹出一次性引导，按厂商跳转到最接近的系统页面，用于开启自启动和实时活动。

从 0.2.4 起，LSPosed 模块包名为 io.github.bileizhen.xblocker，以符合模块仓库的包名规则。0.2.3 及更早版本使用旧包名：升级时先安装新包并在 LSPosed 中重新启用作用域，确认新包工作后再卸载旧包，两个包可以暂时并存。

常见问题

只有保留 XBlocker 后台才能拦截怎么办？

请在系统应用管理中允许 XBlocker 自启动 / 关联启动（名称因系统而异），再打开一次 XBlocker，并强行停止后重新打开 X 复测。已有 0.2.7 用户反馈开启模块自启动后恢复正常；这不代表所有后台问题都由同一原因引起，也无需因此长期锁定后台卡片。

模块已加载，却显示“回报受阻”或 Unknown authority？

使用 HMA-OSS 等应用隐藏工具时，请确保 X 能看见 XBlocker（io.github.bileizhen.xblocker）：检查针对 X 的隐藏规则、模板及 Xposed 模块预设，放行 XBlocker，或关闭针对 X 的应用隐藏。修改后先打开 XBlocker，再强行停止并重新打开 X。未收到回报时，界面的零计数不能证明过滤未运行，请结合回复是否被隐藏判断。

如何更新到新版本？

设置中的“启动时自动检查更新”默认开启，也可以随时手动检查。发现新版本后，在弹窗中点击“下载源”选择服务器；下载完成点击“请求安装”。Android 8 及以上首次安装时，需要允许 XBlocker 安装未知应用。

界面语言怎么切换？

在“设置 → 语言”中选择简体中文、繁体中文、英文或跟随系统；Android 13 及以上也可以在系统设置的“应用语言”中单独指定。未支持的语言回退到英文，切换语言不影响规则、白名单和已有配置。翻译维护见 I18N.md。

安装后需要做哪些一次性设置？

XBlocker 会在首次进入时引导开启自启动和实时活动。自启动保证云端词库能在后台定时同步；实时活动决定拦截胶囊能否显示为小米超级岛或 O 系流体云。引导每个安装只提示一次，选择“暂不”后不再打扰。

隐私
- 规则匹配在设备本地完成，不上传推文正文、账号凭据、自定义规则或白名单。
- 网络只用于公开词库、GitHub 版本检查、用户主动选择的更新下载，以及从 X 媒体菜单发起的图片/视频下载（X 公共媒体 CDN）。
- 诊断 ZIP 不包含自定义词库、白名单或拦截记录。

从源码构建

需要 JDK 21、Android SDK 37 和 Build Tools 36.0.0。创建本地 local.properties 后执行：

.\gradlew.bat :core:test :app:assembleDebug :app:lintDebug

真机测试：

.\gradlew.bat :app:connectedDebugAndroidTest

Windows 遇到 Unable to establish loopback connection 时，改用 scripts/build-local.ps1。正式发布请使用自己的签名密钥。

参与开发
- 多语言维护说明
- 第三方依赖与许可证
- GPL-3.0 完整协议

开源协议

XBlocker 原有代码采用 MIT；界面和部分组件移植自 SukiSU-Ultra v4.1.3，完整应用按 GPL-3.0 分发，详见 COPYING。词库、Miuix、Xposed API 及其他依赖的来源和许可证见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md。

致谢
- LSPosed：模块运行框架
- x-comment-blocker：云端词库来源
- SukiSU-Ultra：界面与部分组件来源
- Miuix：界面组件库
- libxposed/service：模块服务 binder 协议参考

浏览量
modules.changelog:
新增
- 接入 DexKit 特征定位与缓存，补充网络过滤入口和媒体菜单适配；更新后显示定位结果、宿主/模块版本及生效状态。
- 在 X 原生媒体菜单加入图片/视频下载，使用 X 自带下载图标，保存到 /storage/emulated/0/Download/X/。图片下载原图，视频选择最高码率的可用 MP4，支持后台下载和结果通知。
- “屏蔽推广广告”接入 SSP 广告策略禁用、明确广告位过滤和共享时间线状态过滤；记录页新增“视频广告”分类，诊断页显示三组适配状态及实际移除数。

使用提示
- 更新后请彻底关闭并重新打开 X，使新模块代码生效；本版本不请求 Root，不会自动重启 X。
- 保留现有词库和设置，没有添加默认关键词。SSP 屏蔽沿用“屏蔽推广广告”开关。
- 媒体下载需要 Android 10 及以上；部分旧版菜单沿用原生“保存”名称。单张图片上限 32 MiB、单个视频上限 512 MiB，暂不支持直播、YouTube 外链及只有 HLS 的媒体。
- 按特征适配不等于保证所有 X 版本兼容；未识别或存在歧义的结构保留宿主行为。

验证与范围
- 本次 APK 通过 159 项单元测试、14 项手机端测试、构建及 Lint（0 错误）。
- 已在 PLR110 覆盖安装 0.3.5（内部版本码 24），签名保持一致，词库和设置保留；X 12.35.0 确认新模块生效，10/10 组定位成功，7 个 SSP 钩子加载并观察到策略拦截。
- 媒体菜单定位已覆盖 12.16.3、12.19.1、12.23.1、12.35.0 四份 APK；此前已在 12.35.0 实机验证原生菜单图片/视频下载。

Added
- DexKit feature matching and fingerprinted caches for network filtering and native media menus. Post-update results show discovery, host/module versions and activation status.
- Native image/video download actions with X's own icon, saving to /storage/emulated/0/Download/X/. Images use original size; videos use the highest-bitrate available MP4, with background downloads and result notifications.

After updating

modules.name: 域见 ScopeView
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 域见 ScopeView
modules.readme:
域见 ScopeView

  更新 LSP 模块要逐个下载，逛仓库找新模块也得反复点开，还看不清哪些模块同时作用于某个应用？我来帮你。

  Updating LSP modules one by one, opening repo entries to find new modules, and unsure which modules target the same app? I'm here to help.

  一眼看清哪些 LSPosed 模块作用于某个应用，不用再逐个点开查找。

  See at a glance which LSPosed modules target an app, without opening them one by one.

  集中查看模块更新，支持单个更新和批量更新。

  Check module updates in one place and update them individually or in a batch.

  域见是独立的 Root 配套工具，无需激活 LSPosed 模块也可使用原有功能。

  ScopeView is a standalone Root companion utility; its existing features work without activating the LSPosed module.

  你的 Star ⭐ 是我持续更新的最大动力。

  Your Star ⭐ is my biggest motivation to keep updating ScopeView.

  公开下载 / Downloads · 官方索引 / Official index

主要功能 / Features
- 发现模块：按全部、未看和收藏浏览仓库，卡片查看简介与版本摘要；支持搜索、通道选择、隐藏已安装/已收藏、Stars 排序、收藏计数和一键看完。
  Discover modules: Browse All, Unseen and Saved with descriptions and release previews; search, choose a channel, hide installed or saved modules, sort by Stars, bookmark and mark unseen modules as seen.
- 按需查看详情：在卡片展开当前通道下载，另开详情查看 README、发布说明和历史版本；固定版本与下载入口便于跳过长文，APK 附件可在应用内下载、校验并通过 Root 或系统安装器安装。
  Details on demand: Expand current-channel downloads in a card, or open details for the README, release notes and history. A fixed version and download shortcut bypasses long text; download and verify APK attachments in the app, then install with Root or the system installer.
- 按应用查看模块：「本地」查看已有配置；「仓库」列出当前用户已安装的应用，按作者声明的 scope 包名精确查找已安装和未安装模块，不根据名称或简介猜测适用关系。
  Modules by app: Local shows existing scope settings; Repo lists apps installed for the current user and finds installed or uninstalled modules by exact package names in authors’ declared scopes, without guessing from names or descriptions.
- 查看模块更新：跟随管理器选择的官方来源和通道，检查已安装模块详情并核对缓存；失败时保留已有结果，识别仅名称变化的更新。
  Check module updates: Follow the Manager’s official source and channel, check installed-module details and reconcile cached results; retain existing results on failure and recognize version-name-only updates.
- 通知快捷入口：默认开启，点击通知打开域见；授权 Root 和通知权限后，划掉后台仍保留入口，设置中可关闭并保存选择。
  Notification shortcut: Enabled by default; tap to open ScopeView. With Root and notification permission granted, it remains after removing the app from Recents; turn it off in Settings with your choice saved.
- 优先显示更新：有更新的模块始终排在前面，各组内保留你选择的排序规则。
  Updates first: Modules with available updates always appear first, with your chosen sort order preserved within each group.
- 单个、多选或全部更新：支持更新单个模块；「一键更新」在无选择时更新全部，有选择时只更新选中模块；Beta、Nightly 和多 APK 项目由你逐项选择或跳过，没有 APK 的更新需你确认跳过。
  Individual, selected or all updates: Update one module, or use one button for all available updates without a selection and only selected modules with a selection; choose or skip each Beta, Nightly, or multi-APK item, and explicitly skip updates with no APK.
- 并行下载、有序安装：单独点击多个模块时，最多三个下载并行，安装仍逐个执行；同一模块不重复排队，域见自身最后更新。
  Parallel downloads, ordered installs: Start up to three individual downloads in parallel while installation stays sequential; avoid duplicate requests for the same module and update ScopeView itself last.
- 取消剩余任务：等待当前更新完成，再停止后续更新。
  Cancel remaining updates: Let the current update finish, then stop the remaining items.
- 搜索与排序：按名称、包名和说明搜索，发现还可搜索作者；为应用、模块和作用域详情分别保存排序规则，支持收藏优先。
  Search and sort: Search names, package names and descriptions, plus authors in Discover; save separate sorting for apps, modules and scope details, with Saved first available.
- 多语言界面：默认跟随系统语言，也可手动选择简体中文、英文或俄语。
  Multiple languages: Follow the system language by default or choose Simplified Chinese, English or Russian manually.
- 跳转管理器：从模块详情打开 LSPosed 管理器中的对应模块。
  Open in Manager: Open the corresponding module in LSPosed Manager from its details.
- 模块日志与诊断：展开或收起模块发布说明，支持 Markdown；导出日志包含各模块的关联和状态快照，慢操作标明界面、模块与阶段。
  Module notes and diagnostics: Expand or collapse Markdown release notes. Export logs with per-module associations and state snapshots, plus screen, module and stage context for slow operations.
- 安装包清理：默认后台自动清理已安装或旧版本的缓存包与无任务使用的下载残余，扳手中可独立关闭或手动清理；保留待安装、较新版本、失败重试和自身更新核对所需文件。
  APK cleanup: Automatically clear installed or older cached APKs and inactive download remnants by default; disable this separately or clean manually in Settings. Pending installs, newer versions, retry files and self-update verification files are retained.
- 忽略更新与卸载：在模块卡片的“更多”中永久忽略该模块更新，扳手设置可恢复；忽略项保留显示和主动单独更新，不参与更新计数、批量更新或后台提醒。卸载交由系统确认，返回后核对目标包的实际安装状态。
  Ignore updates and uninstall: Permanently ignore a module through its card's More menu and restore it in Settings. Ignored modules remain visible and can be updated individually, while being excluded from counts, batch updates and reminders. Uninstallation uses system confirmation and checks the target package after return.
- 后台更新与提醒：默认每四小时计划处理模块、作用域和发现列表，有更新时通知；进入应用先显示可操作的缓存。「进入应用时检查模块更新」单独控制，前台目录检查有十分钟冷却；返回前台的本地作用域读取独立静默进行。支持手动下拉刷新，不自动下载或安装；系统可能延后后台任务。
  Background refresh and reminders: Schedule module, scope and Discover refreshes every four hours and notify about updates. Show actionable cached lists first. Foreground update checks have a separate switch and a ten-minute cooldown; local scope reads on return remain quiet and independent. Pull to refresh manually. No automatic downloads or installation; Android may delay background jobs.
- 配置备份：在扳手中导出和导入用户设置、外观、标签位置、排序、收藏、忽略更新和自定义来源，包含有效默认值；不复制 Root、作用域、安装任务、APK 或目录缓存。
  Configuration backup: Export and import user settings, appearance, tab position, sort order, bookmarks, ignored modules and custom sources, including effective defaults. Root state, scopes, installation tasks, APKs and catalog caches are excluded.
- 后台恢复：可控制开机恢复与进程退出后的后台恢复，授权 Root 后提供一次性开机后备，不自动弹出界面；系统限制及主动强行停止仍按 Android 行为处理。
  Background recovery: Control boot restoration and recovery after process exit, with a one-shot Root boot fallback when authorized and no automatic screen launch; Android restrictions and user force-stop remain respected.
- M3E / MIUIX 外观：支持浅深色、系统动态配色、自定义色盘、液态玻璃及独立炫彩导航；首页标签可显隐、拖动排序、自选启动页，栏体高度与底部距离分别设置。...
modules.changelog:
域见 ScopeView 0.3

本次更新 · 0.3What's newЧто нового

本次核心特色：给你的 App 找模块。

想给某个 App 找模块，不用再挨个翻仓库了。打开「作用域」，切到「仓库」，再点选这个 App，就能看到仓库里由作者注明支持它的模块。

已经安装的、还没安装的都会一起列出来。即使以前没有任何模块给这个 App 配过作用域，也可以点进去查找。找到感兴趣的模块，就能继续看详情；有安装包的，可以直接在域见里下载并安装。

简单说：「本地」看已有的作用域配置，「仓库」帮你给 App 找模块。这里按名单中的 App 包名精确匹配，不靠名字或简介猜测；空名单和通配符不表示通用支持。没填写名单的模块，暂时不会出现在对应 App 下面。

Main feature: find modules for a specific app.

You no longer need to browse repository entries one by one. Open Scopes, switch to Repo, and choose an app to see modules whose authors have listed it as supported.

Installed modules and modules you have not installed appear together. You can search this way even if the app has never had a module assigned to it. Open a module's details and, when an installer is available, download and install it in ScopeView.

Local shows your existing scope configuration; Repo helps you find modules for an app. Matches use exact app package names in the authors’ lists, not names or descriptions. Empty lists or wildcard entries do not mean universal support; modules without a list will not yet appear under the app.

Главное обновление: поиск модулей для конкретного приложения.

Больше не нужно открывать карточки в каталоге одну за другой. Перейдите в «Области», выберите «Каталог», затем нужное приложение — и увидите модули, авторы которых указали его в списке поддерживаемых.

Установленные и ещё не установленные модули показываются вместе. Поиск работает и для приложения, которому раньше не назначали модули. Откройте сведения о понравившемся модуле; если есть установочный файл, его можно скачать и установить прямо в ScopeView.

«Локально» показывает ваши текущие настройки областей действия, а «Каталог» помогает найти модули для приложения. Используются точные имена пакетов из списков авторов, а не названия или описания. Пустые списки и шаблоны не означают всеобщую поддержку; без списка модуль пока не появится под приложением.

作用域列表和模块操作。

仓库列出当前用户可识别的已安装 App，包括没有本地作用域和零候选的 App；默认按仓库模块数量排序。本地/仓库点击直接切换，分别记住排序和浏览位置。

本地列表过滤未安装、未识别模块的残留配置，保留已安装但停用的模块、不同 Android 用户的配置和成功读到过的取消选择历史；部分扫描或读取失败不清空旧关联。

已安装模块可打开 LSPosed，有可用界面时还能直接打开模块，并补上更新和卸载入口；未安装模块进入仓库详情和下载。启用状态取本地配置，不把作者声明支持当成已经启用。

Scope lists and module actions.

Repo lists recognized apps installed for the current user, including apps with no local scope or no candidates, and defaults to repository-module-count sorting. Tap to switch sources; Local and Repo retain separate sorting and reading positions.

Local filters leftover entries for uninstalled or unrecognized modules while retaining installed disabled modules, Android-user configuration and previously observed unchecked associations. Partial scans or read failures do not clear those associations.

Installed modules offer Open LSPosed, Open module when an interface is available, update and uninstall actions. Uninstalled modules open repository details and downloads. Enabled status comes from local configuration, not an author's support declaration....

modules.name: Call Recorder
modules.author: Benojir Sultana
modules.description: Call recording with configurable audio, conference sessions, app lock and optional microphone/VoIP support. Magisk, KernelSU/Next and APatch.
modules.readme:
Android Call Recorder 2.0.3

Local call recording for Android 10+ with privileged system-app support and an optional non-root microphone mode.

What changed
- Cellular calls, held calls and conference parents/children use one recording session. Repeated ACTIVE callbacks do not start competing recorders. Confirmed local/remote hang-up ends capture immediately. Only ambiguous removals receive a 250 ms conference replacement window; repeated cleanup events do not extend it. An unanswered waiting call does not keep the previous recording alive.
- Choose automatic, microphone, voice recognition, voice communication, camcorder, voice call, uplink or downlink sources. Protected sources require CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT.
- AAC/M4A with selectable sample rate and bitrate, or AMR-NB/AMR-WB with codec-compatible rates. Configuration applies to the next recording. Automatic mode can fall back to microphone; the notification shows the source actually used.
- Privileged cellular calls using Automatic source default to the original VOICE_CALL + AMR-NB / M4A pipeline with valid 8 kHz / 12.2 kbps rates. Compatible automatic call audio can be turned off to use the stored custom encoder settings; those settings are retained. Microphone/VoIP and explicitly selected sources continue using the custom encoder configuration.
- A native stop() error is no longer labelled as a short call. A playable file with a positive metadata duration is recovered even if the audio input ended first. Nonempty files that cannot be finalized are retained with .incomplete appended rather than deleted; they are excluded from the playable library. Only empty failed files are deleted.
- Last recording result in Settings shows the actual source/profile, recorder elapsed time, readable audio duration, file byte count, app/Android version and native error codes. It also records reset/release results and, after shutdown, the recording service, notification and the app's own microphone AppOp state. Unsupported or denied queries are reported as unavailable. Details stay local and can be copied manually; no phone number, contact name or audio path is included.
- Notification Stop and Pause/Resume buttons can be enabled independently. Stop saves the file and suppresses automatic restart for that detection session. Pause/resume continues the same file. The library also provides controls.
- Optional accessibility microphone sharing and phone-state detection for non-root users. The app no longer refuses to open outside /system.
- Optional notification-based call detection for WhatsApp/Business, Telegram/X, Messenger and Instagram, with per-app switches.
- Category filters, date groups, search, light/dark themes and a recording summary. Existing flat-folder M4A recordings remain visible under Phone calls. New recordings use category folders; AMR files are included.
- Built-in 6–12 digit app PIN using a salted PBKDF2 verifier and retry delay. Locks when all app activities enter the background; covers Settings shortcuts and hides recent-app previews. Backups are disabled. This is an interface lock, not audio-file encryption or protection against a rooted administrator. Forgotten PINs cannot be recovered inside the app.

Audio support: read this first

| Mode | Requirements | Practical limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Privileged cellular recording | Privileged system installation, allowlisted CAPTURE_AUDIO_OUTPUT, runtime microphone permission | Both sides depend on ROM/audio HAL support. Root alone does not grant protected sources. |
| Non-root cellular recording | Enable automatic recording, non-root microphone mode, accessibility service, microphone and phone-state permissions | Microphone capture where Android allows it. Speakerphone can help; remote audio and Bluetooth audio are not guaranteed. Phone-state detection can start during outgoing dialing once the device enters call audio mode. |
| Internet calls | Enable automatic recording, VoIP detection, notification access and selected apps | Detects ongoing call notifications while communication audio is active. Some apps/versions do not publish a usable notification. Automatic uses microphone. Privileged sources can be tried manually but do not guarantee the remote stream. |
| Manual recording | Open the app, grant microphone permission, choose Record now and a category | Available when automatic detection is unsupported. Stop manually when finished. |

Accessibility does not read screen text, press call controls, or store message content. The notification listener inspects package identity, call category, ongoing flag and call style; it does not save notification text. Calls and PIN data stay on the device.

Android can refuse background microphone-service starts. When that happens, a Call detected notification lets the user explicitly start recording. Allow notifications for this flow. An expired call notification cannot start a recording after its session has ended. Only one microphone recording can run at a time; a second detected session is skipped with a message.

The OS can supply silence without reporting a recorder error. A successfully created file therefore does not prove both sides are audible. Make a short test call with each chosen source and route before relying on it. MediaProjection/playback capture is not a universal solution for private call audio.

Platform references: Android audio input sharing, background microphone service restrictions.

Setup

1. Install the APK normally for microphone mode, or install the universal module through a root manager and reboot.
2. Open the app and grant microphone permission. Contacts are optional for contact names. Phone-state permission is required for accessibility cellular detection. Allow notifications for recording status and controls.
3. In Settings, enable automatic call recording and configure audio...

modules.author: gilbsgilbs
modules.description: An XPosed / LSPosed module that prevents applications from spamming the annoying location notification dot on Android 12 + LineageOS.
modules.readme:
Location Indicator Whitelist

This LSPosed module is supposed to prevent selected packages from spamming the annoying location
notification dot.

How
- Install Magisk/Riru/LSPosed
- Install and enable this module
- Open the main activity and select the packages you want to whitelist
- Reboot

Why
- Some apps do access the location in background for legitimate reasons, and the user may not want
  to be interrupted because of that.
- Some location providers packages aren't whitelisted by ROMs.
- The "Status bar location indicator" switch in developer options has a lot of drawbacks:
- It disables all notifications when the user might actually find the notification dot useful
- It doesn't survive a reboot, meaning that you consistently have to switch it off
- It's buggy: if you disable it at the wrong moment, you may get the notification dot stuck on
    your screen until you reboot. On LOS20, it seems that it even doesn't prevent the location
    notification dot from showing at all.

Caveats
- Currently only tested on OnePlus 8 (instantnoodle) running LineageOS 20. Please note that I do not
  plan on adding support for all ROMs and devices, and I might not even read or respond to issues
  requesting new supports. However, I'll gladly review PRs adding support for new ROMs or
  devices.
- The current hook is very weak and dirty. I would have preferred hooking into the core framework
  directly, but none of my attempts were successful. I had to hook into SystemUI instead. If you
  find a way to hook into android framework directly, please let me know. Here's a sneak peek of my
  unsuccessful hook attempts:
- android.permission.PermissionUsageHelper => shouldShowLocationIndicator
- android.provider.DeviceConfig => get/setBoolean("location_indicators_enabled")
- android.permission.PermissionManager => getIndicatorExemptedPackages
- Patching resource config_locationExtraPackageNames
- Systemizing whitelisted apps
- com.android.systemui.statusbar.phone.PhoneStatusBarPolicy => onLocationActiveChanged
- a combination of all those
- UI is clunky but simple and straight to the point.

Contributing

Please open issues and PRs on the upstream
repo, not on the
XPosed-Module-Repo.

modules.readme:
OnePlusPlusLauncher

Focused LSPosed enhancements for OnePlus System Launcher

OnePlusPlusLauncher is a small, open-source libxposed module for improving app-drawer search on OxygenOS. The current source intentionally supports only OnePlus System Launcher 16.6.9 (160060009) on Android 13 or newer.

Features
- Swipe-up search autofocus — focuses app-drawer search and opens the keyboard automatically.
- Enter-key launch — launches the highlighted result from the keyboard's Search or Go action.
- Ranked fuzzy search — preserves OnePlus pinyin, alias, DMP, multi-user, and privacy-aware results while adding typo-tolerant title matches.
- Global-search-button redirect — opens focused app-drawer search instead of the external global-search application.
- Swipe-down search redirect — opens focused app-drawer search when the home-screen swipe-down action targets Global Search.

Every feature has an independent toggle in a single Material 3 configuration screen and defaults to enabled.

Requirements
- OnePlus System Launcher 16.6.9
- Android 13+
- Root with an API-101-compatible LSPosed implementation

Compatibility with older launcher releases is not maintained. Launcher updates may change internal classes or methods and require a module update.

Installation

1. Install the module APK.
2. Enable OnePlusPlusLauncher in LSPosed.
3. Select System Launcher (com.android.launcher) in its scope.
4. Restart System Launcher.
5. Open OnePlusPlusLauncher to configure the five features.

The Ready status confirms that LSPosed is reachable and System Launcher is selected. It cannot directly prove that the manager toggle is enabled or that the launcher process has loaded the hooks.

Architecture
- The configuration app is one Jetpack Compose Material 3 screen.
- libxposed remote preferences are the only settings store.
- HookEntry installs exact, fail-closed reflection hooks in the launcher process.
- The fuzzy ranker is pure Kotlin and unit tested independently from Android and the launcher.
- Decompiled launcher sources and APKs stay local under the ignored decompiled/ directory.

See Hook maintenance for the current target descriptors and adaptation workflow.

Source mirrors

Development happens in the canonical repository. Every verified master commit is mirrored to the Xposed Modules Repository; releases continue to be published there separately.

Building

Use JDK 17 and run:

./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleRelease

Local release builds are unsigned when signing credentials are unavailable. CI accepts the following secrets for signed releases:
- SIGNING_KEY_STORE_BASE64
- SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS
- SIGNING_KEY_STORE_PASSWORD
- SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD

Disclaimer

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by OnePlus, OPPO, or Google. It modifies another application at runtime; use it at your own risk.

License

modules.name: TargetedHide
modules.author: Vision/VisionR1
modules.description: Ηide files, folders, and packages from specific target apps.
modules.readme:
TargetedHide (THIDE)

Purpose

A Zygisk module that hides specific files, folders, or apps from specific other apps — and only those apps. Everything else on your device sees your files completely normally.

For example: you can prevent a specific app from seeing a folder on your storage, while every other app (your file manager, gallery, etc.) still sees that folder perfectly fine.

What it actually does
- Hides files and folders from chosen apps. The hidden app doesn't just see an empty folder — it genuinely can't find it at all, the same as if it never existed.
- Hides installed apps from other apps' "installed apps" lists (see below).
- Only affects the specific apps you choose. Nothing is hidden system-wide, and nothing is touched, moved, or deleted on your storage — ever. (Yes, that includes /system — see below for what that actually means.)

Requirements

To use this module you need one of the following combinations:
- Magisk with Zygisk enabled or provided by a module, and either DenyList enabled or disabled if using Shamiko or Zygisk Assistant or NoHello module.
- KernelSU with Zygisk Next or ReZygisk or NeoZygisk module.
- KernelSU Next with Zygisk Next or ReZygisk or NeoZygisk module.
- APatch with Zygisk Next or ReZygisk or NeoZygisk module.

Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.

Installation

1. Download the latest from Releases
2. Flash it in Magisk / KernelSU / APatch, like any other module
3. Reboot
4. Edit the config files, then just force-stop and reopen the app you're hiding from — no reboot needed for config changes

Configuration

All config lives in /data/adb/modules/targetedhide/config/. You can edit these files with any root file manager or text editor.

target.txt — which apps get anything hidden from them

One app per line. This is the list of apps that TargetedHide is even active in — anything not listed here sees your device completely unmodified.

com.example.somecleaner
com.example.somefilemanager

If an app has multiple processes (shown as package:something in a process list), you can write either package:something or package.something — both work the same.

path.txt — what to hide, for every app in target.txt

One path per line. Applies to every app listed in target.txt, unless that app has its own Per-app file.

/storage/emulated/0/SomeFolder
/storage/emulated/0/somefile.txt

If you add a file, folder, or package to your config that doesn't actually exist on your device yet, nothing bad happens. The module simply ignores that line and moves on — no crashes, no errors.

Per-app files — different rules for different apps

Want one specific app to have its own, different hide list instead of the shared path.txt? Create a file named with the package name of the app, e.g.:

com.example.somefilemanager.txt

If this file exists (even if empty), it completely replaces path.txt for that one app — path.txt is ignored for it. Every other app in target.txt still uses path.txt as normal.

Hiding an app by name, without knowing its exact folder

Since Android randomizes app install folders (like /data/app/~~AbCd==/com.example-EfGh==), writing the exact path is impractical. Instead, just write the app's package name, with no / in front:

com.example.someapp

This hides that app's folder wherever it actually is, and also hides it from installed-app lists.

If you use HMA-OSS or other app-hiding tools on the same target app, see here before adding package names to your config.

Excluding one thing from a broader rule

Start a line with ! to make it an exception — this always wins over any hide rule, no matter what order the lines are in.

/data/app
!com.example.appyouwanttokeepvisible

This hides everything under /data/app, except that one app.

If you hide something broad like /data/app, you must exclude every app listed in target.txt itself, or each of them will hide their own files from themselves and crash on launch. See the full example below for exactly what this looks like.

This also works for plain files and folders, at any depth — not just app names. If you exclude something nested a few folders deep inside a hidden folder, every folder along the way down to it stays browsable too, so you can actually reach it:

/storage/emulated/0/Photos
!/storage/emulated/0/Photos/Vacation/2026/example.jpg

Browsing into Photos here shows nothing except the path leading to example.jpg — every other file and folder inside Photos stays hidden as normal.

Full example

  Click to view complete config examples

path.txt:
Standard folder and file hiding
/storage/emulated/0/Download/Example
/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/example.jpg

Keep specific files or subfolders visible inside a hidden path
!/storage/emulated/0/Download/Example/Allowed.txt

Package matching (hides specific app install folders)
com.example.someapp

If hiding the entire /data/app directory:
/data/app

IMPORTANT: You MUST exclude every target app using this global list!
Otherwise, they will hide their own files and crash on launch.
!com.example.firsttarget
!com.example.secondtarget

You can also exclude any other apps you want this target app to still see
!com.example.appyouwanttokeepvisible

com.example.somefilemanager.txt:
Standard folder and file hiding
/storage/emulated/0/Download/Example
/storage/emulated/0/DCIM/example.jpg

Keep specific files or subfolders visible inside a hidden path
!/storage/emulated/0/Download/Example/Allowed.txt

Package matching (hides specific app install folders)
com.example.someapp

If hiding the entire /data/app directory:
/data/app

IMPORTANT: You MUST exclude the target app itself!
Otherwise, it will hide its own files and crash on launch.
!com.example.somefilemanager

You can also exclude any other apps you want this target app to still see
!com.example.appyouwanttokeepvisible

Under the hood: Hiding from "installed apps" lists

TargetedHide relies on native C++ hooks to hide standard files and folders...

modules.name: WeType-Swipe

modules.description: 为安卓版微信输入法增加可自定义的按键下滑操作，支持全选、剪切、复制、粘贴的 LSPosed 模块
modules.readme:
微信输入法滑动快捷键（WeType-Swipe）

给安卓版微信输入法增加 26 键和九宫格 上滑 / 下滑独立快捷动作 的 LSPosed 模块。
- 上滑、下滑分别绑定功能，支持独立的自定义固定文本和标签。
- 功能标签按方向显示：上滑在字母上方，下滑在字母下方。
- L 键下滑可进入内置模块设置；可修改任何支持的键位。
- v1.13.0 起只有微信输入法内置设置可以编辑配置，独立模块 App 为维护与恢复中心，不再维护第二份配置。

下载

当前正式版：v1.13.0（versionCode 69）

从 GitHub Releases 下载 APK、完整源码 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。沿用 v1.12.0 的永久签名，支持直接覆盖安装。

设置入口

首选：微信输入法内置设置

1. 安装 APK，在 LSPosed 中启用模块，作用域选择 微信输入法。
2. 强制停止并重新打开微信输入法，或重启设备。
3. 在微信输入法键盘上 L 键下滑（仅当该绑定已配置），打开内置模块设置；也可在微信输入法的 关于页面连续点击图标 5 次。
4. 在「26 键 / 九宫格 / 选项与备份」三页完成设置，点击底部「保存并应用配置」。

若 L 键未绑定或入口受 ROM 限制，请使用关于页五击入口。

独立模块 App：维护中心

从桌面或 LSPosed 中打开模块 App，可执行：
- 跳转 微信输入法内置设置（若目标 App 不允许跳转，请使用关于页五击）。
- 导出升级前独立 App 的历史配置到 TXT，供迁移检查与回滚使用。
- 复制不含按键文本、密码或其他隐私内容的模块诊断信息。
- 切换桌面图标显示 / 隐藏；隐藏后仍可从 LSPosed 打开。

独立模块 App 不再编辑、保存或展示 26 键和九宫格当前映射。 历史备份不等于输入法当前生效配置。

主要功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 双向动作 | 26 键 A–Z、九宫格 2–9 分别配置上滑与下滑 |
| 编辑快捷键 | 全选、复制、剪切、粘贴、复制全部、剪切全部、撤销、重做 |
| 位置和选区 | 段首、段尾、文首、文尾、选择至文本位置 |
| 输入法功能 | 原生剪贴板、常用语/快捷发送、输入法切换 |
| 自定义文字 | 每键每方向独立文本，支持中文、Emoji 和换行 |
| 键帽提示 | 上滑标签显示在键帽上方、下滑在下方；标签支持隐藏和自定义 |
| 设置快捷入口 | 绑定「内置模块设置」，推荐 L 键下滑 |
| 触发选项 | 26 键和九宫格独立触发距离、振动、按键标签和触发提示 |
| 备份恢复 | 内置设置中的 TXT 文件导入导出与剪贴板复制/导入 |

内置设置在微信输入法 Activity 页面承载时支持 Android 系统文件选择器。若由 输入法悬浮窗口承载，使用剪贴板备份与恢复；此模式不显示无法完成的文件选择器入口。

默认下滑预设

仅首次没有现有配置时使用推荐预设。覆盖安装已有版本时，优先保留输入法当前生效配置，不自动覆盖为预设。内置设置可以主动应用推荐键位，确认后需点击底部保存。

| 按键 | 下滑动作 | 按键 | 下滑动作 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | 剪贴板 | S | 常用语 |
| D | 撤销 | F | 重做 |
| G | 段首 | H | 段尾 |
| J | 文首 | K | 文尾 |
| L | 内置模块设置 | Z | 全选 |
| X | 剪切全部 | C | 复制全部 |
| V | 粘贴 | B | 禁用下滑 |
| N | 选至文首 | M | 选至文尾 |

其他 26 键、所有上滑、九宫格默认不绑定。

v1.13.0 架构与界面更新
- 唯一生效配置源：微信输入法私有配置，内置页面直接编辑、保存；不再将完整配置镜像到独立模块 App。
- 兼容升级：如果目标输入法尚未保存配置，可以从旧模块 App 已保存的配置执行一次性迁移；已有目标配置绝不被历史数据覆盖。
- 维护中心重新设计：主入口清楚展示，诊断与历史备份分区，支持亮色 / 深色和更易点击的触控区域。
- 内置设置优化：清楚标注 ↑上滑 / ↓下滑标签位置；推荐键位应用前确认；备份文件管理成为独立卡片，文件备份优先。
- 完整 TXT 备份：统一在内置设置中导入导出当前实际配置，包含动作、标签、文本和手势参数；导入前校验格式并要求确认。
- 不修改原有动作 ID 0–24、触摸动作实现、密码输入框保护和键帽方向绘制规则。

详细更新：v1.13.0 Release、CHANGELOG。

兼容性及已知限制
- Android 9 及以上（API 28+）；需 LSPosed + 安卓版微信输入法。
- 过往版本曾验证微信输入法 3.5.0 / 3.5.2 / 4.0.0 及 Android 16；v1.13.0 的单一配置迁移、内置文件选择器和界面改造仍缺少真实设备完整回归。
- Android ROM 或微信输入法的 Activity 生命周期变化可能影响直接跳转和文件选择器回调，遇问题建议保留 LSPosed 中 WeTypeSwipe / WeTypeSwipeFile 日志。
- 升级前建议先备份当前配置。如果 Android 阻止安装较低版本，不要通过直接卸载来降级，以免清空私有数据。
- 模块不联网、不上传输入内容或配置。TXT 文件由用户主动选择保存位置。

构建与发布

环境：JDK 17、Android SDK 35、Gradle 8.9。

./gradlew --no-daemon --stacktrace clean testDebugUnitTest lintRelease assembleRelease

Windows 可使用 gradlew.bat。正式版签名存储在仓库受保护的 GitHub Actions Secrets 中，不在源码仓库内。

正式发布流程：更新 gradle.properties、README、CHANGELOG、RELEASE_NOTES_v*.md；通过 PR CI 后合并 main；打开 Actions → 构建并发布正式版 → Run workflow（选择 main、输入不含 v 的版本号），由仓库受保护工作流验证原永久签名并发布 APK、源码 ZIP 和 SHA256。不再创建发布 Issue 或发布触发 PR。

反馈请使用 Issues 中的缺陷或功能建议模板；旧发布触发记录已加 release-automation 标签，历史版本在 Releases。分类及筛选见 Issues 整理说明。

modules.changelog:
WeType-Swipe v1.13.0

微信输入法滑动快捷键 · 单一内置设置 + 界面优化

本次版本的重点

v1.12.0 中，微信输入法内置设置与独立模块 App 分别保留可编辑配置。用户实际遇到“L 键下滑已经在输入法生效，但独立模块仍显示旧绑定”的问题。v1.13.0 从架构上取消两套可编辑配置：
- 微信输入法进程中的私有配置是唯一实际生效的数据源。
- 26 键、九宫格、上下滑、自定义标签/文字和手势参数均只在微信输入法内置设置中编辑和保存。
- 独立模块 APK 改为维护与恢复中心，不再展示或保存另一份按键映射；也不再依靠双向镜像广播保持两个编辑器同步。
- 内置保存失败时提示错误，不显示虚假的成功消息。

界面改进

独立模块维护中心
- 重新设计为统一的原生卡片布局，突出「打开内置模块设置」主入口。
- 分区展示「配置来源」「维护工具」「版本与恢复」。
- 提供旧模块历史配置 TXT 备份、环境诊断信息复制、桌面图标显示/隐藏。
- 支持深色/亮色、合理字体间距与更大点击区域。
- 明确区分历史独立 App 备份与微信输入法当前实际生效的配置，避免混淆。

微信输入法内置设置
- 26 键与九宫格页面显示 ↑上滑／↓下滑标签位置提示。
- 第三标签页明确命名为「选项与备份」，备份管理独立成卡片。
- 从 Activity 打开的内置设置，优先提供 导出 TXT / 导入 TXT 文件按钮；剪贴板复制和导入保留为辅助途径。
- 输入法悬浮窗口无 Activity 文件回调时，保留剪贴板导入导出。
- 应用推荐下滑键位前需要确认，避免无意改动已编辑的配置；仍需点击底部保存后生效。

升级与数据保护
- 优先保留输入法已有配置，不自动重置为推荐默认键位。
- 只有目标输入法完全没有已保存的配置时，才允许从旧独立模块数据执行一次性、有令牌校验的迁移。
- 迁移完成后旧模块数据保持只读、留作 TXT 历史备份；不执行删除。
- 导入 TXT 进行完整字段和格式验证，用户确认后写入输入法单一配置源。
- 动作 ID 0–24、手势识别、L 键下滑打开内置设置、关于页五击入口、键帽上下文字布局及密码框隔离保持兼容。

安装与使用

1. 建议升级前先通过 v1.12.0 保存一份有效配置 TXT；如两边配置不一致，以输入法当前实际生效的配置为准。
2. 安装 v1.13.0 正式 APK，无需先卸载。模块包名与长期签名证书保持不变。
3. 在 LSPosed 中确保模块启用、作用域包含微信输入法；强制停止并重新打开微信输入法。
4. 从 L 键下滑（已绑定的用户），或微信输入法「关于」页面连续点击图标 5 次打开内置设置。
5. 修改后点击底部保存。导入/导出 TXT 的入口位于「选项与备份」页；独立模块 App 仅提供维护功能。

已完成的工程验证
- GitHub CI：单元测试、Lint、Debug 构建。
- GitHub 正式 Release 工作流：clean testDebugUnitTest lintRelease assembleRelease。
- versionCode=69、versionName=1.13.0。
- 使用与 v1.12.0 相同的永久证书签名，并由 apksigner 验证。
- GitHub Release 同时附 APK、源码 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。

已知限制与回退

发布时没有完整真机回归反馈。 Android 系统和微信输入法版本可能影响 Activity 页面打开、文件选择结果回调，以及跨进程首次迁移。自动构建通过不能证明这些真实设备交互都已成功。

如果遇到内置设置跳转或 TXT 文件操作异常，可以保留 LSPosed 里与 WeTypeSwipe、WeTypeSwipeFile 相关的日志；历史备份不会自动删除。Android 可能限制安装旧 versionCode，请先备份，不要无备份直接卸载降级。

版本
- Version Name：1.13.0
- Version Code：69
- Android：API 28+
- 模块签名：沿用既有永久签名，兼容直接覆盖安装
