级一次性审批，物化与状态查询即时强制执行权限
展开 + 运行时命中覆盖；真实调用链一次触发验证（顺序/相邻耗时/跨线程防误判）。
- 候选排序 + 批量验证：可解释的候选方法排序与一次触发批量运行时验证。
- A/B 场景差分：会话级调用图场景采集，自动定位「首次分叉」；分叉条件自动定位 + A/B 条件探针验证分支方向。
- Value Lineage：字段 writer/reader 来源分类、条件值来源、跨方法递归数据流、端到端运行时 A/B 值验证。
- Root Cause：静态+运行时证据融合的根因候选排序与评分，最小假设实验 A/B 自动验证后重排。

🧱 资源治理与打包
- 重型分析任务的内存 / 并发 / 日志预算；Androguard 独立 worker 进程隔离。
- PC 冻结版（PyInstaller onedir exe）打包清单补齐全部新模块，并加入 cryptography（Ed25519）运行依赖。
- 新增 CI：PC pytest + M5 Tracer 单测与 APK
留在旧版，Phase 2-8 的 C++ 路由/工具实际未编入；本次全部重编。
- 手机本地 MCP 暴露完整 runtime_* 工具族（之前缺失）。

📦 发布产物
- ReconBridge-M5.8.zip — KernelSU 模块（daemon + Zygisk native hook），module.prop version=M5.8 / versionCode=6。
- ReconBridge-Tracer.apk — LSPosed 模块（M5 Java 运行时侦察，含 Phase 2-8 全部能力）。
- reconbridge-mcp-win64.zip — PC 侧 MCP 工

⚠️ 升级提醒（重要）
Java 层能力全部在 ReconBridge-Tracer.apk 版本必须两者都更新：
1. 刷入新的 ReconBridge-M5.8.zip 并重启；
2. adb install -r ReconBridge-Tracer.apk，在 LSPosed 管理器重新启用并确认作用域。

只换其一会导致 daemon 与 Tracer 版本不匹配、新 Runtime 能力不可用。

modules.name: scene-unlock-toolkit
modules.author: hu847266h
modules.description: Scene (N1 Alpha8) activation-chain research: LSPosed module (legacy stubs, verdict rewrite) + scene-daemon runtime hot-patch (ptrace icache sync). MIUI + KernelSU.
modules.readme:
Scene Unlock Toolkit

针对 Scene（com.omarea.vtools，N1 2026.09 Alpha8 / 2026.10 Alpha10） 本地会员激活链路的逆向研究工具包：一个 LSPosed 模块（改写激活裁决 + 自动化 daemon 内存热补丁）+ 一套 ptrace 注入工具链。适配魔改版 LSPosed 2.2.0（legacy 桥接）、MIUI + KernelSU 真机环境。
装好即用？ 完整安装/激活/排障说明见 使用教程 USAGE.md；模块下载见 Releases。
模块 hook 表按「Alpha10 优先、Alpha8 兜底」多候选尝试，两个版本通用；daemon 补丁偏移与版本一一对应（Alpha8 / Alpha10 两套见下表），其他版本需按「偏移速查表」一节的方法重新定位。

背景

Scene 的会员激活不走纯客户端判定，而是四层链路：

ActivityStartSplash（选择运行方式）
        │  跳转被状态机拦截
        ▼
C0060b3  状态机（激活状态决定能否进主页）
        │  读取激活状态
        ▼
C0978zz  daemon 客户端（TCP 127.0.0.1:14754）
        │  activate / exec-shell / get-kernel-prop …
        ▼
scene-daemon  守护进程（UPX 壳，本地授权校验）

关键事实（实测）：
- daemon 由 App 通过 files/up.sh 拉起，运行态由 UPX stub 解到 memfd:upx 匿名映射执行，监听 TCP 127.0.0.1:14754（不是报告中写的 8788）。
- 授权校验完全本地，无外联。activate 返回 expired 时，所有 exec 类 action（exec-shell / dumpsys / get-kernel-props 等）一律返回空 —— 这就是「进了主页但全空」的直接原因。
- 魔改 LSPosed 2.2.0 不注入 libxposed API 101 的 dex，且 legacy 桥接的 XposedBridge.hookMethod 返回 Unhook 而非 Object[]。

因此解锁需要同时做两件事：App 侧改写裁决（LSP 模块）+ daemon 侧打通数据通道（内存热补丁）。二者缺一不可。

方案一：LSP 模块（lsposed-module/）

架构

app/src/main/java/com/hu/sceneunlock/
  MainHook.java        IXposedHookLoadPackage，5 个功能 hook + 4 个诊断探针
  DaemonPatcher.java   daemon 热补丁自动化（部署 assets → su 执行 repatch.sh）
stubs/                 手写 legacy Xposed 桩（XC_MethodHook / XposedBridge / …）
app/stubs/xposed-stubs.jar   compileOnly 依赖

Hook 表（运行时混淆名，Alpha10 / Alpha8）

MainHook 按 tryAnyHook 多候选机制依次尝试，首个命中的类生效（混淆名随版本漂移，g/t/r/l、b/c 等成员名在两版间保持稳定，类名变了）：

| 功能 | Alpha10 | Alpha8 | Hook | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 裁决漏斗 | a.s10.g(String) | a.zz.g(String) | DaemonVerdictHook | 改写 daemon 裁决：expired/invalid → success@4102444800000（2100-01-01） |
| 工作模式闸 | a.s10.t() | a.zz.t() | WorkingModeHook | daemon 在线（r()==true）时强制返回 root（静态字段 l 两版同名） |
| 授权缓存 | a.ns.a() | a.vq.a() | DaemonVerdictHook | 同上（缓存 toString 的数据源，供状态机读取） |
| 激活状态机 | a.a3.b(String) / c() | a.b3.b(String) / c() | StateModelHook | 强制 ActivatedStateModel 为已激活/永久专业版（setter 未混淆，两版一致） |
| 诊断探针 | a.s10.M/3、j/1 | a.zz.M/3、j/1 | DiagHook | REQ / ENC 请求与加密日志，仅诊断用 |

踩坑记录（魔改 LSPosed 2.2.0 + MIUI）

1. API 101 不可用：魔改版不注入 API 101 dex，implement IXposedHookLoadPackage（legacy）才能被加载。AndroidManifest 的 xposedminversion 必须写 legacy 值。
2. hookMethod 签名：legacy 桩必须 public static Unhook hookMethod(Member, XC_MethodHook)；返回 Object[] 会静默失败。且缺 findAndHookMethod 变体 → 用 findClass + getDeclaredMethod + hookMethod 组合。
3. 首屏点击不跳转：根因是模块写日志到 files/ 时 EACCES（目录属主不对）。修复：su -c "chown -R 10449:10449 /data/user/0/com.omarea.vtools/files"。
4. daemon 起不来：files/up.sh 需要 toolkit 在 PATH 且 busybox 有 applet 符号链接（sh install_busybox.sh）。

方案二：scene-daemon 内存热补丁（daemon-patch/）

为什么不做文件级补丁
- UPX magic 被魔改（尾部自定义段表标记），upx -d 拒绝解壳。
- 手工 dump + 重建 ELF 的路线失败：运行态 dump 混入已初始化的脏全局/指针，重建出的 ELF（无论是否打补丁）启动即 100% CPU 死循环、不监听端口。
- /proc/pid/mem 写入被 MIUI 内核 anti-debug 拦截（EIO，setenforce 0 也无效，无 yama，dmesg 无 AVC）。
- map_files/ 对 MAP_SHARED memfd 写入可写，但只更新内存，icache 不同步（回读是新字节、执行还是旧指令）—— 对照实验（改字符串引用 #0x4b4→#0x4ad）确认了这一点。

最终方案：map_files 写补丁字节 + ptrace 注入执行 icache 失效指令（dc cvau / ic ivau / dsb ish），由内核路径保证一致性。

补丁点（memfd 内偏移 = vaddr − 0x2CA000）

| 偏移 | vaddr | 原始字节 | 补丁字节 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
N1 Alpha8（memfd text 0x2AD000 = 2805760 B，memfd 偏移 = vaddr − 0x2CA000）：

| memfd 偏移 | vaddr | 原始字节 | 补丁字节 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0x1e562c | 0x4af62c | ad030054 (b.le) | 1f2003d5 (nop) | Function A：校验剩余时长 ≤0 跳 expired，放行让 success 路径接管 |
| 0x1ee6e4 | 0x4b86e4 | ec000054 (b.gt) | 07000014 (b +28) | Function B：强制走 success 分支 |
| 0x1ee6ec | 0x4b86ec | 00d01291 (add x0,x0,#0x4b4) | 00b41291 (#0x4ad) | expired 字符串引用 → invalid（对照实验遗留，兼作兜底） |
| 0x2acf00 | 0x576f00 | 全零（3KB 空白区） | 48B shellcode | icache 失效 stub，mov x4, xzr; b . 为完成标志 |

N1 Alpha10（memfd text 0x2B9000 = 2854912 B；daemon 有 stub + text 两个 memfd 映射，repatch v4 自动选最大 r-xs 段；SITE3 免除——模块侧改写裁决后字符串兜底无意义）：

| memfd 偏移 | 原始字节 | 补丁字节 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0x1e554c | ad030054 (b.le) | 1f2003d5 (nop) | Function A：同上，bl 0x1e3a10（有效期解析）后 cmp x0,#0; b.le 跳失败路径 |
| 0x1e3b40 | ac000054 (b.gt +20) | 05000014 (b +20) | Function B：强制走 success 返回（解析出的时间戳，success@） |
| 0x2b8938 | 全零（1736B 空白区） | 48B shellcode | icache 失效 stub，同 Alpha8 |

裁决字符串 vaddr：invalid=0xc04ad、expired=0xc04b4、not-you=0xc04bb、success@=0xc0fc0（LOAD1 rodata）。

icache shellcode（keystone 汇编，x0..x3 为待刷新地址）：

dc cvau, x0 ; ic ivau, x0
dc cvau, x1 ; ic ivau, x1
dc cvau, x2 ; ic ivau, x2
dc cvau, x3 ; ic ivau, x3
dsb ish
isb
mov x4, xzr
b .

mempoke2（ptrace 注入器）

PTRACE_ATTACH → GETREGSET(NT_PRSTATUS) 保存现场 → SETREGS 把 PC 指到 shellcode、x0..x3 传刷新地址 → PTRACE_CONT → 轮询 x4==0 → 恢复现场 → PTRACE_DETACH + SIGCONT。
- 新版会逐线程尝试：主线程可能阻塞在 syscall（PC 改了也不会执行），优先挑 PC 已落在代码段内的空闲线程。
- NDK 25 静态编译产物的 PT_TLS p_align=8 会被 MIUI bionic loader 拒载（library ... has invalid TLS segment）—— 二进制补丁把 p_align 改成 64 即可（见仓库内说明）。

repatch.sh

一键重打：自动探测 daemon pid 与 memfd 基址 → 基线 diff 校验（>400 字节差异视为 Scene 更新了 daemon，中止防写坏）→ 全量覆写补丁快照 → 逐线程 ptrace 注入刷新 icache → SIGCONT 恢复 → 检查 14754。

自动化：DaemonPatcher

模块内置自动化，正常使用无需手动敲命令：
- 触发 ①：宿主 Application.attach 后启动 worker，最多等 60s 到 daemon 被拉起；
- 触发 ②：DaemonVerdictHook 观察到 expired/invalid（说明 daemon 换了新进程没补丁）；
- 两次触发共享 60s 冷却 + 单飞锁，幂等；工具三件套从 APK assets/scene_patch/ 释放到 /data/local/tmp/scene_patch/ 后经 su 执行。

使用

0) 前置：KernelSU/root、LSPosed（魔改 2.2.0 legacy 可用）、无线调试或 USB
1) 修复 files 目录属主（首屏 EACCES 时）
adb shell "su -c 'chown -R 10449:10449 /data/user/0/com.omarea.vtools/files'"
2) 构建 APK（stubs 先编 jar，或直接 assemble）
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease
3) 安装并在 LSPosed 勾选模块 + 作用域 com.omarea.vtools，重启系统界面
adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk
4) 打开 Scene → 激活流程自动完成；daemon 重启后模块会自动重打补丁

手动重打（模块自动化异常时的兜底）
adb shell "su -c 'sh /data/local/tmp/scene_patch/repatch.sh'"

偏移速查表（换版本重新定位的方法）

1. ps -A | grep scene-daemon 找 pid，SIGSTOP 后 cat /proc/pid/map_files/ > dump.bin 拿干净 text（Alpha8 为 0x2AD000、Alpha10 为 0x2B9000，延迟 ≤60ms 防止调度写脏页）。注意 Alpha10 起 daemon 有 stub（8KB）+ text（2.9MB）两个 r-xs memfd 映射，必须选最大的那段。
2...
modules.changelog:
SceneUnlockLSP v1.6-watchdog (versionCode 105)

修复用户实测反馈：覆盖安装后功能/概览过段时间再次瘫痪（v1.5 已消除弹窗，但瘫痪仍在）。

根因（真机实验定位）

daemon 死掉重启后（任何原因：系统查杀/崩溃/升级），恢复链存在一个致命窗口：

1. App 在主页时只轮询数据、不再发 activate 消息 → verdict 触发（触发②）不会出现
2. 若唯一的补丁请求恰好撞上 busy/60s 冷却被丢弃（日志 patch request ignored (busy)）
3. → 重启后的 daemon 一直裸奔：exec 类 action 返回空 → 概览页空白、功能瘫痪，直到手动强停 App

真机验证：杀掉 daemon 后新进程拉起，看门狗 30s 内检测到 PID 变化并自动重打，
patched daemon pid=xxx 日志确认，14754 恢复 ESTABLISHED，补丁字节实测正确。

修复

DaemonPatcher 新增看门狗线程：每 30 秒 pgrep 核对 daemon pid，与上次成功打补丁的 pid 不一致即无条件重打（不依赖 verdict 触发，不受 activate 消息频率影响）。补丁失败时保留旧 pid 记录，下个周期自动重试。

说明
- 全新安装后概览空白/无法拉取配置的问题在本机（MIUI + Alpha10，pm clear 复现）未能复现——pm clear 后直接进主页、数据满格。若该现象仍存在，请提供 logcat | grep -aE "SceneUnlock|omarea" 日志
- v1.5 的弹窗抑制（盗版提示/Unknown error）继续保留

安装

覆盖安装即可。日志新增：watchdog: daemon pid A -> B、patched daemon pid=xxx

modules.readme:
data_backup
_Download releases_: https://github.com/Magisk-Modules-Alt-Repo/data_backup/releases

Introduction

Script of creating User Data backup from booted system with root (subsequent restoring by  script).

*Advantages*
- creating and restoring data backup in the absence of TWRP for the device;
- a great opportunity to create a full backup with the contents of the internal memory or part of it, allowing you to restore an exact copy without reconfiguring the user after restoring;
- the speed of archiving and restoring is much more higher than TWRP;
- launch from a PC (useful when the display is crashed to take the backup);
- the ability to restore a backup created on a newly released version of Android, in the case when there is no TWRP for this Android yet;
- automatic needed reboot at the first login after restoring the backup in the presence of root;
- the presence of various options for creating / restoring a backup;
- the ability to restore a backup without TWRP from booted system with root;
- the universality of the method for different models of brands of devices on different versions of Android.

*Screenshots*

Supported devices

*First-grade support*

on my hands:
- Google Pixels
- HTC

*Others*
- Asus Rog Phone

some:
- Xiaomi, POCO

Requirement
- Android 7+
- Magisk 20.4+
- Optionally: Windows, macOS or Linux PC with Android Platform Tools installed
- Optionally: External storage device (extSD or USB-OTG)

Installing script

The script data_backup.sh will be integrated into the system by installing a Magisk module data_backup_v2.xx-MAGISK.zip.
- Download the module and copy it to internal storage.
- In the Magisk App: Modules - Install from storage - select the downloaded module .zip - Reboot. Done, now you can use it.

Running script

There are 2 variants for running script, from device or PC therminal.
1. Main variant: From *Android therminal*, for example Material Terminal or another.

    su

    data_backup.sh

2. From *PC therminal* :

   adb shell

    su

    data_backup.sh

Parameters at starting

*Without parameters* (main & default)

The script will make data backup with all contents of internal device memory, except for folders of archives itself data backup and folders TWRP with backups.

*Parameters*

*#1*

-e    - to *exclude* from archive one or several catalogues of internal memory. Folders are listed through a blank.
NOTE: _Paths named with blanks accordingly are not supposed !_
Example 1.1: data_backup.sh -e DCIM Download Pictures/Screenshots My_Music

There is posible to specify folders names with *Pattern Matching:*

Example 1.2: data_backup.sh -M -e DCIM *ownload Pictures/Screen* iG[oO]* [mW]*

where:

*ownload - folders names in the root of intSD with "ownload" in the end of names;

Pictures/Screen* - all subdirectories beginning on "Screen" in catalogue "Pictures" of internal SD;

iG[oO]* - all catalogues beginning on iGo without sensitivity the register of the letter "o";

[mW]* - names begin on letters "m" or "W".

*#2*

-m - to exclude from created backup ALL content of the internal storage. This variant is similar as official TWRPs create data backups (without *media*).

Example: data_backup.sh -m

*#3*

-M - forced creation of *Multy-volume* backup on any storage device in exFAT format for possible coping and restoring from the external SD in FAT32.

This key is not obligatory at backuping directly on external SD in FAT32 because in this case the script automatically creates Multivolume archive up to 4GB of each volume.

The key, as the first specified, can be used together with key -m or -e  ....

Example: data_backup.sh -M -e Download

*#4*

-h - to show *help* message and exit.

Created files

The backup is saving into folder databackup in the root of a storage device.
In case of next backuping, the folder databackup of a previous backup is automatically renamed to databackup_ :

Inside databackup folder  there are files for a latest backup :
- data*.tar - archive files of the backup;
- check_sum.sha1 - hash-file of archive files data*.tar;
- datarestore.log - log-file of restoring user data;
- databackup.log - log-file of backuping user data.

File databackup.log has info for correct restoring backup:
- backuping date;
- system software number;
- including intSD (yes/no);
- excluding folders from intSD;
- Magisk version;
- screen settings.

In the end of the file there is info about successful backuping or error code (in last case data*.tar archives will be deleted).
Warning
- Restoring backup is ONLY from the folder databackup in the root of a storage.
- Do not rename the folder and data*.tar files !
- Any editing of the archive data*.tar files is not allowed for correct restoring !

Features of script working
- Data backup automatically will be created on external storage device if it is mounted. First the script is looking for mounted USB-OTG, then extSD and after intSD. You can unmount external SDs for creating the backup on internal SD.
- If external SD in FAT32, the backup will be created automatically by Multy-volume archive files up to 4GB of each.
- To avoid error 1, do not use your smartphone and do not switch off the screen during backuping.
- After starting the script switches on Air plane mode, reduces the screen brightness.
- Running calculating hash-checksum will be started in the background after successful backuping, Air plane mode will be switched off, screen settings will be restored. At this time you can use your device.
- User itself has to check if enough free space for backup.
- Save created backup on intSD by copying databackup folder somewhere to PC, cloud and so on.

Probable mistakes
- Backup will not be saved at any error during backuping.
- Error 2: "Failure. Error 2. Not enough place on storage device". Care about enough free place.
- Error 1: "Failure. Error 1". It means about other mistakes of recording on a storage device. Do not use your device and do not switch off a screen during backuping...

modules.name: Jefferderp's custom keyboard remaps
modules.author: Jefferderp
modules.description: Jefferderp's custom keyboard remaps
modules.readme:
What?
A simple Magisk module for Android which remaps physical hardware keys to any of Android's virtual software keycodes. For example, remapping your physical *CAPS_LOCK* key to *KEYCODE_POWER* (power button).

By default in release v1.0, the following keys are remapped:
- CAPS_LOCK --> KEYCODE_POWER
- NUMPAD_MULTIPLY --> KEYCODE_POWER

Why?
Why not?  :)

How?
This is accomplished by modifying Vendor_ffff_Product_ffff.kl and Vendor_ffff_Product_ffff.kcm in /system/usr/keychars/. Thanks to Magisk, we can inject these files systemlessly without modifying the root filesystem; the net effect is the same.

This module has been tested to work with scrcpy in OTG mode (scrcpy --otg --hid-keyboard --hid-mouse). Android detects scrcpy's OTG mode as a Generic HID (specifically Device ffff with Vendor ffff), which is the same as any physical keyboard connected via USB.

This module has been tested to work on stock Android 11, 12 & 13, but _should_ still be compatible back to Android 7.

Help?!
This module does not include any options for customization. However, doing so is trivial. If you wish to add or modify any key bindings, you can download the latest release, unpack the zip file, and modify Vendor_ffff_Product_ffff.kl as desired. The existing file contains my customizations, which are clearly notated. Refer to this page for a list of valid keycodes. Once finished, re-zip the module and install via Magisk.

See Issue #3 if you get stuck.

I said help!?
While I appreciate your interest in this module, I'm not offering support unless you have a specific question. Every Android device is different, and you will need to find, modify and inject the specific file which determines your keycode mappings.

Thanks to the following resources which helped me put this together:
- http://gustavepate.github.io/blog/20130714/android-keyboard-layout-logitech-tablet-keyboard/
- https://developer.android.com/reference/android/view/KeyEvent
- https://source.android.com/devices/input/key-character-map-files
- https://forum.xda-developers.com/t/how-to-remap-mouse-buttons-and-is-possible-to-make-kl-and-kcm-files-for-it.3190940/
- https://topjohnwu.github.io/Magisk/guides.html

*Initial commit was 2022/03/22. Commit dates were squashed after performing a rebase.*

modules.name: NexFusion
modules.author: a092devs
modules.description: Advanced root and LSPosed patch manager for Android featuring fluid Material design.
modules.readme:
NexFusion
  Advanced root + LSPosed runtime bytecode patch manager for Android featuring fluid Material design.

    🚀 Getting Started •
    ⚡ Features •
    🧩 Patch Bundles •
    📱 Supported Apps •
    🎨 Theming •
    🌐 Translations •
    🔍 Troubleshooting

📖 Overview

NexFusion is an advanced Android application that applies modular runtime bytecode patches to supported applications via LSPosed / libxposed (API 101/102) and DexKit.

Unlike traditional ahead-of-time (AOT) patchers that decompile, modify, re-sign, and reinstall target APKs, NexFusion operates purely in-memory at process startup:
- 🔒 Zero APK Tampering: Target applications remain official, unaltered on disk, and preserve their authentic Play Store signatures and Play Protect integrity.
- ⚡ Dynamic DexKit Interception: Obfuscated classes, methods, and fields are resolved on the fly via bytecode opcode pattern analysis and string fingerprinting.
- 🛡️ Fail-Safe Isolation: Hooks execute within protected runCatching runtime boundaries, preventing target app crashes if non-critical symbols change across updates.
- 📦 Modular .nxb Bundles: Patches are packaged into signed .nxb (NexFusion Bundle) APK containers loaded directly into process memory — no APK installation required.
- Root & Framework Requirements: Android 8.1+ (API 27) with root access and LSPosed or any modern framework implementing libxposed API 101/102.
- Security Boundary: Patch bundles execute bytecode within target application processes. Always source bundles from trusted maintainers.
- Integrity Guarantee: NexFusion deliberately excludes banking, payment, and security-critical applications from patching.

🚀 Getting Started

1. 📥 Install NexFusion: Download the signed release APK from Releases.
2. 🛡️ Configure LSPosed Scope: Enable the NexFusion module in LSPosed and check the scope for your target apps (e.g. YouTube, Reddit, Instagram, Spotify, X, Maps).
3. 📦 Install Patch Bundles: Open NexFusion → Patches tab. The official companion repository (a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches) is pre-configured; tap Install on NexFusion Patches.
4. ⚙️ Toggle Desired Patches: Open the Home tab, tap any supported application card, and enable your preferred runtime hooks.
5. 🔄 Apply & Restart: Tap Force Stop or use the 1-tap App Info shortcut to restart the target application and let LSPosed attach the updated bytecode hooks.

⚡ Key Features

1. 🌐 Multi-Source Patch Aggregation & Provenance
- Add, update, and manage multiple independent patch repositories simultaneously.
- Source Provenance Classification: Clearly badges sources as Official, NexFusion, Community, or Custom.
- Conflict Detection: Proactively flags applications whose patches are declared by more than one bundle before enabling.
- Offline Caching: Instant application startup using local metadata caching with pull-to-refresh synchronization.

2. 🎨 Dual Design Systems: Official Miuix & Material 3
- Official Miuix Integration: Built directly with the official compose-miuix-ui library (miuix-ui, miuix-blur, miuix-preference, miuix-icons), delivering the authentic MIUI / HyperOS aesthetic.
- Material 3 Mode: Native AndroidX Material 3 design with dynamic Monet color theming on Android 12+.
- Cohesive Surface Switching: Changing the design system instantly transforms every screen, dialog, card, and navigation bar in unison.
- Optional Floating Navigation Bar: An opt-in Miuix arrangement featuring FloatingNavigationBar with real-time blur shaders on Android 13+ and safe fallbacks on older versions.

3. 🎯 Truthful Dynamic Compatibility Engine
- Version recommendations and compatibility badges are derived directly from the targets declared by active patch bundles at runtime:
    val allTargets: List = if (matchingBundles.isNotEmpty()) {
      matchingBundles.flatMap { it.targets[packageName].orEmpty() }
  } else {
      known?.targets.orEmpty()
  }
- Uses semantic version evaluation with trailing zero normalization (2026.42.0 vs 2026.42).

4. 🔄 Honest Process Lifecycle & Force-Stop Control
- Distinguishes genuine root am force-stop termination from background process killing (killBackgroundProcesses), providing truthful feedback.
- Integrated 1-tap App Info navigation directly from the patch screen for manual force-stop on unrooted configurations.

🎨 Appearance & Theming

View Display & Customization Settings

Configure via Settings → Appearance:

| Setting | Options | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Colour Mode | ☀️ Light / 🌙 Dark / ⚙️ Follow System | System-wide theme brightness, persisted across reboots |
| Design System | 📱 Material 3 / 💎 Miuix | Seamlessly switches the visual design language across all screens |
| Floating Navigation Bar | 🟢 On / ⚪ Off | *(Miuix only)* Detaches bottom bar with real-time blur shader (Android 13+) |

🧩 Curated Patch Repositories

The official companion patch repository is maintained at:
- 🔗 a092devs/Nexfusion-Patches

Included Bundles:
- Nexfusion-Patches: Unified community runtime patch distribution covering 17 supported application targets:
- 🎥 Video & Audio: YouTube, YouTube Music, Crunchyroll, VLC, Stremio
- 💬 Social & Communication: Instagram, X (Twitter), Reddit, Discord, LinkedIn
- 🛠️ System, Productivity & Audio: Google Photos, Gboard, Gmail, Google App (Discover), Google Maps, Proton VPN, 1.1.1.1, Spotify

📱 Supported Applications Matrix

🎥 Video, Audio & Streaming (5 Targets) — YouTube, YouTube Music, Crunchyroll, VLC, Stremio

| Application | Package Identifier | Key Patch Capabilities |
|---|---|---|
| YouTube | com.google.android.youtube | Ad-free playback, SponsorBlock, background audio, DeArrow replacement, custom speed/quality dialogs, swipe volume/brightness, miniplayer, ambient mode, Litho node bypass, channel search fix. |...

modules.description: 开机自启和保活 Termux 服务与二进制服务，并提供定时/亮屏/ WIFI 启停服务和 WebUI 聚合管理
modules.readme:
SvcHub
  中文 | English

    一个 Termux / 二进制服务启动、保活和更新的管理模块，支持多种启停策略，WebUI 聚合管理

    在线文档：limpidmo.github.io/SvcHub

    初衷就是为了聚合运行一些服务，省得一个服务装一个模块，统一管理服务。若你觉得好用，欢迎给仓库来个 Star ⭐~

界面概览

| 服务状态 | 服务配置 | 功能设置|
|---------|---------|---------|
|  |  ||
| 启停功能 | 二进制更新 | 服务日志|
|  |  ||

核心功能
- WebUI：中英双语界面，统一管理服务启停、配置管理、查看服务日志及占用；网页访问支持 PWA 安装
- 两类服务：支持 Termux 服务 与 二进制服务 的启动配置及收尾命令管理。Termux 服务无需软件挂后台，可以 root 执行
- 多种启停策略：支持定时窗口启停、亮屏启停、Wi-Fi 启停等策略满足多样化启停需求
- 巡检保活：默认 60 秒巡检一次（可配置 10~86400 秒），自动拉起带 start 标签的服务，日志自动轮转
- 更新服务：支持来源于 GitHub 仓库的二进制文件更新，可按每小时/天/周检查版本，可开启自动更新，替换失败自动回滚
注：本模块默认不开启唤醒锁，如需减少锁屏 Doze 或 CPU 休眠的对巡检、更新检查等的影响，可在「基本设置」开启唤醒锁

快速开始

1. Releases 中下载模块 ZIP
2. 在 Root 管理器中 → 模块 → 从本地安装，选择对应 ZIP 文件刷入，音量键可选是否挂载 DNS 解析配置，默认不挂载
3. 安装完成后重启设备，升级时自动保留已有配置
4. 在 KernelSU 或 APatch 等管理器 → 模块 → 点击打开 SvcHub → 进入 WebUI
Magisk 用户无管理器 WebUI 入口，首次安装默认开启外部访问；浏览器访问 http://127.0.0.1:5555，默认密码 admin，首次登录强制修改。KernelSU / APatch 默认关闭外部访问，改密后在管理器内开启

注意事项
- 请自行确认服务以及命令的安全性，再放到模块中应用和执行，自行对操作和处理结果负责
- Termux 服务依赖已安装的 Termux 应用并下载pkg install对应软件包，二进制服务自行从可信渠道下载使用，并赋权（chmod +x）使用。
- 所有脚本为 POSIX sh，兼容 Android /system/bin/sh
- 玩机有风险，请自行备份数据。代码全公开，请自行检阅后按需刷入

项目文档

完整使用说明与开发文档见 https://limpidmo.github.io/SvcHub。

指南
- 简介 — 模块定位与基本概念
- 启停功能 — 定时 / 亮屏 / Wi-Fi 启停与优先级
- 巡检保活 — 巡检间隔与服务保活机制
- 服务配置示例 — Termux 服务与二进制服务配置范例
- Termux 服务 · 二进制服务 — 两类服务的配置参考
- 更新配置 — 二进制服务更新 JSON 配置
- 注意事项 · 常见问题 — 使用须知与排错
- 更新日志 — 各版本变更记录

开发

- 模块构建 — 打包与校验流程

modules.name: wechat-observatory
modules.author: B022MC
modules.description: WeChat Observatory - LSPosed-based WeChat gateway
modules.readme:
WeChat Observatory

友链
- LINUX DO 社区
项目意义
其实就是因为逆向出来的ipad协议、车载协议等等，容易风控被下线 而且不能再次扫码登录 只能使用wx app 才做了这个项目。这样就算被风控也能继续使用微信、机器人 直接控制的wxapp 就不需要再去扫码登陆其它东西。最重要的是被冻结了依然能识别指令，只是不能回复消息。
截图

Web 管理台

Android / LSPosed 模块

小米设备解锁

如果你手上是小米机型，先把解锁这一步走通，给你们指一条明路：Linuxoid-cn/Mi8G3-Unlocker。

WeChat Observatory（微信看台）是一个通过 Android LSPosed 模块接入微信的网关控制台。手机模块负责在微信进程内观察消息、同步联系人、执行发送；服务端负责 API Key 身份、当前微信账号绑定、消息持久化、出站队列和 Web 管理台。

当前 Android LSPosed 模块面向微信 Android 8.0.75 适配。微信内部实现随版本变化，升级微信后需要重新验证消息观察、联系人同步、媒体上传和发送路径。

微信消息 -> LSPosed 模块 -> 网关入库和实时推送 -> Web 管理台
Web 手动发送 -> 网关出站队列/WebSocket -> LSPosed 模块 -> 微信

功能
- API Key 管理：生成、停用、启用、删除。删除 key 后对应模块会被注销。
- 模块注册：模块自动识别当前微信 wxid，不需要用户手动填写。
- 当前账号隔离：切换微信后，同一个 API Key 更新当前绑定，旧账号消息不会混到当前聊天列表。
- 通讯录同步：支持好友、群聊、文件传输助手。
- 消息观测：文本、图片、语音、视频、文件等消息类型均可记录；附件字节上传后可在 Web 中预览或播放。
- 手动发送：Web 管理台发送文本，手机模块从队列取消息并在微信内发送。
- 实时刷新：Web 管理台通过 SSE/WebSocket/轮询组合展示实时状态和消息。
- Docker 部署：提供单机 Docker Compose 示例和 k3s 参考配置。

项目结构

cmd/bridge                 网关服务入口
cmd/bridge-db              数据库创建、迁移、种子和检查工具
internal/bridge            HTTP API、模块注册、事件、出站队列、Web 静态资源
internal/storage/mysql     MySQL 表结构和持久化实现
android-module             LSPosed 微信模块
web/admin                  React + shadcn 风格管理台源码
internal/bridge/admin_dist Web 管理台构建后的嵌入资源
deploy/docker              Docker Compose 部署示例
deploy/k3s                 k3s 部署参考
docs                       详细文档

快速开始

1. 准备环境
- Go 1.24.2+
- Node.js 20+ 和 npm
- MySQL 8+，生产建议使用 MySQL
- Android Studio / Android SDK，用于构建 LSPosed 模块
- 已 Root 的 Android 手机、LSPosed、微信
- 微信 Android 8.0.75

2. 启动服务端

本地内存配置示例：

$env:BRIDGE_HTTP_ADDR=":8088"
$env:BRIDGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD="change-this-password"
$env:BRIDGE_DEVICE_ADMIN_PASSWORD="separate-device-admin-password"
$env:BRIDGE_DEFAULT_DEVICE="phone-a"
$env:BRIDGE_DEVICES="phone-a||wechat-phone|5s"
$env:BRIDGE_API_KEYS="dev_key_001|phone-a|Test Phone"
$env:BRIDGE_MYSQL_DSN=""
go run ./cmd/bridge

打开管理台：

http://127.0.0.1:8088/admin/

只管理设备和 API Key、完全不读取消息的独立页面：

http://127.0.0.1:8088/device

生产环境请务必设置强密码：

BRIDGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD=your-strong-admin-password
BRIDGE_DEVICE_ADMIN_PASSWORD=your-separate-device-admin-password

3. 使用 MySQL

$env:BRIDGE_MYSQL_DSN="wechat:change-me@tcp(127.0.0.1:3306)/app_wechat_observatory?charset=utf8mb4&parseTime=True&loc=Local"
$env:BRIDGE_MYSQL_AUTO_MIGRATE="false"
go run ./cmd/bridge-db -create-database -migrate -seed -check
go run ./cmd/bridge

长运行服务建议保持：

BRIDGE_MYSQL_AUTO_MIGRATE=false

迁移通过 cmd/bridge-db 显式执行，避免重启服务时误覆盖真实手机注册出来的当前 wxid。

4. 构建 Web 管理台

cd web/admin
npm install
npm run build

cd ../device
npm install
npm run build

构建产物会分别写入 internal/bridge/admin_dist 和
internal/bridge/device_dist，由 Go 服务直接嵌入。

5. 构建 Android 模块

当前仓库没有强制要求提交 Gradle Wrapper。推荐在发布前补充 Wrapper；没有 Wrapper 时，可用 Android Studio 打开 android-module 并执行 debug 构建。

如果仓库已包含 Gradle Wrapper：

cd android-module
.\gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug

安装 APK 后，在 LSPosed 中启用模块并勾选微信作用域，然后重启手机或重启微信。

6. 手机模块配置

在 Web 管理台生成 API Key，打开手机上的 WeChat Observatory 配置页，填写：
- Observatory 服务地址，默认 https://47.108.232.203/observatory
- Web 管理台生成的 API Key

不要手动填写 wxid。模块会在微信进程内自动识别当前登录微信。

修改配置后重启微信。模块注册成功后，Web 管理台的模块状态应显示为“就绪”。

Docker 部署

cp deploy/docker/.env.example deploy/docker/.env
编辑 deploy/docker/.env，至少修改 BRIDGE_ADMIN_PASSWORD、MYSQL_PASSWORD 和 MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD
docker compose -f deploy/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8088/healthz

更多说明见 docs/deployment.md。

常用 API

管理 API 使用 X-Bridge-Password：

curl -H "X-Bridge-Password: your-admin-password" http://127.0.0.1:8088/api/modules/status
curl -H "X-Bridge-Password: your-admin-password" http://127.0.0.1:8088/api/api-keys

模块 API 使用 API Key：
- POST /module/register
- POST /webhook/lsposed/message
- POST /module/contacts/snapshot
- GET /module/outbox/ws
- POST /module/outbox/poll
- POST /module/outbox/ack

完整协议见 docs/api.md 和 docs/module-contract.md。

安全和合规提醒

本项目需要 Root、LSPosed 和对微信进程的 Hook。使用前请确认你理解并接受以下风险：
- 可能违反微信或相关服务的使用条款。
- Hook、自动化发送和异常行为可能带来账号风控风险。
- 服务端管理台必须放在可信网络后，并设置强管理密码。
- API Key 等同于手机模块访问凭证，泄露后应立即停用或删除。

更多发布前检查见 docs/security.md 和 docs/open-source-checklist.md。

验证

go test ./...
cd web/admin
npm run build
cd ../..
cd android-module
.\gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug

如果当前检出没有 gradlew.bat，请用 Android Studio 打开 android-module 构建，或先为项目补充 Gradle Wrapper。

modules.readme:
﻿# DouBanPurify

DouBanPurify 是专为豆瓣（com.douban.frodo）Android 客户端打造的轻量级纯净与净化 Xposed / LSPosed 模块。
基于现代 LibXposed API 102 规范开发，不修改 APK 文件，纯运行时 Hook，实现开屏秒开、精简底栏与首页布局、净化侧边栏、屏蔽更新及评价弹窗，并提供原生内嵌的高质感设置界面。

核心特性

启动与广告拦截
- 开屏广告秒开：彻底去除冷启动与热启动开屏广告倒计时，启动直达首页。
- 信息流广告拦截：自动隐藏首页推荐信息流中的商业推广卡片及广告。
- 更新弹窗屏蔽：彻底拦截内测版、Beta 版本更新提示与静默安装弹窗。
- 好评弹窗屏蔽：阻断应用内弹出的评分求好评浮窗。
- 友盟统计切断：拦截 Umeng+ SDK 初始化、统计打点、崩溃采集及后台上传。

界面布局精简
- 底栏逐项精简：「书影音」、「小组」、「市集」三个 Tab 各自独立开关，隐藏后剩余 Tab 自动均分底栏宽度并防止重绘死循环。
- 首页单 Tab 模式：移除顶部「动态」Tab，仅保留「精选/推荐」，禁止误触滑动至空白动态页。
- 顶栏杂项清理：移除首页右上角播客/耳机图标、搜索框下方小狗宠物挂件及推广横幅。
- 移除悬浮发布笔：隐藏首页右下角常驻的写日记/发布悬浮笔按钮。

搜索与侧边栏净化
- 搜索空白页：沿用豆瓣原榜卡片、左右滑动与点击；实时榜与热门话题可独立隐藏。不使用自绘面板。可单独开启或关闭电影与电视侧卡替换（默认开启）；开启时会预取豆瓣公开榜单 JSON，不发送登录凭据，通过与原条目榜相同的原生绑定显示；关闭恢复原右侧卡。
- 豆瓣 7.138.0（构建号 367）的条目榜及实时榜沿用本次 SearchHots 的前十项；不足十项不补数据。 卡片高度随当前榜单的原行测量调整，超出屏幕时沿原外层页面纵向滚动。
- 侧边栏抽屉净化：隐藏未成年人模式、草稿箱、我的背包、签到足迹、帮助与反馈、社区管理中心以及底部服务订单网格。
- 原生内嵌设置：在侧边栏「设置」正下方无缝植入 DouBanPurify 净化设置入口（使用豆瓣官方图标），点击弹出高质感分类设置弹窗，所有功能开关独立可控，即时生效无需重启。

构建与编译

环境要求
- JDK 17
- Android SDK 34
- Gradle 8.x
- LSPosed 框架（支持现代 API 102 规范）

编译命令
./gradlew assembleDebug
产物位于 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk。./gradlew assembleRelease 生成未签名的 release APK；仓库不提供签名配置或密钥。

安装与生效
adb install -r -t app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
1. 在 LSPosed 管理器中启用 DouBanPurify，勾选作用域 豆瓣（com.douban.frodo）。
2. 强行停止豆瓣并重新打开即可体验。

作用域配置
- 包名：com.douban.frodo
- 入口：com.douban.pure.DoubanPureHook
- 框架 API：io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0

modules.name: FuckDevicePolicy - Bypass Intune Restrictions
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo

modules.readme:
DuckDevicePolicy

Makes apps see no device-policy restrictions on your own device —
DevicePolicyManager / UserManager checks answered "no restriction", per
category, behind a master toggle. Formerly DuckPolicy, same package, so it updates
in place and keeps your settings and scope.

Needs an LSPosed 2.x fork (Xposed API 101+). Mainline 1.9.x will not load it.

Scope matters. Tick every framework entry your manager offers — android,
system, system_server. They disagree about which one actually reaches
system_server, and the wrong one silently does nothing. That covers the device-wide
categories: app install / uninstall, developer options, device-owner spoof. The
target app for everything else, including the device-owner checks Google Photos reads
for Locked Folder. Never scope Intune / Company Portal / Authenticator.

Not working? The LSPosed log has installed N/M hooks in , which names
anything that did not resolve, and first hit:  ... the first time one
fires. Quote both when reporting.

Source & issues: https://github.com/Bouteillepleine/DuckDevicePolicy · fork of
liyafe1997/FuckDevicePolicy.

简体中文

让 App 在你自己的设备上看到「没有任何设备策略限制」，按类别挂钩
DevicePolicyManager / UserManager 的检查并返回「无限制」，带总开关。
原名 DuckPolicy，包名不变，可直接覆盖升级。需要 LSPosed 2.x 分支（Xposed API 101+）。

作用域决定能否生效：请把管理器提供的所有框架条目都勾上——android、system、
system_server，不同管理器对「哪一个真正进入 system_server」并不一致，勾错的那个不会有任何效果。
它们对应全设备类别（应用安装/卸载、开发者选项、设备所有者伪装）；目标应用 用于其余类别，
包括 Google 相册锁定文件夹读取的「设备所有者 / 完全托管检查」。
请勿将 Intune / 公司门户 / Authenticator 加入作用域。

反馈问题时请附上 LSPosed 日志中的 installed N/M hooks in  与 first hit: 两行。
modules.changelog:
Do not tick the android scope entry. Since 4.8 it hooks nothing, and it has been reported to stop Zygisk loading. Tick only the system_server entry — your manager calls it system or system_server. It is no longer in the Recommended list.

Running your own device-owner app (OwnDroid and friends)? Add it under Device-owner spoof exempt apps on the Categories tab, or it will be told it is not the owner of the device.

Reported by @MootComb.

modules.name: Sing for Android
modules.author: francasio
modules.description: A reimplementation of Apple Music Sing mode for Android with on-device Hardware accelerated stem separation.
modules.readme:
Sing for Android

Sing for Android is an Xposed module that attempts to bring Apple Music's iOS-exclusive Sing Mode on the official Android app. It hooks into the Apple Music audio pipeline to isolate, attenuate, or boost vocals on the fly with low latency and hardware acceleration support.

Screenshots

| Apple Music (Sing Active) | Settings Screen | Neural Model Catalog |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|
|  |  |  |

Features
- Real-Time On-Device Stem Separation: Separates vocals from backing tracks in real time during audio playback entirely locally, using whatever hardware accelerator you think is the best to use.
- Hardware Acceleration:
- Qualcomm Hexagon HTP / NPU: Powered by ONNX Runtime with Qualcomm QNN Execution Provider for super high speed real time processing with low thermals and battery drain.
- OpenCL / Vulkan GPU & NNAPI: Powered by Alibaba MNN for cross-platform GPU acceleration and NNAPI support.
- Multi-threaded CPU Fallback: High-performance portable fallback with configurable thread.
- Multiple Model to choose from:
- MDX-Net (Kim Inst, UVR 1-9703) in FP16 / FP32 precision.
- Apple Sing (Vi-NNet) native reference engine.
- Advanced Playback & Slider Controls:
- Two-Way Slider: 0%–50% attenuates vocals for karaoke singing; 50%–100% attenuates the instrumental track for acapella vocal isolation.
- Bypass all client/server-side limitations: Enable Sing on all songs, even those iOS will refuse to work with, and allow the slider to go all the way down & up.
- Preserve Side Channel: Keep backing vocals, stereo reverbs, and vocoder vocal effects in the audio mix.
- Modern Expressive UI:
- Material 3 Expressive and dynamic Material You theming adapting to your wallpaper palette.

Requirements
- Android 11 or higher.
- Apple Music for Android (v7.0.0-beta 1607+).
- Xposed Environment:
- Vector (Rooted with Magisk / KernelSU / whatever)
- Or JingMatrix's LSPatch fork (Non-root, embedded module mode).

Installation & Setup

1. Install Module:
- Download the latest APK release from Releases.
- Install the APK on your device.
2. Enable in Xposed Manager:
- If using Vector: Open Vector, enable the Sing for Android module, and check Apple Music in its scope.
- If using LSPatch: Patch the Apple Music APK with the Sing for Android module in embedded mode and with signature bypass mode 2.
3. Configure Settings:
- Launch Sing for Android from your launcher (or long-press/right-click the Sing icon in Apple Music).
- Select your preferred neural model and compute target in the app.
- Run the built-in benchmark to verify that your hardware achieves realtime speeds (>1.0x Real-Time).

Building from Source

Prerequisites
- Android Studio Koala / Ladybug or command-line SDK tools.
- Android NDK (r25c+ to r28 recommended, set via ANDROID_NDK_HOME or installed via SDK manager).
- CMake 3.22.1+.
- Java 17+.

1. Clone with Submodules

This project uses KissFFT and
SpeexDSP as submodules in extern/.

Clone the repository recursively
git clone --recursive https://github.com/22cms/sing-for-android.git
cd sing-for-android

2. Build libMNN with Hexagon HTP NPU & Vulkan

Run the automated MNN build script, which will patch and compile MNN:

bash scripts/build_mnn.sh

3. Build Application APK

Build the APK using Gradle:

Build Debug APK (arm64-v8a)
./gradlew assembleDebug

Build Release APK
./gradlew assembleRelease

The resulting APK will be located under app/build/outputs/apk/.

Third-Party Projects & Acknowledgements
- Microsoft ONNX Runtime & Qualcomm QNN: Neural network runtime with Hexagon HTP execution provider.
- Alibaba MNN: Lightweight cross-platform deep learning inference engine for mobile GPUs and NPUs.
- MDX-Net / Ultimate Vocal Remover: State-of-the-art vocal isolation architectures by Roman Solovyev et al. (Kuielab).
- KissFFT: Fast Fourier Transform library by Mark Borgerding.
- SpeexDSP: Streaming sample-rate conversion (BSD license).
- Vector / LSPatch: Modern ART hooking framework and patcher.
- Apple SF Symbols: Iconography reference.

License

This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
Apple Music is a trademark of Apple Inc. This project is independent and not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple Inc.
modules.changelog:
Major Changes

1. Layout Optimizations for Large Screens: Sing for Android now uses your tablet' screen real estate more wisely, instead of simply scaling the mobile UI.
2. Conversion-free Passthrough: When Sing mode is turned off, audio now passes through directly in its native precision, preventing format conversions during playback and reducing CPU usage.
3. Real Benchmark Results: In-app benchmarks for MDX-Net models now provide accurate performance metrics.

Minor Changes
- Replaced custom resampler with SpeexDSP
- Shortened VR-Arch chunk overlap from 16,384 to 4,096 samples using a quintic smootherstep
- Fixed a crash when switching neural models during active audio playback
- Improved audio separation quality and reduced high-frequency bleed for VR-Arch and MDXNet models
- Fixed crashes caused by invalid stored slider positions
- Automatic model catalog cache refresh on app update
- Attempted to fix lyrics blur on tracks with immediate vocals
- Added XNNPACK support for ONNXRuntime (on non Qualcomm devices)
- Updated and refined strings

modules.readme:
Duo Status Bar

Duo Status Bar replaces the battery, Wi-Fi and mobile signal icons in your status bar with one clean,
animated indicator.

It is an LSPosed module. It does not modify system files. It only hides the icons it replaces and draws
the new indicator.

Requirements
- Android 13 or newer.
- A custom ROM with root.
- LSPosed installed.

Install

1. Download the APK from Releases and install it.
2. Open LSPosed, go to Modules, and enable Duo Status Bar.
3. In the module's scope, tick System UI.
4. Restart System UI, or reboot the phone.
5. Open the Duo Status Bar app and turn the main switch on.

The module is off until you turn it on. Nothing changes before that.

| OnePlus OxygenOS 16 | ✅ |

modules.readme:
XPosed Hook 模块

本项目是一个基于 现代 libxposed API（LSPosed API 102） 的 Android 应用 Hook 工具，
用于修改指定 App 内部方法返回值，实现特定功能。

迁移到 LSPosed API 102

本项目已从旧版 Xposed API（de.robv.android.xposed，本地 XposedBridgeAPI-89.jar）
迁移到 libxposed API 102，对应 LSPosed 2.2.0+。

| 项 | 迁移前 | 迁移后 |
|----|--------|--------|
| 模块入口 | assets/xposed_init + IXposedHookLoadPackage | META-INF/xposed/java_init.list + extends XposedModule |
| 模块声明 | AndroidManifest.xml 里 4 个 xposed* meta-data | META-INF/xposed/module.prop（minApiVersion / targetApiVersion / staticScope） |
| 作用域 | res/values/array.xml + xposedscope meta-data | META-INF/xposed/scope.list（staticScope=false，由用户/前端勾选） |
| Hook 写法 | XposedHelpers.findAndHookMethod(...) + XC_MethodHook | xposed.hook(method).intercept(chain -> ...) |
| 加载回调 | handleLoadPackage(XC_LoadPackage.LoadPackageParam) | onPackageReady(PackageReadyParam)（拿到最终 ClassLoader） |
| 编译依赖 | compileOnly(files("libs/XposedBridgeAPI-89.jar")) | compileOnly(io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0) |
| 激活状态 | 无 | implementation(io.github.libxposed:service:102.0.0) + XposedServiceHelper |
| 构建 | AGP 8.9.2 / Gradle 8.11.1 / compileSdk 35 | AGP 9.4.1 / Gradle 9.8 / compileSdk 37 |

关键改动

1. 入口重写（HookEntry）：继承 io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModule，
   在 onModuleLoaded() 里把 XposedInterface 交给 XposedUtil，
   在 onPackageReady() 里按包名分发到各个 *AppHooker。
2. 新增两个工具类（API 102 起模块不能再调用 legacy Xposed API，这些能力必须自带）：
- util/XposedUtil：持有 XposedInterface，提供 hook(...) / log(...)；
     默认使用 ExceptionMode.PROTECTIVE，并给每个 hook 设置稳定 id（API 102 的原子替换特性）。
- util/ReflectUtil：替代 XposedHelpers 的 findClass / findMethod / callMethod / callStaticMethod。
3. 10 个 AppHooker 全部改写：beforeHookedMethod/setResult → chain.proceed() / 直接返回常量；
   afterHookedMethod → 先 chain.proceed() 再返回替换值；XC_MethodReplacement → chain -> null。
4. 加固应用的 ClassLoader：保留 UniversalRealClassLoaderUtil（Hook Application.attach），
   并加了 3 秒兜底 —— 如果 Application.attach 没给出真实 ClassLoader，就退回包自身的 ClassLoader，
   避免加固壳差异导致 hook 完全不生效。
5. 模块激活状态：service/ModuleStatus 通过 libxposed service 直接问框架要
   getFrameworkName/Version、getScope，以及 API 102 的 getRunningTargets()，主界面直接展示。
6. 删除：app/src/main/assets/xposed_init、res/values/array.xml、app/libs/XposedBridgeAPI-89.jar，
   以及从未被注册过的死代码 Hook.java。

构建环境

| 项 | 版本 |
|----|------|
| Gradle | 9.8.0（wrapper 自带） |
| AGP | 9.4.1 |
| compileSdk / minSdk / targetSdk | 37 / 28 / 35 |
| libxposed | api:102.0.0（compileOnly）+ service:102.0.0（implementation） |
为什么必须用 AGP 9.x：libxposed:service:102.0.0 要求 compileSdk >= 37，
而 AGP 8.x 读不了 android-37.0（平台用的是 SDK XML v4）。

前端（模块 App）

底部三个 Tab，界面参考 Rain_1.1.4 的信息架构，用 Material 3 组件实现（日夜跟随 + Material You 动态取色）。

| Tab | 内容 |
|:-|:-|
| 应用 | 搜索框、勾选统计、全部勾选 / 全部取消、10 个目标应用的开关列表（真实图标与名称、包名、适配版本、安装状态） |
| 模块 | 激活状态卡、已勾选 / 已安装统计、框架与 libxposed API 信息、使用步骤 |
| 设置 | 深色模式、动态取色、关于 |

「勾选应用」是怎么生效的

开关就是 LSPosed 的作用域本身，只有一个真源，不存在两份状态：

1. 界面上的勾选状态直接来自框架：service API 的 getScope()。
2. 默认（刚装完、还没勾过任何东西）全部不勾选；在 LSPosed 管理页面里勾过的应用，
   打开本 App 时也会自动是勾选状态。
3. 在前端点开关会直接改作用域：勾上 → requestScope()，取消 → removeScope()。
   requestScope 会拉起 LSPosed 的授权确认（见下图），批准后回到列表自动刷新。
4. 模块只会被加载进作用域内的进程，所以「没勾选 = 模块根本不会进那个应用」，
   不需要再加一层运行时开关。
没有引入额外的导出组件、也没有单独的配置文件 —— 勾选状态就是 LSPosed 自己的作用域。

前端代码位置

    HookVIP/app/src/main/java/com/hook/vip/
    ├─ App.java                       # Application：连框架 + 动态取色
    ├─ MainActivity.java              # 底部导航外壳
    ├─ ui/AppsFragment.java           # 应用页（搜索 / 全选 / 开关 / 作用域引导）
    ├─ ui/AppAdapter.java             # 列表项：图标 + 名称 + 徽标 + 开关
    ├─ ui/ModuleFragment.java         # 模块页：激活状态与环境信息
    ├─ ui/SettingsFragment.java       # 设置页
    ├─ data/TargetCatalog.java        # 10 个目标应用目录（与 scope.list 对应）
    ├─ data/AppPrefs.java             # 深色模式 / 动态取色
    └─ service/ModuleStatus.java      # 问框架要激活状态 / 作用域 / 运行中的目标，并改作用域

支持的应用

| 应用名称 | 包名 | 支持版本 |
|----------|------|----------|
| 体重日记 | com.kproduce.weight | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 3.5.3） |
| 番茄轻断食 | com.swhh.fasting.tomato | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 3.4.7） |
| 番茄闪轻 | com.qyxy.tomato.android | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 2.1.7） |
| 一念 | com.mt.copyidea | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 2.4.0） |
| 背书匠 | com.zzdbwku.zizbnea | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 2.2.5） |
| 一木清单 | com.wangc.todolist | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 2.4.3） |
| 一言 | com.jhyan.yan | 理论全版本通杀（测试到 5.1.0） |
| 一木记账 | com.wangc.bill | 适配6.5.5（测试到 6.5.5） |
| Q日记 | com.slfteam.qdiary | 适配1.7.81（测试到1.7.81 ） |

开发日志

放弃对懒人驾考的逆向研究，因本人能力有限，原代码会触发风控导致设备无法使用

使用方法

1. 编译并安装 APK（./gradlew assembleDebug 或 ./gradlew assembleRelease）。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块（作用域默认是空的，模块不会强勾任何应用）。
3. 打开本模块的 App，在「应用」页勾选需要解锁的应用；也可以直接在 LSPosed 管理页面里勾。
4. 重启被勾选的目标应用即可生效。

注意事项
- 虽然理论支持全版本，但建议参考测试信息的版本进行验证。
- 本项目仅用于学习和研究目的，请勿用于非法用途。

// This Comment

Why Must Risk?

Improved Device Performance

By stopping unnecessary applications and clearing RAM cache, Risk helps in freeing up system resources. This can lead to a noticeable improvement in device performance, making it faster and more responsive.

Enhanced Battery Life

Running multiple applications in the background can drain battery life significantly. By stopping third-party and google apps, Risk reduces the load on the CPU and other hardware components, leading to enhanced battery life.

Optimized Memory Usage

Clearing the RAM cache using the  pm trim-caches  command and  drop_caches  mechanism ensures that unused memory is freed up. Risk helps in optimizing memory usage, allowing other applications to run more efficiently.

Reduced System Lag

Background applications and cached data can cause system lag and slow down the overall performance of the device. By stopping these applications and clearing the cache, Risk helps in reducing system lag and ensuring smoother operation.

modules.name: TensorCardEmulator

modules.description: Tensor Card Emulator
modules.readme:
TensorCardEmulator

An NFC card emulator for turnstiles, access control systems, and other systems that rely only on the card serial number (UID).

⚠️ Limitations
This project emulates UID (serial number) only.

Not supported:
- Bank cards
- Transport cards (e.g. Troika, Oyster, etc.)
- Cards using secure elements, cryptography, or application-level authentication

⚠️ Such cards cannot be emulated because they require more than just a serial number.

Supported Devices
- Google Pixel devices only
- Tensor-based SoCs
- Tested on stock Android 16
- Other Android versions are likely supported, but not yet tested

Root Support
- KernelSU (KSU)
- Magisk (likely supported)

Installation & Usage
1. Install the module
2. Reboot the device
3. Grant root access to the app (installed via module)
4. Open the app
5. Tap on the card serial number to enable scan mode
6. Tap the physical card to the phone
7. The card is now ready for emulation

⚠️ Disclaimer
This project is intended for research and testing purposes only with systems that rely on UID-based authentication.

| 组织通讯录巡游 + 花名册归档 | 无障碍 DFS 走遍部门触发懒加载后归档 |
| 离职同事资料归档 | 解析 profile blob；档案/离职名单可同步到模块侧查看 |

设置入口：桌面图标 FeishuKit · LSPosed 模块详情「启动」· 飞书「我 → 设置 → FeishuKit 设置」。

Linux 桌面端（linux-desktop-unread/）：Electron .asar 补丁 + autopatch systemd 单元（升级后自动重打补丁）。
⚠️ 组织通讯录巡游 / 花名册 / 离职资料归档涉及他人个人信息，敏感度远高于防撤回。请谨慎，务必只在合规前提下用于自身研究。

仓库结构

app/                    Android Xposed 模块（Java）
native/jni/             native hook（C++，SQL 层拦截 + inline hook）
stubs/                  Xposed API 编译期桩（无需 XposedBridge 源）
frida/                  frida 动态探针（逆向定位用）
stealth-read/           防已读回执研究脚本（frida hunt / 反汇编 / 抓取）
linux-desktop-unread/   Linux 桌面端 .asar 补丁 + autopatch
scripts/                水印嵌入/提取等杂项
build.sh / build.ps1    一键构建（Linux / Windows）
*.md                    各功能逆向方法论与复盘

构建

需要 JDK 11+、Android SDK（build-tools + platform）、Android NDK。

./build.sh          # Linux/macOS
或 pwsh ./build.ps1   # Windows
- 脚本会自动探测 SDK/NDK/JDK；也可用环境变量覆盖（ANDROID_HOME / ANDROID_NDK_HOME / JAVA_HOME）。
- 签名：缺 keystore 时脚本自动生成本地 debug.keystore（不入库）。正式发布请用你自己的 keystore（KEYSTORE=/path/to/your.jks ./build.sh）。

安装

1. Root + LSPosed（或 Xposed 框架）。
2. 安装 Release 中的 APK（或本地 build.ps1 / build.sh 产物），在 LSPosed 勾选作用域为飞书 / Lark，重启飞书。
3. 打开设置：桌面 FeishuKit 图标，或飞书「我 → 设置 → FeishuKit 设置」。
4. 若在工具页点过「隐藏桌面图标」，LSPosed 的启动入口也会失效——到系统设置 → 应用 → FeishuKit → 启用即可恢复。

版本适配

飞书 native liblark.so 每个版本都可能重排符号、混淆变更（例如 7.71.8 的混淆重排就打崩过 Java 兜底）。定位锚点与更新方法见：
- 防撤回-逆向方法论手册.md
- 防已读-逆向结论-v7.69.6.md / 防已读-复盘-从native碰墙到Java破局.md
- CONTRIBUTING.md —— 怎么给新版本重新定位偏移并提 PR

双版本发布（legacy / api102）

自 v1.8.9 起维护两条线，功能一致、包名相同、同一签名（可互相覆盖安装，数据不丢）：

| 线 | 分支 | 适用框架 | versionCode | 更新检查 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| legacy（主线） | main | 传统 LSPosed / XposedBridge API 82 | 正常递增 | version.json |
| api102 | libxposed-api-102-migration | 仅 libxposed API 102 新框架（LSPosed v2.2+ modern） | = legacy + 1000 | version-api102.json |

发布形态：
- 本仓库：每个版本一个 Release 挂两个包（feishukit--legacy.apk / feishukit--api102.apk）+ 选择说明表。
- 模块市场镜像（Xposed-Modules-Repo）：保持两个 Release——稳定版单 APK（Latest，市场更新器只认单资产，绝不多包同 Release）+ api102 prerelease。市场永远只向 legacy 用户推 legacy 包。
- api102 线在旧框架上不会生效；拿不准选哪个就装 legacy。
- 待 legacy 用户迁移完成（或主流框架仅支持新 API）后，api102 合回 main 转正。

赞助 / Sponsor

飞书更新频繁，跟版本、重新定位偏移、修复 hook 需要持续投入。如果 FeishuKit 帮到了你，欢迎赞助支持我持续维护、适配新版本：
- 爱发电：https://ifdian.net/a/haikow
- 微信赞赏码：

赞助纯属无偿鼓励，与功能无关 —— 本项目所有功能开源免费，不含任何赞助专属内容。

发布自动化（GitHub Actions bot，2026-10 起）
- PR 即时检查（pr-check.yml）：PR 一开即自动跑门禁（scripts/pr_gate.sh，评论「🤖 自动审查」到 PR）+ 无私钥编译验证，无需等维护者。
- 统一发布（publish.yml）：push tag -（稳定版）或 --api102（预览版）→ CI 自动：双线构建 → 签名（Secrets 私钥）→ 验签（证书指纹必须等于代码钉住的 EXPECTED_SIG，否则硬失败）→ 主仓库双包 Release + 市场仓库单包同步 + 电报群双包相册公告置顶。
- 安全约束：发布 workflow 仅由 tag push / 手动触发；第三方 action 钉 commit SHA；不用 pull_request_target；fork PR 拿不到任何 secrets。
⚠️ 私钥风险声明（2026-10 维护者决策）：签名私钥以 KEYSTORE_BASE64 存于 GitHub Secrets。私钥上云后，GitHub 账号/PAT/恶意 workflow 任一失守 = 攻击者可签出通过本模块防篡改校验的"官方更新"，且该 key 无法更换（换了老用户断升级）。缓解：tag-only 触发 + 最小权限 + action 钉 SHA + 建议为 GitHub 账号启用 2FA。回退路径：删除 secrets 与 workflows 即恢复纯本地发布（本地全流程脚本保留于 scripts/ 与维护者机器）。

贡献者 / Contributors

感谢每一位让 FeishuKit 变得更好的贡献者：

| @SonderZhong | 界面与设置体验、数据备份、档案分类、账号隔离、撤回提示、时间常驻、单条标记已读、消息速览与相关知识屏蔽、legacy / API102 双线维护 |
| @haikow | 项目发起与社区维护 |
| @naiheSH | 修复屏蔽消息速览误拦搜索页导致的闪退（#5） |
| @HansYeoh | 飞书 8.x 适配：messages 列序运行时自适应 + 双 provider hook（#6） |
欢迎提 PR 参与适配与修复， CONTRIBUTING.md 有方法论；所有被合入的贡献都会在这里署名。

modules.readme:
Dou+ — 抖音增强工具

基于 LSPosed/Xposed 框架的 Android 模块，为抖音提供无水印保存和增强功能。

功能

无水印保存
- 视频保存 — 自动去除水印，支持 H264/H265 多码率
- 图集保存 — 保存高清原图，无压缩损失
- 实况照片 — 同时保存图片 (HEIC) 和视频 (MOV) 部分
- 评论区媒体 — 保存评论中的图片和实况照片

增强操作
- 分享面板保存 — 在抖音分享弹窗注入「保存到相册」按钮，无需跳转
- 评论区长按保存 — 评论区实况照片长按直接保存到本地

下载管理
- 画质选择 — 最高画质 / 中等画质 / 省流量三档
- 保存目录自定义 — 可配置文件保存的子目录
- 通知提示 — 下载进度通知 + 完成 Toast 提示

系统要求
- Android 9.0+ (API 28)
- LSPosed 框架 (推荐 1.8+ 或 2.0.x)
- 抖音正式版 (com.ss.android.ugc.aweme)

安装

1. 从 Releases 下载最新 APK
2. 安装 APK（需允许未知来源）
3. 打开 LSPosed 管理器 → 模块列表 → 启用 Dou+
4. 勾选作用域：抖音
5. 强制停止抖音或重启手机
6. 打开抖音，模块自动生效

去水印原理

抖音带水印视频 URL 包含 /playwm/ 路径段，替换为 /play/ 即可获取无水印版本。

模块通过多层 Hook 策略拦截：
- Model 层 — Hook Aweme 数据模型，直接修改 URL
- 下载层 — Hook 下载管理器，替换下载 URL
- 分享层 — Hook 分享 Intent，提取无水印 URL
- 面板层 — 注入保存按钮，直接调用下载

项目结构

app/src/main/java/com/xposed/douyinhelper/
├── MainHook.kt                  # 模块入口
├── hook/
│   ├── BaseHook.kt              # Hook 基础接口
│   ├── FeedHook.kt              # Feed 流视频 Hook
│   ├── ShareHook.kt             # 分享拦截 Hook
│   ├── DownloadHook.kt          # 下载流程 Hook
│   ├── DownloadDialogHook.kt    # 保存弹窗 Hook
│   ├── CommentHook.kt           # 评论区 Hook
│   ├── LivePhotoHook.kt         # 实况照片 Hook
│   └── SharePanelHook.kt        # 分享面板保存按钮
├── ui/
│   ├── SettingsActivity.kt      # 设置页面
│   └── DouSettings.kt  # 设置管理
└── util/
    ├── UrlParser.kt             # URL 解析/去水印
    ├── MediaDownloader.kt       # 媒体下载器
    ├── MediaCache.kt            # 媒体缓存
    ├── ClassFinder.kt           # 类查找工具
    ├── HookUtils.kt             # Hook 工具
    ├── ContextHelper.kt         # Context 获取
    └── NotificationHelper.kt    # 通知管理

免责声明

本模块仅供学习交流使用。请尊重创作者版权，勿将保存内容用于商业用途或未经授权的传播。

License

modules.name: HyperCool - Heat & Battery Fix
modules.author: Yudharn
modules.description: Heat and battery fix for Android - Device: Qualcomm | MediaTek (one-shot at boot, only tiny opt-in keepers). Configure in WebUI, then reboot. Telegram Channel: @ModuleArchives.
modules.readme:
HyperCool - Heat & Battery Fix

KernelSU / Magisk module for Qualcomm and MediaTek phones. Less heat, less battery drain, longer battery life.
Focused on battery life, not peak performance.

Everything is configured via WebUI and applied on the next boot. Only lightweight keepers run in the background, and only when enabled.

Screenshots

      Home

      Heat control

      Battery drain (kernel)

      Protected apps

      Battery calibration

      Long battery

      Advanced

      Extra kernel tuning

      RAM management

      Google services

      Storage

      App cache

      Tools

      Extra power saving

      Battery drain (system)

Features
Every feature has its own switch in the WebUI. Changes apply at boot; turning a feature off (or uninstalling) restores the original values. Unsupported features are skipped.

Heat control
- Big / little core, GPU and memory bus frequency caps (with lock), GPU power collapse
- Calmer CPU governor (WALT / schedutil), kernel touch boost off
- Background apps on little cores, prime core parking (Qualcomm)
- CPU keeper: puts the caps back when the ROM undoes them
- UI blur off and cooler charging
- Heat guard (experimental): lower refresh rate and big-core limit while the battery is hot
- Pause / bypass charging when hot, at a level or while gaming (charging switch, 0 mA current limit or charger input off; Qualcomm and MediaTek), battery temperature warning
- Game battery mode: Android Game Mode with a 60 FPS cap and lower render resolution for games

Battery drain (kernel)
- Adaptive screen-off power profile, deep CPU sleep, UFS power saving
- Fewer writeback wakeups, kernel debug off, kernel wakelock blocker
- Screen-off: keep Wi-Fi on, Location / Bluetooth off, mobile data / NFC off (back on at screen-on)
- Hibernate background apps a few minutes after the screen goes off (Protected, default and in-use apps are skipped), plus Hibernate apps now on Home
- Screen-off drain check: drain per screen-off, alert when high, and the app that kept the phone awake
- F2FS cleanup and app optimization (dex2oat) once a week with the screen off
- Battery history: 48 h chart of level, temperature and screen-on / screen-off drain

Apps
- Keep important apps alive, restrict other user apps
- Block apps in background, disable apps

Battery drain (system)
- Cached app freezer, aggressive Doze, GMS Doze, App Standby
- Wi-Fi / BT scanning off, limited background location, network standby saving
- Less stats, logging and telemetry; analytics, ad packages and Joyose off

Long battery
- Stronger Battery Saver with auto level, screen dimming, Smart Pixels
- Refresh rate cap, adaptive refresh rate, animation scale, lower screen resolution

Extras
- Scheduler, I/O and common kernel tuning, balanced system defaults, MiGT / Metis off
- Faster network connections (TCP / BBR; for speed, not battery)
- RAM optimizer, multitasking profile, ZRAM size and compression
- GMS ads / analytics freeze, log cleanup, vendor diagnostics off
- Kernel power saving, Energy Aware Scheduler (C-state aware), idle USB / I2C / SPI power saving
- Fewer background jobs, compact background apps when RAM is low
- Auto app cache clean, on-demand app optimization, leftover app folder cleanup, boot notification

Home
- Search, Recent activity and Keeper status
- Idle drain, battery check, battery history and battery calibration
- Top battery use, Wake sources (with the apps holding wake locks), CPU use now

Requirements
- Android 11+
- KernelSU, KernelSU Next or APatch (Magisk: open the WebUI with MMRL or KsuWebUI)
- Qualcomm or MediaTek SoC, any ROM

Files
- /data/adb/hypercool/config.conf settings
- /data/adb/hypercool/status.conf last boot result
- /data/adb/hypercool/boot.log log
- sh /data/adb/hypercool/restore.sh --all restore every system change by hand

Credits
- Frosty by Drsexo
- Power Saver Pro by @ShastikXD & @TempMeow (some code by @kveld9)
- Hyper Optimize by Tatsh
- Xtreme Battery Saver (DethByte64), Universal GMS Doze, sysconfig-patcher
- WebUI Mono theme: design inspired by Duck ToolBox by Eltavine (MIT)
- WebUI reference: Specter by @dpejoh1

Support

If HyperCool is useful to you, consider supporting development:

Other ways to support: SociaBuzz · QRIS

Disclaimer
HyperCool changes kernel and system settings. Use it at your own risk; the author is not responsible
for bootloops, data loss or damage. Make a backup first, and turn features off one by one if something
misbehaves. Provided without any warranty (see the GPL).

License
GPL-3.0-or-later. Copyright (C) 2026 Yudharn. See LICENSE.
Modified versions must stay GPL-3.0, keep the source open and keep this copyright notice.
Google Sans font: SIL Open Font License (webroot/GoogleSans-OFL.txt).
modules.changelog:
- New: Game battery mode — off by default. Games get Android's battery mode with a 60 FPS cap and a lower render resolution, so they run cooler. On Android 13 the games to use are picked from the list; on Android 14+ every installed game is detected automatically.
- New: Pause charging / bypass charging — off by default. Charging pauses at the temperature or level you pick, or while a game is open, and the charger powers the phone instead. Kernels without a charging switch get bypass through a 0 mA charge current. Qualcomm and MediaTek.
- New: Battery history and temperature warning — off by default. A 48 h chart of level, temperature and screen-on / screen-off drain on Home, and a notification when the battery gets too hot.
- New: Leftover app folders — a new one-shot action finds Android/data and Android/obb folders of apps that are no longer installed, shows them and deletes them when you confirm.
- New: Memory bus frequency cap — off by default, Qualcomm. The RAM and system cache bus stays below its top speed for less heat under heavy load, with a lock so the ROM cannot raise it again.
- New: Lower screen resolution — off by default. The whole screen is drawn at 90, 80 or 75% with the same sizes on screen; the old values come back when it is turned off.
- Changed: C-state aware scheduler — Energy Aware Scheduler now also prefers cores that are awake or lightly asleep, on kernels that have the switch.
- Changed: Charge limit ~80% removed — the Xiaomi night charging limit and its keeper are gone. Use Pause / bypass charging instead; a limit set by an older version is released at the next boot.
- Changed: More charging-switch candidates: also Samsung (ac / dc charging_enabled, batt_slate_mode, stop_charge), Huawei (huawei_charger), Oplus (oplus_chg, google charger), Nubia (nubia_charge), LG (lge-unified-nodes), Transsion (CCIChargerSwitch, smb1357) and generic nodes; the battery keeper records a switch that leaves the battery Discharging as a cut and rejects it while gaming.

modules.name: io.github.lubenjian88.fadecraft
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.readme:
熄屏幻术 FadeCraft

按电源键熄屏的那一刻，不该只是一黑了之。

这个模块接管系统熄屏的最后一帧：先实时截一张当前画面，再把它拆成碎片、像素、灰烬或者微粒，播完一段动画之后才交给系统真正睡眠。
⚠️ 安装或更新本模块后，必须「整机重启手机」才能生效（当前版本 1.0.7）。 应用内的「重启作用域」只会重启 SystemUI 和系统设置，碰不到 system_server——而拦截电源键、触发动画的核心逻辑正好在 system_server 里。所以只点「重启作用域」时，电源键动画不会出现；请直接重启手机。
- 8 种特效，颗粒大小、时长等参数可调
- 播放过程没有常驻服务，不做后台轮询
- 注入系统框架（system_server）、SystemUI、系统设置三个进程；电源键拦截发生在 system_server，所以更新后必须整机重启才会生效
- 出问题时设置页最底部可以一键导出日志（不需要 root），比截图管用
1.0.7 —— 修复某些问题。

特效

| 特效 | 效果 |
|---|---|
| 碎屏 | 从按压点散开的裂纹，碎片带重力坠落 |
| 像素消散 | 画面碎成像素块，随机抖动后缩小消失 |
| 百叶窗 | 横向切条错位滑出 |
| CRT 关机 | 画面纵向压扁成一条亮线再熄灭 |
| 灰烬升腾 | 颗粒化后向上飘散，带火星余辉 |
| 风沙吹散 | 整体被风吹向一侧，带倾斜 |
| 条带垂落 | 竖向长条依次失重下落 |
| 崩解成尘 | 一道斜波从右下扫到左上，扫过处化为微粒飞散 |

每种特效都有独立的参数页：颗粒大小、时长、坠落距离等，改完立刻生效，可以用设置页里的「预览」先看不按电源键的效果。

安装

1. 手机已 Root，并装好 LSPosed（Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 均可）
2. 安装本模块 APK
3. 打开 LSPosed 管理器 → 模块 → 启用「熄屏幻术」
4. 作用域勾选「系统框架 / SystemUI / 系统设置」（三个都勾：电源键拦截在系统框架 system_server，截屏与动画在 SystemUI，设置首页入口在系统设置；缺一个就会有功能不生效）
5. 整机重启手机（关键）：应用内的「重启作用域」只重启 SystemUI + 系统设置、碰不到 system_server，所以必须整机重启才能让电源键动画生效
6. 打开模块的设置页，选一种动画，点「预览」确认有效
设置页内置「3 步生效」引导（折叠式，点标题展开，排在「点击跳转作者抖音」之后）：模块未完全生效时会自动出现，并在「模块状态」里指出缺哪一环（系统框架 / SystemUI），或提示「需重启手机（旧代码）」；按提示处理后点「重新检测」，全绿后引导卡自动消失。

模块会同时出现在系统设置的首页（HyperOS / MIUI 上是一行「熄屏幻术」），也可以从桌面图标进入。

权限

只有两个，都是普通权限：
- VIBRATE —— 熄屏时的触感反馈，可在设置里关掉
- RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED —— 开机后把配置重新推送给 SystemUI，否则重启后第一次按键会用默认参数

模块不联网、不读通讯录、不申请存储权限。截图只发生在按下电源键的那一瞬间，位图用完立刻回收，不会落盘。

设置项

| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 动画 | 8 种特效任选 |
| 随机特效 / 随机池 | 每次熄屏从勾选的特效里随机挑一个 |
| 震动 | 熄屏时是否震动，默认开启 |
| 震动反馈 | 系统按键触感 / 自定义波形；默认对接系统按键触感，跟随系统触感设置 |
| 锁屏音 | 保留系统原本的锁屏提示音 |
| 省电模式不播放 | 省电模式下跳过动画，直接熄屏 |
| 隐藏桌面图标 | 隐藏后可从系统设置首页进入（与下一项至少保留一个） |
| 在系统设置中显示 | 系统设置首页要不要出现「熄屏幻术」这一行 |
| 导出日志 | 页面最底部，折叠式。反馈问题前一键导出（见下节） |
| 恢复全部默认 | 一键还原所有参数 |

导出日志（反馈问题请用这个）

设置页最底部 → 点「导出日志」展开 → 点「导出日志文件」。文件落在 文件管理 → 下载 → FadeCraft，可以直接分享到微信 / QQ。

文件里固定包含：
- 设备信息、模块版本与构建戳、三个进程的应答情况、LSPosed 版本、当前配置
- 诊断结论：是否被 LSPosed 拒载、作用域是否漏勾、进程是否还在跑旧代码
- root 探测：逐个尝试各种 su 调用形式，失败时连异常原文一起写进来
- 熄屏现场记录：模块自己记的环形缓冲。logcat 通常只留得住二三十秒，这份不受影响，能看到「拦到 sleep → 抓帧结果 → 开播 → 补睡」的完整时间线
- 最近几分钟的 logcat 与 LSPosed 模块日志

不需要 root：系统日志由注入在 system_server 里的模块代采后回传，不用去 KernelSU / Magisk 里点授权。

正确导出的顺序：① 先在设置页点「重新检测」，等三行都变「已应答」；② 锁屏一次再解锁（让电源键那段跑一遍）；③ 点「导出日志文件」；④ 整份发出来 —— 截图看不全。

常见问题

按下电源键没有动画

先在模块设置页点一次「预览」。预览也不播，说明 LSPosed 作用域没勾「SystemUI」，或者装完模块没有重启作用域（点右上角刷新图标，或重启手机）。

动画播了，但画面是暗色渐变、看不见屏幕内容

这是没抓到帧，动画退回了兜底画面。1.0.4 及更早版本在 Xiaomi 17 / HyperOS 4（Android 17）上会稳定出现，原因是 ROM 把 system 进程的镜像抓屏权限（ADD_MIRROR_DISPLAY / CAPTURE_VIDEO_OUTPUT）收回了，建镜像虚拟屏一律抛 SecurityException。
1.0.5 已修复：改用 IWindowManager.captureDisplay 直接向 WindowManager 要一帧，不建虚拟屏、不碰那几个权限。更新后日志里应该是：

capture via IWindowManager 1220x2656 in 29ms mean=238

动画播完会闪一下壁纸才黑屏

1.0.4 及更早版本：播完后按固定延时撤黑帧，但系统从「开始灭屏」到「面板真正断电」要 400~600ms，中间就把锁屏壁纸露出来了。
1.0.5：改成轮询 Display.getState()，一直盖到状态真的变成 OFF；万一这次压根没熄屏，走 150ms 淡出而不是硬切。
另外 1.0.5 还处理了更慢的那条路：部分机型（HyperOS 3 / Android 16）上 system_server 主线程在熄屏一瞬被系统任务塞满，「补睡」比预计晚 1.6 秒，黑帧的宽限期会先到期。现在宽限期直接给到 9 秒（只当保险丝用），补睡的定时器在模块自己的线程上也挂了一份，迟到问题一并解决。

指纹 / 人脸识别解锁时没有震动

1.0.4 及更早版本：模块为了吞掉「迟到的锁屏震动」，在熄屏后开了一个长达 2.7 秒的窗口，窗口内第一次震动一律吞掉。熄屏后一秒内按指纹解锁，被吞的其实是解锁那一震。
1.0.5 已修复：窗口改成锚在「动画播完 / keyguard 真正上锁」那一刻的 700ms 窄区间，解锁时窗口早就关了。日志里可以直接验证：

arm haptic mute 700ms
keyguard playSound id=1 suppress=true      ← 同一瞬，锚点吻合
mute late lock haptic (vibrate) id=1000     ← 被吞的是锁屏那一下

动画播到一半黑屏

通常是时长参数拉得太长、超过了系统兜底睡眠的时间。把时长调回 1 秒以内。

锁屏音响了两次

系统自己的锁屏音和模块补的那一声重叠了。在设置里关掉「锁屏音」，或者把抑制窗口的时长调大（模块会自动按动画真实时长调整）。

1.0.6 加了最后一道兜底：同一个音在 1.2 秒内播第二遍时直接吞掉（不看抑制窗口）。
日志里会看到 keyguard playSound id=1 重复（xxms 内第二次），吞掉。

熄屏时手机震了两次

系统那一下「迟到的」锁屏震动没被吞掉。它本该和按键同时，但因为动画把睡眠推迟了整整一个时长，就变成动画结束后再震一次。模块会在动画播完那一刻开一个 900ms 的窄窗口把它吞掉 —— 这个窗口和设置里的「震动反馈」开关无关：开关管的是「模块要不要替你补一下」，窗口管的是「动画造成的重复震动」，两者分开。

如果仍然震两次，看导出日志里有没有这两行：

arm haptic mute 900ms
mute late lock haptic (vibrate) id=...

只有第一行、没有第二行，说明窗口开了但系统那一下来得更晚或走了别的通道，把整份日志发出来即可定位。

升级后完全没反应

同一个版本号短时间内反复覆盖安装，LSPosed 的 dex 缓存可能不刷新。重启一次手机即可。

LSPosed 里明明「已启用」、作用域也勾了，还是没效果

先看设置页顶部的「模块状态」：显示「运行中」才是真的注入进去了。如果一直「未响应」，去看 LSPosed 自己的日志（/data/adb/lspd/log/verbose_*.log）里有没有：

E/LSPosedFramework: Cannot load module: io.github.lubenjian88.fadecraft
E/LSPosedFramework: The Xposed API classes are compiled into the module's APK.

这两行意味着模块包把 Xposed API 类打包进了 dex，LSPosed 会直接拒绝加载 —— 管理器界面照样显示「已启用」，但一行 hook 都进不去。1.0.3 已修复（stub 只参与编译、不再进 dex），更新到这个版本即可。

设置首页没有「熄屏幻术」这一行

这一行是注入进去的，需要在 LSPosed 作用域里勾上「系统设置」。只勾「SystemUI」和「系统框架」时动画照常工作，只有这一行不出现 —— 设置页顶上的「模块状态」会显示「运行中（设置待激活）」。

注意「设置待激活」不一定是没勾：系统设置进程只有被打开时才活着，没打开过就回不了话。打开一次系统设置，回到模块页点「重新检测」即可转绿；如果还是不变，再去 LSPosed 补勾作用域。

模块里的「在系统设置中显示」开关关掉了，设置首页那一行还在

这是 1.0.5 及更早版本的问题：那一行的显示状态由系统设置进程自己判断，而模块从来没有把配置推给设置进程（只推给了系统框架和 SystemUI），所以设置进程手里的开关值一直是默认的「显示」—— 开关等于没接线。

1.0.6 已修复：配置现在也会推给设置进程；设置进程收到后立刻重排列表，那一行该出现就出现、该消失就消失；模块自己打开设置首页时还会从 ContentProvider 拉一次配置兜底。

如果还是不对，看导出日志里有没有 cfg recv —— 出现 com.android.settings 这个进程名就说明配置通道通了。

模块状态显示「系统框架未生效」，但功能明明是好的

多半是误报。设置页靠广播确认三个进程是否注入，而部分 ROM（HyperOS 3 / Android 16）会把「指名发给系统框架」的广播直接丢掉 —— 模块明明在跑，界面却红着。1.0.5 加了第二判据：模块在系统框架里写一条心跳（Settings.Global 的 fadecraft_hb），心跳的构建戳和当前版本一致就算「已应答」。

1.0.6 修的是心跳自己的可靠性：以前心跳只在熄屏时写，开机那次几乎必然失败，于是「刚更新完 + 整机重启 + 还没熄过屏」时读到的是上一个版本的旧心跳 → 误判成「需重启手机（旧代码）」。现在心跳在开机时按 0/1/3/8/20/45/90/180 秒重试，成功后每 60 秒刷新一次；收到检测广播时也会顺手刷新一次。

自检也改精细了：心跳的构建戳对不上时，会再比一次「心跳时间 vs 本次 APK 安装时间」——
心跳更早 ⇒ 说明不了任何事，显示「待确认（熄屏一次后复查）」；心跳更新 ⇒ 跑的就是旧代码，才提示「需重启手机」。

和别的模块冲突

同时改 SystemUI 电源键/熄屏流程的模块（比如某些手势模块）可能互相抢 hook。先停用其他模块逐个排查。

支持的设备与系统

已验证（开发机）
- Xiaomi 13（代号 fuxi，型号 2211133C）｜HyperOS 4.0.5.0（Android 17 / API 37）｜KernelSU + LSPosed 2.2.1
- Xiaomi 17（代号 popsicle，型号 2509FPN0BC）｜HyperOS 4.0.0.43（Android 17 / API 37）｜LSPosed 2.2.1
- 这台是抓帧问题最严重的机器：1.0.4 及更早版本五条抓帧路径全灭，只能播兜底暗色；1.0.5 起正常。

系统要求
- Android 10（API 29）及以上；开发验证环境为 Android 17（API 37）/ HyperOS 4
- 模块 APK 当前 targetSdk 34（在更高版本的系统上以兼容模式运行，功能正常）
- 必须已 Root，并安装 LSPosed（Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 任一方案均可）
- 作用域至少勾选「SystemUI」——这是动画能出现的前提，缺一不可

按 ROM 区分

| ROM 类型 | 熄屏动画 | 设置首页入口 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| HyperOS / MIUI | ✅ | ✅ | 完整支持，设置首页多出一行「熄屏幻术」，桌面图标与设置入口可二选一 |...

modules.readme:
Kexec tools for Android

Magisk module that installs kexec-tools for Android. Installs kexec to /system/bin/ via Magisk's systemless overlay.

Supported architectures: ARM64, ARM, x86_64, x86.

Prerequisites
- Android device with Magisk v20.4+ installed

Installation

From release (recommended)

1. Download the latest kexec-*.zip from the releases page
2. Open Magisk → Modules → Install from storage → select the zip → Reboot

Supports auto-update via Magisk's built-in update mechanism.

From source

git clone https://github.com/evdenis/kexec
cd kexec
make build-kexec-all
make install

Requires Docker (for cross-compilation), adb with USB debugging enabled, and root access on the device.

Support
- Telegram
- XDA Thread

modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: LocusMimic·位置模拟
modules.readme:
LocusMimic（位置模拟）

English below

LocusMimic·位置模拟 是一款面向已 Root Android 设备的 Xposed/LSPosed 定位模拟模块。它支持地图选点、地点搜索、常用地点收藏、位置参数配置，并可向用户在 LSPosed 中选择的目标应用提供模拟位置。

本项目在 noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation 和 auag0/HideMockLocation 基础上继续改造，以满足个人需求

本项目仅用于合法测试、应用调试以及设备所有者明确授权的场景。

功能概览
- 支持 LSPosed 中选定的作用应用提供配置的模拟位置。
- 支持多路点路径规划、自动或摇杆路径模拟、暂停、循环及路径收藏。
- 支持地图选点、地点搜索、收藏地点和当前位置定位等功能。
- 支持对每个 Hook 应用独立设置坐标系、路径模拟方案与步频策略。
- 支持自定义百度、高德、Google地图凭证，可使用自己申请的地图。
- 支持可配置经纬度、精度、海拔、速度与随机偏移等位置参数。
- 支持四种定位模式：Hook模式、系统模式、Root模式 与 Mock Provider。

应用界面与功能概览

开发说明

本项目约 99% 的实现由 AI 辅助完成。维护者负责需求定义、代码审阅及实际测试。欢迎通过 Issues 提交 Bug 报告或功能建议；维护者将根据优先级和维护能力评估处理，不保证修复或实现（手动滑稽）。

定位模式与要求

| 模式 | 适用场景 | 要求 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 应用 Hook | 只向 LSPosed 中选定的作用应用提供位置 | Root、LSPosed/Xposed，并启用模块及目标作用域 |
| 系统 Hook | 测试系统框架或电话服务相关的位置链路 | Root、LSPosed/Xposed；仅在确有测试需要时选择系统框架或电话服务 |
| Mock Provider | 不使用 Root/LSPosed 的本地模拟备用方式 | Android 开发者选项中授予模拟位置信息应用权限；系统会标记模拟位置 |

三种模式同一时间只能启用一种，切换模式后建议重启设备。请只选择测试所需的最小作用域，避免勾选无关应用或系统组件。

安装与使用

1. 从 GitHub Releases 下载与版本对应的 APK 并安装。
2. 使用应用 Hook 或系统 Hook 时，在 LSPosed 中启用 LocusMimic，并仅勾选需要测试的作用域。
3. 打开 LocusMimic，在地图上选点或通过搜索选择位置；按需调整位置参数。
4. 选择一种工作模式后点击“开始模拟”。
5. 结束测试后点击“停止模拟”；如目标应用未立即刷新，强制停止并重新打开该应用。

隐私与外部控制

地图显示和地点搜索通过百度地图 JavaScript API 提供，因此会产生与地图服务相关的网络请求。

“允许外部广播控制”默认关闭。开启后，任何已安装应用或 adb shell 都可通过 Intent 开始/停止模拟或设置坐标；仅在你明确需要本地自动化时开启。接口与安全边界见 docs/EXTERNAL_CONTROL.md。

发布与贡献
- 发布说明
- 发布流程
- 变更记录
- 贡献说明
- 上游改造说明
- Telegram 频道

提交 Issue 时请提供设备/ROM、Android、Root 方案、LSPosed 版本、模块版本、作用域、复现步骤以及必要的 LSPosed 日志或 Logcat，并注意移除账号、地址与其他敏感信息。

合规说明

本项目仅用于合法、已授权的测试、开发调试、学习研究等场景。请勿将其用于绕过平台规则、虚假打卡签到、获取不当利益、干扰服务、侵犯他人权益或任何违法违规用途。使用前请确认你对目标设备、账号、应用和使用场景拥有合法授权，并自行承担使用后果。

License 与上游归属

本项目遵循 MIT License。在 noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation 与 auag0/HideMockLocation 的基础上继续改造；请保留许可证和相应上游归属。

English

LocusMimic is an Android location-simulation module for rooted devices using Xposed/LSPosed. It provides map selection, place search, favourites, configurable location parameters, and scoped simulated locations for selected apps. It is maintained as a personal fork of XposedFakeLocation and HideMockLocation.

Features
- Provides configured simulated locations to selected LSPosed app scopes.
- Supports multi-waypoint route planning, automatic or joystick route simulation, pause, loop, and route favourites.
- Supports map selection, place search, favourite locations, and current-location positioning.
- Supports per-app coordinate systems, route-simulation profiles, and cadence strategies.
- Supports a user-provided Baidu Maps browser-side JavaScript API AK.
- Supports configurable latitude, longitude, accuracy, altitude, speed, and random offset parameters.
- Provides three location modes: Application Hook, System Hook, and Mock Provider.

Development disclosure

Approximately 99% of this project was implemented with AI assistance. The maintainer is responsible for requirements, code review, and real-device testing. Bug reports and feature requests are welcome through Issues; they will be evaluated based on priority and maintenance capacity, and fixes or implementation are not guaranteed.

Modes
- Application Hook — Root and LSPosed/Xposed are required. Simulated locations are supplied only to the selected app scopes.
- System Hook — Root and LSPosed/Xposed are required. Use only when testing system-framework or phone-service location paths.
- Mock Provider — No Root or LSPosed is needed, but Android developer options must authorize LocusMimic as the mock-location app. Android will mark the location as mocked.

Only one mode can be active at a time. Restarting the device after switching modes is recommended. Android 11 (API 30) or newer is required. The current APK supports arm64-v8a.

Download releases from GitHub Releases. Maintainers can refer to docs/PUBLISHING.md for release and signing instructions.

Project updates and discussion: Telegram channel.

The optional external broadcast-control switch is off by default. When enabled, any installed app or adb shell can issue the documented local intents; see docs/EXTERNAL_CONTROL.md before enabling it.

Use this software only for lawful, authorized testing, development, debugging, and research. Do not use it to evade platform rules, falsify attendance, obtain improper benefits, interfere with services, or infringe others' rights.

modules.description: 为每个应用独立强制开启深色模式，支持按设定时间自动切换。基于 Material Design 3 规范重构，全面支持 LSPosed (Xposed) 模块、Shizuku (免 Root) 与 Root 三种工作模式，兼容 Android 10 ~ 16+。
modules.readme:
DarQ

Per-app selectable force dark option for Android, with scheduled automatic switching.

Refactored with Material Design 3, seamlessly supporting LSPosed (Xposed) Module, Shizuku (Rootless ADB), and Root operation modes on Android 10 through Android 14+.

中文说明 (README-CN.md)

✨ Features
- 🌙 Per-App Selectable Force Dark:
- Leverages Android's native system-level Force Dark rendering algorithm.
- Forces dark mode on third-party apps that lack built-in dark themes or have incomplete dark mode implementations.
- Clean inversion with natural contrast, eliminating glaring white screens.
- 🔄 Multiple Working Modes:
- 🛡️ LSPosed / Xposed Module: Injected via Xposed framework. Zero background service footprint, no persistent process needed, highly power-efficient.
- ⚡ Shizuku (ADB) Mode: No root required. Communicates with high-level system APIs through Shizuku, eliminating lags caused by traditional accessibility services.
- 👑 Root Mode: Direct control via Root access on rooted devices.
- ⏰ Smart Auto Dark Theme:
- Sunrise / Sunset: Uses astronomical calculations (Commons SunCalc) based on your geographic location to automatically switch themes.
- Custom Time Schedule: Set custom start and end times for automatic dark mode activation.
- Google Clock MD3 Time Picker: Authentic Material Design 3 time picker experience with pill capsules, circular dials, and 28dp rounded shapes.
- 🎨 Modern Material Design 3 UI:
- Full support for Android 12+ Monet dynamic color extraction (Material You).
- Grouped rounded cards, MD3 switch controls, fluid transitions, and responsive touch zones.
- Smooth collapsible card animation for "Show apps without launcher interface".
- MD3 capsule pill dialogs with precise contrast and color balance.
- 💾 Configuration Backup & Restore:
- Export and backup your DarQ configuration to local storage with one click.
- Restore saved configurations seamlessly from local files.
- Full data reset option guarded by a confirmation dialog.
- 🛠️ Developer & Advanced Tools:
- One-click termination of duplicate services (useful when switching between Shizuku and Root modes).
- Real-time DarQ service status and architecture monitoring.

📱 Operation Modes

| Mode | Needs Root? | Background Service | Recommended For |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| LSPosed Module | No (Needs Framework) | ❌ None | Devices with LSPosed installed (Best battery life, seamless) |
| Shizuku (ADB) | ❌ No Root | ⚠️ Service required | Unrooted devices with Shizuku / Wireless Debugging configured |
| Root Mode | Yes | ⚠️ Service required | Devices with Magisk / KernelSU / APatch root access |

If you have LSPosed installed, simply enable DarQ in the LSPosed Manager and select the system framework and target scopes. No background root/Shizuku service needs to run inside the app!

🛠️ Compatibility
- Android Version: Android 10 (API 29) ~ Android 14+ (API 34)
- Frameworks: LSPosed, EdXposed, TaiChi Magisk, classic Xposed
- ROM Support: AOSP, Google Pixel OS, LineageOS, HyperOS, OriginOS, ColorOS, and other custom/OEM ROMs

📥 Downloads
- GitHub Releases: Download the latest compiled APK.
- Pre-built APKs are also located in the release/ directory of this repository.

🔨 Building from Source

This project uses the standard Gradle build system:

1. Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/rove24/DarQ.git
cd DarQ

2. Build Release APK
./gradlew assembleRelease

The output APK will be placed in app/build/outputs/apk/release/DarQ-v1.4.apk.

📜 Changelog

See Changelog (LOG-CN.md).

🙏 Credits & Acknowledgements
- Original Author: KieronQuinn/DarQ
- LSPosed
- Shizuku
- Commons SunCalc

📄 License

This project is licensed under the Apache-2.0 License.
modules.changelog:
DarQ v3.1 Release Notes

本次更新是一次面向新系统的大版本：全面适配 Android 17，彻底根治 root 模式在新系统上的静默失效，并新增「扩展深色应用」与可开关的调试日志。
- * *

🚀 Android 17 全面适配
- 彻底根治 Android 17 上 root 模式完全失效的问题：
- 根因定位：android.app.IProcessObserver 这个 @hide AIDL 在 Android 15 新增了 onProcessStarted，而且是插在 onForegroundActivitiesChanged 前面（不是追加在末尾）。DarQ 以 compileSdkVersion 32 编译，object : IProcessObserver.Stub() 只实现了旧版的 3 个方法，但运行时继承的是设备 boot classpath 上那版声明了 4 个抽象方法的 Stub —— 匿名类天生不完整；
- 为什么 15 / 16 能凑合用：enableProcessObserverBroadcastOnProcessStarted 这个 aconfig flag 当时默认关闭，系统压根不会调用 onProcessStarted，缺失的那个方法永远碰不到；
- 为什么 17 直接崩：该 flag 打开后系统真的开始回调，缺失的方法抛出 AbstractMethodError。由于抛的是 Error 而不是 RuntimeException，Binder 那层的 catch (RemoteException | RuntimeException) 接不住 —— root 服务静默死亡，不弹窗、无日志、getprop 也看不出任何异常；
- 修复：补齐 AIDL 的 onProcessStarted 声明并改为 oneway 对齐 AOSP，DarqService 的 observer 补上对应空实现。
- 属性写入加入回读校验：debug.hwui.force_dark 的写入原先异常被全部吞掉，写失败完全无感知。现在每次写入后回读校验，失败会明确记录。
- * *

🌙 全新「扩展深色应用」（Android 17+）
- 对接 Android 17 新增的 force invert color 机制：
- 与旧版 Force Dark 不同，扩展深色无视应用自身的 opt-out，对浅色应用直接反色，覆盖更彻底；
- 主页「强制深色应用」下方新增独立卡片，Android 17 以下自动隐藏；
- 复用同一个应用选择器，标题与列表按用途自动区分，两个列表互相独立。
- 实现思路与强制深色完全一致：
- 扩展深色的全局开关和 debug.hwui.force_dark 一样是全局的，DarQ 复用已有的前台应用监听，在每次前台切换时重算一次「当前应用该不该用扩展深色」，因此只对勾选的应用生效；
- 勾选的应用同时写入系统的「强制启用」名单，让不符合系统启发式的应用也能被反色；
- 额外优势：ViewRootImpl 注册了 force-invert 状态监听，开关变化会立刻触发深色重算，不需要等待窗口重建，切换比强制深色更跟手。
- 已知限制：图片与视频内容无法被反色，应用内的商品图、封面图等仍会保持原色，这是反色机制的固有限制。
- * *

📋 可开关的调试日志
- 开发者选项 → 服务信息下方新增「调试日志」开关：
- 打开后输出 root 服务的关键节点：绑定模式（Root / Shizuku）、Shell.rootAccess() 结果、属性写入回读、前台应用切换、白名单同步；
- 关闭时每次调用只有一次布尔判断，几乎零开销；
- 抓取方式：adb logcat -s DarQService:v DarQServiceProvider:v AndroidRuntime:E。
- 新增的日志设施 DarqLog 让这类「静默失效」问题不再需要改代码重新编译才能定位。
- * *

🎨 细节修复
- 开关样式统一：开发者选项新增的开关改用模块自带的 MD3 实现，清除主题 Tint 干扰，与主页总开关样式完全一致。
- 服务连接层日志补全：输出绑定模式与实际失败原因，便于排查 Root / Shizuku 模式切换问题。
- 前台检测链路日志：前台回调、包名反查、observer 注册失败都会留下记录，不再静默。
- * *

📦 下载与安装说明
- 推荐直接下载下方 Assets 中的安装包进行更新。
- 本版本全面兼容 Android 10 ~ Android 17，支持 LSPosed 模块模式、Shizuku 免 Root 模式及传统 Root 模式运行。
- 「扩展深色应用」需要 Android 17（API 37）及以上，低版本系统会自动隐藏该卡片。

modules.name: Enable Blurs
modules.author: HeyItsJono
modules.description: More extensive blur enabler for Magisk, built specifically with the Pixel 5 in mind.
modules.readme:
Enable Blurs for Magisk
This module enables support for window-level blurs on a wide range of devices.

After installing, be sure to go to Settings app -> System -> Developer Options -> Enable Allow window-level blurs under the Hardware accelerated rendering subheading.

Just installing this module isn't enough to get blur/glass effects on your system; system UI components need to specifically be programmed to take advantage of them. One way of achieving this is by installing mods like ClearLineage (download via Telegram), or Iconify.

My module is similar to other modules, but includes a late_start service to modify certain system props just after boot to expand compatibility to a wider range of devices (including my Pixel 5) which don't work with just the standard read-only props mods.

The Action button simply re-runs this late_start service and restarts the surfaceflinger to ensure it takes effect.

Modified Props

	# Default boot stage (system.prop)
	ro.sf.blurs_are_expensive (1)
	ro.surface_flinger.supports_background_blur (1)

	# late_start service boot stage
	persist.sys.sf.disable_blurs (0)

modules.name: XposedFakeLocation
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: XposedFakeLocation
modules.readme:
com.noobexon.xposedfakelocation

An Android application and Xposed module that allows you to spoof your device's location globally or for specific apps without using "mock location" from the developer options.

https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation
modules.changelog:
New features

Fake satellite data that matches the fake location
While spoofing, target apps no longer see satellite data from where you really are. Apps that cross-check GPS satellites against the reported location now see a consistent picture.
- Fake satellite sky: apps that read satellite status (GnssStatus / GpsStatus, e.g. GPSTest) see the satellites that are actually above the fake location at the current time, computed from real orbit data. Satellite positions, signal strengths, which satellites are used in the fix and the time to first fix all look like a real receiver. The sky uses the same satellite systems and bands your phone's chip reports.
- Fake NMEA: apps that read raw NMEA sentences get sentences for the fake position and fake sky (position, time, speed and course, satellites in view and in use, accuracy values), in the same style your chip writes them.
- Raw GNSS data hidden: raw measurements and navigation messages, which could be used to compute your real position, are not delivered while spoofing, and the phone reports them as unsupported.
- Orbit data is bundled with the app and refreshed automatically once a day when online.

Nothing changes while spoofing is stopped: apps get the real data.

Fixes
- System-level spoofing (System Framework in the module scope) now reports the location you picked; before, it could report 0,0 coordinates.
- Should fix the random system crash and soft reboot (IllegalStateException in LocationEventLog) with System Framework in scope (#50): the provider hook that most likely caused it was replaced.
- Fixed a system crash and soft reboot when an app scanned for Wi-Fi networks with the Wi-Fi identity option enabled.

What's Changed
- feat(gnss): hide raw GNSS measurements and navigation messages while spoofing by @noobexon1 in https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation/pull/67
- feat(gnss): show a fake satellite sky while spoofing by @noobexon1 in https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation/pull/68
- feat(gnss): replace NMEA with the fake fix and sky while spoofing by @noobexon1 in https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation/pull/69
- fix: Wi-Fi scan result marshalling and provider location delivery by @Misha803 in https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation/pull/66

New Contributors
- @Misha803 made their first contribution in https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation/pull/66

Full Changelog: https://github.com/noobexon1/XposedFakeLocation/compare/v0.4.0...v0.5.0
