modules.name: doumcp
modules.author: yfishyon
modules.description: DouMCP（抖M）- MCP-enabled LSPosed module for Douyin | 让 AI 通过 MCP 协议操控抖音
modules.readme:
抖M（DouMCP）

抖音 MCP Xposed 模块 —— 注入抖音进程内启动 MCP 服务，让 Claude 等 AI 客户端直接操控一台真实登录的抖音。

与走网页解析 / 协议模拟的抖音 MCP 不同：抖M 活在抖音自己的进程里，所有操作复用宿主的接口与 IM SDK —— 登录态、设备签名、加密全部现成，稳定跟随抖音版本运行。

📦 LSPosed 模块仓库：Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.yfishyon.doumcp —— 可在 LSPosed 管理器里直接搜到并下载

✨ 功能特性
- 账号 —— 多账号列表 / 一键切换 / 任意用户资料（uid 或 secUid）
- 私信 IM —— 会话列表（火花/小火人）、消息分页（全类型解析）、发文本（含引用回复）、发图（同步返回 msgId）、撤回、编辑、表情表态、输入状态、已读、未读统计、云表情目录
- 视频 —— 作品详情（视频/图文）、用户作品列表（分页）
- 评论 —— 一级评论 + 楼中楼（表情/图片/@提及）、发表评论（顶评/回复/楼中楼，文字 / 表情包 / 图片）、批量删除评论
- 发布 —— 发布图文图集 / 图集内动图（实况）/ 普通视频；本地文件直传（模块走宿主上传链路）、正文 #话题 与 @提及、配乐搜索、24 小时动态；批量删除自己的作品
- 搜索 —— 综合搜索（聚合或按类型过滤，分页）
- 本地数据库 —— 直接 SQL 查询抖音全部 SQLite 库；加密库自动解密（含 IM 消息库，任意账号）
- 进程内服务 —— MCP 服务跑在抖音进程内，回环地址 + Bearer 密钥鉴权
- 逆向调试（仅 debug 包） —— 搜类/搜方法/搜字段（DexKit 结构查询）、运行时反射读写与调用、动态 hook 观察与篡改、线程/Activity 堆栈、堆快照等；release 包不含这组工具

🔧 工作原理

Claude / MCP 客户端
      │  HTTP (Streamable) + Bearer Token
      ▼
127.0.0.1:19320  ←── Ktor 服务（抖音进程内）
      │
      ├── 反射调用抖音自己的接口与 SDK（发消息/评论/搜索…）
      ├── DexKit 定位混淆代码（全等字符串锚点，结果两级缓存）
      └── 宿主 WCDB 直解加密数据库

📦 安装

1. 需要 root + LSPosed（Zygisk 版）
2. 安装抖M APK，在 LSPosed 中启用并勾选作用域：抖音
3. 强制停止抖音并重新打开，出现「抖M：服务已启动」提示即生效
4. 配置入口：抖音设置页最上方「抖M设置」（原生样式）—— 端口（默认 19320）与鉴权密钥，保存后重启抖音生效

MCP 客户端配置

支持 Streamable HTTP 传输的客户端（Claude Code、Claude Desktop 等）：

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "doumcp": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "http://:19320/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer "
      }
    }
  }
}
手机与客户端需在同一网络；未配置密钥时服务不鉴权（仅建议本机调试使用）。

🧰 可用工具（32 个）

| 域 | 工具 | 功能 |
|----|------|------|
| 账号 | getUserAccounts / switchAccount | 已登录账号列表 / 切换账号 |
| 账号 | getUserProfile | 任意用户完整资料（uid/secUid） |
| 视频 | getAwemeDetail | 作品详情（视频/图文，含统计与地址） |
| 视频 | getUserAwemes | 用户作品列表（分页） |
| 搜索 | search / searchUsers | 综合搜索（聚合或 type 过滤）/ 账号搜索 |
| 评论 | getComments / getCommentReplies | 一级评论 / 楼中楼（含表情、图片、@提及） |
| 评论 | getCommentStickers | 评论表情包（动图）推荐清单 |
| 评论 | getStickerSets | 我添加的表情集 / 表情集里的表情（带文字描述） |
| 评论 | postComment | 发表评论（顶评/回复/楼中楼/@提及，云表情 [表情名] 语法、表情包、本地图片） |
| 评论 | deleteComment | 批量删除自己发的评论（单条失败不影响其余） |
| 发布 | publishNote | 发布图文：图片发为图集，视频文件发为图集里的动图/实况；正文 #话题/@提及、配乐、24 小时动态 |
| 发布 | publishVideo | 发布普通视频作品（模块走宿主上传链路 + 完整视频参数） |
| 发布 | searchMusic | 搜配乐拿音乐 ID（传给上面两个发布工具的 musicId） |
| 发布 | deleteAweme | 批量删除自己发布的作品（直接删除，不进「最近删除」） |
| IM | getConversations | 会话列表（未读/最后消息/火花状态） |
| IM | getMessages | 消息分页（文本/图片/卡片全类型，含引用关系） |
| IM | sendTextMessage | 发文本（支持 quoteMessageId 引用回复） |
| IM | sendImageMessage | 发本地图片（同步等待，返回 msgId） |
| IM | revokeMessage / editMessage | 撤回 / 编辑自己发的消息 |
| IM | setMessageReaction | 消息表情表态（多值，add/unset） |
| IM | sendTypingStatus | 输入中状态（可定时自动停止） |
| IM | markConversationRead / getUnreadCount | 已读 / 全局未读统计 |
| IM | getEmojis | 云表情目录（可搜、含限时活动表情） |
| 系统 | getCurrentTime | 手机当前时间（iso/ms/秒/自定义格式） |
| 数据库 | listDatabases / listTables | 枚举库 / 表结构 |
| 数据库 | queryDatabase | 只读 SQL（扁平 KV 输出） |
| 数据库 | executeDatabaseStatement | 任意 SQL 写操作（后果自负） |
| 调试 | ping | 连通性检查 |

逆向调试工具（33 个，仅 debug 包）
这组工具只在 debug 包注册；release 包编译时会被 R8 整体裁掉（不入包、不暴露）。用途是把抖M当成一个动态逆向工作台：搜代码结构、读写运行时对象、挂 hook 观察/篡改、看调用链。

| 分组 | 工具 | 功能 |
|------|------|------|
| 静态定位 | dexKitInfo / dexKitInitCache | 桥状态 / 初始化全量缓存 |
| 静态定位 | findClasses / findMethods / findFields | 按结构（类型/修饰符/原始 DEX 标志/注解/数量/继承/字段读写/调用关系）或字符串锚点搜类/方法/字段 |
| 静态定位 | batchFindUsingStrings | 多组字符串锚点批量检索（组内 AND） |
| 静态定位 | dumpClass / dumpMethod / dumpField | 类结构 / 方法细节（含 invokes、callers、smali 助记符、字段读写方）；支持按描述符定位 |
| 静态定位 | findCallers / findStringUsage | 静态调用者 / 字符串用处 |
| 运行时 | runtimeInfo / packageInfo / readPreferences | 进程与框架信息 / 包信息 / 宿主 SP |
| 运行时 | reflectClass / loadClass / listClassLoaders / listEnumConstants / dumpStatics | 真实反射结构 / 类加载 / 枚举 / 静态字段（找单例） |
| 运行时 | inspectObject / readField / writeField | 对象路径解析与字段读写（含 final 尝试） |
| 运行时 | newInstance / invokeMethod / dynamicProxy | 构造对象（返回句柄）/ 反射调用（可走原始实现或完整 hook 链）/ 动态代理 |
| 运行时 | dumpStack / dumpActivities / dumpHeap | 线程堆栈（找 caller）/ 页面栈 / 堆快照 |
| 动态 hook | watchMethod / unwatchMethod / listWatches / traceLog | 挂 hook（记录参数/返回值/耗时/调用栈，可改参数/返回值/this、条件命中）、摘除、列表、增量读日志 |
| 动态 hook | deoptimize | 反内联调用方，保证 hook 命中 |
⚠️ invokeMethod / writeField / watchMethod 等会真实改变宿主状态，请自行承担后果；只在 debug 包可用。

数据库直查示例

IM 消息库是 WCDB 加密的，抖M 直接解密（密钥由账号 uid 推导，任意账号的库都能开）：

queryDatabase: {"database":"encrypted__im.db",
                "sql":"SELECT msg_server_id, conversation_id, created_time FROM msg ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 3"}
→ 3 row(s):
  msg_server_id=76920xxxxxxxxxxxxxx, conversation_id=0:1::, created_time=1790936562351
IM 库的时间戳是毫秒（13 位）；个别扩展字段是秒（10 位），换算前先看位数。

🏗️ 构建

./gradlew assembleDebug          # 调试包（含逆向调试工具）
./gradlew assembleRelease        # 发布包（不含逆向调试工具）
- 两个包的区别：调试包注册 33 个逆向调试工具（搜代码结构、运行时读写、动态 hook 等）；发布包用 BuildConfig.DEBUG 门控 + R8 裁剪，这组工具不会编译进发布包（不含相关类与字符串）
- 按 ABI 分包：arm64-v8a 与 armeabi-v7a 各出一个 APK
- 两个包使用同一签名（release.keystore），可互相覆盖安装不丢登录态
- versionName 写在 app/build.gradle.kts；versionCode = 提交数
- 版本号参与 DexKit 定位缓存键（模块或抖音任一升级，缓存自动失效重扫）

项目结构

doumcp/
  ModuleMain.kt / McpServerHost.kt / ModulePrefs.kt / SettingsInjector.kt
  core/      HostRuntime（宿主上下文/classLoader/模块实例单例）、DexKitSupport（定位+缓存）、
             Reflect、ModLog、DouToastHelper、ResolvedCache(FastKV)、ObjectDump、ValueFormat
  features/  按功能分包，每包 tool / bridge / resolver 三层
    account/ video/ comment/ search/ im/ system/ database/
    devtool/ 逆向调试（仅 debug 包注册）：DexKit 结构查询、运行时反射读写/构造/调用、
             动态 hook（观察+篡改）、堆栈/Activity/堆快照

⚠️ 已知限制
- 发送语音（silk 编码转码链路复杂）与发布作品（上传凭证+大量混淆字段）暂未实现
- 评论区风控：短时间连发评论可能被平台静默过滤（请求成功但不出现在列表）
- 需登录的功能未登录时返回错误；数据库写操作请自行承担后果

📄 免责声明

仅供学习与研究使用。使用者需遵守相关法律法规及抖音用户协议；作者不对使用本模块产生的任何损失或账号风险承担责任。

modules.name: Faker Unlocker
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Faker Unlocker
modules.readme:
Faker Unlocker

An Xposed module for the Android Faker reverse-engineering practice target,
updated for:
- Xposed API 101 (modern libxposed API)
- Android Faker v2.0.0-beta-9-6
- package com.android1500.androidfaker

Usage

1. Build and install the module APK.
2. Enable Faker Unlocker in an API-101-compatible Xposed manager.
3. Select Android Faker and every app in which Android Faker spoofing should run.
   The module intentionally uses a dynamic scope (staticScope=false).
4. Force-stop and reopen Android Faker and the selected target apps.

Beta-9-6 hooks

| Runtime target | Purpose | Patch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| wg6.OooO0O0() | Core UserState.isVip | Return true |
| wg6$OooO00o | Account state | Constructor status 1, expiry year 2100 |
| AccountSummary | Parcelable account state | Constructor status 1, expiry year 2100 |
| HookState | Hook-screen VIP state | Constructor/getter Boolean.TRUE |
| ProfileState | Profile-screen VIP state | Constructor Boolean.TRUE |
| uf5 | APK signature verifier | Return true |
| Native.doInit(String) | Native initialization guard | Return true |
| Native.getDex() | Spoofing payload | Serve the decrypted DEX |

Exact beta-9-6 names are attempted first. DexKit structural matchers provide a
fallback for the data and verifier classes. The old beta-9-5 HookConfig
boolean overrides were removed because those booleans now control fingerprint
randomization rather than VIP access.

JADX's p000 package is synthetic: wg6, wg6$OooO00o, and uf5 are
root-package runtime names.

Native stability

In target apps, the module intercepts Runtime.loadLibrary0 before Android
Faker loads af_native. This prevents beta-9-6's abort watchdog from being
created by doInit or a failing getDex.

DexExtractor locates the encrypted dex\n header dynamically, reads the DEX
size from its header, and decrypts the payload with XOR key 0x32. For
beta-9-6 the payload is 46,416 bytes and has SHA-256:

6779812ebebaa4dcc79099a74dd3b2793d098541af0822551264a509d33befa1

The module can extract it from the Faker module classloader's APK path, the
native-library directory, PackageManager, or the existing cache. It does not
depend on hard-coded native RVAs, and it verifies the beta-9-6 payload size and
SHA-256 before serving it.

Xposed API 101 layout

The APK uses the modern module resources:

META-INF/xposed/java_init.list
META-INF/xposed/module.prop
META-INF/xposed/scope.list

The entrypoint extends io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModule and installs hooks
with hook(...).intercept(...). There is no legacy assets/xposed_init or
de.robv.android.xposed bridge dependency.

Build

Requirements:
- Android SDK 35
- JDK 21
- local io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0 artifact (the module targets API 101)

On Windows:

.\gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug

modules.name: florida zygisk module
modules.author: lok1s | Credits: Ylarod (florida), ViRb3 (magisk-frida)
modules.description: Runs patched frida-server (florida) on boot
modules.readme:
florida-zygisk — Florida frida-server module

A Magisk / KSU / APatch module that automatically starts Florida —
an anti-detection build of frida-server — on boot.

Built on top of the magisk-frida module template by ViRb3.

About project

| Layer | Source |
|-------|--------|
| Module installer / service scripts | ViRb3/magisk-frida template |
| frida-server binary (patched) | Built from Ylarod/Florida patches applied to frida/frida source |

Florida applies source-level patches to frida before compilation, making the server harder to detect
via common heuristics (port, process name, memory maps, etc.).

How updates work

A GitHub Actions workflow runs every week and checks for a new frida release. When one is
detected it builds Florida from source and publishes a new module ZIP here.
Why build from source?
Florida's upstream CI has been unreliable. By cloning their patches/ directory and applying
them ourselves we are independent of their release cadence.

Requirements
- Architectures: arm · arm64 · x86 · x86_64
- Magisk ≥ 24 · KernelSU · APatch

Installation

1. Download the latest florida-zygisk-*.zip from the Releases page.
2. Flash via Magisk Manager / KSU / APatch.
3. Reboot. The Florida frida-server starts automatically at late-boot.

Status & port

The module description shown in the module manager updates at runtime:

| State | Description field |
|-------|-------------------|
| Running | Running on port  (PID=) - tap Action to toggle |
| Stopped | Stopped - tap Action to restart |
| Error | ERROR:  - check log |

You can also read the port from the log:

adb shell grep "frida-server started" /data/local/tmp/florida-zygisk.log | tail -1
or read the description directly
adb shell grep "^description=" /data/adb/modules/florida-zygisk/module.prop

Toggle (KSU Action button)

In KernelSU, the module manager shows an Action button next to florida-zygisk.
Tapping it toggles the server:
- Running → tap → server stops, description updates to Stopped
- Stopped → tap → server starts on a new random port, description updates with port & PID

Connecting

Once the server is running, forward the port and connect:

Get the current port
PORT=$(adb shell grep "^description=" /data/adb/modules/florida-zygisk/module.prop \
        | grep -oE '[0-9]{4,5}' | head -1)

adb forward tcp:$PORT tcp:$PORT
frida -H 127.0.0.1:$PORT

Logs

adb shell cat /data/local/tmp/florida-zygisk.log

Building locally

1. Build Florida frida-server binaries (requires Android NDK r29+)
export ANDROID_NDK_ROOT=/path/to/ndk

git clone --recurse-submodules --branch  https://github.com/frida/frida
git clone https://github.com/Ylarod/Florida florida-repo

cd frida
FRIDA_ROOT="$(pwd)"
for patch_dir in ../florida-repo/patches/*/; do
    subproject=$(basename "$patch_dir")
    cd "$FRIDA_ROOT/subprojects/$subproject"
    git am "$patch_dir"*.patch
    cd "$FRIDA_ROOT"
done

for arch in android-arm android-arm64 android-x86 android-x86_64; do
    mkdir -p ../build-$arch && cd ../build-$arch
    ../frida/configure --host=$arch
    make subprojects/frida-core/server/frida-server
    cp subprojects/frida-core/server/frida-server ../downloads/frida-server-$arch
    gzip -9 ../downloads/frida-server-$arch
    cd ..
done

2. Package into the Magisk module ZIP
FRIDA_VERSION= RELEASE_TAG= GITHUB_REPO=thelok1s/florida-zygisk python3 build.py
Result: build/florida-zygisk-.zip

Credits
- Ylarod/Florida — anti-detection patches and inspiration
- ViRb3/magisk-frida — module template and structure
- frida/frida — the instrumentation toolkit itself

License

See LICENSE

modules.name: glass-ui
modules.author: AurelioMo
modules.description: Glass UI: a complete glass interface for Samsung One UI 9 — control centre, notifications and volume panel (LSPosed).
modules.readme:
Glass UI

A complete glass interface for Samsung One UI 9.
Control centre, notifications and volume panel — one look, one palette, one app.

Glass UI redraws the parts of One UI you touch all day with the same liquid glass:
clear surfaces that bend the wallpaper behind them, live blur, thin bright edges and
spring motion — from the control centre and notifications to the volume panel, home-screen
widgets and folders. It runs as an LSPosed module — nothing on the system partition is
changed, and turning the module off brings stock One UI straight back.

New in 3.0 · Prisma Aurora

The 3.x family is called Prisma. 3.0.0 is Prisma Aurora, with motion and light taken from ColorOS 17:
- Haptics and sound on every Glass UI interaction, following Android's vibration and touch-sound settings
- Living Flow — a soft light follows your finger on tiles and sliders
- Album art colour shared by the control centre player, the island and the shade media card
- Spring cascade when the shade and control centre open, layered overscroll and a curved edge glow on sliders
- Notification stacks for collapsed groups
- Per-app volume, wide connection tiles and resizable folders by dragging
- Charging ring on the Dynamic Island in Samsung's charging colours
- One light/dark glass palette across every surface and glass style

Highlights

Control centre
- ColorOS-style cards, tall sliders and round tiles
- Liquid, Frosted, Opaque or Plain glass
- Live blur, edge shine and tilt highlights
- Per-tile accents or your Material You colour
- Move and resize everything in place
- Wide Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth and Mobile data tiles with network names
- Living Flow light and haptics on every tile and slider

Notifications
- Cards in the exact glass of the control centre
- The wallpaper refracts through every card
- Clean swipe-to-dismiss — Samsung's own card blur is switched off underneath
- Same background blur as the control centre from the very first pull
- Stacked cards for collapsed groups
- One switch to go back to stock cards

Volume panel
- Live-blurred glass panel with spring sliders
- White fill, dark glyphs, glass side buttons
- Ringer mode and Do Not Disturb at hand
- Blur, opacity, side and height adjustable
- Optional: volume keys always for the system
- Per-app volume for up to four apps playing sound

Home screen
- Widgets in the exact glass of the control centre, over a live blur of the wallpaper — photo and gallery widgets keep their look
- Small folders, large 2×2 folders and open folders in the same glass
- Resize any folder by dragging, with a ripple on the icons around it
- Pinch out on the home screen to clear the badges on that page
- Lock screen and AOD widgets are left untouched
- Separate switches for glass widgets and glass folders

Dynamic Island
- An island around the camera for music, calls, timers, downloads and notifications, from Dynamic Island
- All of its settings live in the Glass UI app, in the same look as the rest
- Off by default — turn it on in the app

One app for everything

Every option lives in the Glass UI app and applies live — glass style, tint, edge shine,
blur, tile rows, tile names, notification glass, home-screen widgets and folders, and every
volume panel setting. The status
card shows whether the module is running and restarts SystemUI for you. The pencil in the
control centre is kept for what it does best: arranging your cards and tiles.

Requirements

| | |
| --- | --- |
| System | Samsung One UI 9 (Android 17) |
| Root | Required |
| Framework | LSPosed with libxposed API 101 or newer |
| Scope | System UI · System Framework · One UI Home |
| Tested on | Galaxy S23 (SM-S911B) |
| Languages | 22 — English, Português, Español, Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Русский, Українська, Polski, Čeština, Nederlands, Svenska, Türkçe, Indonesia, العربية, हिन्दी, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文, 繁體中文, Tiếng Việt, ไทย |

Install

1. Download GlassUI-*.apk from the latest release and install it.
2. In LSPosed, enable Glass UI for System UI, System Framework and One UI Home.
3. Reboot once.
4. Open Glass UI — the status card should read Active in SystemUI.

Pull down on the left half of the status bar for notifications and on the right half
for the control centre — on the lock screen too. You can move the split in the app
(Control centre → Where a pull opens the control centre, 20–80%).

Updates

Glass UI checks this repository for new releases whenever you open it, and you can check
manually under About → Updates. Updates are downloaded straight from GitHub and are
only installed after the SHA-256, the package name and the signing key all match. With
root the update installs silently; without it, Android's installer asks for confirmation.
Restart SystemUI afterwards to load the new module code.

FAQ

The app says "Waiting for SystemUI"

Check that the scopes (System UI and System Framework) are enabled in LSPosed and reboot.
After updates, restarting SystemUI from the app is enough.

Widgets or folders are not glass

Enable One UI Home in Glass UI's LSPosed scope, then switch Glass widgets or
Glass folders off and on in the app — it restarts the home screen for you.

The control centre disappeared

Glass UI switches its control centre off after three SystemUI crashes caused by it and
keeps the stock panel. Remove the cause (usually another module hooking the same panel),
then re-enable it as root and restart SystemUI:

su -c rm /data/user_de/0/com.android.systemui/files/glassui_crashes

I see two volume panels or two control centres

Another module is still active. Disable other module that
replaces the same panel.

Reporting a bug

Open an issue with the Glass UI version, your device, One UI and LSPosed versions, and a
short log: adb logcat | grep -E "LSPosed". Please don't post
screenshots with personal notifications, accounts or serial numbers.

Thanks
- jfo5 (Discord) — bug hunting and testing. Many of the fixes in Glass UI came from their reports....
modules.changelog:
Glass UI 3.1.0 · Prisma Brisa

Second release of the Prisma family, with more motion and light taken from ColorOS 17.

New
- Touch physics: tiles, cards and buttons press in and spring back with ColorOS's Jelly and Candy springs, squashing a little more along their short side.
- Light beam on sliders: while you drag, a soft cone of light and fine particles follow your finger on every slider: control centre, its detail pages, the player, the volume panel, per-app volume, the island's media seek and torch.
- Elastic slider ends: pulling past either end stretches the slider and lets it spring back.
- Action ring: turning a tile on sends a ring of light out to the edge of its icon.
- PIN keypad light: the lock screen PIN keys (digits, Delete and OK) light up where you press, with a soft ambient reflection. Samsung's own key animation and security are unchanged.
- Richer haptics: control centre, volume sliders and the Dynamic Island share one haptic engine with frequency and strength curves where the device supports them. Android's touch-vibration setting still applies.
- Each effect has its own switch in the app.

Fixes
- Arabic and other RTL languages: the control centre no longer hides the small tiles on the second page (#16).
- Privacy Display (S26 Ultra): when notification Privacy Display is on, the Dynamic Island steps aside and lets One UI show protected pop-ups with its own blur (#18).
- Pulling down on the control centre side of the home screen (not only the status bar) opens the control centre again.
- No more orange blocks on sliders.
- Smoother control centre close: dragging the control centre closed skipped frames in the status bar inside the panel (also in 3.0.0). Per-frame work was cut: on a Galaxy S23, janky frames fell from about 47% to 36% on slow closes and from 63% to 32% on fast closes.

Notes
- Same package and signing key: install over 3.0.0 to keep your settings.
- Tested on a Galaxy S23 (One UI 9, Android 17). The Privacy Display fix still needs confirmation on an S26 Ultra.

Glass UI 3.1.0 · Prisma Brisa

Segunda versão da família Prisma, com mais movimento e luz vindos do ColorOS 17.

Novidades
- Física de toque: blocos, cards e botões afundam e voltam com as molas Jelly e Candy do ColorOS, achatando um pouco mais no lado curto.
- Feixe de luz nos sliders: ao arrastar, um cone de luz suave e partículas finas seguem o dedo em todos os sliders: central, páginas de detalhe, player, painel de volume, volume por app, progresso da música e lanterna na ilha.
- Pontas elásticas: puxar além do fim estica o slider, que volta com uma mola.
- Anel de ação: ligar um bloco espalha um anel de luz até a borda do ícone.
- Luz no teclado do PIN: as teclas do PIN (números, Apagar e OK) acendem onde você toca, com um reflexo ambiente suave. A animação e a segurança da Samsung continuam iguais....

MIUI.eu 本地化

2024-10-21 经测试，HyperOS 1.0 模块依然可用，工作正常。

自己动手构建完全可信任的 Magisk 本地化模块，无需编程。

以下以 Mipay Module 为例

Requirements
- Windows 10+ x64 (wsl support)
- 7z
- vs code

提取应用

下载 Rom

下载 CN 版 ROM 卡刷包。官方不再提供下载地址，使用社区提供的资源

下载 解包工具

从XDA下载 CRB Kitchen 工具，需要提前配置WSL环境，解压下载好的文件 as $CRB_ROOT

解包

使用刚下载的CRB工具，运行 crb.exe -> "Create new project" -> 起个名"$YourProjectName" -> "Extract Rom (Selective)" -> 选择上边下载好的Rom进行解包

提取应用

等待解包完成后，system分区会位于 "$CRB_ROOT\Projects\$YourProjectName\ROM\system" 中

Mipay 模块需要提取的应用有 "Mipay", "NextPay", "TSMClient" 和 "UPTsmService"

构建 Magisk 模块

下载 Magisk Template

从 https://github.com/oasisfeng/magisk-module-template 中 下载/clone Magisk template zip package。不需要解压缩。

Resolve lib softlink

将 "Mipay", "NextPay", "TSMClient" 和 "UPTsmService" 应用（文件夹）从 "$CRB_ROOT\Projects\YourProjectName\ROM\system\system\app" 复制出来。

在每个应用目录中，删除 ota 目录（如有）

在每个应用目录中，将 \lib\arm64 目录下的链接替换为 $CRB_ROOT\Projects\$YourProjectName\ROM\system\system\lib64 中对应的文件

编辑 install.sh

使用 vs code 编辑 install.sh

Mipay 模块需要修改系统的 prop，因此需要设置
PROPFILE=true

MIUI.eu 系统内置了 NextPay 应用，为避免冲突，需要加入替换
REPLACE="
/system/app/NextPay
"

重置权限设置，在脚本最后 加入下述语句
rm -rf /data/misc_de/0/apexdata/com.android.permission/runtime-permissions.xml

编辑 \common\system.prop

加入
ro.se.type=HCE,UICC,eSE

使得设置中 "安全模块位置" 可以选择 "内置安全模块"

打包

由于未知的异常，直接使用 Windows 的 send to zip 会导致 Magisk 无法解压包。

我们通过 7z 打开 template.zip，加入/替换 所需要的文件，删除不需要的文件。

 请勿自行打包

release 中提供已经打包好的模块，Mix4 12.5上通过测试。理论上适用其他机型和附近的版本。但不建议。

branch 中提供对应功能的模板，自行修改即可

刷入

安装 Magisk -> patch boot.img -> 刷入打包好的模块。这里不再赘述。

可以刷入多个模块，不限顺序，并无冲突。

modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: pairipfix
modules.readme:
pairipfix

This LSPosed module bypasses the "Get this app from Play" screen when installing Android apps as an APK instead of from the Google Play Store.

why does this happen?

This is a security measure made by Google called "pairipcore" based on the binary file it runs from libpairpcore.so. Basically, it’s used to prevent abuse during app runtime. It mainly does three things:
- Validate app was installed from Google Play (this is what the module bypasses)
- Validates app signature to prevent resigning/repackaging
- Detects and blocks Frida hooks and debuggers such as GDB

how does it work?

Pairip works by attaching itself to the app resources that it cannot run without it, this is done through rewriting some of the app methods in encrypted? or obfuscated? VM code.
each time a protected method is called a vm code file is loaded from the app storage and executed inside the pairip VM. preventing these calls would simply crash the app, due to missing resources.

alternative solutions

Currently the module dosent work on some apps, i have yet to fully understand why, if this module dosent work for you or app keeps crashing when using it, try this guide.

TikTok地区助手

简体中文 | English

一个仅作用于 TikTok 进程的 LSPosed 模块，用于统一 TikTok 读取到的地区、SIM、运营商、时区和商店地区信号。

当前版本：1.6.0

1.6.0 更新
- 适配 Google Play TikTok 47.7.3 的商店地区接口；保留旧版 Hook 分支，并跳过返回类型不匹配的内部方法。
- 重新设计紧凑设置页，更新中文名称和环球定位图标。设置项整行可点击，设置与地区列表统一滚动，底部两个操作按钮固定并排。
- 底部按钮随文字换行自适应高度，最小触摸高度 48dp；已检查 320dp 宽度下 100%、130%、200% 字号的完整显示和列表滚动。
- 城市/时区使用独立选择框，避免展开后挤占地区列表。
- 新增模块加载提示和只读模式；未检测到加载时禁止修改和应用配置。手动停用模块后需强制停止并重新打开 TikTok，才能停止原进程中的地区覆盖。
- 修复桌面启动误触地区、选择城市后首次操作无响应，以及从关于页返回时国家、城市与配置摘要不一致的问题。
- 区分“待应用”和“已保存”；首次安装的默认预设不再误标为已保存。关于页同步显示最新已测 TikTok 版本及验证范围。

界面预览

以下截图展示模块加载状态的区别，已裁除系统状态栏和导航栏，并将配置摘要匿名化为公开预设示例。

| 模块已加载 | 模块未加载（只读模式） |
| :---: | :---: |
|  |  |
| 可编辑地区和城市，点击“应用并重启TikTok”后应用配置。模块加载状态不等同于地区覆盖开关状态。 | 配置不可修改或应用。若手动停用了模块，需强制停止并重新打开 TikTok，使原有地区覆盖停止。 |

功能
- 支持美国、英国、日本、韩国、新加坡、德国、法国、加拿大和澳大利亚预设。
- 可在国家预设内选择常用城市/时区，例如美国的洛杉矶、纽约、芝加哥和丹佛。
- 同步覆盖 country ISO、MCC/MNC、运营商、SIM、系统地区和商店地区等地区信号。
- 支持 com.zhiliaoapp.musically 和 com.ss.android.ugc.trill 两种 TikTok 包名。
- 在 LSPosed 作用域页面将已安装的 TikTok 标记为“推荐应用”并置顶。
- 可选择跳过 TikTok 冷启动时可关闭的登录引导。
- “应用并重启 TikTok”会保存地区、强制停止 TikTok 并重新打开。
- “清除地区并重启 TikTok”会停用全部地区覆盖，恢复使用真实 SIM 和系统地区。
- 配置会缓存到 TikTok 进程可读取的位置，TikTok地区助手无需常驻后台。
- 设置页右上角提供关于入口，可查看模块版本、已验证的最新 TikTok 版本、源代码、反馈和许可证。

兼容性

最新已测版本为 Google Play 47.7.3。开发验证覆盖信息流、评论、用户主页与作品列表、US/JP 配置保存及冷启动、模块非驻留和清除地区；模块停用、US/JP 覆盖、模块启用但关闭覆盖四组分别连续上滑 7 条，均观察到后续加载和画面变化。

手机号前缀、国外 SIM 恢复及完整交互矩阵未全部验证，连续播放可用不证明推荐内容的地域归属；最终构建未重跑完整播放矩阵。

| 项目 | 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| 最新已测 TikTok 版本 | Google Play 47.7.3（验证范围见上） |
| 当前模块对旧版的回归状态 | 保留旧 Hook 分支，尚未逐版本重新回归 |
| 历史已验证 TikTok 版本 | Google Play 46.1.3、46.5.3、46.6.3（使用当时的模块版本） |
| 已验证包名 | com.zhiliaoapp.musically、com.ss.android.ugc.trill |
| 已验证 Android 版本 | Android 12、Android 16 |
| 最低 Android 版本 | Android 8.1（API 27） |
| 运行环境 | Root + LSPosed/Vector |

模块同时 Hook Android 稳定 Telephony API 和 TikTok 内部地区提供器。TikTok 的内部混淆类可能随版本变化；升级 TikTok 后如果功能异常，需要针对新版本重新适配。

安装

1. 确认设备已具备可用的 Root 和 LSPosed/Vector 环境。
2. 从 Releases 下载并安装 TikTok地区助手 APK。
3. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块，确认已安装的 TikTok 显示为“推荐应用”且已勾选。
4. 打开 TikTok地区助手，选择地区后点击“应用并重启TikTok”。
5. KernelSU/Magisk 首次询问 Root 权限时选择长期允许，否则应用无法强制停止 TikTok。

更新模块后，确认 TikTok 仍在作用域内并已启用，然后强制停止并重新打开 TikTok 即可加载新 Hook；通常不需要重新优化模块。“重新优化”属于 ART dex/profile 优化，仅在目标进程重启后仍疑似未加载新模块时作为排查手段。覆盖安装通常会保留 Root 授权；卸载重装会清除授权，需要重新授予。

使用

切换地区

选择一个地区预设和对应的城市/时区，保持“启用地区覆盖”开启，然后点击“应用并重启 TikTok”。地区变化必须在 TikTok 进程完全重启后才能稳定生效。

恢复真实 SIM 地区

插入目标国家或地区的 SIM 卡时，可以点击“清除地区并重启 TikTok”。模块会写入停用状态并重启 TikTok，不会删除 TikTok 数据；上次选择的预设仍会保留，但不会生效。

跳过启动登录引导

该选项只处理 TikTok 新进程启动后短时间内可关闭的登录引导，不会绕过账号登录、验证或其他访问限制。

权限与安全
- Root 仅用于执行 TikTok 的 am force-stop 和显式 Activity 启动。
- 模块不修改系统地区、系统属性、方向锁定或其他全局设置。
- 地区 Hook 仅安装在受支持的 TikTok 进程中。
- 模块不包含网络权限，不上传配置或设备信息。
- 本项目不会修改或重签 TikTok APK。

已知限制
- 本模块不能替代可用的国际网络环境；TikTok 服务端仍会结合 IP、账号和其他风控信号判断可用性。
- TikTok 更新可能改变内部混淆类，使部分版本专用 Hook 失效。
- 信息流能够加载不代表登录、用户主页和所有地区接口都一定兼容，应在更新 TikTok 后完整回归。
- 点赞、关注等交互受平台多种条件影响；地区覆盖通过不代表交互持久性已完整验证，不能据此判断模块是相关问题的原因。
- 该方案依赖 Root 和 LSPosed，不适用于未 Root 设备。

从源码构建

要求：
- JDK 21
- Android SDK，包含 API 34
- 项目自带的 Gradle Wrapper

调试构建：

.\gradlew.bat clean lintDebug assembleDebug

Linux/macOS：

./gradlew clean lintDebug assembleDebug

发布构建需要本地 keystore.properties。复制 keystore.properties.example，填写自己的签名库信息；不要提交签名库、密码或 keystore.properties。

.\gradlew.bat clean lintRelease assembleRelease

维护现有发行签名时，必须继续使用相同证书，否则无法覆盖安装旧版本。发布 APK 应上传到 Releases，不建议提交到 Git 仓库。

项目结构

app/src/main/java/com/local/tiktokregion/  模块与配置源码
app/src/main/resources/META-INF/xposed/    Xposed 作用域元数据
app/src/main/res/                          Android 资源
app/libs/api-82.jar                        Xposed API 编译依赖
AGENTS.md                                  版本适配与真机验收流程

维护者在适配新 TikTok 版本前应先阅读 AGENTS.md。

modules.name: xh for Android
modules.author: ducaale & Der_Googler
modules.description: Friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests
modules.readme:
xh

xh is a friendly and fast tool for sending HTTP requests. It reimplements as much
as possible of HTTPie's excellent design, with a focus
on improved performance.

Installation

Via MMRL or via the MMRL CLI

mmrl install -y xhhttp

Usage
USAGE:
    xh [OPTIONS]  [--] [REQUEST_ITEM]...
ARGS:
           The request URL, preceded by an optional HTTP method
    ...    Optional key-value pairs to be included in the request
OPTIONS:
    -j, --json                           (default) Serialize data items from the command line as a JSON object
    -f, --form                           Serialize data items from the command line as form fields
    -m, --multipart                      Like --form, but force a multipart/form-data request even without files
        --raw                       Pass raw request data without extra processing
        --pretty                  Controls output processing [possible values: all, colors, format, none]
    -s, --style                   Output coloring style [possible values: auto, solarized, monokai, fruity]
        --response-charset     Override the response encoding for terminal display purposes
        --response-mime       Override the response mime type for coloring and formatting for the terminal
    -p, --print                  String specifying what the output should contain
    -h, --headers                        Print only the response headers. Shortcut for --print=h
    -b, --body                           Print only the response body. Shortcut for --print=b
    -v, --verbose                        Print the whole request as well as the response
        --all                            Show any intermediary requests/responses while following redirects with --follow
    -P, --history-print          The same as --print but applies only to intermediary requests/responses
    -q, --quiet                          Do not print to stdout or stderr
    -S, --stream                         Always stream the response body
    -o, --output                   Save output to FILE instead of stdout
    -d, --download                       Download the body to a file instead of printing it
    -c, --continue                       Resume an interrupted download. Requires --download and --output
        --session                  Create, or reuse and update a session
        --session-read-only        Create or read a session without updating it form the request/response exchange
    -A, --auth-type           Specify the auth mechanism [possible values: basic, bearer, digest]
    -a, --auth      Authenticate as USER with PASS or with TOKEN
        --ignore-netrc                   Do not use credentials from .netrc
        --offline                        Construct HTTP requests without sending them anywhere
        --check-status                   (default) Exit with an error status code if the server replies with an error
    -F, --follow                         Do follow redirects
        --max-redirects             Number of redirects to follow, only respected if follow is set
        --timeout                   Connection timeout of the request
        --proxy            Use a proxy for a protocol. For example: --proxy https:http://proxy.host:8080
        --verify                 If "no", skip SSL verification. If a file path, use it as a CA bundle
        --cert                     Use a client side certificate for SSL
        --cert-key                 A private key file to use with --cert
        --ssl                   Force a particular TLS version [possible values: auto, tls1, tls1.1, tls1.2, tls1.3]
        --native-tls                     Use the system TLS library instead of rustls (if enabled at compile time)
        --https                          Make HTTPS requests if not specified in the URL
        --http-version          HTTP version to use [possible values: 1.0, 1.1, 2]
    -I, --ignore-stdin                   Do not attempt to read stdin
        --curl                           Print a translation to a curl command
        --curl-long                      Use the long versions of curl's flags
        --help                           Print help information
    -V, --version                        Print version information
Each option can be reset with a --no-OPTION argument.

Run xh help for more detailed information.

Request Items

xh uses HTTPie's request-item syntax to set headers, request body, query string, etc.
- =/:= for setting the request body's JSON or form fields (= for strings and := for other JSON types).
- == for adding query strings.
- @ for including files in multipart requests e.g picture@hello.jpg or picture@hello.jpg;type=image/jpeg;filename=goodbye.jpg.
- : for adding or removing headers e.g connection:keep-alive or connection:.
- ; for including headers with empty values e.g header-without-value;.
- =@/:=@ for setting the request body's JSON or form fields from a file (=@ for strings and :=@ for other JSON types).

The request body can also be read from standard input, or from a file using @filename.

Shorthand form for URLs

Similar to HTTPie, specifying the scheme portion of the request URL is optional. xh also supports
omitting localhost from the URL as long it starts with colon plus an optional port number.

xh http://localhost:3000/users # resolves to http://localhost:3000/users
xh localhost:3000/users        # resolves to http://localhost:3000/users
xh :3000/users                 # resolves to http://localhost:3000/users
xh :/users                     # resolves to http://localhost:80/users
xh example.com                 # resolves to http://example.com
xh ://example.com              # resolves to http://example.com

Making HTTPS requests by default

xh will default to HTTPS scheme if the binary name is one of xhs, https, or xhttps. If you have installed xh
via a package manager, both xh and xhs should be available by default. Otherwise, you need to create one like this:

cd /path/to/xh && ln -s ./xh ./xhs...

modules.readme:
VirtualRegion

用一台 Android 设备复现位置、网络和相机测试场景。

Reproduce location, wireless, and camera test scenarios on one Android device.

中文 · English · 下载 / Download 2.1.6

使用地区限制 / Regional Usage Restriction
中文：本模块不允许在中国使用，因此采用 Telegram 群组授权验证。
English: This module is not permitted for use in China. Authorization is therefore verified through the Telegram group.

中文

VirtualRegion 是面向 LSPosed 的 Android 环境模拟工具。测试多语言界面、复现网络条件、演示移动路线，或给相机应用一段可重复的输入，都可以使用保存好的配置。选好场景、应用给目标，再用同一套条件复测。

下载 VirtualRegion 2.1.6 · 查看版本历史 · Telegram 社区

构建场景，保存后随时复用
- 环境与地图　用高德或 Google 地图搜索地点、点选位置、输入 WGS-84 坐标，也可以一键回到真实位置。地图定位超时时可回退到 Android 系统定位。采集设备附近的 Wi-Fi、基站、经典蓝牙和 BLE，或在地图选点生成 Wi-Fi 数据、查询附近基站。设置 GPS 抖动幅度，复现小范围的位置漂移。海拔优先使用实时结果，采用最近有效缓存时会标注来源。
- 管理与迁移　位置和无线数据保存在同一份环境中，支持预览、编辑、重命名、导入、导出、快速应用和多选整理。可导入 Fake Location 的环境文件，或将系统保存的 SSID、加密类型等 Wi-Fi 数据加入环境。地图提供方及基站查询范围可在设置中调整。
- 环境广场　按名称或地区搜索公开与私密环境，先在地图预览位置，再通过分享码或列表导入，也可分享自己的环境。常用场景留在本地，按需要应用。

让位置和连接一起变化
- 独立应用与全局模拟　可为应用单独选择环境或路线，逐项控制 GPS、Wi-Fi、基站和蓝牙，按需启用严格隔离。主空间、双开和工作资料可以分别配置。支持应用搜索、筛选和快捷切换。全局模式适合多个应用共用同一场景，工作台总开关可保留配置并暂停或恢复环境模拟。
- Wi-Fi、基站与蓝牙　自定义 Wi-Fi 扫描列表、连接网络和信号，按信号自动选网，也可手动指定。为测试环境保存不同制式的基站记录，配置蓝牙设备、已绑定设备列表及 BLE 广播内容。需要复现扫描细节时，可编辑原始广播数据和扫描响应。
- 路线模拟　在地图规划起终点，或录制真实路线，保存后可预览。录制可暂停、继续和恢复中断。为指定应用或全局范围选择路线并开始播放，随时暂停、继续、停止、调速、循环，或从当前位置重新规划终点。播放时可同步位置、Wi-Fi、基站和支持的卫星状态。GPS 摇杆可即时控制方向和速度。

把边界场景也纳入测试
- SIM 与地区　按订阅配置实体 SIM 或 eSIM 的测试数据，包括运营商、IMSI、ICCID、号码和信号。无实体 SIM 时可一键创建虚拟配置。语言和时区支持为应用分别设置、按地区模板应用及恢复系统值，可按国家、城市、语言代码或时区查找。
- 应用可见性　按名称或包名搜索，并按 Android 用户空间设置隐藏应用列表，复现普通应用遇到依赖缺失的场景。页面可查看保存与生效状态，随时调整选择。
- 虚拟媒体　把 RTSP、RTMP 网络流或本地视频和照片用作兼容应用的相机输入。可独立控制预览、拍照和麦克风替换，兼容录像链路支持媒体音轨及麦克风混音。支持前后摄像头切换时的画面方向适配，网络流加载时显示占位画面。照片模式保留真实麦克风，媒体不可用时回退到真实输入。

快捷操作和可见的运行状态
- 四个悬浮窗　让测试应用保持前台，直接切换环境、操作 GPS 摇杆、控制路线或切换多段视频和图片。悬浮窗可随时收起，路线控制与管理器保持同步。
- 工作台与外观　通过工作台、环境、应用、路线和更多入口定位常用功能，侧栏提供全部入口。配置编辑支持草稿恢复。支持浅色、深色及跟随系统，管理器可独立切换 18 种界面语言。
- 同步与诊断　在状态页查看系统服务和配置同步进度，同步遇到问题时可重试。日志可筛选、复制和导出，崩溃报告可单独查看。管理器内置更新检查和下载入口。

2.1.6 新功能
- 环境列表输入即搜。单条或批量删除时，清理关联应用配置、解除路线关联并停止对应模拟。
- 在应用管理的全局配置中打开「系统应用生效范围」，勾选要使用全局环境的系统应用。模拟 Wi-Fi 可在手机未连接 Wi-Fi 时向目标应用呈现选定网络的已连接状态。
- 路线播放时可开启全局动作模拟，选择步行、跑步或驾车。加速度计、线性加速度和陀螺仪的波形频率随实时速度变化。播放停止后恢复原始动作数据。该功能适用于兼容设备上的普通传感器事件。
- 改善启动时的设置同步和 Xposed 兼容性。

快速上手

1. 在已 Root、支持 arm64-v8a 或 armeabi-v7a 的 Android 11 及以上设备上安装 APK，使用支持 Modern Xposed API 102 的框架启用模块。
2. 按模块推荐设置系统作用域。需要 SIM、语言与时区或虚拟媒体时，把相关目标应用加入 LSPosed 作用域。
3. 重启设备，打开 VirtualRegion 并按提示完成授权。
4. 保存一个环境或路线，选择目标，应用后在运行状态页确认配置已同步。对使用缓存的功能，重新打开目标应用以读取新配置。

具体支持范围取决于 Android 版本、厂商 ROM 及应用使用的接口。请在自有设备或明确授权的测试环境中使用。

English

VirtualRegion is an Android environment simulation tool for LSPosed. Test localized interfaces, reproduce wireless conditions, demonstrate a route, or feed a repeatable clip to a camera app. Save the setup, apply it to your test targets, and reuse it on the next run.

Download VirtualRegion 2.1.6 · Release history · Telegram community

Build a scenario once and reuse it
- Environments and maps. Search AMap or Google Maps, pick a location, enter WGS-84 coordinates, or return to the real location. Android location can provide a fallback on map location timeouts. Capture nearby Wi-Fi, cell, classic Bluetooth, and BLE data, or use a map selection to generate Wi-Fi entries and look up nearby cells. Adjust natural GPS drift. Altitude capture uses a live reading when available and labels a recent cached reading when used.
- Manage and move profiles. Keep location and wireless data in one saved environment. Preview, edit, rename, import, export, apply quickly, or select multiple environments for cleanup. Bring over Fake Location exports or add SSIDs and security types from saved system Wi-Fi networks. Choose the map provider and adjust the cell lookup radius in Settings.
- Environment Plaza. Search public and private environments by name or region, preview the location on a map, import from the list or with a share code, and share your own profiles. Keep useful profiles on the device until you need them.

Move the location and wireless scene together
- Per-app and global simulation. Choose an environment or route for each app, control GPS, Wi-Fi, cell, and Bluetooth individually, and enable strict isolation as needed. Configure primary, cloned, and work-profile instances separately. Search and filter apps to change a setup quickly. Use global mode for a shared scenario. The home switch pauses or resumes environment simulation while keeping your settings.
- Wi-Fi, cellular, and Bluetooth. Set the Wi-Fi list, connection, and signal. Pick the connection by strength or choose it manually. Save cell records by radio technology, configure Bluetooth devices and bonded lists, and edit BLE advertisement and scan-response data.
- Route playback. Plan a route with map endpoints or record real movement and preview the saved route. Recordings support pause, resume, and recovery. Play a route for selected apps or globally. Pause, resume, stop, adjust the speed, loop, or plan a new destination from the current position. Playback can coordinate location, Wi-Fi, cells, and supported satellite status. Use the GPS joystick for quick direction and speed changes.

Cover the edge cases of app testing
- SIM and regions. Configure test data for individual physical SIM or eSIM subscriptions, including carrier, IMSI, ICCID, number, and signal. Create a virtual profile on devices without a SIM. Set each app’s language and time zone independently, choose a region template, or restore system defaults. Search by country, city, language code, or zone.
- App visibility. Search by app or package name and manage hidden lists by Android user. Check how ordinary apps behave when a dependency appears unavailable. Review save and delivery status and adjust the selection when needed.
- Virtual Media. Use RTSP or RTMP streams, local videos, or photos as camera input. Control preview, photo capture, and microphone replacement separately. Compatible recording paths can use media audio or mix in the microphone...

modules.name: BackStyleMod
modules.author: sakurakingfifth-debug
modules.description: LSPosed 模块：把侧滑返回箭头背后的水滴换成竖向胶囊（ColorOS / OPPO / OnePlus）
modules.readme:
返回样式 · BackStyleMod

我懒，所以README.md是大肥鱼写的

一个 LSPosed 模块：把侧滑返回那个箭头背后的「水滴」换成竖向胶囊，可以调尺寸、透明度、背景模糊，长按还能呼出智能侧边栏。

An LSPosed module that replaces the gesture-back "teardrop" behind the arrow with a vertical capsule (shape, size, opacity, blurred backdrop, long-press → smart sidebar).

功能
- 胶囊尺寸 —— 上下高度 150%~700%、左右宽度 30%~120%，实时生效
- 不透明度 —— 0%~100%
- 背景模糊 —— 30~80px 真实高斯模糊，走系统截屏 + 可分离方框卷积；暗色模式自动加 2dp 描边
- 长滑呼出智能侧边栏 —— 侧滑按住超过设定时长（0~15000ms 滑块，或手填到 3600000ms）后呼出 ColorOS 智能侧边栏，自动跟随左右侧
- 深色/浅色自适应 —— 按背景亮度自动反色图标
- PUI 风格设置页，简中 / 繁中 / 英 / 日 / 韩 五种语言

支持范围

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 系统 | ColorOS / OPPO / OnePlus（com.oplus.systemui 的 SideGestureNavView），Android 14+ |
| AOSP 机型 | 有 com.android.systemui.navigationbar.gestural.BackPanel 的走备用方案（只改椭圆尺寸） |
| 框架 | LSPosed，作用域勾选「系统界面 (com.android.systemui)」 |
| 权限 | root（设置项通过 su -c settings put global 写入） |

已在 OnePlus / OPPO 的 ColorOS 15~17 上验证；其它 ROM 只要类名没改大概率也能用，改了就改常量：

MainHook.OPLUS_VIEW    com.oplus.systemui.navigationbar.gesture.sidegesture.view.SideGestureNavView
MainHook.OPLUS_CALC    com.oplus.systemui.navigationbar.gesture.sidegesture.view.animcalculator.BaseBezierCalculator

构建

export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jbr      # 需要 JDK 17+，实测 JDK 25
./gradlew assembleRelease
产物：app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

工具链：AGP 9.2.1 / Gradle 9.6 / compileSdk 37 / minSdk 34。
仓库里带了 app/libs/api-82.jar（Xposed API）和 pui-release.aar（设置页用的设计系统），所以离线也能编。

安装

1. 装 APK，在 LSPosed 里启用模块并勾选「系统界面」
2. 重启系统界面（设置页底部有「强制停止系统界面」按钮，或 killall com.android.systemui）
3. 打开 App 调参数，滑一下返回即可看到效果
注意：装完新版本必须重启一次系统界面，LSPosed 只在进程启动时加载模块。App 检测到版本变化会提示。

设置项（Settings.Global）

| key | 含义 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| backstyle_pill_height | 胶囊高度倍率（×箭头边长） | 3.6 |
| backstyle_pill_width | 胶囊宽高比 | 0.68 |
| backstyle_pill_alpha | 不透明度百分比 | 100 |
| backstyle_pill_blur_on | 背景模糊开关 | 1 |
| backstyle_pill_blur | 模糊半径 px（30~80） | 30 |
| backstyle_pill_sidebar | 长滑呼出侧边栏开关 | 1 |
| backstyle_pill_sidebar_ms | 长滑时长 ms（0 = 不呼出） | 5000 |
| backstyle_pill_sidebar_custom | 是否使用手填时长（滑块置灰） | 0 |

改完不用重启，hook 端每秒读一次。

实现要点
- 不再 hook BaseBezierCalculator.getPath() —— 新版系统界面把它改成了三行指令的 public final getter，会被 ART 内联进 onDraw，hook 收不到回调（6.0 就是这么静默失效的）。现在在 SideGestureNavView.onDraw 里反射拿同一个 Path 对象、computeBounds 记宽度、reset()，帧帧都走这条路。
- 模糊：IWindowManager.captureDisplay(int, CaptureArgs, ScreenCaptureListener)（3 参数）+ HokoBlur 式可分离方框卷积，截完图把胶囊自身那块抹掉避免鬼影；预测性返回期间改用透传。
- 位置：直接取箭头的 backIconMatrix，手势位移/缩放/左右方向全跟着系统走，不自己算坐标。
- 禁止在 MainHook 的静态字段里碰 Handler / Looper / Context —— 模块类加载时 SystemUI 主线程还没准备好，会在类初始化阶段直接炸掉整个模块。

更新日志

6.5
- 对话框改用色块按钮（取消 / 确定 / 返回拖动滑块）

6.4
- 修复长滑时长改不动：写入同时兼容旧的「秒」键；模块版本变化时提示重启系统界面；hook 打印实际读到的时长

6.3 / 6.2
- 长滑时长单位改成毫秒，滑块 0~15000ms，新增手填（上限 3600000ms），手填后滑块置灰

6.1
- 修复在系统界面 17.99.02 上完全不生效（getPath 被内联）

6.0
- 五语言、自适应图标、暗色描边、强制停止系统界面

3.x ~ 5.x
- 胶囊几何、出现/消失动画、截屏模糊、长滑侧边栏、自动反色

License

MIT

An LSPosed module for the international Bilibili app (com.bilibili.app.in, tested against 6.3.0 / 6.4.0 / 6.5.0 / 6.6.0 / 6.7.1 / 6.8.0 / 6.9.0).

功能一览 / Features

| 功能 Feature | 说明 Description | 默认 Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 评论/主页 IP 属地 IP location | 把请求身份改写为国内版客户端，服务端返回 location 字段，评论区「IP属地：」与主页 IP 标签随之显示 / Rewrite request identity to the domestic client so the server returns the location field (comment-area "IP location" and profile IP tag) | 开 on |
| 身份声明范围 Identity scope | 评论区限定：仅评论/字幕请求声明国内版身份，其余请求保持国际版；或全局（旧行为）/ Scoped: declare the domestic identity for comment & subtitle requests only; or global (legacy behavior) | 评论区限定 scoped |
| 解码顺位 Decoder preference | AV1 > HEVC > H264 自动顺位，或锁定某一种（含锁定 H264 兜底档），或关闭（不干预）；自动顺位按设备硬解能力过滤请求位（先清后设，宿主已置的位也会被移除），不能硬解的编码不下发（只过滤请求，不替换解码）/ AV1 > HEVC > H264 auto preference, or lock one (incl. lock H264 fallback) or off (untouched); auto mode explicitly clears + re-sets request bits by hw-decode capability (bits the host already set are also removed) so undecodable codecs aren't delivered (filter only, no substitution) | 自动 auto |

modules.name: EdgeX
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: EdgeX
modules.readme:
EdgeX

English | 中文

English

An Xposed module for Microsoft Edge on Android, designed to enhance your browsing experience with UI tweaks and functional improvements.

Features
- Hide Status Bar: Allows the webpage to display in the status bar area for a more immersive experience.
- Remove Address Bar Bottom Padding: Optimizes the bottom spacing of the address bar.
- Long press Overflow to scroll to top: Long press the "More" (overflow) button to quickly scroll to the top of the page.
- Long press New Tab to load in-place: Long press the "New Tab" button to load the target URL in the current tab instead of creating a new one.
- Set New Tab Page URL: Customize the URL for your new tab page.
- Support external downloads: Use the system downloader, third-party apps, or copy the link.
- Clear browsing data on exit: Optionally, also close all tabs, time range, and data types to clear.
- Force Open in External Edge Browser: When Edge is set as your default browser, many apps open links in a restricted, simplified Edge window inside the app. Enabling this feature forces links to break out of the current app and open in the standalone Edge browser, allowing you to use its full features.
- Open the hidden .crx file installation screen

Installation

1. Install the EdgeX APK.
2. Enable the module in LSPosed (or your preferred Xposed manager).
3. Ensure Microsoft Edge (com.microsoft.emmx) is selected in the scope.
4. Open EdgeX and enable the desired features.
5. Restart Microsoft Edge.

Tips

The Set New Tab Page URL feature allows you to use "New Tab" extensions on your mobile device:

1. Install any New Tab extension, such as Rainbow Tab.
2. Visit Edge-Extensions
3. Search for and navigate to the desired extension's page.
4. Extract the extension ID from the address bar (a string of letters after the trailing /).
5. Open EdgeX and set the New Tab Page URL to extension://[Extension ID]/[Entry File] . For example: extension://gjkmaoeddnpkgljohocjeejoofijgoib/index.html
Pretty please, give EdgeX a Star!

中文

一个为安卓端 Microsoft Edge 浏览器设计的 Xposed 模块，旨在通过 UI 调整和功能改进来增强您的浏览体验。

功能特性
- 隐藏状态栏：允许网页显示在状态栏区域，提供更沉浸的浏览体验。
- 移除地址栏底边距：优化地址栏底部的间距。
- 长按更多按钮回顶部：长按“更多”按钮即可快速滚动到页面顶部。
- 长按新标签页按钮原地加载：长按“新标签页”按钮在当前标签页中加载，而不是新建标签页。
- 设置新标签页 URL：自定义新标签页的起始地址。
- 支持外部下载：调用系统下载器、第三方应用或者复制链接。
- 退出时清除浏览数据：可选同时关闭所有标签页、时间范围和要清除的数据类型。
- 强制跳转外部 Edge 浏览器：当 Edge 被设置为默认浏览器后，很多应用在点击链接时，会在应用内部弹出一个受限的简易 Edge 网页窗口。开启此功能后，会强制跳出应用并交由外部 Edge 浏览器打开，让你能使用完整的 Edge 浏览器功能。
- 打开隐藏的.crx文件安装界面

安装步骤

1. 安装 EdgeX 应用。
2. 在 LSPosed（或您使用的 Xposed 管理器）中启用本模块。
3. 确保作用域已勾选 Microsoft Edge (com.microsoft.emmx)。
4. 打开 EdgeX ，启用相关功能。
5. 强制停止并重新打开 Microsoft Edge。

小技巧

设置新标签页 URL 功能可以实现在手机端使用新标签页类的扩展哦：

1. 安装任意新标签页扩展，例如 Rainbow Tab - 彩虹标签页。
2. 访问 Edge-Extensions
3. 搜索并点击进入该新标签页扩展。
4. 在地址栏提取扩展ID（末尾 / 之后的一串字母）。
5. 打开 EdgeX ，设置新标签页 URL 为 extension://[扩展ID]/[扩展入口文件] ，例如 extension://gjkmaoeddnpkgljohocjeejoofijgoib/index.html
求求你了，给个 Star 吧 EdgeX

🪶 EvilFont

Transform your Android UI with EvilFont. This systemless module lets you interactively choose from a beautiful collection of Arabic/Persian typefaces and install high-definition Apple Emojis. Want just the font? Just the emoji? Or both? The choice is entirely yours. Designed for safety and flexibility, EvilFont delivers a premium experience without ever modifying your /system partition.

✨ Features
- ⚙️ Interactive Installer: Use your device's volume keys to navigate and select your desired font and emoji style during the installation process.
- 🧩 Modular Selection: You're in full control. Choose to install only a font, only the emoji pack, or combine both for a complete UI makeover.
- 🎨 Curated Font Library: Choose from over a dozen beautiful and open-source Arabic/Persian fonts.
- 🤩 Multiple Emoji Versions: Now supporting iOS 18.4 and macOS 26 emoji styles. Select the one that suits you best.
- 🛡️ Systemless: All customizations are applied without touching your /system partition, keeping SafetyNet/Play Integrity happy.
- ⚡ Lightweight: Designed to have no noticeable impact on system performance.
- 🫧 Compatibility: Works on most AOSP and custom-skinned Android versions.

⚙️ How It Works

EvilFont is installed as a systemless root module. During installation, the interactive installer lets you choose which resources should be applied using the device's volume keys.

The available resources are:
- Arabic & Persian Fonts: A collection of open-source typefaces with different styles.
- Apple Emoji: Emoji packs based on iOS 18.4 and macOS 26.

You can install a font, an emoji pack, or both at the same time. The selected resources are applied through the module environment without modifying the original /system partition.

To change the selection later, simply reinstall the module and choose the desired resources again.

modules.name: FakePers
modules.author: pwh-pwh
modules.description: 一款写给测试者与隐私偏好者的 LSPosed 权限伪装模块
modules.readme:
FakePers

权限可以假装给了 · 隐私不必真的交出

一款写给测试者与隐私偏好者的 LSPosed 权限伪装模块

故事从那句「请允许访问」说起

打开一个 App，屏幕中央弹出熟悉的对话框：
需要访问通讯录 / 文件 / 位置……

点「允许」，生活得以继续；点「拒绝」，功能大门常常立刻合上。
很多时候你并不想把真实通讯录、相册与轨迹交给对方——你只想顺利走过那道门。

系统里的权限检查，本质上是在回答一个问题：
「你有没有被允许？」

FakePers 想做的，不是在系统设置里真的打开那把锁，
而是在目标 App 耳边轻轻说一声：
「可以。但房间里什么也没有。」

检查层返回「已授权」，敏感数据侧可选返回空结果——
App 以为自己通过了门禁，却读不到你的真名、真号、真照片。
像给好奇心穿上一层雾：路可以走，隐私仍留在雾后。

名字 FakePers，来自 *Fake Permissions* 的缩写——
假的是「许可的姿态」，真的是「对边界的尊重」。

它能做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 权限检查伪装 | checkSelfPermission / PackageManager.checkPermission 等返回已授予 |
| 请求流程跟进 | 运行时 requestPermissions 与常见 Activity Result 合约结果可伪装为同意 |
| 按应用细控 | 每个包独立开关；权限组分项勾选，不搞「一刀切」 |
| 空数据桩 | 通讯录 / 短信 / 通话记录 / 日历 / 媒体库查询可返回空 Cursor |
| 电话标识弱化 | 启用电话组时，号码 / 设备标识类 getter 可返回空串 |
| 共享配置 | 管理端写入，目标进程通过 YukiHookPrefs 读取，日常不必为改配置去 Root |

权限组一览

| 组 | 覆盖的常见意图 |
|----|----------------|
| 存储 / 媒体 | 读写存储、分区媒体权限 |
| 通讯录 | 读写信录、账号 |
| 电话 | 电话状态、号码、拨打相关 |
| 短信 | 收发读短信 |
| 通话记录 | 通话历史 |
| 日历 | 读写日程 |
| 位置 | 精粗定位与后台定位 |
| 相机 / 麦克风 | 成像与录音权限声明 |
| 传感器 | 体感、活动识别 |
| 附近设备 | 蓝牙扫描连接、附近 Wi‑Fi 等 |
作用域仍由你在 LSPosed 里亲手勾选。
FakePers 不替框架做决定——诚实，比「一键全开」更重要。

它不做什么

写清楚边界，比夸大功能更重要。
- 不会在系统层真实授权（设置里权限页可能仍显示未授予）
- 不会 Hook AppOps / system_server 做深层系统改造
- 不会伪造相机画面、麦克风音频或真实轨迹数据
  （位置类若需深度模拟，可搭配 Locus 等模块）
- 绕不过服务端二次校验「是否真授权」的 App——那是另一层信任模型

FakePers 的哲学是：骗过门卫的点头，不必交出房间的钥匙。

开始使用

1. 安装模块

从 Releases 下载 FakePers-*.apk，或自行编译：

./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
产物：app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

2. 在 LSPosed 中启用

1. 打开 LSPosed → 模块 → 启用 FakePers
2. 勾选需要伪装的目标应用（作用域）
3. 按提示重启相关作用域（或重启目标 App）

3. 在 FakePers 里写好「剧本」

| 步骤 | 操作 |
|------|------|
| ① | 打开 状态 页，确认模块已激活，打开 总开关 |
| ② | 进入 应用，搜索并点开目标包名 |
| ③ | 启用伪装 → 勾选权限组 → 按需打开 空数据桩 → 保存 |
| ④ | 强制停止并重新打开目标 App，让配置生效 |

管理端底部三页：状态 · 应用 · 关于——从总览到细控，再到边界说明。

技术栈

Kotlin 2.x · Jetpack Compose · Material 3
YukiHookAPI + KavaRef · LSPosed / Xposed API 82
minSdk 26 · compile / targetSdk 35

工程骨架与配置同步思路对齐同作者的 Locus 模块：
管理端与 Hook 侧共享一份 prefs，职责分离、便于维护。

发布（GitHub Actions）

推送版本标签即可自动构建 APK 并挂到 Release：

git tag v0.1.0
git push origin v0.1.0

| 项 | 说明 |
|----|------|
| 工作流 | .github/workflows/release.yml |
| 产物名 | FakePers-.apk（assembleRelease，便于侧载的 debug 签名） |
| 可选 Secret | DEBUG_KEYSTORE_BASE64：固定签名，方便覆盖安装 |

main 与 PR 会跑轻量 CI（单测 + debug 构建），避免坏掉的代码悄悄上岛。

写在最后

权限对话框从来不只是 UI 组件——它是 App 与人之间的一份临时契约。
有些契约你愿意签；有些你只想礼貌地点头，却把真正的故事留在本地。

FakePers 是给后者的一把小工具：
在合法、自有设备与授权测试场景里，让「功能可走通」与「数据可少交」多一点点共存空间。
请仅在你有权操作的设备与环境中使用。
尊重他人隐私，也保护好自己的边界。

Fake Permissions · 假的是许可 · 真的是边界

真机测试台（testapp）

仓库内附带模块 :testapp（包名 com.pwh.fakepers.testapp），用于在真机上验证 FakePers：

| 页 | 作用 |
|----|------|
| 说明 | 自测步骤与判定标准 |
| 检查 | 多 API 权限检查对比 |
| 请求 | 全量 / 按组请求权限 |
| 读数据 | Contacts / SMS / CallLog / Media / Telephony 探测 |

./gradlew :testapp:assembleDebug
APK: testapp/build/outputs/apk/debug/testapp-debug.apk
adb install -r testapp/build/outputs/apk/debug/testapp-debug.apk

LSPosed 作用域勾选 FakePers 测试台，在 FakePers 管理端为本包启用对应权限组即可。

modules.description: HideRecentTask / 隐藏最近任务
modules.readme:
Hide App from Recent Task List

!!!LSPosed IS REQUIRED TO USE THIS MODULE!!!

你需要先安装 LSPosed 才能使用这个模块！！！

Simple module to hide apps from the recent task list, or keep them visible while hiding their preview snapshots.

Designed with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and Material Design 3. Can also serve as a template for any Xposed module with an application selection list.

How to use
Tested on: Android 10 ~ 16.

1. Select System framework (package name may be android or system or empty, see this) in module scope and activate the module
2. Force stop the module
3. Set a mode for each app in module settings: /, Hide task, or Hide preview (if the package list is not shown, you can manually import / export settings to edit config)
4. Reboot the device (you MUST reboot the device after modifying the list or the hide mode, otherwise the changes will not take effect)
5. If you need multi-user support, install this module only in main user, and use Shizuku to get app info from other users.

Module Scope
- android

Project URL

Home URL:

Xposed Modules Repo URL:

Technical Details

UI: Material Design 3 + Jetpack Compose + Kotlin.

Hook: Hook com.android.server.wm.RecentTasks.isVisibleRecentTask(com.android.server.wm.Task) and com.android.server.wm.RecentTasks.isVisibleRecentTask(com.android.server.wm.Task, boolean) for apps set to Hide task. The two-arg overload is used directly by Vivo and some other OEM ROMs.

For apps set to Hide preview, hook com.android.server.wm.TaskSnapshotController.getSnapshotMode(com.android.server.wm.Task), com.android.server.wm.AbsAppSnapshotController.getSnapshotMode(com.android.server.wm.Task) (parent class on some ROMs), and com.android.server.wm.ActivityRecord.shouldUseAppThemeSnapshot() so selected apps use an app-theme task snapshot instead of a real screenshot. com.android.server.wm.Task.getSnapshot(boolean, boolean) is also hooked to avoid returning previously cached real snapshots.

Please open an issue here. Provide your Android version, /system/framework/framework.jar, /system/framework/services.jar and all /system/framework/framework{a number here}.jar if they exist.

PR for refactoring is also appreciated.

License

Apache-2.0 License or MIT License are fine.

Thanks

Why?

出于隐私或便捷原因，有些时候我们总是想隐藏一些应用。

CrDroid 内置了这个功能，这是好的，然而并不是所有人都在用 CrDroid。

而且，国内的 ROM 的“最近任务列表”里划掉一个卡片，就等于杀死这个应用，这太蠢了！你也不想你的 Clash For Android 编辑完配置就挂了吧？

Thanox 等一些应用也有这个功能，但只为了这个功能氪金并装一个闭源应用，怎么看都很怪。于是我买了 Thanox 订阅，然后写完这个模块后又卖了。

modules.name: LMK Controller
modules.author: ferrdishx
modules.description: Total control over Low Memory Killer. Modes: Gamer, Stable, and Normal.
modules.readme:
LMK Controller

  Full control over Android's Low Memory Killer.
  Adaptive kernel detection, three tuning profiles, clean WebUI, automatic boot persistence.

Overview

The Low Memory Killer is the kernel subsystem responsible for freeing RAM by terminating background processes when memory runs low. Android exposes this through two distinct mechanisms depending on the kernel version.

Classic LMK is a kernel driver controlled via /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/minfree. Six thresholds defined in pages determine at which memory levels each process priority class gets killed. This is the standard path on kernels 4.9 and older.

LMKD is a userspace daemon that handles memory kills outside the kernel. On modern kernels it operates in PSI mode, reacting to memory pressure stall events with millisecond precision via /proc/pressure/memory. On older kernels without PSI it falls back to a simpler threshold model.

Most OEMs ship conservative defaults that cause unnecessary app reloads, stuttering on app switches and degraded multitasking. LMK Controller lets you tune the relevant parameters for your kernel type through a single interface, with settings that survive every reboot automatically.

Kernel Detection

At boot the module identifies your kernel type and applies the correct tuning strategy. No manual configuration is required.

| Kernel Type | Detection Condition | Applied Strategy |
|---|---|---|
| classic_lmk | /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/minfree exists | Writes minfree thresholds directly to the kernel node |
| psi_lmkd | /proc/pressure/memory exists | Sets ro.lmk.* PSI props and starts a dynamic swappiness monitor |
| legacy_lmkd | Neither node found | Sets ro.lmk.* props without PSI and reinitialises lmkd |

Profiles

Classic LMK — minfree thresholds

Values are in pages. One page equals approximately 4 KB. Thresholds scale with device RAM automatically: separate value sets are applied for devices under 3 GB, between 3 GB and 5 GB, and above 5 GB.

| Profile | Values (pages) | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| ⚡ Performance | 1024, 2048, 4096, 6144, 8192, 10240 | Gaming and maximum RAM availability for the foreground app |
| 🌿 Stability | 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192, 12288, 16384 | Daily use and balanced multitasking |
| 🔵 Default | 4096, 5120, 6144, 7168, 8192, 9216 | Near-stock behaviour, close to AOSP defaults |

PSI LMKD — key properties

| Property | Performance | Stability | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| psi_partial_stall_ms | 50 | 70 | 100 |
| psi_complete_stall_ms | 400 | 500 | 700 |
| kill_heaviest_task | true | false | true |
| thrashing_limit | 30 | 100 | 100 |
| swap_util_max | 80 | 90 | 95 |
| ro.lmk.low | 0 | 1001 | 1001 |
| ro.lmk.medium | 200 | 900 | 800 |
| ro.lmk.critical | 100 | 800 | 0 |

VM and ZRAM

| Parameter | Performance | Stability | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| vm.swappiness | 60 | 100 | 130 |
| vm.dirty_ratio | 20 | 30 | 40 |
| vm.dirty_background_ratio | 5 | 10 | 15 |
| vm.vfs_cache_pressure | 200 | 100 | 80 |
| ZRAM compression | lz4 | zstd | zstd |

On devices with less than 3 GB of RAM, swappiness is automatically increased by 20 and dirty_background_ratio is reduced to a minimum of 2 to compensate for the smaller memory pool.

In Stability and Default profiles a background PSI monitor runs every 60 seconds and adjusts swappiness dynamically based on current memory pressure. Performance mode disables this monitor to eliminate any scheduling overhead.

Features
- 🌐 Clean WebUI accessible via MMRL
- 🔁 Settings persist across every reboot via service.d
- 🧠 Automatic kernel type detection at boot
- 📊 Live RAM and ZRAM dashboard with kill log (logcat | grep lmkd)
- 🎯 Whitelist system: protect chosen apps from being killed (oom_score_adj -1000), validated against real installed packages via pm path
- 💾 Snapshot on install / full restore on uninstall — original system values are captured before any change and reverted automatically when the module is removed
- 📈 RAM-aware scaling across all profiles, including PSI LMKD (previously Classic LMK only)
- 🔄 Reset to Stock button in the WebUI for an instant manual revert
- 📊 Dynamic swappiness monitor driven by real-time PSI readings
- 🗜️ ZRAM compression algorithm selection per profile
- 📜 Detailed boot log at /data/adb/lmk_controller/service.log
- 🧹 Clean uninstall with automatic boot service removal
- ⚠️ Compatibility check during installation

Requirements
- Android 8.0 or higher
- Magisk 20.4+ or KernelSU
- KSU WebUI or any compatible module manager

Installation

1. Download the latest .zip from Releases
2. Flash via MMRL, Magisk or KernelSU
3. Reboot

The module installs a persistent boot service at /data/adb/service.d/lmk_controller.sh. No manual steps are required.

Usage

1. Open MMRL and navigate to LMK Controller
2. Select a profile
3. Tap Apply Settings

The selected profile is saved to /data/adb/modules/lmk_controller_feerd/lmk_mode and reapplied automatically on every subsequent boot.

Verifying

After rebooting, the following commands confirm that the configuration was applied correctly.

cat /data/adb/lmk_controller/service.log

cat /data/adb/modules/lmk_controller_feerd/lmk_mode

cat /sys/module/lowmemorykiller/parameters/minfree

getprop ro.lmk.low
getprop ro.lmk.medium
getprop ro.lmk.critical
getprop ro.lmk.psi_partial_stall_ms

cat /proc/sys/vm/swappiness

How Boot Persistence Works

The module installs a script into /data/adb/service.d/, a directory that Magisk executes on every boot regardless of module state. At boot the script sources common/psi_lmk.sh, detects the kernel type, reads the saved profile from lmk_mode, and applies the full configuration covering minfree thresholds or ro.lmk.* props, VM parameters and ZRAM compression.

For PSI LMKD, after applying props the script signals lmkd to reinitialise via lmkd.reinit, falls back to SIGHUP, and as a last resort performs a stop/start cycle. This avoids requiring a second reboot for property changes to take effect....
modules.changelog:
Patch release fixing a critical whitelist bug reported on Reddit.

Bug: whitelist entries were saved correctly to disk, but only the last package added would display after closing and reopening the WebUI. Removing that displayed entry would then wipe every other saved package too.

Root cause: the whitelist was being loaded with a single cat command, and large command output was getting truncated by the KernelSU Next exec bridge, keeping only the last line.

Fix: whitelist is now loaded line by line using wc and sed instead of reading the whole file in one call, avoiding the truncation entirely.

If you were affected, just reopen the WebUI after updating and re add any packages you're not sure got kept, the whitelist file itself was never actually corrupted, only the display was wrong.

modules.name: lsposed-modules-manager
modules.author: rushiranpise
modules.description: An Android app for finding, installing and updating Xposed/Lsposed modules.
modules.readme:
Modules Manager 📦

An Android app for finding, installing and updating Xposed/Lsposed modules.
- Package: io.github.rushiranpise.modulesmanager
- Android 8.1 (API 26) and newer
- Versions up to 2.0.0 used com.rushi.modulesmanager and update separately.
- ⬇️ Latest release

What's new in 2.3
- Save release APKs without installing them on Android 10+, with progress in the app and notification and a Cancel action in both places.
- Module cards and detail pages show each module's target libxposed API level, or Legacy for older modules.
- Tablet rail switching from a detail page now returns to the selected tab root instead of restoring the old detail page.
- Notification permission is requested when the first transfer starts, not on launch, and can be enabled later from Settings.
- Batch update and manual save transfers now run in the foreground service, so they keep going when the app is backgrounded.
- Duplicate update starts are blocked, delegated installs no longer hold up a batch, and the manager's own update is installed last.

Features
- Browse over 2,000 module repositories from the daily xposed-modules index.
- Search, sort by name, last update, stars, recently added or number of sources, and filter by updates, installed or not installed.
- See the installed version next to an available update. Each update row shows its own download percentage and can be cancelled without stopping the rest of the batch.
- Pause and resume a module download, or let it retry after a dropped connection and continue from the bytes already on disk. Settings can limit the app to 1 to 5 concurrent downloads.
- Save a release APK without installing it on Android 10+, with progress in the app and notification and a Cancel action in both places. Saved files go to Download/ModulesManager.
- Open a module to read its README, its full GitHub release history and target apps.
- Every module page links to the rest of that developer's modules, and the card menu offers the same action.
- Card menus can copy the package name, open the repository's releases list or show the developer page.
- The module page shows the package, author, star and fork counts, release date and version pills, with an Uninstall action for installed modules.
- Module cards and detail pages show the target libxposed API level, or Legacy for older modules.
- Long card descriptions expand with Read more; AMOLED mode gives cards, the navigation pill and the download banner a black background and a hairline outline.
- The Releases tab lists every published release, stable and pre-release, with their APKs, and renders and translates release notes.
- Translate module descriptions, READMEs and release notes, manually or automatically.
- Install with the system installer, a PackageInstaller session, Shizuku, or root for silent installs. Installs handed to an external installer are remembered and confirmed on the next scan. Uninstall follows the same installer choice.
- On HyperOS, ColorOS and similar ROMs, grant the installed-apps permission when prompted so every module can be detected.
- When a release ships several equally suitable APKs, a chooser reads the ABI, vendor OS, Android version and libxposed API level, and remembers the choice for later releases.
- Override the source repository of a module when the index points at a fork. The picker lists the alternate repositories from the index and marks the current one.
- Cards show a small sources badge when the index lists more than one repository for the package.
- Long press an installed module to uninstall it through the selected installer.
- The Installed tab lists every installed module, including ones missing from the index. Its filters are All, Updates, Skipped and Untracked.
- On tablets, switching rail tabs from a module or developer page returns to the selected tab instead of restoring the previous detail page.
- Star modules to keep them in the Library, together with recently viewed modules and skipped or ignored updates.
- Floating refresh, sort and scroll-to-top actions, a navigation rail on tablets, the phone navigation in landscape on phones, and package events that keep the installed list current.
- Light, dark and system themes, Material You colors, AMOLED black and GitHub-style identicons.
- Diagnostics in Settings shows the build commit, device, module counts and cache sizes, with copy, share and clear actions.

The app also declares itself as a self-scoped Xposed module. It hooks nothing; the declaration lets LSPosed Manager install and update the app. Its scope list is intentionally the app itself, so LSPosed Manager shows no other targets.

Translation

Translation goes through Google's public translate endpoint, so no API key or account is needed. The text leaves the device, and the endpoint needs a working network connection.
- Translate automatically in Settings translates module descriptions when the list loads, the README when a module is opened, and release notes when the Releases tab opens.
- Language picks the target language, or keeps the device language.
- Requests are batched, Google hosts are tried in turn if one fails, and translations are cached per language.
- README and release-note translation rewrites only prose. Markdown, links, images, code blocks and inline code keep their exact syntax.
- Rows whose description is already in the target language hide the translate icon.

Build

Requires JDK 21 and Android SDK 37.

./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest

Signed release APKs are built by the release workflow when a v* tag is pushed. One APK covers every CPU architecture.

Data

The app reads the daily index from:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rushiranpise/xposed-modules/main/data/repos.json

Each entry provides the package, summary, target scope and latest APK release...
modules.changelog:
Features
- Newest release across sources: modules are checked in both their source repository and mirror, and the newest release is selected automatically.
- Source labels: the source picker marks the selected repository as Current and alternate repositories as Fallback.
- Mirror sources: mirror repositories are counted as module sources, including Xposed-Modules-Repo entries.

Fixes
- Release history: source and mirror release histories are merged, so a newer release is not hidden when one repository is stale.
- Build hash tags: release tags such as 1.6.3-ceca486e now match the installed build code.

Downloads
One APK works on every phone and emulator.
- ModulesManager-v2.3.1-release.apk: signed release build
- ModulesManager-v2.3.1-debug.apk: debug build

modules.name: MeiWindow
modules.author: Leaf-lsgtky
modules.description: 魅窗 (MeiWindow) - 在 Xiaomi HyperOS 上复刻 Flyme 经典屏幕边角内滑小窗呼出方式的 LSPosed 模块
modules.readme:
魅窗 (MeiWindow)

  在 Xiaomi HyperOS 上复刻 Flyme 经典屏幕边角内滑小窗呼出方式的 LSPosed 模块

📖 简介

魅窗 (MeiWindow) 是为 Xiaomi HyperOS 打造的系统级增强模块。它将魅族 Flyme 系统中最受好评的「屏幕底角内滑呼出小窗」操作逻辑带到了 HyperOS 上。

无需繁琐地打开多任务切换器或侧边栏，只需从屏幕左下角或右下角轻轻向内划出，即可展开标志性的扇形底栏与应用面板，快速以悬浮小窗启动常用 App。

✨ 核心特性
- 🪟 经典边角内滑手势
- 精确的屏幕左右底角 1/4 椭圆区域判定算法，顺滑接管内滑上提动作；
- 智能手势分流，完全不影响系统原生的屏幕贴边返回手势；
- 支持设置双侧、仅左角或仅右角触发，可独立调整底边与侧边触发范围。
- 🎯 扇形呼出面板 (Fan Dock)
- 划入手势区即刻展开经典的环形扇面动效，手指划至对应图标抬起即开；
- 支持单层 / 双层：双层时内层放前几个应用（默认 5 个）+ 一枚「更多」，外层比内层多 2 个应用（内层 5 个 → 外层 7 个，外层没有「更多」）；外圈自动跟在内圈外面一格，也可以用外圈半径开关 + 滑条单独设定（滑条不会低于内圈半径）；
- 图标数量（5 个 / 6 个）与展开扇形半径均可自由调整（双层时半径 = 内圈半径）；
- 外部空白区域的收起方式可切换：单击即收（默认） 或 双击才收；
- 支持一键以自由窗口（Freeform）或全屏模式开启应用。
- 📱 更多应用面板 (More Panel)
- 点击扇形面板上的“更多”图标即可无缝展开全量应用面板；
- 应用居中排布，配备拼音字母索引条与平滑模糊过渡效果；
- 推荐应用数量支持手动输入（4–50 个，默认 12）；推荐与收藏各自超过 20 个时默认折叠，点「展开更多」才铺开；
- 高度可定制：自由调整面板宽度/高度百分比、应用图标大小、文字大小，以及外部空白区域单击/双击收起。
- 🧩 功能页与应用磁贴
- 除应用快捷方式外，功能页还会列出系统里所有「应用磁贴」（TileService），并按宿主应用并入快捷方式分组；
- 磁贴用和快捷方式一样的圆形图标：圆底填应用图标的取色（统一明度），前景是真实磁贴 icon（按 0.62 归一化后漂白）；
- 更多应用面板设置里可开关「显示磁贴」；磁贴可加入「已选功能」，出现在扇形/面板里，点击执行磁贴本身的动作。
- 🛡️ 稳定性护栏
- 小窗风暴熔断：目标应用在小窗里自我重启死循环（例如某些应用的目标页被判"非正常入口"后回闪屏、又被路由送回来，每轮都开新小窗）时，模块自动对该应用暂停小窗参数 15 秒（短时间反复风暴逐级放大到 120 秒），期间退化为普通打开；取证与判定见 docs/test-plan-device.md A36。
- ⭐ 收藏应用与拖拽排序
- 专为快捷小窗优化的收藏管理页，支持长按拖拽排序与快捷勾选；顶部收藏区与列表一体滚动（手指落在收藏区上也能上下滑）；
- 点收藏里的应用即按「小窗启动」打开：与扇形走同一条系统小窗链路（system_server 闸门用 ROM 自己的小窗参数落窗）；
- 修改即时同步生效，无需重启 SystemUI。
- 🎨 HyperOS / Miuix 原生美学
- 深度采用 Miuix (HyperOS Design) Compose 组件库重构；
- 顶部渐进模糊导航栏，无硬分割切线，完美适配系统动态色彩与深色模式；
- 状态卡片刻意做成 KernelSU / HyperMusicCover 的形态：超尺寸状态图标从右下角出血、左上标题与副行、左下角应用名，卡片内还铺了一层 InstallerX 式的流体光效（随状态在绿/红之间流动），按下有倾斜回弹；
- 关于页独立成二级页（从设置进入，和「外观与主题」同级，不占底栏）：OS3 流体光效背景、hero 三段视差淡出、光扫过 logo 与标题的 textureBlur、跟着背景一起糊的玻璃卡片；
- 采用 Miuix 封装的原生转场动画与系统边角圆角裁切，无缝融入系统体验。
- 👁️ 触发区域可视化预览
- 内置触发区域预览功能，点击可在屏幕左右底角实时绘制物理 1/4 椭圆判定范围，直观感受调整效果。

🛠️ 安装与激活

1. 环境准备
- 运行环境：Xiaomi HyperOS (Android 14 / 15 / 16)；
- Root 与 Xposed 框架：KernelSU / Magisk / APatch + LSPosed。
2. 激活步骤
- 安装最新版本的 MeiWindow APK；
- 打开 LSPosed 管理器，在模块列表中启用 「魅窗」；
- 作用域勾选 「系统界面」 (com.android.systemui) 与 「系统框架」 (system)
     —— 扇形面板在系统界面里，「收藏页点应用变小窗 / 轻量打开」的闸门在系统框架里；
- 重启 SystemUI（或重启手机）使模块首次生效；
- 打开「魅窗」应用，顶部状态卡片显示「已连接」即可根据喜好调整手势与面板参数。

⚙️ 编译构建

本项目使用 Gradle 构建：

运行单元测试
./gradlew test

构建 Release APK
./gradlew assembleRelease

构建生成的 APK 位于 app/build/outputs/apk/release/。

签名：正式包由 CI 用仓库 Secrets 中的密钥签名；本地构建（不设环境变量）回落到 debug 签名。要用指定密钥本地签名：

SIGNING_STORE_FILE=/绝对路径/release.jks \
SIGNING_STORE_PASSWORD=… SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS=… SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD=… \
./gradlew assembleRelease

只要设置了 SIGNING_STORE_FILE，密钥找不到、或口令为空，构建就会直接失败，不会静默回落到 debug 签名
（1.1.4 及更早的发布包正是因为这种静默回落而每次签名都不同：CI 每次运行都会现生成一把随机 debug 密钥，
详见 v1.1.5 说明）。CI 还会在打包后比对密钥与 APK 的证书 SHA-256，不一致直接终止发布。

🤝 鸣谢与参考
- 魅族 Flyme OS（经典小窗手势与交互灵感来源）
- LSPosed（现代 Xposed 运行时框架支持）
- miuix（Xiaomi HyperOS 风格 Compose Multiplatform UI 组件库）
- KernelSU / HyperMusicCover / ghostlock-app（UI 状态卡片与构建流参考）

📄 开源许可

本项目基于 GPL-3.0 License 开源。
