modules.name: nsg-tweaks
modules.author: h3nnes
modules.description: Enhancing Network Signal Guru field testing Android app with an LSPosed module
modules.readme:
NSG Tweaks

An LSPosed module that extends NSG (QuickTest) with additional columns, rows, signaling tools, and log-replay improvements.

Supported NSG version

NSG Tweaks v12.0 targets exactly one NSG build: the qtrun v4.8.14 APK of com.qtrun.QuickTest.
It hooks that build's classes by their obfuscated names, so it does not work with any other NSG version or flavor.

| NSG build | Status |
|-----------|--------|
| qtrun v4.8.14 | Supported (NSG Tweaks v12.0+) |
| qtrun v4.8.12 and older | Not supported (use NSG Tweaks v11.1) |
| gplay (Google Play) | Not supported (dropped in v12.0) |
Breaking change in v12.0: support for the Google Play flavor and for all NSG builds before qtrun v4.8.14 was removed. The module now uses a single verified symbol table instead of runtime flavor detection.

Requirements
- NSG qtrun v4.8.14 (com.qtrun.QuickTest)
- LSPosed with API 102 support (minApiVersion=102)
- Android 6.0+ (module minSdk 23)

Installation

1. Install the module APK.
2. In LSPosed → Modules, enable NSG Tweaks and set the scope to NSG (QuickTest).
3. Force-stop NSG and reopen it.
4. Most features are active by default. Eleven switches at the bottom of NSG → Settings → Experiments let you turn individual features on or off.

Features

Cell tables

NR-NSA cell table — ARFCN, bandwidth and 16 rows

A Band column (ARFCN) and a BW column (DL channel bandwidth in MHz) are added to the NR-NSA cell table. The redundant sub-row previously shown beneath each cell row is removed, saving roughly 22 dp of vertical space per row so more cells fit on screen at once. The table is extended from 8 to up to 16 rows.

Final column order: Serving | Band | BW | PCI | Beam | RSRP | RSRQ | SINR

Both the serving bucket (PCell + SCells) and the detected/neighbour bucket display ARFCN values. BW is shown for serving cells only.

Controlled by the "NSGMod: Cell table mods" and "NSGMod: NR-NSA 16-cell table" toggles.

NR-SA cell table — ARFCN, bandwidth and same-site highlight

The same treatment for the NR-SA cell table: ARFCN and BW columns are injected, the sub-row is hidden, and column headers ("ARFCN", "BW") are added. Row heights are also reduced (top row 28 dp → 22 dp, child rows 26 dp → 21 dp) so more rows fit on screen.

Final column order: Serving | ARFCN | PCI | BW | Beam | RSRP | RSRQ | SINR

Same-site neighbour highlight: detected/neighbour rows whose PCI *and* ARFCN match the serving primary cell get their PCI value painted turquoise (the same colour as SCell 2 on the NR-SA CA Matrix DL page). In multi-beam deployments one sector appears as several neighbour rows sharing PCI + ARFCN, so this makes the beams of your own site easy to tell apart from other sectors. Works in any RRC state; serving rows keep NSG's colours.

Controlled by the "NSGMod: Cell table mods" and "NSGMod: Highlight same-site NR neighbours" toggles.

LTE cell table — bandwidth column and 16 rows

A BW column is inserted between the Band and EARFCN columns in the LTE cell table. It shows the DL channel bandwidth (1.4, 3, 5, 10, 15, or 20 MHz) for the PCell and up to seven SCells. Detected/neighbour rows show "—". The table is extended from 8 to up to 16 rows (in both pure-LTE mode and NR-NSA mode).

Controlled by the "NSGMod: Cell table mods" and "NSGMod: LTE 16-cell table" toggles.

Collapse empty cell rows (LTE and NR-NSA)

Cell rows carry a second line with cell-database information (cell name / cell ID). When the cell database has no entry for a cell that line is empty; this feature hides it, reclaiming 22 dp per row so more rows fit on screen. In the NR-SA cell table the same sub-line is already removed by the cell-table mods above.

Controlled by the "NSGMod: Collapse empty cell rows" toggle (default: on).

CA Matrix (DL)

LTE CA Matrix DL — RSRP row

An RSRP bar row is inserted between the Band/Width row and the SINR row on the LTE CA Matrix DL page. It shows LTE RSRP in dBm for the PCell and each active SCell (up to three SCells). All CA layout geometries (1, 2, or 3 SCells) are handled.

NR-NSA EUTRA CA Matrix DL — RSRP row

The same RSRP row injection for the LTE-anchor component of NR-NSA connections, placed between Band/Width and SINR.

NR-NSA Dual Connectivity — stacked NR SCell

On the NR-NSA "Dual Connectivity" page, when an NR SCell is aggregated the right-hand NR column is stretched so each logical row shows the PCell value on top and the first NR SCell value below. The label and LTE cells in the same row are stretched too, so the grid stays aligned. This mirrors how the NR-SA CA Matrix DL page stacks PCell + SCell values.

NR-SA CA Matrix DL — SS-RSRP and CSI-RSRP rows

Two new rows are inserted after the ARFCN/PCI row on the NR-SA CA Matrix DL page:
- SS-RSRP — per-SCell bars (PCell + all active SCells)
- CSI-RSRP — PCell bar

All CA geometry paths (2-, 3-, and 4-carrier layouts) are supported.

NR-SA CA Matrix DL — CSI SNR and PDSCH SINR rows

A CSI SNR row (PCell) is added after the SS-SNR row, before the RBs section. Optionally a second PDSCH SINR row is added below it; it uses the same dynamic colour thresholds as the SS/CSI SNR bars.

Controlled by the "NSGMod: Show NR PDSCH SINR" toggle (default: off).

NR-SA CA Matrix DL — 16QAM and QPSK utilisation rows

Two additional modulation-utilisation rows appear after the existing 64QAM row, before Phy. Thput:
- 16Q Util. — 16QAM utilisation %
- QPSK Util. — QPSK utilisation %

NR-SA CA Matrix DL — per-SCell colour coding

Each SCell's value labels on the NR-SA CA Matrix DL page are coloured distinctly, making it easy to identify which SCell each bar belongs to even when several are stacked:

| SCell | Colour |
|-------|--------|
| SCell 1 | Purple #AA66CC |
| SCell 2 | Turquoise #00BCD4 |
| SCell 3 | Yellow #FFEB3B |
| SCell 4 | Green #4CAF50 |

Colours survive fragment recreation and all CA carrier-count configurations (2–4 carriers).

NR-SA CA Matrix DL — carrier count indicator fix

Fixes the green "-" carrier count indicator on the NR-SA CA Matrix DL...

modules.name: oslokrok
modules.author: Ascen1ty
modules.description: A Vector/LSPosed module used to bypass PayPal's new root-detection.
modules.readme:
Oslokrok - PayPal root-detection bypass

A Vector (formerly Xposed/LSPosed) module that prevents the PayPal app from crashing on rooted devices.

This crash is caused by PayPal's own on-device anti-tamper (RASP), which
kills the app a few seconds after launch on rooted devices. Oslokrok neutralises
the mechanism that causes this crash, allowing the PayPal app to run normally.

🪝 Oslokrok?
PayPal's internal package name = com.paypal.oslo.
Oslo = Norway.
Hook = Krok in Norwegian.
PayPal Hook = Oslokrok.

✨ Features
- ✅ Prevents on-launch anti-tamper crash (AppVerifier for 10.19.0+, s=root for pre-10.19.0).
- ✅ Self-healing: targets are resolved at runtime with DexKit, not hardcoded names.
- ✅ Falls back to fixed hooks if DexKit is unavailable.

🛠️ How It Works
- AppVerifier (10.19.0+) - this is a startup integrity check that crashes the process on a mismatch. No-opping its run() method prevents the crash.
- Legacy (pre-10.19.0)   - RASP has several detection channels, but only the root channel is set up to cause the crash. No-opping this channel means the crash never happens.

🔍 Target(s)

| Check | Method | Package |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AppVerifier (10.19.0+) | AppVerifier.run() | com.paypal.oslo.core.startup |
| Legacy (pre-10.19.0) | RaspDetectionDataSourceImpl.signal() | com.paypal.oslo.core.security.rasp |

Oslokrok locates both methods with DexKit
using structural anchors (package names + method shape) with a fixed-name fallback
so hooks should survive updates, unless these are removed.

🧪 Requirements
- ✅ Root + an Xposed framework: Vector or LSPosed with Zygisk.
- ✅ Working root hiding (DenyList / HMA / Shamiko, etc).
- ❗ arm64-v8a only.
- ❗ Oslokrok only prevents the crash; it does not hide root from PayPal's servers.

🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest Oslokrok-*.apk from Releases and install it.
2. Enable Oslokrok in your LSPosed / Vector app; confirm PayPal is in scope (ticked/selected).
3. Force-stop PayPal (and/or reboot) and reopen PayPal.
⚠️ Upon install, Play Protect will probably say it *"hasn't seen an app from
this developer"* - this is due to a new-signing-key reputation notice. Tap
More details → Install anyway.

Check LSPosed/Vector log (filter oslokrok) for:
signal hooks=1, verifier hooks=1 (dexkit).

🧠 Notes
- If an update changes the package/interface/method so that nothing hooks
  (signal hooks=0, verifier hooks=0), the anchors in
  app/src/main/java/net/oslokrok/hook/Hook.java need updating.
- Tested on v10.14.0, v10.16.0, v10.17.0, v10.18.0 and v10.19.0, v10.20.0, v10.21.0.

🙏 Credits
- Santand3rp by mwilky — for inspiring the
  initial concept for this project and the two-hook approach to defeating the in-process anti-tamper.
- DexKit by LuckyPray — the
  runtime dex-search engine that makes the hooks "self-healing".

modules.name: SplashScreenAdvanced
modules.author: jichuo1
modules.description: 启动遮罩进化A / 基于 RestoreSplashScreen 的现代化实现。
modules.readme:
SplashScreenAdvanced

启动遮罩进化A

自定义 Android 原生 Splash Screen 的 libxposed 模块

简体中文 · English

功能 · 要求 · 使用 · 构建 · 反馈 · 许可

本项目是 GSWXXN/RestoreSplashScreen 的修改版，以 AGPL-3.0 继续分发。详见 出处与许可。

功能

设置界面是底栏 5 页的横向分页：首页（模块状态与作用域）、图标、背景、显示、模块；每页再按功能分成带标题的小组，顶部胶囊栏的搜索可直接定位到具体开关。改完多数选项会立刻热重载，不必重启。

| 页面 | 分组 |
|:---|:---|
| 首页 | 作用域 |
| 图标 | 形状与尺寸 · 图标来源 · 画质增强 · 按应用设置 |
| 背景 | 背景颜色 · 按应用设置 · 系统兼容 |
| 显示 | 时长与显示 · 底部品牌图 · 兼容与关闭 |
| 模块 | 界面外观 · 桌面与日志 · 备份与恢复 · 关于 · 更新 · 开放源代码许可 |

图标
- 强制使用原生 Splash Screen
- 遮罩图标跟随桌面 / 图标包 / 小米大图标
- 忽略应用主动适配的图标（可解方角）
- 隐藏图标、绘制圆角、缩小、模糊底、去描边

背景
- 从图标取色、莫奈取色或自定义颜色
- 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统，可逐应用单独配色
- 忽略小米强制深色背景
- 移除应用截图当背景的情况

显示
- 全局或逐应用最小持续时长
- 移除底部 Branding Image
- 强制显示、强制开启、热启动遮罩
- 彻底关闭 Splash Screen

作用域与模块
- 自定义作用域（排除 / 仅选中）
- 作用域外可替换为空白遮罩
- 备份与恢复设置
- 隐藏模块桌面图标、大屏双栏布局

MIUI / HyperOS 与 ColorOS 走专门分支，其余系统走 AOSP 通用路径。

设置界面与运行时基于 LumenCoacervationEngine 1.6.2 与 Meguviz 家族（MeguvizHook、DexMeguviz、MeguvizRef、MeguvizUI、MeguvizAndroid、MeguvizDrawable、MeguvizMemory）构建：材质、浮动顶底栏、分页与控件由引擎提供；Hook 调度、DEX 查询、视图与 Drawable 生命周期、窗口 Insets、反射与公平内存域管理由 Meguviz 家族提供。

要求

| 项 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|
| 系统 | Android 14 及以上（minSdk 34） |
| 框架 | 实现 libxposed API 101 的框架即可；API 102 额外支持热重载 |
| 作用域 | 至少勾选 系统界面（com.android.systemui） |
| 适配 | 重点覆盖 MIUI / HyperOS、ColorOS；其余 ROM 走通用路径 |

框架只有 API 101 时，Hook 与设置热更新仍然可用，但模块 APK 更新后需要重启系统界面（勾了系统框架则重启手机）。API 102 会自动热重载，一般不必重启。

使用

flowchart TD
  A[安装模块并在管理器中激活] --> B[勾选系统界面 com.android.systemui]
  B --> C{要用强制显示、热启动或彻底关闭？}
  C -->|否| D[重启系统界面]
  C -->|是| E[再勾选系统框架 android 并重启手机]
  D --> F[打开「启动遮罩进化A」调整选项]
  E --> F
  F --> G[多数设置立即生效；API 102 还可热重载模块更新]

作用域对照

| 功能 | 系统界面 | 系统框架 | 生效方式 |
|:---|:---:|:---:|:---|
| 图标 / 背景 / 时长 / 作用域等常规项 | 需要 | — | 改设置即时生效；API 101 下更新模块后需重启系统界面 |
| 强制显示遮罩 | 需要 | 需要 | 重启手机 |
| 热启动遮罩 | 需要 | 需要 | 须同时开启「强制开启启动遮罩」，并重启手机 |
| 彻底关闭 Splash Screen | — | 需要 | 重启手机；开启后模块内其余选项不再起作用 |

「强制开启启动遮罩」只在模块已激活却完全不生效时再试。正常工作时不要打开，否则可能在不该出现的场景显示遮罩，或挡住应用自己设置的背景图。

「最小持续时长」会拖慢应用启动。没有明确需求就保持默认。

构建

需要 JDK 21 与 Android SDK Platform 37.2。

git clone https://github.com/jichuo1/SplashScreenAdvanced.git
cd SplashScreenAdvanced
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

| 产物 | 命令 / 入口 |
|:---|:---|
| Debug APK | ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug |
| Alpha 预发布 | 向 main 推送，或手动运行 alpha-release |
| Stable 发布 | stable-release |

发布签名使用 GitHub Environment Secrets，密钥库不要放进仓库。步骤见 release-signing。

反馈

使用交流与问题讨论，欢迎加入 Telegram 交流群。提交 Bug 请按下方说明提供信息，方便跟进。

请先到 Releases 确认已是最新版本，再提交 Issue，并附上：

1. Android 版本、ROM 及版本号
2. Xposed 框架名称与版本（API 101 或 102）
3. 复现步骤，以及是否勾选了系统框架
4. 模块日志与框架日志：在设置中打开「启用日志」后复现（日志会在 24 小时后自动关闭）

日志里请去掉账号、路径等无关隐私后再上传。

出处与许可

本项目基于 GSWXXN/RestoreSplashScreen（作者 GSWXXN）修改而来。原作品与本仓库均以 GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 授权。

相对上游的主要变更包括：
- 模块包名与项目身份改为 com.SplashScreenAdvanced.xposedmodule
- Hook 层的异常隔离、反射缓存、内存与线程安全修复
- 设置界面重组为横向分页，改用 Lumen 引擎与 Meguviz 家族重写；图标加载、设置页启动与切页优化
- 发布流水线改为 GitHub Actions + Environment Secrets 签名

原作者的个人品牌素材、社区链接与捐赠信息已移除，它们指向的是原作者本人而非本项目。

致谢

| 项目 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|
| GSWXXN/RestoreSplashScreen | 上游项目 |
| libxposed | 模块 API 与服务 |
| LumenCoacervationEngine | 界面材质、浮动顶底栏、分页与控件 |
| MeguvizRef | 运行期反射与成员解析 |
| MeguvizUI | 原生 View 的身份与生命周期 |
| MeguvizAndroid | 窗口会话、Insets 与帧调度 |
| MeguvizDrawable | Drawable 所有权、FlightCache 与释放 |
| MeguvizHook | Hook 统一封装与 libxposed API 101/102 双后端热重载 |
| DexMeguviz | QueryIR 宿主 DEX 类查找 |
| MeguvizMemory | 受控内存域、内存预算观察与公平运行内存配合 |
| ncnn | 画质增强的超分推理 |
| waifu2x-ncnn-vulkan | 超分模型（源自 waifu2x） |
| Hide My Applist | 应用列表获取思路 |
| MiuiHome_R | 备份恢复逻辑参考 |
| MIUINativeNotifyIcon | 开源参考 |
| YukiHookAPI | 开源参考 |

AGPL-3.0 · Issues · Releases

感谢原作者 GSWXXN，以及每一位提交 Issue 与参与测试的用户。
modules.changelog:
🧬 SplashScreenAdvanced v1.1.0

_✨ 更新说明 · Stable 稳定版_

得益于视效引擎的进一步调校，设置界面的顶底栏、卡片与分组整体焕新，搜索与重启面板改为从按钮旁以气泡弹出。对玻璃材质随内容取样、内存压力后材质恢复以及首次打开的配色等问题进行了修复，返回与折叠动画亦已恢复正常。新增了可折叠的开源许可行，展开后可查看各项目与许可证，模块页布局因此更为紧凑。

✨ 新增

开源许可
- 开源许可折叠为可展开行，展开后可查看各项目与对应许可证，列表内容已按实际引用的项目更新。

🛠️ 修复

玻璃材质
- 卡片、悬浮栏与底栏的玻璃材质此前按屏幕原点绘制，滚动时与下方内容脱节，现可正确跟随内容取样与定位。
- 系统内存紧张导致玻璃降级后，返回设置页面时会自动重建并恢复玻璃效果，无需重新打开应用。

配色
- 首次打开设置页即可呈现正确的莫奈配色，此前需再次打开窗口才会生效。

返回与动画
- 首页首个分页按返回键时恢复系统的返回桌面预览，仅在应用内仍有可返回内容时才拦截返回操作。

动效
- 手风琴收起时页面内容连续上移，不再在动画结束后发生跳动，分割线也随行移动重绘而不再停留在展开动画中途。

⚡ 优化

视觉与材质
- 顶栏、底栏与卡片改用更中性的表面配色，环境背景与其上的玻璃不再被染成蓝灰色；莫奈模式下的次色、第三色与前景色也更贴近系统色调。
- 顶栏胶囊与底栏的软阴影恢复呈现，悬浮栏与卡片之间的层次更为自然，底栏选中项改为表面色镜片。

分组与分割线
- 设置分组改为整张卡片承载，行与行之间以跟随文字起点内缩的细线分隔，取代原先逐行独立卡片的堆叠。

布局与控件
- 底栏宽度按标签内容收窄，两侧保留足够边距，五项底栏不再撑出屏幕边界；设置行、对话框按钮与二级面板的控件尺寸也已统一整理。
- 更新检查移至首页状态卡下方，模块页仅保留外观与行为相关设置，各分页的页面长度更为接近。

取色与应用列表
- 取色页改为圆角预览与固定尺寸的圆形色板，通道卡片与底部按钮间距统一；应用列表的搜索与菜单同行、保存独占一行，列表滚动时玻璃会重新定位。

二级面板
- 二级页面展开后与屏幕圆角对齐，面板与对话框从来源行的圆角长出，不再以直角矩形起始。

动效
- 分组内的行不再各自呈现长按弹性，改由整张分组卡片统一响应，按压反馈更为整体。

搜索面板
- 顶栏的搜索与重启按钮以气泡形式从按钮旁弹出面板，搜索面板宽度固定，结果合为一张分组卡片，标题与位置信息排版更清晰。

YayPentestMagiskModuleYay

Custom Magisk Module that does various tasks on the device for pentest purposes
- Move CA certificates from the User store to the System store
- This means you need to install your root CA via the Settings menu in Android before this module will move your root CA
- Add a frida-server binary to the device

Usage
- Install this module in Magisk, then reboot the device
- adb shell
- su
- frida-server

This will start the Frida server on the device

Other information

Latest build is in the Releases section

If you want to modify the logic of this module:
- post-fs-data.sh contains most of the logic, including moving root CAs for Android API 33 and below
- service.sh ensures frida-server continues to run, as well as moving root CAs for Android API 34 and above

If you want to build your own module, or if you want to build a version with newer frida-server binaries, then:

python3 ./build.py

The build script will automatically download the latest frida-server binaries for arm, arm64, x86, and x86_64

3. 任何问题可前往 QQ群：979221822 咨询。

简介

极速高刷 Astra_MaxRefresh_Pro 是专为欧加（Oplus）系设备打造的高刷模块，支持原生刷新率与超频 DTBO 档位，可强制锁定所需的刷新率，无论在原生还是超频环境下，都能实现稳定高效的屏幕刷新控制。

功能特性

刷新率锁定
- 支持原生刷新率：如 60Hz、90Hz、120Hz 等
- 支持超频 DTBO：可根据需求自定义刷新率档位
- 强制锁定指定档位，避免系统自动降频或切换
- 支持按应用自动切换档位，轮询间隔可调

WebUI 管理器
- 拟物仪表盘设计，实时显示当前档位、切换路径与帧信号
- 应用规则可从已安装应用中选择，显示应用图标
- 浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统三种外观，动画可选完整 / 精简 / 关闭
- 边到边布局，原生适配状态栏与手势导航条

超频 DTBO 兼容性
- 首次启动时自动扫描全部刷新率档位，并按 120Hz 原生基准自动标注原生与超频档位，可在 WebUI 中调整
- 超频 DTBO 中必须保留 120Hz 档位，否则可能导致功能失效或不稳定
- 当自定义应用切换功能不生效时，请优先联系提供该 DTBO 的作者更新至最新版本

使用步骤

1. 下载并刷入 极速高刷 Astra_MaxRefresh_Pro 模块（KernelSU，或 Magisk + KsuWebUI）。
2. 重启设备，模块将自动扫描并标注全部刷新率档位。
3. 打开 WebUI，在「设置」页核对档位属性：超频档位需填写切换顺序，存在超频档位的分辨率需设置原生基准，然后保存。
4. 在「主页」选择全局档位并保存，或在「应用」页按应用添加档位规则。

配置文件保存在 /data/adb/Astra_MaxRefresh_Pro_data，卸载模块时保留，重新安装后自动恢复。运行记录位于同一目录下的 run.log。

常见问题

锁屏或关机重启后无法切换到高档位
- 某些设备上，超频 DTBO 在锁屏或关机重启后无法直接切换到高档位；原生用户在重启后几秒内可自动恢复到之前设定的档位。
- 建议更新超频 DTBO 至最新版本。

管理器推荐
- KernelSU 及其分支体验最好。
- Magisk 用户必须下载 KsuWebUI 软件，并授予 Root 权限后使用。

更新日志见 CHANGELOG.md。

modules.name: CaptureSposed
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: CaptureSposed
modules.readme:
CaptureSposed

With the release of Android 14, Google added an API to enable app developers to detect screenshots. This API has since been adopted by popular apps such as Snapchat.

CaptureSposed is an Xposed module that effectively disables this API as well as the screen recording detection API added in Android 15. The app provides in-app switches to control each hook. You can also add optional Quick Settings tiles that mirror the in-app switches.

⚠️ WARNING: CaptureSposed is intended for rooted devices running Android 14 or newer and requires Xposed. The required Xposed variant to use is LSPosed. Other Xposed variants will not work. This module cannot be guaranteed to work on all devices. In the worst case, it can cause a bootloop. Use at your own risk. Additionally, this module does not protect against screenshot detection from apps that use the pre-Android 14 approach of using file system listeners to detect screenshots (ref 1, ref 2).

To use CaptureSposed:
1. Install an LSPosed build with API 101 support. This requires your device to be rooted with Magisk or KernelSU.
2. Install CaptureSposed.
3. Grant root access to CaptureSposed.
4. Activate the CaptureSposed module in the LSposed user interface.
5. Reboot your device and sign in.
6. Open the CaptureSposed app and use the switches to enable or disable screenshot and screen recording detection blocking. Use the Testing card to verify that detection is blocked when expected.
7. Optionally, add the Block Screenshot Detection and Block Recording Detection Quick Settings tiles from the tile editor. These tiles mirror the in-app switches.
modules.changelog:
This release updates CaptureSposed to LSPosed API 101. An LSPosed build with API 101 support is required; this version is not compatible with API 100-only frameworks.

If you are unable to use an LSPosed version that supports API 101, then you must stay on CaptureSposed v1.0.8.

modules.name: com.rel.mujde
modules.author: mon231
modules.description: Mujde
modules.readme:
Mujde app
Mujde is an android app in form of Xposed module, that integrates with Xposed framework to hook apps.
Mujde lets the user manage a local repository of frida-js scripts, and select what script should it inject to which selected application.
Using android's SharedPreferences, mujde stores a map between apps to the list of scripts it should inject into them.
Using Xposed's XSharedPreferences, mujde's hook (InjectionRequester cls) is accessible to that mapping.

Via Xposed framework, mujde gets a callback (handleLoadPackage) whenever an app is loaded by zygote-forkAndSpeciallize.
Then, mujde fetches the list of scripts it should inject to that app (using XSharedPreferences).
If that list isn't empty, mujde (installHookOnActivityCreation) installs hook on Activity.onCreate function,
Which lets us get a callback whenever a new activity is started in that app (which we already know that has scripts the user wants to inject into).
Then, from that hook, mujde sends an injection-request from the app's context to mujde's broadcast-listener named InjectionRequestHandler.

That handler sends parses the injection-request via intent,
And creates frida-inject subprocesses (as root user) to inject the selected scripts into the started app.
NOTE that the scripts will be re-injected whenever the app creates/re-creates any activity.

Mujde manages the local scripts repository in the app-data folder's files subfolder.
Users with root permissions can create/remove/edit files from that folder directly,
Without using mujde's app to manage the repository: /data/data/com.rel.mujde/files/scripts
This feature is extremly usable for scripts / massive management operations on the repository.

Additional, mujde's shared-preferences are stored at Xposed-shared-preferences folder to be world-readable.
Root users can edit the shared-preferences from there to import settings from other devices,
And any user can read the contents of that folder and files. Mujde's main shared-pref can be found at /data/misc/eb08c078-3e01-43a8-8857-4e57e0f0e2e3/prefs/com.rel.mujde/mujde_prefs.xml.
NOTE that this path might have a different guid on different android devices / between reboots.

Compile The App
Use this guide to compile the app by yourself (or simply download the build artifacts from github-action or releases)
NOTE you can compile the app using windows / linux / macos

Requirements
- git client
- java setup (e.g. java-temurin v21) and android-sdk
- java-home (env. variable ANDROID_HOME) or local.properties set correctly with sdk.dir
- internet connection (in order to download frida-inject binaries from frida's github releases)
- python3 + pip + pip install signapp buildapp && buildapp_fetch_tools
- optional, for release-builds only

Build steps
Clone the project:
git clone https://github.com/mon231/com.rel.mujde mujde

Execute gradlew:
cd mujde
./gradlew assembleDebug

Find the apk at mujde/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
In order to build the app for release compilations:
./gradlew assembleRelease
signapp -a mujde/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk -o app-signed.apk

Find the apk (release build) at app-signed.apk

Install The App
The app is implemented in form of Xposed module, therefore MUST be installed on devices with Xposed-framework, like LSposed/EdXposed.
On devices with such framework (e.g. rooted devices with LSPosed over zygisk, or virtual-LSposed over normal android/vm),
Simply install the app and enjoy hooking other apps, automatically & covertly!

If the app is installed over devices with no Xposed framework, it might simply crash when opened.
Use network guides to install LSposed / root your device, or use an emulator with similar guides.

Code Classes

Fragments
- HomeFragment: shows home screen from navbar, the first fragment of the main activity
- ScriptsFragment: show the scripts page from navbar. let the user watch existing scripts, create new, edit, delete, ...
- AppsFragment: show list of apps. when app is selected, creates the ScriptSelectionActivity for chosen app (via intent's extra)

Xposed-classes
- InjectionRequester: notified when a new injectible app is loaded,  hooks it's Activity.onCreate method to broadcast a com.rel.mujde.INJECT_REQUEST request

DATA-classes
- InjectionRequest: simple data-holder to serialize/deserialize request content in Intent's extra
- Constants: contains consts and strings for global needs

Handlers
- InjectionRequestHandler: handles broadcasted com.rel.mujde.INJECT_REQUEST requests, notifies the FridaInjectorService

Utils
- ScriptUtils: utils about scripts (repository, SharedPref, content, files, folder, ...)
- AccessibilityUtils: chmod files / folders to make sure they are readable from other users

Activities
- ActivityMain: the activity which contains the fragments and the footer navbar
- ScriptSelectionActivity: a screen where the user selects what scripts should be injected to currently selected app

Adapters
- AppListAdapter: used to list all installed apps and move to ScriptSelectionActivity to choose what scripts to inejct
- ScriptCheckboxAdapter: used by ScriptSelectionActivity, to track availableScripts/selectedScripts
- ScriptAdapter: used by ScriptsFragment to view each script-item (script name, edit button, delete button)

modules.name: Doula
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Doula
modules.readme:
Doula · 沉浸播放，让画面更出彩

Doula 是适用于抖音的 LSPosed 模块，提供沉浸播放、内容过滤、手势、消息和媒体工具。按自己的习惯调整界面与播放体验。

Telegram 交流群：@DOULA_LSPOSED

全屏控件半透明沉浸播放 · 彩虹弹幕 · 发布时间与发布地

@Jhih he · Android 13+ · ARM64 · 现代 Xposed API 102

官方发行与下载 · 完整功能 · 更新日志 · 真实截图 · 反馈教程

版本与下载

Doula 1.1.5 正式版 · 2026111301 · 2026-11-13

编译时间：2026-11-13 08:39:35（北京时间）。

本次加入抖音 41.1.0 适配、自动播快捷开关和个人主页底栏开关，精简侧栏隐藏列表，修复分享、图片保存和关注确认，调整发布时间彩虹及进度时间样式。与 1.1.4 的 12 组变化见 更新日志。

下载 1.1.5 APK / ZIP · Telegram 下载话题 · 全部版本

需要 Android 13+、ARM64、现代 Xposed API 102。覆盖安装后完整重启抖音。适配代码保留 40.6–41.1 路径；一台设备上的部分功能已有实测，其他机型、旧宿主及部分功能组合仍待回归，详见 验证范围。

旧蓝奏链接仍是 1.1.4 修正版，本轮 1.1.5 请使用上面的 GitHub 或 Telegram 附件，不把旧链接当成新包。

重点体验：画面更沉浸，信息更清楚

全屏控件半透明沉浸播放

顶部菜单、视频控件、底部菜单的透明度分别调节，播放与暂停各有一套设置。0–100 自由选择：半透明保留必要操作提示，完全透明让画面更干净，暂停时也可以恢复显示。 状态栏与导航栏另有显示选项，视频保持原始画幅，不强行拉伸横屏内容。

透明不等于禁用点击，也不承诺所有页面和原生控件都隐藏。建议先选半透明，再按习惯微调。透明度和手势真机界面

液态玻璃实验外观

设置页面使用 70% 快照毛玻璃效果。实验玻璃开关默认关闭，用于控制其他已适配控件；关闭后恢复这些控件的原样。照片和视频长按菜单也调整了背景与明暗模式下的文字、图标和倍速显示。

彩虹弹幕

让文字弹幕呈现彩虹渐变，保留图片表情原样，不把普通菜单一起染色。未经三维重排的40.7候选真实显示见下图；已验证的Compose路径、关闭恢复白色及其他待测后端见验证记录。

视频发布时间与发布地

分别选择显示时间、显示发布地，也可启用多彩显示。让内容发布信息更直观；仅显示视频提供的可读取发布地，缺失时不猜测、不推算创作者实时位置。这不是查看他人当前位置的工具。

真机截图同时展示半透明控件、彩虹弹幕与视频时间/发布地，来自40.7 / 1.1.0-dy40.6-40.7-api102-rc.3候选。视频与弹幕为第三方公开内容，创作者与本模块无关联。

设置更多，查找更直接

设置按六类整理：播放与提醒、内容过滤、界面与控件、手势操作、消息与隐私、更多设置。关键词搜索可以缩小选项范围，清空后恢复分类；保留原控件与配置绑定。

浅色与深色统一重绘卡片、输入框、红色开关、复选状态、单选列表和操作按钮。菜单隐藏、四区域手势、透明度及低赞输入窗口同步更新。

既有功能与改进
- 默认播放倍速：跟随抖音，或选择 0.75 / 1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 2 倍；固定值在新视频首帧应用，保留原生临时倍速。
- 推荐流最低点赞数：0 表示关闭，仅处理可识别的推荐列表。未知点赞数、直播保留，搜索、收藏与关注不参与。
- 底部导航高度调节：配合系统安全区域处理，改善底栏、前景控件和进度区域间距；更多机型和页面仍需继续核验。
- 彩虹弹幕：增加开关与局部文字渐变适配。40.7 候选已见 Compose 文字渐变及关闭恢复白色；图片表情不染色，40.6 和其他后端未全部实测。
- 桌面缓存维护：重新扫描 DEX、清除 Doula 缓存；完整退出并重启抖音后处理，保留抖音账号、聊天和草稿。

保留熟悉的操作，也修复实际问题

沉浸播放、顶/底菜单和视频控件隐藏、播放/暂停六项透明度、四区域双击和长按、11 类视频过滤、文案正则、时间与发布地、消息与评论、媒体工具等继续保留。

此前修复涉及 API 102 加载桥、配置初始化竞态、版本缓存、菜单全隐藏恢复、收藏隐藏、评论与拍摄手势、完成暂停和自动连播、原生进度时间生命周期、消息已读与输入状态接口、媒体保存和存储路径。各项实现与实测范围见 更新日志 和 验证记录。

安装与使用

需要 Android 13 或更高版本、ARM64 设备，以及支持现代 Xposed API 102 的框架。适配路径包括官方抖音 40.6.0 / 400601、40.7.0 / 400701、40.8.0 / 400801、40.9.0 / 400901、41.0.0 和 41.1.0；不同版本的功能验证范围请查看 验证记录。

1. 使用支持现代 Xposed API 102 的框架；环境要求 Android 13+ / ARM64。
2. 安装 Releases 中明确对应目标抖音版本的 APK。官方包名 io.github.jhihhe.doula，抖音目标包名 com.ss.android.ugc.aweme。
3. 在 LSPosed 启用 Doula 并勾选抖音作用域。
4. 强制停止抖音后重新打开，长按视频或照片，在弹出菜单中选择「Doula 设置」；也可使用已配置的模块手势入口。
5. 菜单勾选的是要隐藏的项目，保存后按提示重启。不要清除抖音数据来解决普通加载问题。
6. 无入口或不生效时，按 反馈教程 提交具体版本、步骤与日志。桌面缓存维护不能修复框架不支持或作用域错误。

本轮适配路径针对 40.6.0 / 400601、40.7.0 / 400701、40.8.0 / 400801 与 40.9.0 / 400901；1.1.5 在 1.1.4 的 41.0.0 基础上新增 41.1.0 适配，部分功能已实测，其余功能及旧版回归仍在继续；不等于任意“最新版”都兼容。Android 11、抖音极速版、TikTok 及其他版本不在当前支持声明中。

截图、验证与反馈

新 UI 完整截图集 · 新增与原有功能清单 · 验证范围 · 宣传文案

截图集中的 11 张截图均为历史候选真机原图，来自 rc.3 与 test.21 / .23 / .24 / .26 候选，确切版本见截图集。截图里的选项值不代表默认值，不表示 1.1.4 全部验收。旧图和历史说明保留在 1.0.x 记录。

提交问题。体验有帮助，欢迎收藏、留言并自愿支持维护；反馈请附具体版本和复现步骤。

Doula 当前界面、兼容层与发布维护者：@Jhih he。版权与来源声明。仓库用于文档、宣传图、真实截图与发行记录，不公开模块源码、原始输入 APK、私有日志或签名密钥。Doula 与抖音官方无隶属关系。

modules.name: MiAIPlus
modules.author: astoHu1
modules.description: HyperOS LSPosed module extending 超级小爱 (MiAI) with on-device Phone Use tools and external Agent & model integration
modules.readme:
MiAIPlus

给超级小爱添加手机操作和 MCP 插件。默认使用小爱当前模型，无需额外 API，也可以接入自己的模型服务。

下载 APK · 配置界面 · 验证记录

需要支持 miclaw 的 HyperOS 3+、支持 API 102 的 LSPosed，以及超级小爱 8.2.65.4714 或 8.3.30.4420。

能做什么
- 前台控屏：打开应用、点击、滑动和输入。通知岛显示进度，随时可以停止。
- 后台控屏：在虚拟屏里执行任务，主屏可以继续使用。需要给 MiAIPlus 授予 root 权限。
- MCP 插件：添加 HTTP MCP 服务，把它的工具交给小爱调用。
- Eta Agent：把多步复杂任务、跨应用操作、深度调研、脚本和日志分析交给本机已安装的 Eta，使用 Eta 自己配置的模型。
- 自定义模型：保存多套模型配置，支持 Responses 和 Chat Completions。

开始使用

1. 安装 APK，在 LSPosed 启用 MiAIPlus，保持默认作用域。
2. 打开「插件 → 控屏配置」，开启「启用控屏工具」。规划模型保持「小爱当前模型」。
3. 开启 MiAIPlus 无障碍服务，并允许「后台弹出界面」。API 配置可以留空。
4. 重启小爱，说出具体任务，例如「打开计算器，清空当前结果」。

「插件」页可以分别开关前台和后台控屏。想让任务在虚拟屏执行，告诉小爱「在后台操作」。操作中可展开通知岛停止，结束后点击完成通知返回原对话。

添加 MCP 插件

已安装 Termux 的设备可以在「插件 → Termux 配置 → 自动配置」一键配置，无需手填地址或 Token。此功能需要给 MiAIPlus 授予 root；shell 仍由 Termux 以普通应用身份执行。插件页的「Termux MCP」开关控制工具是否启用。「Termux 配置」页可手动启动服务；「按需启动 Termux」默认关闭，开启后小爱调用工具时可在后台启动 Termux。

命令并行、长输出、后台任务和服务升级方式见 Termux 执行契约。

1. 打开「插件」，点击「MCP 插件」右侧的「添加」。
2. 填写插件名称、完整服务地址和可选 Token，例如 https://example.com/mcp。
3. 保存后点击「获取工具」，在「工具列表」查看结果，再开启插件。

默认协议为 2025-11-25，服务需要旧版时可选择 2025-06-18。保存配置不会连接服务器。当前支持 Streamable HTTP 的工具调用；使用实例见 Plugin 与 MCP 文档。

接入 Eta

MiAIPlus 不修改 Eta，只通过 Eta 的 AgentRuntimeService 接口转发任务。详见 Eta 外部 Agent。

1. 安装 Eta 最新发布版（官方签名，版本不低于 3.4.4），并在 Eta 里配置好模型。
2. 打开「插件」，开启「Eta Agent」。未安装或校验不通过时开关不可用，摘要会说明原因。
3. 对小爱说「让 Eta 帮我……」即可委派。只是提到 Eta 不会触发。

「插件 → 控屏配置 → 执行 → 动作协议」选 Eta 后，MiAIPlus 自己的控屏工具不再加载，控屏请求全部转给 Eta。在虚拟屏还是主屏执行由 Eta 自己决定，「规划模型」变灰。

「终端和敏感工具」（含 shell、短信、联系人和系统设置）只在「Eta Agent」开关开启后出现，默认关闭。MiAIPlus 的「操作确认」不作用于 Eta，敏感操作是否确认取决于 Eta 自身。

使用自己的模型

在「模型 API」填写服务地址、API 密钥和模型名称，保存后开启「使用外部模型」，再重启小爱或热重载模块。协议可选自动、Responses 或 Chat Completions。控屏所用模型需要支持图片和工具调用。

语音识别、语音合成及米家等服务仍使用原链路。

排查问题

在「首页 → 日志」开启「详细日志」，复现后查看记录，或保存／分享 ZIP。默认关闭，不记录截图、页面正文和输入内容。详见 日志说明。

「插件 → 控屏配置 → 操作确认」可选择手动确认、智能判断或自动执行。锁屏、密码、验证码和安全窗口等限制仍然生效。后台虚拟屏不是应用分身，兼容性因设备和应用而异；后台失败会停止任务。

构建

需要 JDK 17+、Android SDK 37 和 build-tools 37.0.0。

./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug :app:assemblePreview

日常试用使用优化的 Preview APK：app/build/outputs/apk/preview/app-preview.apk。Debug 用于调试。正式发布包使用发布签名，Preview 使用开发签名，二者不能直接覆盖升级。

GitHub Actions 会在 main 推送和 PR 时运行测试、Lint 与构建，产物在对应运行的 Artifacts。发布流程见 发布说明。

更多说明
- 文档索引 · 架构 · 开发指南
- 后台虚拟屏 · 无障碍前置检查
- Eta 外部 Agent
- API 102 与热重载 · 第三方许可

免责声明

LLM 存在不可避免的错误，该插件权限极高，请自行监控设备状况。小米公司和该模块所有贡献者对使用本模块产生的一切后果概不负责。
modules.changelog:

- 新增 Eta 控屏协议。控屏页「动作协议」可选 Eta，控屏请求全部交给 Eta 规划和执行。
- 新增系统提示词页，可追加或替换小爱的系统提示词，并保存多套人设。默认关闭。
- 改进 Termux 命令执行：命令原样交给 Bash 运行，支持有时限的后台任务。
- 推理强度选项改为参考 models.dev 公开目录，新模型的合法强度值可随目录更新，减少对 APK 更新的依赖。
- 优化菜单样式、语音与语言路由、前台控屏上下文和诊断日志覆盖。

兼容 Android 13+、LSPosed API 102；支持小爱同学 8.2.65.4714 和 8.3.30.4420。

modules.name: Swift Backup Premium - Custom Firebase Backend & F
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Swift Backup Premium - Custom Firebase Backend & Feature Unlocker
modules.readme:
SwiftBackupPrem

An advanced Xposed / LSPosed / LSPatch module for Swift Backup that unlocks Premium features, enables cloud backups for local accounts, and supports isolated personal Firebase backends.

Table of Contents
- Features
- Core Features
- Cloud & Migration Capabilities
- Companion App & Usability
- How it Works
- Compatibility & Prerequisites
- Installation & Activation
- Method 1: Obtainium (Recommended)
- Method 2: Manual Download
- Rooted Activation (LSPosed / LibXposed)
- Rootless Setup (LSPatch)
- Android TV / Leanback Devices
- Choosing Your Cloud Workflow
- Local Account Cloud Features Guide
- How It Works Under the Hood
- Encryption Keys & Custom UID
- Custom Firebase Setup Guide
- Why Use Your Own Firebase Instance?
- Step 1: Create a Firebase Project
- Step 2: Set Up Realtime Database & Security Rules
- Step 3: Configure Authentication
- Step 4: Register Android App & OAuth Client
- Step 5: Enable Google Drive API & OAuth Scopes
- Step 6: Import or Enter Credentials in SwiftBackupPrem
- Migrating & Accessing Backups from Default Firebase
- Backup Migration
- Local Migrator (Decrypt, Convert & Re-encrypt)
- Universal Cloud Discovery & Snapshot Injection
- Firebase Realtime Database Metadata Sync
- LSPatch Rootless Integration & In-App Settings
- Configuration Export & Migration
- Building from Source
- Community & Support
- Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- Credits & Acknowledgements
- License & Disclaimer

Features

Core Features
- Unlocks Premium Features: Unlocks all Swift Backup Premium features (batch operations, scheduling, cloud backups, app data backup/restore, custom folder backups) without requiring Google Play Store licensing checks.
- Privacy & Telemetry Suppression: Blocks Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Sessions, Installations, and Google DataTransport calls to keep your backup operations private.
- Root & Rootless Environments: Works in rooted environments (Magisk, KernelSU, APatch with LSPosed or Vector) and non-rooted environments via JingMatrix/LSPatch.

Cloud & Migration Capabilities
- Local Account Cloud Features (Zero-Firebase Mode): Enables cloud backup creation, cloud file uploads, and cloud backup restores for offline/local accounts without requiring a Google account or Firebase project. Intercepts Realtime Database calls to persist catalog metadata locally and to cloud providers directly, with optional Custom Encryption UID for backups.
- Universal Cloud Discovery & Snapshot Injection: Multi-cloud scanner (Google Drive, Microsoft OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, pCloud, Amazon S3, WebDAV / Nextcloud / ownCloud) that discovers cloud backups without prior database records, injecting synthetic Firebase DataSnapshot objects directly into Swift Backup's native restore screens.
- Fast-Path Remote Discovery & Cloud Cache: Caches catalog metadata locally for instant offline navigation across restore screens, and synchronizes canonical cache files to cloud remotes for instant discovery on new devices.
- Remote APK Manifest Parsing via HTTP Range Requests: Uses ApkRangeManifestParser for cloud discovered backups to fetch only the remote APK ZIP Central Directory and parse AndroidManifest.xml via HTTP byte ranges in seconds, displaying exact app labels, package names, and version codes without downloading gigabytes of data.
- Google Drive Full OAuth Scope Expansion: Upgrades runtime OAuth scopes from restricted drive.file to full drive access so Swift Backup can query and restore backups uploaded from other devices or Swift Backup accounts on different Firebase projects.
- Local Backup Migrator & Re-encryptor: On-device cryptographic engine to decrypt archives, repair missing metadata, switch encryption keys (Shared Anonymous Key vs Custom Firebase UID), or export unencrypted portable archives (.apk, .tar.gz, .json).

Companion App & Usability
- Modern Material 3 UI: Clean user interface built with Jetpack Compose, Material 3 guidelines, dynamic color adaptation, and edge-to-edge support.
- Android TV / Leanback Support: Features a custom Leanback banner, native D-pad focus traversal, and big-screen friendly layouts for Android TV devices.
- In-App Settings Integration: When running in LSPatch Integrated Mode, module settings inject natively into Swift Backup's settings menu (Settings → SwiftBackupPrem).
- Guided Setup & 1-Tap Helpers: In-app Setup Wizard with clipboard helpers (Package Name, SHA-1 signing fingerprint) and one-tap import for google-services.json files.
- Configuration Export & Import: Export your active configuration to sbp_config.json and restore it instantly on fresh ROM installs or secondary devices.
- Quick Process Controls: One-tap Root Force Stop and Launch shortcuts directly within the app.

How it Works
- Dynamic DexKit Bytecode Scanning: Utilizes DexKit to dynamically locate obfuscated classes, methods, and fields at runtime across versions, ensuring robust compatibility with newer app releases without requiring fragile hardcoded ProGuard symbols.
- Native JNI Protection: Leverages a companion C native library (libnativelib.so) to intercept JNI_OnLoad calls, ensuring 16 KB kernel page-size alignment for Android 15+ devices.

Compatibility & Prerequisites

| Requirement                 | Details                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| :-------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |...

What's Changed in v3.2.0

Additions

modules.name: TwitterHideAds
modules.author: MrxSiN
modules.description: A focused Xposed module for removing promoted posts from the X Android app
modules.readme:
Twitter Hide Ads

An Xposed module that removes promoted posts and ads from X, with its ad policy written in Brainfuck. Yes, really.

Promoted posts and ads are stopped before X draws them, not hidden after.

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Español · Português · Русский · 日本語 · 한국어 · Bahasa Indonesia · Bahasa Melayu

X renames its obfuscated classes with almost every update. The module finds its targets again by
shape, caches them per X version and APK, and rescans after an update. When it cannot be sure it
installs nothing rather than guess. See the compatibility table for what has
actually been tested.

Why Brainfuck?

Surely nobody would write the decision logic of an ad blocker in Brainfuck.

Brainfuck was selected for its rich ecosystem, mature package manager, excellent Android SDK
bindings, comprehensive type system, first-class coroutine support, and famously pleasant
debugging experience.

Just joking.

The real idea is the one ThreadsHideAds proved out:
keep every decision about X out of the Android code. Whether an entry identifier is promoted,
how entry, metadata and fallback evidence rank, which Video Tab entries may go and when a rebuilt
batch is safe, how a Compose render boundary is recognised and scored — that is the part that has
to change when X changes, and it is the part that tends to leak into hook callbacks and reflection
helpers until nobody can say where the policy lives.

Brainfuck enforces that boundary, because it literally cannot call Android, Xposed, DexKit or JNI.
It reads bytes and writes bytes. Java reduces what it read to a handful of flags, roles and
character codes, sends them in one request, and does exactly what the answer says.
TwitterHideAds uses Brainfuck for its filtering and decision-policy core, while Android/Xposed
integration remains Java/native.

It is not slow either. The three programs are hand-written plain eight-command Brainfuck, compiled
ahead of time to C and then to native code with the NDK. There is no interpreter in the APK, and a
post is classified in about 2 µs on a Pixel 8 Pro — several times faster than the Java it replaced.

|  | |
|---|---|
| 🧹 Stopped before render | Promoted posts are declined at the Compose render boundary, so there is no blank gap and no flash of an ad. |
| 🌐 Every surface | Home, post detail, search and anything else that renders posts through the same boundaries; the Video Tab is filtered at its data layer. |
| 📰 Google ads too | The real-time-bidding ads X 12.37 serves through Google SSP are removed from the timeline data on Home, in conversations and in the Video Tab. |
| 🔎 Survives renames | DexKit finds the render boundaries by structure, cached per X version and APK fingerprint; an X update triggers a rescan. |
| 🧠 Policy in Brainfuck, compiled | Every decision is hand-written Brainfuck, compiled ahead of time to native code. One native call per post, no allocations. |
| 🛟 Fails open | Anything the module cannot classify is left alone. A failed policy request keeps the post. |
| 🧪 Proven identical | The old Java policy is kept as a test oracle; 411 162 comparisons per run check that old and new answers match. |

What it removes

A promoted post is recognised by its URT entry identifier, matched whole against a strict
grammar, or by a promoted-metadata model among its fields:

Home         promoted-tweet--
Post detail  conversationthread--promoted-tweet--
Search       search-conversation--promoted-tweet--
Video Tab    promoted-tweet-

Look-alikes such as not-promoted-x, unpromoted-1, promoted-deal or free text that mentions
"promoted" never count. A model with no recognisable identifier falls back to a bounded walk for the
promoted post actions (PromotedDismissAd, PromotedAdsInfo, PromotedReportAd). Organic posts,
replies and cursor, paging and control entries are never touched.

Since X 12.37 X also serves real-time-bidding ads through Google SSP. They are timeline items of
their own (UrtTimelineRtbImageAd), not posts, so no post boundary sees them. They are recognised
by that data-class name and removed from the timeline data; a conversation module is removed only
when everything inside it is such an ad. Event Summaries, which X 12.37 also routes through its
Google SSP code, are left alone.

🧱 The two layers

| Layer | Where | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| Render boundaries | the static Compose functions that draw a post, found by DexKit (9 on X 12.28.0) | Classifies the post model before the call; a promoted post returns without chain.proceed(). Each boundary is deoptimized so ART cannot run an inlined copy past the hook, and each must prove at runtime that it renders timeline entries or it is unhooked. |
| Video Tab dataset | the URT state-copy method that receives the tab's paging batch, found by structure | Rebuilds the Kotlin persistent list without promoted videos through the list's own builder, before the pager is created. Anything it cannot rebuild exactly is left alone. |
| RTB ads | the URT paging state's constructor and the timeline item-to-presenter mapper, found by DexKit once per X build | The paging state is built without RTB ads (Video Tab, conversations); the mapper hands an RTB ad on Home to X's own empty presenter, which X itself uses when Google SSP is off, so nothing is drawn and no gap is left. The constructor's inlined callers are deoptimized. Anything ambiguous installs nothing. |

Status

v3.1.0. Removes the Google SSP real-time-bidding ads X 12.37 added on Home, in conversations and
in the Video Tab, and adds a translated module description (14 languages) and user README
(8 languages). The policy core is unchanged since v3.0.0, which moved it from Java into three
hand-written Brainfuck programs, compiled ahead of time and checked against the frozen 2.1.0 Java
policy over hundreds of thousands of cases (docs/BRAINFUCK_ARCHITECTURE.md).

The release version is 3.1.0 (versionCode 35).

Compatibility

Each row is one setup somebody has actually run...
modules.changelog:
Twitter Hide Ads v3.1.0

Google SSP ads removed, and the module speaks 14 languages

X 12.37 started showing real-time-bidding ads served through Google SSP. They are not posts, so 3.0.0 never saw them: they appeared on Home, between conversation replies and as full pages in the Video Tab, while promoted posts were still blocked. This release removes them.

Fixed
- Real-time-bidding ads (UrtTimelineRtbImageAd, the cards with an "Ad" label and an Open or Install button) are removed on Home, in conversations and in the Video Tab.
- Video Tab and conversations: the ads are dropped from the timeline's paging state before it is built. A conversation module is dropped only when everything inside it is such an ad.
- Home: an RTB ad is handed to X's own empty presenter, the one X itself uses when Google SSP is off, so nothing is drawn and no gap is left.
- Event Summaries, which X 12.37.2 also renders through its Google SSP code, are left alone.
- The hooks are found by structure through DexKit once per X build and cached, so later starts add only a few milliseconds. Anything ambiguous installs nothing.
- The inlined-caller lookup no longer fails with UnsatisfiedLinkError when the boundary resolver was served from its cache.

Added
- The module description shown in Vector and LSPosed is translated into Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Indonesian, Hindi, Arabic, Turkish, Vietnamese, French and German.
- A short user README in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Indonesian, linked from a language bar on every README (#1).

Verified
- On a Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, Vector 2.2, X 12.37.2-prod.01: 3 full passes of 25 Home, 20 conversation and 20 Video Tab screens each showed no ad, with promoted posts still blocked and no crashes. Without the fix the same check found ads on most conversation screens and almost every Video Tab page.
- 74 JVM tests, including the 411 162-comparison policy parity suite and the new RTB filter tests.
- The first start after an X update spends about 3 s on DexKit discovery for the new hooks; later starts take 2–16 ms.

LSPatch, 32-bit and x86 devices were not run for this release.

Version metadata
- Version name: 3.1.0
- Android version code: 35
- Git tag: v3.1.0
- APK filename: TwitterHideAds-v3.1.0.apk

Updating

Install the v3.1.0 APK over v3.0.0, keep X (com.twitter.android) as the module's only scope, then force-stop and reopen X once. Confirm the framework log reports enforcement=ACTIVE_ADAPTIVE and RTB ad filter initialized with a mapper= other than none.

AnyDebug

English | 简体中文

Change your view attributes without restarting your application.

About

This software relies on the Xposed Framework, For more API details, visit their website.

Features
- Touch screen to select views, instead of clicking it, this is far more convenient
- Remove view
- Change views' visibility
- Change views' sizes
- Change views' layout margin/padding
- Change text of a TextView
- Change text size
- Change image, but currently only supports image url.
- Properties viewer.
- May be more...

TODO
- Extract as a libracy for integrating into apps for debugging purpose.

Usage

Install this app

Just download and install it from the latest releases page.

Check apps

Check apps you want to hook in LSPosed or other xposed framework. Don't forget to force stop it before using.

Mini window

A mini window shows the preview, selection switch, and the bottom drag bar inside.
- Click the preview to enter details page.
- Check the selection switch to start view selection. When this is on, touching on screen will select the nearest views from your touch point.
- Press the bottom drag bar then you can move the mini window to other positions.

Details page

Details page shows basic information and modification control. After modifing views' attributes, click the floating button below to confirm.

Properties page

The entry is Details page -> Properties, which shows all exported properties in a view. These properties are annotated with ViewDebug.ExportedProperty.

Quick setting

Add the quick setting button to notification control panel, you can toggle the state of the hook.

Max window

When the window is maximized, just drag the bottom bar and fling it to turn it back into a mini window.

modules.name: 不奇妙应用
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 不奇妙应用
modules.readme:
不奇妙应用

  对奇妙应用全家桶进行一些优化和破解

   支持框架 | LSPosed | LSPatch

介绍

不奇妙应用 是一款解锁优化奇妙应用及其全系列功能的模块，旨在使软件的使用更加方便简洁。

说明
在 GitHub 点击右上角 ⭐ Star 以支持我们在空余时间继续开发
- 一切开发旨在学习和提升用户体验，请勿用于非法用途
- 请勿用作商业用途或大肆分发，违者严惩
- 由于个人原因，可能随时停止更新或删除项目
- 本模块完全免费，如果您支付费用才获取软件，那么您受骗了

开发背景

本人是奇妙应用老用户，对奇妙应用的广告和投币机制较为反感，于是开发了这个模块。考虑到开发成本，于是又添加了另外四个软件的 Hook 支持。

在 V2.1.9 版本中，我们首次引入了设置界面，支持更多的模块定制化，功能如图所示：

详细适配

奇妙应用
*支持v1.3.9版本*

功能：
- 解锁Premium会员权限
- 附件免硬币查看
- 去除所有广告
- 支持自定义硬币、粉丝、关注、付费、等级
- 支持一键自动签到

由于 奇妙应用 功能较多，我们为用户提供了一个设置对话框。只需打开奇妙应用的设置页面，设置对话框就会自动弹出。

安卓清理君
*支持v3.8.7版本*

功能：
- 去除所有广告
- 免登录使用
- 解锁永久会员

朝花夕拾
*支持v1.3.4版本*

功能：
- 去除所有广告
- 免登录使用
- 解锁永久会员

奇妙扫描
*支持v1.0.7版本*

功能：
- 去除所有广告
- 免登录使用
- 解锁永久会员

奇妙工具箱
*支持v0.4.1版本*

功能：
- 去除广告
- 免登录使用
- 解锁永久会员
此软件很多VIP功能在云端执行，无法完全破解

开始使用

1. 下载
在发行渠道中，选择合适的发行渠道，下载符合您系统环境的最新版本或者前往 LSPosed 官方页面进行下载。
如果您是特殊区域用户，因为网络环境而无法访问，请您转到其他问题查看解答。

2. 安装
在设备上安装安装包，给予程序所需要的权限，同意 《软件使用声明》 ，然后在模块管理器中启用模块并勾选模块作用域。

3. 运行
运行作用域软件 ，然后尽情享受吧 ！

发行渠道

|  | GitHub Releases | 正式版 |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|

|  | Gitee Releases | 正式版 |
|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------|---------------|

|  | Xposed-Modules-Repo | 正式版 |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|

|  | 蓝奏云网盘 (密码：8888) | 正式版 (备用) |
|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|

本模块发布地址仅限于上述所列出的地址，从其他非正规渠道下载到的版本或对您造成任何影响均与我们无关。

其他问题

1.  Q : 为什么 不奇妙应用 没有在我的设备上正常运行？
A  : 不奇妙应用 由 AIDE Pro 开发，在 *Android 10* 、 *Android 11* 、 *Android 12* 、 *Android 13* 等系统均测试成功，理论上适用于大多数用户 ，但是请确保您的安卓版本不要过低或过高。如果您在确认完这些条件后， 不奇妙应用 还是不能在您的设备上正常运行，可能是 不奇妙应用 还未适配您的设备或 CPU 架构，请您向我们提交意见后，耐心等待下一个版本的优化升级。

2. Q : 为什么 不奇妙应用 的功能相对来说还是比较少？
A : 因为 不奇妙应用 才刚刚开始开发，我们由于工作的原因，我们只能挤出周末的空闲时间来进行代码编写。但是对于日常使用来说，这些功能是完全够用的。

3. Q : 为什么 不奇妙应用 在作用域软件更新后，Hook 功能会失效？
A : 因为作用域软件对方法和类进行了一定强度的混淆，我们无法保证更新的软件仍适配于原先的 Hook 方法。请时常打开模块主页接收更新、查看 LSPosed 的更新页面或关注发行渠道中的渠道更新。

4. Q : 在更新或逆向修改 不奇妙应用 后，为什么会提示“安全检测异常”的弹窗？且在打开应用域软件时，提示"模块不合法"？
A : 您触发了 不奇妙应用 的完整性校验。为了防止不法分子二改软件，我们设置了低强度的完整性校验，包括签名校验和其他校验。如果您触发了完整性校验，那么您应意识到您极大可能下载的是盗版软件。由于某些未知问题，如果在更新时触发，那么您只需清空软件的所有存储，再次打开软件尝试即可。
在V2.2.0版本中，我们引入了"安全修复"模式。您只需授予模块 Root 或文件读取权限，并在主页的菜单中找到"安全修复"选项，点击即可解除限制。

5. Q : 为何在用一些免 Root 框架时，作用域软件功能可能失效甚至闪退？
A : 由于奇妙应用有 360加固 ，所以当使用免 Root 框架时，只要修改了安装包，作用域应用就会闪退。除奇妙应用外的所有应用理论上都支持免 Root 框架。但是当作用域软件更新时，由于类名和方法名的变化，功能也可能失效。

6. Q : 为什么在奇妙应用的设置对话框中，或在模块本身的设置页面中，保存设置后仍未生效？
A : 您需要检查您是否给予了 不奇妙应用 和作用域应用需要的权限，比如 Root 权限 、 文件读写权限 等。因为设置需要存储在公共目录或私有目录，以便软件进行读取。

7. Q : 我是特殊区域用户，访问有问题怎么办 ？
A  : 没关系，我们为您准备了备用的下载链接，我们保证备用链接下载的软件和发行版是完全一样的，而且我们在 Gitee 等开源社区也有我们的仓库。您可以前往发行渠道，移步到其他渠道下载 。

modules.readme:
网络增强 Network_Enhance (AxManager 免Root 网络优化)
中国大陆网络优化模块 — 严格遵循 AxManager 官方插件协议
作者：寒碑听风 · 协议：MIT
适用于 Android 14+ 国产手机（小米/OPPO/vivo/华为/荣耀/三星）

⚠️ 免Root环境下的能力边界（重要！请先阅读）

本模块基于 AxManager 的 ADB 免Root 权限运行，无法突破系统级限制。以下能力边界请明确知悉：

❌ 免Root下无法实现的功能
1. 完全禁用 4G+ 载波聚合（CA）
- Android 14/15 上没有公开的 settings global 键可直接禁用载波聚合
- 本模块通过锁定 LTE Only（mode=11）+ 关闭 ENDC 间接降低跳频概率
- **完全禁用 4G+ 需 Root 权限或工程模式（*#*#3646633#*#*）**
- 效果因设备和运营商而异

2. **setprop persist.* 写入**
- 免Root下 setprop 只能修改非 persist.* 的属性
- 原 v6.3.x 的 system.prop（persist.sys.satellite_earth.*）在免Root下完全不生效
- 本版本已移除 system.prop，功能迁移到 settings put global

3. service call phone 直接调用
- 免Root下大部分 phone service 调用会因权限被拒
- 网络制式切换只能通过 settings put global preferred_network_mode 间接实现

4. 各品牌私有 cmd 子命令
- 经搜索验证，没有任何国产手机品牌提供公开的私有 cmd 子命令用于网络优化

⚠️ 使用限制与副作用
1. LTE Only 模式的语音副作用
- 游戏模式或手动锁定 LTE（菜单 31）会启用 LTE Only（mode=11）
- 非 VoLTE 环境下的电话可能无法接入（无法回落 2/3G）
- 游戏结束请及时执行"解锁 LTE"（菜单 32）或"恢复默认优化"（菜单 5）
- 模块会通过通知明确告知用户此副作用

2. Data Saver 的全局影响
- 游戏模式会开启系统级 Data Saver（cmd netpolicy set restrict-background true）
- 这会影响所有应用的后台数据使用
- 游戏结束执行"恢复默认优化"会自动关闭 Data Saver
- 卸载模块时 uninstall.sh 会兜底关闭 Data Saver

3. 华为/荣耀/三星 PNM 写入可能受限
- 部分版本的华为/荣耀/三星 ROM 会忽略 preferred_network_mode 写入
- 本模块对这三个品牌启用写入验证机制（循环验证 3 次 + 功能性验证）
- 验证失败会标记"PNM 受限"，避免后续反复尝试无效写入

核心功能

1. 5G 假满格自动降级（核心新增）
问题场景：5G 信号满格但实际几乎无网（延迟极高/丢包严重）

解决方案：
- 每 120 秒检测一次 5G 信号质量（RSRP + SINR + Ping）
- 判定条件（满足任一即判定为假满格）：
- RSRP ≥ -85 dBm（信号强度好）但 Ping > 200ms
- RSRP ≥ -85 dBm 但 SINR  200ms 或 SINR < 0
- 等级切换发送通知 + 后台应用动态参数
- 与 weaknet 严格隔离：游戏/视频模式激活时，调度器绝对禁止任何 PNM 操作

6. 场景模式（5 个）
| 模式 | 主要调整 | DNS 预热 |
|---|---|---|
| 视频模式 | WiFi 弱信号 -95，扫描 10s | 抖音/B站/快手/西瓜/爱奇艺/优酷 |
| 游戏模式 | LTE Only + ENDC=0 + Data Saver | 腾讯/网易/米哈游 |
| 社交模式 | 保 WiFi，DNS 预热 | 微信/QQ/DNSPod |
| 下载模式 | WiFi idle 6h | 淘宝/京东/百度网盘/123pan |
| 恢复默认 | 关闭 Data Saver + 恢复 5G + 重启调度器 | - |

7. 智能 DNS 选择
- 6 家 DoT 提供商：阿里/腾讯/360/AdGuard/DNSPod/苏宁
- auto 模式自动 ping 测试，选延迟最低的提供商
- 保留 Private DNS (DoT) 防泄漏功能

模块结构

Network_Enhance/
├── module.prop                    # 模块清单（id=Network_Enhance）
├── customize.sh                   # 安装脚本（路径解析6级fallback + 自检bug修复）
├── post-fs-data.sh                # BOOT_COMPLETED first sync（静态优化, 不启动调度器）
├── service.sh                     # BOOT_COMPLETED late_start（late_verify + 启动调度器）
├── action.sh                      # 用户主动触发（32 项菜单）
├── uninstall.sh                   # 卸载清理（Data Saver兜底 + 深度清理残留）
├── config.sh                      # 用户配置中心（14类参数）
├── banner.png / LICENSE / README.md / CHANGELOG.md
├── scripts/
│   ├── common.sh                  # 核心函数库（版本检测/RSRP解析/假满格判定）
│   ├── oem_compat.sh              # OEM 兼容性矩阵（6厂商 + PNM写入验证）
│   ├── monitor.sh                 # 动态调度器（120s间隔/5G降级/防振荡冷却）
│   ├── network_info.sh            # 网络状态采集（cmd wifi status优先 + 5G信号）
│   ├── wifi.sh / carrier.sh       # WiFi/运营商优化
│   ├── dns.sh                     # Private DNS（含智能选择）
│   └── weaknet.sh                 # 弱网自救（5场景模式）
└── webroot/
    └── index.html                 # WebUI 控制面板

已移除：system.prop（persist.* 免Root不生效）

安装与激活

前置要求
1. Android 14+ 国产手机
2. AxManager 应用已安装（v1.0+）
3. 无线调试已启用（Android 11+）

安装步骤
1. 在 AxManager 中选择 Network_Enhance_{版本号}.zip 安装（CI版本为 Network_Enhance_ci_{时间戳}.zip）
2. 重启手机
3. 重新激活 AxManager（无线调试模式）
4. 在 AxManager 中点击模块"界面"按钮打开 WebUI

卸载
- 在 AxManager 中卸载模块
- uninstall.sh 会自动执行：
- 关闭 Data Saver
- 恢复 5G 网络制式
- 还原所有 WiFi/移动网络设置
- 清理所有运行时残留文件
- 杀掉存活的 monitor.sh 进程

各场景模式说明

视频模式（菜单 1）
适用：抖音/B站/快手/爱奇艺等视频卡顿
- WiFi 弱信号阈值 -95 dBm（容忍弱信号）
- 扫描间隔 10s（快速重连）
- DNS 预热视频平台域名（含抖音 API 域名）
- 关闭 WiFi 休眠优化

游戏模式（菜单 2）
适用：打游戏延迟高/4G+ 跳频断流
- 锁定 LTE Only（mode=11）+ 关闭 ENDC
- 开启 Data Saver 禁止后台抢带宽
- DNS 预热腾讯/网易/米哈游
- ⚠️ 会发送语音副作用通知：非 VoLTE 来电可能无法接通

社交模式（菜单 3）
适用：微信/QQ 消息延迟
- 保 WiFi（mobile_data_preferred=0）
- DNS 预热微信/QQ/DNSPod
- 关闭 WiFi 休眠优化

下载模式（菜单 4）
适用：大文件下载
- WiFi idle 6 小时（持续传输不中断）
- DNS 预热淘宝/京东/百度网盘/123pan

恢复默认优化（菜单 5）
- 关闭 Data Saver（绝对还原）
- 调用 carrier.sh unlock-lte 联动恢复 5G
- 清除 PNM 受限标记
- 重启调度器

5G/LTE 制式管理（菜单 30/31/32）
- 菜单 30：5G 假满格自检（显示 RSRP/SINR/Ping + 判定结果）
- 菜单 31：手动锁定 LTE Only（与游戏模式同款 + 语音通知）
- 菜单 32：解锁 LTE，恢复运营商默认 5G

支持的品牌与系统版本

| 品牌 | 系统 | 最低 Android | PNM 支持 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 小米/Redmi/POCO | MIUI/HyperOS | Android 14 | ✅ | nr_sa_mode→nr_mode 替换 |
| OPPO/OnePlus/Realme | ColorOS/OxygenOS | Android 14 | ✅ | 全部键可写（主测试环境） |
| vivo/iQOO | Funtouch/OriginOS | Android 14 | ✅ | nr_sa_mode 跳过避免崩溃 |
| 三星 | OneUI | Android 14 | ⚠️ | PNM 部分版本会忽略，启用验证 |
| 华为 | HarmonyOS/EMUI | Android 14 | ✅ | 5G NR 键跳过，PNM 可用，启用验证 |
| 荣耀 | MagicOS | Android 14 | ✅ | 同华为 |

常见问题与排障

Q1: 模块安装后 WebUI 显示"API 不可用"
A:
1. 确认 AxManager 已通过无线调试激活
2. 重启 AxManager 应用
3. 在 WebUI 诊断面板点击"重新诊断"
4. 检查 Android WebView 是否正常

Q2: 5G 假满格降级后一直不恢复
A:
- 防振荡冷却期为 30 分钟，期间不会恢复
- 冷却期后需连续 3 次检测正常（6 分钟）才恢复
- 可在 config.sh 中调整 DOWNGRADE_COOLDOWN_SEC（默认 1800）和 DEGRADE_RECOVERY_COUNT（默认 3）
- 紧急情况可手动执行菜单 32（解锁 LTE）

Q3: 游戏模式后接不到电话
A:
- 游戏模式锁定 LTE Only，非 VoLTE 来电可能无法接通
- 这是免Root下的固有限制
- 游戏结束请立即执行菜单 5（恢复默认）或菜单 32（解锁 LTE）

Q4: 华为/荣耀设备 PNM 切换无效
A:
- 部分版本的华为/荣耀 ROM 会忽略 PNM 写入
- 模块会自动标记"PNM 受限"，不再反复尝试
- 可通过菜单 26（模块自检）查看 PNM 受限状态
- 可通过菜单 32（解锁 LTE）清除标记重试

Q5: 自检报告显示 customize.sh 缺失
A:
- 本版本已修复此 bug（v6.3.x 的已知问题）
- 自检逻辑已增加 pwd 兜底，不会再误报

Q6: 公网延迟显示 "2000 ms (较差)" 是什么意思
A:
- 这是模块的nc 端口可达性兜底生效的正常表现
- 在 AxManager 的 ADB shell 环境下，原生 ping 命令可能因 SELinux 或网络权限限制执行失败
- 模块会自动通过 nc -w 2 -z 223.5.5.5 53 测试端口可达性作为兜底
- 若 nc 可达，则返回 2000（代表网络连通但延迟无法精确测算）
- 若 nc 也不通，则显示 timeout (不通)（代表网络彻底不通）
- 这不是 bug，而是免Root环境下的正常降级表现，5G 假满格判定仍可基于 RSRP/SINR 正常工作

Q7: 卸载后后台应用无法联网
A:
- 这是 Data Saver 未关闭导致
- uninstall.sh 会兜底关闭 Data Saver
- 如仍异常，手动执行：adb shell cmd netpolicy set restrict-background false

Q8: 调度器日志显示"PNM 受限"
A:
- 该品牌 ROM 忽略了 PNM 写入
- 5G 假满格降级功能在该设备上不可用
- 其他功能（WiFi 优化、DNS、场景模式）仍正常工作

配置参数说明

所有参数在 config.sh 中，修改后需重启调度器（菜单 21）生效。

核心参数
CARRIER="auto"                    # 运营商: auto|telecom|mobile|unicom|ctn|off
ENABLE_MONITOR=true               # 智能调度器总开关
ENABLE_FAKE_5G_DETECTION=true     # 5G 假满格检测总开关
ENABLE_LTE_LOCK_FOR_GAME=true     # 游戏模式锁定 LTE
MONITOR_NORMAL_INTERVAL=120       # 检测间隔（秒，统一120）

5G 假满格判定参数...

charging-bypass-magisk
Charging Bypass Magisk Module — Android 14–16 supported. Disables charging when screen is ON and re-enables when OFF. Useful for gaming/dev use. Kernel-level control. Tested on Miatoll (AOSP 16). Logs saved to /sdcard/charging_bypass.log

Charging Bypass Magisk Module (v1.0)

Run your phone plugged in without charging the battery while the screen is ON. Charging automatically resumes when the screen turns OFF.

⚙️ Features
- 🔌 Disable charging when screen is ON
- ⚡ Re-enable charging when screen is OFF
- 🧾 Logs activity to /sdcard/charging_bypass.log
- ✅ Designed for Miatoll and compatible ROMs
- 📲 Supports Android 14, 15, 16

📦 Installation
1. Download charging-bypass-v1.0.zip from Releases
2. Open Magisk Manager → Modules → Install from storage
3. Reboot your device
4. Plug in charger and monitor behavior

🧪 How To Test
- With charger connected, turn screen ON → battery % should stop increasing
- Turn screen OFF → charging icon returns
- Check kernel state via:
    cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/charging_enabled
🥳😜 Support This Project

If you like this project and want to support future development:

-📲 UPI: "kabhishek2972@ybl"

Every small contribution helps!

modules.author: CHERWIN

modules.readme:
CHERWIN FRPC
  高性能 FRP 内网穿透客户端 · KernelSU / Magisk 专版

    中文 ·
    English

项目简介

CHERWIN FRPC 是一个专为 Android Root 环境（KernelSU & Magisk）打造的 FRP 内网穿透模块。内嵌最新 FRPC 核心（v0.69.1），通过 KernelSU WebView 原生 API 提供完整的管理面板，无需 busybox、无需 httpd，开箱即用。

功能特性

🚀 核心能力
- 全协议穿透 — TCP / UDP / HTTP / HTTPS / STCP / XTCP / SUDP
- token 认证 — 与服务端安全通信
- 负载均衡 & 健康检查 — 多节点自动切换
- Store 持久化 — FRP v0.52+ store 特性，防重启掉线

🖥️ WebUI 管理面板
- 实时状态 — 进程存活、服务端连接、代理通道在线/离线
- 连接异常看门狗 — 自动检测日志错误，即时重启 frpc
- 定时运行调度器 — 设置起止时间，时段外自动休眠省电
- 网络守卫 — 断网自动停止，网络恢复自动启动
- 低电量保护 — 可自定义阈值（默认 20%）
- 配置热重载 — 在线编辑 frpc.toml，保存即重启
- 内置配置手册 — 完整配置教程和代理模板参考

💾 配置持久化
- 配置文件自动备份到 /data/local/tmp/，刷写模块不丢失
- 安装脚本和开机脚本双层兜底恢复

📜 独立脚本
- start.sh / stop.sh / restart.sh — MT 管理器可直接执行
- uninstall.sh — 卸载时自动清理
- action.sh — 模块列表「▶」快捷启停

安装

前置条件
- Android 设备已获取 Root 权限
- 已安装 KernelSU（推荐）或 Magisk
- 仅支持 arm64（aarch64） 架构

安装步骤

1. 下载最新发布包
从 GitHub Releases 下载 CHERWIN_FRPC_magisk_module.zip

2. 刷入模块
KernelSU / Magisk → 模块 → 从本地安装 → 选择 ZIP

3. 重启设备

首次配置

1. 打开 KernelSU → 模块列表 → 点击 CHERWIN FRPC 的 WebUI（<>） 按钮
2. 切换到「配置」标签页
3. 修改 serverAddr 和 auth.token 为你的服务器信息
4. 点击「保存」，frpc 自动重启生效
⚠️ 管理面板需在 KernelSU 模块 WebView 内打开（依赖 ksu.exec() API），不支持外部浏览器

使用方法

基础流程
1. 填写服务器地址和 token → 保存
2. 添加需要的代理通道（TCP / HTTP / HTTPS 等）
3. frpc 自动启动，在状态页查看连接

定时运行（省电）
- 开启「定时运行」，设置每天运行时段（如 08:00–22:00）
- 时段外 frpc 自动停止并进入长睡眠

故障重启（防掉线）
- 开启「故障重启」，看门狗每 20 秒检测日志
- 检测到连接错误且无成功 → 自动重启 frpc

网络守卫（防异常）
- 检测到网络不通 → 自动停止 frpc
- 网络恢复 → 自动重新启动

低电量保护（防耗电）
- 电量低于阈值（默认 20%）且未充电 → 自动停止
- 充电恢复后调度器自动拉起

配置持久化说明

| 触发时机 | 备份内容 | 备份路径 |
|---------|---------|---------|
| WebUI 保存配置 | frpc.toml | /data/local/tmp/.frpc_config_backup |
| WebUI 保存模块设置 | settings.conf | /data/local/tmp/.frpc_settings_backup |
| 开机成功连接服务端 | frpc.toml | /data/local/tmp/.frpc_config_backup |
| 刷写新版本 | — | 安装脚本自动从备份恢复 |

常见问题

Q：WebUI 打不开？
从 KernelSU 模块列表点击「WebUI（<>）」进入，不要用浏览器直接打开。

Q：状态一直显示「检测中」？
关闭页面重新点击 WebUI 按钮打开。

Q：刷写模块后配置会丢吗？
v1.2.0 以上不会。配置自动备份到 /data/local/tmp/，刷写时自动恢复。

Q：连接异常但不自动恢复？

modules.author: Adinata | @Adivenxnataly
modules.description: Enhance Display Calibration for universal Android devices (this module using surfaceflinger for color saturation & disable VSYNC, for color saturation u can change the value manually from 1.0 - 1.5).
modules.readme:
Display Calibration

Display Calibration is a module that implements various features such as Enhance Color Saturation, Disable VSYNC & DynamicRange for universal Android devices.
[!warning]
I didn't combine them all because there was a bug when combining DynamicRange and Disable VSYNC, which resulted in a crash on the surfaceflinger resulting in a blank screen.

Color Saturation

1.x - 2.x (non-suffix) version
default version using surfaceflinger for color saturation & u can change the value manually from 1.0 - 2.0.

 service running, with terminal use su (superuser) access :

    service call SurfaceFlinger 1022 f 1.25

 persistent on boot (property) :

    resetprop -n persist.sys.sf.color_saturation 1.25
default value 1.0, maximum value 2.0

| types    | command                                              |      value     |
|:-------- |:-----------------------------------------------------|:---------------|
| property | resetprop -n persist.sys.sf.color_saturation  | 1.0 - 2.0      |
| command  | service call SurfaceFlinger 1022 f            | 1.0 - 2.0      |

Disable VSYNC
[!note]
vx.x-200 (suffix) version
for this version x.x-200 using disable VSYNC for better experience. before you install this version, try to find out if the device you are using uses VSYNC, with the command:

    dumpsys SurfaceFlinger | grep -A 15 "DesiredDisplayModeSpecs"

 | output | VSYNC |
 |:-------|:------|
 | Idle   | disable |
 | Vsync  | enable |

 focus on "app: state=" if the description is Vsync it means your device is using VSYNC, if the description is Idle then the device is using disable VSYNC.
 with the command:

    service call SurfaceFlinger 1036 i32 0
value: 0 for disable, 1 for enable.
[!caution]
If you have installed but the description remains Vsync instead of Idle, then you must restart the surfaceflinger with the following steps:
- open terminal (adb, Termux, etc.) run with root access su
- then, stop surfaceflinger (ur screen automatically goes blank) and reboot manually by pressing the power button.
- done!

DynamicRange
[!note]
x.x-x10 (suffix) version
for this version xx-x10 using Color Matrix (RGBA) Dominan for increase DynamicRange (brightness and darkness).
 with this command:

     service call SurfaceFlinger 1015 i32 1 f 1.05 f 0 f 0 f 0 f 0 f 1.05 f 0 f 0 f 0 f 0 f 1.05

| Number | Float value      | Color     |
|:-------|:-----------------|:----------|
| 1      | f 1.05 (first) | Red 🔴    |
| 6      | f 1.05 (second)| Green 🟢  |
| 11     | f 1.05 (third) | Blue 🔵   |
the configuration for f (float) values is like this: R G B A R G B A R G B A and change R G B in different places, so it's not directly R G B A like this service call SurfaceFlinger 1015 i32 1 f 1.05 f 1.05 f 1.05 and not use value for alpha.
value: 0 - 1 (normal), but in this module used 1.05 to make it stronger (not recommended).

 • for disable ColorMatrix to restore to default:

     service call SurfaceFlinger 1015 i32 0

The Result
- this result is an illustration of the results using v1.25-010 with DynamicRange

Requirement
[!important]
Android 7+ (API 24)
doesn't cause softbrick or bootloop.

this is module version so install using Magisk app:
 Download from Release page

- Android 12 - MIUI 13

modules.description: 专为 Google Chrome 打造的功能增强 Xposed 模块，基于现代 LibXposed API 102 架构与 MD3 Expressive 设计规范。支持启动直开主页、清空历史标签、跳过所有下载警告与弹窗、隐藏横幅等。
modules.readme:
﻿# 增强 Chrome (Enhanced Chrome)

专为 Google Chrome (Android 稳定版) 深度定制的功能增强 Xposed 模块。

基于现代 LibXposed (API 102) 原生架构构建，界面采用 Material Design 3 (MD3) Expressive 规范设计，支持 Android 8.0 ~ Android 16+。

✨ 核心特性

1. 🚀 启动行为优化
- 冷启动直开主页：启动 Chrome 时禁止自动恢复上次退出的历史标签页，直接打开默认主页，并清空所有未保存的历史标签。
- 新建标签页 (+) 直达主页：点击新建标签页按钮时，直接导航至设置好的自定义主页，跳过默认新标签页。
- 清空历史标签：打开主页或冷启动时，彻底清空「最近关闭的标签页」历史记录，保护浏览隐私。

2. 🛡️ 下载弹窗全自动跳过
告别频繁、恼人的下载确认与安全警告对话框：
- 去除「文件可能有害」警告（有害/危险类型 APK、可执行文件跳过确认，自动继续下载）
- 去除「无法安全地下载」警告（非 HTTPS 不安全连接下载直接开始）
- 去除「重复下载」确认弹窗（同名文件自动保留下载）
- 去除「策略警告」下载限制弹窗
- 去除「位置与重命名」路径询问弹窗（自动存入默认存储目录）
- 去除下载完成底部的「要打开此文件吗」询问对话框

3. 📦 下载体验增强
- APK 下载完成自动安装：Android 应用安装包下载完毕后，自动唤起系统软件包安装程序。
- 重复下载同名覆盖：同名下载时不追加 (1) 等后缀，直接覆盖原文件。
- 按扩展名自动关联打开：支持按文档、表格、PPT、压缩包、PDF、音视频、电子书等分类自定义自动调用外部系统应用打开。

4. 🔕 横幅与系统提示优化
- 隐藏下载横幅：下载文件与完成时不弹出占用屏幕顶部空间的下载卡片横幅。
- 隐藏网页翻译横幅：访问外语网页时不弹出顶部 Google 网页翻译建议横幅。
- 下载完成转轻量 Toast：将顶部臃肿的完成横幅替换为原生的浮动 Toast 提示。

5. 🎨 现代设计规范
- MD3 Expressive 设计：卡片式流线圆角分组、平滑动效、完备的日间/夜间深色模式配色适配。
- 原生 Chrome 图标：提取自 Chrome 官方无损 WebP 资产，完美适配 Android 自适应图标，无黑底、无毛边。
- 静态作用域 (Static Scope)：在 LSPosed 中开箱即用，精准绑定 com.android.chrome，无需手动翻找应用列表。

📲 安装与使用要求

1. Root / Xposed 环境：
- 推荐使用 LSPosed（支持 Zygisk / KernelSU / APatch / Magisk）。
2. 目标浏览器：
- 适配 Google Chrome 153 及后续主流版本（包名：com.android.chrome）。
3. 启用模块：
- 在 LSPosed 管理器中启用「增强 Chrome」，重启 Google Chrome 即可生效。

🛠️ 项目构建

本项目使用 Gradle 构建：

git clone https://github.com/Rove24/EnhancedChrome.git
cd EnhancedChrome
./gradlew assembleRelease

编译产物位于 app/build/outputs/apk/release/。

📄 开源许可

本项目遵循 MIT License 开源。仅供 Android 逆向技术交流与个人日常效率提升学习使用。
modules.changelog:
增强 Chrome v0.8 更新说明 🛠️

本版本为重要稳定性与缺陷修复更新，重点重构了主页解析与标签页生命周期链路，彻底解决在 Chrome 153 上打开浏览器或点击新建标签页时出现 about:blank 空白页的问题。

🐛 核心修复与改进

1. 彻底修复冷启动与新建标签页变成 about:blank 的严重 Bug
- 原因剖析：Chrome 本地存储的自定义主页采用的是包含 \u0000 NUL 字符的二进制序列化格式（GURL.n() 序列化数据）。旧版模块直接读取原始配置注入给新标签页，导致 Chromium 底层解析 URL 遇到非法字符判定失效，被迫降级回退到 about:blank。
- 重构方案：
- 废弃直接读取 SharedPreferences 原始字符串的做法，改用 Chrome 官方 HomepageManager 获取经过内核严格反序列化后的有效 GURL；
- 增加 URL 合法性严格校验（isValidUrl），拦截任何非法字符与畸形数据；
- 当主页为 Chrome 原生新标签页（NTP）时，完全保留原生执行链路，杜绝多余篡改，确保新标签页毫秒级秒开。

2. 重构冷启动标签管理与安全防线
- 彻底废弃旧版易失效的反射创建逻辑，替换为通过 Tab.loadUrl(LoadUrlParams) 安全平滑导航；
- 引入最低存活标签保护（closeOtherTabsSafely），确保无论何种异常情况下都始终保留至少 1 个有效活动标签页，根除标签页归零导致的 Activity 空白异常。

3. 细节与兼容性优化
- 解决多 ClassLoader 环境下 openNewTab 重复拦截的冲突；
- 修复了版本关于信息中弹窗展示版本号的同步更新。

📥 下载与安装
- 适用于 Google Chrome 153 及后续主流版本；
- 需搭配 LSPosed (现代 LibXposed API 102 架构)；
- 直接下载下方 Assets 中的 增强 Chrome_v0.8.apk 覆盖安装，重启 Chrome 即可生效。

modules.name: FiiO Android Tweaker
modules.author: WheresWaldo @(GitHub|Head-Fi)
modules.description: This module tweaks your FiiO Android DAP, for better memory management and application performance. Removes zswap, adjusts scheduler, debloats, all in one script.
modules.readme:
FiiOat
 FiiO Android Tweaker .
A Magisk module to Tweak Kernel parameters, zswap size, and minimal debloater. This module applies at boot.

Since you have found this page you should already have a fundamental knowledge of how Magisk modules work. Other than a version of Magisk newer that v20.4 and a rooted FiiO device there are no other prerequisites. Since this module is a tweak and debloat combination, it is suggested that you do not run any other kernel tweak modules or debloating modules for Android at the same time.

This module is a highly modified version of YAKT by NotZeetea(@github.com) [https://github.com/NotZeetaa/YAKT]. It is not a fork, but rather a standalone 'inspired by' port specifically to support FiiO Android DAPs and there idiosyncratic implementation of Android.
Parts of this module have been sourced from other shell scripts.

While this module is specifically designed for the FiiO M21/JM21 DAP it may work on other devices. Note that all the changes made by this module are available in the FiiO kernel (Android 13 devices) and may not be available in DAPs made by other manufacturers, in other word, it might or might not work on other DAPs!

No warranty as to servicablity of this module is either expressed or implied. User assumes all risk by downloading and using this module.

What this module does:
- Reduces Jitter and Latency
- Optimizes Ram Management
- Disables scheduler logs/stats
- Disables printk logs
- Disables SPI CRC
- Tweaks mglru
- Allows sched boosting on top-app tasks (Thx to tytydraco)
- Tweaks uclamp scheduler (Credits to darkhz for uclamp tweak)
- Sets -20 (highest priority) for the most essential processes
- Uses Google's schedutil rate-limits
- Removes some unnecessary apps from firmware
- Removes zswap (compressed RAM)
- Forces FiiO secondary apps to not autorun
- Small SYSTEM application tweaks
- Window animations
- Blur effects
- Provides smooth and balanced running of Music apps
- Adds properties for Wavelet Enhanced Audio Detection
- Adds support for Pano Scrobbler

What the module doesn't:
- Require additional modules for complete implementation
- Require additional applications
- Proport to change the soundstage or any other aspect of the sound!
- Make permanent changes to your device (everything is systemless)
- Change settings that don't need changing

Notes:
- This is not a gaming/video module!
- This is not a sound shaping module!

How to install:

Quick Install:
1. Download the latest release from Releases
2. Flash in Magisk Manager
3. Reboot

Build from Source:
git clone https://github.com/WheresWaldo/FiiOat.git
cd FiiOat

Install the generated ZIP file via Magisk Manager

How to check logs:

- Check error.log text file in /data/adb/modules/fiioat/ folder

Via ADB:
adb shell
su
cat /data/adb/modules/fiioat/info.log
cat /data/adb/modules/fiioat/error.log

What's New in the latest release:
- Check release notes accompanying module release

How to Contribute:
- Fork the Repo

- Commit with proper name and info/docs about what you did
- Test the change you did and check if eveything it's fine
- Then make a pull request

modules.description: KeyFlux is an LSPosed/Xposed module for customizing Google Gboard, exposing selected hidden features, and adding clipboard-related enhancements.
modules.readme:
KeyFlux

KeyFlux is an LSPosed/Xposed module for customizing Google Keyboard (Gboard).

It focuses on exposing selected hidden or experimental Gboard options, improving clipboard behavior, and integrating additional settings into Gboard's native settings interface when supported by the installed Gboard version.

Features
- Hidden Gboard Flags
- Exposes selected internal Gboard flags through configurable settings.
- Availability may depend on the installed Gboard version.
- Experimental Features
- Optional toggles for selected experimental Gboard capabilities.
- Some features may depend on Google server-side configuration, Gboard version, device ROM, or Android version.
- Clipboard Enhancements
- Adds configurable clipboard history retention options.
- Supports longer retention behavior where compatible.
- Designed not to log clipboard contents or copied sensitive text.
- Gboard Settings Integration
- Injects KeyFlux options into supported Gboard settings screens.
- Attempts to match Gboard's native layout style where possible.
- Compatibility Fallbacks
- Uses a safer initialization path with fallback hook handling.
- Prevents duplicate initialization within the same process.

Compatibility

Compatibility may vary depending on Android version, ROM, Gboard version, and hook framework.

Tested / Targeted
- Target app: Google Gboard
- Hook frameworks:
- Vector recommended
- LSPosed-compatible frameworks may work, but behavior can vary
- Architecture:
- arm64-v8a
- x86_64

Notes
- Some hidden or experimental Gboard flags may not exist in every Gboard version.
- Some features may be controlled remotely by Google and may not activate even if the local flag is enabled.
- Samsung One UI and heavily modified ROMs may require additional fallback handling.

Installation

1. Install an LSPosed-compatible hook framework on a rooted device.
2. Download the latest KeyFlux APK from the Releases page.
3. Install the APK.
4. Enable the KeyFlux module in your hook framework manager.
5. Select Gboard as the module scope.
6. Force stop Gboard.
7. Open Gboard settings and configure KeyFlux options.

Build Instructions

To build the project locally:

./gradlew assembleDebug

For release builds:

./gradlew assembleRelease

Privacy

KeyFlux is designed not to log clipboard contents or copied sensitive text.

If you find logs that expose sensitive data, please open an issue with the log context after removing private information.

Troubleshooting

If KeyFlux does not load correctly:

1. Make sure Gboard is selected in the module scope.
2. Force stop Gboard after enabling the module.
3. Reboot the device if needed.
4. Check LSPosed/Vector logs.
5. Open an issue and include:
- Android version
- ROM / device model
- Gboard version
- KeyFlux version
- Relevant LSPosed/Vector logs

License

This project is licensed under the MIT License.

modules.name: Languager
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Languager
modules.readme:
Languager - Language Spoofing Xposed Module

Overview
Languager is an Xposed module that allows you to change the language of specific Android applications, without changing your system language. This is particularly useful against apps that enforce system language settings or buggy apps that fail to show the selected language from app's settings.

Features
- Per-App Language Selection: Choose a different language for each app independently
- Comprehensive Language Support: 26+ languages available including English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, and many more
- User-Friendly Interface: Easy-to-use UI with app search functionality and intuitive language selection
- Wide Compatibility: Works on Android 5.0+ (API 21+) with support for both older and newer Android versions
- Efficient Hooking Mechanism: Hooks all locale-related methods to ensure complete language spoofing

Technical Details
- Language Spoofing Mechanism:
- Uses Xposed framework for comprehensive method hooking
- Targets all locale-related methods across different API levels:
- Configuration.getLocales() (API 24+)
- Configuration.getLocale() (API
But NOTE!!! Languager only spoofs the system-language, and won't translate app's strings for you.
In addition, some apps are installed via split-apk and do not have the language you want (they only support the system-language).
To bypass such apps and use your prefered language, temporarly switch your system-language, reinstall the app then select language in Languager.

Implementation Details
- Preference Handling: Uses MODE_WORLD_READABLE with LSPosed's xposedsharedprefs flag for secure preference sharing
- Dynamic Locale Creation: Creates locale objects for all supported languages
- API Level Detection: Automatically detects device API level and uses appropriate hooking methods
- UI Optimization: Efficient app list loading with search functionality
- Compatibility Layers: Special handling for different Android versions and manufacturer customizations

Building from Source

Prerequisites
- Android Studio 4.0+
- JDK 11+
- Gradle 7.0+

Local Build (debug-mode)
1. Clone the repository:
      git clone https://github.com/mon231/com.rel.languager languager
   cd languager

1. Build:
      ./gradlew clean assembleDebug

1. Find the APK at app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

Troubleshooting
- Module not working: Make sure it's enabled in LSPosed/EdXposed Manager
- Language not changing: Try restarting the app or rebooting your device

Acknowledgements
- Xposed Framework
- LSPosed Framework

modules.name: MultiRoute
modules.author: Linoleic
modules.description: An Android LSPosed module for per-app network routing.
modules.readme:
MultiRoute

English | 简体中文
Architecture · Building · Changelog
Download installation packages from GitHub Releases or install via the LSPosed Module Repository.

MultiRoute is an Android LSPosed module for per-app network routing (including secondary SIM channel controls and SIM-based assignments), secondary Wi-Fi management, personal hotspot upstream selection, per-channel traffic monitoring, and wireless debugging controls. Device and ROM behavior varies by function.
Prerequisites: Requires Root (KernelSU / Magisk / APatch) and LSPosed (LibXposed API 101+), scoped to System Framework (system) and the NetworkStack Tethering packages.

Features
- Per-app policy routing: Assign individual apps to Primary Wi-Fi, Secondary Wi-Fi, Cellular (including secondary SIM selection on dual-SIM devices), Ethernet, or System Default via Linux kernel policy routing without a userspace VPN. Connected LAN subnets stay routed on their own interfaces so local devices (NAS, printers, casting) remain reachable.
- Cloned apps & scenario plans: Cloned spaces (e.g., Xiaomi XSpace (999)) and work profiles are listed as separate targets. Save named Scenario Plans with conditions (*Wi-Fi SSID*, *Dual Wi-Fi active*, *Cellular only*, *Always*, or *Manual*). Matching plans stack in priority order and re-evaluate on network changes even when the app UI is closed.
- Dual Wi-Fi management (STA + STA): Connect and switch a secondary Wi-Fi network alongside primary Wi-Fi, distinguish access points sharing an SSID by BSSID and band, and show band compatibility indicators.
- Personal hotspot upstream selection: Request Android Tethering to select Cellular, Secondary Wi-Fi, or System Default as the hotspot uplink (for example, keeping the device on an intranet Wi-Fi while sharing cellular data over hotspot).
- Channel monitoring & egress probes: Inspect per-interface download/upload rates, 30-second traffic history graphs, cumulative usage since boot, Wi-Fi link rates, and per-channel public-IP probes.
- Wireless debugging helper: Manage Android 11+ Native TLS wireless debugging and Legacy TCP mode (configurable port 1024..65535), inspect active ADB connections and peer IPs, copy adb connect commands, and configure boot/unlock recovery, automatic switching on trusted Wi-Fi networks, or system auto-start takeover.

Requirements & Compatibility

| Requirement | Details |
| :--- | :--- |
| Root | KernelSU / Magisk / APatch (policy routing and root shell queries require root) |
| Xposed Framework | LSPosed or another framework implementing LibXposed API 101+ |
| Module Scope | System Framework (system / system_server) and NetworkStack (com.android.networkstack.tethering, etc.) |
| Android Version | Android 11 (minSdk 30) or later |

| Verified Environments | Status |
| :--- | :--- |
| Android 17 / HyperOS (Phone) | Verified Dual Wi-Fi, secondary SIM controls and SIM-based routing, app and clone routing, IPv4/IPv6 routing, and rule recovery |
| Android 16 / HyperOS (Tablet) | Verified Dual Wi-Fi, app and clone routing, IPv4/IPv6 routing, DNS redirection, and rule recovery (no cellular hardware) |
| Android 16 / AOSP | Verified connecting, disconnecting, and IPv4 Internet access via saved secondary Wi-Fi networks; other features not broadly verified |
| Android 11 – 15 | ⚠️ Not verified |
| Android 7 – 10 | ❌ Not supported (required framework interfaces were added in Android 11) |
Hardware, firmware, and ROM behavior vary. Dual Wi-Fi radio combinations, concurrent dual-SIM data, and hotspot upstream policies cannot be determined by Android version alone.

Installation & Getting Started

1. Install the APK: Download MultiRoute--.apk from Releases, or install from LSPosed Manager's module repository (io.github.linoleic.multiroute). Both methods support update checks via xposed_update.json.
2. Enable in LSPosed: Open LSPosed Manager → Modules → MultiRoute, enable the module, and check its scope (system and NetworkStack Tethering packages). Supported managers pre-select this list from the embedded scope.list metadata.
3. Reboot: Reboot the device, or restart the system server (su -c 'setprop ctl.restart zygote').
4. Verify status: Open MultiRoute, grant Root permission, and tap the module status icon on the toolbar. It should report Activated (hooks ready).
- To route apps over Cellular while Wi-Fi is connected, enable Mobile data always on in Developer Options (or your ROM's equivalent setting).

Upgrading from 1.1.x (Package ID change)

From v1.2 onward, the package ID changed from com.multiroute to io.github.linoleic.multiroute to match the Xposed Module Repository ownership namespace:
1. Uninstall 1.1.x first (assignments do not migrate automatically).
2. Install the current APK, enable the new entry in LSPosed Manager, configure its scope, and remove the old uninstalled entry.

Uninstalling / Cleaning Up

1. Inside the app: set Hotspot Upstream back to System Default, disconnect any managed Secondary Wi-Fi, and run App routing → menu → Clear all app routing rules.
2. If Dual Wi-Fi was used, revert any device/overlay changes that were applied before using MultiRoute and remove /data/adb/service.d/01-multiroute-dualwifi.sh if present.
3. Disable MultiRoute in LSPosed Manager, uninstall the APK, and reboot.
- If the app cannot be opened before removal, see manual cleanup commands.

Usage

MultiRoute provides four main destinations (App routing, Channels, Tools, and Settings), using bottom navigation on narrow screens and a navigation rail with list-detail panes on wide screens:

1. App Routing
- Single-app assignment: Tap an app (or its (999) clone / work profile entry) and select a target channel.
- Batch assignment: Long-press an item to enter multi-select mode and assign or reset multiple apps together.
- Scenario plans: Save assignments as named plans with trigger conditions (*Wi-Fi network*, *Dual Wi-Fi online*, *Cellular only*, *Always*, or *Manual*)...
