- Updated the module for LSPosed API 102 with backwards compatibility for API 101 frameworks. On API 102, updating the Let Me Downgrade APK can reload module hooks without a reboot (first-time activation still requires a reboot). On API 101, reboot after updating the module APK.
- Added Japanese localization, courtesy of @reindex-ot.

modules.name: Lune Bridge
modules.author: uraniam9
modules.description: Warmer, darker, calmer screens. Candlelight to 1700K, dimming below the panel minimum, flicker-safe mode for PWM eye strain, and Quiet Field to stop apps waking you. Companion to SonoLune.
modules.readme:
Candlelight warmth and below-minimum dimming from Android's own display pipeline, and a phone that stops waking you.

    
    
    
    

  Install ·
  Commands ·
  Safety ·
  Device profiles ·
  API ·
  Changelog

A Magisk / KernelSU / APatch module in two halves: Display, which gives Android's display pipeline the range it already has the hardware for, and Quiet Field, which stops apps taking your attention when you didn't offer it.

Both work the same way. They drive mechanisms Android already has instead of inventing new ones. Neither needs Xposed, and that includes LSPosed. Nothing here hooks a process or patches a framework method, which is why it survives ROM updates and behaves the same on a Pixel and on a heavily skinned OEM build.

candlelight. Stock Android stops at 2596K.
su -c lunectl warm 1850
readable at 3am, below the panel's minimum.
su -c lunectl level 8
stop the PWM strobe low brightness causes.
su -c lunectl flicker on

no wake locks, no screen-on, no takeover.
su -c quietctl add com.some.app
quiet hours. Alarms still work.
su -c quietctl window 2100-0800

Display

Android can already tint your screen to candlelight and dim it far below the brightness slider's floor. It does both in the compositor, with no overlay window and no accessibility service. It just refuses to go that far. The limits are constants in framework-res, and they are set conservatively.

This module moves those limits, correctly.

Why this is not another screen-dimmer

Every no-root dimming app works the same way: draw a translucent black window over everything. That approach has permanent costs. It can't cover the status bar reliably, it blacks out in screenshots and screen recordings, it's excluded from secure surfaces, it crushes contrast because it's adding black rather than emitting less light, and it needs an accessibility service or an always-on overlay permission that users are right to be suspicious of.

Android's own mechanisms have none of those problems, because they run in the compositor before anything reaches the panel:

| | Overlay apps | Lune |
|---|---|---|
| Lock screen, status bar | partial | covered |
| Screenshots / recording | blacked out | clean |
| Secure surfaces (banking, DRM) | excluded | covered |
| Contrast at low light | crushed | preserved |
| Permissions needed | accessibility or overlay | none, it is a root module |
| Cost | an extra composited layer | none, it is a colour matrix |

Lune doesn't add a mechanism. It unlocks the ones that are already there.

Display: the three things it changes

1. Warmth down to 1700K, with a refitted colour ramp

Night Light stops at 2596K. Lowering that limit is a one-line overlay and plenty of tweaks do exactly that. What you get is a washed-out tint rather than candlelight, and the reason is worth knowing.

ColorDisplayService computes the tint from a quadratic, a·T² + b·T + c, per channel. AOSP fits that quadratic over 2596–4082K only. Evaluate it at 1700K and it still reports 26% blue, which is nothing like a 1700K blackbody. The curve is being used far outside its domain.

So Lune refits it. tools/coefficients.py derives a new ramp from the Planckian locus, and constrains it so that:
- it is exact at 4082K, so the top of the slider is untouched;
- it is exact at the new floor, at the true gamut-clipped blackbody value;
- it is monotonic, so warming never starts adding blue back. An unconstrained least-squares fit turns over inside the range and does exactly that, which reads as a bug;
- it never goes negative, which would invert a channel instead of warming it.

The generator validates its own output and the build refuses to ship a ramp that fails. Cost of the refit: green stays within 0.03 of stock inside the old range, blue within 0.05. Run python3 tools/coefficients.py to see the report.

2. Dimming below the panel minimum, without an overlay

Android 12 added "Extra Dim", which multiplies the framebuffer down through the hardware colour matrix. It's the right mechanism and it's already on your phone. It's also clamped to 25–90% strength.

At 90% the stock ramp leaves 14% of the signal. Lune raises the ceiling to 99%, which leaves 5.4%, roughly another 2.6× darker. That's the difference between "dim" and "readable at 3am without waking yourself up".

Lune also drops config_screenBrightnessSettingMinimumFloat to 0.0, which is what the AOSP comment on that resource explicitly suggests, so the ordinary brightness slider reaches the panel's real minimum first.

3. Flicker-safe mode

Most OLED panels dim by PWM: below a certain backlight level the driver strobes the panel, and for a significant minority of people that strobe causes eye strain, headaches and nausea. Vendor "DC dimming" toggles fix it, but they are per-device kernel features with no standard interface, and most devices don't have one at all.

Flicker-safe mode doesn't need one. It holds the backlight above the knee where strobing gets bad, and takes the remaining dimming out of the colour matrix instead, which doesn't strobe. You get the brightness you asked for without the flicker that usually comes with it.

lunectl flicker on
lunectl knee 40      # lower it for a darker minimum until flicker shows, then go back up a step

The default knee is a guess, and lunectl status says so. Measuring it is one slider drag.

Quiet Field

Attention control, built the same way: no hooks, no Xposed, no accessibility service. Just permissions apps no longer have, and Android's own Do Not Disturb on a schedule.

Levers

Each one is an appop: a permission the framework simply stops granting. Instant, free, enforced by the system, and it survives reboots by itself.

| Lever | What the app can no longer do | Needs |
|---|---|---|
| wake | hold a wake lock, so it cannot keep the CPU or screen up | any Android |
| screen | turn your screen on | Android 14+ |
| fullscreen | take the whole screen over with a notification | Android 14+ |...
modules.changelog:
Warmth reaches the warm end again. Drag the warmth slider straight to its warmest, or take SonoLune's Light room to 100%, and on some phones nothing happened: the screen kept the warmth it already had, and nudging the slider back a step put it right. The cause is in Android. Its colour service remembers the last temperature its own Night Light slider gave it, and ignores any later setting that matches it, until the phone restarts. With this module's overlay in place, the warm end of Android's own slider is 1700K, which is also the warm end of every slider that drives this module. So once Android's own slider had been taken to its warmest, every request for 1700K was stored and then ignored. Measured on a Nothing Phone (2): after 3000K, a write of 1700K left the screen at 3000K. Lune now writes a value one kelvin away first, then the real one. Android can ignore at most one of the two, so the screen lands on what you asked for or one kelvin beside it, which nobody can see. If you drive Lune Bridge from SonoLune, this is the whole fix, and SonoLune does not need an update.

The panel's warmth takes turns. The warmth slider waited for your finger to rest, then started a change and read the settings back when it finished, and the presets started theirs straight away. Nothing stopped a second change from starting while the first was still running, so a drag that paused, or a preset tapped right after a drag, could finish in either order and leave the screen on the older value. The read-back could also pull the thumb back under a finger that was still moving. Now only one change runs at a time, the newest value waits behind it, and the last thing you touched is always the last thing applied. The screen follows the thumb while you drag, and a preset moves the thumb the moment you tap it.

Commands that overlap no longer trip over each other. Every lunectl command that changes the display now waits for the one before it, and the settings file is written so that two writers can never corrupt it. The wait can never be what keeps your screen dark: a command that died is stepped over at once, and one that is stuck gets about five seconds before Lune carries on without it. lunectl warm now also says so, and exits non-zero, when Android refuses a temperature, instead of recording a warmth the screen is not showing.

modules.name: Magpie AI 网关
modules.author: KANGKKKKKKK
modules.description: Magpie AI 网关常驻服务 | 点 [执行] 开音量键菜单：切网关、启停、看地址
modules.readme:
Magpie AI 网关 · Android 模块

把 magpie 变成 Android 上的常驻服务：开机自启，被杀自动拉回，[执行] 菜单里启停。

简体中文 | English

本仓库只含模块脚本，不含 magpie 本体（arm64 二进制约 87 MB）。本体没装也没关系：装上模块后点 [执行] 就能下载安装——首次点按只显示方案，再点一次才下载。
模块只负责让 magpie 在这台手机上稳定运行；provider、模型、额度、账号这些属于 magpie 本体，不在本模块范围内。

目录
- 为什么需要它
- 能做什么
- 快速开始
- 安装本体
- 日常使用
- 客户端怎么接入
- 两把密钥的区别
- 配置
- 自检与排障
- 工作原理
- 文件结构
- 卸载
- 更新
- 已知限制
- 开发与测试
- 贡献者与致谢
- 许可证

为什么需要它

magpie 是为桌面写的 Go 程序。搬到手机上能跑，但会连续撞上四件事：
- DNS 查不到。Go 找不到 /etc/resolv.conf，退回查 ::1:53，日志里刷 connection refused。
- HTTPS 全挂。Go 只认 /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt 这类固定路径，Android 上一个都没有——它的证书是 /system/etc/security/cacerts/.0，一证书一文件。
- 开机不自启。Android 没有 systemd，重启之后得手动再起一次。
- 被杀就没了。清理类 App、内存回收、系统「一键清理」都能直接 kill 掉它，而它自己不会回来。对下游客户端来说，这等于出口断了。

这个模块补上前三件，用看门狗解决第四件，并附一套能看见状态、能自己检查问题的周边。

能做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 开机自启 | 等 sys.boot_completed 后拉起，不阻塞开机 |
| 进程守护 | 20 秒巡检，被杀或回收后自动拉回；用户主动停止时不强行恢复 |
| 音量键菜单 | 点 [执行] 开菜单：切网关、看接入信息、启停、重启、开面板，音量键选、不用打字 |
| 状态可见 | 管理器那一行直接显示状态和可用地址（示例），不用点按钮 |
| 自检 | scripts/doctor.sh 九项检查，直接告诉你哪里不对、下一步做什么 |
| 命令行 | magpie 自动进 PATH，补齐 HOME、SSL_CERT_FILE、MAGPIE_BUN，并在 DNS 没配好时直说 |
| CA 证书 | 合并系统根证书供静态 Go 使用，系统 CA 变化时自动重建 |
| 日志轮转 | 超过 5 MB 归档为 .1，只留一份 |
| 在线更新 | 管理器里可直接收到新版本 |
| 安装本体 | 本体没装时，点 [执行] 就能下载并装好：sha256 校验、原子替换、失败不留残骸 |
| 彻底卸载 | 停服务、收守护进程、清 PATH 链接、删数据目录，并复查残留 |

快速开始

前置条件
- [ ] 设备已 root，且装了 Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 之一
- [ ] 架构是 arm64（magpie 本体是 arm64 ELF，arm32 / x86_64 跑不了）
- [ ] 会用管理器的「从本地安装」刷模块
- [ ] magpie 本体：有就用现成的，没有可以让模块装（见第 2 步）

本体没就位时服务不会启动，但刷入模块本身不会失败：只提示一句，看门狗也不会反复重试刷日志。装本体见第 2 步。

[执行] 按钮由管理器提供，要求它支持模块的 action.sh——Magisk 从 27.0 起才有。更老的 Magisk、或管理器里根本没有这个按钮时，模块照样装得上、跑得起来，只是改用命令行启停，能力一样。

步骤

1. 安装模块

从 Releases 下载最新的 magpie-v*.zip（文件名带版本号），管理器 → 模块 → 从本地安装 → 选 zip。

这一步不需要先有 magpie 本体：检测不到只提示一句，照样装完。

2. 准备本体（两条路，任选）

/data/adb/modules/magpie/ 要等模块刷好才存在，所以两条路都放在这一步。

已经有本体，确认一下就行：

su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh status
state=ready version=0.1.4302 path=/data/adb/magpie/bin/magpie

没有本体，让模块去装（推荐，省掉自己找文件）：

su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh install --yes

不想敲命令就在管理器里点 [执行]——走的是同一个安装流程。
细节与安全说明见安装本体。

3. 重启

模块会等 sys.boot_completed 再拉起服务，不需要解锁屏幕。

4. 验证

su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/magpie.service status
running (PID )

su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/doctor.sh   # 九项自检，出问题会告诉你怎么修

管理器里那行描述会从刷入时的静态文字变成「🟢 运行中 v… | 仅本机」；开过局域网之后则是「🟢 运行中 v… | 192.168.x.x:3425」。

5. 打开面板

点 [执行] → 选 6「打开面板」，会带着访问密码直接用浏览器打开。也可以自己取地址：

su -c cat /data/adb/magpie/run/web.url
http://127.0.0.1:3430/?k=

把打印出来的地址粘进手机浏览器即可。这是 magpie 本体的界面，别和模块自带的 webroot 面板弄混。

想从电脑上打开面板，先把 配置 里的 MAGPIE_WEB_ADDR 改成 0.0.0.0:3430 并重启服务，再用面板/自检里给出的局域网地址访问。开之前先看一眼下面的两把密钥那一节。

不想刷 zip 的，手动放置：

unzip magpie-v*.zip -d /data/adb/modules/magpie   # 换成实际下载到的文件名
chmod 755 /data/adb/modules/magpie/*.sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/*.sh
chmod 600 /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/magpie.config

安装本体（让模块来做）

本体没装时，[执行] 不再是音量键菜单，而是安装入口。命令行也一样：

su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh status    # 只检测
su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh check     # 联网比版本，不下载
su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh plan      # 打印将装什么，不下载
su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh install   # 先给方案，再点一次才下载
su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh install --yes   # 直接装
su -c sh /data/adb/modules/magpie/scripts/install.sh rollback  # 用备份退回

从哪来。 清单是 https://usemagpie.ai/api/latest —— magpie 自己的更新端点，
magpie update 用的也是它；资产名 magpie-cli-android-arm64（实测这是发布页里唯一的 Android 构建，
没有 arm32 的）。下载优先走厂商 CDN，失败再退回 GitHub。

怎么校验。 清单给出 size 和 sha256，下载后逐项比对，对不上就丢弃换下一个来源。
SHA256SUMS 与 GitHub API 的 digest 字段两者与该值一致。注意：sha256 来自同一个清单，
所以真实性的信任根是「usemagpie.ai 这个源 + TLS」，与 magpie 本体自己更新时的信任假设相同；
仓库里虽然也有 SHA256SUMS.sig，但本模块没有内置公钥，因此不声称做过 GPG 签名验证。

怎么落盘。 先下到同文件系统的临时文件 → 校验 → mv 原子替换（不会出现半截文件）；
替换前把旧本体备份成 bin/magpie.bak。装完立刻跑一次 --version 自检：跑不起来就回退；
首次安装没有备份可退时，把失败样本挪到 bin/magpie.rejected 并报出它的 sha256，
正式路径上绝不留下「看起来已安装」的文件。

不做什么。 不自动下载、不每次开机检查、不自动升级、不覆盖已有可用本体（除非显式
install --yes）、不碰 data/、配置、账号、provider、密钥、监听地址。升级交给本体自己：

su -c magpie update check   # 只看有没有新版
su -c magpie update         # 下载、校验、重启进新版本

刷入模块时不会联网下载。刷机流程里没有可靠的交互终端，87 MB 的下载也太大，
所以 customize.sh 只做检测并告诉你怎么装，真正下载由你确认后触发。

安装器不依赖 wget 在 PATH 上。模块脚本被管理器拉起时，PATH 往往只有系统目录，
那里没有 wget；安装器会把各 Root 方案的 bin 目录加进去，并在必要时回退到
busybox 自带的 wget。可用 MAGPIE_DL=/path/to/curl 指定别的下载器。

想换源（自建镜像、内网缓存）：
MAGPIE_MANIFEST_URL=https://内网/… sh install.sh install --yes。
清单格式不变时可用。资产名也可用 MAGPIE_ASSET_KEY 覆盖。

日常使用

执行按钮

管理器模块页的 [执行] 是一个音量键菜单。点开后不需要打字，也不需要终端：

───────────  Magpie  ───────────
 状态  运行中
 网关  局域网 · 其他设备可连接
 地址  192.168.1.5
────────────────────────────────
   1  切到「仅本机」
 ▸ 2  查看接入信息
   3  重启
   4  停止
   5  启动
   6  打开面板
   7  退出
────────────────────────────────
 音量下 换一项 · 音量上 执行
 60 秒没按键就自动退出

音量下 = 换一项，音量上 = 执行，60 秒没按键自动退出。各选项：

| 选项 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| 1 切换网关 | 在「仅本机 127.0.0.1」和「局域网 0.0.0.0」之间切换，服务在跑就自动重启生效 |
| 2 查看接入信息 | 本机与局域网两套地址分行列出，并给出别的设备该填什么 |
| 3 / 4 / 5 | 重启 / 停止 / 启动 |
| 6 打开面板 | 用浏览器打开 WebUI（带你自己的密钥） |
| 7 退出 | 关掉 [执行] 窗口，回到模块列表 |

本体没装或跑不起来时，[执行] 仍然是安装入口：先打印将装的版本、大小、来源，
再点一次才开始下载。

开热点给平板用时：先点 [执行] → 选 1 切到「局域网」→ 选 2 看给出的地址，
把它填进平板上 Eta 的 magpie 接口；用完再切回「仅本机」，外部就进不来。

音量键本身会系统性地调一下媒体音量，菜单退出时会还原成进来时的值。
在终端里跑同一个菜单（见 命令行）时会原地重画、只有 ▸ 移动；
Magisk 的文本框不支持光标控制，所以那里只画一次菜单、每按一次追加一行当前选中项。

那行文字会自动更新，不需要点任何按钮就能看到该填进客户端什么：

🟢 运行中 v0.1.4260 | 192.168.1.5:3425      ← 运行中，并给出可用的局域网地址
🟢 运行中 v0.1.4260 | 仅本机                 ← 只监听 127.0.0.1，别的设备连不上
🔴 已停止 | 点 [执行] 启动

地址变了（WiFi 重连、热点开关、切飞行模式）会自动刷新，不会让你照着旧地址折腾。字体不支持 emoji、显示成方框时，把配置里的 MAGPIE_ICON 设成 0，就会换成 [运行中] / [已停止] 纯文本。

管理器里没有 [执行] 按钮时（见前置条件），用下面的命令行启停，效果一样。

两个「面板」，别弄混

有两个完全不同的页面，地址和用途都不一样。下面把 magpie 本体那个叫 P1、模块自带那个叫 P2，后文不再说左右：

P1：magpie 自带的面板，截图停在「关于」页（版本号、更新开关）；日常配模型、供应商、额度、密钥都在这里。
P2：模块自带的 webroot 面板，要靠 KernelSU WebUI / WebUI-X 托管才能打开；里面的 API Key 与访问密码默认折叠为「点击「显示」查看」，截图未展开。

| | P1：magpie 自带的面板 | P2：模块自带的 webroot 面板 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 地址 | http://:3430/?k=；也可以用 [执行] → 6 打开 | 没有自己的地址：在 KernelSU WebUI / WebUI-X 里打开 |...

MyDNS
Use your local DNS server on Android

Disclaimer
I'm not an expert in Android nor in bash scripting.

- Run your local DNS server with any configuration
- Choose any upstream servers

1. Install Magisk
2. Install Termux
3. Open Termux and install dnsmasq:
pkg install root-repo && pkg install dnsmasq
4. Download this module from releases tab

6. Reboot

Configuration
- Open Termux and run su. Allow root access for Termux.
- Run mydns config and update the file to your needs.
- Run mydns restart for changes to take effect.
- Run mydns to check resource usage. If CPU usage is high, wait a minute and check again. If it's still high, please open an issue in this repository.

Installation (non-Android)
You can use linux_install.sh to install MyDNS for any Linux system.
Keep in mind that you will need to add mydns start to autostart manually.

modules.name: onHit: Create NFC Tag from Nothing
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: onHit: Create NFC Tag from Nothing
modules.readme:
onHit

Introduction / 简介

onHit is an Xposed module designed to simulate NFC tag events at the system level. By injecting data into the Android NFC framework, it enables the system to parse and dispatch NDEF and protocol-level data as if a physical tag were present.

onHit 是一个用于在系统层面模拟 NFC 标签事件的 Xposed 模块。通过向 Android NFC 框架注入数据，它使系统能够像处理实体标签一样解析和分发 NDEF 及协议层数据。

How to Use / 如何使用

1. Install & Enable: Install onHit and enable the module in your Xposed manager. Scope it to NFC Service (com.android.nfc).
2. Setup Storage: Open onHit and select a working directory.
3. Capture/Import: From the "Add" menu, choose to read from physical tags, record a trace, or import existing files.
4. Edit: Use the NDEF Editor to modify records if necessary.
5. Replay: Click a data file in the list to trigger the system-level dispatch.

1. 安装并启用: 安装 onHit 并在 Xposed 管理器中启用模块，作用域勾选 NFC 服务 (com.android.nfc)。
2. 设置存储: 打开 onHit 并选择一个工作目录。
3. 采集/导入: 在“添加”菜单中选择从实体标签读取、记录轨迹或导入已有文件。
4. 编辑: 如有需要，使用内置编辑器修改记录。
5. 重放: 在文件列表中点击数据文件，即可触发系统级分发。

Demonstration Videos / 演示视频
- ［Xposed模块］在无实体卡片的情况下用系统钱包app模拟一张特定UID的卡片
- onHit TagRecorder 标签记录器使用方式案例
- ［Xposed模块］在无标签的情况下触发NFC/NDEF事件 - onHit

Core Features / 核心功能
- Multi-Protocol NFC Replay: Simulates system-level NFC touch events via Xposed. Supports NDEF, Mifare Classic (MFC), and Trace-based protocol emulation.
- Trace Reverse Simulation: Replays previously recorded interaction traces to emulate complex tag behaviors.
- NDEF Management: Read from physical tags, save as files, and write back to tags using public Android APIs.
- NDEF Editor: Built-in editor to create or modify NDEF records directly within the app.
- Tag Recorder: Captures raw data streams during NFC tag interactions for local analysis.
- Tag Trace: View and analyze local NFC tag trace files.
- File Manager: Built-in manager for organizing data files, supporting renaming, deletion, and folder categorization.
- Personalization: Supports custom application backgrounds with built-in cropping.
- Quick Search: Real-time keyword filtering for local files.
- 多协议 NFC 重放: 通过 Xposed 模拟系统级 NFC 触碰事件。支持 NDEF、Mifare Classic (MFC) 以及基于轨迹的多种协议模拟。
- 轨迹反向模拟: 通过回放之前记录的交互轨迹，模拟复杂的标签行为。
- NDEF 管理: 从实体标签读取数据并保存为文件，或通过 Android 官方 API 将文件写回标签。
- NDEF 编辑器: 内置编辑器，支持直接在应用内创建或修改 NDEF 记录。
- Tag Recorder: 记录 NFC 标签交互过程中的原始数据流，仅用于本地分析。
- Tag Trace: 支持查看和分析本地存储的 NFC 标签轨迹文件。
- 文件管理: 内置文件管理器，支持重命名、删除及文件夹分类管理。
- 个性化: 支持自定义应用背景，内置裁剪功能。
- 快速搜索: 对本地文件进行实时关键词过滤。

Technical Principles / 技术实现

System Injection / 系统注入
The module hooks the NfcApplication within the com.android.nfc process. It retrieves internal references to the NfcService and its associated Handler to interact with the system's NFC logic.

模块 Hook 了 com.android.nfc 进程中的 NfcApplication，并获取了内部 NfcService 及其关联 Handler 的引用，从而实现与系统 NFC 逻辑的交互。

Protocol Emulation / 协议仿真
- NDEF: Directly injects NDEF messages into the dispatch system.
- Mifare Classic: Emulates the storage structure and protocol interaction logic of MFC tags.
- TagTrace: Accurate replay of specific interaction flows by matching historical transceive commands with captured response data.
- NDEF: 直接向分发系统注入 NDEF 消息。
- Mifare Classic: 模拟 MFC 标签的存储结构与协议交互逻辑。
- TagTrace: 通过匹配历史 Transceive 指令及其响应数据，实现对特定交互流程的精准回放。

Event Simulation / 事件模拟
Tag replay is achieved by reflectively invoking the dispatchTagEndpoint method on the NFC service handler. This bypasses hardware-level constraints and directly injects a custom TagEndpoint into the Android dispatch system.

标签重放通过反射调用 NFC 服务 Handler 的 dispatchTagEndpoint 方法实现。这绕过了硬件层面的限制，直接向 Android 分发系统注入自定义的 TagEndpoint。

Data Collection / 数据采集
The Tag Recorder intercepts TagEndpoint objects before they are dispatched by the system, allowing the module to log raw interaction data. All captured data is stored locally on the device and is not uploaded to any server.

Tag Recorder 在系统分发前拦截 TagEndpoint 对象，从而实现对原始交互数据的记录。所有采集到的数据均仅保存在设备本地，不会上传至任何服务器。

Compatibility & Limitations / 兼容性与局限性
- Oplus (ColorOS): Specialized hooks for NfcDispatchManager to bypass foreground whitelist restrictions and clear the system's internal UID database cache via DatabaseManager.
- System Features: Hooks ApplicationPackageManager to ensure hasSystemFeature correctly reports NFC capabilities.
- Hardware Dependency: Strongly dependent on Android version and vendor NFC implementation. Some OEM frameworks may restrict NFC internals.
- Oplus (ColorOS): 针对 NfcDispatchManager 进行专项 Hook，以绕过前台白名单限制，并清理系统内部 UID 数据库缓存。
- 系统特征: Hook 了 ApplicationPackageManager，确保系统特征正确返回 NFC 支持状态。
- 硬件依赖: 运行效果高度依赖 Android 版本和厂商的 NFC 实现，部分定制 ROM 可能会对 NFC 内部逻辑进行修改或限制。

Acknowledgments / 致谢
Special thanks to the following projects:
- LSPosed
- EzXHelper
- AndroidX
- Material Symbols

Legal & Ethical Notice / 法律与道德声明

This project is for research, learning, and testing purposes only.
The user is solely responsible for any actions taken using this software. Do not use this tool to bypass security mechanisms or violate privacy policies.

本项目仅用于研究、学习与测试。
用户对使用本软件所采取的任何行为承担全部责任。请勿使用本工具绕过安全机制或违反隐私政策。

License / 许可证

This project is licensed under the GNU General Public License v2.0 (GPLv2).

本项目采用 GNU General Public License v2.0 (GPLv2) 许可证。

modules.name: Play Integrity Break
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Play Integrity Break
modules.readme:
Play Integrity Break

Fix Google Play Integrity... by BREAKING it!

What does PIB do?

PIB is an Xposed module that logs, and optionally intercepts, Play Integrity service requests/responses activity per target app.

Why do we want to do this? (Project vision)

1. Have a more stable bypass for Play Integrity

The current situation

The current situation with modified Android devices is that:
- You get your detection bypass setup, with susfs, xygisk next, HMA, Tricky Store and most importantly, an unrevoked keybox.
- The keybox you use gets revoked and you start getting no integrity, without notice
- Your apps get a "no integrity" verdict and they stop working when you most need them.
- You have to find a new keybox, which is a both a pain and a limited and non-renewable resource, and re-login to all your apps.

The idea: What if we fake errors?

From
Google's guide on Play Integrity Errors:
Use exponential backoff for Play Integrity operations that happen in the background and don't affect the user experience while the user is in session.
...
If you continue to see errors after three retry attempts, treat the outcome as if the client has failed all integrity checks.

What are we exploiting here is that many apps do not actually treat the failure as "no integrity", OR that they only require a single successful response during the first launch and/or during login.

Why?
Well, put yourself in the shoes of a bank. You want to use Play Integrity to protect your app, but you also don't want to lock out users when Google servers are down. So what do you do? You basically go down whenever Google goes down?

In other words: Depending on your apps, you might only want to have a working PI with unrevoked keybox during your app's setup. After that, you don't need Play Integrity to work at all.

2. Reduce number of Play Integrity requests

Keyboxes are quickly revoked because they are used by thousands of users at the same time.
Some apps use Play Integrity APIs improperly, increasing usage unnecessarely.
By intercepting requests, PIB can reduce the number of requests sent to the Play Integrity service, which should make keyboxes last longer.

3. Study app's usage of Play Integrity at scale

This app includes optional opt-in telemetry that sends anonymized data about Play Integrity usage to a central server.
This data can be used to understand how apps use Play Integrity.
The long-term goal is to create and maintain a database of apps and their Play Integrity usage patterns.

What does PIB NOT do?

PIB does NOT help you to:
- Hide root and modifications
- Get a working Keybox
- Help you get a BASIC, DEVICE or STRONG verdict.
- Get apps that always want a working Play Integrity to work.

PIB starts with the assumption that you already have a working root hiding mechanism, and that you get a DEVICE verdict (at least for setup time).

Telemetry ??

The idea is to get a larger picture of how apps use Play Integrity, and to be able to share this information with the community.
This is an optional feature, disabled by default.

Privacy policy (what do I receive)
- Your IP address: I have to receive it because that's how the internet works. I do not log it, store it, or use it in any way.
- Your user ID: This is a random UUID generated by the app on first launch. It is used to separate data from different users. This should enable us to distinguish between setup-level events and regular usage events, which is important for the project vision. I'm not able to link this ID to any real identity.
- Your app's package name: The package name of the apps installed in your phone asking for Play Integrity.
- Play Integrity version: The version of the Play Integrity library used by the app.

How is it used

This data is only used to get statistics and patterns of how apps use Play Integrity.
The insights coming from these statistics (e.g. X only needs PI during setup) will build a database of apps and their Play Integrity usage patterns, which will be shared with the community.
The data will not be shared with any third party, and will not be used for any other purpose than the one described above.
Data will be retented as long as they are useful (a few years?)

Data deletion

Contact me with your user ID and I will delete all data associated with it.

Intents API (opt-in)

PIB includes an optional external Intents API that can change per-app settings and default policy settings.
- Disabled by default.
- Must be enabled manually in Settings by turning on External Intents API and confirming the warning.
- When enabled, any app on the device can send supported Intents to update per-app settings or default policy values.

Full action/extras/result contract and examples are documented in INTENTS_API.md.

How to correct the weaknesses that PIB exploits?

1. Google: Authenticate errors

This project exploits the fact that Play Integrity errors are not authenticated at all. This makes sense for a few errors (unreachable network, internal error...), but some errors (rate limit, server reachable but unhealthy...) could be authenticated (maybe with a different set of generic keys).

2. Developers: Treat errors as "no integrity"

As Google says, implement PI correctly and treat errors as "no integrity".
Log out users when you get an error.
You chose to lock-in to Google, deal with the consequences.
Maybe you can not use it and let us live in peace?

Build with Nix

PIB ships a repo-local Nix development shell for reproducible Android builds.

1. Enter the shell:

nix develop

2. Build all modules:

nix develop -c ./gradlew :common:assembleDebug :xposed:assembleDebug :app:assembleDebug --no-daemon

The shell uses Android SDK components from nixpkgs by default and only falls back to a host SDK when the required platform/build-tools are already present.

AI Policy

This project has been vibe coded.
I didn't read the code at all (and I don't have Kotlin android skills). It is probably badly written....

modules.name: Sentry Radio
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Sentry Radio
modules.readme:
Sentry Radio 📡

Sentry Radio is a professional-grade Android forensic tool designed to detect, analyze, and map cellular network anomalies, including potential IMSI Catchers (Stingrays), cell site simulators, and suspicious network downgrades.

Built for security researchers and privacy-conscious users, it provides deep insights into the radio stack, monitoring both SIM slots in real-time.

🚀 Key Features
- 🛡️ Dynamic CVE Intelligence: Fetches real-time modem vulnerabilities from the NIST NVD API, replacing the static, hardcoded list.
- 🛠️ System-Level Hardening (Magisk/KSU): Optional module enforces secure radio parameters directly on the baseband level with automatic reboot detection.
- ⚡ Advanced Panic Mode: Full system lockdown with network isolation and hardware radio disable for emergency situations.
- 🔄 Recovery Controls: Automated recovery procedures and panic validation for post-incident analysis.
- 📱 App Update Management: Automatic detection and notification of app updates via GitHub releases with integrated overlay dialog.
- 🔄 Reboot Management: Intelligent reboot detection and overlay prompts after KSU/Magisk module installation or updates.
- 🛡️ Real-time Threat Detection: Monitors for encryption deactivation, silent SMS, and suspicious cell handovers.
- 🚨 Full-screen Overlay Alarms: Critical alerts now appear over all apps and on the lock screen for immediate notification.
- 📊 Advanced Radio Metrics: Tracks PCI, EARFCN, Signal Strength (RSSI/RSRP), Timing Advance, and Neighboring cells.
- 🌐 Forensic Mapping: Visualize detected cell towers and your movement on an offline-capable map using OSMDroid.
- 📡 Dual SIM Support: Full monitoring for multi-slot devices.

modules.readme:
改机型工具箱

中文 · English

一个跑在 Android 上的机型伪装工具：改掉系统里跟「这台手机是什么」有关的属性，
并支持开机持久化、快照回滚与 App 级伪装。
- 包名 com.xuzhang.devicetoolbox
- 最低 Android 5.0（API 21），目标 API 34
- 系统级伪装依赖 root：Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 任一（需要它提供的 resetprop）
- App 级伪装依赖 Zygisk（Zygisk Next / KernelSU 自带），逐应用、不需要重启
- 只打包了 arm64-v8a 原生库：逐应用伪装仅支持 arm64 设备；其他架构上应用仍能安装，
  但只有不依赖原生库的功能可用（机型库浏览、方案、生成器）
- 不需要联网：机型库内置在 APK 里，全程离线可用

本项目由作者手工编写与维护 —— 界面、脚本、原生模块与内置机型库的整理都是自己写的；
路线上的方向参考见文末「思路参考」。

功能

改哪些属性

写入的是一整套互相自洽的身份，不是零散几个键：
- 六个分区（system / vendor / odm / product / system_ext / bootimage）的机型键一起对齐：
  型号 / 品牌 / 制造商 / 设备名 / 代号 / 产品名
- 各分区的构建指纹、构建号、Android 版本、安全补丁与内部版本号同步改写，
  保证「关于手机」、getprop、android.os.Build 三处口径一致
- 目标机型在库里没有真值的键不写 —— 宁可少改，也不编一个值进去

动手前的确认框会把这次要改的条数报给你：条数由程序按目标机型实时算出，所以不同机型会略有差异。
界面上显示的就是这一次真实要写的条数，不是写死的宣传数字。
属性表在代码内部按三档（轻量 / 标准 / 深度）组织，**当前版本固定写入覆盖最全的那一档，
界面不提供档位切换**；档位字段随方案与分享码一起保存，留给后续版本使用。

机型库

内置机型库 3,539 条，其中 3,312 条带真实指纹（93.6%），
覆盖 278 个品牌，文件约 572 KB（585,835 字节）。目标机型从 Android 5.0（API 21）
一直覆盖到 Android 17。
- 每一条都是完整可用的身份：品牌 / 制造商 / 通俗名 / 机型码 / 代号 / 产品名 /
  Android 版本 / 构建号 / 内部版本 / 完整指纹 / 安全补丁 / 芯片 / 平台 —— 不是只有一个名字
- 列表里显示的是通俗名（「三星 Galaxy S24 Ultra」），写进系统的是机型码（SM-S928B）
- 支持搜索（通俗名 / 机型码 / 芯片）、按品牌筛选、按 Android 版本筛选（全部 / 10+ / 12+）、收藏置顶
- 代号不确定的机型留空，由程序按品牌与型号推导 —— 宁可推导，也不编一个假代号
- 列表用 ListView + 适配器渲染，只创建可见行（三千多行全量创建会明显卡顿）
- 内置「自定机型生成器」：给品牌 + 型号 + 芯片 + 版本，推导出代号、构建号、安全补丁与完整指纹

数据来源

机型库由下面这些公开来源合并去重而来（保留项目名与链接，本身也是致谢的一部分）：

| 来源 | 贡献内容 |
|---|---|
| 本项目整理 | 2023–2025 旗舰与热门机型，带中文通俗名与芯片信息 |
| xdaGari/tadiphone-buildprop-archive | 最大的来源：44,716 份分区级 build.prop 公开归档 |
| TheFreeman193/PIFS | 真实指纹档案 |
| Seyud/device_faker_config | 公开的机型模板仓库，含 marketname |
| 公开固件库（如 samfrew / sammobile 的三星 PDA 码） | 三星机型的构建号与版本信息 |

各来源的口径并不一致：有的只有指纹、有的只有模板、有的字段残缺。合并时按机型码去重，
同一条以「字段更全、且带真实指纹」的那份为准；指纹与本机型的品牌 / 代号 / 版本对不上的，
宁可留空，也不拼一条假的进去。

安全护栏
- 还原以「原厂真值」为准：真值只可能来自只读的 build.prop 文件（/system、/vendor、/odm），
  resetprop 改不到它们。首次使用时取一份基线落盘，之后所有还原都从基线取 ——
  这修掉了「还原出来还是上次伪装的那个机型」（快照读的是 getprop，也就是当时内存里的值，
  一旦上一次没还原干净，快照存的就是伪装值）
- 改之前自动快照：把即将被改动的键在改动前的值写成 restore.sh，同时留一份 values.tsv 期望值清单
- 改完读回校验：逐键 getprop 比对，不一致就如实报告「未生效」，不假装成功
- 还原也读回校验：还原后拿 values.tsv 逐项核对，还原不干净会直接告诉你哪几项没回去
- 原本不存在的属性要删掉而不是写空：getprop 不输出空值，所以「原机没有」与「值是空」
  在快照里都表现为缺失。这类键还原时走 resetprop --delete —— 留个空壳属性仍然能被检测到
- 还原只回写自己改过的键，不动系统其它属性
- 「恢复出厂」等危险操作要过两道确认

App 级伪装（Zygisk 逐应用）

只对勾选的应用生效。模块在目标进程 specialize 阶段（应用的代码还没跑起来之前）
同时改两条路：
- Java 侧：替换 Build / Build.VERSION 的静态字段；
- native 侧：在该进程内克隆一份属性区私有副本，把 bionic 的属性查找指向这份副本，
  再按 bionic 的协议写值。

于是 SystemProperties 与 __system_property_find 读到的是同一份假值，
进程内不会出现「两个来源对不上」。不改系统属性（整机真值原封不动），配置改完也不用重启。

作用范围按包名精确匹配，不是前缀匹配 —— com.tencent.mobileqq2 不会被
com.tencent.mobileqq 的配置误命中（模块侧拿整串包名比对，不取前缀）。

配置由本应用写进只有 root 能读的模块目录；目标进程自己没有 root、读不到那里，
所以它通过 Zygisk 的 companion socket 向 root 侧的模块进程要
（删除清单走同一条连接的另一趟往返，值域里永远不会出现删除标记）。
早先还有一条 Xposed 路，已经退役：它只在目标进程里改 Java 层，native 直接读内存绕不过去；
而且挂在 LSPosed 里时会因为缺方法抛 AbstractMethodError（真机实测）。现在
AndroidManifest.xml 里没有任何 Xposed 模块注册，相关源码与资源都已删除。

其它
- 持久化模块：往 root 管理器的模块目录装一个模块，开机早期自动写入
- 方案与分享码：存成方案随时套用，导出为 DTB1.xxxx.yyyy 分享码（带 CRC 校验）
- 三路一致性自检：getprop / android.os.Build / 目标值 并排对比
- 明暗主题，切换不用重启
- 导出独立脚本 到手机的公共目录，不依赖本 App 也能跑

界面速览

底部五个页签，按「先定目标机型 → 再决定改哪儿 → 再看结果与回滚」组织（下面的名字就是界面上的原文）：

| 页签 | 能做什么 |
|---|---|
| 首页 | Zygisk 状态 + 四个按钮（检测 / 安装 / 卸载 / 更新重装）；「目标伪装」卡：当前机型摘要、去机型库挑选或生成、应用隐藏（只改勾选的应用进程）、全局隐藏（改整机属性）、还原原始、随机换一个机型 |
| 伪装 | 当前目标机型、更换机型、机型字段（可折叠，逐项中文标签）、按当前字段重新推导指纹与构建号、应用隐藏入口 |
| 机型 | 搜索（通俗名 / 机型码 / 芯片）、全部品牌 筛选、版本筛选（全部版本 / Android 10+ / Android 12+）、收藏置顶、＋ 自定机型生成器 |
| 方案 | 保存当前方案、导出分享码、从剪贴板导入、方案列表（套用为当前目标 / 删除） |
| 工具 | 三路一致性自检（运行自检）、快照（立即存一份快照 / 刷新列表 / 每份可单独删除 / 回滚到这一份）、导出独立脚本到 /sdcard/ModelSpoof、真值基线（用当前状态重建 / 刷新）、危险区：恢复出厂（两道确认）、设备信息总览（只读） |

首页的「应用隐藏」是就地展开的面板，不用换页：搜索应用、勾选要隐藏的应用、可折叠的「已隐藏的应用」列表，
每个已隐藏的应用一张卡片 —— 更换机型 / 关闭伪装 / 移除，以及一键取消全部隐藏
（只停用，不清掉每个应用各自记着的机型；要恢复随时再勾上）。

设计

界面按 Material 3 组织，全部用代码构建（不用 XML 布局），因此换主题只要重建视图。

几个刻意的取舍：
- 不用实心 1px 灰边，改带透明度的发丝描边；不用硬阴影，深度靠表面色阶
  （深色下是色调抬升，浅色下才加一层极轻的环境阴影）。
- 同一层级的按钮只有一个高度（52dp），只有填充 / 色调 / 描边 / 文字四种语义区分主次。
- 导航项用固定尺寸的图标容器 + 药丸选中指示器，图标与文字因此永远在同一中轴线上，
  不受字体基线影响。
- 状态芯片排 2×2：四个挤一行时最后一个会被压成竖条（这是踩过的坑）。
- 列表用「单容器 + 发丝分隔行」，不是一摞卡片 —— 三千多台机每台一张卡会碎成一片。
- 标题不带上方小标签（kicker）：标题自己扛得住；标题上方的留白永远大于下方。
- 状态用图标而不是符号：收藏星是矢量图，不是 ★ 字符。

配色从应用图标里取样，深色走 OLED 深底，浅色走近白底；正文与次要文字都按 4.5:1 对比度选过。

构建

仓库分两部分，在 Android 设备上即可完成构建，不需要电脑：

app/      Android 应用（Java）
module/   Zygisk 原生模块（C++）

顺序是先构建模块、再构建 App —— App 会把模块产出的同一个 .so 作为自己的 native
自检库打进 APK，两条路走的是同一份代码。

1. 先构建模块

cd module
bash build.sh

产出 module/pkg/zygisk/libdtbprobe.so（同一个二进制另存一份 arm64-v8a.so，供 Zygisk
按约定名加载），同时刷新 module/pkg/module.prop。

需要 clang：NDK 自带的 clang、或任意能指定 -target 的交叉编译 clang 都可以（脚本按
aarch64-linux-android24 目标编译）。.so 不链接 libc++，只依赖 libc / liblog，
因此 Zygisk 从哪个目录加载它都不会缺库。

2. 再构建 App

cd app
bash build.sh

按 app/build.sh 里的步骤，依次是：

aapt2 compile res -o res.zip             # 编译资源
aapt2 link ... --java build/gen          # 链接资源、生成 R.java（--min-sdk-version 21 --target-sdk-version 34）
javac -cp tools/android.jar ...          # 编译 Java
d8 --min-api 21 ...                      # class → classes.dex
zip 追加写入                              # 把 classes.dex 与模块的 .so 打进 APK
apksigner sign --ks  ...        # 签名

其中 .so 的落点是 lib/arm64-v8a/libdtbprobe.so；如果模块还没构建，这一步会提示你
先回去跑 module/build.sh。产物是签名好的 APK，可直接安装。

需要自备三样（仓库里都不含）：
- android.jar：约 26 MB，自行放到 app/tools/android.jar（或用 ANDROID_JAR 指定）
- d8.jar 与 apksigner.jar：Android SDK build-tools 里自带；这两个没有默认值，
  必须用环境变量 D8、APKSIGNER 给出 jar 的完整路径，否则脚本会直接报错退出
- 签名密钥：仓库不含任何 keystore，请自建一个，用环境变量传入
  KEYSTORE（密钥库路径）、KS_PASS（口令）、KS_ALIAS（别名），
  别名口令不同时再用 KEY_PASS

工具链：aapt2 / javac / java / jar（另外 PYTHON 用于把 classes.dex 与
lib/arm64-v8a/libdtbprobe.so 追加进 APK，可用 PYTHON 指定解释器）。
不想一个个写环境变量的话：只要环境里有 ANDROID_SDK_ROOT（或 ANDROID_HOME），
app/build.sh 会自动从 platforms/ 与 build-tools/ 里挑版本最高的那一份，补齐
android.jar、d8.jar、apksigner.jar 与 aapt2；同一思路下 module/build.sh 支持
ANDROID_NDK_HOME（或 ANDROID_NDK_ROOT）自动找 NDK 里的 clang++。自动探测只在对应变量
没给、默认路径也找不到时才生效，找不到照旧按原来的方式报错，不猜版本、不下载任何东西。...
modules.changelog:
改机型工具箱 v1.0.0 · 首个公开版本

Android 机型伪装工具箱：系统级属性改写 + Zygisk 逐应用伪装（App + 原生模块）。

安装前请先确认三件事（缺一不可）

1. root：Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 任一，且提供 resetprop（少了它系统级伪装不可用，App 会明确提示而不是崩溃）
2. Zygisk：Zygisk Next 或 KernelSU 自带 —— 逐应用伪装依赖它
3. arm64 设备：本版只打包了 arm64-v8a 原生库；其他架构上应用能装，但只有机型库等不依赖原生库的功能可用

不需要联网：机型库（3,539 条，其中 3,312 条带真实指纹）内置在 APK 里，全程离线可用。

上手三步

1. 安装 APK（需允许「安装未知应用」），首次打开时给 root 授权
2. 在「机型」页挑一台目标机型；要改整机点首页 全局隐藏，只改某个应用点 应用隐藏 勾上它
3. 若安装了 Zygisk 模块，重启一次让 Zygisk 加载；之后逐应用即时生效、不用再重启

本版内容
- 内置机型库 3,539 条（3,312 条带真实指纹，93.6%）、278 个品牌，覆盖 Android 5.0 ～ 17
- 系统级伪装（root + resetprop）、开机持久化模块、快照与回滚、真值基线、方案与分享码
- App 级伪装：Zygisk 逐应用，只改被勾选的应用进程，整机真值原封不动
- 中文界面，深 / 浅色主题

关于构建产物
- 本 APK：1,145,903 字节，md5 6f9c5390e5fe89a2d2715f52d3f11cfb，由本仓库 v1.0.0 标签对应的源码构建
  （先 module/build.sh 产出原生模块，再由 app/build.sh 把它作为 lib/arm64-v8a/libdtbprobe.so 打进 APK）

modules.readme:
Systemless Cuts 2 Bootanimation for Magisk

Prior notice
I am not responsible for bricked devices or dead SD cards. YOU choose to install this module. If you will blame me, I will laugh at you. BTW, don't forget to take a TWRP backup before flashing, so that you will be in the safe zone.

Compatibility

Guarunteed compatibility with 720x1280 devices. I have not tried on other resolutions, but you may try.
Magisk 20.4+
Android 5.1+

Incompatibility

Samsung Devices: Samsung ROMs use a proprietary .QMG format for their boot animations. This bootanimation in will not work with your phone unless you convert it to .QMG format. See here for a converting solution.
If NOT running a Google/AOSP/LineageOS based ROM, especially if your ROM is heavily skinned by your manufacturer.
If you are using any other bootanimation changing Magisk module, first remove it, then flash this one.

Installation

Download this module and flash through Magisk App
OR
Manual Installation

Download the bootanimation.zip.
Use a root explorer and navigate to /system/media on your device.
Paste the bootanimation.zip which you have already downloaded in Step 1.
Set the permissions to rw--r--r (chmod 644).
Reboot and enjoy!

Credits
Dhruv Krishna Vaid - for making this module
John Wu - for developing Magisk
The one who created this animation (Sorry, but I don't know his name)

Happy flashing!

modules.readme:
WhatsApp消息自动翻译 外贸必备工具WATransChat

在 WhatsApp 中深度集成实时自动翻译功能，输入框可直接使用中文发送消息，对方将自动收到对应的本地语言内容。聊天记录中的任何语言消息也会实时翻译为中文，让跨语言沟通更加高效顺畅。

功能特点
- 支持输入中文直接发送，自动翻译为对方当地语言
- 自动翻译聊天记录中的任何语言消息为中文
- 支持 8 种翻译接口
- 支持 248 种语言
- 自动识别并显示：
- 对方国家
- 对方语言
- 当地货币
- 当地时间
- 支持自定义译文颜色

使用优势

帮助您快速了解客户背景，提升沟通效率与专业度，让全球客户沟通更加轻松便捷。

安装说明

Root / LSPosed 版本

1. 请确保您的设备已获得 Root 权限
2. 在你的设备上安装 LSPosed（Zygisk 或 Riru 版本）。
3. 下载并安装 WATransChat APK
4. 打开 LSPosed Manager 应用
5. 启用 WATransChat 模块。
6. 确保 WhatsApp 被选中
7. 强制停止 WhatsApp
8. 打开 WhatsApp，确认模块是否激活。
推荐使用最新版本的 LSPosed，以获得更好的兼容性与稳定性。

免 Root 版本

如果您的设备没有 Root 权限，也可以使用免 Root 的版本，谷歌Play商店直接搜索“WATransChat”下载安装。

法律声明 / Disclaimer

它与 WhatsApp 公司或 Meta Platforms， Inc.无任何关联、认可或关联。本项目仅“按现状”提供，供研究和教育目的使用。使用请自行承担风险。

modules.name: 防止烧屏 · OLED 防烧屏模块：周期透明化状态栏图标与导航栏，不影响下拉与通知；实测 K90 U
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 防止烧屏 · OLED 防烧屏模块：周期透明化状态栏图标与导航栏，不影响下拉与通知；实测 K90 Ultra HyperOS 4.0.0.15（Android 17）
modules.readme:
防止烧屏（Antiburn）

防 OLED 烧屏工具，当前稳定版 v3.2.6（versionCode 105），包名 io.github.wumisc.antiburn，签名不变，可直接覆盖安装。

OLED 像素会随点亮时长累积衰减。状态栏的时钟、信号、电量，导航栏的三个按键，短视频里固定不动的点赞、评论按钮，长期停在一处就会留下擦不掉的残影。模块让它们别一直亮在同一处：能透明化就透明化，不能就周期遮盖、像素微移，把曝光摊开。

两种运行方式

| 引擎 | 适用 | 能做到 | 做不到 |
|---|---|---|---|
| LSPosed 模块 | root + LSPosed | 透明化 / 隐藏状态栏、导航栏与抖音、红果、快手、B站各区域，像素微移 | 需要模块确实被注入目标 App 进程 |
| 无障碍遮盖 | 免 root | 按周期盖黑系统栏，并按屏幕比例遮盖抖音 / 红果 / 快手 / B站 的右侧按钮列、顶部标题、底部导航；触摸完全穿透 | 透明化、像素偏移 |

同一 APK 二选一：先在首页「运行方式」选引擎，再打开「防烧屏总开关」——总闸关着时一切隐藏与遮盖都不生效。免 root 路线可用 Shizuku 代开无障碍；要关闭功能，须先开无障碍再关总开关。遮盖只是让像素不发光，想要透明化与像素微移仍需 LSPosed。

App 内固定区域的防护方式：位置微移。 右侧按钮列、顶部标题、底部导航整体平移 2~3 像素，九宫格绕圈、每 8 秒一格，任何时刻都不回到原点停留；画面完整可见，点击照常。进直播间自动还原原位 —— 礼物栏与弹幕输入框位置是动态的，位移会点不准。

v2.8.3 曾用覆盖层把这几块区域盖黑，真机反馈会连视频画面一起压暗，v2.8.4 已停用，配置文件里残留的开关也不再生效。

微移跑在目标 App 进程内，前提是模块真的被注入。日志里出现 INJECTED Douyin / INJECTED Kuaishou / INJECTED Bilibili / INJECTED Drama 即为已注入；只有 INJECTED SystemUI 时看同一份日志的 LSPDB 行：

| LSPDB 输出 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| scope=complete | 作用域已齐，重启该 App 或手机即可注入 |
| added=… | 刚自动补上缺失的作用域，重启后生效 |
| module=unregistered | LSPosed 尚未识别本模块，先在管理器里启用并重启 |
| LSPDB none | 未找到 LSPosed 配置库（KernelSU 版路径不同或非 LSPosed 框架） |

有 root 时，首次打开本应用会自动补齐作用域并启用无障碍服务（A11Y auto-enabled），两件事都不需要手动去设置页操作。

功能
- 状态栏、导航栏独立开关；周期时长在「功能 → 通用」磁贴弹窗调整
- 抖音、红果短剧、快手、哔哩哔哩各自独立卡片，分区隐藏互不干扰（快手 / B站 可分别开关右侧列、顶部、底部、角落）
- 名单三态：白名单（命中豁免）、黑名单（仅命中才保护）、关闭；两份独立保存、切换不互相覆盖
- 七套界面适配（HyperOS / MagicOS / ColorOS / OriginOS / HarmonyOS / 魅族 Flyme / AOSP），首次打开按机型自动识别
- 进直播间自动暂停隐藏，退出即按原开关恢复
- 位置微移：固定控件整体平移 2~3px，不进直播间不归零，画面完整可见，触摸照常
- 进直播间还原：礼物栏与弹幕输入框位置动态，位移会造成点不准，进直播即归零
- 悬浮球、诊断日志、旧版 Hook 自检与一键重启系统界面；配置改动即时落盘
- 待机几乎不耗电：配置预取自适应降频（活跃 2 秒 / 空闲 20 秒 / 灭屏 60 秒），遮盖服务空转 5 秒一帧，灭屏后不再查询前台应用；诊断日志只在状态变化时落盘（心跳 60 秒），不再每秒写一行
- 悬浮球可拖到屏幕最下方松手收起，下次打开自动恢复
- 隐藏桌面图标后仍可从 LSPosed / 系统设置正常打开
- 无障碍模式可周期遮盖抖音 / 红果 / 快手 / B站 的右侧按钮列、顶部标题与底部导航（免 root，仅 overlay 引擎）
- 感谢名单（酷安 / 心之所及等）与支持捐赠

最近更新（v3.2.4 → v3.2.6）
- v3.2.6：整条移除状态栏「三班倒」。真机日志 zone=no L1/R0/w1280 说明这台设备探不到左右分区，三班倒与主周期是两套独立时钟，降级只能保证「不硬演」不能保证「跟周期」，表现为图标不按 40/10 走。删除范围：statusRound / applyStatusRound() / 三段调度 / applyHide 让路分支 / sideAllowed 四相位分支 / zoneReady+lastProbe+probeLeaves() 分区探测 / lastMaskSig / applyShowNavOnly() / Config.enableStatusRound / conf 键 / 通用页开关行。状态栏回到单一时钟：隐藏相位 hideStatusKeepNotify（按「隐藏时间 / 隐藏右侧图标」分侧），显示相位 applyShow。白名单残留恢复条件保留 hidden || statusChildrenHidden()。测试 853 项全绿（新增 T-72 零残留八条）。
- v3.2.5：开关翻正 + 再压一轮功耗 + 闭合覆盖缺口。① 「取消三班倒」改成正向「三班倒」：勾上=三档轮换（只遮右 / 只遮左 / 全遮），关掉=走原来的整条隐藏（applyHide，通知让开照旧），底层 enable_status_round 仍 1=开，老配置不用迁移；② 功耗四处：applyMask() 加同帧短路（相位内不再每秒重建 5 个 Rect）、KeyguardManager 3 秒缓存 + 灭屏短路、配置 TTL 8s→15s、前台包查询 1s→3s；③ 四区比例：R 右界左边界 84%→80%（907→864px）、B 底部起点 90%→86%（2160→2064px），把快手带货卡/评论区所在的 84%~86% 横带夹住；④ release 开 minifyEnabled + shrinkResources（-dontobfuscate + 全包 keep），APK 36.66MB→3.48MB，模块自身代码仅 0.46MB。测试 855 项全绿（新增 T-71）。
- v3.2.4：「取消三班倒」开关放进「通用 → 状态栏」正下方（默认开=保持三班倒，关掉回两段周期）；修白名单残影 —— 白名单/直播暂停分支的恢复条件由 if (hidden) 改为 if (hidden || statusRound >= 0 || statusChildrenHidden())，微信这类白名单应用不会再卡在「时间被遮、右侧信号电量还亮」。测试 846 项全绿（新增 T-70）。
- v3.2.3：功耗与体积治理。① 灭屏停车（idleParked + 屏幕三广播，灭屏彻底停 tick）、invalidateConfig() 缓存失效、诊断串惰性化、抖音全树扫描 400ms→1500ms；② release 首次开 R8（不混淆），36.66MB→3.48MB；③ 新增 T-68/T-69 测试。测试 846 项全绿。
- v3.2.2：无障碍「盖黑」不再吞掉悬浮通知。免 root 的遮盖层是一块不透明黑矩形，z-order 高于 heads-up 横幅 —— 通知弹在状态栏下方时会被整块盖住，而旧版无障碍只监听窗口切换、根本不知道有通知。现在：① 事件类型补上 typeNotificationStateChanged，收到通知后只撤顶部区 10 秒（右侧列/底部/角落照旧遮）；② 通用页新增「通知弹出时让开」开关（默认开），关掉即回到旧行为；③ 首页「运行方式」卡片在选中无障碍引擎时直接写明这件事，不再让用户自己撞出来。
- v3.2.1：Pixel / AOSP 状态栏修复。① 补回「整层透明」第 4 级兜底 —— 前三级（几何分区 / 除通知 / 除横幅）都只遮「能遍历到的叶子」，Android 16 的时钟与系统图标由 Compose 直接绘制、没有子 View，于是三级链全跑完只遮到 3 个空节点（真机 dim=3 zone=w1080/n1/h0/f2=3 却肉眼无变化）；v2.5.2 靠整层 alpha 一直有效，这版把它作为最后一级接回来，栏内存在显示中的 heads-up 横幅时自动放弃整层，悬浮通知不受影响。② 无子 ViewGroup 一律当叶子处理（四处递归入口）。③ 导航栏抓取放宽：NavBarView 类名 + nav_bar 资源名 + 按 id 找（Pixel 真机 nv=none 的修复）。
- v3.2：稳定性 / 省电版。① 分不了区的机型退出「状态栏三班倒」——真机 zone=no 时 rot 在 2 和 3 之间每 20/40 秒翻一次、dim 在 19 和 0 之间跳，观感就是状态栏整条黑一阵亮一下；现在测不出左右分区就交回常规 hide/show 相位，不再硬演三段。② 省电：SYS 行的「变化签名」剔除 hid/rot/dim/nv/zone 这些每轮都在变的字段（旧版退化成每秒一条，一天八万行），心跳 30s→60s；MASK 行对前台包名去抖，系统插件进程来回切不再每次写盘。③ 状态栏宽度判定 aw 恒为 0 的兜底修正（改用 View 自身宽度），不再每轮白跑一遍兜底扫描。
- v3.1.1：把「系统界面里跑的还是旧版」提示搬到首页一级——它原来只在「运行方式」二级页里，等于让用户先点进去才知道自己白点了。一级直接可点「重启系统界面」，重启后自动消失。
- v3.1：首页重排。「运行方式」+「界面适配」合并成一张一级卡片，两个功能打开 App 就能直接调（切引擎要重启界面、识别错了手动改，都写在芯片下方）；「隐藏桌面图标」「从最近任务隐藏」合并为「本应用隐身」一个开关；总开关的「已开启/已关闭」移到开关左侧同一行。
- v3.0.36：快手「半拉隐藏」修复——识别结果加 3 轮宽限（滚动 / 弹层 / 重绘落空不再立刻释放已藏控件），跨容器收集右缘按钮列（快手新版把点赞 / 评论 / 收藏 / 分享拆成各自容器，旧口径「同容器 ≥2 个」导致整列判空）；状态栏成败判定从「遮了几个」改成「遮了多宽」；新增隐藏台账，showAll 按台账全量还原，杜绝「藏过一次就再也不亮」。
- v3.0.22：修底部 chrome 贴底判定的坐标系错位（沉浸式下差一个状态栏），并修正通用页「4/3 项」计数错位；新增 BOTTOMCHROME add 诊断日志。
- v3.0.21：修合集页 / 搜索单视频页底部固定条不隐藏——新增 collectBottomChrome（半屏宽、≤14% 屏高、贴底 86%，含输入框或「有什么想法/展开说说/合集/下一集」文案），并排除抖音「取消静音」音量浮层。
- v3.0.20：状态栏隐藏细分为「隐藏时间」「隐藏右侧图标」两个独立开关（中间通知区永远保留）；「周期时间」从通用二级页提到功能首页首屏，通用页旧入口删除。
- v3.0.19：修悬浮球「显」模式仍误伤——hideSafe / transparentDeep 最底层统一加 forceShow 闸，显模式下任何隐藏请求都改为恢复，右侧点赞/评论不会再消失。
- v3.0.18：v3.0.17 装到真机仍「没效果」（dim=1）——HyperOS 4 把右侧系统图标挂在资源名带 notification 的容器下，被 containsHeadsUp 当成横幅整支跳过。本版把横幅判据收紧为只认 heads_up/headsup 类名或资源名，并加三级降级链：几何分区 → 除通知叶子外全透明 → 除正在显示的横幅外全透明（必胜）；SYS 行新增 zone= 诊断（栏宽/命中数/跳横幅数，兜底时追加 /f2=、/f3=）。
- v3.0.17：修状态栏隐藏/偏移在 HyperOS 4 上完全不生效——类名匹配（Clock/Signal/Battery）一个都不命中（真机 dim=0），改为按几何分区透明：左区时钟、右区信号电池透明，中区通知图标区整棵保留；含 Notification 的叶子和 heads-up 子树一律不动，通知与悬浮横幅不误伤。

modules.changelog:
这版只做一件事：整条移除状态栏「三班倒」。

为什么删
真机日志（v3.2.5，73 行）：

SYS-ROUND zone=no L1/R0/w1280
SYS ... rot=-1 dim=19 zone=w1280/n1/h0/aw0

这台设备探不到左右分区（L1/R0），三班倒整套前提不成立，只能降级退出——但降级只保证「不硬演」，不保证「跟周期」。根因是三班倒与主周期是两套独立时钟（三段 show/show/hide vs 两段 hide/show），分区判定、配置签名、视图重建任何一环错位，两边就错开，表现就是图标不按 40/10 走。

历史上在这套双时钟上打过四次补丁（v3.0.30 硬演翻车、v3.0.31 加探测、v3.2 不可分区退出、v3.2.4 白名单残影）。这次不再修，整条删掉，回到单一时钟。

删了什么
- Controller：statusRound 字段、applyStatusRound()、三段调度边界、applyHide() 的让路空分支、applyShowNavOnly()、applyShow() 的相位复位
- Controller：zoneReady / lastProbe / probeLeaves()（分区探测）、lastMaskSig（轮播签名）
- Controller：sideAllowed() 的 statusRound == 0/1/2/3 四个分支
- Controller：hideDiag() 的 rot= 字段
- Config：enableStatusRound 字段与 enable_status_round 解析
- ConfStore：默认键 enable_status_round=1
- MainActivity：字段 / 存档索引 50 / 读写映射 / putB / 通用页开关整行
- 测试：T-70 六条 + T-71-A1~A3b 四条，换成 T-72 八条「零残留 + 回两段」

老配置里残留的 enable_status_round=1 会被解析器直接忽略，不用手动清配置。

现在的状态栏
- 隐藏相位：applyHide() → hideStatusKeepNotify()，按「隐藏时间 / 隐藏右侧图标」决定遮左、遮右或整条（中间 34%~62% 通知区永远保留）
- 显示相位：applyShow() 整条恢复
- 一个时钟、两个参数（隐藏时间 / 显示时间），日志里 hid= 与 cyc= 直接对应，不再有 rot=
- 白名单 / 直播暂停 / 灭屏恢复条件保留 if (hidden || statusChildrenHidden())，微信不会再卡「只遮一半」

保留
功耗四改（applyMask() 同帧短路、keyguard 3s 缓存 + 灭屏短路、配置 TTL 15s、前台包 3s 缓存）、四区比例 80/86、裁剪口径、无障碍通知让开 10 秒。

modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: AnyWebView / Any WebView is OK!
modules.readme:
AnyWebView

Any WebView is OK!

Feature

It tries to detect all system webviews and add them to the developer options -> WebView implementation list.

Usage

Android Framework should be selected in LSPosed.

A webview app must be installed for all users (or in all spaces, so-called Dual app, Second space, etc.) to be selectable. Maybe deleting redundant users is alternative.
adb command:

Enable "redundant packages" (Maybe it won't work, but that's OK.):

adb shell cmd webviewupdate enable-redundant-packages

Get USER_ID list:

adb shell pm list users

Each user entry is as follow: UserInfo{USER_ID:USERNAME:INT} , USER_ID 0 is the main user.

Install apk for specific USER_ID:

adb install --user USER_ID PATH/TO/APK/ON/COMPUTER

or

adb shell pm install-existing --user USER_ID PACKAGE.NAME.OF.APK (for apks already installed for one user)

or

adb push PATH/TO/APK/ON/COMPUTER PATH/TO/APK/ON/PHONE (copy an apk file to phone from computer)

adb shell pm install --user USER_ID PATH/TO/APK/ON/PHONE

Delete a user (NOT RECOMENDED, be careful, you may lose important data):

adb shell pm remove-user USER_ID

All the adb shell pm ... commands above can be run in an Android terminal simulator(root access granted) as pm ...

Reboot to take effect.

FAQ

Can I set Chrome as the system webview implementation?

Only supported on Android 8-9, not supported on Android 10+. It is Google's policy that Google Chrome app is no longer the WebView provider in Android 10. Even though it is listed in the WebView implementation, it does not work on Android 10+. Related discussion: AnyWebView#12

Is Bromite/Mulch/Vanadium etc. system webview supported?

Yes.

Learn More (For Developers)

WebView quick start

WebView for AOSP system integrators

WebView Architecture

Installing SystemWebView

android_webview/nonembedded

WebViewFactory.java

modules.name: Bipan
modules.author: OmarMesqq
modules.description: An anti-fingerprinting and security sandbox for Android
modules.readme:
Bipan

Bipan is an anti-fingerprinting sandbox for Android which works on a per-app
basis. For the apps you wish to jail, Bipan applies a set of patches *at runtime*
which mitigate fingerprinting:
- Phone identity: Bipan alters your phone's "ID" at the JVM and native layer so that apps can't fingerprint your hardware for nefarious purposes.
- Sensors blinding: Some apps will map all available sensors in your device, which, by itself, can be a quite unique identification vector. Furthermore, they query those sensors for behavioral tracking (e.g.: how close you are to the phone (proximity), whether you are in car (accelerometer)) and so on. Bipan blocks this at native and at the Java layer.
- Randomization of uniquely identifying fields: Your Android phone features a ton of OS- and hardware-backed IDs that can be queried without your consent and - if done smartly - a permanent fingerprint of your device can be established, surviving even factory resets. How many times your phone was rebooted, the SSAID, the ID tied to your phone's DRM blackbox (for playing protected (copyrighted) content) which, according to Google, is unique and made so at device provisioning. Bipan spoofs these and some others, once again, natively and at the JVM boundary.[1]
- Unlocking usage of apps: apps will unceasingly check whether they were installed from Google's Play Store or if they were "sideloaded" - cool word for downloading apps. With Bipan, the Play Store is returned as the installer and maintainer package for targeted apps so you don't stand out in the crowd nor get blocked by some "anti-fraud" SDK. Additionally, some apps, like banking and gaming ones, will flag or even block you if Development Settings, for instance, is enabled. Bipan also handles this.
- Blocks app discovery: Although Google made this harder in Android 11+,
apps can still query and gather info on arbitrary packages declared in their Manifest via the  attribute which, needless to say, can have a ton of entries. Furthermore, if you have a convincing reason, you can ship your app to the Play Store holding the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission, which does precisely what is states. Bipan blinds all these attempts.
- Screen-related patches: Google introduced new APIs
which allow developers to write apps that detect screenshots and
screen recordings while the app is visible.
Furthermore, those actions *can be blocked* by the application
if it deems the currently shown content as sensitive. Bipan bypasses
these detection and blocking mechanisms, thus allowing screenshots and recordings
in any app screen. But please, do me a favor, exercise caution and be a good person.
- Privacy preserving and powerful networking: Surely apps may have legitimate reasons to learn about your local network topology or get details of your connection. Nonetheless, Bipan is quite agressive when it comes to networking.
If you choose Bipan, your sandboxed apps will consistently get a fake and fixed IPv4 address and have no LAN IPv6 (this is a personal choice, but IPv6 addresses are a gazillion times more unique than IPv4 ones. It was created for this purpose!). Additionaly, VPNs, Private DNS usage, your precious Wi-Fi network name (SSID) and its associated hardware address (BSSID) are also hidden from jailed apps. Finally, I bumped the MTU of the active network interface to 1500. This may help conceal VPN usage even further and aid in online games.
- Some security measures: Bipan fools apps requesting the listen syscall, which allows your phone to act as server and accept inbound connections, by always returning success[2]. Binary execution - at both the Java layer with Runtime.exec() and whatnots as well as the good old unix fork()/exec() - is blocked.
This works because Bipan operates at the syscall level: you can't (I think?) lie to the kernel ;)

[1] Randomizing such IDs, in particular the SSAID, may log you out of several apps, so an allowlist is available (for now, in code only).

[2] This obviously breaks apps which may use this for good reasons such setting up a hotspot or a NAS-like server.

Usage
Prerequisites
- An Android device running the aarch64/arm64-v8a and/or armeabi-v7a architectures whose minimum SDK is 28 and is rooted with Magisk >= 26

At each app launch, Bipan is injected by Zygisk and applies the patches to the app
using info at the module's private folder: /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/
To jail an app using Bipan, simply touch a file inside this folder with the package name of the targeted app:

As root:
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.omarmesqq.grunfeld
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.android.vending
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.google.android.gms
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.google.android.gms.unstable
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.facebook.katana
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.instagram.android
touch /data/adb/modules/bipan/targets/com.android.webview

Alternatively, you can use the *Bipan Manager* app to sandbox in the apps:

If the launched app isn't in this list, Bipan exits cleanly and doesn't apply
any sort of modification to the app's memory.

Building
Prerequisites
1. Android SDK, NDK and JDK tools/binaries  in your PATH
- SDK: Android 16/API level 36 (android-36)
- NDK >= 25.1.8937393
- JDK: >= 21 (though it may work with 17 or 11)
- ANDROID_HOME and NDK_HOME set

2. Ensure you also have common Unix CLI utils in PATH, in special, xxd and zip
3. r8's JAR file at root of repo:
- at least 9.3.7-dev
- you can get it with curl --get https://storage.googleapis.com/r8-releases/raw/9.3.7-dev/r8lib.jar -o r8lib.jar
4. Clone this repo
5. Run the build_module.sh script
6. The module's flashable zip will be at the project's root with the name bipan.zip

(Optional) Building Dobby
Bipan leverages Dobby, an inline hooking framework, for, well, exactly that....

modules.readme:
Custos - Anti-Forensic Defense Module

A paranoid-level defensive Magisk module designed to neutralize forensic extraction vectors used by commercial tools such as Cellebrite UFED, Oxygen Forensic Detective, and MOBILedit Forensic.
DISCLAIMER: This module is intended for legitimate privacy protection and security research. Use responsibly and in accordance with applicable laws.

Table of Contents

1. Features
2. Threat Analysis
3. Installation
4. Configuration
5. Usage
6. Recovery
7. Technical Details
8. Architecture
9. SELinux Policies
10. Troubleshooting
11. FAQ

Features

Core Defensive Capabilities

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| USB Lockdown | Enforces charge-only mode, preventing data negotiation |
| ADB Neutralization | Persistently kills and blocks Android Debug Bridge |
| Key Eviction | Removes encryption keys from memory on hostile events |
| Boot Anomaly Detection | Detects recovery mode, EDL, and tampered boot images |
| Hostile Custody Mode | Panic mode for border/arrest scenarios |
| State Machine | Managed transitions between security states |
| Failsafe Timer | Prevents permanent self-lockout |

What Gets Blocked
- ✅ USB data transfer (MTP, PTP, ADB)
- ✅ Logical extraction via content providers
- ✅ Physical extraction via ADB root
- ✅ File system extraction
- ✅ Cloud token extraction
- ✅ Memory forensics (key eviction)
- ✅ Recovery mode exploitation

Threat Analysis

Cellebrite UFED

| Attack Vector | Method | Status |
|--------------|--------|--------|
| Logical Extraction | ADB backup, content providers | BLOCKED |
| Physical Extraction | Bootloader exploits, EDL mode | BLOCKED |
| File System Extraction | Custom recovery | BLOCKED |
| JTAG/Chip-off | Physical memory access | MITIGATED (key eviction) |

Why Cellebrite Fails: Without USB data negotiation, UFED cannot establish any communication channel. The device appears as a "dumb charger" with no enumerable interfaces.

Oxygen Forensic Detective

| Attack Vector | Method | Status |
|--------------|--------|--------|
| Cloud Extraction | Session tokens | BLOCKED (token purge) |
| Logical Plus | ADB root shell | BLOCKED |
| Physical Extraction | Chipset exploits | BLOCKED |

Why Oxygen Fails: Oxygen relies heavily on ADB for Android extraction. With persistent ADB neutralization and USB lockdown, no extraction path is available. Cloud extraction is defeated by session token purge.

MOBILedit Forensic

| Attack Vector | Method | Status |
|--------------|--------|--------|
| MTP/PTP Access | USB transfer protocols | BLOCKED |
| ADB Extraction | Debug bridge | BLOCKED |
| SIM Clone Detection | ICCID reading | BLOCKED |

Why MOBILedit Fails: MOBILedit is entirely dependent on USB connectivity. With charge-only enforcement and ADB neutralization, the tool cannot interact with the device at all.

Installation

Requirements
- Android 8.0+ (API 26+)
- Magisk 20.4+ installed
- ARM64 device (recommended)

Steps

1. Download the latest release ZIP
2. Open Magisk Manager
3. Go to Modules → Install from storage
4. Select the ZIP file
5. Reboot when prompted

First Boot

On first boot after installation:

1. The module initializes with a default recovery phrase: custos_recovery_2025
2. IMMEDIATELY change this phrase:
      su -c 'sh /data/adb/modules/custos/common/recovery_validator.sh set "your_secret_phrase"'
   3. MEMORIZE your recovery phrase - it's the only way to exit hostile mode

Configuration

Trigger Configuration

Edit /data/adb/custos/triggers.conf:

Hostile mode triggers (immediate activation)
volume_down:5:3:enabled       # Vol- 5x in 3 seconds
sim_removed:enabled           # SIM card removal
lockscreen_fail:5:enabled     # 5 failed unlock attempts
usb_data_attempt:enabled      # USB data mode detection
boot_anomaly:enabled          # Abnormal boot detection

Alert mode triggers (warning level)
airplane_toggle:3:alert       # Airplane toggle 3x
power_button:7:5:alert        # Power 7x in 5 seconds

Timing configuration
alert_timeout:30              # Seconds in alert before normal
hostile_min_duration:60       # Minimum hostile mode duration
failsafe_hours:72            # Auto-exit hostile after 72h

Disabling Specific Triggers

To disable a trigger, comment it out or change enabled to disabled:

sim_removed:disabled

Usage

State Overview

┌─────────┐     suspicious      ┌─────────┐
│ NORMAL  │ ─────────────────── │  ALERT  │
└────┬────┘                     └────┬────┘
     │                               │
     │ immediate threat              │ confirmed
     │                               │
     ▼                               ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              HOSTILE MODE               │
│  • USB locked to charge-only            │
│  • ADB completely neutralized           │
│  • Encryption keys evicted              │
│  • Biometrics disabled                  │
│  • Airplane mode enabled                │
└────────────────────┬────────────────────┘
                     │
                     │ valid recovery phrase
                     ▼
                ┌──────────┐
                │ RECOVERY │ ──── ► NORMAL
                └──────────┘

Manual Hostile Mode Activation

Panic Trigger (recommended): Press Volume Down 5 times within 3 seconds

Alternative methods:
- Remove SIM card
- Toggle airplane mode 3 times quickly
- Via terminal (if accessible):
    su -c 'sh /data/adb/modules/custos/common/hostile_mode.sh activate'

Checking Status

su -c 'sh /data/adb/modules/custos/common/hostile_mode.sh status'

Recovery

Exiting Hostile Mode

1. Via Terminal (if you have shell access):
      su -c 'sh /data/adb/modules/custos/common/recovery_validator.sh interactive'
      Enter your recovery phrase when prompted.

2. Via Failsafe Timer: After 72 hours (configurable), hostile mode automatically deactivates.

3. Via Magisk Manager: If you can access Magisk, disable the module and reboot.

Screenshots

Home

What it does
- Uses a photo or video that you import as the camera source of an app you select, where the device, camera API and app support it.
- Lets you choose the target apps and adjust playback, rotation, mirror, zoom and framing. A Main source and four presets can be saved and switched.
- Lets you switch a configured target between the virtual feed and the real physical camera. Some apps need their camera reopened before a change appears; DRVCAM tells you when that is the case.
- Offers an optional floating controller that stays above the app you are using (needs the overlay permission).
- Leaves the real microphone unchanged — DRVCAM does not replace or process audio.

Requirements
- A rooted Android device (Magisk or KernelSU), Android 9 and newer. Camera replacement needs root; without it the app opens but replacement is unavailable.
- An Xposed-family framework that supports libxposed API 102 — DRVCAM is tested with Vector (the successor of LSPosed). A framework without API 102 support will not load the module.
- Enough decoder and graphics capacity for the media and app you choose.

Download

This listing carries the phone build for Android 9 and newer (arm64). The emulator image is on droidrooter.com/drvcam, with a picker that recommends the right one for your device.

Every release here includes its SHA-256 in the release notes — verify your download before installing.

Install

1. Download and install the APK that matches your Android version and device type (above).
2. Open your framework manager and enable DRVCAM, then reboot if it asks you to.
3. Open DRVCAM and grant root when prompted. DRVCAM manages the scope of the apps you select from inside its own app — you do not need to add anything by hand in the framework manager.
4. Sign in, or choose Try Free (see Free plan and paid plans).
5. Import a photo or video into Library, select it, choose a target app, then Enable. Open the target app's camera yourself.
6. Check the result inside the target app. DRVCAM's own preview helps you pick media; it does not by itself prove the target app received the feed.

Disable removes DRVCAM's scope from the target again.

Free plan and paid plans

DRVCAM needs a DRVCAM account and an internet connection for sign-in, device registration and renewal. After signing in, the app can keep working offline for a limited period.
- Try Free (no cost): image sources, one target app.
- Paid plans: video sources, several target apps, the floating controller and the Camera Source switch.

Current plans, device limits and prices: droidrooter.com/drvcam.

Privacy basics
- Your media stays on your device for the camera workflow — the account service does not need your media or camera frames to sign you in.
- The account service processes account, device and subscription data so that sign-in and licensing work. Diagnostics are sent only when you request them.
- A target app can still save, analyse or transmit what its camera shows; that app's own privacy practices apply.
- Full policy: droidrooter.com/privacy.

FAQ

Does this need root?

Yes. Camera replacement is delivered through a system-level hook that requires root and a compatible Xposed-family framework.

Will it work on my device?

Only verified combinations are listed on the product page. Device, firmware and camera app vary too much to promise support in advance.

Can I use it without signing in?

Yes, with Try Free (image sources, one target app). Video and the other features need a paid plan.

Does it replace my microphone too?

No. DRVCAM only replaces what the camera sees. The real microphone is left untouched, whichever plan you're on.

Can I use a live network stream as my camera source?

Yes, on a paid plan. Import an RTSP/RTMP stream the same way you'd import a photo or video.

How many camera setups can I save?

A Main setup plus four presets. Presets need a paid plan; Main is available on the free plan too.

What does Remote Diagnosis do?

It lets support connect to your device to help diagnose an issue. It's off by default — you turn it on yourself in Settings only when you want help.

I lost my password — what do I do?

Account recovery is manual for now; use the Support links below.

Where is the source code?

Not published here. This repository is a module listing with signed release binaries only.

Disclaimer

DRVCAM is beta software, provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. Rooting a device and installing a systemless framework are actions you take at your own risk and may affect your device's warranty or stability.

You are solely responsible for the media you use, for the applications you use DRVCAM with, and for complying with the laws and the terms that apply to you. The developer is not responsible for any illegal, unauthorized or otherwise improper use of this software.

Signed release build — DRVCAM 1.0.6, versionCode 89. One APK covers Android 9–17 (phone = arm64, emulator = x86_64).

Hotfix over 1.0.5.

Fixed
- The app could get stuck on, or close at, the splash screen on some devices — most often after upgrading from an older version. It now recovers to a Retry / sign-in screen instead of hanging, so you can always get back in.
- Some phones signed you out, or sat on "checking", after a restart — most often on rooted devices running a secure-keystore spoofing module, where the keystore is briefly unavailable right after boot. The app now stays signed in across the reboot and recovers on its own once the keystore is ready, instead of locking you out until you sign in again.

Verify & install
- Download only from droidrooter.com or the official release pages. Builds modified or re-signed by anyone else are unsupported and receive no licences. Always update older builds to this one.
- Signing certificate SHA-256: d705c053bd41b95af6d10f00ac69ce5daf4f7320778e0965d139fb7377e05869

Full history: CHANGELOG.md

_Stable release. Behaviour can still vary by device, Android build, root and Xposed framework, target app and camera mode. Using DRVCAM illegally is the user's responsibility._

modules.name: MTK Extreme Bandwidth Mod
modules.author: Elvan
modules.description: Universal network optimization for all MediaTek (Helio/Dimensity). WiFi · LTE · NR/5G · TCP/BBR · VoLTE · 3 profiles (Performance/Balanced/Battery). Aborts on non-MTK.
modules.readme:
MTK Extreme Bandwidth Mod
v1.0 — Universal Magisk module for all MediaTek devices
Helio G / P / X · Dimensity · MT6xxx · MT8xxx

Pure network optimization — WiFi, LTE, NR/5G, TCP, VoLTE, data connectivity.
No GPU/audio/memory tweaks. Network only.

Features

system.prop — 14 Sections (~270 props)

| # | Section | What it does |
|---|---------|-------------|
| 01 | LTE Carrier Aggregation | Forces CA on uplink + downlink, increases LTE.lteca cap |
| 02 | MTK Baseband & RIL | Baseband optimization, AMR wideband, HSDPA cat 24 |
| 03 | Fast Dormancy Disabled | Disables modem sleep for lower latency/ping |
| 04 | WiFi Power Save Off | Disables all WiFi power limits, 2.4+5GHz aggregation, WiFi 6/6E (HE/TWT/MBO/OCE/SAE) |
| 05 | TCP Buffer Sizes | Buffers up to 64MB for NR, 32MB for WiFi |
| 06 | HW Offloading | GRO hardware offload, disables modem/WiFi debug logging |
| 07 | DNS Cloudflare | Forces 1.1.1.1 on rmnet0, rmnet1, and base |
| 08 | Network Hints & QoS | iWLAN, QoS, high-bandwidth preference, netmgrd |
| 09 | NR/5G Force | SA + NSA, all global bands, default network mode 26 |
| 10 | MTK Universal Stack | ConnSys auto-detect, multi-RAT, IMS/VoLTE/WFC/ViLTE full stack, DSDS |
| 11 | LTE-A + NR Extended | EN-DC, MIMO, 256QAM, HARQ, beam management, PDCP ROHC, BWP timer |
| 12 | VoLTE / VoNR | HD Voice + 5G calling, WFC, debug override |
| 13 | Connectivity & Stall Recovery | Data stall detection, PDCP/RLC aggregation, RRC timers, keepalive |
| 14 | Mobile Data Optimization | MTU 1500, DL/UL batch 64/32 packets, packet scheduler, signal threshold |
| 15 | Unlock Network Features in Settings UI | Shows 5G/VoLTE/WFC/ViLTE toggles, full network mode selector, APN editor, signal dBm — works on AOSP, MIUI, HyperOS, ColorOS, Origins, and all custom ROMs |

service.sh — 10 Sections (runs every boot)

| # | Section | What it does |
|---|---------|-------------|
| 1 | Radio props | Re-applies NR/CA/MIMO/EN-DC after modem init |
| 2 | IMS/VoLTE/WFC | Re-applies full IMS stack props after boot |
| 3 | TCP/BBR | BBR congestion control, 32MB buffers, fastopen, keepalive |
| 4 | UDP/QUIC | UDP buffer 64K min, QUIC-ready |
| 5 | WiFi runtime | Power save off, 5GHz preferred, roaming trigger -75dBm |
| 6 | DNS override | Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 on all active interfaces (overrides DHCP) |
| 7 | Network IRQ affinity | Binds wlan/modem IRQs to big CPU cores (adaptive mask per core count) |
| 8 | Data stall recovery | Runtime keepalive + PSM disabled |
| 9 | txqueuelen + RPS | Sets txqueuelen=3000 on all interfaces, RPS on rmnet |
| 10 | eSIM runtime | Forces eUICC, LPA, GSMA RSP, hot-swap props after modem init |

New sections added

| # | Section | What it does |
|---|---------|-------------|
| 16 | MTK CCCI | Cross Chip Communication Interface — modem↔AP handshake, bypass FSD |
| 17 | Antenna Switch & RX Diversity | 4RX diversity for LTE + NR, antenna impedance, SAR switch |
| 18 | CA Scheduler | Up to 4 LTE CA components, BW class A-D, NR intra+inter band CA |
| 19 | ConnAC WiFi Chip | MT663x/MT665x — A-MPDU/A-MSDU, OFDMA DL+UL, SU/MU beamformee, WPA3 |
| 20 | IMS Stack Extended | AMR-WB, EVS, Opus codecs, RTCP-XR, emergency VoWiFi, bearer persist |
| 21 | Network Search | Fast camp, RAT priority NR>LTE>WCDMA>GSM, PLMN scan interval |
| 22 | Signal Processing & Uplink | AFC, ULFD, MCS boost UL/DL, 4-rank MIMO, CQI/CSI period tuning |
| 23 | PS/CS Fallback + SRVCC | SRVCC type 3, CSFB timeout, ECBM, PS2 RAT scan |
| 24 | Data Throttle & QoS | Throttle=0, QoS scheduler, 5G network slicing, URSP |
| 25 | Modem Power & Sleep | Fast wakeup, sleep threshold -100dBm, PMIC ctrl, plmn wakelock off |
| 26 | ConnSys Coexistence | WiFi priority over BT/GPS, PTA enable, BT coex mode 2 |
| 27 | WiFi AP Communication | WMM/EDCA, Block ACK 64-frame window, ADDTS QoS Traffic Stream, SU/MU beamforming CSI feedback to AP, 802.11k Neighbor Report, 802.11v BSS Transition, 802.11r Fast Roaming, 2×2 MIMO spatial streams, rate adaptation |

Device Support

Automatically detected at install. Aborts on non-MTK hardware.

| Detection Method | Property / Path |
|-----------------|-----------------|
| Platform string | ro.board.platform starts with mt |
| Vendor platform | ro.vendor.mediatek.platform starts with mt |
| Hardware | ro.hardware starts with mt |
| SoC model | ro.soc.model starts with MT |
| Dimensity | ro.soc.model contains Dimensity |
| MTK battery | /proc/mtk_battery_cmd exists |
| MTK sysfs | /sys/devices/platform/mediatek exists |
| BT debug node | /sys/kernel/debug/mtk_btcvsd exists |
| MTK namespace | Any prop matching *.mtk.* |

Any one match → installation proceeds.

Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| SoC | Any MediaTek (Helio, Dimensity, MT-series) |
| Root | Magisk v24+ or KernelSU |
| Android | 10 and above |
| ROM | Any — AOSP, MIUI, HyperOS, ColorOS, custom |

Installation

1. Download mtk_bwmod.zip
2. Magisk → Modules → Install from storage
3. Select the zip
4. Installer checks your SoC — aborts if not MTK
5. Reboot

File Structure

mtk_bwmod/
├── META-INF/
│   └── com/google/android/
│       ├── update-binary
│       └── updater-script
├── module.prop
├── system.prop       ← 14 sections, ~270 props
├── customize.sh      ← 9-method MTK detection + install
├── service.sh        ← 9-section runtime boot service
└── README.md

Log

adb shell cat /data/local/tmp/mtk_bwmod.log

Disclaimer

These props and sysctl tweaks target MTK-specific modem/radio/WiFi firmware interfaces. Results vary by carrier, ROM, and chipset generation. No hardware is modified. Safe to remove by disabling/deleting the module.

License

MIT — free to use, modify, and redistribute.
modules.changelog:
Changelog

v2.3

Changed
- Reworked the module around a small, restorable TCP tuning profile.
- Added persistent performance, balanced, and battery profiles.
- Added noninteractive profile selection:
    /data/adb/modules/mtk_bwmod/action.sh performance
  /data/adb/modules/mtk_bwmod/action.sh balanced
  /data/adb/modules/mtk_bwmod/action.sh battery
- Performance uses 32 MiB socket buffer limits and enables BBR only when the running kernel reports BBR as available.
- Balanced uses 16 MiB socket buffer limits and restores the captured pre-module congestion-control value.
- Battery Saver restores the boot-scoped original TCP buffer and congestion-control values.
- Added boot ID tracking so saved restoration values are refreshed after a reboot.
- Installer now preserves module state during updates and removes obsolete v2 files from the new module directory.
- Added explicit skip_mount support because the module no longer ships a system overlay.
- Updated package metadata to version=v2.3 and versionCode=25092026.

Removed
- Forced LTE, 5G, carrier aggregation, MIMO, 256-QAM, IMS, VoLTE, VoNR, ViLTE, and Wi-Fi properties.
- Vendor Wi-Fi, supplicant, dhcpcd, and resolver file modifications.
- CPU IRQ affinity, RPS/XPS, scheduler, and Ethernet interrupt-coalescing changes.
- iptables and ip6tables rules, including destructive flushing of the host OUTPUT mangle chain.
- Root qdisc replacement across network interfaces.
- Unsupported claims that properties could enable radio capabilities beyond the device hardware.

Compatibility
- Magisk module installer format retained.
- KernelSU and APatch module execution supported without requiring a system-overlay metamodule.
- MediaTek installation guard retained.

v2.2
- Initial MediaTek-focused networking module with modem properties, vendor configuration patching, TCP tuning, qdisc changes, DSCP rules, CPU affinity tuning, and profile switching.

Upgrade note

Flash mtk-bwmod-v2.3.zip and reboot. Older runtime sysctl changes reset on reboot. If v2.2 left a /data/vendor/wifi/*.bwmod_bak file or modified a writable wpa_supplicant.conf, inspect those files before removing their backups. v2.3 does not rewrite vendor files.

modules.readme:
OPlus 桌面 Google 搜索栏 (OPlus Google Search Box)

专为 一加 (OnePlus)、OPPO、真我 (Realme) ColorOS / OxygenOS 系统桌面打造的现代 Xposed 模块。

在国内版系统桌面中原生解锁并启用底栏 Google 搜索栏 (QSB)，完美补全返回与手势上划回到主屏的过渡动画，彻底消除切换开关时的布局重置与弹窗打扰，享受完全贴合原生的丝滑体验。

✨ 核心特性
- 🔍 原生底栏 Google 搜索栏
  在不更改系统区域、不更换第三方桌面的前提下，直接激活 ColorOS 桌面底部的官方 Google 搜索栏。负一屏（智能助手/Breeno/Google Discover）完全不受影响。
- 🎬 补全系统级过渡动画
  解决普通模块缺失动画的遗憾：
- 点击底栏搜索框进入 Google 后，按返回键平滑回缩至底栏搜索框。
- 全屏手势上划回到桌面 (Swipe-to-Home) 享受原生级图标缩放与位移动画。
- 桌面普通 Google 搜索小组件同样享受完整回缩动画。
- ⚡ 无感秒切，零重载、零弹窗
- 拦截了系统切换底栏开关时强制重排网格与重载桌面的逻辑（不重置 5×6 / 5×7 布局）。
- 彻底去除开启与关闭时的“重置主屏幕布局”警告弹窗，开关即时响应，桌面图标与小部件原封不动，零闪烁、零位移。
- 🎨 保留官方底栏定制入口
  长按底栏搜索框依然保留官方原生的“调整搜索栏样式”入口，可无缝跳转微件外观自定义设置。
- 📐 智能自适应桌面微件菜单
  修复了官方将桌面 Google 搜索组件菜单锁死在上方、导致微件置于屏幕顶层时长按菜单被挤出屏幕边缘无法点击的缺陷，自适应在下方/上方展开。
- 🛡️ 安全现代的 LibXposed API 102 架构
  采用现代 LibXposed 规范编写，安全挂载，绝不提前触发系统类加载，杜绝卡开机或桌面崩溃风险。

📱 兼容性与运行环境
- 系统要求：ColorOS 14+ / OxygenOS 14+ / realme UI 5.0+（Android 14+）
- 框架要求：支持 LibXposed (API 102) 的框架（如 LSPosed 现代环境）
- 依赖应用：已安装并启用 Google App（搜索）

🚀 使用方法

1. 在 GitHub Releases 下载最新的 OPlus桌面Google搜索栏-v2.3.apk。
2. 安装 APK，并在 LSPosed / Xposed 管理器中启用本模块。
3. 作用域勾选 系统桌面（com.android.launcher）。
4. 强行停止桌面进程或重启手机使模块生效。
5. 进入手机 设置 -> 桌面与锁屏 -> 搜索栏 / 任务栏搜索框，直接开启开关即可体验！

🛠️ 技术原理 (Technical Highlights)

1. 安全特性激活：通过在 FeatureOption.initFeature(Context) 中动态注入国际版特性，避开 Java 类加载器静态代码块执行时序问题。
2. 动画链还原：
- 挂载 Launcher.getFirstMatchForAppClose 修正返回键动画目标 View。
- 挂载 QuickstepTransitionManager.findLauncherView 修正应用开启过渡视图。
- 挂载 LauncherSwipeHandlerV2.findWorkspaceView 补全手势上划手势缩略动画。
3. 布局与弹窗抑制：
- 拦截 BottomSearchCompat.applyLayoutCompat 与 needChangeLayoutRow 消除桌面重新绑定。
- 拦截 LauncherQsbSettingsFragment.needShowLayoutCompatDialog 与 BottomSearchCompat.needShowAlert 实现纯净静默切换。

⚠️ 免责声明
- 本模块仅供 Android 及逆向技术学习交流使用。
- 请在合规且了解 Xposed 机制的前提下使用。

📄 License

本项目基于 Apache License 2.0 开源。
modules.changelog:
欢迎使用 OPlus 桌面 Google 搜索栏 v3.4！🚀

专为 ColorOS 17（Android 17 / API 37）打造，基于现代 LibXposed (API 102)​ 标准构建。

ColorOS 17 的桌面做了大量重构，底栏搜索相关的一整批类被 R8 混淆改名、模块依赖的旧类名大面积失效。v3.4 是完整的 17 适配版：不再依赖任何写死的混淆类名，并把旧版"全局伪装海外版"的做法换成定点补偿，负一屏速览与问小布的原生手势动画全部保留。
- * *

🌟 v3.4 核心更新亮点

1. 🎯 负一屏速览 / 问小布手势动画：彻底恢复
- 定位到真正的根因：旧版把 FeatureOption.isExp 全局改成 true（伪装海外版）来启用底栏 Google 搜索栏。而桌面初始化负一屏客户端时会读这个标志位：
  if (isExp) setSShelfAssistantEnable(ASSISTANT_SCREEN_TYPE_LEFT_ENABLE == 1)
  国内机型该 Secure 项默认值为 0，速览被直接判定为关闭，手势动画随之消失；问小布入口也受同类标志位影响。
- 改为「定点补偿」：isExp 保持国内原生不变，只在真正需要海外行为的少数几个点上临时置位、执行完立刻还原。

2. 🧩 ColorOS 17 全量适配：不再写死混淆类名
- 17 的桌面把底栏管理器的类名改了（16 的 bottomsearch.h 在 17 已变成日志接口），旧版反射会静默失效、且不报任何错。
- 新版改为按结构特征动态发现：在底栏包内寻找"具有静态自类型字段 + 无参方法返回容器 View"的类，候选优先、兜底扫描，桌面再更新也不会直接失效。
- 其余关键类名（LauncherClient、CustomLauncherAppWidgetHostView、LauncherSettingsFragment、OplusBaseSystemShortcut$Customize*、BottomSearchCompat 等）全部按 17.3.12 的真实名字重新对齐。

modules.changelog:
[1.5.1] - 2026-11-18

Fixed
- Diagnostics token sync resilience: Added bounded token-only convergence retry while module settings are ready and reporter-side token lookup retries to reduce Diagnostics IPC token unavailable / report not dispatched failures caused by unsynchronized remote tokens.
- Truthful fallback diagnostics on provider-invisible paths: Token-authenticated fallback telemetry is now recorded and presented as diagnosable when the diagnostics provider is unavailable (for example SDK < 34 cases), without claiming OS-verified sender identity/PID or current-run proof. Milestone and VERIFY-card text now disclaims token-authenticated fallback once, consistently across English and all translated UIs (no double prefix, no OS-verified-origin wording for token runs).
- Epoch-unknown VERIFY handling: VERIFY payloads without a boot epoch are accepted when the epoch is unavailable instead of failing schema validation, without fabricating or binding boot epochs, while keeping currentness labeling truthful; epoch-unknown run-bound events are accepted likewise when the boot epoch is unreadable but the numeric boot counter is readable (blank payload and stored epochs, exact run identity, and no contradicting counter); when the OS boot clock is unusable altogether, such events fail closed (rejected).
- Boot identity fail-closed: the kernel boot-time (/proc/stat btime) fallback now rejects a zero btime, so a dead-RTC device cannot present prior-boot runs as current-boot evidence; affected devices report unknown currentness instead of matching across reboots.
- Boot-boundary epoch binding: an exact replay of an epoch-unknown run now binds the blank stored epoch one way once the OS boot identity becomes readable, instead of wiping prior VERIFY/sequence state; an epoch-null start replay is idempotent for the same run identity.
- Diagnostics regression coverage: Expanded unit coverage for token convergence/retry, fallback provenance and labeling, and epoch-unknown schema/run-matching behavior.
