modules.name: Github-direct — Android Root / LSPosed 选择性网络连通性模块
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Github-direct — Android Root / LSPosed 选择性网络连通性模块
modules.readme:
Github-direct

English | 简体中文

This is the LSPosed distribution repository for Github-direct. The complete source code, technical documentation, and issue tracker live at FxxkLocation/Github-direct.

Github-direct is a selective network-connectivity module for Android Root and LSPosed environments. It combines pollution-resistant DNS, verified endpoint candidates, transparent TCP/TLS relaying, and fail-open protection, and operates only on applications explicitly selected by the user.

GitHub is the stable baseline with completed end-to-end device validation. Google, YouTube, Discord, and OpenAI / ChatGPT profiles remain experimental, are disabled by default, and require separate validation on each device and network.

Highlights
- LibXposed API 102 with minimum compatibility at API 101.
- LSPosed hooks and the Root data plane require separate authorization; an empty scope never expands to the whole device.
- The transparent Root backend dynamically probes su, iptables, owner matching, REDIRECT, and optional IPv6 capabilities.
- Endpoint candidates must pass TCP, public certificate-chain, real-hostname, and endpoint-semantic verification.
- Capability, listener, rule-installation, or health-check failures automatically remove this module's rules and restore the native path.
- Supports arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64, and 16 KiB ELF LOAD alignment.

Requirements
- Android 8.0+ (API 26)
- LSPosed or another framework compatible with modern API 101+
- Magisk / KernelSU with working su and iptables for Root transparent mode
- Complete ip6tables and listener capability checks for IPv6 interception

Installation

1. Download the APK from this repository's Releases.
2. Enable the module in LSPosed and select only the target applications that need it.
3. Open Github-direct, grant Root access, and select the same applications in the in-app Root scope.
4. Start the service and confirm that the status page shows an active rule generation and no failure stage.

The normal path does not require a CA. Browser TLS termination is limited to hosts explicitly authorized a second time and requires a per-device CA, strict upstream certificate and hostname validation, and controlled suffix boundaries. Certificate-pinned native clients are not guaranteed to work.

Current release

1.1.1 (versionCode 3) fixes a compatibility issue where some legacy/nft iptables -S implementations reorder rule arguments and caused the Root backend to report installed rules as missing. Startup verification and runtime health checks now compare the chain, UID, destination, protocol, port, and jump target semantically, without model- or vendor-specific branches.

Downloads and source
- LSPosed release: 3-1.1.1
- Main-project release: 1.1.1
- Source: FxxkLocation/Github-direct
- Issues: GitHub Issues

APK SHA-256: d4b372925751fbed2c128a2c14991bcf276750a5b26344621bbf63e5cdc8c330

modules.name: Google Play Store System Base
modules.author: D3SOX (AI-Assisted)
modules.description: Systemlessly installs a user-supplied official Google Play Store APK as the privileged system app, replacing microG's FakeStore where the ROM ships it, and applies the tested device-idle compatibility fix.
modules.readme:
microG Play Store workarounds

A tested setup for passing Play Integrity on Android 13+ with microG as the Play Services implementation. It works on ROMs that ship microG, such as LineageOS for microG, and on ROMs where you install microG yourself, such as official LineageOS. The reference device passes MEETS_STRONG_INTEGRITY. This repository has the guide and four root modules for the Play Store side of the setup.

Play Integrity verdicts come from Google's servers. Google changes attestation rules and revokes keys over time, so this setup can stop working, and it may behave differently on another ROM or device.

Modules

| Module | What it does | Needed? |
|---|---|---|
| playstore-base | Makes the real Google Play Store the privileged system app, in place of microG's FakeStore if the ROM has it. Optionally makes a user-installed microG GmsCore a privileged app too. | Yes |
| playstore-xray-privacy-filter | Blocks the Play Store's downloads and most of its traffic, but keeps Play Integrity working. | Optional |
| play-provenance-repair | Fixes owned apps that still say they were not installed from Google Play. | Optional |
| omk-keybox-updater | Installs the newest valid public keybox into OhMyKeymint when you tap its Action button. | Optional |

Each release has the privacy filter, provenance repair, and keybox updater as ready-to-flash ZIPs. playstore-base ships as source, because you build it with your own Play Store APK. Google's APK is proprietary, so this repository does not include it.

These modules handle the Play Store. The device verdicts come from the root, Zygisk, and attestation modules in steps 2 and 3.

Supported setups

The guide works with two ways of getting microG onto a ROM. The setup steps say where they differ.

| | ROM ships microG | You install microG yourself |
|---|---|---|
| Example | LineageOS for microG | Official LineageOS |
| microG GmsCore | Privileged system app from the ROM | Normal app. playstore-base adds a privileged system copy. |
| com.android.vending before setup | FakeStore, a system app from the ROM | microG Companion as a normal app, or nothing |
| What playstore-base does | Replaces FakeStore with the Play Store | You uninstall Companion, and the module adds the Play Store as a new system app |
| Signature spoofing | Built into the ROM | Built into official LineageOS, for microG-signed GmsCore only |
| Signing-key workaround such as CorePatch | May be needed, because FakeStore and the Play Store have different keys | Not needed, because no app is replaced by one with a different key |

GmsCore has to be a privileged app because Play Integrity runs in microG's DroidGuard process, which belongs to GmsCore. As a normal app, DroidGuard runs in a restricted SELinux domain, and the reference device got only MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY. See microG as a privileged app.

Tested setups

Both setups ran on the same Pixel 8 Pro with these components:

APatch, with Hybrid Mount as the metamodule
ReZygisk and Zygisk Assistant
Play Integrity Fork v19 with a current Pixel 8 Pro profile
OhMyKeymint 1.2.6
Public Yurikey68 keybox
Google Play Store 54.1.11-34
microG 0.3.18

Other root managers, Zygisk implementations, and keystore modules may work. Use current releases and follow their upstream documentation rather than copying this list.

Official LineageOS

Tested on 2026-11-16 with Android 17 (SDK 37), official LineageOS 24, and microG installed as normal apps. playstore-base 1.4 was built with the Play Store and GmsCore APKs. CorePatch was still installed in Vector, but nothing in this setup needs it.

Play Integrity API Checker returned MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY, MEETS_DEVICE_INTEGRITY, and MEETS_STRONG_INTEGRITY with the privacy filter enabled. Before GmsCore was a privileged app, it returned only MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY. The app and licensing verdicts were not recorded.

LineageOS for microG

Tested on 2026-11-12 with Android 16 (SDK 36) and LineageOS for microG 23.2. playstore-base 1.3 replaced FakeStore, with CorePatch in Vector for the signing-key change. The checker returned these verdicts with the privacy filter enabled:

deviceRecognitionVerdict  MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY, MEETS_DEVICE_INTEGRITY, MEETS_STRONG_INTEGRITY
appRecognitionVerdict     PLAY_RECOGNIZED
appLicensingVerdict       LICENSED
playProtectVerdict        NO_ISSUES

Full response

{
  "appIntegrity": {
    "appRecognitionVerdict": "PLAY_RECOGNIZED",
    "packageName": "gr.nikolasspyr.integritycheck",
    "versionCode": "22"
  },
  "deviceIntegrity": {
    "deviceRecognitionVerdict": [
      "MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY",
      "MEETS_DEVICE_INTEGRITY",
      "MEETS_STRONG_INTEGRITY"
    ],
    "recentDeviceActivity": {
      "deviceActivityLevel": "LEVEL_1"
    },
    "deviceAttributes": {
      "sdkVersion": 36
    }
  },
  "accountDetails": {
    "appLicensingVerdict": "LICENSED"
  },
  "environmentDetails": {
    "playProtectVerdict": "NO_ISSUES"
  }
}

Setup

Do the steps in order. Get each one working before you start the next, so you only debug one thing at a time.

Commands that start with adb run on your computer and need Android SDK Platform-Tools. They work as written in PowerShell, Command Prompt, and Linux or macOS shells. On Windows, run them from the platform-tools folder (type .\adb in PowerShell) or add that folder to your PATH. Commands that start with su -c run on the phone, in a terminal app or after adb shell.

Set up with a coding agent

A coding agent with shell access, such as Claude Code or Codex, can do most of these steps over ADB. Enable USB debugging, grant root to the ADB shell in your root manager, connect the phone, and paste this prompt into the agent:

Clone https://github.com/D3SOX/microg-play-store-workarounds and follow AGENT_SETUP.md to help me pass Play Integrity on my phone.

AGENT_SETUP.md tells the agent to survey the phone first and to ask before each change. Read each command before you approve it.

modules.changelog:
Assets
- playstore_base_module_source.zip: source-only builder for the Play Store base module (1.3 → 1.4). It does not include a Google APK.
- playstore_xray_privacy_filter-v1.5-arm64.zip: optional ARM64 network filter for the Play Store, unchanged.
- play_provenance_repair-v1.1.8.zip: WebUI and CLI provenance repair tool, unchanged.
- omk_keybox_updater-v1.0.zip: Action-button keybox updater for OhMyKeymint, unchanged.

Official LineageOS support

The guide now works on ROMs where you install microG yourself, such as official LineageOS, as well as on ROMs that ship microG, such as LineageOS for microG. The README starts with a table of both setups and gives per-setup steps.

On official LineageOS, the reference Pixel 8 Pro with Android 17 passes MEETS_STRONG_INTEGRITY with the privacy filter enabled. Two things differ from LineageOS for microG:
- Build playstore-base with your installed GmsCore APK as a second argument. The module then makes GmsCore a privileged app. As a normal app, microG's DroidGuard runs in the untrusted_app SELinux domain, and the device got only MEETS_BASIC_INTEGRITY.
- Uninstall microG Companion before you flash the module. Android then clears the installer of every app that named Companion as its installer, and those apps can no longer see the Play Store. Save the list first, and repair them afterwards with play-provenance-repair.

No signature-compatibility workaround such as CorePatch is needed on official LineageOS, because no app is replaced by one with a different signing key.

Keybox and profile dates

Yurikey68, used for both tests, expires on 2026-11-25. The tested Play Integrity Fork profile has an estimated expiry of 2026-12-16. The README shows how to check both and how to replace the keybox.

Changelog

Play Store base (1.4)
- Detect at install time whether the ROM ships FakeStore. Without FakeStore, install the Play Store at /product/priv-app/Phonesky as a new system app, and skip the bind mounts and the package-cache clearing at boot.
- Accept an optional GmsCore APK in build-module.sh and add it as a privileged app at /product/priv-app/PrebuiltGmsCore, with an allowlist for the three privileged permissions LineageOS does not grant to microG 0.3.18. Skip it when the ROM already has a GmsCore folder.
- Keep the FakeStore behavior on LineageOS for microG unchanged.

Documentation
- Add a supported-setups table, results for both tested setups, and per-setup steps for installing microG, building the module, removing Companion, and flashing.
- Document how to install GsfProxy on recent Android, how updates and rebuilds work, and what uninstalling the module does on each kind of ROM.
- Add troubleshooting for "Play Store not found" in Play Integrity API Checker, and record the 50-app installer repair as a tested case of play-provenance-repair.
- Teach AGENT_SETUP.md to tell the two setups apart and to save the installer list before it removes Companion....

modules.name: LHDC A2DP Enabler (Android 17 universal)
modules.author: Makuro-Arisaka
modules.description: 自动定位 audio_policy_configuration.xml，把 A2DP 输出端口迁进 bluetooth module 并声明 AUDIO_FORMAT_LHDC，让 Android 17 的原生 LHDC 真正出声。面向「LHDC 协商成功但完全无声」的 AOSP 蓝牙栈 + 高通音频 HAL 混合架构设备。
modules.readme:
LHDC A2DP Enabler

适用于 Android 17 的 Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 模块，用于修复
耳机已协商 LHDC，但 A2DP 音频完全无声的问题。

本模块由 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(编写代码) 与 Kimi-K3.1-Pro(编写文档) 制作。
English documentation

适用范围

本模块面向使用 AOSP 蓝牙栈 + 高通 PAL 音频 HAL 的混合架构设备：
- AOSP 蓝牙协议栈不会建立高通 QTI HIDL session；
- 高通 offload 通路因此得不到编码器配置，可能反复输出
  invalid encoder config / write error -22；
- 模块把 A2DP 转到 AOSP 软件编码通路，使系统自带 LHDC 编码器能够被使用。

模块只调整音频策略路由，不提供 LHDC 编码器，也不解决耳机固件、厂商编码器
授权或其他 A2DP/LE Audio 故障。

安装时检查的必要条件

| 条件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| Android SDK ≥ 37 | Android 17 及以上 |
| 有 awk | 用于生成补丁策略 |
| 有 audio.bluetooth.default.so | 提供 AOSP 蓝牙音频 HAL |
| 有可处理的音频策略文件 | 安装时会实际试运行补丁器，检查 A2DP 端口和输出路由 |

不满足时安装会中止，并在 root 管理器的安装控制台说明具体原因。

/apex/com.android.bt、busybox 和 offload 属性会作为辅助信息报告；其中缺少
busybox 会降低挂载隔离的可靠性，但不会单独阻止安装。

联发科平台、纯厂商蓝牙音频实现、没有系统 LHDC 编码器的设备，通常不属于本模块
的适用场景；不能仅凭 SoC 品牌判断，应看 HAL 和实际音频策略。

安装与卸载

安装

1. 从 Releases
   下载 zip，或按下方说明自行构建。
2. 在 Magisk / KernelSU / APatch 中安装，查看安装控制台的检查结果。
3. 重启设备，让 post-fs-data.sh 在 audioserver 启动前应用策略。

安装检查是只读的；检查通过后才会修正脚本权限并清除旧版运行数据。
FORCE=1 可跳过适用范围检查，但绕过检查并不代表设备能够使用 LHDC。

卸载

在 root 管理器中删除模块即可。卸载脚本会：

1. 摘除本模块创建的音频策略挂载；
2. 检查分区中的原始文件；
3. 清理模块运行数据和备份。

原厂备份位于模块目录的 state/golden/；正常运行时还会导出至
/sdcard/lhdc-a2dp-backup/。分区原文件正常情况下无需恢复，因为模块从未改写它。

验证与诊断

重启后不要只看模块状态，需核对 audioserver 的实际运行策略。

1. A2DP 输出及采样率

su -c 'dumpsys media.audio_policy' | grep -A5 '"a2dp output";'

应看到 a2dp output，并包含明确的采样率，例如：

sampling rates: 44100, 48000, 88200, 96000

如果出现 [dynamic rates]，说明列表分隔符或 XML profile 解析不正确，A2DP
输出可能打不开。

2. 蓝牙编码与播放状态

dumpsys bluetooth_manager | grep -i 'Current Codec'
logcat -b all -d | grep -i lhdc
logcat -b all -d | grep -E 'invalid encoder config|write error -22|PAL: Bluetooth: startPlayback'

耳机应协商到 LHDC；最后一组错误若在播放时持续出现，说明仍在使用故障的
高通 offload 通路。

3. 只读诊断

su -c 'sh /data/adb/modules/android17-lhdc-a2dp-universal/post-fs-data.sh --dry-run'

诊断会列出 SDK、HAL、策略文件、选中目标、挂载传播模式及近期日志。
日志保存在模块目录的 state/run.log；开机早期的时间戳可能尚未同步。

配置

编辑模块目录下的 lhdc.conf，默认下次重启生效。

| 配置 | 默认值 | 用途 |
|---|---:|---|
| SKU | 空 | 手动指定 sku_* 名称；留空则自动定位 |
| PATCH_ALL | 1 | 活跃 SKU 无法确定时处理所有候选 |
| OFFLOAD_FIX | 1 | 将 persist.bluetooth.a2dp_offload.disabled=true 改回 false |
| FORCE | 0 | 跳过安装期及启动期的适用范围检查 |
| MIN_SDK | 37 | 最低 Android SDK |
| VERBOSE | 0 | 输出额外调试信息 |
| LHDC_DUMPSYS_TIMEOUT | 20 | dumpsys 单次调用超时（秒），不要设为 0 |

目标策略的定位顺序为：上次记录的活跃路径 → 手动 SKU → 权威 SKU 属性 →
平台/设备线索 → 唯一候选 → 全部候选（PATCH_ALL=1）。

实现概要

模块不改写 /vendor 或其他分区，而是在模块 state/ 中保存文件并进行 bind mount：

原厂 XML → state/golden/       原厂备份
        ├→ state/work/         原厂兜底挂载层
        └→ state/patched/      补丁挂载层
- customize.sh：安装前检查、权限修正、旧运行数据清理。
- post-fs-data.sh：定位策略、备份、生成补丁并挂载。
- service.sh：复查文件和 audioserver 状态，记录活跃策略，导出备份。
- uninstall.sh：摘除挂载、检查原文件并清理运行数据。
- lib/patch_policy.awk：迁移 A2DP 端口，补全 LHDC、a2dp output 和路由。

补丁器按 XML 根元素的 version 生成列表：1.0 使用逗号，7.0/7.1 使用空格；
encodedFormats 始终使用空格。挂载层会使用 busybox 尽可能设置为 private，
降低 shared mount 传播导致补丁层丢失的风险。

开发与构建

统一使用 build.sh 打包，它会检查必需文件、LF 行尾、shell/awk 语法、zip
结构和文件权限，并生成 SHA-256 校验文件：

./build.sh
./build.sh --reproducible       # 同一提交可复现构建
./build.sh -o /tmp/module.zip   # 指定输出
./build.sh --allow-dirty        # 工作区有改动时继续打包

安装检查可在开发机上用模拟设备环境进行回归测试：

bash tests/run-install-check.sh

tests/、构建脚本和 CI 文件不会进入模块包。发布新版本时递增
module.prop 中的 version / versionCode，提交后推送 v*
标签，由 GitHub Actions 构建 Release。

许可证

GNU General Public License v3.0

modules.name: LKM SUSFS管理器
modules.author: 1stDawn; LKM by inforcqb (GPL-2.0); ksu_susfs by sidex15 & simonpunk (AGPL-3.0)
modules.description: 自动匹配 8 种 KMI；含 WebUI、规则管理、Probe PID Guard 与内核版本匿名统计
modules.readme:
LKM SUSFS管理器

  English · 中文
  KernelSU 系列 · Magisk · APatch（实验性）
  SUSFS LKM 自动匹配 / 加载 / 规则管理

一个多管理器的 SUSFS LKM 管理器：自动匹配 KMI → 加载 SUSFS LKM → 下发规则 → 状态写回模块描述，附带中文/英文 MIUIX WebUI。

1.2.7 起除上游 SUSFS LKM 外，还自带一个自研内核模块 Probe PID Guard（generic_pid_guard，GPL-2.0，源码在 source/generic_pid_guard/），按 UID/comm 伪装 getppid。

不再只适用于 KernelSU 系：
- KernelSU 系列：官方 KernelSU / SukiSU / ReSukiSU / BakaSU / KernelSU Next
- Magisk：按 late_start 阶段应用规则
- APatch / KernelPatch：实验性支持，默认拒绝外挂 LKM，需显式放行
实验性项目。 KSU 系已做真机冷/热启动验证；Magisk 仅代码适配；APatch 仅 QEMU 验证，真机未验收。刷机与 root 有风险，请自行评估恢复手段。

支持矩阵

| 管理器 | 适配 | 验证状态 | 开机阶段 |
|---|---|---|---|
| KernelSU 官方 / SukiSU / ReSukiSU / BakaSU / KernelSU Next | 完整 | SukiSU 实机冷/热启动验证；其余代码兼容，未逐一实机 | post-fs-data → boot-completed |
| Magisk | 完整 | 代码适配，未做真机冷启动 | post-fs-data → service |
| APatch / KernelPatch | 实验性 | 仅 QEMU GKI；真机未验收 | post-fs-data → boot-completed，默认拒绝 LKM |

快速开始

1. 从 Releases 下载 susfs_allinone-.zip；
2. 按管理器安装：
- KernelSU 系列安装
- Magisk 安装
- APatch 安装（实验性）
3. 重启，或执行模块 Action 手动加载；
4. 打开 WebUI 查看状态与规则。

功能亮点
- 8 个 KMI 自动匹配（android12-5.10 ～ android17-6.18）；无 Android tag 的 5.15 支持按 SDK 自动消歧。
- 多管理器开机阶段：KSU 系 / APatch 走 boot-completed，Magisk 走 service；boot-completed 会检查 LKM 状态，未加载时补一次（不显式判断 late-load）。
- APatch 检测与安全策略：识别 /data/adb/ap / apd，默认不自动外挂 LKM，需显式放行。
- KernelPatch 运行时探测：读 dmesg banner；不可读显示 unknown，不误报。
- 启动守卫 / pstore 崩溃暂停 / 半加载保护：避免错误 LKM 导致反复 bootloop。
- 规则与隐藏：sus_path、sus_mount、try_umount、hide_modules、AVC 伪装、扩展隐藏项。
- WebUI：状态 / 配置 / PID 隐藏 / 日志 / 关于；APatch 环境额外显示 APatch 卡片。
- 两套主题（1.2.8+）：冷蓝圆角（默认）/ 暖灰极简，在关于页切换，选择存本地。
- 前端技术栈（1.2.8+）：Vite + Vue 3 + TypeScript 构建，Vitest 单测；产物打成 IIFE 经典脚本（不用 ESM），兼容 ksu:// 加载方式；多语言改为 JSON 词典 + template.json，社区可直接提交翻译。
- Probe PID Guard（Beta，可选）：自研 generic_pid_guard LKM，kretprobe __arm64_sys_getppid，按 UID 范围 / comm 前缀伪装 getppid；随包 6 套 KMI（5.10/5.15/6.1/6.6/6.12/6.18），默认关闭、需要时在「PID 隐藏」页开启；装载后自动写入 /proc/susfs_hide_modules，与 kernelsu 同级隐藏。
- 「PID 隐藏」一级页：六张状态卡（已启用 / 内核模块 / 内核可见 / 隐藏列表 / 最近结果 / 命中进程）+ 独立保存；改参数即时 rmmod+insmod，关闭立即卸载。

APatch（实验性）

APatch/KernelPatch 下默认不自动加载 SUSFS LKM；需要外挂时，先确认内核没有内置 SUSFS，再执行 ctl.sh allow_lkm 或 WebUI 放行。QEMU 已验证模块路径 14/14，但真机安装、ABI、WebUI 卡片均未验收。

详见 APatch 实验性支持。

自研内核模块（1.2.7+）

模块现在包含两个内核侧组件，来源不同，请分开看待：

| 组件 | 来源 | 许可证 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| lib/susfs_guard_lkm-*.ko、bin/susfs_insmod | 上游 inforcqb/susfs4ksu-lkm | GPL-2.0 | 未修改，sha256 与上游 Release 一致 |
| lib/pid_guard//generic_pid_guard.ko | 本项目自研 | GPL-2.0 | 源码随仓库分发：source/generic_pid_guard/ |

Probe PID Guard 是本项目自行编写并编译的：kretprobe __arm64_sys_getppid，命中目标后改写返回值；
参数在 insmod 时传入（target_uids / target_comms / exclude_comms），
sysfs 侧权限为 0440，只有 root 可读。它是可选组件，1.2.8 起默认关闭；开启后开机自动加载，关闭即卸载。

source/generic_pid_guard/
├── generic_pid_guard.c     # 唯一源文件
├── generic_pid_guard.lds
├── Makefile
├── build_one.sh            # 在 DDK 容器里编单个 KMI
├── build_inside.sh
└── README.md               # KMI 表、编译命令、产物 sha256

构建前端

WebUI 源码在 webui/，构建产物落在 module/webroot/（已随仓库提交，用户不需要 node）：

sh tools/build_webui.sh          # npm ci（首次）+ 类型检查 + vite build + 写源码指纹

module/webroot/.build.json 记录源码指纹；tools/check_zip.py 会复算比对，
改了 webui/src 却忘记重建时门禁直接失败。

安全
- 不要重复加载 LKM，不要执行 rmmod susfs_guard_lkm；
- 不要同时启用两个会加载 SUSFS 的模块；
- APatch 放行可能导致 bootloop，只在测试设备尝试；
- 出问题先禁用模块并保留 load.log / apply.log。

完整安全与免责条款见 安全与免责。

文档

| 文档 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 安装与卸载 | KSU / Magisk / APatch 安装、升级、回滚 |
| APatch 实验性支持 | 已验证/未验证范围、放行步骤、风险 |
| KMI 匹配 | KMI 表、dirty 内核、强制指定、排错 |
| 配置与 WebUI | config.ini、规则文件、WebUI 页面 |
| 常见问题 | 加载失败、APatch 卡片、Magisk、Zygisk |
| 验证记录与限制 | 真机/QEMU/离线记录、已知限制 |
| 安全与免责 | 安全规则、禁止操作、免责声明 |
| 上游关系与许可 | 第三方组件、版本、许可证、致谢 |
| 反馈与支持 | 反馈渠道、最小信息、日志要求 |

验证与限制（摘要）
- KSU 系：1.2.4 冷启动加载 r18.9（3,101,664 B / 116 symbols），规则/完整性正常；热重启后 LSPosed 保持 connected。
- QEMU GKI：SUSFS LKM 加载/隐藏/恢复；模块级 APatch 路径 14/14。
- 离线：35/35 测试通过。
- 未验证：Magisk 真机冷启动、APatch 真机全链路、其余 7 个 KMI。
- PID Guard：真机仅 6.6.77 验证装载 / 隐藏 / 参数即时重载 / 关闭卸载；其余 5 套 KMI 只编译未运行。
- sus_path 目录重建：1.2.7 起普通规则也按 inode 比对，下次 apply 会撤销旧规则并按新 inode 重加；即时恢复仍需内核事件钩子（原型未合并）。
- 默认隐藏 /data/adb：NeoZygisk 用户必须删除该行；模块/SUSFS 不支持从已隐藏父目录中排除子目录（外部反馈的 zygote 循环风险）。

详见 验证记录与限制。

反馈
- Bug：提交问题
- 功能建议：Feature request
- 使用经验：Discussions
- 安全漏洞：见 SECURITY.md，请勿公开开 issue
- 上游 .ko / ksu_susfs 问题：优先找上游仓库

提交前请附 load.log、apply.log、ctl.sh status；APatch 反馈另附 KernelPatch 版本与 allow_lkm 状态。

许可证
- 本项目脚本/安装器/WebUI：GPL-2.0（LICENSE）
- 第三方二进制：lib/susfs_guard_lkm-*.ko、bin/susfs_insmod（GPL-2.0）、bin/ksu_susfs_good（AGPL-3.0）
- 自研内核模块：lib/pid_guard//generic_pid_guard.ko（GPL-2.0），源码 source/generic_pid_guard/
- 版权与许可证归原作者所有，详见 上游关系与许可、NOTICE、provenance.json

如果你不完全理解风险，请不要安装。
modules.changelog:
1.2.9

配置保存加了长度校验（能识别 base64 截断）、status 去掉大量进程启动（约 1.6 s → 0.8 s）、预设路径 / 强制指定 KMI / 公告改回二级窗口。

新增
- 保存配置带长度校验：set_bundle 的线格式改为每段 :，解码后比对实际字节数。此前「base64 4 字符边界截断」无法被发现（截断后仍是合法 base64，解出来只是内容前缀，重编码校验也一致）。旧格式仍兼容
- 预设路径补两个：/data/local/tmp/brevent（Brevent 的 root helper）与 AppRetention 的常见落点；界面只列设备上真实存在的路径，已加入的标「已加入」并禁用
- 交流群：关于页新增「交流」板块（群号 1019737433 + 加入群聊）；公告增加内置兜底，拉不到远程公告时也能看到群号与 Issues 入口

更改
- status 提速：探测结果按 boot_id 缓存到 state/.probe_cache（换 boot 或 ksu_susfs 二进制变化才重算），pid_guard 的 7 个状态字段、规则数统计、cfg_get、_cf_state 等改为 shell 内建读取。设备交错 A/B：约 1.6 s → 0.8 s，空载最佳 0.75 s
- apply 锁：持有者进程已死立即接管（原先要等满 TTL），TTL 900 → 180 s；所有判定与建锁移入二级互斥目录，修掉 8 并发下可同时持有 2–3 个的竞态
- 无 Android tag 的内核：不再自动猜 KMI（susfs_insmod 会改写 vermagic 后重试，猜错可能真的装进内核），改为在日志里给出建议值，加载仍需显式指定
- 日志时间戳：开机早期 RTC 未同步时显示「开机+Ns（RTC 未同步）」，不再出现 1970 年

修复
- kernelsu 隐藏 与 pid_guard_hidden 误报「未隐藏」：/proc/susfs_hide_modules 的模块名在 names: ... 那一行以空格分隔，需按词匹配
- [i] pid_guard 已加载 重复：ksud insmod 已输出 Loaded kernel module，脚本不再复述
- cfg_get 读不到带尾随空白 / TAB / CR 的值：会被判成「全空白」并静默回落默认值
- kernelpatch / apatch_userland 恒为空：探测逻辑写错了位置
- 探测缓存半写会让整个 boot 用空值：改为原子写 + ok=1 哨兵，截断即视为未命中当场重算
- 安装期残留 config/.pid_guard.conf.new；tools/build_webui.sh 失败时留下残缺产物

验证
- 离线 40/40、前端 45/45、门禁 5/5、I18N_OK keys=157；两次构建字节一致
- 真机（6.6.77 / android15-6.6 / SukiSU）：integrity=ok、hide_kernelsu=1、截断 payload 被拒且 8 个文件零改动、8 并发抢锁恒 1 个赢家、cfg_get 带尾随空白能读对
- 两轮独立审计：1.2.9 候选结论「有条件可发」，其中 3 个缺陷（含上述 cfg_get 与两个空字段问题）已全部修复并复验

产物：susfs_allinone-1.2.9.zip，13,192,648 B，sha256 b1a3fd4f60ffe934c23e6cb36151538f45c43a3a3197943157e5b3eda0faf618

modules.readme:
Mirage Manager

Introduction

Mirage is a Manager App for hxo framework/tool for auto-injecting shared objects into target processes.

Preview
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/32a9c128-141c-4334-b04f-26a7dba350dd

Supported Versions
- Minimum of android 9 maximum is as long as google dosent disable side loading or pairip is implemented in every app (a work around to make  the apps compaitiable with pairip to a certain extent is being planned for future)

Installation Instructions

Setting up Mirage Client is quick and straightforward. Follow these steps:

1. Download the APK: Head to our Releases page and download the latest Mirrage APK.
2. Allow Unknown Sources: On your Android device, go to Settings > Security (or Apps & Notifications on newer versions) and enable Install from Unknown Sources.
3. Install the APK: Open the downloaded APK file using a file manager, tap to install, and follow the prompts.

If you encounter issues, visit our Discord for support.

Development Setup

For developers looking to contribute or customize Mirage, here’s how to set up your environment:

1. Clone the Repository:

        git clone https://github.com/Kitsuri-Studios/Mirage.git

   This downloads the full source code to your local machine.

2. Open in Android Studio:
- Launch Android Studio and select Open an existing project.
- Choose the M1rage directory and open it.

3. Sync Gradle:
- Click Sync Project with Gradle Files to fetch dependencies.
- Ensure you have the Android SDK (API level 28 or higher) and Gradle installed.

4. Build and Test:
- Connect an Android device or configure an emulator.
- Select Run > Run 'app' to build and deploy Mirage.
- Test changes on a local Minecraft Bedrock server to verify functionality.

Refer to inline comments, For development tips, join our Discord.

Prohibited Uses
- Do not distribute modified versions without sharing the source code, as required by the GPL.
- Do not claim Mirage as your own without crediting the Kitsuri team and its contributors.
- Selling Mirage or derivatives without adhering to the GPL is prohibited.
- Do not distribute Mirage as closed-source or under a non-GPL license.
- The authors are not responsible for bans, damages, or issues arising from Mirage’s use.

Community and Support

Join our community to connect with other Mirage users and developers:
- Discord: Our Discord server is the best place for real-time support, bug reports, and feature discussions.

Credits and Acknowledgments

We are deeply grateful to the open-source community and internal contributors whose tools and libraries make Mirage possible.

UI, Jetpack Compose & Material

| Project                                                                                                                      | Description                                                                | Resources      |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- |
| Tabler Icons (Project Module)                                                                                            | Vector icon pack used throughout Mirage for consistent and clean UI icons. | Project module |

modules.author: k0mraid3
modules.description: NFC Framework for Samsung
modules.readme:
Minimal NFC Framework - Magisk Module - ALPHA v0.0001
A Min-NFC-Framework template Magisk Module for NFC devs and researchers. (VERY Early Development)

This Magisk module is designed for *Samsung* Android devices with NXP NFC controllers (most Galaxy series like S21,22), although it may work on older and non-samsung devices provided a few tweaks. It is basically a fully functional Mininal NFC Framework template but should have cross-compatability between different NXP NFC controllers. It will include a few extra tools and a way to hook NFC and offer broader compatibility down the road. essentially a Min-NFC-Framework with some dev tools.
TODO-

-Create a method to hook NFC.

-Include NFCGate app (Lib is already implemented in https://github.com/k0mraid3/Magisk-Module-NFC-Framework-for-Samsung/commit/b88824caf6079b3a300bd096b8dac99c425c1dd4)  as a system or systemless app. Should be placed in either /product/priv-app/ or /system/priv-app/ (https://github.com/nfcgate/nfcgate)

-Need to make the module check if files exist before trying to copy, no need to overwrite files if they exist unless user wants this. Need some logic for this.

-Source remainder of missing parts. Currently top priority is secure element. I.e Kernel Modules, JAR's, .so Libs, etc.

-Identify any system properties (getprop/setprop) that need to be set and at what boot stage && create needed .prop file for module.

-Further Debugging and log audits

Features:
- This Magisk Module aims to provide a minimal NFC framework as template for future NFC based projects.
- Will attempt to provide support for external NFC attachments.

This module will currently enable the following features on a software level. Further debugging is very much needed. Still missing something..

Compatibility:
- This module is specifically intended for Samsung devices with NXP NFC controllers, but *should* be cross compatabile with any device using a NXP NFC chip. If you come across a different chip I need to add please let me know and I will add its firmware.
- This was devleloped on a Samsung Galaxy Tab S8+ (Android 13) and LG Velvet (Android 11). *Not tested on any other devices yet.*

Installation:
1. Ensure you have Magisk installed on your device.
2. Download the NFC Framework Magisk module ZIP file.
3. *MUST* be Flashed with Fox's Magisk Module Manager, I have 0 idea why but when I try to use Magisk it fails for whatever reason trying to read config.sh, *maybe its the way i formatted it? Worth checking.*
4. Reboot your device.

Important Note:
- This module is still in early development and may have bugs or limited functionality.
- There should be a VERY low risk of any kind of bootloop or serious crashes & I have not experienced any instability with this module enabled at all. *Please report if you do.*
- Please proceed with caution and be aware that using this module is at your own risk.
- !MOUNTING SYSTEM! On the Samsung Galaxy Tab S8+, which due to its F2FS filesystem type, I had to use HuskyDG's "Magical OverlayFS" Magisk Module to fix mounting, however once installed, you will need to go into /data/adb/modules/magisk_overlayfs and locate the "mode.sh" and edit the line "export OVERLAY_LEGACY_MOUNT" from "false" to "true". It should look like this when you are done.
Contributing:
- If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for improvements, feel free to open an issue or contribute to the project.

Disclaimer:
- The developer and contributors are not responsible for any damage or issues caused by using this module.
- Use this module at your own risk.

REFERENCES/DOCUMENTS
- NXP SN220U (Galaxy S22) https://www.commoncriteriaportal.org/files/epfiles/NSCIB-CC-0258298-ST.pdf
- NXP SN100 Series (Galaxy S21) https://www.commoncriteriaportal.org/files/epfiles/ST_SN100_SE_lite_v2_2.pdf

modules.changelog:
新增
- 按住组合中的多击手势：首键保持按住期间，唯一成员键执行双击、三击、四击或单击后长按即可触发，动作写入该档组合自身的配置项。该功能按「先按住首键、再连击成员键」的先后顺序判定，仅对单成员按住组合提供。
- 「单击后长按」的松手时触发：第 2 击按满时长后不立即执行，抬键时执行一次；关闭时仍为到时执行。
- 「执行时提示」四档：不提示、通知、Toast、流体云，公共设置与独立设置共用同一档位。
- 自定义命令以 Shizuku 执行：shell: 命令增加「以 Shizuku 执行」选项，与「以 root 执行」互斥。
- 新增变量「前台应用」：输出值为包名，文案值为应用名。
- 命令输出作为提示文案：提示中的动作名替换为本次执行的标准输出，无输出时回退为命令名。
- 四个内置常用命令：微信扫一扫、微信收付款、支付宝扫一扫、支付宝收付款，自动写入命令库与常用命令清单，支持修改与删除。
- 顶栏「重置」：「更多选项」「按键设置」「独立设置」各提供一项，仅恢复当前页面所属设置。
- 更多外观设置：外观设置四项收纳至折叠栏；「Monet 配色」移至主题菜单底部；强调色与语言菜单增加分隔线。

改进
- 「使用独立设置」不再复制公共设置的值：未修改的配置项取出厂默认值，已修改的配置项使用该档自身值。
- 「无操作时振动」以「振动反馈」为前提：总开关关闭时该功能不再振动，且仅在总开关开启时显示。
- 默认值与滑杆范围调整：四项窗口默认值 150 ms；命令间隔默认值 300 ms、上限 1500 ms；长按延迟与连续触发上限 1000 ms；时长滑杆步长 10 ms，拖动落点取 50 的整数倍。
- 界面细节统一：滑杆行补充行尾箭头，分隔线合并为两支，勾选框统一为自绘样式，「添加命令」更名为「添加常用命令」。

移除
- 内置能力不再依赖 root：结束应用改由系统进程执行，自动亮度改为先写入系统值再关闭自动亮度，多条命令不再统一以 root 执行。
- 部分副标题移除：多击手势、使用独立设置、等待窗口等处仅保留标题；兜底文案整体删除。
- 键名标签样式移除：键名仅显示纯文字，行高按统一档位对齐。

修复
- 自定义命令输入 keyevent: 时即报格式不合法。
- 灵感语音在部分设备上找不到落点。
- 按住组合的多处判定：成员连击无法判定「单击后长按」、开启成员连击时「首键松手后仍触发长按」不生效、组合长按连带执行、按住组合的「长按连续触发」不触发。
- 「无操作时振动」与「每次触发都振动」同时开启时仅首次振动。
- 英文界面下「三击」「四击」「单击后长按」「松手」显示为中文。

下载

- -releaseLog：与正式包一致，仅开启详细日志，用于问题排查。

modules.readme:
Pixel Suite 3.0.2

Your Pixel. Your way.

Made by RovianDev. An open-source LSPosed module for Pixel phones: launcher customization and icon packs, navigation buttons, app and folder locks, gestures, screenshot tools, share menu tools, call recording, ad blocking and more. Every feature has its own switch.

Open Pixel Suite from your home screen: touch and hold an empty area, then choose Pixel Suite settings.

📥 GitHub download · 📥 Xposed download · Full 3.0.0 release notes · Changelog

What's new in 3.0.2

A share menu you can arrange by hand, app drawer folders you can place anywhere, and icon pack fixes.

✨ New
- 📤 Share menu, your way: drag an app into the top row to pin it, then drag your pinned apps into the order you want. The apps below keep your chosen order instead of being rearranged by suggestions. Newly installed apps join the bottom of the list.
- 👆 Hold to pin or hide: hold an app in the share menu to open its Pin / Hide window. If it has several shortcuts, they appear between Pin and Hide; tap the arrow under the app to open them directly. Pinning or hiding keeps the app and its shortcuts together as one app.
- 📁 Place drawer folders anywhere: hold a folder in the app drawer and drag it among your apps. The apps glide aside to make room, and the folder lands with a gentle bounce.
- ⬇️ Move to bottom: a pill appears at the bottom while you drag a drawer folder. Touch it to start scrolling down, then push deeper into the bottom area to scroll faster. Drag toward the top edge to scroll upward in the same way.
- ✌️ Two-finger drag for folders: while holding a folder, swipe with a second finger to scroll the list.
- 🧹 Clear badge: hold an app or folder with a notification dot, then choose Clear badge. Notifications that can be dismissed are cleared. Notifications that cannot be dismissed remain, but stop showing a dot.

💎 Polish
- ✨ Share menu: pinning, unpinning and hiding apps are way smoother, with apps gliding into place and the menu resizing without jumps or flicker.
- 🗂️ Share menu: the Hidden apps panel groups each app with its own shortcuts and icons.
- 🎯 App drawer: dropping an app or folder now lands with a soft bounce, and nearby apps give way slightly.
- 🏠 App drawer: the Add to home screen pill sits slightly higher, to prevent accidentally adding apps or folders to the home screen.
- 🎨 Icon packs: the pack list and the per-app icon picker have more spacing, so selections no longer touch.

🐞 Bug fixes
- App drawer: folders now show a notification dot when an app inside has notifications.
- Icon packs: see-through icon packs now stay see-through, with no white or black disc behind them, and icons are no longer cut off at the edges.
- App drawer: on some Pixel Launcher versions, folder backgrounds no longer flash when you open or close them.
- Screen recording: the Start and close panel no longer flashes or flickers with Frosted Glass.
- Hide Developer Options: USB debugging is now hidden more thoroughly, even from apps that aren't ticked in LSPosed.

🛠️ Google & Pixel bugs fixed
- Pixel Launcher: some app icons had clipped corners and rough edges. They're clean now.

What's new in 3.0.0

3.0.2 lets you arrange the share menu, place app drawer folders anywhere and clear notification dots, and fixes icon packs. See the 3.0.2 release notes.

The biggest Pixel Suite release yet:
- 📤 Share menu tools: reorder pinned apps and contacts, hide apps and contacts into folders.
- 🖼️ Pixel Studio, reimagined: pinch to zoom, an all-new text tool on the picture, the whole picture kept after a crop, a floating colour menu.
- 🎨 Icon packs for Pixel Launcher, cut into your icon shape.
- 📞 Call recording in the Google Phone app, in any country, without the announcement.
- 🚫 Ad blocking system-wide, in Chrome and Google News, plus an ad-free Google feed.
- 🔕 Do Not Annoy: silence incoming calls while staying connected.
- 🛡️ OTA & Store blocker: keep your system and chosen apps on their current versions.
- ⌚ Pixel Watch eSIM setup with a QR code, in any country.
- 🧭 Navigation buttons beside the gesture bar, with Circle to Search or Gemini on a long press of Home.
- 🍞 Toasts: show every toast at the top, in the middle or at the bottom.
- 💠 A fresh look: a redesigned app with search across every setting, and glass rims on Frosted Glass panels.
- 📱 More Pixel Launchers supported, and fixes for bugs in Google's own apps.

See the full release notes for every change.

📤 Share menu (Share menu > Share sheet tools)
- Reorder pinned apps by dragging; extra pinned rows when one is full. Pinned apps aren't listed twice.
- Hide apps into a Hidden apps folder, one by one or several at once with Edit. Tap a hidden app to share to it; long-press to unhide.
- Contacts: reorder pinned contacts, hide contacts into a Hidden contacts folder, or fold the whole contacts row away.
- Long app names stay on one line. Folders and panels follow your surface style and theme.
- Google Photos' share page now uses the share sheet's own colours instead of plain white.

🖼️ Pixel Studio, reimagined
- Zoom: pinch to zoom up to 5x and pan, anywhere in the editor. While zoomed, the pen, highlighter and eraser draw right under your finger, and crop corners stay under it. Save and Share are unaffected.
- All-new text tool: type right on the picture, live, in your chosen font and colour.
- Only ✓ saves, in the top bar or on the text's frame; ✕ deletes.
- A saved text keeps a frame: drag to move it, side handles re-wrap the words, corner handles resize it. Two fingers on a text zoom the picture, like anywhere else.
- A floating fonts and colours menu above the tool bar or keyboard, compact or full width, that you can drag or flick.
- Typing on a cropped picture shows the cropped part right above the keyboard.
- The whole picture after a crop: other tools keep the picture in place, the cropped part where the box was and the rest softly blurred around it....
modules.changelog:
Pixel Suite 3.2.0

Widgets feed, Autofill OTP, Block WhatsApp calls, a much bigger Pixel Arcade, feature films, and lots of fixes.

✨ New
- Autofill OTP: one-time codes from SMS, chat apps and email (Outlook included) show above your keyboard and fill in with a tap, or by themselves if you turn that on. Codes with letters and digits work too. (Autofill OTP)
- Block WhatsApp calls: while Do Not Annoy is on, WhatsApp calls never ring and callers see Unable to call. A notification shows who called, with a Call button to call them back. Blocked calls still show in WhatsApp's Calls tab, and messages and your own calls work as usual. (Do Not Annoy)
- USB on top: the USB notification stays pinned at the top and picks File transfer when your phone is unlocked, with USB debugging right under it. (Miscellaneous › USB on top)
- Quick USB modes: switch to File transfer without your fingerprint or PIN, as long as your phone is unlocked. (Miscellaneous › USB on top)
- Safe from updates: an option that works inside an app (like Block WhatsApp calls) keeps that app from updating while it's on, so an update can't break it. (OTA & Store blocker › Play Store blocker)
- App lists: lists where you pick apps now have a proper search bar and a Select all box.
- LSPosed scope: External Storage and WhatsApp now show as recommended, since Files and Block WhatsApp calls need them.
- On its side: Pixel Suite's pages now fit a phone turned on its side.
- Feature films: every feature page now opens with a short film that shows what it does.

💎 Patreon
- Widgets feed: your own page of widgets next to the home screen and the lock screen. Add widgets from the usual picker, move and resize them, and pick its side and how see-through it is. Keep the Google feed on the other side, or leave it out. On the lock screen, widgets can open the apps you pick without unlocking, so choose carefully. (Widgets feed)
- Chrome+ tabs: opening a tab always zooms smoothly now instead of fading, and going back to the tab grid, the tab keeps its whole frame as it shrinks into place, at full frame rate. The colours follow the tab, and your current tab's card is never cut off by the bottom bar. (Chrome+)
- Chrome+ back and forward: the arrows on the bottom bar follow the page's history, so a dim arrow means there's nowhere to go. (Chrome+)
- Chrome+ tab switcher: more space between the plus buttons and the Tabs group on the bottom bar. (Chrome+)
- Gboard+ Arabic keys: the letters ر and ى now trade places on the third row for easier typing, as a Patreon member asked. (Gboard+)

🛠️ Patreon fixes
- Chrome+: the pinned extension button no longer disappears while a page scrolls, the loading circle no longer sits in the new tab page's feed, and the bottom bar stays down on the inactive tabs page, and a site opened from a speed dial folder opens in the same tab again, so back takes you to the new tab page instead of leaving Chrome....

modules.name: PixelInjector

modules.description: PixelInjector
modules.readme:
Pixel tweaks for Xposed, each behind its own switch. Switches apply live and updates hot reload.

Built and tested on Pixels. A tweak broken on your ROM? Report it from the app.

 Screenshots

Install

1. Get the APK from Releases or the Xposed Modules Repo.
2. Enable it in your Xposed manager and scope the apps you want tweaked.
3. Reboot once.

Tweaks

System UI
- Warm Tiles: raises the limit of 3 bound tiles in Quick Settings. Same hook as  qs-boundless-tiles.
- PillShot: draws the app name on screenshots. Revived from eXtreames/PillShot.
- Mute screenshot sound: skips the screenshot shutter sound.
- Empty shade message: replaces the empty shade's trophy and text with your own. Android 17 only.
- Always expand notifications: opens notifications expanded.
- Pin ongoing notifications: stops swiping away ongoing notifications like media and VPN.
- Charging details: adds watts, volts, amps and temperature to the lock screen charging text.
- Now playing chip: shows the playing track in a status bar chip, with your own font and colors.
- Download chip: shows download progress in a status bar chip. Ported from Iconify's ongoing action chip.
- Fingerprint icon: replaces the lock screen fingerprint icon with a custom ROM icon or your own image.
- Hide shortcut circles: removes the circle behind the lock screen shortcuts while they're off.
- Heads-up duration: sets how long heads-up notifications show.
- Double tap status bar to sleep: double tap empty status bar space to sleep.
- Biometric Bypass: confirms the biometric prompt after a face unlock. Same hook as  biometric-bypass.

System Framework
- Force NEW_TASK: adds NEW_TASK to activity starts that match your rules.
- Clipboard in background: allows selected apps to read the clipboard in the background.
- Screen off animation: replaces the screen-off fade with a CRT animation. Frame math from the YRRPs Lineage CRT.

Launcher
- Double tap to sleep: double tap empty home screen space to sleep. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3.
- Hide gesture pill: hides the navigation handle and shrinks the bottom inset.
- Hide search bar: hides the hotseat search bar. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3.
- Hide app shortcuts: a long press on an app shows only the system actions. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3.
- Home menu entry: adds PixelInjector to the home screen long press menu. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3.

Double tap to sleep needs root for your launcher. On KernelSU and APatch, grant it in the manager.

Gboard
- AMOLED black keyboard: makes the dark keyboard pure black. Same hook as  gboard-material-expressive-black.

Phone
- Remove feedback chip: removes the Help us improve chip and its after-call notification. Same hook as  gdialer-dechip.

File picker
- Force sort by newest first: opens folders newest first in the file picker. Same hook as  remember-my-sort.

KDE Connect
- KDE Connect Quiet: stops KDE Connect from holding the Wi-Fi multicast lock.

GitHub
- GH FastPass: closes the GitHub app's approved 2FA dialog right away. Same hook as  gh-fast-pass.

Firefox
- Material You colors: uses your wallpaper colors in Iceraven and Firefox. Private browsing turns dark red.
- Material 3 loading indicator: shows pull to refresh as the shape morphing Material 3 indicator.
- Menu style: Classic popup: opens the three-dot menu as a popup instead of the bottom sheet.
- Betterfox: applies Betterfox prefs per browser, each one switchable.

Report a bug

Full specs

modules.name: PrivacyMask
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: PrivacyMask
modules.readme:
PrivacyMask

Feeds apps a fake timezone, SIM/carrier, locale and GPS location so they can\'t fingerprint your real location or country.

What it does
- Hooks TelephonyManager (SIM/network country ISO, MCC/MNC, carrier names, getLine1Number),
  Location / LocationManager.getLastKnownLocation, TimeZone.getDefault(), and
  Locale.getDefault() in every process the framework has scoped this module to.
- Reads the current fake identity from remote preferences
  (XposedInterface#getRemotePreferences, read-only on the hooked side); PrivacyMask's own UI
  writes to the same group via XposedService#getRemotePreferences (writable there).
- Applies hooks from onPackageReady(), before the target app's Application.onCreate() runs.
- Works immediately after install + a force-stop/reopen of the target app — PrivacyMask's own
  UI never needs to be opened first. If its remote preferences are still empty, hooks use the
  built-in defaults in FakeConfig.
- Lets you generate a random identity or edit one by hand — pick the fake location either by
  dragging a pin on the built-in map or by typing latitude/longitude directly, both on the same
  screen and kept in sync.
- Every hook group (telephony, subscription info, location, time zone, locale, system
  properties) has its own on/off switch in the UI, so you can fake only what you need.
- Saves and applies automatically as soon as anything changes — there's no separate Apply
  step. A process that's already running still needs you to force-stop and reopen it (or
  reboot) yourself to pick up the change; PrivacyMask never force-stops anything on its own
  and never needs or requests root for that.

What it doesn't do
- Doesn't touch network traffic — your real IP is still visible to anything doing
  IP-based geolocation. Pair with a VPN exiting in the country you're spoofing for that.
- Doesn't cover native (NDK) code or APIs outside the list above.
- Doesn't defeat root/hook detection — some banking/anti-fraud apps refuse to run at all on a
  rooted, hooked device, independent of anything this module does.
- Doesn't choose target apps itself — that's entirely your framework Manager's scope screen
  (Vector/LSPosed); PrivacyMask has no package-selection UI of its own.
- Doesn't force-stop anything for you — after a change, already-running target apps need a
  manual force-stop + reopen (or reboot) from you to pick it up.
- Doesn't draw real coastlines on its location picker — the map is an offline
  latitude/longitude grid with a few reference cities for orientation, not map tiles (no
  internet permission, no Maps SDK, no API key). Good enough to drop a pin roughly where you
  want; use the numeric fields for precision.

Known limitations
- Requires a framework that advertises PROP_CAP_REMOTE (remote preferences support).
  Without it, getRemotePreferences() throws UnsupportedOperationException.
- Hooks apply per-process; a process already running before you change the config needs a
  restart (manual force-stop + reopen, or a reboot) to pick up new values.
- Requires Vector 2.2+ or another libxposed API-102-compatible framework, and root
  (Magisk/KernelSU with Zygisk/NeoZygisk).

Responsible use

This is meant for protecting your own privacy on your own device — e.g. stopping ad/analytics
SDKs from fingerprinting your location. Using it to deceive services where your real location
or identity is a legal or contractual requirement (regional pricing, financial identity
verification, etc.) may violate those services' terms; that's on the user.

modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Sunny
modules.readme:
Sunny

Prevent Tachiyomi and Mihon from throttling your requests by ignoring rate limits.

Features
- Ignore extension-specific rate limits (makes page loading, downloading and browsing faster).
- Increase max number of concurrent downloads from 2 to 16.

What is this?

Tachiyomi has a rate limit system that was designed to prevent manga sources from being overloaded with too many requests and to avoid specific users from being blocked by manga sources due to high network traffic (i.e. bulk downloads). This is achieved by deliberately waiting for a specific amount of seconds before sending networks requests.

The downside is that nowadays these rate limits are applied to every extension; even those that do not actually require any rate limit. "just in case".

Unfortunately, this results in browsing and downloading being slower than necessary, degrading the overall user experience.

Bellow is a video comparison:

Left side: Tachiyomi with the Sunny module enabled.
Right side: Tachiyomi without the Sunny module.

Usage

This module requires root and an API-compatible Xposed implementation to work.

Firstly, download and install the APK from the releases page.
- LSposed (Android 8 and up)
- Go to the modules section, enable Sunny, and mark the Tachiyomi package in the list of apps. Then, kill/force-close the Tachiyomi process.
- Legacy Xposed (Android 7 and below)
- Go to the modules section, enable Sunny, and reboot the device.

Supported versions

The minimum supported version is Tachiyomi v0.12.0. It might be compatible with older releases, but that is not guaranteed to work.

This was tested up to Mihon v0.17.1.

Non-root alternative

If you are looking for a non-root alternative, try my fork of Mihon. It's the original Mihon app with my changes on top of it.

modules.name: Van Step
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Van Step
modules.readme:
Van Step
将 SmartisanOS 的 One Step 侧边栏和 BigBang 文字拆分功能，以 LSPosed 模块的形式带入 HyperOS。

Smartisan OS 已经远去，但它最好的两个创意不应被遗忘。Van Step 在现代小米 HyperOS 之上还原了 One Step 侧边栏——将任何内容拖拽到任何地方——以及 BigBang——点按文字，即刻拆词。它通过 Hook SystemUI 和系统启动器来实现.

功能

侧边栏

从屏幕边缘滑入，即可查看最近的图片、文件和剪贴板历史。将条目拖拽到应用图标上即可分享，或拖拽到窗口槽位即可在其中打开。
- 最近图片 / 文件 / 剪贴板，各自记住上次滚动位置
- 拖拽分享至应用快捷方式，每次命中时提供触觉反馈
- 媒体控制位于顶部栏，重新打开时定位到你上次使用的页面
- 任务切换和自由窗口控制，包括主/副分屏互换

BigBang

将任意文本炸裂为可点按的词语碎片，忠实还原原版体验：碎片先收缩至你的触摸点，然后向外迸发就位。
- 中英文混合分词，标点符号作为独立的窄碎片呈现
- 跨碎片拖拽进行范围选择；长按可拖出选区
- 复制、分享，或将选区直接拖入其他应用
- 以悬浮面板形式覆盖在变暗的宿主应用之上，而非全屏页面

手势触发方式

| 触发方式 | 工作原理 |
| --- | --- |
| 大面积按压 | 读取厂商触控 HAL 的接触密度信号——参见 触控守护进程 |
| 双指长按 | 纯 MotionEvent 几何计算 |
| 长按回退 | 可选方案，用于面积信号不可用时 |
| 角落 / 边缘滑动 | 可从屏幕边缘自定义入口 |

模块设置中提供按应用黑名单和可调节的长按时长。

环境要求
- Android 15 – 16（minSdk 35，targetSdk 36）
- HyperOS  2.0 / 3.0（已在小米 15 Pro、 和 K40 上测试）
- 搭载 Zygisk 的 LSPosed
- Root 权限（Magisk / KernelSU / APatch）——持久化设置和触控守护进程均需要
！！！在使用前请备份数据 硬盘有价 数据无价！！！
安装

1. 安装 APK 并在 LSPosed 中启用 Van Step。
2. 启用以下作用域，然后重启：

   | 作用域 | 用途 |
   | --- | --- |
   | 系统框架（android、system） | 窗口管理、重启策略、手势 Hook |
   | 系统界面（com.android.systemui） | 侧边栏本体 |
   | 启动器（com.miui.home） | 从桌面触发 |

   system_server 的 Hook 仅在开机时安装，因此重启是必须的——仅重启 SystemUI 不会安装这些 Hook。

3. 在 Root 管理器中授予本应用 Root 权限。设置通过 su 写入，如果没有 Root 权限，所有开关都会静默回退。

触控守护进程

大面积按压触发方式需要一个小型 Root 守护进程，因为触控驱动虽然声明了 ABS_MT_TOUCH_MAJOR，但从未实际发出该值——接触面积信息仅存在于厂商触控 HAL 内部。scripts/onestep-touchd.sh 通过 uprobe 读取该信息，并将判定结果以系统属性的形式发布。
守护进程仅在mi15pro上测试成功，其他设备请自行测试/修改

将其安装为 Magisk/KernelSU 模块，以便每次开机自动启动：

adb push scripts/module/module.prop scripts/module/service.sh /data/local/tmp/
adb push scripts/onestep-touchd.sh scripts/onestep-touchd-stop.sh /data/local/tmp/
adb push scripts/deploy-module.sh /data/local/tmp/
adb shell su -M -c 'sh /data/local/tmp/deploy-module.sh'
构建

./gradlew assembleDebug

需要 JDK 21。Gradle 8.7 会拒绝 JDK 24 并报 Unsupported class file major version 68 错误，因此如果你的默认 JVM 是 JDK 24，请将构建指向其他版本：

JAVA_HOME="/path/to/jdk-21" ./gradlew assembleDebug

项目结构

| 路径 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| src/ | 侧边栏 UI 和数据管理器，运行于 SystemUI 内部 |
| src-lsp/ | Xposed Hook、BigBang、窗口和手势控制 |
| src-stubs/ | AOSP 中不存在的 SmartisanOS 框架类的桩代码 |
| scripts/ | 触控守护进程及其 Root 模块打包脚本 |
| res/ | 布局、绘图资源和字符串 |

致谢

Smartisan Technology（锤子科技）——感谢 One Step 和 BigBang，以及将它们开源。本项目是 SmartisanTech/packages_apps_OneStep 的移植版本，以 Apache License 2.0 发布。这里每一个值得称道的交互都是他们的原创；本仓库所做的工作，主要是让这些创意在别人的 ROM 上跑起来。

BigBang 团队，其原版 com.smartisanos.textboom 构建提供了精确的动画时序、碎片颜色和窗口参数。

LSPosed 和 libxposed 的作者们，感谢这个框架让 Hook SystemUI 和 system_server 成为可能，而无需触碰 ROM。

Lucide 提供的图标集。完整声明见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md。

SukiSU-Ultra，其 Miuix 风格的管理界面是本模块设置页面的参考——悬浮胶囊底部栏、色调卡片和状态标签均是其 Compose 组件的 View 层移植。其液态玻璃效果则基于 Kyant0/AndroidLiquidGlass。

遇到问题
1. 模块未启用：检查 LSPosed 是否已启用本模块，并确保其作用域已启用。
2. 权限不足：检查 Root 管理器是否已授予本应用 Root 权限。
3. 触控守护进程未启动：检查守护进程是否已安装并启动。如果未启动，请参考 触控守护进程。
4. 系统版本不兼容：本模块仅支持 Android 15 – 16，请确保您的设备运行的是兼容的 Android 版本。
5. 自行无法解决的问题 请提交issue至https://github.com/LAOBILAXI233/onestep_on_hyper
   提交的issus应该包括但不限于:
   1. 系统版本
   2. HyperOS版本
   3. LSPosed版本
   4. 出现问题的具体操作
   5. 出现问题的具体描述
   6. 出现问题的具体截图
   7. 出现问题的具体日志
   日志的获取方式:/data/data/com.hyper.sidebar/files/onestep/onestep.log
手势操作
1. onestep启动：从状态栏边缘向内滑动，即可打开侧边栏，如果安装守护进程即可触发大面积按压，大面积按压并向斜方向滑动。在侧边栏中，你可以查看最近的图片、文件和剪贴板历史，并将条目拖拽到应用图标上即可分享，或拖拽到窗口槽位即可在其中打开。
2. BigBang：在应用中大面积按压（以安装守护进程模块）或双指长按，即可打开 BigBang。在 BigBang 中，你可以将任意文本炸裂为可点按的词语碎片，并将选区拖拽到其他应用中。
3. 媒体控制：在侧边栏的顶部栏，你可以找到媒体控制按钮，包括播放、暂停、上一首、下一首等操作。
4.媒体控制与近期图片、文件、剪贴板历史切换 向左滑动解锁三大金刚键（bushi）

modules.name: WeType UI Enhanced
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: WeType UI Enhanced
modules.readme:
WeType UI Enhanced

一个以 微信输入法（WeType）界面美化与个性化 为主要功能的 Xposed 模块，同时为作用域其它输入法解锁 MIUI 全面屏优化限制。

功能

微信输入法美化
- 自定义浅色 / 深色模式下的窗口背景颜色与透明度
- 自定义浅色 / 深色按键颜色、透明度与圆角
- 自定义背景模糊强度、平滑圆角及边缘高光效果
- 自定义输入法全局品牌强调色
- 调节工具栏图标背景透明度
- 调节候选词背景透明度与圆角
- 调节首个候选词及候选栏拼音边距
- 支持阻止微信输入法热更新

高级材质与液态玻璃

在支持相应系统视效接口的 HyperOS 设备上，可在设置的「外观」分组中启用：
- 高级材质：采用超级小爱输入法的系统磨砂背景效果，保留模块的自定义平滑圆角。
- 系统液态玻璃：在高级材质下启用 os4 原生玻璃渲染，支持调节折射、厚度、模糊及高光等参数；使用「颜色」分组保存的浅色 / 深色背景色与透明度作为 tint。

两项功能默认关闭，需要系统视效处于开启状态；不支持的设备上，对应开关不可用。

MIUI / HyperOS 附加功能

在支持小米全面屏键盘优化的 MIUI / HyperOS 系统上，提供三方输入法解锁全面屏键盘优化限制，解锁小米短语的包名校验，修复三方输入法无法获取系统剪贴板列表的问题。

该部分并非模块主要功能，在非小米系统上不会启用，也不影响 WeType 美化功能。

效果预览

默认效果为 iOS 27 Apple 官方设计稿内的配色、圆角等数值

#FB7299 主题色截图

使用要求
- Android 12+
- LSPosed / 兼容的 Xposed 框架
- Xposed API Version ≥ 102
- 微信输入法

安装模块后，在 LSPosed 中启用模块并勾选 微信输入法 作用域，然后重启微信输入法。

模块生效后，可通过桌面入口进入设置；也可以点击微信输入法「关于」页面中的 Logo 打开寄生设置页。

部分设置修改后需要重启微信输入法进程才能完全生效。

测试环境

设备：Xiaomi 17 Pro

HyperOS 4.0.0.27 Beta

Android 17

LSPosed v2.1.1-it (7846)

微信输入法：3.5.3.56201

兼容性

模块主要针对微信输入法进行适配。微信输入法内部实现、资源名称或云端热修复发生变化时，部分功能可能暂时失效。

MIUI / HyperOS 相关附加功能仅针对小米系统，不适用于其他厂商的系统级输入法优化实现。

下载

请前往 Releases 下载最新版本。

源码：https://github.com/NEORUAA/WeType_UI_Enhanced

开源致谢

感谢项目 MIUI_IME_Unlock(MIT) 提供的解锁 MIUI 全面屏优化限制功能

感谢 miuix 提供的 Compose UI 库

开源许可

本项目采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证。
modules.changelog:
1.29.0 更新日志

这次的 1.29.0 是一次视觉质感与细节调优的重磅大版本！不仅带来了 Apple 原生 SF Pro 字体与精致的 SF Symbols 键盘符号，重构了极致平滑的按键圆角与通透纯净质感，还实现了深/浅色外观方案独立保存与候选词配色解绑，并彻底解决了微信输入法 4.0.0 在小米全面屏底栏下的争夺闪烁问题。

🍎 质感飞跃：全套 SF Pro 字体与 SF Symbols 键盘符号
为了让输入法在磨砂与液态玻璃下更具原生精致感，我们对键盘文字与按键符号进行了全面重塑：
- 原生 SF Pro 字体排版：英文字母与文本改用 Apple 官方 SF Pro Text 可变轴渲染，文字形态优雅利落；字体采用零压缩打包并由系统直接内存映射（mmap），不产生额外的解压内存与 CPU 开销。
- 经典 SF Symbols 矢量功能键：退格、Shift、大小写锁定、空格及表情键全面替换为语义化的 Apple SF 风格图标。
- 向上发送箭头 & 气泡居中：回车发送键替换为经典的向上实心箭头；同时修正了按键长按弹出的预览气泡，文字完美垂直居中，不再偏移（#8008f98）。
- 缺字智能回退：遇到极冷门符号或特殊字符时，会自动无缝回退到微信输入法内置字体，绝不出现“豆腐块”乱码或漏字。

✨ 极简纯净：连续平滑圆角（Squircle），告别生硬边框与阴影
- 平滑连续曲率圆角：按键绘制改用类似 iOS 原生的连续平滑圆角（Squircle）算法，四角弧度过渡更加柔和自然。
- 去除多余边框与投影：剔除了旧版按键繁杂的描边与深色投影，配合背景磨砂与液态玻璃，呈现出晶莹、通透且极具现代感的高级质感。
- 设置预览 1:1 对齐：重构了设置页中的按键预览几何比例，现在与宿主真实键盘的键位尺寸、比例和圆角缩放完全一致，所见即所得。

🎨 独立外观：深/浅色模式分离 & 候选词颜色自由定制
- 深浅模式各自独立：支持根据当前微信输入法的皮肤状态（深色/浅色），分别保存独立的背景颜色、按键透明度及配色方案，切换系统模式时不再互相牵制。
- 候选词高亮色独立解绑：响应社区小伙伴在 #56 的建议，将候选词高亮颜色从全局品牌色中剥离出来，浅色和深色模式均可自由定制最舒服的候选字高亮颜色。
- 全新色板选择弹窗：重构了取色器对话框，滑动调节透明度时会精确保留 RGB 纯色数值，支持色彩与无障碍模式标签联动。

🛡️ 稳如泰山：彻底解决微信输入法 4.0.0 与 MIUI 底栏冲突
- 解决反复争抢闪烁：针对微信输入法 4.0.0 与小米全面屏键盘优化底栏同时开启时出现的频繁重绘、闪烁与布局争抢问题（#59），引入了全新的底栏 Inset 补偿所有权追踪机制。
- 轻量高效测量：在窗口根节点拦截分发，微信输入法或系统重写布局时主动避让并复用轻量更新，敲字与切换流畅丝滑。

🛠️ 详细更新列表
- feat: 引入 Apple 原生 SF Pro 字体与语义化 SF Symbols 键盘符号
- feat: 采用平滑连续圆角（Squircle），移除按键旧式边框与杂乱阴影，重塑高级纯净质感
- feat: 支持深色与浅色模式独立保存外观方案，配备全新色板调节弹窗
- feat: 候选词高亮色与全局品牌色解绑，支持独立自定义（Fixes #56）
- fix: 解决微信输入法 4.0.0 在小米全面屏优化底栏下的 Inset 争抢闪烁与卡顿（Fixes #59）
- fix: 修复按键长按气泡文字未垂直居中的问题，并采用经典向上发送箭头
- fix: 特殊字符与冷门符号自动回退微信输入法内置字体，避免缺字乱码
- fix: 限制键盘符号最大尺寸在标称按键高度内，防止部分特殊分辨率下溢出拉伸
- fix: 设置页按键预览比例与真实键盘 1:1 精准对齐
- chore: 优化 GitHub Issues 反馈模板与工程依赖升级

💡 贴心小建议 (Tips)
1. 升级后配色推荐：本次更新解绑了深浅模式以及候选词颜色，如果升级后觉得显示效果与以往略有差异，建议进入模块设置界面重新挑选或微调一次深色/浅色下的「候选词高亮色」。
2. SF Symbols 效果：全新的功能键符号已完全自适应微信输入法的暗色与亮色模式，打字手感与视觉统一性均大幅提升，快去试试吧！

modules.name: ZEEHO APP Unlocker - 解锁电自功能限制
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: ZEEHO APP Unlocker - 解锁电自功能限制
modules.readme:
Zeeho Unlocker

用于测试 ZEEHO APP（com.cfmoto）功能的 LSPosed 模块。

启用后可解锁 App 内按车型灰度关闭的入口（孪生仪表、主题商城、骑行数据等），
调整深色模式与状态栏配色，自定义仪表壁纸 / 车辆立绘 / 2D·3D 车模 / 充电动画，
并在小米澎湃 OS 上把充电状态投射为超级岛或实时活动。

使用

1. 设备需已安装 LSPosed（本模块要求 API 100 以上）；
2. 安装本模块并在 LSPosed 中启用，作用域勾选 com.cfmoto；
   充电超级岛 / 实时活动另需 com.android.systemui；
3. 重启 ZEEHO APP 后生效。设置入口：模块桌面图标，或 APP 内「车辆服务」页的设置行。

免 root 场景可通过 NPatch 打包后使用（仅 com.cfmoto 作用域）。

说明
- 仅供功能验证使用，不保证所有车机/车型可用；
- 修改 App 行为的开关是否真实生效取决于车辆控制器与服务端下发，部分项目仅界面可见；
- 本仓库只发布 APK 与更新日志，不提供源码。
modules.changelog:
- 设置页首页标题右侧新增「ZEEHO NEXT WEB」按钮：一键打开网页版仪表盘（车况、车辆设置、车控、消息、任务都在那上面，也能直接用手机号登录）。能取到登录凭据就自动带过去，不用手抄 token；还没登录也照常打开，在网页里登录即可。
- 「其它与维护」里的「全新仪表」改名为「一键配置 web」（行为不变：把 token 与账号 ID 通过网址参数带过去，打开就是配好的状态）。
- 新增「复制账号 ID」（「其它与维护 → 账号与数据」）：复制首页响应里的 bindingUserId，带登录态调接口时 URL 上要用的那个 id。免 root 也能拿到——极核起来后会主动把凭据补推给模块。
- 免 root 通道改进：极核每次启动都会向模块报一次到，让设置页把账号 ID 与 token 补推过来（以前模块后启动就错过那次推送，得手动重进设置页才会显示）。

modules.name: ZUXOS+
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: ZUXOS+
modules.readme:
ZUXOS+

   简体中文 丨 English

面向联想 ZUXOS设备的 Xposed 系统增强模块

项目简介

ZUXOS+ 用于在联想 ZUXOS设备上扩展系统设置、桌面、系统界面、系统更新、游戏助手和软件包安装程序等体验。项目提供独立的 Compose 配置应用，也可将功能入口注入到系统设置中，方便按页面管理各项 Hook 开关。

主要功能

系统框架增强
- 核心破解：支持允许应用降级安装、跳过 APK 签名验证、放宽签名能力检查、绕过厂商安装黑名单等功能。
- 强制允许截屏：解除 FLAG_SECURE 对截屏和录屏的限制。
- 安装验证优化：可禁用安装包验证代理，减少系统安装限制带来的阻断。

设置与应用信息
- 设置入口集成：在系统设置中注入 ZUXOS+ 功能入口，并按系统现有页面风格组织一级、二级、三级菜单。
- 应用信息扩展：在应用详情页显示包名、SDK 版本、首次安装时间、最后更新时间和安装来源。
- 长按复制：应用信息条目支持长按复制，便于调试和分享包名等信息。
- 关于设备自定义：可修改联想“关于平板电脑”页面中的设备名称、型号、处理器、存储、内存、软件版本、Android 版本，并支持替换顶部设备图片。

联想系统更新
- 隐藏新版本提醒：屏蔽系统更新小红点、通知和新版本提示，同时保留系统更新入口。
- 本地安装入口：强制显示本地更新选项，不影响原有 OTA 功能。

ZUX 桌面
- 更大的 Dock 栏：提高 Dock 图标数量上限。
- 自定义桌面网格：支持覆盖桌面行数和列数。
- 原生后台管理：阻止最近任务清理时强制停止受保护应用。
- 白名单模式：仅保护指定包名的应用。
- 最近任务内存显示：在最近任务底部显示已用内存 / 总内存。
- 隐藏桌面图标名称：隐藏桌面图标下方文字，不改变布局和点击区域。

游戏助手
- 拯救者系列门禁：使用 Elden / 拯救者系列游戏助手门禁，并修复 CPU 频率和温度显示。
- 功能强制开启：强制开启语音助手 / 变声器、弹幕、高光时刻、游戏岛、防误触、通知免打扰、智能预下载、智能旁路充电、移动网络加速和主卡加速。

系统界面
- 控制中心自定义：支持修改快捷开关未开启 / 开启状态颜色。
- 透明度调整：支持调整快捷开关背景透明度和控制中心整体透明度。
- 背景模糊强度：支持调整下拉通知栏时底层背景模糊程度。

软件包安装程序
- 跳过安全扫描：减少安装前扫描等待。
- 自动授予权限：安装应用时自动允许权限确认流程。
- 跳过未上架警告页：跳过联想安装器的安全警告页面。
- 去广告：安装完成后不显示推荐应用。
- 原生安装界面：使用系统自带安装界面替代 ZUI 安装界面。
- 保留安装包：安装完成后不自动删除安装包文件。

模块配置
- Hook 日志：可记录功能注册、运行和失败日志，并在应用内查看、筛选和清理。
- 配置导入导出：支持将当前模块设置备份为 JSON 文件，也可从备份恢复。
- 外观设置：支持浅色 / 深色 / 跟随系统、悬浮导航栏、液态玻璃效果、卡片透明度和自定义背景。

安装要求
- 系统：联想 ZUXOS / ZUI，Android 9 及以上。
- 框架：LSPosed 或其他兼容的 Xposed 框架。

modules.readme:
抖仙人

面向抖音 Android 客户端的 LSPosed Modern API 102 纯净播放模块。

功能
- 功能总开关：关闭后恢复抖音原有界面和操作，停止模块功能，保留各子开关配置。
- 沉浸式播放独立开关：可单独关闭纯净播放，继续使用内容过滤、双击拦截和暂停下载。
- 可选禁用屏幕双击，拦截视频双击点赞和爱心动画，保留单击、滑动与侧边长按。
- 可选“双击打开评论区”：双击画面直接展开抖音原生评论区，不再触发点赞与爱心动画。
- 沉浸播放时屏蔽隐藏按钮及其子控件的触摸响应；点击原按钮区域会暂停并恢复完整界面。
- 保留侧面长按的原生快进／快退手势及上下滑动切换视频，屏蔽中间长按菜单。
- 修复长按结束后立即点击时，暂停却未恢复界面的问题。
- 播放视频时隐藏视频画面以外的抖音界面和系统栏。
- 可在模块设置页开启播放弹幕，纯净播放时保留抖音原生弹幕（40.8 起按整层保留 Compose／Functor／Canvas 各渲染层）。
- 滑动切换视频时持续隐藏其他控件，避免界面闪烁。
- 暂停视频时立即恢复完整界面和视频页原始布局，避免介绍被底部菜单栏遮挡；继续播放后再次进入纯净模式。
- 暂停后在右侧操作栏顶部显示下载按钮，可选择“视频（无水印 MP4）”或“音频（MP3）”，保存到系统 Download 目录。
- 无水印下载可按“视频清晰度”取流并在保存前校验画面/音轨；图文作品支持保存无水印原图。
- 在模块设置页分别配置是否跳过广告、图文、直播和普通视频。
- 支持按关键词匹配普通视频的标题或介绍，命中后自动切换到下一条；关键词忽略英文大小写，
  可使用换行、逗号或分号分隔。
- 默认跳过广告、图文和直播，保留普通视频；关键词默认为空。

兼容范围

| 项目 | 当前支持 |
| --- | --- |
| LSPosed API | Modern API 102 |
| 已验证抖音版本 | 39.7.0（versionCode 390701） |
| 本次触摸回归验证 | 抖音 40.3.0（versionCode 400301）／Android 16 |
| 暂停布局回归验证 | 抖音 40.4.0（versionCode 400401）／Android 16 |
| Android | 9（API 28）及以上 |
| 作用域 | com.ss.android.ugc.aweme |
| 模块包名 | com.zz.douyin |
| 新功能实机验证 | 抖音 40.5.0（versionCode 400501）／Android 16，用户已完成测试并确认发布 |
| 模块版本 | 1.7.6 |

模块基于抖音 39.7.0 的运行时结构适配，并针对 40.5.0 补充双击拦截、40.8.0 补充弹幕分层、广告标记与图文渲染适配。抖音升级后，播放器类、数据模型或界面层级可能变化，
届时需要重新适配。

安装与使用

1. 在 LSPosed 模块仓库中下载并安装“抖仙人”。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块并勾选默认作用域“抖音”。
3. 强制停止后重新打开抖音。
4. 正常播放时自动进入纯净模式；可选择显示弹幕，暂停后恢复界面并显示下载按钮。
5. 打开“抖仙人”应用，可修改功能总开关、沉浸式播放、禁用屏幕双击、双击打开评论区、播放弹幕、内容类型开关和视频关键词；设置会同步到抖音进程。
6. 总开关和沉浸式播放默认开启，禁用屏幕双击默认关闭。暂停后点击下载，可选择视频或 MP3 音频；音频从当前视频音轨提取并转码。

modules.name: 抖音低赞视频过滤模块
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 抖音低赞视频过滤模块
modules.readme:
README.md
抖音低赞视频过滤器 (DouyinLowLikeFilter)

一个基于 LSPosed/Xposed 框架的抖音模块，可以自动过滤推荐流中点赞数低于自定义阈值的视频。

功能特性

Hook RecyclerView.Adapter.onBindViewHolder，隐藏所有漏过数据层的低赞视频（包括本地缓存数据）

项目结构

DouyinLowLikeFilter/
├── app/
│   ├── build.gradle                          # App 级构建配置
│   ├── proguard-rules.pro
│   └── src/main/
│       ├── AndroidManifest.xml               # 声明 Xposed 模块
│       ├── assets/
│       │   └── xposed_init                   # Hook 入口类路径
│       ├── java/com/example/douyinlowlikefilter/
│       │   ├── MainActivity.java             # 模块说明界面
│       │   └── MainHook.java                 # 核心 Hook 逻辑
│       └── res/
│           ├── layout/activity_main.xml
│           ├── values/
│           │   ├── strings.xml
│           │   ├── themes.xml
│           │   └── arrays.xml                # 模块作用域
│           └── xml/
├── build.gradle                              # 根构建配置
├── settings.gradle                           # 仓库配置（含 Xposed API）
├── gradle.properties
└── gradle/wrapper/

如何安装使用

1. 安装模块：将编译好的 APK 安装到手机
2. 激活模块：
- 打开 LSPosed 管理器
- 在「模块」页面找到「抖音低赞过滤」
- 勾选启用，并选择作用域为 抖音
- 强制停止并重新打开 LSPosed
3. 设置阈值：
- 打开抖音 → 我 → 设置 → 通用设置
- 页面底部找到「低赞视频过滤」选项
- 点击设置最低点赞数（默认 1000）
4. 重启抖音：强制停止抖音后重新打开

验证模块是否生效
- 将阈值设为极大值（如 99999999）
- 如果推荐流视频全部消失 → Hook 成功
- 如果无变化 → Hook 点可能不适用于当前版本

版本适配

本模块针对 抖音 37.9.0 设计，理论适配一定范围的其他版本。

注意事项
- 模块仅在推荐页生效，不影响关注页、喜欢页、搜索页等其他页面
- 过滤的是已加载的数据，不会影响抖音的推荐算法
- 如果抖音频繁更新，模块可能需要跟着适配
- 模块安装后无桌面图标，设置入口在抖音「通用设置」页面
- 如需查看模块说明，可在 LSPosed 模块列表中点击本模块打开

License

modules.readme:
番茄小说 Hook

基于 LSPosed 框架的番茄免费小说 Hook 模块，主要用于阅读时长追踪与书籍数据采集。

功能
- 自动记录阅读过程中的有效时长
- 打开书籍时自动提取书名、作者、字数、封面、分类等元数据
- 进入书架页时同步书架列表
- 访问个人主页时自动获取用户 ID
- 绕过 license 校验，无谷歌服务使用Play版番茄小说

目标应用

| 应用          | 包名                           |
|-------------|------------------------------|
| 番茄免费小说      | com.dragon.read            |
| 番茄小说（Play版） | com.dragon.read.oversea.gp |

使用方法

1. 在 LSPosed 中激活模块，勾选番茄小说
2. 打开番茄小说，进入个人主页（模块会自动获取用户 ID，成功后会弹出提示）
3. 正常阅读即可，模块会在后台自动采集阅读时长和书籍数据
4. 进入书架页面触发书架数据同步

数据说明

采集的数据会发送至远程服务端，用于统计和推荐模型训练。具体包括：
- 书籍元数据（书名、作者、字数、封面、分类、连载状态）
- 阅读记录（用户 ID、书籍 ID、起止时间、有效时长）
- 书架信息（书籍 ID 列表）
- 收集服务仅供统计和训练模型使用，不提供任何其他形式的服务，也不参与任何商业行为
- 目前初步成果: 阅读时长排行榜，共有日、周、月、季、年、总榜。推荐模型暂时使用的基于用户书架的协同过滤算法进行相似度推荐，数据量较少效果不是很好，后续会加入更多的推荐算法
- 阅读时长排行榜，仅是使用模块收集服务的数据，不代表官方数据，仅供参考!!!

免责声明

本模块仅供学习交流，请在下载 24 小时内删除。使用本模块可能违反番茄小说相关用户协议

modules.name: AmznKiller
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: AmznKiller
modules.readme:
An Xposed module that hides ads and sponsored products in the Amazon Shopping app. It injects CSS rules into Amazon's pages that hide the ad markup and leave the rest of the page alone.
- Remove ads: hides sponsored results, ad slots and sponsored video carousels.
- Price history: adds Keepa and CamelCamelCamel charts to product pages, each with its own switch. Keepa covers Amazon US, UK, DE, FR, JP, CA, IT, ES, IN, MX, BR and AU. CamelCamelCamel covers the same stores except IN, MX and BR.
- Hide Rufus AI: removes Amazon's Rufus assistant.
- Disable video autoplay: videos wait for a tap.
- Dark mode: forces a dark theme on Amazon. Experimental, see Force dark.
- Rule updates: ships with built-in rules and updates them from this repo, or from a list URL you set.
- App updates: installs new versions from GitHub releases after checking the checksum and the signing key.

The blocking is cosmetic. Amazon still sends its ad requests. Pair it with a DNS blocker such as AdGuard, NextDNS or Pi-hole to stop those too.

Before and after

Search query: "macbook air m1 16gb 512"

    Stock (2 real results, rest are ads)
    With AmznKiller

    Stock
    With AmznKiller

    Price charts

    Dark mode

 Companion app

Install

Needs Android 10 or newer, root and an Xposed framework with libxposed API 101 or newer (LSPosed or Vector).

1. Download the APK:

2. Enable AmznKiller in your Xposed manager. The scope is fixed to Amazon Shopping (com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping), Amazon India (in.amazon.mShop.android.shopping) and Amazon Business (com.amazon.mShop.android.business.shopping).
3. Force stop Amazon Shopping and open it again.
4. Open AmznKiller. The dashboard says Ads are blocked once the module is active.

Settings apply while Amazon is running, on the next page load: Remove ads, rule updates, Keepa, CamelCamelCamel, video autoplay and WebView debugging. Hide Rufus AI and Dark mode need a force stop of Amazon Shopping.

AmznKiller targets libxposed API 102, so on a framework with hot reload a new version takes effect without restarting Amazon.

Force dark

Amazon opts out of Android force dark with forceDarkAllowed=false in its theme. AmznKiller turns force dark back on for native views and WebViews and adds CSS fixes for the parts it gets wrong.

It needs Android 15 (API 35) or newer. On Android 10 to 14 Amazon's opt-out wins. Some ROMs that aren't Pixel builds don't support it.

Pick Off, System or On under Amazon appearance on the dashboard, then force stop Amazon Shopping.

Troubleshooting

1. If the dashboard says AmznKiller isn't active, enable the module in your Xposed manager.
2. Force stop Amazon Shopping and open it again.
3. Pull down on the dashboard to update the rules. If the update fails, reset Rule source in Settings to the default.
4. If a page looks broken, turn off Remove ads to check whether the rules cause it.
5. Open an issue and paste the versions from About > Diagnostics.

Build

git clone https://github.com/hxreborn/amznkiller.git
cd amznkiller
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

Requires JDK 21 and the Android SDK. Configure local.properties:

sdk.dir=/path/to/android/sdk

Optional: release signing
RELEASE_STORE_FILE=
RELEASE_STORE_PASSWORD=
RELEASE_KEY_ALIAS=
RELEASE_KEY_PASSWORD=

See CONTRIBUTING.md before opening a pull request.

License

modules.name: App Clone
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: App Clone
modules.readme:
App Clone

Use the same Android app with separate accounts and data. App Clone manages
Android's native clone profiles and raises their limits through an Xposed module.
It doesn't modify the original APKs.

Download APK ·
Source ·
Report a bug

Requirements
- Android 13+ with native AOSP clone-profile support
- Root access
- LSPosed or a compatible framework supporting legacy Xposed API 82

The clone engine has been tested on Pixel / Android 17. Other Android versions
and firmware remain unverified; not every app supports cloning.

Get started

1. Download the APK and install it in your main profile (user 0).
2. Enable the module for System Framework (android) and reboot.
3. Open App Clone, grant root, and tap Add clone app.
4. Pick an app, then choose an existing profile or create a new one.
5. Tap ▶ Open beside the clone, or pin a home-screen shortcut from its ⋮ menu.

Several apps can share a profile. Another instance of the same app needs a
different profile.

Manage your clones
- Apps: see every clone beneath its app. Use the instance's ⋮ menu to
  disable, enable, force-stop, restrict background activity or remove it.
- Profiles: start, stop, rename or delete a profile and manage its apps.
- Settings: customize shortcut labels, choose a language and set what happens
  after reboot. Reboot actions wait for main-user unlock and require root; they
  don't prevent initial profile startup.

System apps are hidden by default; reveal them with Show system apps.
Use Refresh after making changes outside App Clone.

Before changing or deleting data
- Stopping a profile pauses all its apps and notifications but keeps data.
  Opening a clone starts that profile again.
- Disabling an app keeps its data but stops it and its notifications until
  you enable it. Force stop is temporary, not a permanent freeze.
- Background restrictions can delay notifications. Use Restore previous
  before clearing App Clone's data or uninstalling it; otherwise Android's
  restriction can remain without a restore record.
- Deleting a profile erases all its app data, including hidden system apps.
  Removing an app deletes only its data in the selected profile. Main-user,
  work and private profiles aren't managed here. Back up important data first.

Changing system apps can break other apps in that profile. Root and framework
changes can also affect boot; keep a recovery method available.

Languages

From version 2.3.1: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish,
Hindi, Bengali, Russian, Japanese and Turkish. Switch in Settings → App language;
choose a bundled language or System default. Translations are AI-authored;
corrections are welcome.

Help and contributions

If cloning fails, check root access and System Framework scope. Use
Export diagnostics for a bug report, and remove personal information before
sharing it. App Clone has no Internet permission.

Build from source

In the source repository, use JDK 21, Android SDK platform/build-tools 36,
Python 3.11+ and the Xposed API 82 jar.
Set the paths for your machine, then run:

export JAVA_HOME=/path/to/jdk21 ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/sdk
export XPOSED_API_JAR=/path/to/api-82.jar
export BUILD_DIR="$HOME/.cache/appclone/build"
python3 build.py --self-check
python3 build.py --lint
python3 build.py

Unsigned APK: $BUILD_DIR/AppClone-unsigned.apk.
See the localization guide for translation checks and contributions.

GPL-3.0-only.
Not affiliated with Google, Android or LSPosed.
modules.changelog:
App Clone 2.4.0
- Bundles English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Hindi, Bengali,
  Russian, Japanese and Turkish. Choose Settings → App language to switch.
  Translations are AI-authored; fluent-speaker review is still welcome.
- Native Android plurals, language fallback and right-to-left layout support.
- Redesigned Material 3 lists show every profile directly beneath its app,
  with Open and a per-instance ⋮ menu instead of Manage.
- Swipeable Apps / Profiles tabs keep independent search and scroll positions,
  including after rotation. Long lists recycle rows; search/status scroll with content.
- Rename profile saves the exact name without changing IDs, app data or running
  state. It affects all apps sharing that profile; existing shortcut labels stay unchanged.
- Root-shell startup retries the canonical Android su path only when PATH lookup
  cannot find the executable; started/denied/timed-out operations are never replayed.
  Diagnostics now include app UID/PATH and a root identity check.
- Raises AOSP clone-profile limits so many clone users can run at once.
- App-first Apps / Profiles navigation: only cloned apps, with counts
  and profile locations; disabled apps and stopped profiles stay visible.
- Navigation reuses inventory instead of rescanning. Refresh picks up external
  changes, keeps visible rows/scroll and combines repeated requests; errors offer Retry.
- Material You / Material 3 Expressive 1.14.0, dynamic colours and dark mode.
- Explicit existing/new profile choices when adding clones; no automatic allocation.
- Per-clone Disable/Enable, manifest default, Force stop, shortcuts and removal.
  Disabling pauses that app's notifications; removal deletes its profile-local data.
- Background activity previews a clone package's Android background mode:
  Keep current, Restrict, or Restore previous. Restrictions can delay notifications/jobs;
  they do not stop profiles or disable apps. Prior modes are saved before mutation.
- Open/shortcuts combine fresh identity/package/readiness checks and launch in one
  bounded root process; already-unlocked profiles skip startup/authentication.
- System apps are hidden initially; the visible menu filter can include them.
- Starts or stops individual profiles without deleting their app data.
- Home-screen shortcuts and Open start stopped profiles and request Android's
  cached shared-credential unlock before launching. If authentication is needed,
  the error explains how to unlock with the main user's PIN/pattern/password.
- Choose System default, Start all profiles, or Stop all profiles
  once after reboot and main-user unlock; stopping pauses notifications.
- Pin shortcuts from the selected instance; new shortcuts bind the profile serial.
- Export diagnostics includes the failed creation command, users and filtered logcat.
- Labels shortcuts such as 12: Chrome.
- Keeps app data separate per clone user.

modules.readme:
Autoqqpet

QQ 宠物，交给它照看。
学习、打工、冒险、喂食洗澡，按你的意思安排，在你自己的手机 QQ 里自己跑。

  下载最新版
   · 
  源码
   · 
  更新日志
   · 
  源码许可
   · 
  用户许可协议
   · 
  开发文档
先读这几句
1. 完全免费。 没有内购、会员、广告，也不收集任何数据。向你收费、卖“激活码”“内部版”的，都是别人二次打包的。
2. 风险自负。 它调用手机 QQ 自己的宠物接口，属于非官方自动化。平台可能限制功能或封号，通常无法申诉。请只在你自己的账号与设备上使用。
3. 与腾讯无关。 本项目不是官方产品，也没有获得任何授权或背书。
4. 不再积极维护。 源码按现状提供，作者基本不再改动代码；Issue 不保证回复，PR 不保证合并。

源码公开说明

源码仓库：Juwan-Hwang/Autoqqpet（下文提到的文档、工具和构建文件都在那里）。

源码按 PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 公开：个人自用、学习、研究都可以，也可以 fork、修改、再分发，不要求公开你改过的代码；但不能用于任何盈利用途，比如售卖、捆绑进付费产品或代挂代练。再分发时附上 LICENSE.md 即可。

QQ 更新后想自己适配，命令表、抓包工具和流程都在仓库里，也可以把抓到的结果连同相关源码交给 AI 助手帮你改。命令含义是逆向整理的，不保证准确；会改账号状态或花金币的写命令，建议先抓官方客户端的包确认再用。

入口：
- 文档索引：docs/README.md
- 模块在用的命令表：docs/commands-in-use.md；全量逆向总表：docs/pet-commands.md；已知命令号清单：tools/pet_recon/known_cmds.txt
- 抓新命令的工具与流程：tools/pet_recon/、docs/capture-guide.md

自己构建： ./gradlew assembleDebug（带抓包/调试命令）或 ./gradlew assembleRelease。仓库不带任何签名材料：
在仓库根放你自己的 keystore.properties（storeFile / storePassword / keyAlias / keyPassword）即用你自己的 key 签名，没有时自动用默认 debug 签名。
请用你自己的 key，你的包与官方发布包签名不同——从官方版换成自己构建的版本（或反过来）需要先卸载再安装（卸载会清掉模块自己保存的设置与进度）。
fork 后请改包名：把 app/build.gradle 里的 applicationId "com.juwanh.autoqqpet" 改成你自己的（如 io.github..autoqqpet），这样能和官方包共存，用户也不会把你的版本当成官方版。namespace（代码包名）不用动，java_init.list 里的入口类名跟它走；改完记得在框架里重新勾选作用域。
源码公开版停用了开屏前的协议确认页（原代码以注释保留），也不包含官方发布包里的加固组件。

为什么用它
- 不需要电脑、模拟器或第二台手机。 它是一个 LSPosed 模块，就跑在你手机里的 QQ 中。
- 装好就不用管。 照顾、学习、打工、冒险一条龙；QQ 被系统杀掉也能静默接回。
- 从不打扰你。 不会把 QQ 弹到你面前，没有悬浮窗；真需要你动手时，只发一条通知。
- 只在本机。 没有网络权限，不上传任何东西。

它能做什么

| | |
| --- | --- |
| 照顾 | 体力、清洁低了就喂食、洗澡；饼干和香皂用完自动补货（花游戏金币）。 |
| 最优调度（默认） | 把今天剩下的账按实时目录算一遍全天最优安排：疲劳按官方三档分段折算、补给按单价计入、冒险按期望值，只走第一步、每趟重算。目标三选一：金币优先 / 工分优先 / 属性优先；工分挡带净亏刹车，属性挡可设学习停课线。 |
| 学习 | 按你要练的属性（力量 / 智力 / 魅力）挑当下最划算的课，一节接一节，到期自动结算。 |
| 打工 | 自动选最划算的岗位与时长档；也可以指定只去某个职业。列表直接读自你的账号，只列出你解得开的职业。 |
| 冒险 | 学工都累了才去冒险；也可以选「只冒险」一直刷短冒险。冒险金币到顶当天自动停派（排班不受影响）。 |
| 五种干活方式 | 最优调度（新装默认）· 学习优先 · 打工优先 · 只冒险 · 排班。学习优先 / 打工优先是旧逻辑，学工疲惫后转冒险。 |
| 排班 | 自己定顺序：每一步“做什么、做哪一条、做几次或做多久”，做完进下一步；可设例外规则，比如“体力低于 30 时，先照顾”。 |
| 学累了自动收手 | 不靠猜：读服务器发下来的结算明细，实收比预期少了，才判定这一档今天干累了，第二天自动重来。 |
| 算得清账 | 今天净赚多少金币、一整天的金币曲线、服务器实发了哪些奖励，主页一眼看完；每天零点归档成「昨天」报告。 |
| 雇好友一起干（默认关） | 250 金币只在第一次雇时扣，当天复用不再花钱；只在预期多赚够 250 的长单上新雇；开工前先问服务器对方能不能雇。 |
| 被雇走自动召回（默认开） | 确认被好友雇走（服务器通知里有“雇佣了”）后，进度到 71% 叫回来，拿满基础工资和 75% 分成；可改成“立刻召回”。 |
| 属性与经验 | 主页显示力量、智力、魅力、战力和今日经验；PK 按真实战力只挑弱一截的对手，胜负按服务器结算称号判断。 |
| 火花 | 你定每天踩谁、谁永远不踩；每天各踩一次不断线，快断了提醒你。可选回踩（默认关）。 |
| 每日白捡 | 签到领食物（默认开）、信箱一键领取（实验，默认开）、福袋（默认关，自己名下的也能领）。 |
| 照顾好友（默认关） | 好友饿了脏了，用你的饼干香皂帮一把；或用一键照顾。都有阈值和每日上限。 |
| 好友互动 | 任务间隙 PK（只挑比自己弱的，输一次永久拉黑）、访问、踩踩，带黑名单与白名单和每日上限。 |
| 实验功能 | 个别请求格式是按回包推断的功能，界面里标着「实验」。 |
| 保活 | 前台服务 + 看门狗 + 开机自启；QQ 被杀先静默唤起进程，不弹任何界面。 |
| 看得见 | 主页实时显示宠物在做什么、还剩多久、今天做了什么；通知栏随时可看。 |
| 不丢设置 | 设置与当日进度存放在模块自己的目录里，QQ 重装或清数据也不会带走。 |

运行要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| Android | 8.0 及以上 |
| 注入框架 | LSPosed 或 Vector（需要 Root 或相应的内核补丁） |
| 手机 QQ | 9.3.75（当前真机验证版本）。9.3.70 / 9.3.65 的入口发现与调用路径未变，但 9.3.65 未回归实测 |
| 账号 | 已开通 QQ 宠物并保持登录 |

安装

0. 先校验（建议）。 下载后核对 SHA-256 与发布页写明的值一致；不一致就不要装。文件名形如 autoqqpet-v.apk，

certutil -hashfile autoqqpet-v.apk SHA256   # Windows
shasum -a 256 autoqqpet-v.apk                # macOS / Linux

1. 从 模块仓库 Releases 下载最新 APK 并安装（LSPosed / Vector 商店里点“下载”也是这里）。升级直接覆盖安装，设置与当日进度都在。
2. 打开 LSPosed / Vector，启用 Autoqqpet，作用域勾选 QQ。
3. 彻底关掉 QQ 再打开（模块只在 QQ 启动时加载）。
4. 打开 Autoqqpet，读完首启说明与许可协议，允许通知。
5. 省电设置很关键：系统设置 → 电池 → QQ → 不受限制 / 允许后台活动；并在最近任务里锁定 QQ。App 里的「运行诊断」会帮你逐项核对。
6. 回到主页，选好干活方式与要练的属性，打开 托管。

不需要“悬浮窗 / 显示在其他应用上层”权限。

第一次打开

只出现一次（协议文本更新后会请你重新确认；用本仓库源码自己构建的版本没有这一步）：

1. 开始之前：免费、风险自负、与腾讯无关 —— 三件事说清楚再往下。
2. 许可协议：读到最后才能勾选“我已阅读并同意”，勾选后才能继续。不同意就退出，什么也不会保存。

界面一览

主页「此刻」 —— 打开就知道它在干什么。
- 舞台：团子、进度环与倒计时。颜色告诉你它在做什么：靛色学习、琥珀打工、青色冒险、玫红照顾。
- 心跳行：最近一次心跳、下次醒来的时间；点「诊断」直达体检。
- 此刻叙事：服务器说宠物正在做什么，就原样写在倒计时下面。
- 提醒：模块没启用、该召回了、照顾被拒、学费不够、信箱可领、QQ 失联时才出现，并告诉你下一步怎么做。
- 托管开关，以及 怎么干活（最优调度 / 学习优先 / 打工优先 / 只冒险 / 排班）和 练什么（力量 / 智力 / 魅力）。
- 属性与经验：力量、智力、魅力、战力，今日经验进度与各项每日任务。
- 今日收益：金币净变化（滚动数字）、会自己画出来的金币曲线、服务器实发的奖励。
- 今天：学习、打工、冒险各几次，学工与冒险的时长构成。
- 时间线：今天做过的每一件事。
- 昨天：一句话总结加四格数字，PK、雇佣、帮好友、福袋另起一行。

设置 —— 每一项都写清楚开或关会发生什么。
- 干活：干活方式（五挡）、去哪打工、刷新打工目录、排班、学习停课线、每天最多冒险几次、任务间隔、学习/打工鼓励次数、实时叙事、读结算明细、用实收校准收益。
- 金币与雇佣：金币底线、开工时雇好友与每日上限、被雇走自动召回与召回时机。花金币的开关打开前都会先说清楚。
- 照顾与补给：体力和清洁低于多少就照顾、用完自动补货。
- 每日白捡：签到领食物、信箱一键领取与提醒、福袋。
- 好友：火花（每天踩谁/不踩谁、回踩、快断提醒）、任务间隙 PK 与上限和对手强弱比例、替好友喂食洗澡（可选喂完告诉对方）、一键照顾、黑名单、白名单、刷新好友列表。
- 提醒与报告：被雇佣时提醒、检查是否被雇佣、每日报告。
- 外观：跟随系统 / 浅色 / 深色；Android 12+ 可跟随壁纸取色；减少动效。

排班 —— 按住把手拖动排序；轻点一步就能改；规则读起来是一句话。只有最后一步可以“一直循环”。

运行诊断 —— 模块、QQ、心跳、唤醒计划、通知、电池优化逐项体检；无法自动判断的项（如 QQ 的后台限制）可点按钮手动确认。一键采集运行快照、复制全文，或带着快照去 GitHub 反馈。

常见问题

通知栏提示“可能已停止”怎么办？
只在心跳断了（QQ 被杀或被冻结）或循环没排上下一次唤醒时出现，它会自己尝试接回。反复出现多半是省电策略冻结了 QQ：按「安装」第 5 步设置，并确认作用域勾了 QQ。

会不会突然把 QQ 弹到我面前？会不会有悬浮窗？
都不会。后台恢复只静默唤起进程，你手里的应用始终在前台。极少数情况下系统连静默唤起都不允许，这时它只发一条通知，点不点由你 —— 不打扰优先于自动。

怎么确认它真的在干活？
看主页的舞台与时间线，或通知栏。也可以连上 adb 看日志：adb logcat | grep Autoqqpet（Windows 用 findstr）。

中途想换属性或干活方式？
直接在主页点，下一轮立即生效，不用重启 QQ。

升级会丢进度吗？
不会。覆盖安装即可。

怎么彻底停用？
先在主页关掉托管，再到框架里关闭模块（或直接卸载）。

已知限制
- 对 QQ 版本敏感。 宠物模块内部类名会随版本变化；本模块按方法签名自动寻找入口，不写死类名。若某次更新改得更彻底，通知栏与主页会直接提示“没有心跳”，而不是默默不干活。建议关掉手机 QQ 的自动更新。
- QQ 升级后可能要你动一下手。 真机遇到过框架对新安装的 QQ 不再注入：在框架里把本模块禁用再启用（或重新勾选作用域），再彻底重启 QQ 即可。
- 被雇佣是“拉”出来的。 服务器不推送被雇佣消息，模块每 10 分钟看一次通知，所以发现可能晚几分钟（不影响 71% 召回）。

隐私
- 没有网络权限：不联网、不采集、不上传；没有统计、广告 SDK、崩溃上报或自动更新检查。
- 它在你自己的 QQ 进程里调用 QQ 的宠物接口，因此会产生由 QQ 发出、发往腾讯服务器的宠物请求 —— 这就是它工作的方式，除此之外没有任何网络行为。
- 不读取聊天内容。设置、当日进度与日志只保存在本机。
- 「反馈」不会替你上传任何东西：它只把打过码的运行快照填进你自己浏览器里的新建 issue 页面，完整日志复制到剪贴板，粘不粘由你决定。QQ 号、宠物 ID、好友昵称会自动打码。
- “查询已安装应用”权限只用于确认 QQ 存在并把它拉起。
- 不申请“显示在其他应用上层”。

许可

- 官方发布的安装包：另适用应用内的 《用户许可协议》：免费自用；不得售卖、捆绑或冒充官方；只在自己的账号上使用；适用中华人民共和国法律。

「QQ」「QQ 宠物」及相关标识归腾讯所有。本项目与腾讯没有任何关联。
