modules.description: 透明截图/Transparent Screenshot
modules.readme:
中文 |
  English

🖼️ 透明截图 (Transparent Screenshot)

*基于 LSPosed 框架的 Xposed 模块，为应用提供全面的截图、录屏及屏幕投射防护。*

✨ 核心功能

🛡️ 应用层功能

| 功能 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 启用默认窗口隐藏方案 | 通过 setSkipScreenshot 标志阻止系统截图和录屏。 |
| 强制允许截屏 | 移除应用自身的 FLAG_SECURE 与 skipScreenshot 保护，使其窗口始终可被截取（与隐藏功能方向相反，用于解除应用自带的截屏限制）。 |
| 去除阴影遮罩 | 移除窗口的阴影效果。 |
| 窗口不接收触摸与焦点 | 设置 FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL，窗口无法接收任何触摸和焦点事件。(⚠️ 注意：窗口将无法点击。) |
| 绕过焦点检查 | 仅设置 FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE，保留触摸能力，但输入法（键盘）不会弹出。(⚠️ 注意：键盘输入将无法弹出。) |
| 隐藏最近任务界面 | 从最近任务列表中移除应用卡片。 |
| 修改窗口标题为 | 将窗口标题伪装为系统录屏组件，支持全局品牌选择或自定义标题。 |
| 允许截屏至壁纸层 | 窗口完全透明时显示壁纸而非黑色（仅部分应用生效）。 |

🔧 系统层隐藏

系统层隐藏通过注入系统框架，在系统服务层级直接拦截窗口的渲染，可同时隐藏窗口及其所属 Task 的阴影/边框。此功能需要在设置中手动开启，并在主界面点击 系统框架 进行配置。
⚠️ 开启后可能略有卡顿，请按需使用。

🧩 模块管理（2.1.2 新增）
- 动态作用域：可直接在模块内添加 / 移除作用域，动态向框架申请，无需再打开 LSPosed 管理器逐个勾选。
- 启用 Hook 开关：每个应用的配置页都有总开关，关闭后该应用立即停止 Hook，无需移除作用域即可临时停用。
- 热重载：基于 libxposed 102，全面适配热重载，在模块里更改功能配置后立即生效，无需重启目标应用。
- 全新界面：界面风格升级为 Material 3，并适配动态取色。

📖 使用方法

1. 确保设备已 Root 并安装了 LSPosed 框架。
2. 安装本模块。
3. 打开 LSPosed 管理器，启用本模块。
4. 在模块界面中 勾选需要生效的目标应用（作用域），也可以直接在模块内通过添加按钮动态申请作用域。
5. 点击目标应用进入配置页，开启所需功能。
6. 配置更改后通过热重载 立即生效，无需强制停止或重启目标应用。

🌐 全局标题设置

在模块主界面右上角菜单 → 设置，可以选择默认的窗口标题品牌。应用配置中选择 “全局” 模式时，将自动跟随此设置。

🔌 系统层隐藏设置

1. 进入 设置 → 开启 系统层隐藏 开关。
2. 系统将请求添加 system 到模块作用域。
3. 返回主界面，点击 系统框架 条目。
4. 在系统层隐藏界面中，选择需要隐藏的应用（支持搜索）。
5. 已开启隐藏的应用会自动排在列表最上方。
6. 右上角菜单可切换显示/隐藏系统应用。

🔬 技术说明

SkipScreenshot 原理

SkipScreenshot 是系统窗口与渲染流程中的标识，用于指示某个窗口或界面在进行截图、录屏或屏幕投射时应被 跳过，不参与最终画面的合成。

当该标识生效时：
- 应用界面在设备本地仍然可见、可交互。
- 系统截图、录屏或投射结果中 不会包含 该界面内容。

SystemUI 增强 - Oplus 小窗菜单隐藏

在 设置 中开启 SystemUI 菜单隐藏（Oplus 增强） 后，模块会 Hook SystemUI 进程中的 FlexibleMenuManager，在 OPPO/一加设备的自由窗口（小窗）弹出菜单时，自动对该菜单的 Surface 施加 setSkipScreenshot，使其不显示在截图/录屏中。

此功能仅适用于 OPPO/一加 ColorOS 15/16 设备。

修改窗口标题原理

当窗口标题为特定字符串时，系统在截屏和录屏中会跳过合成该窗口，从而达到隐藏效果。

系统层隐藏原理

系统层隐藏直接作用于系统服务 (system_server) 的窗口管理机制，在目标窗口的 Surface 创建时就为其设置 setSkipScreenshot 标志，并将该标志同步应用到窗口所属的 Task 容器，从而同时隐藏窗口内容和阴影边框。

⚠️ 注意事项
本模块涉及对系统窗口管理机制的深度干预。使用前请确保您了解相关风险，并具备基本的窗口系统知识。因不当配置导致的系统界面异常、功能失效或其他不可预期的问题，由用户自行承担。

🔒 权限说明

本模块需要以下权限：
- QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES – 用于获取已安装应用列表。
- Xposed 框架权限 – 用于 Hook 目标应用窗口。

📄 免责声明

本工具仅供 安全研究 和 个人学习 使用。
请勿用于侵犯他人隐私或版权的用途。
使用本模块产生的任何后果由用户自行承担。

🙏 致谢

本模块的核心功能实现受到了以下优秀项目的启发：

| 项目 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| SpoofTitle | 窗口标题伪装逻辑 |
| -HideScreen- | 防截屏问题修复 |

Transparent Screenshot © 2025 · Made with ❤️

🖼️ Transparent Screenshot

*A LSPosed module that provides comprehensive screenshot, screen recording and screen casting protection for apps.*

✨ Core Features

🛡️ App-Level Features

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Enable default window hiding | Prevents system screenshots and recordings via the setSkipScreenshot flag. |
| Force allow screenshots | Removes the app's own FLAG_SECURE and skipScreenshot protection so its windows are always capturable (the opposite of hiding; useful for lifting an app's built-in screenshot restrictions). |
| Remove shadow mask | Removes window shadow effects. |
| Block touch and focus | Sets FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE \| FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL – window becomes unclickable. (⚠️ Note: the window will not respond to any touch or focus events.) |
| Bypass focus check | Sets only FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE – touch events remain intact, but the input method (keyboard) will not pop up. (⚠️ Note: keyboard input will not appear.) |
| Hide recent tasks | Removes the app card from the recent tasks list. |
| Modify window title to | Disguises the window title as a system recorder component; supports global brand selection or custom title. |
| Allow screenshot to wallpaper layer | Shows wallpaper instead of black when the window is fully transparent (works with some apps only). |

🔧 System-Level Hiding

System‑level hiding injects into the system framework to intercept window rendering at the system service level. It can hide both the window itself and the shadows/borders of its parent Task. This feature must be manually enabled in Settings, and configured by tapping System Framework on the main screen.
⚠️ May cause slight lag; enable only when necessary.

🧩 Module Management (new in 2.1.2)
- Dynamic scope: Add or remove scope entries right inside the module; scope is requested from the framework dynamically, no need to tick apps in the LSPosed manager one by one.
- Enable Hook switch: Each app's config page has a master switch; turning it off stops hooking for that app immediately, without removing it from scope.
- Hot reload: Fully adapted to libxposed 102 hot reload; feature changes take effect immediately, with no need to restart the target app.
- Refreshed UI: The interface has been upgraded to Material 3 with dynamic color support.

📖 Usage

1. Ensure your device is rooted and has LSPosed framework installed.
2. Install this module.
3. Open LSPosed manager, enable the module.
4. Select the target apps (scope) that you want the module to affect; you can also request scope dynamically from within the module via the add button.
5. Tap a target app to open its configuration page, and enable the desired features.
6. Configuration changes take effect immediately via hot reload; no need to force stop or restart the target app.

🌐 Global Title Setting

In the top‑right menu of the main screen → Settings, you can choose a default window title brand. When an app’s title mode is set to "Global", it will automatically follow this setting.

🔌 System-Level Hiding Setup

1. Go to Settings → turn on System‑level hiding.
2. The system will request to add system to the module scope.
3. Return to the main screen and tap the System Framework entry.
4. In the system‑hide screen, select the apps you wish to hide (search supported).
5. Enabled apps are automatically sorted to the top of the list.
6. Use the top‑right menu to toggle showing/hiding system apps.

modules.name: am-glass
modules.author: dmitthedazed
modules.description: LSPosed/Xposed module: iOS 26-style liquid glass for Apple Music on Android (Kyant0 backdrop library)
modules.readme:
AM Liquid Glass

iOS 26 liquid glass for Apple Music on Android. An LSPosed / Xposed module.

Resting

Pressed: the dock grows and the selection turns into a lens

What changes
- Tab bar. A floating glass capsule with blur and edge refraction. Press and drag a tab and the selection turns into a lens.
- Mini player. The same glass. Text and buttons switch between black and white depending on what's under them.
- Header buttons and the ⋯ menu. Glass instead of the stock blur.
- Material You. Your wallpaper accent instead of Apple Music's blue, and the system font instead of SF Pro.
- Settings. Material 3 segmented lists, headers, switches, radio buttons and sliders.
- Transitions. Shared-axis slide when you open and close pages inside a tab.

Install

1. Download am-glass-*.apk from Releases and install it.
2. In LSPosed, enable AM Liquid Glass with the scope set to Apple Music.
3. Force-stop Apple Music and open it again.

The APK is signed with a debug key, so you may need to uninstall the old one before updating.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Apple Music | 7.0.0-beta (versionCode 1611) only |
| Android | 13+ |
| Framework | LSPosed, Vector or another Xposed API 82 framework |
| Root | Magisk, KernelSU or APatch |

Apple Music is obfuscated, and the module looks for classes from this exact build. Other versions most likely won't get the glass. Tested on one phone (Realme, Android 16), so treat it as experimental.

How it works
- Apple Music draws its floating bars with Dimezis BlurView: a BlurTarget records the page into a RenderNode, and each BlurView blurs it. The module swaps the blur for a no-op and puts its own ComposeView inside, sampling the same RenderNode as a backdrop.
- The stock BottomNavigationView stays invisible and still provides the tabs, selection and clicks. Touches are forwarded to the glass dock.
- The module brings its own Compose runtime with a private lifecycle, because Apple Music's AndroidX is a separate obfuscated copy. Module resources use package id 0x6e, so they never collide with the app's 0x7f.
- The ⋯ menu is blurred by Haze inside the app's own Compose. The module hooks Haze's effect node and draws glass with platform RenderEffects and the library's lens shader.

Source: app/src/main/java/dev/dimka/amglass.

Build

Needs JDK 21.

./gradlew :app:assembleRelease

The APK lands in app/build/outputs/apk/release/.

Credits

Glass by Kyant0/AndroidLiquidGlass: the backdrop library, plus the LiquidBottomTabs demo and its helpers, copied into catalog/ under Apache-2.0.

Not affiliated with Apple. Apple Music is a trademark of Apple Inc.

License

Apache-2.0

modules.name: ARTEX 渗透测试平台
modules.author: ARTEX
modules.description: 在 Android 设备上以 root 权限容器化（Debian 12 + PostgreSQL 15）运行 ARTEX，开机自启，浏览器访问 http://设备IP:8787
modules.readme:
ARTEX Magisk 模块

把 ARTEX 装进 Android 的 Magisk 模块。刷完重启，浏览器打开 http://手机IP:8787 就能用。

ARTEX 是套 AI 自主渗透测试系统（Go 后端 + Next.js 前端），原本要求 Docker 加 PostgreSQL。
Android 上这两样都不好使：bionic 拒绝执行 glibc 程序，系统里也没有 PostgreSQL。
所以这里的办法是往手机里塞一个 Debian 12 arm64 的 rootfs，用 chroot 跑起来，
容器里装 PostgreSQL 15 和 artex 本体，只把 8787 端口露给宿主。

在 Android 14 + Magisk alpha 上实测可用。arm64，Android 10 以上应该都行，KernelSU / APatch 没试过。

装

1. 到 Releases 下 artex-magisk-v3.zip（144 MB）
2. Magisk → 模块 → 从本地安装 → 选这个 zip，重启
3. 打开 http://:8787，第一次进去会让你设密码

首次开机会跑 initdb 建库，等 20–60 秒，期间打不开是正常的。
进度看日志：

su -c 'tail -f /data/adb/artex/service.log'

不想重启也可以走命令行（手动把 update 目录挪过去）：

su -c 'magisk --install-module /sdcard/Download/artex-magisk-v3.zip'
su -c 'cp -a /data/adb/modules_update/artex/. /data/adb/modules/artex/ && rm -rf /data/adb/modules_update/artex && sh /data/adb/modules/artex/service.sh'

用

端口和两个开关都在 /data/adb/artex/ports.conf，改完重启手机或在模块卡片上点「运行」：

WEB_PORT=8787              # 网页端口
PROXY_ADDR=127.0.0.1:8788  # 流量录制代理，只监听本机；留空就关掉
KEEP_AWAKE=1               # 开着不睡，保证随时能连；嫌费电改 0

几个常用命令：

su -c 'tail -f /data/artex/app/logs/artex.log'      # 应用日志
su -c 'tail -f /data/artex/app/logs/postgresql.log' # 数据库日志
su -c 'chroot /data/artex/rootfs /bin/bash'         # 进容器
su -c '/data/adb/modules/artex/service.sh'          # 重启服务
su -c 'curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/health'    # 健康检查

东西都在这几个位置：

| 路径 | 是什么 |
| :--- | :--- |
| /data/adb/modules/artex/ | 模块本体（脚本、tools.sh） |
| /data/adb/artex/ | ports.conf、service.log、apt-packages.list |
| /data/artex/rootfs/ | Debian 容器，约 648 MB |
| /data/artex/app/ | artex 二进制、skills/、jwt.key、data/、persist/ |
| /data/artex/pgdata/ | PostgreSQL 数据目录 |

加工具

容器里已经带了 Python 3.11（含 pip、venv）、Node 24、git、curl、wget、jq、dig、nc、
ripgrep、sqlite3、nmap、vim-tiny。ARTEX 的 Bash 工具和 Python 脚本工具都在这个容器里跑，
PATH 里已经包含 /usr/local/venv/bin、/usr/local/bin、/opt/node/bin。

再装东西用 tools.sh：

T=/data/adb/modules/artex/tools.sh

sh $T list                        # 看看有啥
sh $T pip install requests httpx  # Python 包
sh $T npm install playwright      # Node 全局包
sh $T install masscan seclists    # apt 包
sh $T run "python3 -c 'import requests; print(requests.version)'"
sh $T shell

持久化这块容易踩：pip 和 npm 装到 /data/artex/app/persist/usr-local（容器里的
/usr/local 和 /opt/tools 都 bind 到这里），重刷模块不会丢；
apt 包装在 rootfs 里，重刷会被冲掉，但包名记在 /data/adb/artex/apt-packages.list，
刷入时自动重装（要联网）。数据库和任务数据一直在 /data/artex，不受影响。

想用 Playwright 抓浏览器：sh $T npm install playwright && sh $T run "playwright install chromium"，
浏览器约 150 MB，按需再装。

实现

Magisk service.sh
└── chroot /data/artex/rootfs          Debian 12 arm64
    ├── /opt/artex        ← /data/artex/app
    ├── /usr/local        ← /data/artex/app/persist/usr-local
    ├── /opt/tools        ← /data/artex/app/persist/tools
    ├── /var/lib/postgresql/data ← /data/artex/pgdata
    ├── PostgreSQL 15     只走 /run/postgresql 的 unix socket，不开 TCP
    └── /opt/artex/artex  Go 单二进制，前端已内嵌

守护进程每 30 秒查一次 PostgreSQL 和 artex 在不在，掉了就拉起来。

有个坑值得单独说一句：Android 的 GKI 内核基本都关了 CONFIG_SYSVIPC，shmget 直接返回
ENOSYS，PostgreSQL 连 initdb 都过不去：

FATAL:  could not create shared memory segment: Function not implemented
DETAIL:  Failed system call was shmget(key=4452628, size=56, 03600)

shared_memory_type = mmap 能绕开主共享内存，但 initdb 的 bootstrap 和
PGSharedMemoryCreate() 内部还会直接调 SysV，这两处没有配置项能管。
所以模块里带了个 30 行的 libsysv-shim.so（源码在 files/app/shim/shimsysv.c），
把这几个调用映射到 MAP_SHARED|MAP_ANONYMOUS，靠 LD_PRELOAD 只注入 PostgreSQL。

已知问题
- DNS 不走 VPN。容器里的 /etc/resolv.conf 写死 223.5.5.5 / 119.29.29.29，
  ARTEX 的 Go 解析器读的就是它，所以走 VPN 或内网 DNS 时，域名解析结果可能和手机浏览器不一样。
  改法：su -c 'printf "nameserver 1.1.1.1\n" > /data/artex/rootfs/etc/resolv.conf' 后重启。
- 手动 pg_ctl start 会失败，因为没带 LD_PRELOAD。日常别手起，用 service.sh 或 tools.sh。
- 内存紧的机器会被系统杀。守护 30 秒内会拉回来，但如果一直不够内存就会反复重启；
  可以调小 /data/artex/pgdata/postgresql.conf 里的 shared_buffers。
- MIUI / HyperOS 这类系统喜欢杀后台，KEEP_AWAKE 只防休眠，不防厂商清理，得去电池设置里放行。
- 升级方式：直接再刷新 zip。rootfs 会重新解压，数据目录和持久层不动。
  卸载想留数据就先 su -c 'mkdir -p /data/adb/artex && touch /data/adb/artex/.keep_on_uninstall'。
- 只支持 arm64。x86 模拟器、32 位设备用不了。

从源码构建

构建得在 Debian 容器里做（Next 的 SWC 只有 linux/arm64 版，Go 交叉编译没问题）：

前端静态导出
cd web && npm ci && NEXT_EXPORT=1 npx next build
cd .. && rm -rf server/webui/dist && mkdir -p server/webui/dist && cp -a web/out/. server/webui/dist/

后端（前端内嵌，纯静态）
CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -tags embedui -trimpath \
  -ldflags "-s -w -buildid= -X main.version=v0.3.15" -o artex ./cmd/artex

ARTEX 源码在上游仓库被作者删除后，我把对应源码放进
source-v0.3.15 分支（标签 v0.3.15-source），
里面 SOURCE.md 写了完整环境和命令。ARTEX 本体是 AGPL-3.0。

modules.name: Audio Safe Volume Disabler
modules.author: Lycidias93
modules.description: Disables/delays Android safe-volume / Sound Dose warnings after boot. Pixel Android 16/17 tested. v1.2.9 install-text hotfix; runtime unchanged.
modules.readme:
Release updates: @lycidias93

Audio Safe Volume Disabler

What it is and why it exists

Audio Safe Volume Disabler / ASVD is a Magisk module that disables or delays Android safe-volume / Sound Dose warning behavior after boot.

It started from a manual Android settings workaround and turns it into a bounded boot-time module: wait for boot, apply the target state, verify it, optionally reapply once if Android rewrites values, then exit.

ASVD is intentionally small and conservative:
- no resident daemon
- no polling loop by default
- no wakelock
- no network access
- no Play Services manipulation
- no Bluetooth config patching

The internal Magisk module ID intentionally remains audio-safe-volume-battery-aware for update compatibility.

Current status

| Area | Status |
|---|---|
| Current stable release | v1.2.9 |
| Version / versionCode | v1.2.9 / 129 |
| Runtime model | Magisk late_start service |
| Boot behavior | one-shot apply + bounded delayed reapply |
| Battery behavior | no default loop, no wakelock, no network |
| Verified phone | Pixel 10 Pro XL / Android 16/17 / SDK 36/37 |
| Verified baseline | boot verify PASS |
| Verified Bluetooth scenario | H222 / Skoda BT2MP3 receiver after active guard |
| Optional companion | ASVD BT Type Helper v0.6.1 / 61 |
| Companion shared state | /data/adb/asvd/bt-helper.env |
| Online updates | Enabled via Magisk updateJson |
| Other phones / OEM ROMs | Unknown, tester feedback needed |

Download

All releases:

Latest release:

Download the Magisk ZIP from the newest stable release:

ASVD-vX.X.X.zip

Do not install this as a normal APK. Flash the ZIP in Magisk.

Install

1. Flash the ZIP in Magisk.
2. Reboot.
3. Run full verify:

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/verify.sh

Expected final line:

RESULT: AUDIO_SAFE_VOLUME_VERIFY_PASS

Safety warning

This module can disable or delay loud-volume / Sound Dose warnings. That can increase risk of hearing damage. Use conservative playback levels and do not treat this as a safety feature.

Target values

audio_safe_csd_next_warning = 999999.0
safe_media_volume_enabled   = 0
audio_safe_volume_state     = 1
audio_safe_csd_current_value = 0.0
audio_safe_csd_dose_records = null

What the boot service does

1. Waits for boot completion.
2. Waits for Android Settings Provider readiness.
3. Captures a before state snapshot.
4. Applies target values only when current values differ.
5. Captures after_primary state.
6. Performs one bounded delayed reapply.
7. Verifies the final state.
8. Performs one final delayed reapply only if drift is detected.
9. Writes structured logs and exits.

Manual helpers

Apply now

Use this after a transient warning or after values drift during active playback:

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/apply-now.sh

Active guard once

Use this for active Bluetooth sessions where Android repopulates CSD values during playback. It is bounded and exits after the configured passes. It is not a daemon.

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/active-guard-once.sh

Default: 12 passes, 15 seconds apart. Optional custom run:

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/active-guard-once.sh 12 15

H222 / car Bluetooth receiver note

On the tested Pixel, the H222 Skoda BT2MP3 receiver is shown as Headphones and the Android audio device type picker is greyed out. During active loud Bluetooth playback, Android can repopulate Sound Dose values even after the boot-time ASVD service has passed.

Observed behavior:
- transient high-volume warning can still briefly appear
- volume was not reduced
- CSD values can repopulate during active playback
- active-guard-once.sh restored the target state and final verify passed

ASVD itself does not modify Bluetooth device classification. The separate optional ASVD BT Type Helper can change Bluetooth metadata key 17 with explicit user action and can report sanitized companion state back to ASVD.

Rejected experimental helper path

Do not use Google Play Services manipulation as a public/helper path for changing Bluetooth audio device type.

Private testing on Pixel Android 16 showed:
- H222 UI-unlock soft mode failed
- H222 UI-unlock hard mode failed
- H222 offline-ui + Bluetooth reload failed
- GMS-disable/offline-ui testing caused Google Play Billing account-context side effects
- Wavelet Pro license check used the wrong Google account
- Play Store data reset alone did not fix that account-context issue
- removing all non-primary Google accounts restored Wavelet Pro in that test

Decision:
- no GMS-disable/offline-ui helper is shipped in public ASVD
- no Play Services manipulation as a default or helper path
- no direct /data/misc/bluedroid/bt_config.conf patching
- no boot automation for Bluetooth type changes

Future BT Device Type Helper research, if any, must use a Bluetooth metadata/API path only and remain optional/manual.

Install

Install the ZIP in Magisk:

Magisk → Modules → Install from storage → ASVD-v1.2.7.zip → Reboot

Verify after reboot

Recommended full verify:

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/verify.sh

Recommended XDA/GitHub report:

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/verify.sh --xda

Expected final line:

RESULT: AUDIO_SAFE_VOLUME_VERIFY_PASS

Advanced/debug modes still exist but are not the primary support path: --compact, --xda-short, --json.

Compatibility probe

For non-Pixel or unverified devices, run the read-only compatibility probe. It does not change Android settings.

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/verify.sh --compat

Copy-ready XDA/GitHub compatibility report:

tsu /system/bin/sh /data/adb/modules/audio-safe-volume-battery-aware/verify.sh --compat-xda

The probe checks Android/OEM identity, root-stack hints, Settings Provider access and safe-volume / Sound Dose related settings keys.

Support bundle...

modules.name: AudioEffect-Broadcaster-Xposed
modules.author: EXPress-016
modules.description: Xposed module that broadcasts audio session events system-wide for audio effect applications
modules.readme:
AudioEffect-Broadcaster-Xposed
An Xposed module designed to broadcast audio session creation and destruction events system-wide. This allows applications like Wavelet and Viper4Android to detect audio streams from any app and apply their audio effects, even from apps that don't normally support it.

Requirements
- A compatible Xposed Framework installed (e.g. LSPosed).

Installation
1.  Download the latest release of the AudioEffect-Broadcaster-Xposed module from the releases page.
2.  Install the APK on your device.
3.  Open your Xposed manager app (e.g. LSPosed).
4.  Enable the AudioEffect-Broadcaster-Xposed module and ensure it is scoped to the apps you want to affect.

Problem
Many popular audio effect applications, such as Wavelet and Viper4Android, rely on Android's standard AudioEffect broadcasts (ACTION_OPEN_AUDIO_EFFECT_CONTROL_SESSION and ACTION_CLOSE_AUDIO_EFFECT_CONTROL_SESSION) to detect when an audio session starts or ends. However, not all applications send these broadcasts, which means that these audio effect apps won't detect the audio and therefore won't apply any effects.

Solution
AudioEffect-Broadcaster-Xposed forces applications to announce their audio sessions. It does this by hooking into the Android media framework with two-layer approach:

First, it targets ExoPlayer (androidx.media3 and com.google.android.exoplayer2), the most common media player library. By monitoring the setPlayWhenReady method, it can tell when audio starts and stops, and broadcasts the standard ACTION_OPEN_AUDIO_EFFECT_CONTROL_SESSION and ACTION_CLOSE_AUDIO_EFFECT_CONTROL_SESSION intents accordingly.

As a fallback for apps that don't use ExoPlayer, the module hooks the fundamental android.media.AudioTrack class. By watching for play and pause/stop/release/flush events, it ensures nearly all audio playback is detected and broadcasted correctly.

This makes previously unsupported apps visible to audio effect engines like Wavelet and Viper4Android.

modules.readme:
Background App Slayer (BAS)

Modul Magisk pembasmi aplikasi latar belakang otomatis.
Versi ini adalah pembaruan besar dari proyek SmartAppClose lama.

✨ Deskripsi Modul

Background App Slayer (BAS) membantu kamu mendapatkan performa maksimal dan menghemat baterai saat bermain game.
Dengan cara menutup aplikasi-aplikasi latar belakang secara otomatis saat game dijalankan.
Dirancang modular agar mudah disesuaikan hanya dengan edit file teks, tanpa perlu termux atau coding ulang.

⚙️ Fitur Unggulan
- Auto-kill aplikasi background saat game aktif.
- 3 Mode kerja:
- 1 Normal – ringan dan aman.
- 2 Aggressive – lebih banyak aplikasi ditutup.
- 3 Extreme – semua dibantai (termasuk app sistem yang ga penting) KECUALI list extreme.txt
- Konfigurasi lewat file teks:
- gamelist.txt – daftar game yang memicu aksi.
- whitelist.txt – aplikasi yang tidak akan ditutup.
- extreme.txt – daftar aplikasi yang akan dilindungi di Mode 3.
- mode.txt – menentukan mode kerja (1, 2, 3).
- Logging aktivitas di /data/adb/modules/appslayer/log/
- Ringan, fleksibel, tidak perlu reboot saat ganti konfigurasi.
- Action Button di Magisk/KSU Manager untuk cek status mode dan sistem.

🆚 Perbandingan dengan SmartAppClose

| Fitur | SmartAppClose | BAS v5.0.5 |
|-------|----------------|------------|
| Mode kerja | ❌ Tidak ada | ✅ Ada 3 mode |
| Modular | ❌ | ✅ |
| Logging | Minimal | Lengkap |
| Fleksibilitas | Rendah | Tinggi |
| User friendly | Cukup | ✅ Sangat |

🛠️ Cara Install

1. Install via Magisk Manager / KernelSU / KSU Next
- Buka Magisk > Modules > Install from storage
- Pilih ZIP dari modul BAS
- Reboot

2. Atur Konfigurasi:
- Buka folder /data/adb/modules/appslayer/
- Edit file:
- mode.txt → isi 1, 2, atau 3
- gamelist.txt → isi dengan nama package game
- whitelist.txt → aplikasi penting yang wajib hidup
- extreme.txt → aplikasi yang akan DILINDUNGI di mode 3

⚠️ Penting Tentang Mode Extreme

Mode 3 (Extreme) akan menutup semua aplikasi kecuali yang ada di extreme.txt.
JANGAN hapus isi default file tersebut — itu bisa membuat SISTEM ERROR dan FREEZE

Kalau ingin menambahkan aplikasi untuk dilindungi:
- Tambahkan di baris paling atas atau paling bawah file extreme.txt.

🚨 Peringatan
- Gunakan sesuai kebutuhan, terutama untuk Mode 3.
- Jangan aktifkan Mode Extreme terus-menerus, HP kamu bisa ngambek!
- Kalau ada bug, jangan lapor ke service center, apalagi lapor polisi. Lapornya ke sini saja:
  TELEGRAM

🤖 Untuk Users Android 11
Jika mengalami error saat install, pakai cara yang sama seperti project sebelumnya klik di sini
DO WITH YOUR OWN RISK
Kamu tanggung sendiri kalau terjadi sesuatu.

Selamat ngoprek dan semoga lancar gaming-nya!
_– @unknuw Projects Team_

modules.name: BioPay
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: BioPay
modules.readme:
BioPay

让支付应用轻松接入系统原生生物认证。

项目简介

BioPay 是一个面向 Android 10+、基于 LSPosed 的支付辅助模块。它支持注入微信、支付宝、淘宝、QQ 和云闪付的应用进程，识别到对应的支付窗口后，通过安卓标准的 BiometricPrompt 接口发起系统生物认证，并在验证成功后解密、自动无感输入预先保存的六位支付密码。

部分手机的面容认证硬件仅达到便利级安全标准，被 Android 系统底层限制用于应用级认证，因而暂无法调用。

模块入口

| 应用名称 | 在哪里打开 BioPay 设置 |
| --- | --- |
| 微信 | 聊天页右上角 "+" 菜单 → "生物支付" |
| QQ | 聊天页右上角 "+" 菜单 → "生物支付" |
| 支付宝 | 我的 → 设置 → 支付设置 → 生物支付 |
| 淘宝 | 我的 → 设置 → 生物支付 |
| 云闪付 | 我的 → 设置 → 生物支付 |

页面识别和设置入口依赖支付应用的内部布局，可能随应用更新而变化。

安装与设置

需要： Android 10+ 版本、支持 LibXposed API 102 的 LSPosed，以及设备上已录入指纹或面容。

1. 从 Releases或 模块仓库 下载并安装 APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用 BioPay，勾选需要使用的支付应用作用域。
3. 在手机设置里强制停止对应的应用，再重新打开。
4. 按上表进入相应应用的 BioPay 设置页。
5. 按需选择验证方式并设置支付密码，根据提示完成系统验证并保存。
6. 下次付款时，按系统提示验证即可。

日常使用
- 切换验证方式： 在对应应用的设置页调整指纹和面容开关，按提示验证后保存。已有密码时无需再次输入。
- 临时手动输入： 点击取消验证按钮，或使用系统的导航栏按钮/手势进行返回。
- 重新验证： 在支付键盘显示时按一次音量键可切换到生物认证页面。
- 关闭功能： 在设置页关闭指纹和面容开关后保存，或是直接取消该应用的作用域勾选。
- 清除密码： 长按设置页的清除按钮，按提示完成验证后清除。

支付流程

flowchart TD
    A[受支持的支付键盘出现] --> B[系统指纹或面容验证]
    B --> C{验证结果}
    C -->|通过| D[自动输入支付密码]
    C -->|取消或错误| E[恢复支付键盘]
    E --> F[手动输入密码]
    E -->|按音量键| B
    D --> G[由支付应用继续处理付款]
    F --> G

识别未通过时，可以继续尝试。BioPay 只协助输入密码，最终支付结果以支付应用提示为准。

隐私与安全
- BioPay 只声明一个 使用生物特征硬件 权限，不会申请其它网络、剪贴板等任何非必要权限。
- 模块也不主动收集、上传支付密码和生物信息，指纹和面容的识别都交由 Android 系统完成。
- 支付密码使用 AES-256-GCM 加密保存于本地，密钥由安卓 Keystore 统一管理，硬件保护能力取决于设备。
- 支付密码不会明文落盘，认证通过后才解密用于自动输入，使用后会立即清理明文缓冲区。

反馈与贡献

问题反馈（Issue）：
如果遇到 Bug 或有功能建议，欢迎提交 Issue。提交前请按以下步骤操作：
1. 从 Releases 下载 -Debug.zip 压缩包，解压后覆盖安装其中的 APK 并进行一遍问题复现，测试结束后覆盖安装正式版。
2. 在对应应用中打开「模块设置 → 异常诊断 → 导出」生成诊断日志，日志不会涉及任何个人敏感信息。
3. 进入 Issues 选择问题报告(Bug Report)，并附上诊断日志以及相关信息后进行提交。

代码贡献（PR）：
如果您已有不错的改进方案，也欢迎提交 Pull Request！无论是修复 Bug、优化现有逻辑，还是实现新功能。

致谢
- FingerprintPay
- LSPosed

开源协议与免责声明

Copyright (C) 2026 kiriashi。项目以 GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 或更新版本 开源，修改和再分发须遵守该协议。

请仅在自己有权使用和修改的设备、账号上使用，并遵守相关法律及平台规则。本项目不提供任何担保；使用产生的账号、数据或支付风险由使用者自行承担。

modules.name: BitPerfect Universal Audio Engine
modules.author: Kostyantyn Matviyevskyy aka kostyamat & Antigravity (c)2026
modules.description: QF/K706 (or MG clone) only: UIS7862 full module, UIS8581 reduced profile (factory 16-bit/44.1 kHz kept). On UIS7862 bit-to-bit audio: 24-bit/48 kHz path at 0 dB, volume and effects on the sound processor only. Shared microphone (several recorders at once), navigation ducking with your own navigators, call microphone per channel (level, echo cancelling, noise reduction depth, presets), USB DAC output at full scale with the DAC's own volume following the head unit's knob. Settings app: BitPerfect
modules.readme:
BitPerfect
Bit-perfect audio engine for QF / Roco K706 head units
a Magisk module + its settings app, BitPerfect Control

  ⬇️ Download ·
  📖 Guide ·
  📖 Посібник ·
  📝 Changelog ·
  💬 Support group

A Magisk module for QF / Roco K706 head units (and their MG clone) on Unisoc UIS7862 — and, with a
reduced profile, UIS8581. It takes the sound from any player at full quality, with no attenuation and no change to the
frequency response, and hands it to the head unit's sound processor at 24 bit / 48 kHz, 0 dB.
Volume and effects stay where they belong: in the sound processor.

At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| 🎚️ Bit-perfect path | one 24-bit / 48 kHz output at 0 dB into the sound processor (UIS7862); volume and effects on the chip |
| 🔌 USB DAC | switch at once, full scale from Android, level on the DAC's own control — optionally on the head unit's knob |
| 🎤 Call microphone | per channel (SIM, VoIP, Bluetooth): level, echo cancelling, noise reduction and its depth, presets |
| 🎙️ Shared microphone | several apps record at once — a dashcam next to wDSP Pro |
| 🧭 Navigation | prompts duck the music; add your own navigators |
| 📱 BitPerfect Control | what is really playing and where; every setting in one app; 25 languages |

⚖️ Legal status / Right to Repair: LEGAL.md (Ukrainian)

Supported hardware

The installer reads the MCU code and picks the profile by itself.

| unit | output path | status |
|---|---|---|
| UIS7862 + ROHM BU32107 | digital I2S, 24/48 | ✅ tested on the developer's unit |
| UIS7862 + ROHM BD37xxx | the SoC's own DAC (analogue), 24/48 by factory design | 🧪 needs reports |
| UIS8581 | factory 16 bit / 44.1 kHz kept | 🧪 reduced profile, untested — see below |
| any firmware other than QF or its MG clone (Topway, FYT and the rest), whatever the SoC | — | ❌ refused — the installer accepts QF/MG only |

🧪 UIS8581 — a reduced profile, never run on a unit. Its audio HAL, libraries and vendor files are
different, so the module does far less there. Kept factory: the 16-bit / 44.1 kHz output (most music is
44.1, so it plays without resampling), the HAL's own sound parameters, effects and calls. Applied:
navigation prompts duck the music (also iGo and the navigators the factory list misses), the louder music
curve, the USB DAC setting, as ready files built from the 8581 factory ones. The "default volume" slider in car settings
stays yours — set it to 15 for 0 dB. The UIS7862 patched libraries are never installed there. Reports
from 8581 owners (the snapshot plus /data/adb/BitPerfect.log) are what turns 🧪 into ✅.

🔴 QF firmware (or its MG clone) only — everything else is refused. Other vendors ship UIS7862 too,
with their own audio HAL and libraries; the module's patched files leave such a unit unable to boot (a
Topway owner needed a reflash). The installer accepts only a QF MCU string / hardware revision (QF… or
MG…) and refuses anything else.

What it changes
- Playback: one 24-bit 48 kHz output, Android at unity gain (no digital attenuation before the
  sound processor), navigation ducking, louder VoIP calls on the speaker.
- Calls: SIM calls with handsfree echo cancellation and microphone headroom; Bluetooth calls with
  a louder microphone; Telegram / WhatsApp calls fixed (the factory VoIP record mode loops the input).
  The car-settings microphone sliders trim the level down from there.
- Microphone for apps: a raw, unprocessed input for DSP and voice apps (wDSP, assistants).
- Everything is overlaid by Magisk; no system partition is ever written.

What changed since the classic v4.18

v4.18 was a single BU32107 profile — the full list of what changed since then

v4.18 was a single BU32107 profile. Since then:

Hardware detection
- The sound processor and the output path are read from the MCU code at the right positions (v4.x read
  the control-panel digits, so every BD37xxx unit got the BU32107 I2S profile — the "digital rasp").
- Two profiles: BU32107 (I2S) and BD37xxx (the SoC's DAC). The audio configuration is built from scratch
  for the detected hardware; no file of the other variant is left behind, also after an upgrade.
- 🔴 QF / MG firmware on UIS7862 (full) or UIS8581 (reduced profile); any other platform or firmware is refused.

Playback
- One 24-bit / 48 kHz output: the second output on the same PCM made pcmC0D3p busy, re-routed the bus
  under music and silenced TTS — gone.
- 0 dB that survives: the platform default volume is pinned at unity where the platform keeps it
  (car.config), not only in a property it rewrites at boot. The incoming-call ringtone is no longer
  played 18 dB down.
- The CarSettings start-up volume slider is never touched (v5.0/v5.1 overwrote it).
- The 24-bit I2S width is enforced only where an I2S bus exists, at boot and after sleep.
- After boot and after sleep the MCU gets the level of the current source.

Navigation
- Navigators that announce themselves as "assistant" are treated as navigation, not music.
- Google TTS prompts duck the music like navigation prompts.

Calls
- SIM: handsfree echo cancellation on the handset path, microphone ≈ +13 dB with the echo reference moved
  with it, the handset bass back.
- Bluetooth: louder microphone; the call stays at 0 dB, without a forced communication mode.
- Telegram / WhatsApp: the Unisoc VoIP record mode looped the microphone input (stutter, crackle,
  silence) — it is no longer switched on, and the apps use their own echo cancelling; VoIP is louder on
  the speaker at mid volume.
- The calling module (qf_cellular_calling_master) works only on top of BitPerfect, which confirms
  itself each boot (sys.bitperfect.enabled=1) once the policies are loaded and the audio path is alive.

Microphone
- Raw, unprocessed input for DSP apps (wDSP), voice recognition without echo cancelling or noise
  suppression (assistants); the vendor override that forced every app to the plain microphone is patched
  for these two sources....

modules.name: DuckUSB - Spoof OFF
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: DuckUSB - Spoof OFF
modules.readme:
DuckUSB

Makes apps read USB debugging as OFF while it stays really ON, same for wireless debugging and Developer Options, and hides the persistent *"USB debugging enabled"* notification.

Source, issues & builds: https://github.com/Bouteillepleine/DuckUSB

Scope

Tick the entry whose package is system. That is the one that injects into system_server, which is where the whole spoof now lives. Not the one whose package is android; that does not inject there, and picking it gives you a module that looks enabled and does nothing.

Add System UI for the notification hider. Nothing else needs scoping — there is no per-app mode any more. Reboot after scoping.

How it works

Detection apps don't read any real adb state. They query the settings provider for adb_enabled, adb_wifi_enabled and development_settings_enabled.

One hook in system_server covers every app at once, on the provider's call and query, so the getter and a direct cursor read agree — a detector that queries the settings table instead of calling the getter reads the same lie.

Nothing is injected into the apps being fooled. That is the point: a hook installed inside a target process leaves dirty executable pages in its own memory, and a detector reading its own /proc/self/smaps can see them. From 2.0.0 there is no client-side hook and no native library at all, so there is nothing in those processes to find.

Callers at uid < 10000 (root, system, shell) always read the truth, so adb and the Settings toggle keep working, and the OS file-transfer components are spared so MTP is unaffected.

A diagnostics card lists every caller that was lied to since boot, so a mis-scoped module can't masquerade as a working one. The same card compares what the app reads against the true values, served from system_server — DuckUSB never spoofs itself, so a mismatch there means something *else* on the device is spoofing this app.

Toggles

Pause (live, stops everything) · Spoof USB debugging · Cover the query path · Hide the notification · Mask the USB config property · Verbose log.

Mask the USB config property is the one extra: detectors also flag persist.sys.usb.config=adb. It is rewritten to mtp in the property area itself, so every read route agrees, and *only* there — the persisted value on disk stays adb, because init seeds sys.usb.config from it at boot and writing mtp to disk would bring USB up with no adb interface. It needs root, and it reverts on reboot unless the boot script is installed.

Also available as a Zygisk module

Same behaviour without an Xposed framework, for KernelSU / Magisk, built from the same repo. Either one alone is enough.

Tested on

OnePlus 15 / OxygenOS / Android 16 with LSPosed + KernelSU. Verified there and nowhere else, though the provider is matched by authority and the guards key off uid rather than OEM package names.

modules.name: Fake Bluetooth Connect / 伪蓝牙连接
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Fake Bluetooth Connect / 伪蓝牙连接
modules.readme:
Fake Bluetooth Connect

LSPosed module that makes scoped apps always think a Bluetooth A2DP device is connected.

Hook coverage
- AudioManager.isBluetoothA2dpOn()
- BluetoothAdapter.getProfileConnectionState(BluetoothProfile.A2DP)

The goal is to let some music apps enable external lyric display features even when no Bluetooth device is actually connected.

Usage

1. Install the APK
2. Enable this module in LSPosed
3. Add the target app to the module scope in LSPosed
4. Force stop the target app
5. Reopen the target app
6. Turn on the External Device Bluetooth Lyrics / Car Bluetooth Lyrics feature inside the target app

Notes
- This module is designed to be minimally invasive
- It only changes app-side query results
- It does not fake global Bluetooth connection state for the whole system
- Compatibility may vary across apps if they rely on additional audio device callbacks or their own cached state

Tested
- NetEase Cloud Music: V9.4.70 working
- QQ Music: V20.1.5.8 working

Build

This project uses:
- Android Studio / Gradle
- legacy Xposed API 82 (compatible with LSPosed legacy module loading)
- Kotlin

License

MIT

伪蓝牙连接

一个 LSPosed 模块，让被加入作用域的应用始终认为当前已连接蓝牙 A2DP 设备。

Hook 范围
- AudioManager.isBluetoothA2dpOn()
- BluetoothAdapter.getProfileConnectionState(BluetoothProfile.A2DP)

目的是让部分音乐应用在没有真正连接蓝牙设备时，仍然启用外显歌词功能。

使用方法

1. 安装 APK
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用本模块
3. 在 LSPosed 中给本模块勾选目标应用作用域
4. 强制停止目标应用
5. 重新打开目标应用
6. 在目标应用内部开启 外接设备蓝牙歌词 / 车载蓝牙歌词 功能

说明
- 本模块尽量保持最小侵入
- 只修改应用侧查询结果
- 不会伪造整个系统的全局蓝牙状态
- 如果某些应用依赖额外的音频设备回调或自身缓存状态，兼容性可能存在差异

已测试
- 网易云音乐: V9.4.70 可用
- QQ音乐: V20.1.5.8 可用

构建

项目使用：
- Android Studio / Gradle
- legacy Xposed API 82（通过 LSPosed 的 legacy 模块兼容路径加载）
- Kotlin

协议

MIT

modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: FuckDevicePolicy / 去你大爷的设备策略
modules.readme:
Source Code Github Repo
English

简体中文

This module can let you make some user restriction policies (set by Device Admin App or Work Profile, e.g. Microsoft Intune) nonfunctional. Especially some device-wide policies, even it is in the Work Profile but affected the outside  whole android environment(Your Personal Profile).

For example, since Android 10, a new feature for Work Profile added: https://developer.android.com/work/versions/android-10#work_profile_device-wide_unknown_sources (aka DISALLOW_INSTALL_UNKNOWN_SOURCES_GLOBALLY, value is "no_install_unknown_sources_globally")

This allow the Work Profile App (For example, Microsoft Intune, aka Company Portal) disable the permission of installing APKs from unknown source GLOBALLY, even its inside the Work Profile, then you also can not install APKs in your personal profile!

Another example of device-wide restriction is
If you are facing these problem, just use this Xposed module.

Check https://developer.android.com/reference/android/os/UserManager to get all restriction policy values (See [Constant Value]). Put those you want to disable in this module's App, one line one policy value.

Use dumpsys device_policy (run via adb shell or root) to check what restriction policies applied on your device (under [userRestrictions:] section).

Only apply this module to [System Framework] (which is the default scope setting), no need to apply to any other apps, especially DO NOT apply to Microsoft Intune, otherwise your Xposed and ROOT will be detected.

Due to LSPosed's New XSharedPreferences, if you are using LSPosed, please Activate this module and reboot firstly, before edit and save your custom policies!!! (In another word, when you click the save button, this module should be activated, if you are using LSPosed). Otherwise your custom policies will not be saved correctly for LSPosed.

简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)

该模块可以让一些Android的用户限制策略失效，这些策略一般由“设备管理员”App设置，或者“工作配置文件”。比如Microsoft Intune（又叫“公司门户”）就是用来干这事的。特别是一些全局策略，即使是在工作配置文件里面设置的，但是会影响到外面的整个安卓（你的个人空间，即安卓的主环境）。

比如，从Android 10开始，“工作配置文件”加了个很扯的功能：“device-wide unknown sources” (即用户限制DISALLOW_INSTALL_UNKNOWN_SOURCES_GLOBALLY，值为 "no_install_unknown_sources_globally")。让你全局（哪怕在工作配置外面，即你的个人环境）都无法安装APK。（见https://developer.android.com/work/versions/android-10#work_profile_device-wide_unknown_sources）

有的企业管理App，比如微软的Microsoft Intune（也叫公司门户）可能会应用这个策略（根据你的公司设置）。

另一个例子是
如果你遇到这些问题，可以使用这个Xposed模块。

可以在https://developer.android.com/reference/android/os/UserManager找到所有的用户限制策略的值（见Constant Value），把你想禁用的写到这个模块的App里，一行一个。

如果你想看有哪些策略应用在了你的设备上，可以运行dumpsys device_policy（用adb shell来运行，或者通过root权限在一些终端如Termux上跑），见[userRestrictions:]字段。

这个模块的作用域只需要勾选“系统框架”（即保持默认设置即可），不需要勾选其它App，特别不要勾上Microsoft Intune，不然Xposed和ROOT会被它检测到。

由于LSPosed的New XSharedPreferences机制，如果你用的是LSPosed，在App中编辑/保存策略你的自定义策略之前，请先激活这个模块并重启！！！（换句话说，当你点击保存按钮时，这个模块应处于激活状态！），否则你保存的策略无法在LSPosed环境中正确读取。

modules.name: HyperBackground
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: HyperBackground
modules.readme:
HyperBackground

为 HyperOS 3/4 打造的系统背景与外观自定义模块

HyperBackground 是一个面向 HyperOS 的 LSPosed 背景与外观自定义模块，用于为系统设置及部分 HyperOS 系统应用提供统一、可配置的自定义背景体验。
当前最新发行版：1.4.4
包名：com.ciallo.hyperbackground
最低 Android 版本：Android 13 / API 33
当前开发基线：HyperOS 4 / Android 17
配置界面：Kotlin + Jetpack Compose + Miuix KMP
Hook 框架：LibXposed API 102

功能

背景自定义
- 设置主页、我的设备、全局背景、通讯录与拨号、短信五套独立背景通道，选图方式一致。
- 设置主页支持独立图片，不强制继承全局背景。
- “我的设备”支持图片、GIF、动态 WebP、MP4 和 WebM，并可恢复系统 RuntimeShader 动态背景。
- 各套背景均支持透明度、模糊开关和模糊强度。
- 全局背景覆盖 Settings 普通二级页面，并扩展到设备互联、电话设置、小米账号、主题壁纸、系统桌面、手机管家、省电管理、健康使用手机、短信等已适配页面。
- MIUIX 二级页面支持透明顶栏与连续背景显示。
- 对移动网络 MobileNetworkSettings 使用独立的背景宿主处理，避免背景被 MIUIX 页面转场容器一同移动。
- 登录、授权、锁屏凭据、支付、拨号、紧急呼叫及浮动窗口保持系统原样。

通讯录与拨号
- 独立背景通道，通过 Hook com.android.contacts 注入，仅作用于拨号盘 / 联系人主界面，不影响详情、编辑等二级页面。
- 「拨号盘与列表」适配：清除联系人列表、字母分组吸顶头等不透明中性底透出背景，深浅色行为一致，半透明层与彩色控件保留。
- 拨号盘独立背景：可单独为拨号盘键盘区导入图片，与联系人整页背景叠加共存；支持等比缩放（1–200%）、纵向定位、四角圆角裁切，以及默认模式下键盘面板不透明度独立调节。
- 「通讯录颜色」独立深浅色控件，与全局强制深浅色独立并存。

自定义我的设备
- 「自定义我的设备」入口取代原「我的设备」通道，内含设备界面样式、动态背景与自定义 LOGO。
- 设备界面样式支持「系统默认 / 样式1（教程卡）/ 样式2（鸿蒙卡）」；样式1、样式2 可分别导入机型图片、背景图片、LOGO，并逐项调节缩放、偏移、模糊、行间距、对齐与文案等参数。
- 「动态背景」通道复用带预览的背景选图，静态背景支持透明度调节。
- 系统默认样式下支持自定义 LOGO：可选「不保留 / 保留高级材质（导入 SVG/XML）」并调节缩放。
- 所有选图入口统一为带预览对话框，可在对话框内预览、换图、清除。

设备信息覆盖
- 覆盖设置各页面显示的手机型号、处理器、运行内存、电池、屏幕、分辨率、摄像头、系统 / Android 版本、存储、内核、基带、硬件等参数，仅改变设置页显示，不修改任何系统属性。

主题与外观
- 支持强制设置文字明暗模式与 Settings 应用深浅模式。
- 模块界面支持 Monet 壁纸取色、12 色预设、HSV 调节，以及 #RRGGBB / #AARRGGBB 手动输入。
- 模块外观支持独立背景、背景透明度、模糊和卡片透明度。

卡片与材质
- 设置分组卡片支持自定义颜色、磨砂、柔光玻璃三种背景模式，浅色/深色独立配置颜色、模糊强度、不透明度与高光。
- 「我的设备」自绘卡片、通知说明卡、蓝牙设备卡等独立卡片统一接入当前卡片样式，材质不可用时逐级回退。
- MIUIX 弹窗在柔光玻璃模式下复用当前材质。
- 卡片配置支持剪贴板导入导出与统一恢复默认。
- 动态适配体系按内容自动识别独立卡片表面，卡片材质路由可扩展到 LSPosed 中勾选的其它应用。

其它
- 提供 Hook 读取记录，用于确认目标进程是否已执行 Hook 并读取全局背景。
- 关于页提供版本检查、版本说明、更新日志、制作者信息、酷安和 GitHub 入口。

随机背景
- 通过图片 API 随机拉取背景图，与手动设置的背景互不影响——独立存储 .random.bin，关闭开关即刻恢复手动图。
- 图片来源可自定义 API 地址（默认 uapis 随机图片接口），提供图片类别选择；二次元动漫默认强制手机竖图。
- 作用范围支持设置主页 / 我的设备 / 全局 / 通讯录 / 模块自身背景（拨号盘渲染基准不同，不参与随机），默认折叠为一行、点击展开。
- 槽位三态：不使用 / 随刷新 / 固定。「固定」的槽位仍显示当前随机图，但跳过「立刻更换」与开机自动换图。
- 换图时机可选「仅手动」「仅开机自动」「手动 + 开机」。
- 每个背景通道详情页新增「导出当前图片」，将当前生效背景（随机优先）保存到相册 Pictures/HyperBackground/。

1.4.4

汇总 1.4.4-beta1 至 beta11 全部测试线，作为稳定版发布：
- 卡片背景体系：分组卡片支持自定义颜色、磨砂、柔光玻璃三种模式，浅色/深色独立配置；弹窗复用柔光材质；卡片配置支持导入导出与恢复默认。
- 动态适配体系：内容驱动的通用卡片表面识别，卡片材质路由可扩展到 LSPosed 勾选的其它应用；新增底栏渐变与顶栏渐变设置。
- 新增短信背景通道（主页会话列表与聊天页双通道）。
- 「我的设备」新增 COS 样式与背景预加载，自绘卡片统一接入卡片材质路由。
- 拨号盘独立背景重构：等比缩放、纵向定位、四角圆角裁切、键盘面板独立不透明度。
- 功能与作用域两级控制：作用域管理页、一键重启作用域，完善 26 个作用域适配。
- 设置页「配置」栏目、隐藏桌面图标、顶栏按钮常驻。
- 修复蓝牙/通知卡片浅色漏接管、misettings 分组装饰器卡片失守、柔光切换闪烁、顶栏模糊层拦截触摸、我的设备黑帧、设置 UI 溢出等。

1.4.3

汇总 1.4.3-beta6 至 beta8 全部测试线，作为稳定版发布：
- 全模块 Kotlin 化与 UI 结构调整。
- 新增「随机背景」功能：通过图片 API 随机拉取背景图，与手动设置的背景互不影响，独立存储、按槽位生效、支持「仅手动 / 仅开机自动 / 手动 + 开机」三种换图时机、二次元动漫默认强制手机竖图。
- 随机背景作用范围支持「不使用 / 随刷新 / 固定」三态，「固定」的槽位显示当前随机图但跳过刷新。
- 每个背景通道详情页新增「导出当前图片」，将当前生效背景（随机优先）保存到相册。
- 随机背景作用范围移除拨号盘（整屏宽度渲染基准与其它槽位不同），手动拨号盘背景不受影响，升级自动清理历史配置。
完整历史更新记录见仓库中的 CHANGELOG.md。当前 HyperOS 桌面二级设置页由 Flutter/Rust 渲染，模块的 View 树背景注入对其无效；模块仅确保旧版桌面设置背景原本能生效的路径不被破坏。

1.4.2

汇总 1.4.2-beta1 至 beta11 全部测试线，作为稳定版发布：
- 新增「通讯录与拨号」独立背景通道、拨号盘与列表适配、拨号盘独立背景（缩放 / 定位 / 圆角 / 不透明度）及「通讯录颜色」独立深浅色控件。
- 移植自 HyperChanger：新增「自定义我的设备」（系统默认 / 教程卡 / 鸿蒙卡三种样式）、自定义 LOGO（支持 SVG/XML 高级材质）与「设备信息覆盖」（仅改变设置页显示）。
- 「动态背景」并入「自定义我的设备」，所有选图入口统一为带预览对话框。
- 升级 LibXposed API 至 102，原有背景注入体系不受影响。

当前作用域
- com.android.settings
- com.android.contacts
- com.android.mms
- com.android.phone
- com.milink.service
- com.xiaomi.account
- com.xiaomi.misettings
- com.android.thememanager
- com.miui.securitycenter
- com.miui.securitycore
- com.android.deskclock
- com.android.fileexplorer
- com.android.providers.downloads.ui
- com.android.quicksearchbox

- com.android.soundrecorder

- com.miui.aod
- com.miui.calculator
- com.miui.cloudservice
- com.miui.cloudbackup
- com.miui.backup
- com.miui.huanji
- com.miui.misound

普通 Settings 二级页面使用全局背景；设置主页、我的设备、通讯录与拨号、短信分别由独立通道控制。跨包作用域只处理已识别的全屏设置页面，敏感或临时窗口保持系统原样；非官方支持范围的应用仅加载卡片与弹窗材质，不启用整页背景、主题或文字颜色管线。

安装

1. 从 GitHub Releases 下载 APK。
2. 安装后在 LSPosed 中启用 HyperBackground。
3. 勾选模块声明的作用域，并结束对应应用进程或重启设备。
4. 打开 HyperBG 配置背景、透明度、模糊和外观选项。

签名

从 1.3.6 起，Release APK 使用 GitHub Actions Secrets 注入的私有 PKCS#12 密钥签名，私钥和密码不会进入仓库或源码 ZIP。

1.3.6 起使用的证书 SHA-256：

A1:75:5A:BE:D4:13:5A:38:17:B0:D8:76:0F:40:BE:A5:D3:B7:00:1B:08:A8:29:EA:1D:3C:DA:90:FB:D4:4F:4B

由于 1.3.5 及更早版本使用旧签名，首次升级到 1.3.6 或更高版本需要备份配置并卸载旧版；1.3.6 之后的同签名发行版可以覆盖升级。

构建环境

- Android SDK 37
- Android Build Tools 36.0.0
- Gradle 9.7.0
- Android Gradle Plugin 9.3.1
- Kotlin 2.4.10
- Compose BOM 2026.08.00
- Miuix KMP 0.9.3

Release 本地构建需要提供：
- HYPERBG_KEYSTORE_PATH
- HYPERBG_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
- HYPERBG_KEY_ALIAS
- HYPERBG_KEY_PASSWORD

执行 ./build.sh，产物位于 dist/HyperBackground-v.apk。

仓库分支

- source-archives：历史源码 ZIP；独立构建链选择版本号最高的源码包。

作者与反馈

苍簇

致谢

本次 1.4.0 的 UI 与框架重构，得到了 芥子（@1812z）的大力支持，在此致以诚挚感谢。

License

KernelSU/Apatch/Magisk WebUI Module Template

This is a template for creating KernelSU/Apatch/Magisk modules with WebUI. It includes a basic structure and a build script

How to use template

1. Fork this template
2. Modify module/module.prop with your module details.
   1. Set your repo url in updateJson
3. Develop you own module, lol
4. Edit CHANGELOG.md
5. Build the module using nix build
   1. or just use GitHub Actions (nix run nixpkgs#act -- -j build -P ubuntu-latest=ghcr.io/catthehacker/ubuntu:act-24.04 --artifact-server-path ./artifacts (choose Medium size image))
6. Remove "How to use template" section from README.md

Module Structure
- docs
- KernelSU
- Apatch
- Magisk
- module/: Module content
- module.prop: Module metadata
- banner.{png,webp}: Banner which will be shown in module managers
- works in KSU-Next and other new managers
- you could place it inside webroot/ to use as WebUI media
- recommended size is 640*320
- webroot/: WebUI assets
- META-INF/ From magisk docs
- CHANGELOG.md: Module changelog
- update.json: Will be generated from module.prop

Development with Nix

Use nix develop (or better, use direnv) to enter a development shell with necessary tools installed:

Install
- Download zip from latest release
- Flash via your module manager of choice

modules.readme:
中文 | English

LockPerm

LockPerm

伪装 · 防护
一个基于 Libxposed API 102 的 Xposed 模块，把「伪装」「防护」「控制」三件事放在一起。

LockPerm 是一个以应用为单位工作的隐私模块：它让目标应用读到你想让它读到的内容（伪装），并阻止它做你不允许它做的事（防护），还能在应用运行时挂一个悬浮面板直接动手改界面（控制）。

在「应用」页把目标应用加入作用域，点「配置」进入它的专属配置页，在 防护功能 / 权限伪装 / 设备伪装 / 设备模板 / 其他功能 五个页签里勾选需要的功能即可。每个应用的配置互相独立，互不干扰。

🚀 快速上手

1. 在 LSPosed 管理器中启用本模块（也支持 LSPatch）。
2. 在「应用」页为目标应用申请作用域。
3. 在「应用」页给已加入作用域的应用点「配置」，进入它的配置页。
4. 在五个页签里勾选这个应用需要的功能，页签可左右滑动。
5. 强制停止目标应用再打开，配置才会生效。

🛡 防护功能

权限与设备控制权
- 无障碍防护：禁止开启无障碍服务，也可单独禁用读屏、监听通知、监听窗口变化、读取输入内容、模拟操作、无障碍悬浮窗、按键 / 手势监听；清空无障碍服务列表、伪装无障碍开启状态。
- 设备管理员 / Device Owner 防护：阻止主动申请成为设备管理员，并按需禁用锁屏、改密码、恢复出厂、停用相机、应用管理、系统设置、权限授予、加密等能力。
- 悬浮窗：可拦掉系统级悬浮窗；也可「允许显示并改造」—— 穿透点击、完全透明、限制占屏大小、自定义窗口标志、给所有窗口加 / 去 FLAG_SECURE。
- 壁纸拦截：无论应用用哪种方式改壁纸都拦下。
- 安装 / 卸载拦截：阻止静默安装或引导安装，可伪装成「操作成功」直接回执。
- 打印 / 投屏拦截：阻止应用发起打印或投屏。
- 命令执行拦截：拦截应用执行命令（Java/应用层 + 原生层）。

硬件与感知
- 摄像头 / 麦克风实时拦截：即使已拿到权限也打不开硬件。
- 传感器拦截：禁用全部传感器，或逐项设置「不处理 / 禁用 / 伪装值 / 动态值」。
- 硬件能力拦截：红外发射、生物识别、BLE 广播与主动扫描、点亮屏幕。
- 闪光灯 / 振动拦截：禁止控制手电筒与震动。
- 屏幕捕获拦截：拒绝授权、伪造图片 / 视频、伪造静态文字，画面可自适应。
- 音频输出拦截：按媒体、通话、铃声、通知、闹钟、系统、TTS 分别拦截，也可只拦「有 / 无音频焦点」的播放。
- 音量控制：总开关拦截、固定音量值、只允许调小、阻止改响铃模式与静音。

数据与踪迹
- 隐私数据拦截：剪贴板读写（可分别控制）、通知发送、通知隐藏。
- 文件防护：拦截 MediaStore 与 File / NIO 的创建、写入、删除、重命名等操作，可选「内部存储」或「所有路径」；文件重定向。
- 系统下载拦截：拦掉系统下载与直接写入下载库。
- 隐藏应用列表：让应用PackageManager枚举不到你装了哪些软件，支持白名单 / 黑名单。
- 网络请求域名过滤：按黑白名单过滤域名（部分生效）。
- 屏幕与电源：禁止应用使屏幕常亮、禁止息屏但不锁屏、释放屏幕常亮锁、通话息屏、禁止从后台任务中隐藏、禁止后台弹出界面（含 PendingIntent 弹窗）。
- 按键拦截：禁止应用消费按键事件，可单独放行返回键。

跨应用与常驻
- 跳转拦截：阻止跳转到其他应用，支持白名单、未知包名处理策略。
- IPC 拦截：显式 Intent、FileProvider、ContentProvider、BroadcastReceiver 四类通道，收发双向可分别控制，支持严格模式与 authority 白名单。
- 禁止前台常驻服务：不允许应用挂着常驻通知活着。
- 无线调试拦截：堵死 ADB over Wi-Fi 的开关、配对、发现、跳转与系统属性入口(部分有效)。
- Shizuku 拦截：阻止申请授权，也禁用已授权后的调用。

稳定性与退出
- 退出功能：倒计时、指定时刻、内存超阈值、CPU 超阈值、存储增量、断网 / 联网、电量或充电状态、指定文件变动、长时间未触摸、卡顿累计、音量变化 —— 条件可并行监听，触发后按指定方式退出。
- 阻止闪退 / 自杀：强度可调，分项覆盖进程自杀、退出指令、信号、kill 命令、系统服务杀进程、未捕获异常、消息循环异常、退后台结束任务、等待调试器、线程守护；原生层退出与崩溃拦截能力有限。
- 应用层异常捕获器：崩溃时复制堆栈到剪贴板、写入应用私有目录、拦截应用抛出的异常、崩溃后弹出详情界面（可倒计时自动退出）。
- 拦截自动返回操作：关界面、退回上一页、退后台都拦下。

🎭 伪装功能

设备信息（Build 字段）
- 型号、品牌、厂商、指纹、序列号、硬件、板型、设备名、SoC、产品、Bootloader、Radio、Display、安全补丁、增量版本、代号、Base OS、编译时间 / 主机 / 标签 / 类型 / 用户等项。
- 支持一键随机生成与全部清空。

标识伪装
- Android ID、GSF ID、广告 ID（GAID）、App Set ID、DRM ID、DRM System ID、Widevine 等级。
- OAID / ODID / VAID / AAID、Firebase FID / IID。

硬件与内核
- 内核版本、架构、平台、硬件厂商标识。
- CPU：芯片型号、板型代号、核心数、每核频率。
- GPU：厂商、渲染器、GL 版本与 GLSL、Vulkan API、驱动信息、Vendor / Device ID、显存与纹理上限。
- 设备温度、电量百分比（可模拟自动掉电）、电池细节（充电状态、电流、电压、设计容量）。

显示与存储
- 应用 DPI、屏幕分辨率与刷新率（含支持的刷新率列表）。
- 内存与存储：总运行内存、可用内存、存储总容量、可用容量。
- 相机分辨率：按像素数生成前后摄支持的拍照尺寸。

网络与 SIM
- WiFi / 蓝牙 MAC、SSID / BSSID、IMEI / MEID / ICCID、SIM 序列号、订阅 ID、运营商与名称、国家码、手机号。
- eSIM 支持、移动数据、漫游状态伪装。
- VPN / 抓包代理隐藏：VPN 网卡接口、传输能力、旧版 NetworkInfo、HTTP 代理、相关系统设置，接口名可自定义。
- 网络身份：内网 IPv4 / IPv6、网关、DNS、WiFi 标准，并覆盖 Socket、LinkAddress、InetAddress 与原生层取地址的多种路径。

WiFi / 蓝牙状态伪装
- 断网时把网络状态报成「已连接 WiFi」，SSID、BSSID、信号、速率、IP、频率可自定义，可伪造扫描热点列表、屏蔽已保存网络查询。
- 蓝牙：伪装开启状态、本机名称与 MAC、已配对设备、已连接设备、扫描列表与设备类型。

系统环境
- 时区、语言 / 地区、开机时长、vbmeta digest、boot id。
- 系统时间：指定时刻（继续走秒 / 定住不走）或偏移分钟，可同步伪装原生层。
- 伪装开发者选项已关闭，USB 调试与无线调试单独控制。

位置与基站
- 坐标（纬度 / 经度 / 海拔 / 精度），可改写所有 Location 对象字段。
- 按通道拦截：GPS（含 GNSS 原始数据：卫星状态、测量值、NMEA）、网络定位（含 WiFi 扫描结果）、融合定位、电话服务。
- 基站信息：MCC / MNC / LAC / CID / PCI；电话与短信存储（sms / mms / call_log）。

服务与 Root
- 伪装拥有 Google Play 服务：包查询、可用性检查、GAID、版本信息。
- 伪装拥有华为移动服务（HMS）：包查询、可用性检查、OAID、版本信息。
- Root 伪装：伪装 su 文件存在，屏蔽 Permission denied 伪装返回执行成功，可切换「有 Root / 无 Root(效果有限)」。

权限伪装
- 覆盖通讯录、短信、通话记录、电话、存储、位置、日历、相机、麦克风、身体传感器、通知、附近设备、运动识别、健康数据、无障碍、设备管理员、通知监听、使用情况、悬浮窗、安装未知应用、所有文件访问、精确闹钟、电池优化、自启动、VPN、修改系统设置、后台弹出界面、媒体管理、全屏通知、音频设置、锁屏显示、动态壁纸、勿扰、画中画、付费短信等权限组。
- 勾选即伪装成「已授权」，部分权限可返回伪造数据：假联系人、假短信、假通话记录、假文件目录、固定坐标、假日程、符合量程的传感器值、假通知、假蓝牙设备、假使用统计等。

网页 / WebView 伪装
- User-Agent：预设随机或手动填写。
- WebView 指纹：屏幕与像素比、CPU 核数、内存、触摸点数、平台与厂商、WebGL 厂商与渲染器、navigator.languages、时区偏移。
- 时间与地理：改写 JS 的 Date、时区与 Intl.timeZone、伪造地理位置。
- 隐藏 webdriver / selenium 标记、声明 DNT、WebRTC 防护或直接停用。
- 指纹噪声：Canvas / WebGL / Audio 取值加随机扰动，强度可调。
- 基础开关：强制启用 JavaScript、忽略证书错误、注入自定义 JavaScript。

🧰 其他功能
- 文字替换：网页、View、绘制 / Compose、其它组件（通知、磁贴、Toast、媒体等）四类范围，支持精确 / 正则 / 宽容匹配、忽略大小写、长文本，并带替换诊断。
- 点击内容：页面出现指定文字或控件 id 就自动点击，支持包含 / 精确匹配、重复间隔与次数。
- 控件拦截：按控件 ID、文字、资源名、类名、内容描述、坐标区域隐藏控件，带预设类型与状态，可输出到日志。
- 去除弹窗：弹窗左上角挂圆钮，点击后选择处理方式。
- 拦截方法执行：按类名 + 方法名拦截任意方法，可指定返回值、列出参数类型、输出日志。
- 命令执行记录：记录应用实际执行过的命令（含原生层），支持弹窗提示、悬浮窗实时显示、静默记录，并可记录输出内容。
- 全局代理：把勾选应用的流量送进隧道，支持白名单。
- 设备模板：把一整套设备参数存成模板，一键套用到任意应用，支持导入 / 导出、复制、源码模式编辑。
- 测试检测：用于测试应用的检测强度，总开关 + 字节一致性、类名检测、内存（maps / smaps）、注入痕迹、虚拟化、IO 重定向、日志特征过滤或清空；可全局默认，也可按应用覆盖。
- 原生层钩子：覆盖属性、uname、时间、文件、stat、执行、退出、网络、读取、mmap、GPU、传感器等层面，可按应用单独开关。

🎛 控制面板

在目标应用屏幕左上角挂一个悬浮球，点开即展开面板，不需要重启目标应用就能立即生效：
- 日志分区：多个日志区可切换，支持保存与复制。
- 增强拾取：手指划过高亮、点击选定控件，然后对它移除、隐藏、改文字、改颜色、换图片、存图片、控件转图片、整页截图；还能用父控件 / 子控件 / 上一个 / 下一个切换。
- 持久化：带「持久化」的改动会被记下来，下次进入应用自动生效。
- 一键功能。
- 命令区：共用一个 sh 会话，直接输入并执行命令。
- 控件信息：查看控件属性、当前生效配置、权限自检、线程堆栈与分辨率等运行信息。
- 小细节：面板可最小化或隐藏，隐藏后按音量键唤出；被对话框压住时，在屏幕任意位置 1 秒内连点五下即可重新置顶。

📱 模块自身
- 外观：语言、深色模式与切换时间、主题颜色与配色风格、对比度与文字描边、动态壁纸、模糊与透明度。
- 界面：主页切换动画、配置页向上弹出、圆角形状、配置页组件缩放与应用 DPI。
- 图标：用任意图片在桌面创建自定义快捷方式图标，或禁用所有启动图标隐藏本模块。
- 其它：配置备份导出与导入、检查更新、触摸震动、开屏动画、预测性返回手势。
- LSPatch 模式：激活后，应用页可直接配置（作用域在 LSPatch 里添加）。

⚠️ 使用须知
- 模块只在目标应用进程里工作，不会常驻任何后台服务。
- 部分修改配置后需要强制停止目标应用再打开才会生效。
- 防护类功能可能会影响目标应用的正常使用，请按需开启。
- 崩溃日志写在 /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/{目标包名}/files/ 下。
- 测试检测会带来额外开销，效果有限，且默认关闭，按需开启。
- 🚫 请勿将本模块用于 Android 系统程序，禁止对涉及金融、账号安全、财产等关键场景使用本模块。本模块仅供学习研究与合法合规的技术测试使用，禁止用于规避风控、绕过授权、侵犯隐私、诈骗或其他违法用途；违规使用产生的一切后果由使用者自行承担。
- 若显示未激活、作用域不同步或未更新，重启本模块尝试解决。

modules.name: LSPosed-DisableSMS
modules.author: gabeluci
modules.description: LSPosed module to enable Google Messages device pairing
modules.readme:
LSPosed - Pair a second phone to Google Messages

Running Google Messages on a tablet will let you pair it to your phone. However,
there is no way to do this on a second phone.

This LSPosed module will tell Google Messages that your device does not support
sending or receiving SMS. That will make Google Messages think it's a wifi-only
tablet and prompt you to pair with another phone.

This will not combine SMS messages from two phones. One phone will be the
primary, where all messages are sent and received.

Why?

I made this for when I go on a trip and don't want to take my primary phone with
me out of the country. I can leave my primary phone plugged in at home and use
this module to pair a second phone that I take with me.

Warning
Make sure your primary phone will not automatically restart, since you will stop
getting messages until the phone is unlocked. In Settings, search for "restart"
and disable every setting that you find. On my Samsung phone, there were 4 settings.

Better than Google Messages for Web

Google Messages in "tablet" mode is really just a Progressive Web App (PWA)
for Google Messages for Web (https://messages.google.com/web). You _could_ open
Google Messages for Web in Chrome → 3-dot menu → Add to home screen → Install, and
that would put an icon in your launcher like any other app. I've done this before
and found that it will not stay alive in the background, so I would stop getting
notifications from it shortly after closing it. I had to open the app to check
for new messages.

Using the official Google Messages app in tablet mode (with this module) will
stay open in the background and you will reliably get notifications.

You can still use SMS

If you install a different SMS app, you can still send normal SMS messages using
that app as long as you only apply this module to Google Messages.

This will work on any app

There is nothing in this module specific to Google Messages. All it does is tell
whatever app you apply it to that your device does not support SMS. More specifically,
it highjacks calls to TelephonyManager.isSmsCapable())
and the newer TelephonyManager.isDeviceSmsCapable())
and always returns false.

If you find a use case other than Google Messages device pairing, let me know!

Installation

1. Make sure the prerequisites are installed:
- Magisk
- LSPosed

2. Download DisableSMS.apk and install it.
3. LSPosed should prompt you to enable it. Enable it and select the "Messages"
app from the app list (it will be listed first if it's installed).
4. If you opened the Google Messages app before installing this module, you may
need to delete the app data for it.
5. Open Google Messages and follow the instructions to pair with your primary phone.

Apparently there's a way to run LSPosed modules without root (so I've read).
I've never done that and I don't know if this module would work without root.
If you try it, let me know how it goes.

modules.name: lsposed-veil
modules.author: bdeshi
modules.description: LSposed module to hide accessibility services and other stuff from apps
modules.readme:
Veil

An LSPosed module that hides accessibility, debugging, and root/hook state from the apps
in its scope, without changing the actual state of the device.

Built entirely by AI in one evening to fix a personal problem. YMMV — it works for me
and hasn't been audited beyond that.

Requirements
- Rooted device with a working Zygisk implementation and LSPosed (or an LSPosed-compatible
  framework such as Vector).
- Android 8.1+.

Setup

1. Build (below) or grab a release APK from the repo's Releases page.
2. Enable the module in LSPosed Manager and scope it to the target apps.
3. Force-stop each target app; Veil applies from its next cold start.

If the target app still won't launch, check whether it's on your root manager's DenyList
(e.g. KernelSU: app profile → "Umount modules"). An app on that list never gets Zygisk
modules injected at all, Veil included. The settings screen's help panel covers this and
a few other gotchas.

Features

Every app in scope gets all of these. Veil's settings screen is a read-only summary.

| Feature                  | Hides                                                  |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| Accessibility services   | Any accessibility service running                      |
| USB / wireless debugging | adb_enabled / adb_wifi_enabled                     |
| Developer options        | Developer Options enabled state                        |
| Mock location            | Legacy pre-Marshmallow flag only                       |
| Root / manager apps      | Fixed list of ~30 packages (see Features.kt)         |
| Build tags/type          | Real build swapped for release-keys / user         |

The package list covers root managers (Magisk and forks, KernelSU and forks, APatch), module
managers, hook frameworks and their managers, and older su apps, plus Veil itself. Xposed modules in general have no common package name, so they
aren't covered by name.

Doesn't cover native-level root/hook detection or remote attestation (Play Integrity,
SafetyNet) — that's your Zygisk implementation's job, not Veil's.

Why there's no per-app configuration

A hooked app can't read anything Veil's own app saves: Veil's data dir is private to it,
and the framework's shared-prefs redirect for legacy modules only works if the framework
hooks Veil's own process, which Vector doesn't reliably do. Settings would be silently
ignored, so there are none. To change what's hidden, edit VeilHook.kt /
Features.HIDDEN_PACKAGES and rebuild. For per-app package lists, use Hide My Applist.

Building

Requires JDK 17 and Android SDK (platform 35, build-tools 35.0.0).

./gradlew assembleDebug       # debug-signed APK
./gradlew assembleRelease     # minified release build, debug-signed unless keystore.properties exists
scripts/generate-keystore.sh  # create a personal release-signing keystore
scripts/release.sh            # build + copy signed release APK into dist/

CI releases

Pushing a tag matching *.*.* (e.g. 1.2.0) triggers .github/workflows/release.yml.
For a properly signed CI build, set repo secrets: KEYSTORE_BASE64 (base64 of your
release.jks), KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, KEY_ALIAS, KEY_PASSWORD.

Android 10+ only! AOSP ROMs only (e.g. LineageOS, crDroid)! Do not install on non-AOSP ROMs (MIUI, OneUI, etc.)!

It overrides the system android:string/config_icon_mask via a lightweight Runtime Resource Overlay (MeowIconShapeOverlay.apk in /system/product/overlay/), and during installation automatically resets the launcher's Wallpaper & Style shape override (*.grid_control) so the home screen also renders cat-ears.

Download latest release and install it via Magisk app. After reboot, the cat-ears icon shape should be applied to home screen, menu, and settings.

modules.name: miui-blank-pass-ultra

modules.description: MIUI Blank Pass Ultra（空值权限）— LSPosed 模块：权限视为已授予，但所有查询返回空数据
modules.readme:
MIUI Blank Pass Ultra（空值权限）

基于 LSPosed 的 modern Xposed API 模块：勾选的权限类别，目标应用会认为「已授权」，但所有查询都拿到空数据。

不是权限管理，也不是拒绝授权——是真授权、假数据。对应用来说权限状态一切正常，只是通讯录空了、相册空了、剪贴板空了、相机打不开了。

功能

| 类别 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| 通讯录 | 权限视为已授予，查询返回空列表 |
| 短信 | 权限视为已授予，查询返回空列表，发送静默失败 |
| 通话记录 | 权限视为已授予，查询返回空列表 |
| 日历 | 权限视为已授予，查询返回空列表 |
| 相册媒体 | 媒体权限视为已授予，图片 / 视频 / 音频返回空 |
| 文件与下载 | 存储权限视为已授予，下载目录与文档查询返回空 |
| 外部存储浏览 | 应用列不出外部存储目录 |
| 定位 | 权限视为已授予，但返回空值且不再上报位置 |
| 剪贴板 | 读取剪贴板返回空 |
| 设备标识 | 电话状态权限视为已授予，IMEI / IMSI / 序列号返回空 |
| 应用列表 | 应用列表权限视为已授予，查询返回空 |
| 账户 | 账户权限视为已授予，系统账户列表返回空 |
| 麦克风 | 录音权限视为已授予，录到的数据全为零（静音） |
| 相机 | 相机权限视为已授予，但打开相机失败、不返回画面 |

界面部分：
- Miuix（HyperOS 风格 Compose 组件库）实现，深浅色跟随系统，支持高级材质（玻璃 / 模糊）
- 单应用精细开关 + 批量开启 / 关闭，自动向 LSPosed 申请作用域
- 每张卡片带 Hook 状态圆点：绿 = 全部注入，红 = 部分失败，灰 = 尚未注入；读不到模块日志时显示「状态未知」而不是误报「尚未注入」
- 诊断页：运行状态、配置数量、按包名 / 级别筛选模块日志、一键导出到系统下载目录或自定义目录
- 20 种语言：简体中文、繁体中文（香港 / 台湾）、维吾尔语、藏语、英语（US / GB）、法语、德语、意大利语、土耳其语、荷兰语、俄语、西班牙语（ES / 拉美）、葡萄牙语（PT / BR）、阿拉伯语（RTL）、日语、韩语

截图

主页
批量选择
排序与系统应用
温馨提示

设置
主题与高级材质
诊断
关于

环境要求
- Android 10 及以上（minSdk 29，targetSdk 37）
- LSPosed（modern Xposed API，minApiVersion=101、targetApiVersion=102）
- Root 只在「重启作用域应用」和诊断页读取模块日志时需要，模块本体不需要

使用

1. 安装 APK
2. 在 LSPosed 里启用「MIUI Blank Pass Ultra」，勾选需要生效的应用
3. 打开模块，选中应用 → 勾选要屏蔽的类别（模块会自动写入作用域）
4. 强制停止并重新打开目标应用

关闭类别后 hook 不会立刻卸载，需要重启目标应用；卡片和批量操作里都会提示。

构建

需要 JDK 17 与 Android SDK 37。构建脚本会自动找 gradle，也可以 GRADLE_BIN=/path/to/gradle ./build.sh。

cp local.properties.example local.properties   # 填入 sdk.dir 与签名信息
./build_native.sh                              # 可选：仓库已带编译好的 so
./build.sh                                     # 产出 app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk

几个不算常规的细节：
- native 安全层用系统 clang + NDK sysroot 手动交叉编译（build_native.sh），因为官方 NDK 的 ndk-build / cmake 依赖 x86_64 host 工具
- 签名信息全部来自 local.properties，仓库里没有任何 keystore 和密码
- 没配签名时 assembleDebug 仍可正常出未签名包
- ./build.sh debug 出未优化的 debug 包，只用来排查问题；Compose 在 debug 下滚动会明显掉帧
- aarch64 机器上必须指定 aapt2：SDK 自带的 aapt2 是 x86-64 二进制，直接跑会报 Daemon startup failed。两条路：用 ARM 原生版本，或用 qemu 包装

方案一：ARM 原生 aapt2（推荐，无需翻译层）
AAPT2_OVERRIDE=/path/to/arm64/aapt2 ./build.sh

方案二：qemu 包装 SDK 自带的那份
printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/bin/qemu-x86_64 -L /usr/x86_64-linux-gnu %s "$@"\n' \
    "$ANDROID_HOME/build-tools/36.0.0/aapt2" > /tmp/aapt2-wrap
chmod +x /tmp/aapt2-wrap
AAPT2_OVERRIDE=/tmp/aapt2-wrap ./build.sh

脚本会自动加 -Pandroid.aapt2FromMavenOverride=，不需要改 gradle.properties。

签名校验

期望值从 local.properties 的 EXPECTED_SIG_SHA256 注入，不写进源码。留空 = 不校验，适合自己编译调试；填了 = 严格校验。

校验分两层，因为模块的代码会跑在两类完全不同的进程里：

1. 模块自己的界面进程（App.onCreate → Security.verify）
签名不符直接结束进程。这一层拦住的是「装了个假界面」。

2. 目标应用进程（PermNullModule.install → ModuleIntegrity）
hook 代码被框架注入到别的应用进程里，不会经过 App.onCreate，上面那层覆盖不到这里。所以在真正安装 hook 之前，再核对一次承载模块代码的 APK 签名：
- 通过 getModuleApplicationInfo() 拿到框架实际加载的那份 APK 路径
- 用 PackageManager.getPackageArchiveInfo 取出签名证书，算 SHA-256 比对
- 每个进程只算一次，结果缓存，后续不产生开销
- 不匹配就跳过安装，不装任何 hook，也绝不终止目标进程

这层的意义是：重打包产物能装、能打开界面，但对任何目标应用都不生效，等于空壳。

取值方式（keystore 需自行生成，仓库不含任何 keystore 与密码）：

keytool -list -v -keystore  -alias  | grep SHA256

对应 native 层只负责比对，自身不烧任何哈希。

官方包指纹

官方发布的 APK 由固定证书签名，证书 SHA-256 为：

ebe065a95b248ca8e9d98a4f8e4a9e3877b30e1a3b61833e9a34cf41c29dc0d0

安装前可以自己核对拿到的包是不是这个证书签的：

apksigner verify --print-certs 你的包.apk

看输出里的 Signer #1 certificate SHA-256 digest 是否一致。不一致就是别人改过重签的版本，不要装。

从源码自行编译的包签名必然不同，那是正常的——这类包在 EXPECTED_SIG_SHA256 留空时不做任何校验，只在你自己填了期望值时才按你的证书校验。

这条公示挡不住有备而来的伪造者，但能让「假包冒充官方包」这件事当场暴露。

目录结构

app/src/main/java/io/github/sweetpotato_digua/mbpu/     Hook、配置、Root、安全校验（Java）
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sweetpotato_digua/mbpu/   Compose UI（Miuix）
app/src/main/cpp/security.c                 native 安全层：反调试 + 签名比对 + 反注入
app/src/main/jniLibs/                       预编译 native 产物（arm64-v8a / armeabi-v7a / x86_64）
app/src/main/res/values*/strings.xml        20 种语言
app/src/main/resources/META-INF/xposed/     modern Xposed 模块声明
docs/screenshots/                           README 引用的界面截图
build.sh / build_native.sh                  构建脚本

已知限制
- 「文件与下载」「外部存储浏览」「相册媒体」是文件 / URI 级拦截。对已经拿到真实存储权限的应用，系统 fuse 层仍可能放行部分路径，屏蔽完整性不如系统级权限撤销
- 部分应用启动时会扫描存储，拿到空结果后可能闪退或停在启动页（应用内「温馨提示」有说明）
- ContentProviderClient.call(String method, String arg, Bundle) 这类拿不到 authority 的三参调用未拦截
- MediaRecorder 录音链路未 hook，只覆盖了 AudioRecord
- 不带 authority 的 applyBatch：全部命中屏蔽范围时返回伪成功；混合批次抛 OperationApplicationException 引导应用回滚
- 卸载应用后配置残留不会自动清理，重装同包名会继承旧配置

免责声明

仅供学习与个人隐私保护使用，请勿用于规避应用的风控、付费或授权机制。使用本模块造成的一切后果由使用者自行承担。

许可证

PolyForm Strict 1.0.0

本项目采用 PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 许可证：允许个人学习、研究、业余爱好等非商业用途，禁止分发、修改及基于本项目创建衍生作品。商业使用请通过 a285865818@outlook.com 联系获取授权。

modules.name: MultiRoute - per-app network channels
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: MultiRoute - per-app network channels
modules.readme:
MultiRoute

MultiRoute 是一个 Android LSPosed 模块，提供分应用策略路由（支持主副 Wi-Fi、副卡数据与以太网）、个人热点上游选择与无线调试辅助。分流使用 Linux 内核策略路由，不使用用户态 VPN 转发。
本仓库存放模块索引说明和发布资源。源码、完整文档与问题反馈请访问 Linoleic/MultiRoute。

功能
- 分应用策略路由：为每个应用独立指定网络通道（主 Wi-Fi、副 Wi-Fi、蜂窝移动数据、以太网），支持应用分身与工作资料独立分流；基于 Linux 内核策略路由实现，不走用户态 VPN。
- 副 Wi-Fi 接入支持：提供自动、小米专用、AOSP 与 Root 直连方案辅助连接副 Wi-Fi，按 BSSID 与频段区分同名接入点，作为独立分流通道。
- 副卡数据通道：在双卡设备上激活非默认数据卡通道，支持将应用或场景按稳定 SIM 标识绑定分流。
- 个人热点上游选择：重定向个人热点出口至蜂窝数据、副 Wi-Fi 或系统默认网络，并显示实际出口。
- 场景方案与策略：按网络条件或手动切换分流方案，支持优先级叠加、通道故障自动降级、恢复延迟与局域网直连放行。
- DNS 改写与诊断：将被指派应用的 IPv4 UDP/TCP 53 端口流量改写到所选通道解析器；支持通道与模块状态诊断及日志导出。
- 无线调试辅助：提供原生 TLS 与传统 TCP 双模式无线调试控制、自定义端口、电脑连接状态感知与安全开机恢复。
- 配置备份与恢复：支持导入预览、按类别恢复与旧版配置迁移；导出不含 Wi-Fi 密码。

运行环境

| 项目 | 要求 |
| :-- | :-- |
| Root | KernelSU / Magisk / APatch |
| Xposed 框架 | LSPosed，或实现 LibXposed API 101+ 的兼容框架 |
| Android | Android 11 及以上；AOSP Multi-Internet 连接方案要求 Android 13 及以上 |
| 模块作用域 | 系统框架；热点功能还需设备对应的 NetworkStack / Tethering 包 |

NetworkStack / Tethering 包包括 com.android.networkstack、com.android.networkstack.tethering、com.google.android.networkstack 和 com.google.android.networkstack.tethering，仅启用设备中存在的对应作用域。

使用说明与限制

1. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块及所需作用域，然后重启设备。更新模块 APK 后也需重启以加载新代码；修改应用分流规则无需重启。
2. AOSP / 通用 Multi-Internet 方案仅连接系统已保存的网络；首次连接前，请先在系统 Wi-Fi 设置中保存。
3. 双 Wi-Fi 与热点并发取决于硬件、固件和 ROM。Root 不会增加硬件并发能力，息屏连接也受系统策略影响。
4. 副卡数据通道与双数据并发取决于芯片平台、Modem 固件与运营商网络支持（DSDA 双卡双通）。
5. 热点上游由 Android 异步重选；转发、NAT、IPv6 和硬件卸载由系统管理，实际行为受设备和运营商策略影响。
6. IPv6 DNS、Private DNS（DoT）和 DoH 不改写。VPN 下的流量与 DNS 路径取决于 VPN 模式和策略。
7. 开机恢复用于重建路由规则，不会建立副 Wi-Fi 连接；恢复时间取决于网络是否就绪。无线调试开机恢复受限于首次解锁保护与指定 Wi-Fi 环境，且不参与配置备份。

相关链接
- 下载与版本发布
- 完整中文说明
- Full English Documentation
- 版本更新日志
- 问题反馈
- LSPosed 模块索引

English

MultiRoute is an Android LSPosed module providing per-app policy routing (primary/secondary Wi-Fi, secondary SIM data channels, and Ethernet), hotspot upstream selection, and a wireless debugging helper. Routing uses Linux kernel policy rules without userspace VPN forwarding.
This repository hosts module index information and releases. Visit Linoleic/MultiRoute for source code, full documentation and issue reports.

Features
- Per-app policy routing: Select primary Wi-Fi, secondary Wi-Fi, cellular, or Ethernet for each app, including clones and work profiles; uses Linux kernel policy routing without userspace VPN forwarding.
- Secondary Wi-Fi support: Provide Auto, Xiaomi, AOSP, and Root Direct schemes to connect to secondary Wi-Fi, distinguishing same-SSID access points by BSSID and band as an independent routing channel.
- Secondary SIM data channel: Activate non-default data SIM channels on dual-SIM devices, routing assigned apps or scenarios by stable in-device SIM identity.
- Hotspot upstream selection: Redirect hotspot upstream traffic to cellular, secondary Wi-Fi, or the system default network, displaying the actual upstream.
- Scenario plans and policies: Switch routing plans based on network conditions or manually; support priority layering, fallback on channel unavailability, recovery delay, and on-link LAN bypass.
- DNS redirection and diagnostics: Redirect assigned apps' IPv4 UDP/TCP port 53 traffic to the selected channel's resolver; display channel and module status, and export diagnostic logs.
- Wireless debugging helper: Provide Native TLS and Legacy TCP dual-mode controls, custom listening ports, connected workstation detection, and secure boot recovery.
- Configuration backup and restore: Preview imports, restore by category, and migrate older configs; exported files omit Wi-Fi passwords.

Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
| :-- | :-- |
| Root | KernelSU / Magisk / APatch |
| Xposed framework | LSPosed, or a compatible framework implementing LibXposed API 101+ |
| Android | Android 11 or later; the AOSP Multi-Internet scheme requires Android 13 or later |
| Module scope | System framework; hotspot features also require the device's NetworkStack / Tethering packages |

NetworkStack / Tethering packages include com.android.networkstack, com.android.networkstack.tethering, com.google.android.networkstack and com.google.android.networkstack.tethering. Enable the corresponding scopes that exist on the device.

Usage and Limitations

1. Enable the module and required scopes in LSPosed, then reboot. Reboot after updating the module APK to load new code; changing app routing rules does not require a reboot.
2. AOSP / generic Multi-Internet schemes connect only to system-saved networks. Save a new network in system Wi-Fi settings first.
3. Dual Wi-Fi and hotspot concurrency depend on hardware, firmware and ROM. Root cannot add hardware concurrency, and screen-off connections remain subject to system policy.
4. Secondary SIM data channels and dual-data concurrency depend on SoC, modem firmware, and carrier network capabilities (DSDA).
5. Android reselects the hotspot upstream asynchronously and manages forwarding, NAT, IPv6 and hardware offload. Results depend on device and carrier policy.
6. IPv6 DNS, Private DNS (DoT) and DoH are not rewritten. Traffic and DNS paths with a VPN depend on its mode and policy.
7. Boot recovery rebuilds routing rules without establishing secondary Wi-Fi connections; timing depends on network availability. Wireless debugging boot recovery is subject to first-unlock protection and designated Wi-Fi networks, and is excluded from configuration backups.

modules.readme:
OnePlusPlusLauncher

Focused LSPosed enhancements for OnePlus System Launcher

OnePlusPlusLauncher is a small, open-source libxposed module for improving app-drawer search on OxygenOS. The current source intentionally supports only OnePlus System Launcher 16.6.9 (160060009) on Android 13 or newer.

Features
- Swipe-up search autofocus — focuses app-drawer search and opens the keyboard automatically.
- Enter-key launch — launches the highlighted result from the keyboard's Search or Go action.
- Ranked fuzzy search — preserves OnePlus pinyin, alias, DMP, multi-user, and privacy-aware results while adding typo-tolerant title matches.
- Global-search-button redirect — opens focused app-drawer search instead of the external global-search application.
- Swipe-down search redirect — opens focused app-drawer search when the home-screen swipe-down action targets Global Search.

Every feature has an independent toggle in a single Material 3 configuration screen and defaults to enabled.

Requirements
- OnePlus System Launcher 16.6.9
- Android 13+
- Root with an API-101-compatible LSPosed implementation

Compatibility with older launcher releases is not maintained. Launcher updates may change internal classes or methods and require a module update.

Installation

1. Install the module APK.
2. Enable OnePlusPlusLauncher in LSPosed.
3. Select System Launcher (com.android.launcher) in its scope.
4. Restart System Launcher.
5. Open OnePlusPlusLauncher to configure the five features.

The Ready status confirms that LSPosed is reachable and System Launcher is selected. It cannot directly prove that the manager toggle is enabled or that the launcher process has loaded the hooks.

Architecture
- The configuration app is one Jetpack Compose Material 3 screen.
- libxposed remote preferences are the only settings store.
- HookEntry installs exact, fail-closed reflection hooks in the launcher process.
- The fuzzy ranker is pure Kotlin and unit tested independently from Android and the launcher.
- Decompiled launcher sources and APKs stay local under the ignored decompiled/ directory.

See Hook maintenance for the current target descriptors and adaptation workflow.

Source mirrors

Development happens in the canonical repository. Every verified master commit is mirrored to the Xposed Modules Repository; releases continue to be published there separately.

Building

Use JDK 17 and run:

./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug assembleRelease

Local release builds are unsigned when signing credentials are unavailable. CI accepts the following secrets for signed releases:
- SIGNING_KEY_STORE_BASE64
- SIGNING_KEY_ALIAS
- SIGNING_KEY_STORE_PASSWORD
- SIGNING_KEY_PASSWORD

Disclaimer

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by OnePlus, OPPO, or Google. It modifies another application at runtime; use it at your own risk.

License

modules.name: Quest 2 Touch on Quest 3
modules.author: LiterallyAxo
modules.description: Lets Quest 2 Touch controllers pair and track on a Quest 3. Requires Magisk OverlayFS.
modules.readme:
Quest 2 Touch on Quest 3

A Magisk module that lets Quest 2 Touch controllers pair and track on a Quest 3.

How It Works

The Quest 3 already supports Quest 2 controllers internally, but a few software checks block them. This module turns those checks off so the controllers can pair and track normally.

The full technical breakdown is in WRITEUP.md.

Safety
- Your system files are never modified. Uninstalling the module returns the headset to stock.
- The installer checks your firmware first and refuses to install if it is not supported.
- The module turns itself off after a system update. Reinstall it to re-enable.

Requirements
- Quest 3 rooted with Magisk
- Magisk OverlayFS (built into Singularity)

Quest 3S and other headsets are not tested, and therefore not supported officially.
If you have the capability to test this on a 3S or similar, you can fork this and attempt to get it working.

Install

1. Download q2touch_on_q3.zip from Releases and flash it in Magisk.
2. Reboot and pair your controllers.

To confirm it is working, run the command below. The output should start with armed:.

adb shell getprop debug.q2touch.state

Known Issue: Rebooting

Before rebooting/during boot, unpair the controllers or take out their batteries.

Root is applied to the Quest 3 after it has already booted, either automatically with auto root enabled or manually through the Singularity app.

Until that happens, the module is not active. If the controllers try to connect during this time the headset's tracking service will keep crashing until Magisk applies the module. Reconnect the controllers once root is applied.

Building From Source

Requires Android NDK r26 or newer.

./build.sh

Disclaimer

This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Meta. Use it at your own risk.

License

Released under the MIT License. Copyright (c) 2026 Axo (@LiterallyAxo).

AI assistance was used in the development of this project.
