modules.name: SCR01 SMS Receive
modules.author: Earrmouth / Aaron
modules.description: Adds SMS send and receive to the SCR01 (SCR01KDU1AVK2).
modules.readme:
SCR01 SMS Receive

A minimal KernelSU module that brings SMS send and receive back to the SCR01.

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · 한국어

Requirements

| Item | Requirement |
| --- | --- |
| Device | Samsung SCR-01 / SM-H412J |
| Firmware | SCR01KDU1AVK2 exact match (hard-checked by every script) |
| Android | 11 |
| Root | Required; not rooted yet? Use SCRoot for one-click rooting |
| SIM | Any operator; the IMS APN follows the inserted SIM |

/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox must be available (bundled with SCRoot / KernelSU-Next).

How it works

The stock firmware ships config_sms_capable=false, so the SMS role does not exist in the system and no SMS app can start. On every boot the module automatically:

1. Ensures Fossify Messages is installed — fetched from the official release (pinned URL + SHA256) when absent; an installed copy is never replaced;
2. Turns the SMS capability back on through Samsung's own theme-overlay channel;
3. Bootstraps the SMS role and grants it to Fossify;
4. Restarts the phone process once to refresh the receive cache, then configures the IMS APN and the volte/smsip switches (best effort, never fatal);
5. If Surfing is installed and enabled, inserts a RETURN for system UID 1000 at the head of its four local proxy/DNS chains so IMS registration is not caught by TPROXY. Surfing rebuilds those chains on every service restart, so a boot-time watch puts the rule back within a few seconds and stops when Surfing is disabled or removed; rollback deletes it by its comment. The bypass covers every flow owned by UID 1000, not only IMS.

Failures only log; the next boot retries. Every change is runtime state with per-item journaling, no partition is modified, and rollback.sh restores everything. The only visible side effect is the system accent color switching to Cinnamon.

Install

adb push SCR01-SMS-Receive-v0.1.2.zip /data/local/tmp/
adb shell "su -c 'ksud module install /data/local/tmp/SCR01-SMS-Receive-v0.1.2.zip'"
adb reboot

Allow 2-3 minutes after reboot; an Active: line in /data/adb/scr01_sms_receive_state/run.log means success.

Known limitations
- Roughly 2-3 minutes after each reboot, sends may report "no service" — just wait.
- Sending depends on IMS registration (receiving is unaffected); if a broken 5G configuration keeps IMS from registering, re-run the appendix procedure and reboot.
- The phone process restarts once per boot; mobile data or hotspot may blip for a few seconds.
- volte being enabled does not imply voice calling works.
- Roll back before swapping SIM cards.

Rollback and uninstall

Restore everything (role, switches, APN, overlay, binds); the module stays
adb shell "su -c '/data/adb/ksu/bin/busybox sh /data/adb/modules/scr01_sms_receive/rollback.sh'"

To remove entirely: roll back first, then uninstall in the KernelSU manager

Reboot once after rollback to clear the phone process cache; the state directory is intentionally preserved for inspection and can be deleted once verified.

Appendix: enabling 5G (Samsung service mode)

The device camps on 4G by default; the procedure below enables 5G (including SA) at the modem level and takes effect after a reboot:

1. Settings → About → Status → Phone number — tap it quickly 10 times to enter DRParser Mode;
2. Type *#0011# to enter Service Mode;
3. Tap the top-right menu → tap Back once → tap Key input;
4. Enter an uppercase Q and confirm, then wait about a minute for the main menu;
5. Navigate [2] UE SETTING & INFO → [1] SETTING → [1] PROTOCOL → [9] NR → [2] allow list control → [2] allow list off (shows APLY success); tap the top-right menu, tap Back twice to return to the parent list;
6. Enter [1] nr5g sa/nsa mode control → [1] sa/nsa enable and reboot the device when prompted.

To type an uppercase Q on the default 9-key IME: tap the globe icon at the bottom-left to switch to English, tap A/a for uppercase, then tap PQRS twice.

Credits
- Based on the SCR01 SMS module shared by Earrmouth (https://github.com/earrmouth)
- Fossify Messages:  (GPL-3.0, distributed from the official releases)
- Root environment: SCRoot / KernelSU-Next, provided by the device; this module contains no root components of its own.
- The overlay candidate derives from this firmware's own theme overlay with only bool/config_sms_capable=true added; all other rights remain with their respective owners.
modules.changelog:
Adds SMS send and receive to the Samsung SCR01 (SCR01KDU1AVK2).
- Turns config_sms_capable back on through the mutable Cinnamon overlay (init-namespace bind + idmap reset)
- Bootstraps the Fossify Messages SMS role; fetches Fossify from its official release when absent
- Owned IMS APN follows the inserted SIM; volte/smsip best effort
- Once-per-boot phone restart after the home activity resumes; full rollback included
- Sending works on both LTE and 5G SA once IMS registers (see README appendix for the 5G service-mode procedure)
- README in English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean

New in 0.1.2: when Surfing is installed and enabled, keeps IMS registration out of its TPROXY path. A RETURN for system UID 1000 is inserted at the head of Surfing's four local proxy/DNS chains and re-inserted within a few seconds whenever Surfing rebuilds them; the watch stops when Surfing is disabled or removed, and rollback deletes the rules by their comment. The bypass covers every flow owned by UID 1000, not only IMS, and does nothing on devices without Surfing.

SHA256: fc5853f15cd096c7a5c81bd29678d7ce69b754f9327295158e32d275eceb4cfd

Requires a rooted SCR01 on firmware SCR01KDU1AVK2 — see the README for install, rollback and known limitations.

modules.name: SonyCamStereoEnabler
modules.author: SmArT-32-projects
modules.description: An Xposed module that restores stereo audio recording capabilities in Sony Camera and Video Pro apps when using custom ROMs.
modules.readme:
Sony Camera Stereo Enabler for Xperia Devices

Sony Camera Stereo Enabler is an Xposed module designed to restore stereo audio recording capabilities in official Sony Camera apps when running on custom ROMs (such as LineageOS, crDroid, EvolutionX, etc.) on Sony Xperia devices.

Features
- Restores Stereo Recording: Enables true stereo audio capture in "All Directions" mode.
- UI Fixes: Ensures input level (VU) meters display correctly where applicable.
- Smart Switching: Maintains the ability to toggle between "Voice Priority" (Mono/Rear) and "All Directions" (Stereo) within the camera settings.
- Universal Compatibility: Supports Camera, Video Pro and Cinema Pro apps including various modded versions and clones (package names starting with jp.co.sony.mc.camera, jp.co.sony.mc.videopro and com.sonymobile.cinemapro).

When to Use This Module
You should use this module only if you are experiencing a bug where the camera app records mono sound from the rear microphone regardless of the settings chosen in the UI. This is a common issue on AOSP-based ROMs where the Sony hardware abstraction layer (HAL) and AOSP audio routing are not handled correctly by the app's standard logic.

Common Unsolved Issues
- External Microphones: Audio recording via the 3.5mm jack is currently not working. This is a common limitation of custom ROMs for Xperia devices and is not caused by this module.
- 4K @ 60 FPS in Camera "Basic" Mode: Video recording at 4K 60 FPS is not functional in the Camera app when using the Basic video mode. This is an app/ROM compatibility issue and is not caused by this module either. However, 4K 60 FPS works perfectly fine in the Video Pro mode (both in the standalone Video Pro app and the Video Pro mode integrated within the Camera app) and in the Cinema Pro app.
- Rear Mic Noise: In "Voice Priority" mode, the recording might contain audible noise from the Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) system. This is a hardware design characteristic of Xperia devices.

Note: While I cannot fix the hardware-induced OIS noise, I may investigate the first two issues (External Mic and 4K60 Basic Mode) in the future if there is community interest.

Installation
1. Ensure you have Magisk (or KernelSU/APatch) and the LSPosed Framework installed.
2. Download and install the module's APK.
3. Open the LSPosed Manager and activate the module.
4. Select your Sony Camera app (Camera, Video Pro, or Cinema Pro) in the module's scope.

Compatibility
Theoretically compatible with all Xperia devices on custom ROMs where the stereo recording bug is present.

Feedback and Contributions
If you encounter a bug or have a suggestion, please open an issue!
- Report a Bug

Credits
- Thanks to tongyuantongyu for the code refactoring and Cinema Pro support.

modules.name: Sound-Tweaks
modules.author: MrRaita
modules.description: LSPosed/Vector module to replace Android system sounds (keyboard, touch, screenshot, lock/unlock, charging, dock) with your own sounds.
modules.readme:
Sound Tweaks

🇬🇧 English · 🇹🇷 Türkçe

Sound Tweaks is an LSPosed module that changes Android system sounds (keyboard, touch, screenshot, lock screen, charging, dock).

No system files are modified. The chosen sounds are kept in a separate store and only the sound path is redirected inside the relevant system processes; when the module is disabled or the sounds are reset, the system returns to its own defaults.

Features
- Pick sounds inside the app instead of by file path: from system sounds, from your own file, or by muting.
- A playable library that scans and lists the system sound directories.
- Per-sound normalization (global, off, or a custom target level); peaks are limited with a soft limiter.
- Show and change the state of the system switches for touch, lock screen and charging sounds (including the ringer mode and volume levels).
- Optional "force play" mode: lock sounds are played on the media stream so they are audible in silent/vibrate mode.
- An option to turn off the loud-volume (hearing protection) warning shown with headphones; no hook is added to the system, a tiny script that runs at boot is used instead.
- A diagnostic report (file permissions, settings, hook status, SELinux denials).

Supported sounds

| Group | Sounds | Method |
|---|---|---|
| Keyboard | Key, space, delete, enter, invalid key | system_server hook |
| Touch and screen | Touch click, screenshot | system_server hook, SystemUI hook |
| Lock screen | Lock, unlock, trusted device | Settings.Global path (default), optional SystemUI hook |
| Charging and battery | Low battery, charging, wireless charging | Settings.Global path |
| Dock | Desk/car dock, undock | Settings.Global path |

Camera, video recording, NFC and reverse-charging sounds are played in processes other than system_server and SystemUI, so they are out of scope (see Known limitations).

Requirements
- Android 9 (API 28) or newer
- Root (KernelSU, Magisk or APatch); no extra module is needed. For the headphone warning option, the root manager must run the scripts in /data/adb/post-fs-data.d (all three do)
- An LSPosed framework that supports libxposed API 101 (for example Vector)

Development and test environment: Nothing Phone (4a), Nothing OS 4.1, Android 16, KernelSU, Vector 2.2.

Why root is required

The hooks themselves run inside the system processes through LSPosed and do not need root. The app side does, because a normal app is not allowed to touch the places the system reads sounds from:

| What the app does | Why it needs root |
|---|---|
| Writes the chosen sound files to /data/system/soundtweaks | Apps cannot write to /data/system, and the files must carry the system_file SELinux label so system_server and SystemUI can read them |
| Points lock_sound, unlock_sound, low_battery_sound and the other Settings.Global sound paths at those files | Writing Settings.Global needs the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission, which normal apps cannot get |
| Changes the system switches (touch sounds, lock screen sounds, charging sounds) | Same permission as above |
| Refreshes SystemUI so lock sounds are reloaded | Stopping another process requires root |
| Turns off the headphone volume warning | The three properties must be set by a script that runs at boot, before the system starts; this is only possible from /data/adb |
| Builds the diagnostic report | Reading file labels, system settings and SELinux denials requires root |

Browsing the sound library and playing previews do not need root; those read world-readable system directories. In practice the root requirement adds little on top of LSPosed, which needs root to work in the first place.

Installation

1. Download the APK from the repository's Releases page and install it.
2. Open the app and grant Sound Tweaks superuser access in your root manager.
3. Enable Sound Tweaks in the Vector (LSPosed) manager and add System Framework and System UI to its scope.
4. Reboot the device.
5. The Vector card on the app's Settings tab should show that the hooks are active.

Usage
- Sounds: Tapping a sound opens the options: choose from system sounds, choose your own file, mute, or reset to default. Files are decoded and written to the store as WAV.
- Library: The system sounds that were found can be filtered, searched with the search icon, and played.
- Advanced: System sound switches, audio processing (global and per-sound normalization), force-playing lock sounds, and turning off the headphone warning.
- Settings: Status cards (Root and Vector module), theme and colors, bottom bar layout, tools (SystemUI refresh, diagnostic report).

How it works

Sound store

The chosen sounds are written under /data/system/soundtweaks through root and labeled with the world-readable system_file SELinux context.
- override/.: files the hooks redirect to
- files/.: files that Settings.Global paths point to

The context is re-applied every time the app opens and every time a sound is written. If a system update rewrites the file contexts, opening the app once is enough.

Hooks

Written against libxposed API 101 (minApiVersion = targetApiVersion = 101). The entry class is com.mrraita.soundtwks.hook.SoundTweaksModule; the metadata lives under app/src/main/resources/META-INF/xposed/.

| Process | Class / method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| system_server | SoundEffectsHelper.getResourceFilePath | Redirects keyboard and touch sound paths |
| SystemUI | ScreenshotSoundProviderImpl.getScreenshotSound | Replaces the screenshot sound |
| SystemUI | KeyguardViewMediator.playSounds, playTrustedSound | Plays lock sounds, only in "force play" mode |

On the Vector card, the "Framework" row shows Vector's own API version and the "Module API" row shows the API Sound Tweaks was built against (101); it is normal for them to differ. Every hook sits in its own try/catch; on failure the stock behavior continues....
modules.changelog:
Sound Tweaks changes Android's system sounds (keyboard, touch, screenshot, lock/unlock, charging, dock) to any sound you choose: another system sound, your own file, or silence. It is an LSPosed/Vector module with a companion app. No system files are modified, and resetting a sound or disabling the module restores the stock behavior.

Key features
- Replace each system sound with a system sound, your own audio file, or silence
- Per-sound volume normalization with soft peak limiting
- Optional "force play" so lock sounds are audible in silent/vibrate mode
- Optional removal of the headphone loud-volume warning (boot script, no hook)
- Diagnostic report for troubleshooting

Requirements: Android 9+, root (KernelSU/Magisk/APatch), Vector (LSPosed).

Tested on: Nothing Phone (4a), Nothing OS 4.1 (Android 16). Other ROMs may work partially.

Sound Tweaks, Android sistem seslerini (klavye, dokunma, ekran görüntüsü, kilit açma/kapama, şarj, dock) dilediğiniz sesle değiştirir: başka bir sistem sesi, kendi dosyanız ya da sessiz. Bir LSPosed/Vector modülü ve yönetim uygulamasıdır. Sistem dosyalarına dokunmaz; bir sesi sıfırladığınızda ya da modülü kapattığınızda stok davranış geri gelir.

Test edilen cihaz: Nothing Phone (4a), Nothing OS 4.1 (Android 16). Diğer ROM'larda kısmen çalışabilir.

Three Finger Swipe

  Xposed module that adds a configurable three-finger swipe-down gesture for screenshots and system actions.

Features

Toki

English | 中文 | Changelog | 更新日志 | Telegram

Toki is a libxposed API 102 enhancement module implemented and tested for official TikTok 46.4.3.
It only targets com.zhiliaoapp.musically.

Features
- Region and environment spoofing: choose region presets with country codes and carrier
  information, and independently spoof GPS, system language, and system time zone.
- Startup login prompt: close the dismissible prompt shown during startup without bypassing
  login or verification.
- Download enhancements: remove download restrictions, prefer watermark-free saving for all
  videos, and set separate save locations for videos, images, and GIFs.
- Feed filtering: hide ads, livestreams, photo posts, AI-generated content, trending-topic bars,
  content ratings, and long videos; filter by view or like count.
- Duet and Stitch: allow restricted content to be used for Duet or Stitch. When looping is
  disabled, playback pauses at the end and can be replayed with one tap.
- Playback controls: automatically apply 1.25x to 2.0x to each new video without overriding a
  manual speed choice, and optionally keep the progress bar visible on videos under 30 seconds.
- Feed display: optionally show the author's region code with its matching country flag.
- Comment translation: show Translate and Revert controls in comments and preserve translation
  state across videos.
- Page purification: independently hide author avatar and information, descriptions, music,
  action buttons, navigation, search, LIVE, commercial, creative, movie, anime, and game
  entrances, feedback surveys, safety warnings, Tako, translation controls, and the system
  status bar.
- Count ranges: enter full numbers or compact suffixes such as 20K and 1.5M directly.
- Metric range fields preserve the exact text entered while filtering uses the parsed count.
- Home dashboard: view LSPosed service and TikTok version status, restart TikTok, clear only its
  cache with Root, reset Toki settings, and open the project community and issue tracker.
- Material 3 settings UI with dark mode, dynamic color, and manual Follow System, English, and
  Chinese language switching.

Requirements
- Android 8.0 or later
- An LSPosed implementation that supports libxposed API 102
- Official TikTok 46.4.3 with package name com.zhiliaoapp.musically. Other versions are outside
  the support scope and receive no version-specific compatibility work or guarantees.
- The module APK is architecture-independent.

Installation

1. Download the APK from Releases.
2. Install it, enable Toki in LSPosed, and select the TikTok scope.
3. Open Home in Toki and tap Restart TikTok after changing settings. Restart TikTok manually when
   Root access is unavailable.

Root is used only when you explicitly choose Restart TikTok or Clear TikTok Cache on Home. Cache
clearing preserves TikTok accounts, settings, drafts, and app data.

Community: Telegram group

Reporting Issues
- Use the Bug Report form
  for reproducible failures. Include the Toki, TikTok, Android, device, and LSPosed versions,
  exact reproduction steps, relevant settings, and sanitized LSPosed module logs.
- Use the Feature Request form
  for concrete improvements based on an actual use case.
- Use the Telegram group for general discussion and help identifying
  a problem before filing it. Do not post account data, tokens, cookies, or unredacted private logs.

Privacy

Toki declares no network permissions and contains no analytics, telemetry, remote updates, or
promotional entry points. Settings are stored only on the device.

Build

JDK 21, Android SDK Platform 37.0, and Build Tools 37.0.0 are required.

.\gradlew.bat testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleDebug

Without signing environment variables, assembleRelease produces an unsigned APK. For a signed
release, set the following variables and run
.\gradlew.bat clean testDebugUnitTest lintDebug assembleRelease:

TOKI_KEYSTORE_FILE
TOKI_STORE_PASSWORD
TOKI_KEY_ALIAS
TOKI_KEY_PASSWORD

Origin and License

The project originally used the MIT-licensed project structure of
TiktokPatchXposed. Toki's implementation has
since been rewritten. This repository contains neither a TikTok APK nor decompiled source code.

This project is released under the MIT License. Licenses for dependencies and build
tools are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Disclaimer

This project is intended only for learning, research, and use on personal devices. It is not
affiliated with or endorsed by TikTok, ByteDance, or LSPosed. TikTok updates can break
compatibility; make sure your use complies with local law and the applicable terms of service.

中文

Toki 是面向官方 TikTok 46.4.3 实现并完成测试的 libxposed API 102 功能增强模块，仅作用于
com.zhiliaoapp.musically。其他版本不在支持范围内，不提供专门适配或兼容保证。

- 地区与环境伪装：选择预设地区（含国家/地区码与运营商信息），可独立伪装 GPS、系统语言和系统时区，并可强制指定地区。

- 合拍与拼接：允许受限内容合拍或拼接；关闭循环播放后视频进入暂停状态，单击即可重播。

modules.name: VirtualNet
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: VirtualNet
modules.readme:
VirtualNet

Choose what each app sees: Wi-Fi, mobile data, or both.

An open-source Xposed module for Android 9 and up, by DroidRooter.
This repository is the Xposed module listing for VirtualNet. Source code, issues and full documentation are at github.com/saadnahid7/VirtualNet.

Why VirtualNet

Some apps only work, or only download, when they think you are on Wi-Fi. Others insist on mobile data. VirtualNet lets you decide, per app, what the app is told about your connection, without changing the connection itself.
- A phone on mobile data can look like it is on Wi-Fi to one app.
- A phone on Wi-Fi can look like it is on mobile data to another.
- Everything else on the phone sees the truth.

Your real traffic never changes. Only the answers an app gets when it asks "what am I connected to?" change.

Table of contents
- Features
- Modes
- Coverage: system framework or inside the app
- Requirements
- Installation
- Usage
- What it covers
- Compatibility
- Limits
- FAQ
- Lab app
- Building
- Project layout
- Open source
- Contributing
- Disclaimer
- Acknowledgements
- From DroidRooter
- License

Features
- Per-app control. Pick Wi-Fi, Data, Both or Off for each app in one list. Changes apply live, with no reboot.
- One coherent identity. SSID, router MAC, local IP and range, gateway, DNS, signal, link speed, frequency, mobile type and interface all come from one editable profile, so an app that cross-checks sees a consistent network.
- System-level coverage. Hooks inside system_server and the phone process cover every app you pick, callbacks included, without scoping each app.
- Inside-the-app coverage. Optional hooks in a scoped app also cover socket addresses, network interfaces and Wi-Fi scan results.
- Choose your layer. A switch selects System, Apps or Both.
- Small and quiet. About 120 KB, no network permission, no ads, no analytics, no accounts.
- Verifiable. A detector app (built from source) shows exactly what an app would see, so you can check a change in seconds.

Modes

| Mode | The app is told |
|---|---|
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi connected and not metered. Mobile data disconnected. |
| Data | Mobile data connected and metered. Wi-Fi off and disconnected. |
| Both | Wi-Fi is the default network and mobile data is also connected. |
| Off | Nothing is changed. |

Coverage: system framework or inside the app

VirtualNet has two layers. A switch on the main screen chooses which one works.

| Setting | What runs | Scope you add in Vector or LSPosed |
|---|---|---|
| System | Hooks in the system framework only | System Framework and Phone Services |
| Apps | Hooks inside each app only | Each app you pick |
| Both *(default)* | Both layers | System Framework and Phone Services, plus apps for socket and interface checks |

Use Apps if you would rather not touch the system framework, or on a ROM where the system layer does not attach. Android 9 defaults to Apps.

Requirements
- A rooted device with an LSPosed-compatible framework that supports the modern libxposed API 102, such as Vector or a recent LSPosed.
- Android 9 or newer (API 28 and up). See Compatibility for what has been verified.

VirtualNet is built on the modern libxposed API. Legacy Xposed and EdXposed are not supported.

Installation

1. Download the latest APK from Releases and install it.
2. Open Vector or LSPosed, enable VirtualNet, and add System Framework and Phone Services to its scope. VirtualNet offers this on first launch.
3. Restart the device, or its framework, once so the system hooks load.
4. Open VirtualNet and pick a mode for an app. No restart is needed after that.

Prefer to work only inside apps? Set Coverage to Apps, then scope each app instead.

Usage

1. Open VirtualNet and look at the status pill. Active means the framework is connected.
2. Tap a mode on any app row: Wi-Fi, Data, Both or Off.
3. Open the app you changed. If it was already running, close it once so it asks again.
4. To change what the fake network looks like, tap a profile card and edit it.

The recommendation banner has a Hide button if you do not want it.

What it covers

| Area | System layer | Inside a scoped app |
|---|:---:|:---:|
| Network capabilities, transport, metered flag, link properties, callbacks | yes | yes |
| Legacy network info and the network list | yes | yes |
| Wi-Fi state, connection info, DHCP | yes | yes |
| Mobile network type and data state | yes | yes |
| A stand-in cellular network in Both mode | yes | yes |
| Socket local address, network interfaces | no | yes |
| Wi-Fi scan results, Settings.Global | no | yes |

Compatibility

| Android | API | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 17 | 37 | Verified |
| 16 | 36 | Verified |
| 15 | 35 | Verified on a real device |
| 14 | 34 | Verified |
| 13 | 33 | Verified |
| 12 | 31 | Verified |
| 11 | 30 | Verified |
| 10 | 29 | Verified |
| 9 | 28 | Unverified. Supported by the app, but not yet confirmed on a working framework. |

"Verified" means the Wi-Fi, Data, Both and Off modes were checked with the Lab app on a rooted Vector setup, for both the system layer and the inside-the-app layer. Details are in docs/TESTING.md.

Limits
- Anything outside the Java framework sees the real network: raw sockets, native code and server-side checks such as your public IP, latency or carrier attestation.
- Both mode adds a stand-in cellular network. A callback registered for a cellular request does not fire for it.
- Status bar and quick settings are unchanged.
- After installing or updating the module, restart the framework once so the system hooks reload.
- Android 9 is unverified, see above.

FAQ

Does it change my real connection?
No. It only changes what selected apps are told.

Will it make a Wi-Fi-only download work over mobile data?
The app will believe it is on Wi-Fi and proceed. The data still uses your mobile connection.

Do I have to add every app to scope?
Not with System or Both coverage. Add an app to scope only if you want socket and interface checks covered too....

WXEntry · 微信增强模块（内核版）
📢 快来频道一起聊天：https://t.me/Wxentry

面向 微信 8.0.80 的 Xposed 模块：安装后只是一个「引导器」，内核从服务器下发、加密加载，功能全部跑在内存里，不在本地留明文代码。

免费版装好即自动开通，不需要任何激活码；高级版 / VIP 打赏后获取激活码解锁。

支持版本：微信 8.0.80（versionCode 3220） —— 其它版本内核自检后直接停用并弹提示，不会干扰微信。

装好后长按微信首页右上角 ＋ →「微信增强」，所有功能都在里面开关，默认全关，按需打开。

功能

💬 聊天
- 防撤回 —— 对方撤回的消息留在本地，原消息后标注「（已撤回）」；撤回的图片、视频、文件、语音都能正常打开
- 语音防撤回 + 批量转发语音 —— 一条语音可转发到多个会话，自动排队发送
- 自动下载原图 —— 收到图片自动下原图，独立开关，与防撤回互不影响
- 原图下载名单 —— 个人 / 群聊分开设白名单或黑名单，支持搜索
- 撤回图片备份 —— 撤回的图片留底，可在菜单里直接预览（不写相册、不需要存储权限）
- 一键已读 —— 所有会话未读清零，不会把公众号拉出分组
- 未读快捷已读 —— 长按微信主页左下角「微信」页签，直接打开微信原生的未读聊天列表，右下角多一个「一键已读」按钮（适配浅色 / 深色，执行期间防重复点击）
- 清空聊天列表 —— 按公众号 / 群聊 / 个人分类批量清理，可选连消息一起删
- 新群自动免打扰 · 公众号批量取关
- 真名 —— 群里直接显示成员真实备注名，按需查询、低功耗调度，关掉即恢复

🧧 红包 / 转账
- 抢红包 —— 免费版自动打开微信原生领取页并拆包（新旧页面都跟随微信）；高级版 / VIP 可选静默模式
- 名单 + 延时 —— 个人 / 群聊分别配置黑白名单，按秒数延时，不重复领
- 自动接收转账（高级版 / VIP）—— 到账以微信原生查询为准，不把提交成功当成到账
- 关键词过滤（VIP）—— 红包按祝福语、转账按备注设关键词：命中就跳过，或只处理命中的；支持模糊（包含）/ 精确（全等），与名单、延时同时生效

🌈 朋友圈
- 朋友圈防删 —— 别人删掉的动态在你这儿继续保留，标注「（这条朋友圈被删除啦）」，图片 / 评论 / 点赞都还在
- 一键转发（高级版 / VIP）—— 文字、图文、九宫格、短视频、链接、视频号卡片，准备好素材和文案直接带到发表页，发不发你自己点
- 朋友圈去广告（高级版 / VIP）—— 按原生标记过滤时间线广告，关掉刷新即恢复
- 伪集赞（高级版 / VIP）—— 微信原生点赞样式（爱心 + 好友姓名，点姓名进资料页）；支持搜索、全选、按人数随机抽选，不限制人数
- 伪评论（高级版 / VIP）—— 选好友逐人写内容或用预设，可长按编辑、删除，长列表可展开
- 定时发朋友圈（VIP）—— 文字 / 纯图片 / 图文任务，最多 9 张图，设定日期时间与可见范围（公开 / 仅自己可见）；到点通过微信原生图文通道发布，错过时间会先提醒你确认再补发
伪集赞 / 伪评论只在本机显示，不点赞、不评论、不通知对方，也不写微信数据库。

⚙️ 其他
- 发图默认勾选「原图」
- 平板模式 + 平板扫码登录（高级版 / VIP）
- 模拟相机扫码（实验功能） —— 扫一扫里从相册选一张二维码图片，自动改用相机通道识别；PC 登录码在相册通道被拒时可用（不支持长按识别）
- 设置菜单跟随微信深色模式（浅色粉白 / 深色深灰配玫粉）· 更新公告 · 内核检查更新 · 一键重启微信

版本区别

| | 免费版 | 高级版 | VIP |
|---|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| 价格 | 免费，无需激活码 | 打赏获取 | 打赏获取 |
| 聊天全部功能（防撤回 / 语音 / 原图 / 名单 / 已读 / 未读快捷已读 / 清列表 / 免打扰 / 取关 / 真名） | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| 红包前台自动领取 | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| 红包静默领取 | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| 自动接收转账 | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| 朋友圈四项（防删 / 转发 / 去广告 / 伪集赞·伪评论） | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| 平板模式与平板扫码登录 | — | ✓ | ✓ |
| 红包 / 转账关键词过滤 | — | — | ✓ |
| 定时发朋友圈 | — | — | ✓ |
| 模拟相机扫码（实验功能） | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |

安装

1. 环境：已 Root + LSPosed（Zygisk 版）；
2. 安装 APK；
3. 打开 LSPosed → 模块 → 勾选 WXEntry（APK 已声明推荐作用域，会自动推荐「微信」，确认勾上即可）；
4. 强制停止微信后重新打开。

开通与升级

免费版：装好就能用，不需要激活码。
安装 APK → LSPosed 勾选作用域 → 强制停止微信再打开，模块会自动开通免费版并下载内核（首次进入会多等几秒），之后长按 ＋ →「微信增强」即可使用全部免费功能。

高级版 / VIP：打赏后获取激活码。
1. 打开「微信增强」菜单，下滑到底部点「打赏」（或直接访问 https://www.zidianidc.com/shop/Z2EWXNI6 ）；
2. 打赏后在 Telegram 频道 https://t.me/Wxentry 领取对应版本的激活码；
3. 回到菜单：设置与支持 → 升级/更换激活码，粘贴激活码 → 激活，内核会自动切换到高级版 / VIP，按提示重启微信后生效。

激活码与微信号绑定（不绑设备）：同一微信号换手机仍然可用；换微信号需要新的激活码。

使用

1. 长按微信首页右上角 ＋ →「微信增强」；
2. 菜单分「聊天 / 红包 / 朋友圈 / 防撤回 / 设置与支持 / 实验功能」，下滑还能看到「打赏」「更新公告」；
3. 需要多层设置的（名单、关键词、评论预设）在对应子页里配置；
4. 有新内核时菜单里会出现更新提示，更新后重启微信生效。

关键词过滤（VIP）：菜单 → 红包 →「红包关键词过滤」/「转账关键词过滤」。每行一个词（最多 100 个、每个 200 字），两个滑块互斥：选「命中就跳过」则碰到词就不处理，选「只领取命中的」则只处理包含关键词的。只读红包祝福语 / 转账备注，规则改动从下一条消息开始生效。

平板模式（高级版 / VIP）：菜单 → 设置与支持 → 实验功能 → 平板模式 → 重启微信；登录页也能打开实验功能，用「平板扫码登录」。

定时发朋友圈（VIP）：菜单 → 朋友圈 → 定时发朋友圈。选文字 / 图片 / 图文（最多 9 张），设日期时间与「公开 / 仅自己可见」，点「保存并开启定时发布」即排程；任务列表里可查看、编辑、取消。到点需要微信在运行、已登录、有网络，模块用精确闹钟唤醒（不点亮屏幕）；如果错过了时间，任务会变成「待确认」，你在详情里点确认才会补发，不会自动重发。

常见问题

Q：免费版需要激活码吗？
A：不需要。装好后打开微信会自动开通免费版，全程不用填任何激活码；只有高级版 / VIP 需要打赏后获取激活码。

Q：怎么升级到高级版 / VIP？
A：菜单下滑到底部 →「打赏」，打赏后在频道 https://t.me/Wxentry 领取激活码，再到「设置与支持 → 升级/更换激活码」填入，功能立即生效（内核切换后按提示重启微信）。

Q：装上去没有任何功能？
A：① 确认微信是 8.0.80；② 确认 LSPosed 里勾选了模块并给了微信作用域；③ 免费版是自动开通的，若提示模块未启动，检查网络后彻底退出微信重开一次，并把模块更新到最新版本。

Q：朋友圈防删没生效？
A：菜单里「朋友圈防删」要处于「开」；只有别人的动态会保留，自己删自己的正常删除。

Q：开启防撤回后，撤回的视频 / 文件能看吗？
A：能。视频、短视频和附件会在撤回前留一份模块私有副本（默认 3 分钟内有效，单文件 256 MiB、总量 512 MiB 上限），超过期限未撤回的副本会自动清掉。

Q：免费版红包没自动领到？
A：① 自动领取依赖微信在前台；② 过期、领完、需要实名 / 验证的红包不会强行操作；③ 更新后请用新收到的红包复测，不会补领历史红包。

Q：伪集赞 / 伪评论会被对方看到吗？
A：不会。没有真实点赞、评论请求，好友不会收到通知，也不出现在对方朋友圈。

Q：定时发朋友圈为什么没准点发出去？
A：定时依赖微信进程在运行且网络可用；被系统冻结、清理后台或断网时无法保证准点，此时任务会转为「待确认」，你打开模块确认后才会补发。另外需要在系统里给微信「闹钟和提醒」权限，否则到点不会被唤醒。

Q：内核怎么更新？
A：微信启动 8 秒后后台比对版本；有新版时首页会出现横幅，或菜单里点「检查内核更新」。更新后重启微信生效。

Q：会不会收集聊天内容？
A：不会。除开通 / 内核下载与真名功能按需查询外，模块不向服务器上传任何聊天或朋友圈内容。

源码

加载器与内核源码发布在 vividbeacon43/io.github.vividbeacon43.wxentry（source/ 目录），与各版本 APK / 内核一一对应；不含签名密钥与激活记录。

已知限制

1. 仅支持微信 8.0.80（3220）；平板模式等高级功能需升级到高级版 / VIP 并把内核更新到当前版本；
2. 广告类朋友圈动态不保留；
3. 自己删自己的朋友圈不拦截；
4. 微信大版本升级后需要等待内核适配。

免责声明

本模块仅用于个人学习与备份自己设备上的消息内容，请勿用于商业用途或侵犯他人隐私。
使用产生的一切后果由使用者自行承担。

modules.name: Xiaomi Play Store Fix
modules.author: leapdragon
modules.description: Fixes Google Play Store crashes, stalled downloads and high CPU on Xiaomi/HyperOS ROMs with a buggy built-in Cronet (libcronet in the Tethering APEX). Zygisk only; no Xposed/LSPosed/Vector.
modules.readme:
Xiaomi Play Store Fix

Fixes the Google Play Store on Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO phones running HyperOS or MIUI
(stock, Global, EEA or Xiaomi.eu) where it:
- crashes randomly while browsing or updating apps,
- gets stuck partway through downloads,
- pins the CPU (com.android.vending above 100% in top).

Magisk module, Zygisk only. No Xposed, LSPosed or Vector needed, and no app or notification.

The cause
Since Android 14, apps can use a copy of Chrome's network library (Cronet) that ships inside the
ROM, in the Tethering system module (/apex/com.android.tethering/lib64/libcronet.*.so). Some
Xiaomi ROMs ship an old, buggy build (seen: libcronet.114.0.5735.84.so). The Play Store
uses it, and the process aborts with:

Abort message: 'fdsan: attempted to close file descriptor 0, expected to be unowned, actually owned by unique_fd ...'
  #03 /apex/com.android.tethering/lib64/libcronet.114.0.5735.84.so (net::SocketPosix::StopWatchingAndCleanUp)

The ROM signs that module itself, so Google Play system updates cannot replace it; only a
Xiaomi firmware update can, and older phones no longer get them.

The fix
Inside Play Store processes only, the module makes the ROM's Cronet unavailable to Play Store:
android.net.http.HttpEngine.Builder#build() throws, and Play Store's
HttpEngineNativeProvider reports itself disabled. Play Store then uses its own fallback
network stack. Every other app is untouched.

Credit to SongXiaoXi/VendingCronetOff, which
found this approach and does it through an Xposed framework. This module is an independent
implementation that needs only Magisk.

Install
1. Magisk with Zygisk enabled (Magisk → Settings → Zygisk).
2. Magisk → Modules → Install from storage → XiaomiPlayStoreFix-.zip.
3. Reboot.

Check it is active: adb logcat -s XiaomiPlayStoreFix should show
Phase1: HttpEngine.Builder#build blocked and Phase2: HttpEngineNativeProvider disabled
each time Play Store starts.

To undo it, disable or remove the module in Magisk and reboot.

How it works
- native/main.cpp: the Zygisk module. In com.android.vending processes it loads the embedded
  LSPlant (lsplant-standalone 6.4) from a memfd and initialises it against libart's on-disk
  symbol table (pre-specialize), then loads the embedded dex (post-specialize). All other
  processes unload the module immediately.
- java/xiaomiplaystorefix/Main.java: the hooks. App-classloader hooks are installed from
  Instrumentation#newApplication, before Play Store code runs. Hooker classes must be public,
  because LSPlant's generated stub calls them from another package.

License
MIT for this project's code (LICENSE). The zip embeds LSPlant (LGPL-3.0) and
And64InlineHook (MIT); see THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Build
./build.sh → build/XiaomiPlayStoreFix-.zip. Needs JDK 17, Android SDK
(platform 35, build-tools) and NDK; defaults to ~/Android/jdk-17 and ~/Android/Sdk.

modules.name: YKZ-Pinscan (SSL-pinning posture, research)
modules.author: yinkoshield
modules.description: Research-only. Per-app Conscrypt-APEX CA bind for packages listed in /data/adb/ykzpinscan/targets, to evaluate SSL-pinning posture with the pinscan proxy harness. Boot-safe (only runs at app fork).
modules.readme:
Measure which endpoints of a mobile app actually pin their TLS certificates, how well, and how sure you can be.
  No Frida, no hooks, no repackaging. Never "secure" from silence.

  Installation •
  Quickstart •
  How it works •
  CI •
  Limits •
  Documentation •
  Contributing

Built by the YinkoShield Threat Lab (Yinkozi Group), the team behind our research on malware targeting Africa's financial apps.

Every mobile banking review says "the app implements certificate pinning". pinscan
replaces that sentence with a measurement. It makes a test device trust a research
CA, presents the app with three forged certificates of increasing fidelity, and
records what the app accepts, per host. The login API above rejects every forgery.
The configuration, push and analytics hosts the same app talks to on startup do
not, and an attacker holding any certificate the device trusts reads and modifies
all three.

We built it because our threat research kept finding apps whose security review
said "pinned" and whose startup traffic said otherwise, and the tools we had
could not tell a pinned host from one that simply made no request. We wanted a
measurement that is honest about what it did not see, that a developer can act
on, and that CI can re-run on every release.
- Per-host verdicts on a strength scale, from open to spki (every
  forged chain rejected), with the evidence behind each one carried into the
  report. Verdicts describe what the app did, not the mechanism that did it.
- Separates key pinning from name checking. A wave that clones the real
  issuer's name under our CA passes name-based "pinning" and fails real pinning.
  A plain MITM proxy cannot tell them apart.
- Never reports "hardened" because it saw nothing. A timeout, a reset or a
  silent connection is inconclusive, counted and shown, never a pass.
- Never reports "hardened" because the test was broken. A client that does
  not trust the research CA rejects every forged chain exactly like a pinned
  one. pinscan verifies the CA from inside the app's own mount namespace before
  a rejection counts, and withholds hardened verdicts when it cannot.
- Confidence is a separate axis. A one-shot spki and a well-evidenced
  spki are not the same thing, and CI can demand the latter.
- Gets past a pinned front door without lying about it. -passthrough
  relays a named host (a key-pinned login API, say) to its real server
  untouched, so the app logs in and exposes the hosts behind it. The relayed
  host is reported as not tested, never as hardened; -passthrough '*' relays
  everything and only lists what the app contacts.
- Built for pipelines. Exit codes that tell a broken scan from a policy
  breach, byte-stable JSON baselines, a regression gate, a policy file with
  mandatory reasons, SARIF and JUnit output.
- Nothing to trust blindly. Open Magisk module in plain shell, Zygisk module
  source included, pure classifier with its rules in a test table, and a
  selftest that proves the methodology without a device.

Authorized use only. Test devices and apps you own or are explicitly
authorized to assess. pinscan is a posture-evaluation tool, not an interception
tool for third-party traffic. See SECURITY.md.

Installation

Go 1.26+ (an older Go downloads the right toolchain automatically)
go install github.com/yinkoshield/pinscan/cmd/pinscan@latest

Prebuilt binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows, with SHA256SUMS and a
CycloneDX SBOM, are on the releases page.
From a clone, make build writes ./bin/pinscan.

For Android you also need adb on the host and a rooted device (Magisk) on
the same LAN. Any other TLS client works with the manual driver.

Quickstart

pinscan selftest                   # proves the methodology end to end; no device needed
pinscan ca-new                     # creates the research CA at ~/.pinscan/ca.pem
pinscan ca-module -o pinscan-ca    # generates an open Magisk module that trusts it (push + reboot)
pinscan doctor com.example.app     # checks every prerequisite and prints the fix for each
pinscan scan com.example.app -report scan.html

Run pinscan selftest first. It mints the certificates, runs the proxy and the
classifier against six in-process clients with known postures, including one
that does not trust the research CA and one relayed untouched, and asserts
each verdict. If it passes,
the methodology works on your machine. The same proof on a real device, against
Network Security Config, OkHttp, a custom TrustManager, WebView and three broken
setups, is the validation matrix: a small test app plus
scripts/validate-device.sh.

Step by step, including rooting, the two CA-trust modes and finding the package
name: Getting started. No hardware?
Try it on an emulator.

How it works

Three waves, each signed by the research CA the device trusts:

| Wave | Certificate presented | Acceptance reveals |
|:----:|-----------------------|--------------------|
| A | a generic leaf for the hostname | no pinning at all |
| B | a leaf cloning the real certificate's subject and SANs, with our key | the app checks names, not keys |
| C | that leaf under an intermediate whose name clones the real issuer | the app checks the chain's names, not keys |

No forgery ever uses the real endpoint's key. That is exactly what public-key
pinning detects, and exactly what name-based checks miss.

| Verdict | Meaning | Defeated by a trusted-CA attacker |
|---------|---------|:---:|
| open | sent a request over the generic leaf | yes |
| metadata | rejected the generic leaf, accepted the cloned names | yes |
| name-validation | rejected both leaves, accepted the cloned-issuer chain | yes |
| key-pinned | rejected the forged leaves; wave C did not separate a key check from issuer-name validation | not established |
| spki | rejected everything, including the cloned issuer | no |
| inconclusive | no usable signal | not established |

"not established" is not a weaker "no". A key-pinned host rejected two...
modules.changelog:
First public release of pinscan, the TLS certificate-pinning posture scanner.

go install github.com/yinkoshield/pinscan/cmd/pinscan@v1.0.0
pinscan selftest   # proves the methodology end to end, no device needed

Prebuilt binaries for Linux, macOS and Windows are attached, with SHA256SUMS and a CycloneDX SBOM per archive. Builds are reproducible (make repro).

First public release.

Added
- Three-wave TLS-pinning posture measurement (generic leaf, cloned-metadata
  leaf, cloned-issuer chain) with per-host verdicts open, metadata,
  name-validation, key-pinned, spki and inconclusive.
- The "never secure from silence" rules: acceptance requires an observed request,
  and only a certificate-class TLS alert counts as a rejection.
- A confidence axis (low, medium, high) per verdict and -min-confidence.
- Android driver over adb with two CA-trust modes: system via a generated,
  readable Magisk module (pinscan ca-module) and scoped via the ykzpinscan
  Zygisk module, source included.
- Transparent mode: UID-scoped iptables redirect of tcp/443, with QUIC and IPv6
  port 443 refused for that UID so the app falls back to TCP over IPv4.
- manual driver for any TLS client that can trust the research CA and use a
  proxy.
- Capture pass for interceptable hosts with credential-header redaction, body
  caps, and JSON or HAR dumps.
- Reports in JSON (schema 1.0.0), Markdown, HTML, SARIF 2.1.0 and JUnit.
- Canonical, byte-stable baselines; diff and -fail-on-regression on the
  strength lattice; .pinscan.yaml policy with mandatory reasons.
- Exit codes 0 to 5 separating usage errors, operational failures, policy
  violations, regressions and incomplete coverage.
- pinscan doctor prerequisite checks, including CA trust verified from inside
  each zygote mount namespace.
- pinscan selftest: a device-free end-to-end proof of the methodology.
- Reproducible builds (make repro), goreleaser release pipeline with
  SHA256SUMS and CycloneDX SBOMs.

Documentation: https://github.com/Yinkoshield/pinscan#readme · Security policy: https://github.com/Yinkoshield/pinscan/blob/main/SECURITY.md

modules.name: Zygisk - Frida Gadget
modules.author: leolovenet
modules.description: Configurable Zygisk loader for Frida Gadget
modules.readme:
Zygisk - Frida Gadget

Config-driven Zygisk module for loading Frida Gadget into selected Android app processes.

Sample target examples use com.example.app, but targets are configured in targets.conf and do not require C++ changes.

Use Case

This module is intended as a Frida Gadget based alternative when frida-server cannot run reliably on a device, for example because of vendor restrictions, process hiding, executable mapping policy, or other runtime constraints.

Instead of starting a global frida-server, the module uses Zygisk to enter selected app processes and loads Frida Gadget only for configured targets.

Responsible Use

This project is intended for authorized security research, debugging, compatibility analysis, and defensive testing on devices and applications you own or have explicit permission to assess.

Do not use this project to access, modify, instrument, or monitor applications, systems, or data without authorization.

Install

Requirements:
- Magisk 27001 / Kitsune Magisk with Zygisk enabled
- A device/app ABI supported by this module: arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a

Use the prebuilt module zip from this project's GitHub Releases page when you only want to install and use the module:

https://github.com/leolovenet/Zygisk-FridaGadget/releases

Copy the zip to the phone, for example:

adb push zygisk_frida_gadget.zip /sdcard/Download/

Before installing, open Magisk settings and make sure Zygisk is enabled. If you just enabled it, reboot once before testing modules that depend on Zygisk.

Install it in Magisk:

Magisk -> Modules -> Install from storage -> zygisk_frida_gadget.zip

Reboot after installation. The module creates editable runtime config files under:

/data/adb/modules/zygisk_frida_gadget/

Quick Start

Edit targets.conf in the module directory:

package|process|match|abi|profile
com.example.app|com.example.app|exact|auto|default
com.example.app|com.example.app:remote|exact|auto|remote

Non-default profiles such as remote need a matching libgadget-.config.so, for example libgadget-remote.config.so.

Edit libgadget.config.so if you need to change Gadget's listener address, port, or behavior. The shipped default listens on all IPv4 interfaces on port 27042 and lets the app continue immediately:

{
  "interaction": {
    "type": "listen",
    "address": "0.0.0.0",
    "port": 27042,
    "on_port_conflict": "pick-next",
    "on_load": "resume"
  }
}

After changing targets, Gadget files, or Gadget config, redeploy:

adb shell su -c '/data/adb/modules/zygisk_frida_gadget/action.sh'

Start the target app again. By default, install and manual redeploy flows force-stop successfully deployed packages so the next launch enters the new Zygisk/Gadget path.

Connect With Frida

Watch module logs:

adb logcat -s ZygiskFridaGadget
adb logcat | grep -i Frida

Check whether Gadget is listening:

adb shell su -c 'netstat -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep 27042 || ss -lntp 2>/dev/null | grep 27042'

If the phone and computer can reach each other over the network, connect to the device IP:

frida -H :27042 -n Gadget

For USB-only testing, forward the port first:

adb forward tcp:27042 tcp:27042
frida -H 127.0.0.1:27042 -n Gadget

Frida Gadget's Listen interaction exposes a frida-server compatible endpoint, but the visible process name is always Gadget, and the visible app identifier is always re.frida.Gadget. Use -n Gadget even though the real Android package is different. See the official Frida Gadget docs: frida.re/docs/gadget.

Deployment logs are written to:

/data/adb/modules/zygisk_frida_gadget/deploy.log

Early Startup Hooks

If you need to hook code that runs immediately when the app starts, use a dedicated profile with on_load=wait. This blocks the target process until Frida attaches, so start the attach loop before launching the app.

For early startup hooks, use a fixed port and fail on conflict:

{
  "interaction": {
    "type": "listen",
    "address": "0.0.0.0",
    "port": 27042,
    "on_port_conflict": "fail",
    "on_load": "wait"
  }
}

on_port_conflict=pick-next is convenient for casual attach, but it is not recommended here because the actual listening port may change. Early startup hooks need the computer side to connect to the exact Gadget endpoint as soon as it appears. Before launching the target app, make sure no previous Gadget instance is still listening on that port.

Use a small POSIX sh wrapper named frida-retry.sh to retry Frida itself. The
wrapper forwards every argument to frida; it only adds retry behavior around
connection/startup failures:

#!/bin/sh
set -u

DELAY="${FRIDA_RETRY_DELAY:-0.1}"

while :; do
  frida "$@"
  status=$?

  [ "$status" -eq 0 ] && exit 0
  [ "$status" -eq 130 ] && exit "$status"

  sleep "$DELAY"
done

For USB-only testing:

adb forward tcp:27042 tcp:27042
./frida-retry.sh -H 127.0.0.1:27042 -n Gadget -l hooks.js

Keep critical hook registration as early as possible in your script. Slow setup, delayed async work, or heavy logic before installing hooks can miss early lifecycle calls.

Configure Targets

targets.conf format:

package|process|match|abi|profile

Fields:

package: target Android package name, used for deployment under /data/app
process: optional target process name, compared with args->nice_name from Zygisk
match: optional process-name matching mode, defaults to exact
abi: optional Gadget ABI selection, defaults to auto
profile: optional payload/config profile, defaults to default

If process is omitted or empty, it defaults to the package name. These forms are equivalent:

com.example.app
com.example.app|
com.example.app|com.example.app
com.example.app|com.example.app|exact
com.example.app|com.example.app|exact|auto
com.example.app|com.example.app|exact|auto|default

Supported match values:

exact
prefix
suffix
contains

For most apps, start with exact to avoid injecting child, sandbox, or service processes unintentionally...

modules.name: 反禁用截屏录屏
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 反禁用截屏录屏
modules.readme:
Screenshot（反禁用截屏录屏）

强制允许截屏和录屏的 LSPosed / Vector 模块，通过 hook 移除 Android 的 FLAG_SECURE 截图保护。基于 libxposed API 102，纯 Kotlin。

功能特性
- 移除 Window 的 FLAG_SECURE 标志，让应用无法禁止截屏 / 录屏；
- 强制 SurfaceView.setSecure(false)；
- Hook WindowManagerGlobal 的 addView / updateViewLayout，清除 LayoutParams 的 FLAG_SECURE；
- Hook system_server 的 WindowState.isSecureLocked，从系统层面强制窗口判定为非安全；
- 低版本的 WindowManagerService.isSecureLocked 一并 hook，高版本静默跳过。

工作原理

| Hook | 目标 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Window.setFlags(int, int) | 应用进程 | 清除 FLAG_SECURE |
| Window.addFlags(int) | 应用进程 | 清除 FLAG_SECURE |
| SurfaceView.setSecure(boolean) | 应用进程 | 强制 false |
| WindowManagerGlobal.addView(...) | 应用进程 | 清除 LayoutParams.flags 的 FLAG_SECURE |
| WindowManagerGlobal.updateViewLayout(...) | 应用进程 | 清除 LayoutParams.flags 的 FLAG_SECURE |
| WindowState.isSecureLocked() | system_server | 返回 false |

作用域：system（system_server 进程）。

使用

1. 安装支持 libxposed API 102 的框架（Vector，或新版 LSPosed）；
2. 安装本模块，在框架中启用并勾选作用域 system；
3. 重启目标应用后，即可对原本禁止截屏的应用正常截屏 / 录屏。

构建

环境要求：JDK 21、Android SDK 37（build-tools 37.0.0）、Gradle（使用仓库内 wrapper）。

Debug 包（无需签名）：

./gradlew assembleDebug

Release 包（需要 app/signing.properties，release.keystore 与 signing.properties 均被 .gitignore 忽略，不提交）：

STORE_FILE=release.keystore
STORE_PASSWORD=
KEY_ALIAS=
KEY_PASSWORD=

./gradlew assembleRelease

免责声明

本项目仅用于解除你自己设备上的截屏限制，请遵守当地法律法规与目标应用的服务条款，勿用于窃取他人隐私或侵权内容。由此产生的一切后果由使用者自行承担。

modules.name: 取件码助手 (PickupCodeGrabber) - 自动提取快递取件码写入小米笔记待办
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 取件码助手 (PickupCodeGrabber) - 自动提取快递取件码写入小米笔记待办
modules.readme:
取件码助手 (PickupCodeGrabber)

一个 LSPosed 模块：从短信和 App 通知里认出取件码，存进本地库，
首页顶部就是「待取件」，桌面小组件常驻；需要时再同步进系统待办。

支持 小米 / 红米（MIUI · HyperOS）、一加 / OPPO（ColorOS 16） 与 荣耀（MagicOS 11+），
需要 root（Magisk / KernelSU）+ LSPosed。

✨ 特性
- 两个来源：短信 Hook（不申请短信权限）+ App 通知提取（菜鸟、菜鸟裹裹、京东、淘宝、拼多多、顺丰、丰巢、抖音等）
- 本地库是事实源：带状态、地点、时间，能搜索、筛选、导出；超过一天没取的标「滞留 N 天」，只提醒不删
- 写入目标两处，默认都开：
- 系统待办：小米笔记待办 / ColorOS 日历待办 / 荣耀日历待办（可跟账号云同步，同账号的其他设备也能收到）
- 软件内部记录：首页「待取件」和桌面小组件读的就是它
- 桌面小组件：每行固定高度、一行一条；配色 / 透明度 / 字号可调，实时预览与桌面一致；长按图标可一键添加
- 识别规则 v13：覆盖主流驿站写法；单段「字母-数字」码、混排码不再被拆错；
  一条短信里有几个取件码就出几条；电商那种「提醒你有件但不给码」的推送不会被误判
- 取件记录：可按时间倒序或按地点聚拢（新消息整组置顶）；每条能展开看原始短信/通知并全文复制
- 提醒：精确闹钟到点就响；一条短信多个码时通知按码拆分
- 自定义规则：自建驿站 / 学校自提柜可以按号码或正则单独写一条
- 一键链路测试：不消耗真实短信，验证「解析 → 写入 → 去重 → 通知」整条链路
- 隐私：全程本地处理，不收集任何数据；唯一联网行为是检查更新（3 天一次）

🔧 环境要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 系统 | HyperOS / MIUI、ColorOS 16，或荣耀 MagicOS 11+；Android 9+ |
| Root | Magisk 或 KernelSU |
| 框架 | LSPosed 或兼容实现 |
| 作用域 | 必勾 4 项：系统框架（LSPosed 2.x 显示为「系统框架 / system」，旧版为「Android 系统 / android」，两者等价，勾一个即可）、电话、短信（小米/一加 com.android.mms，荣耀 com.hihonor.mms）、电话和短信存储（com.android.providers.telephony）。「小米笔记」不需要勾 |

⚠️ 框架那一项在 LSPosed 2.x 里叫「系统框架」（system），置顶且带「推荐应用」标记；
旧版叫「Android 系统」（android）。两者指同一个进程，勾一个即可，不用两个都勾。

📲 安装

1. 下载 APK 安装；
2. LSPosed 启用模块，按上表勾作用域；
3. 重启手机；
4. 打开 App → 点开首页状态卡 → 点「点击体检」，全绿即完成。

📖 文档与反馈
- 完整说明：GitHub README
- 更新日志：CHANGELOG
- 反馈：QQ 群 901543676（备注「取件码助手」）｜ 酷安 ｜ Issues

⚠️ 声明
- 实测：Redmi K90 Pro Max / HyperOS 4.0 / Android 17；荣耀 MagicOS 11 / Android 17（社区适配）；ColorOS 16 的部分适配路径无实机验证；
- 直写系统待办库：只增行 / 定点标记，不删改已有数据。跨设备靠系统账号同步，
  同步由系统负责（没登录账号或关掉同步就不会传），模块不介入这个过程；
- 与小米 / OPPO 无关联，MIT 许可，使用风险自担。
modules.changelog:
4.2.0 的主角是桌面小组件：把「还差几件没取」从 App 里搬到桌面上。
这一版也把取件记录、识别规则和取件提醒顺了一遍。

桌面小组件：待取件就在桌面上
- 待取件的取件码、地点、来源一行一条，已取件的划掉
- 关掉「显示取件码」就只显示件数，适合桌面不想露太多的情况
- 配色五套加 24 色自定义、透明度七档，字号和显示内容都能调
- 设置页里的预览和桌面看到的样子一致，边调边看
- 长按 App 图标选「添加小组件」就能加，不用先进设置页

取件记录：按地点聚拢，或按时间倒序
- 同一个地点的件归成一组，新短信来了整组顶到最上
- 你在两个驿站都有件的话，去哪个取、各取几件，一眼就分清
- 每条能展开看原始短信或通知，并一键全文复制

规则集 v13：取件码认得更准
- 字母加数字连着写的码不会再被拆成两个错码，运单尾号也不会当成取件码
- 地点不再把「找店员」「您的包裹已到店」这类话当成店名
- 电商通知里那种「提醒你有件、但不直接给码」的推送，也能正确取到码和来源

提醒：到点就响
- 改用精确闹钟，选了 9:00 就 9:00 响，不再被省电策略推后
- 一条短信里有多个取件码时，通知也按码拆成多条

⚠️ 升级注意

1. 装完重启手机一次：短信与通知的解析代码跑在系统进程里，不重启还是旧逻辑；
2. 确认一遍 LSPosed 作用域：LSPosed → 模块 → 取件码助手 → 作用域，
   确认带「推荐应用」标记的「系统框架」等必需项都勾着，调整好再重启。

modules.name: 抖音不裁剪
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 抖音不裁剪
modules.readme:
抖音不裁剪 (DouYin NoCrop)

一个 LSPosed 模块:让抖音视频按原始宽高比完整显示,不再被左右裁剪。

A modern LSPosed module (Xposed API 102) that makes Douyin render videos at their
original aspect ratio — no more left/right cropping.

下载 / Download
- LSPosed 模块仓库:
- 安装包 Releases(Xposed-Modules-Repo 镜像):
- 源码:

版本 / Version

当前版本 v1.1.0(versionCode 8,2026-09-28 发布)。相对 v1.0 的要点:
- 适配范围严格限定三处全屏界面:推荐主 Feed、搜索打开的视频详情播放器、清屏全屏
- 评论区五重门控(视图树 / Activity / params Fragment / 可见评论 Fragment 子树 / 全屏级独立窗口),评论动图与图片完全保持抖音原生行为
- 图文详情浏览(捏合缩放层)、搜索列表卡片不触碰
- 容器尺寸持久监听:进出全屏、面板开合自动重算/还原
- 静态图文改 Fresco FIT_CENTER,不破坏捏合缩放

效果对比

*左:抖音原生 cover 放大填满 → 视频比屏幕宽时左右被裁;右:本模块把渲染 View 收成视频宽高比的内接矩形 → 完整显示,多余部分留背景。*

原理 / How it works

抖音播放引擎按 cover(放大填满)模式把视频渲染进与容器同尺寸的 surface,当视频比容器
更"宽"时,左右两侧内容会被裁掉。

本模块 hook 抖音换视频的时机(VideoItemParams.getAweme()),读取内容宽高比,把视频
渲染 View 的 LayoutParams 收缩为"内容宽高比在容器内的最大内接矩形"(保留原有居中
gravity)。这样 surface 宽高比 == 视频宽高比,引擎的 cover 渲染在数学上等价于 fit,
裁剪自然消失,容器多余部分显示背景。容器尺寸变化时(进出全屏、面板开合)由持久
layout 监听驱动重算/还原,对抗抖音 FeedAllScreenHelper 等对布局的覆写,幂等写入。

Douyin renders video frames with a "cover" (fill-and-crop) strategy. This module shrinks
the render view to the largest rectangle matching the video's aspect ratio (centered),
so the surface ratio equals the video ratio and nothing gets cropped.

功能 / Features
- 视频/动图按原始比例完整显示,左右不再裁剪
- 场所白名单:仅处理主 Feed(*MainActivity)、详情播放器(*DetailActivity)、清屏
  三处全屏界面;搜索列表、广告、直播等未知上下文自动还原
- 评论区五重门控完全不碰,评论动图/图片保持抖音原生行为
- 宽高比四级回退提取(width/height → t/s → aspectRatio → imageInfos),
  每次从 Aweme 对象独立读取、无全局状态,杜绝跨内容陈旧比例污染
- 状态按 View 弱表记账,还原前比对是否仍是我们写入的值;只改 View 布局参数,
  不碰播放器内核
- 全部 Hook 使用 PROTECTIVE 异常模式:钩子出错自动降级,不会导致抖音闪退

要求 / Requirements
- LSPosed(支持 Modern Xposed API 102 的版本)
- 作用域:com.ss.android.ugc.aweme(抖音,安装后在 LSPosed 中勾选)
- Android 9+ (minSdk 28)

安装 / Install

1. 从 Releases 下载最新 APK 并安装
2. LSPosed → 模块 → 启用 抖音不裁剪
3. 作用域勾选 抖音
4. 强行停止并重启抖音

验证日志:adb logcat -s DouYinNoCrop:D

构建 / Build

.\gradlew.bat assembleRelease
产物: app\build\outputs\apk\release\app-release.apk
- AGP 9.2.1 / Gradle 9.4.1 / compileSdk 37 / minSdk 28 / Java 17
- 依赖仅一行:compileOnly("io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0")(Maven Central)

兼容性说明 / Compatibility

Hook 锚点均为未混淆的接口方法与 public 字段(在抖音 40.6.0 上实测):

| 锚点 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| VideoItemParams#getAweme() | 换视频时取内容宽高比(绑定即收缩) |
| VideoItemParams#mAweme / #mBaseFeedPlayerView | 取 Aweme 与播放器 View |
| Aweme#getVideo() / #imageInfos | 视频/图文宽高比回退提取 |
| BaseFeedPlayerView#getVideoView() | 拿真正渲染 View(覆盖 Texture/Surface 两条路径) |
| KeepSurfaceTextureView#onAttachedToWindow() | attach 时序补偿(TextureView 路径) |
| CleanModeViewModel#sA(...) | 清屏状态进出,驱动全量重算/还原 |

抖音大版本更新后如失效,可用 droidasc 等 dex 分析工具重新验证上述锚点,
只需更新 NoCropModule.java 中的类名/方法名常量。

License

MIT
modules.changelog:
抖音不裁剪 v1.2.0（versionCode 14）

基于 v1.1.0（versionCode 8）分支开发，不包含 image-fit / video-fit 图文调试分支的改动。

变更
- 静态作用域：module.prop 新增 staticScope=true，作用域锁死为 scope.list 里的抖音，LSPosed 中不能勾选其他应用，杜绝误注入
- 热重载：autoHotReload=true + onHotReloading/onHotReloaded。模块更新后可把新代码热重载进正在运行的抖音进程，免强停重启；换代时交出适配状态（只含宿主 View/宿主对象与基本类型），新代用 replaceHook 原子接管全部钩子，新旧钩子之间不留空档
- 反优化：全部钩子锚点调用 deoptimize()，防止 JIT 把小方法内联进调用点后绕过钩子
- 进程摘除：WebView 沙箱等无关进程用 detach() 直接摘除，不再收后续生命周期回调
- module.prop 显式声明 exceptionMode=protective；加载日志补全框架版本 / 版本号 / 属性

不变
- 适配范围仍为三处全屏界面（主 Feed / 详情播放器 / 清屏），评论区五重门控、图文 Fresco FIT_CENTER、onVideoSizeChanged 真实宽高回调等逻辑与 v1.1.0 完全一致

校验
- assembleDebug / assembleRelease 构建通过，apksigner 验签通过
- APK 内 META-INF/xposed/{module.prop,scope.list,java_init.list} 齐全，staticScope=true
- dex 中无任何旧版 API（de.robv.android.xposed / XposedHelpers / xposed_init）
- 包名 io.github.dunxuan.douyinnocrop，libxposed API 102

modules.name: 静盒
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 静盒
modules.readme:
静盒 (QuietBox)

一个面向小红书的 LSPosed 模块：去掉广告、收敛弹窗、收紧隐私，让 App 安静下来。

基于 libxposed Modern API 102，纯 Java Hook 实现。
当前版本：0.9.12（versionCode 26）。适配小红书 9.54.1（9541801），70 个锚点全部按 9.54.1 APK 重新定位并通过静态体检（methods 70/70、classes 6/6）。本版新增诊断回传 socket 快速通道（socket → ContentProvider，失败自动回落），底栏第二个 tab 由「测试」更名为「实验」。0.9.11 为 CodeFloe 迁移补丁版；0.9.10 新增 UI-06「阻止返回自动刷新」，并把 EN-04 条目门（PR #9）重定位到 9.54.1；EN-03 四个实况链路锚点、EX-01、UI-04 也一并重定位。0.9.9 为四模块深审修复版（本模块 122 条）。0.9.8 按 9.53.0 重定位 21 个挂载点（7 SIG / 14 GONE）。只支持 9.54.1，不再支持 9.53.0 及更早版本。
⚠️ 本项目与小红书官方无任何关联，仅供学习、研究和个人设备使用。
使用前请阅读文末的免责声明。

主平台：CodeFloe ｜ 项目主页：quiet-tools.codefloe.page ｜ 下载：Releases ｜ 通知：Telegram ｜ 反馈：Issues

更新日志见 CHANGELOG.md。
源码、Issues 与 Releases 已迁移到 CodeFloe；GitHub 官方 Xposed 镜像保留旧版本，恢复后同步。

功能

27 项功能，24 项提供开关（3 项 blocked 不渲染；EX-01 为实验性，未在真实场景实测），每项独立开关。默认值遵循“净化开、敏感关”：广告净化与界面精简默认开启，隐私保护、功能增强、实验功能默认关闭。改动需重启小红书生效（实验页的单项实验约 3 秒生效）。

广告净化（AD）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|---|
| AD-01 | 开屏广告跳过 | 覆盖内嵌 Fragment、独立全屏 Activity、冷启动占位三条路径 | 开 |
| AD-02 | 信息流广告过滤 | 开屏关联广告与服务端下发的普通广告都过滤 | 开 |
| AD-03 | 评论广告过滤 | 隐藏评论区广告组件 | 开 |
| AD-04 | 广告外跳拦截 | 广告落地页不拉起淘宝、京东等外部 App | 开 |
| AD-05 | 搜索广告过滤 | 搜索结果里不显示广告 | 开 |
| AD-06 | 详情页广告条屏蔽 | 隐藏笔记详情页底部的二跳广告条 | 开 |
| AD-07 | 评论带货插入屏蔽 | 评论区顶部不再插入商品卡 | 开 |
| AD-08 | 直播卡过滤 | 首页信息流按 modelType 过滤直播卡；仅覆盖已验证的首页列表链路，详情连播不覆盖 | 开 |
| AD-09 | 带货卡过滤 | 首页信息流按 modelType 过滤带货卡；仅覆盖已验证的首页列表链路，详情连播不覆盖 | 开 |
| AD-10 | 投票卡过滤 | 首页信息流按 modelType 过滤投票卡；仅覆盖已验证的首页列表链路，详情连播不覆盖 | 开 |
| AD-11 | 摇一摇跳转禁用 | 本版本不可用：广告摇一摇检测在原生引擎侧，Java 层无精确挂载点 | 关 |
AD-08/09/10 只挂首页信息流的列表追加、刷新与分页路径（9.54.1 为 zid.m0#T / zid.m0#E0 / tid.t#Xd；9.53.0 为 hgd.m0#S / hgd.m0#C0 / bgd/s#Sd；9.52.0 为 ExploreView#S / ExploreView#C0 / vha/s#Pd），不处理详情页连播；9.51.0 真机曾观察到 modelType=note 与 live_v2 并保留正常笔记，9.54.1 沿用同一链路、尚未真机验证，其他类型原样放行。

界面精简（UI）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|---|
| UI-01 | 评分引导弹窗屏蔽 | 不弹「满意吗 / 去评分」和系统评分 | 开 |
| UI-02 | 通知引导弹窗屏蔽 | 不弹「开启通知」引导；手动开通知不受影响 | 开 |
| UI-03 | 满意度调研条屏蔽 | 详情页不再弹出「对内容满意吗」 | 开 |
| UI-04 | 更新弹窗屏蔽 | 不再弹出版本更新提示 | 开 |
| UI-05 | 自动播放 | 关闭详情页/视频 tab 的自动播放（画质偏好本版本不提供） | 开 |
| UI-06 | 阻止返回自动刷新 | 按返回或重新打开时保留当前首页推荐，不自动刷新；下拉刷新不受影响 | 开 |

隐私保护（PV）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|---|
| PV-01 | 截图检测关闭 | 不注册截图监听；手动分享不受影响 | 关 |
| PV-02 | 通讯录同步关闭 | 不上传通讯录，不再有通讯录推荐好友 | 关 |
| PV-03 | 复制链接净化 | 去掉链接里的追踪参数（xsec_token 默认保留，可单独勾选删除） | 关 |
| PV-04 | 埋点抑制 | 本版本不可用：没有安全的挂载点，强行拦截会影响应用生命周期 | 关 |

功能增强（EN）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|---|
| EN-01 | 水印策略 | 保存图片时不带水印 | 关 |
| EN-02 | 默认静音 | 本版本不可用：需求取消，小红书自带自动静音 | 关 |
| EN-03 | 实况图去水印 | 保存实况图（Live Photo）不带水印：静态帧跳过水印绘制，视频走与笔记详情预览同源的本地下载链路（不再请求服务端渲染）；会切换实况保存链路，默认关闭 | 关 |
| EN-04 | 强制允许保存 | 对作者关闭保存的笔记强制允许保存；默认关，开启前请自行判断合规风险 | 关 |

实验功能（EX）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|---|
| EX-01 | 已删除笔记查看 | 实验性：服务端返回「内容无法展示」错误页时，若同进程里还留有同一 noteId 的上一份详情数据，则继续展示；否则走离线/错误分支，页面可能为空。不伪造内容，未在真实被删笔记场景实测 | 关 |
| EX-02 | AB 测试面板 | 强开小红书灰度实验。实验页内置 21 个高价值、纯客户端的实验开关（详情页渲染、播放体验、评论键盘等），并展示模块探测到的其他实验 key；未收录项只读，不建议修改。支持把全量 key + 当前探测值导出为 CSV | 关 |
强开的是灰度实验组，不是隐藏福利。部分实验依赖服务端配套数据，可能出现页面空白或崩溃。
请一次只开一项、逐项验证；广告、埋点、直播、服务端调参类实验不提供开关。

PV-03 另有一个子选项「同时删除 xsec_token」，不单独编号，依赖 PV-03 开启。

界面
- 底栏 4 Tab：设置 / 实验 / 诊断 / 关于，底部导航切换、状态各自保留。
- 设置 Tab：状态卡 → 异常横幅 → AD/UI/PV/EN/EX 分组 → 恢复默认 → 页脚。
- 状态卡：只有正在连接框架… / 未激活 / 框架已连接 / 已激活四种状态，副标题显示框架 API、目标版本与 remote prefs 可用性。
- 异常横幅：仅在目标应用版本未适配，或已启用且 ≥2 个功能明确失效时出现；不新增第五种状态。
- 实验 Tab：AB 测试面板（EX-02）与全量实验导出。
- 诊断 Tab：逐功能显示 编号 标题 · registered · hit N · skip 原因，无数据用 —；页首显示刷新时间，页尾提供刷新与复制。
- 关于 Tab：模块版本、目标应用、源码、四模块互链、免责声明与 MIT 许可证。

设置页不展示逐功能诊断信息，排障细节统一放在诊断 Tab。

环境要求
- Android 10 及以上
- 已安装 LSPosed（Zygisk 版，配合 Magisk / KernelSU）
- 小红书 9.54.1（versionCode 9541801）

其他版本可能只有部分功能生效，甚至完全不生效——模块的 Hook 点依赖具体版本。

安装

1. 从 Releases 下载 quietbox-x.y.z.apk 并安装。
2. 打开 LSPosed 管理器，在模块列表里启用「静盒」。
3. 进入模块的作用域设置，勾选 小红书（com.xingin.xhs）。
4. 打开「静盒」，确认顶部显示 已激活，且副标题包含 已注入小红书。
5. 按需调整开关。

常见问题

开关是灰色的？
模块 App 还没绑定到 LSPosed 服务。等一两秒会自动刷新；一直灰着就检查 LSPosed 里模块是否启用、作用域是否勾选。

某项功能没效果？
先看诊断页的逐功能状态，再看 logcat（tag QuietBox）：
- 注册成功会打印 AD-05 registered jl0.f0#o
- 命中会打印 AD-05 hit search ads removed=3

诊断页显示 skip 或没有注册日志，说明这个版本的挂载点没找到，大概率是小红书升级后内部结构变了。请看「兼容性」。

升级小红书后失效了？
正常现象。模块依赖具体版本的内部结构，升级后需要重新适配。顶部出现「目标应用版本未适配」或「N 项功能未生效」的红色提示时，打开诊断页查看 skip 原因。当前唯一适配版本是 9.54.1，升级小红书后请等待新版本模块，或回退到 9.54.1。

会不会导致封号？
模块不修改账号数据、不拦截网络请求、不上传任何信息。但它确实会 Hook 目标应用进程，理论上存在被检测的可能。是否使用、是否用于主账号，请自行评估并承担风险。

和同类模块冲突吗？
同时使用多个 Hook 同一应用的模块可能互相覆盖。建议只保留一个。

需要给静盒加自启动白名单吗？
不需要。功能开关通过 LSPosed 的 remote preferences 传递。诊断与 AB 探测数据由小红书进程单向写入模块 App 的本地 ContentProvider，只在本机展示，不联网、不上传。

隐私
- 不申请网络权限，App 本身无法联网。
- 无统计、无遥测、无崩溃上报、无后台服务。
- 不读取、不上传任何用户数据。
- 所有逻辑都在本机目标进程内完成。
- 诊断数据只写入模块 App 的本地存储（status_report），AB 探测结果只写入 ab_report，均仅用于界面展示。
- 模块只在 LSPosed 中勾选的应用里生效。

兼容性

| 项目 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 小红书 9.54.1（9541801） | 已适配：70 个锚点按 9.54.1 APK 重新定位，静态体检 methods 70/70、classes 6/6（2026-11-14）；真机安装 0.9.10 后各 hook 注册通过（0.9.12 仅诊断回传与文档变更，未改动 hook 锚点），UI-06 的实际命中需在视频 feed 停留超过热启动阈值后复验 |
| 小红书 9.53.0（9530807）及更早 | 不再支持：不阻断运行（fail-open），横幅提示「未适配」，大部分功能可能失效 |
| Android 10 及以上（minSdk 29） | 支持；运行记录覆盖 Android 15（模拟器）与 Android 17（0.8.0 核心回归、0.8.1 诊断修复复验），其余版本未逐一验证 |
| LSPosed（API 102） | 支持 |

已知限制
- 安装包签名校验：启动时核对 APK 签名证书与内置指纹；签名不符会首次启动警告一次（不阻断功能）。该校验只能提示二次打包，恶意修改仍可移除，请优先从 CodeFloe Releases / Telegram 频道下载。
- AD-05 只过滤搜索结果中 alioth.entities.i 广告实体，品牌广告卡不在覆盖范围。
- EN-03 开启后实况保存走预览同源视频：宿主后续若改保存链路（如下线 livePhotoVideoPath）可能失效，因此默认关闭。
- EX-01（已删除笔记查看）与 AD-04（广告外跳拦截）未真机验证，不据此宣称通过。
- UI-06 只跳过热启动/返回时的 needRefresh 写入，不影响下拉刷新；宿主改链路时会 critical skip。
- 小红书 9.53.0 不再支持，请升级到 9.54.1（9541801）。
0.8.1 已修复 0.8.0 的「N 项功能未生效」误报；0.9.0 进一步区分 critical skip 并加入会话标识、TTL 与心跳，只有类级主锚点缺失才会触发失败横幅。

相关模块

四个模块使用统一的设计与工程规范，可分别独立安装：
- 云音乐工具箱 (CloudMusicTool)
- 静盒 (QuietBox)（当前）
- 静途 (QuietMap)
- 贴吧静净 (TiebaQuiet)

从源码构建

依赖缓存放 D 盘（按需修改）
set GRADLE_USER_HOME=D:\gradle-home

gradlew assembleDebug      # 调试包
gradlew assembleRelease    # 正式包，产物名 quietbox-.apk

release 读取仓库根目录的 keystore.properties 签名（该文件不入库）。缺失或 storeFile 未配置时，release 任务在执行前直接失败，不会回退 debug 签名，也不会产出未签名包。...

modules.name: ADB_X - 无线ADB调试增强 Xposed 模块。固定端口、配对码捕获、信任WiFi自动开启无
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: ADB_X - 无线ADB调试增强 Xposed 模块。固定端口、配对码捕获、信任WiFi自动开启无线ADB。
modules.readme:
﻿# ADB_X — Wireless ADB enhancement Xposed module
⚠️ Early development — expect bugs. This project is in a very early
stage of development. Expect rough edges, missing features, broken
builds, and behavior that varies wildly between ROMs. Please report
issues you hit, but do not rely on it for anything you can't recover
from, and please don't expect stable APIs yet.
📖 Looking for Chinese documentation? See README.zh.md.

ADB_X pins the wireless-debugging port, captures the ADB pairing code
the moment it appears, and turns ADB on automatically when you join
a trusted Wi-Fi network — all driven by an LSPosed module, with no
foreground app or background service required.

Features
- Fixed wireless-debugging port — no more random port from adb pair
- Live pairing-code capture — read the current pairing code straight
  from the system-server hook, copy to clipboard
- Saved-Wi-Fi scan — list every Wi-Fi your device remembers, split
  into connected / saved / available sections
- Trusted networks — tick the SSIDs that should re-enable ADB
- Auto-enable on trusted Wi-Fi — flips Settings.Global.ADB_WIFI_ENABLED
  on when you join one
- Wired (USB) tab — trust a host by serial and arm ADB-over-USB
  independently of the wireless toggle
- Bilingual UI — English or Simplified Chinese, switchable at runtime
- Mostly foreground-free — the core toggling logic runs in
  system_server via LSPosed; a lightweight foreground daemon keeps it
  alive when the UI is closed

Requirements
- Android 11 (API 30) or newer
- LSPosed / Xposed framework
- Root (KernelSU or Magisk) for the LSPosed scope — the system-server
  hook needs root to write to /data/local/tmp

Build

Windows
gradlew.bat assembleRelease

Linux / macOS
./gradlew assembleRelease

The signed APK lands in app/build/outputs/apk/release/.
The debug APK (un-signed, installable via adb install -r) is in
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/.

Install

1. adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
2. Open LSPosed Manager → enable the ADB_X module
3. Set the scope to Android (system_server) and **Settings
   (com.android.settings)**
4. Reboot, or soft-restart the affected processes
5. Launch the ADB_X app, pick your language, set the fixed port,
   tick the Wi-Fi networks you trust

How it works

Fixed port
The hook intercepts SystemProperties.set for service.adb.tls.port
and service.adb.tcp.port and rewrites the value to the user-chosen
fixed port before adbd binds to it.

Pairing-code capture
On the pairing dialog's construction (best-effort hook across several
candidate classes for different Android versions), the temporary
pairing port is written to /data/local/tmp/adb_x_pairing_port; the
saved custom code is written to /data/local/tmp/adb_x_pairing_code.
The app reads both files and renders the full
adb pair host:port code command with a copy-to-clipboard button.

Auto-enable on trusted Wi-Fi
A ConnectivityManager.NetworkCallback runs in system_server (via
LSPosed) and again in the app process (foreground daemon plus a
statically registered WifiStateReceiver). When the active Wi-Fi matches
one of the trusted SSIDs, wireless ADB is switched on. Disconnects are
deliberately left to Android — adbd keeps its endpoint alive across SSID
transitions, and disabling behind the user's back would drop a live
session.

Saved-Wi-Fi list
Android 11+ hides WifiManager.getConfiguredNetworks() from third-party
apps (it returns an empty list), so the hook inside system_server reads
the networks and publishes them through Settings.Global in
adb_x_wifi_list_* chunks. The app reassembles those chunks; an on-disk
marker file is used as a fallback on ROMs where the settings provider is
restricted.

Project layout

ADB_X/
├── app/
│   ├── build.gradle.kts
│   └── src/main/
│       ├── AndroidManifest.xml
│       ├── assets/xposed_init
│       ├── kotlin/top/cbug/adbx/
│       │   ├── App.kt                   (Application, loads settings)
│       │   ├── MainActivity.kt          (single-activity host, 4 tabs)
│       │   ├── PairingActivity.kt       (full-screen pairing manager)
│       │   ├── BootLogger.kt            (in-app boot diagnostic log)
│       │   ├── BootReceiver.kt          (boot-time trusted-SSID evaluate)
│       │   ├── WifiStateReceiver.kt     (Wi-Fi state change evaluate)
│       │   ├── UsbStateReceiver.kt      (USB attach / detach evaluate)
│       │   ├── PairingReceiver.kt       (wireless-debug discover action)
│       │   ├── TrustedWifiService.kt    (foreground auto-toggle daemon)
│       │   ├── store/Settings.kt        (SharedPreferences + config mirror)
│       │   ├── ui/                      (4 fragments + adapters)
│       │   │   ├── StatusFragment.kt
│       │   │   ├── NetworkFragment.kt
│       │   │   ├── WiredFragment.kt
│       │   │   ├── SettingsFragment.kt
│       │   │   ├── WifiSettingsActivity.kt

│       │   │   └── StatusIndicatorView.kt
│       │   ├── util/                    (shell + ADB + Wi-Fi helpers)
│       │   │   ├── AdbHelper.kt

modules.name: ADBLive - 无线 ADB 保护
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: ADBLive - 无线 ADB 保护
modules.readme:
ADBLive

一个 Android 无线 ADB 保护应用（单 APK），防止无线 ADB 被意外关闭。适配 KernelSU / Magisk root 与 LSPosed 模块环境。

功能
- 无线 ADB 开关：一键开关无线 ADB（固定端口 5555）。App 内开关 = 用户最高意志，关闭后被动守护不会拉回
- 主动守护（Shield）：Xposed/LSPosed 模块，拦截系统关闭无线 ADB 与杀 adbd 的操作
- 被动守护（Guard）：root 授权后部署 shell 守护脚本，10s 轮询自动恢复无线 ADB
- 用户意志尊重：用户主动关闭 ADB 时写入意图文件，守护 / 开机自启均不恢复
- 开机自启：重启后自动部署守护、恢复无线 ADB
- 卸载零残留：卸载时清理全部注入钩子、守护进程与状态文件，无僵尸残留

贡献鸣谢
- @StriveMario：修复部分厂商 libc 告警污染 shell 输出导致无线 ADB 开关显示错误的问题（PR #3）。
- @gjk0510（净沙）：贡献无线 ADB 快捷磁贴与系统开发者选项入口（PR #1）。

构建

export JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/opt/openjdk@17
./gradlew assembleRelease
产物：app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release.apk

安装与使用

1. 安装 APK 后在 KernelSU / Magisk 中授权 root，并重启一次 App 解锁（首次授权需重启 App 一次）
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用本模块（作用域 system + settings + 本应用），重启激活主动守护
3. 打开被动守护开关部署守护脚本；按需开启开机自启

状态文件（卸载清理清单）

卸载后软件会自动清理全部状态文件与守护进程（无残留）。核心文件：
- 盾状态：/data/system/adblive_shield_armed
- 守护：/data/adb/service.d/99_adblive_guard.sh
- 用户意图：/data/adb/adblive_user_disabled_adb
- 开机自启标记：/data/adb/adblive_boot_enabled

English Overview

ADBLive is a wireless ADB protection app for Android (single APK). It keeps wireless ADB alive so it is not accidentally turned off.
- Active Shield (Xposed/LSPosed): hooks and blocks the system from disabling wireless ADB (adb_wifi_enabled=0) or killing adbd
- Passive Guard (root): deploys a shell watchdog script that polls every 10s and restores wireless ADB automatically
- User's will respected: turning off wireless ADB inside the app writes an intent file; guard / boot auto-start will not pull it back
- Boot auto-start: redeploys the guard and restores wireless ADB after reboot
- Zero residue on uninstall: all hooks, guard process and state files are cleaned up on uninstall

Compatible with KernelSU / Magisk root and the LSPosed module environment. Fixed port 5555, minSdk 30 (Android 11).

modules.name: Always Battery Saver
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Always Battery Saver
modules.readme:
Always Battery Saver

An Xposed module to prevent Android from automatically disabling Battery Saver when the device is charging.

Problem & Solution

Android's default behavior disables Battery Saver upon charging. This module intercepts specific system calls within the Android System Server (android package) to prevent this automatic deactivation, allowing Battery Saver to remain active even while plugged in.

Technical Overview

The module hooks methods within com.android.server.power.batterysaver.BatterySaverStateMachine:

1. enableBatterySaverLocked (all variants):
- lock_on_plugged_in: Checks if method arguments contain REASON_STRING_PLUGGED_IN ("Plugged in").
- lock_on_power: Uses reflection to check the current state of the mIsPowered field within the BatterySaverStateMachine instance.
- lock_any: Unconditionally blocks the method call.

2. updateStateLocked:
- fake_power: If enabled, uses reflection to set the mIsPowered field of the BatterySaverStateMachine instance to false *before* the original method runs, effectively hiding the charging status from the state machine's internal logic.

Note: This module relies on specific class/method names and the mIsPowered field name within AOSP. Significant changes by OEMs or in future Android versions could impact functionality.

Known Issues

In some cases, other system components or features may change the Battery Saver state without going through BatterySaverStateMachine. This can cause the internal state of the system to become inconsistent with the actual Battery Saver state.

For example, a feature that automatically disables Battery Saver when the battery reaches 90% may change the state independently of BatterySaverStateMachine. When this happens, the system may end up in an inconsistent state where Battery Saver cannot be disabled normally through Settings or other system UI.

Usually, a reboot is enough to restore the Battery Saver state to a consistent state.

Alternatively, you can try manually resetting the Battery Saver mode from a shell:

cmd power set-mode 0

or

cmd power set-mode 1

Depending on the device and Android version, you may need to run these commands multiple times, or repeatedly switch between 0 and 1, before the Battery Saver state is restored to a consistent state.

More Ideas
- ~~Settings UI: Add a simple configuration UI to toggle the module's functionality or potentially add more options later.~~
- UI Unlocking: Hook the Battery Saver settings page and the Quick Settings tile to prevent them from becoming disabled or grayed out while the device is charging and Battery Saver is forced on by this module.
- Extend Support to Android 5.0 (Lollipop): Power Saving Mode seems to be present in Android since API level 21, so supporting older devices might be feasible. This would require investigating compatibility with the BatterySaverStateMachine class or an equivalent implementation in those versions.

Thanks
- Xposed Framework Developers
- CorePatch (Inspiration for hook structure)
- LLMs (Gemini, DeepSeek, ChatGPT) for assistance.

*Disclaimer: Use Xposed modules responsibly. Modifying system behavior carries inherent risks.*

KeyFlux

An advanced LSPosed/Xposed module designed to unlock the hidden capabilities and experimental features of Google Keyboard (Gboard). KeyFlux seamlessly integrates new options directly into Gboard's native settings.

🔗 Original Repository & Source Code: https://github.com/NawafCode/KeyFlux

🚀 Features (Shortened)
- Experimental & AI Features: Unlock TFLite Neural Engine, Proactive Emoji Kitchen, Inline Smart Suggestions, and Material Silk Redesign.
- Enhanced Clipboard Action Chips: Extract entities from copied text and bypass clipboard limits.
- Hidden Flags: Easily toggle internal Gboard Phenotype flags.
- Floating Layouts & Multilingual: Unlock floating keyboard options and concurrent multilingual typing.
- Privacy Focused: Completely safe with no sensitive data logged.

🛠 Installation
1. Install LSPosed or Vector on your rooted Android device.
2. Download the latest KeyFlux APK from the Original Repository Releases.
3. Install the APK and open your Hook Manager (LSPosed/Vector).
4. Enable the KeyFlux module and make sure Gboard is selected in the module scope.
5. Force stop Gboard to apply the changes.
6. Open Gboard Settings to explore your new features!

📱 Compatibility
- Android Versions: Android 10 (API 29) to Android 17 (API 37)
- Target App: Google Gboard (13.x - 17.x)
- Hook Framework: Vector (Recommended), LSPosed 1.8.x - 1.9.x
- Architecture: arm64-v8a, x86_64
modules.changelog:
This update represents a complete overhaul of how KeyFlux hooks into Gboard, combining the best of all previous attempts into one incredibly robust solution!

🛠️ What's Changed
- Dual Context Hooking: To bypass Samsung OneUI 8 (Android 16) restrictions, KeyFlux now uses both ContextWrapper#attachBaseContext AND Instrumentation#callApplicationOnCreate. This guarantees the module loads properly on all OEM ROMs without failing.
- Fail-Proof Preference Scanner: The dynamic preference scanner no longer relies on ANY obfuscated letters (o, x, e). Instead, it scans the entire Gboard app's internal structure at runtime, checking return types and object instances (e.g., androidx.preference.PreferenceGroup).
- Direct Argument Hooking: If the settings screen is intercepted mid-creation, KeyFlux intercepts the PreferenceScreen object directly from the method arguments (param.args[1]), completely bypassing the need for reflection!
- Header Fragment Support: Fixed a silent failure where KeyFlux would abort if it encountered a settings category (like a Header Fragment) that didn't have preferences.

📥 Installation
1. Download the KeyFlux_release_v1.0.2_.apk below.
2. Install the update.
3. Force stop Gboard.
4. Enjoy!

在背景与图标严格保持 B 站官方原色的前提下，将文字与高亮色系全面接入 Android 系统 Monet 动态取色引擎，壁纸一换，B 站配色跟着走。

1. 🎨 官方底色，零妥协
- 绝不染蓝：页面大背景、顶栏、搜索框、卡片底色 100% 保持官方原生（白天纯白，夜间纯黑）。

- 双 Hook 引擎兼容：同时兼容现代 Modern Hook（io.github.libxposed:api）与传统 Xposed API（de.robv.android.xposed）。
- 精准作用域：仅作用于 tv.danmaku.bili，零常驻后台、零电量消耗。
- 静默无日志：release 构建无任何日志输出，不写 LSPosed 日志。
- 不碰发布链路：底栏发布按钮、评论发布按钮、创作中心发布按钮保持官方原样。

5. 换一张壁纸，重启 B 站，配色即跟随系统 Monet 变化。

本模块仅供技术交流与个人学习使用。

简体中文 | English

简体中文
⚠️ 重要声明
本项目仅供学习研究和合法的开发调试使用。严禁用于任何非法目的，包括但不限于：欺骗、破解商业软件、干扰他人设备、未经授权的追踪、恶意攻击等。使用本模块造成的任何法律后果由使用者自行承担。请遵守当地法律法规。

一个强大的 Xposed/LSPosed 模块，用于向 Android 系统蓝牙扫描结果中注入虚拟 BLE 设备，方便开发者进行蓝牙应用调试。

✨ 功能特性

核心功能
- ✅ 虚拟设备注入 - 向系统蓝牙扫描结果注入自定义 BLE 设备
- ✅ 完全自定义 - 自定义 MAC 地址、RSSI 信号强度和广播数据
- ✅ 多设备管理 - 同时管理多个虚拟设备
- ✅ 实时生效 - 修改设备配置后无需重启

完整版本

完整的源代码、详细文档和最佳实践请访问：

主仓库 - jingyu233/BluetoothHook

如果这个项目对你有帮助，请在主仓库给它一个 ⭐ Star！

📋 系统要求
- Android 10 (API 29) 及以上
- LSPosed 框架（推荐）或 Xposed 框架
- Root 权限

📱 使用指南

添加虚拟设备

1. 点击右下角的 + 按钮
2. 填写设备信息：
- 设备名称: 显示在扫描列表中的名称
- MAC 地址: 格式为 AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
- RSSI: 信号强度 (-100 到 0，越接近 0 信号越强)
- 广播数据: 十六进制格式的 BLE 广播数据
- 扫描响应数据 (可选): 扫描响应的十六进制数据
- 广播间隔: 设备出现频率（毫秒）
3. 点击右上角的 √ 保存

广播模式选择

系统会根据数据长度自动选择最佳模式：

传统广播模式 (1-31 字节)
- 适用于简单设备
- 兼容所有 BLE 设备
- 示例: 02 01 06 09 09 4D79426561636F6E (Flags + 设备名 "MyBeacon")

传统广播 + 扫描响应 (32-62 字节)
- 将数据分为广播数据（31字节）和扫描响应（31字节）
- 兼容所有 BLE 设备
- 点击 "自动分割" 按钮可自动分割数据

扩展广播模式 (63-254 字节)
- 支持大量数据传输
- 需要 BLE 5.0+ 硬件支持
- 点击 "使用扩展广播" 按钮切换

快速创建标准设备

点击 "根据设备名称自动生成广播数据" 按钮，系统会自动生成包含 Flags 和设备名称的标准 BLE 广播数据。

🔧 技术架构

Hook 实现

模块通过 Hook ScanController.onScanResultInternal() 方法（位于 com.android.bluetooth.le_scan.ScanController）实现虚拟设备注入。

关键 Hook 点（基于 AOSP 源码分析）：
- 文件: com/android/bluetooth/le_scan/ScanController.java
- 方法: onScanResultInternal() (line 362)
- 注入时机: 在真实扫描结果分发后，遍历所有扫描客户端时注入

📊 广播数据格式

BLE 广播数据使用 AD (Advertising Data) 结构格式：

[Length] [Type] [Data...] [Length] [Type] [Data...]

本项目采用 MIT 协议开源。

- Xposed Framework - 原始 Xposed 框架

A powerful Xposed/LSPosed module for injecting virtual BLE devices into Android system Bluetooth scan results, facilitating Bluetooth application debugging for developers.

✨ Features

- ✅ Virtual Device Injection - Inject custom BLE devices into system Bluetooth scan results
- ✅ Fully Customizable - Customize MAC address, RSSI signal strength, and advertising data

📱 User Guide

Adding Virtual Devices

1. Tap the + button in the bottom right corner
2. Fill in device information:
- Device Name: Name displayed in scan list
- MAC Address: Format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
- RSSI: Signal strength (-100 to 0, closer to 0 means stronger)
- Advertising Data: BLE advertising data in hexadecimal format
- Scan Response Data (optional): Hexadecimal scan response data
- Advertising Interval: Device appearance frequency (milliseconds)
3. Tap the √ button in the top right to save

Advertising Mode Selection

The system automatically selects the best mode based on data length:

Legacy Advertising Mode (1-31 bytes)
- Suitable for simple devices
- Compatible with all BLE devices
- Example: 02 01 06 09 09 4D79426561636F6E (Flags + device name "MyBeacon")

Legacy Advertising + Scan Response (32-62 bytes)
- Data split into advertising data (31 bytes) and scan response (31 bytes)
- Compatible with all BLE devices
- Tap "Auto Split" button to automatically split data

Extended Advertising Mode (63-254 bytes)
- Supports large data transmission
- Requires BLE 5.0+ hardware support
- Tap "Use Extended Advertising" button to switch

Quick Create Standard Device

Tap the "Auto-generate advertising data from device name" button, and the system will automatically generate standard BLE advertising data containing Flags and device name.

🔧 Technical Architecture

Hook Implementation

The module implements virtual device injection by hooking the ScanController.onScanResultInternal() method (located in com.android.bluetooth.le_scan.ScanController).

Key Hook Point (based on AOSP source code analysis):
- File: com/android/bluetooth/le_scan/ScanController.java
- Method: onScanResultInternal() (line 362)
- Injection Timing: After real scan results are distributed, inject when iterating through all scan clients

📊 Advertising Data Format

BLE advertising data uses AD (Advertising Data) structure format:

[Length] [Type] [Data...] [Length] [Type] [Data...]
