modules.name: MountX
modules.author: Noir
modules.description: Android App & Game Storage Bind-Mount Engine & Advanced I/O Optimization.
modules.readme:
MountX

Move massive Android games to MicroSD or USB storage with zero lag, zero crashes, and zero reinstallation.

Running out of space from 50 GB+ games like *Wuthering Waves*, *Genshin Impact*, or *Honkai: Star Rail*?

MountX safely moves heavy game files to your MicroSD card, external SSD, or USB drive while keeping the phone convinced they are still on internal storage. Your games run at full speed, updates work normally, and your save data is never touched.

Download APK & Module  •  Getting Started  •  Documentation Wiki

      Master Control

      Storage Breakdown

      Apps Manager

      Partition Manager

🎯 What You Get
- Reclaim 30 GB to 80 GB per Game
  Move massive texture packs, audio files, and cutscenes to your external storage and free up your precious internal memory for photos, videos, and daily apps.
- Native Hardware Speed & Zero Lag
  Unlike old moving methods that caused stutter, games load assets directly through native storage channels without performance loss.
- Safe by Design: Zero Risk of Data Loss
  Your login sessions, saved progress, and app databases stay safe on internal storage. Only the heavy, replaceable asset files are moved.
- Automatic Boot Restoration
  Reboot your phone whenever you want. MountX automatically restores all game mounts in the background before you even unlock your screen.
- Beautiful Dark & Light Themes
  Features a high-contrast AMOLED Cyber Dark theme and a soft Sandstone Light theme that adapts to your system setting.

🛠️ Technical Highlights

For power users and developers interested in the implementation:
- Kernel VFS Bind-Mounts: Direct filesystem redirection with global namespace propagation, bypassing user-space FUSE overhead and EXDEV errors.
- Granular Category Offloading: Selectively offload game assets (Android/data), expansion files (Android/obb), or custom folders while keeping SQLite databases in /data/data.
- Integrated Partition Formatter: Format and manage F2FS, Ext4, exFAT, and FAT32 partitions directly within the app, complete with filesystem checking (fsck).
- Kernel I/O Speed Booster: Automatically tunes sysfs block queue parameters (read-ahead cache buffer up to 2048 KB, I/O schedulers) at boot.
- Universal Root Compatibility: Powered by libsu, working identically across Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch.
📖 Curious about how it works under the hood?
Read our full technical breakdown in Architecture & Internals.

📋 Requirements
- Root Access: Magisk 24+, KernelSU 0.9+, or APatch 10+
- Android OS: Android 10 to Android 16 (API 29–36)
- Storage Media: MicroSD card, External USB-C SSD, or USB OTG drive
- Filesystem: F2FS or Ext4 recommended for native POSIX permissions. exFAT and FAT32 are also supported.

🚀 Quick Start

Choose either of the two hassle-free installation methods:
- Method 1: Universal Module Flash (Recommended)
  1. Download MountX-Magisk-v.zip from GitHub Releases.
  2. Flash the ZIP in Magisk, KernelSU, or APatch. The installer automatically installs the companion MountX app during flash.
  3. Reboot your device, launch MountX from your app drawer, and grant Superuser access.
- Method 2: Standalone APK with In-App Activation
  1. Download and install MountX-v.apk.
  2. Launch the app and grant Superuser permission.
  3. On the Dashboard, tap Install & Activate Module to install the root backend directly without rebooting.

Managing Storage
Open the Apps tab, select your application, tap Manage Storage, choose the data categories to offload (Data, OBB, etc.), select your target external disk and partition, and tap Start Transfer.

📚 Documentation

Detailed guides and manuals are available in the repository and the MountX Wiki:
- Installation Guide : Prerequisites, root setup, and configuration.
- User Guide : Interface overview, partition tools, and storage management.
- Architecture & Internals : Deep technical dive into kernel namespaces, VFS bind-mounts, and I/O tuning.
- FAQ & Troubleshooting : Common questions, crash prevention, and error solutions.
- Contributing Guide : Developer guide, code style, and pull request workflow.
- Changelog : Full release and version history.

❤️ Support the Project

MountX is free and open-source. If it helped you save storage, consider supporting ongoing development:
- ☕ Ko-fi: Support on Ko-fi
- 💳 PayPal: Donate via PayPal
- 💰 Saweria: Dukung via Saweria

📄 License

MountX is licensed under the MIT License.

Developed and maintained by Noir (@Zy0x).

[2.2.48] - 2026-11-04

Added
- Spotify & Private Data Loop Container Engine:

- Added automated SELinux context restoration (u:object_r:app_data_file:s0:c...) and POSIX UID/GID ownership realignment, permanently resolving SQLite and database permission denials for offline music libraries (Spotify) and sensitive app caches.
- Implemented streaming data migration pipeline (tar -c | tar -x) for zero-loss transfer of complex internal directories directly to loop containers without intermediate archive space exhaustion.
- Long backing file paths exceeding 64 characters safely leverage busybox losetup to prevent kernel string truncation.
- Zero-Reboot Silent Module Sync & Live Daemon Reload:
- Introduced seamless root module synchronization on app cold-start (checkAndSyncModuleSilently), copying updated scripts and binaries from APK assets to root storage without requiring Magisk/KernelSU/APatch re-flashing.
- Added graceful daemon termination via /dev/.mountx_service.pid to avoid shell byte-offset corruption during script updates.
- Implemented live daemon reload (nohup sh service.sh &) that immediately adopts updated watchdog supervisor logic while keeping all active mounts intact without requiring a system reboot.
- Added dormant daemon watchdog revival guard to automatically restart the background supervisor if terminated by system memory constraints.

Changed & Improved
- 100% Strict Bilingual Parity (Zero Hardcoded Strings):
- Eliminated all Indonesian text leaks in English system locales across the entire application interface.
- Synchronized values/strings.xml (natural English) and values-id/strings.xml (natural Indonesian) with 1,170 identical translation keys (1:1 parity).
- Cleaned and refactored string resolution across ViewModels, root managers, and Jetpack Compose screens.
- Adaptive I/O Booster Stability across Storage Hardware:
- Refined kernel block queue and read-ahead tuning to strictly target the designated block device BDI (/sys/class/block/$disk/bdi/read_ahead_kb), preventing memory bloat and swap thrashing on zram.
- Added kernel scheduler compatibility verification before applying requested schedulers (such as none, mq-deadline, bfq), preventing kernel write rejections across diverse device kernels.
- Improved queue depth and I/O scheduler presets for budget eMMC 5.1, low/high-class MicroSD (UHS-I, A1/A2), external USB SSDs, and UFS 2.x/3.x/4.0 storage.
- Dynamic Storage Branding & UI Polish:

- Replaced nested pager swipe in application detail view with responsive segmented capsules ([ Media | Details ]), resolving infinite height measurement crashes....

modules.readme:
Now Bar Color

Customize the collapsed Now Bar capsule background on Samsung One UI 8.0+ & One UI 9.0+ (Lock Screen)

Overview

Now Bar Color is an advanced LSPosed module for Samsung Galaxy devices running One UI 8.0, 8.5, and One UI 9.0+. It provides full control over the background styling of collapsed lock screen Now Bar capsules—applying solid colors, frosted-glass blur effects, smooth two-stop horizontal gradients, and adaptive wallpaper palettes without altering album artwork, notification icons, text colors, or native system animations.

It includes a native One UI companion app with interactive live capsule previews, dynamic audio waveforms, large One UI squircle vector badges with transparent cutouts that preview each capsule's active color or gradient, per-category toggles, independent opacity sliders, and trilingual support (English, Spanish, and Portuguese). Deep hooks in SystemUI and FaceWidget/AOD deliver zero-lag styling from frame 0 while completely suppressing Samsung's default chip gradient overlays.

Screenshots & Examples

Examples showing how custom colors, gradients, and blur effects blend dynamically with lock screen wallpapers and capsule categories:

| Solid & Adaptive Palettes | Two-Stop Gradients | Frosted Blur & Companion UI |
| :---: | :---: | :---: |
|  |  |  |

Compatibility & Downloads

Critical Architecture & AOD_Service Build Requirement — One UI 8.0 / 8.5 vs. One UI 9.0+
- Having One UI 9 does NOT guarantee out-of-the-box compatibility: Samsung's AOD_Service (com.samsung.android.app.aodservice) changes drastically across different device branches, models, and firmware builds.
- Mandatory Base AOD_Service Build (896548000): It is strictly mandatory to run the exact same base build of AOD_Service used to develop this module—extracted from the Galaxy S26 FE, build 896548000 (v8.9.65.48). Running any other AOD_Service variant or branch will cause graphical glitches in the capsule or prevent the module from working entirely.
- Running One UI 8.0 or 8.5 (Suite Required): Lower One UI versions do not include the One UI 9 AODService natively. Installing NowBarColor.apk alone will have no effect on One UI 8.x. You must flash NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip (via KernelSU, Magisk, or APatch), which installs and stabilizes the required components out of the box on the first boot.
- Running One UI 9.0 or newer (Standalone APK + Mandatory AOD_Service): Do not flash the Suite ZIP. Your device runs One UI 9, but you must install the standalone AOD_Service.apk (896548000) provided in this release alongside NowBarColor.apk.

All official builds are available on the Releases page:

| Target System | Package File | Package Type / Description | Direct Download |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| All Supported Versions | NowBarColor.apk | LSPosed Module APK (v1.3.0, versionCode 4) | Download APK (v1.3.0) |
| One UI 9.0+ (Mandatory Base) | AOD_Service.apk | S26 FE Base App (Build 896548000 / v8.9.65.48) | Download AOD_Service.apk (896548000) |
| One UI 8.0 & 8.5 ONLY | NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip | All-in-One Root Module (KernelSU / Magisk / APatch) | Download Suite (v1.3.0) |

Installation Guide

Option A: One UI 8.0 & 8.5 Devices (1-Step All-in-One Suite)

1. Ensure LSPosed Framework (Zygisk or JingMatrix/Vector fork) is installed on your rooted device (KernelSU, Magisk v26+, or APatch).
2. Download NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip.
3. Open KernelSU, Magisk, or APatch Manager, go to the Modules tab, and flash NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip.
4. Reboot your device.
5. Done! Both NowBarColor and LockScreenFix_OU9 are automatically activated in LSPosed upon boot—no manual setup in LSPosed Manager is needed. Open Now Bar Color from your app drawer to customize your capsules.

📦 What is included inside NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip? (Click to expand)
- One UI 9 Core Lock Screen & AOD Apps: AODService (v8.9.65.48 / build 896548000 extracted from Galaxy S26 FE), DressRoom, GalleryWidget, and SamsungGallery pre-configured for priv-app mounting.
- Good Lock Companion Plugin: LockStar (v9.0.00.5) automatically installed with required system permissions.
- LockScreenFix (LSPosed Module by TAVATAAN): LockScreenFix_OU9 v2.1.7 stabilizes all ported One UI 9 lock screen, AOD, media controls, and gallery components on One UI 8.0 / 8.5.
- NowBarColor v1.3.0 (LSPosed Module): Full Now Bar background customization app and hooking engine.
- Automatic LSPosed SQLite Activation & Permissions: Automatically registers and enables both NowBarColor and LockScreenFix_OU9 directly inside LSPosed's configuration database (modules_config.db) with all required target scopes and runtime permissions (WRITE_SETTINGS, storage, calendar).

Option B: One UI 9.0+ Devices (Standalone APK)

If your ROM is already on One UI 9.0 or higher, do not flash NowBar_LockScreen_Suite.zip.

1. Download AOD_Service.apk (S26 FE — Build 896548000) and install it as an update over your system's Always On Display service.
💡 Troubleshooting Cross-Branch Installation Failure (KernelSU):
If AOD_Service.apk fails to install as an update due to signature/branch verification differences across Samsung firmware branches, disable the official release check first by running the following command in a root terminal:
su -c "/data/adb/ksu/bin/resetprop -n ro.build.official.release false"
Then install AOD_Service.apk again.
2. Download and install NowBarColor.apk (or install/update directly from the LSPosed Repository).
3. Open LSPosed Manager and enable Now Bar Color with its recommended scopes (System UI and Always On Display).
4. Restart System UI (su -c killall com.android.systemui) or reboot your device.
5. Open Now Bar Color from your launcher to configure your colors, gradients, blur, and per-capsule styles.

Features

Visual Finish Modes & Adaptive Palettes

| Finish Modes | Adaptive Wallpaper Extraction |
| :--- | :--- |
| Pure Solid Color: Vibrant, high-contrast backgrounds...

modules.name: oneui-recents-toolkit
modules.author: rushiranpise
modules.description: An LSPosed module for OneUI 8.5 and OneUI 9 that adds Force stop, Restart and Screenshot to the per-task popup menu in Recents,
modules.readme:
Recents Toolkit

LSPosed module for OneUI 8.5 and OneUI 9 that adds Force stop, Restart, Screenshot, a Device care style memory card to Recents, and live charging details to the lock screen.
- Force stop closes the menu and force-stops that one app (the tapped task only). Its Recents card is deliberately left in place - only the process is stopped, so the carousel never has to re-layout behind the menu and cannot get stuck.
- Restart force-stops the same app and then starts it again, so it comes back cold in the foreground.
- Screenshot saves a picture of the app itself into Pictures/Screenshots. It is the task's own snapshot, not the current screen, so the recents UI and the menu are never in it.
- Memory card shows used and advertised RAM, a usage bar, reserved memory and RAM Plus above the navigation bar. It refreshes every 2 seconds while Recents is open. If One UI X's tagged memory line is present, the card sits above it.
- Charging details adds a line below One UI's charging percentage and time-to-full with live wattage, current, voltage and battery temperature. It appears while charging and updates from battery broadcasts.

Requirements
- Samsung device on OneUI 8.5 or OneUI 9
- Root via one of:
- Magisk + Zygisk + LSPosed
- KernelSU + ZygiskNext + LSPosed

There are no separate Magisk/KernelSU builds. It's a plain LSPosed APK hooking com.android.systemui (and the OneUI launcher), so it works anywhere LSPosed runs.

Install

1. Download the APK from this repository's Releases and install it.
2. In LSPosed Manager, go to Modules and enable Recents Toolkit.
3. Set the scope to com.android.systemui and com.sec.android.app.launcher.
4. Reboot, or restart SystemUI.
5. Open Recents. The memory card appears at the bottom; tap a task's icon for the task menu. Lock the phone while charging to see the extra charging line.

Credits

The original work this module grew out of is ForceKill Focused by the 1ndevelopment team (1ndevelopment/lsp-forcekill-focused): the task-menu injection, the LayoutInflater hook, the card and target resolution, and the stop sequence all began there and are still the shape of the code here. This repository is that work, unmaintained upstream and carried forward for OneUI 9 on the developer's own device, with the anchor row, the kept Recents card, the Restart row and the Screenshot row added on top. Thank you to 1ndevelopment for the foundation.

How it works

The task menu lives in MainHook.java; the memory card lives in MemoryCardHook.java; the charging line lives in ChargingInfoHook.java.
- Menu injection: OneUI's task menu is a custom DataBinding view (task_menu_layout containing task_menu_item_layout rows), not a framework PopupMenu. This was verified via on-device resource and stack-trace inspection.
- Hook point: LayoutInflater.inflate() is hooked. Each task_menu_item_layout inflation schedules a post() that clones the rows below the App info row, which is matched by its task_option_app_info string. A marker tag per row ensures each is added only once.
- Anchor row: App info is used rather than the pin row because it is present for every task and its title never changes. OneUI 9 renamed the old Keep open row to Pin to Recents (task_option_pin_to_recents), which is why the previous anchor stopped matching.
- Target resolution, in order:
  1. The tapped card's TaskView.getTaskPackageName() (exact)
  2. The view-tag chain (TaskIconView args)
  3. The top non-system recent task
- Stop sequence: hidden ActivityManager.forceStopPackage(), with a su am force-stop fallback if the app survives. This runs inside the hooked process (SystemUI / launcher), which holds the required permission.
- Restart: the same stop sequence, then the package's launch intent is started with FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK on the main thread, so the app comes back as a fresh process.
- Screenshot: the card's TaskSceneView holds the task snapshot (TaskSceneData.thumbnail), which is copied out of a hardware bitmap and written through MediaStore into Pictures/Screenshots. If a task has no snapshot to hand, the card's on-screen pixels are copied with PixelCopy and cropped to the card instead.
- Memory card: RecentsActivity.onCreate() adds a card to the decor view, onResume() starts a 2-second refresh, and onPause() stops it. RAM comes from ActivityManager.MemoryInfo; the advertised capacity is rounded from totalMem because advertisedMem reports the wrong size on some firmware. RAM Plus comes from Settings.Global.ram_expand_size; swap comes from /proc/meminfo. The card detects the oneuix:recents_memory view and offsets itself above it.
- Charging details: on the lock screen, KeyguardIndicationController.setIndicationArea() appends a TextView below keyguard_indication_text_bottom. On AOD, PluginAODManager.setAODPlugin() gets the AOD plugin class loader and ChargingInfoView.onFinishInflate() appends the same line below the stock time-to-full text. ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED, BatteryManager current, voltage and temperature update both while charging.

Troubleshooting

Recents internals change between OneUI builds.
- Button doesn't appear: get the Recents activity name and check that it matches the module's substring filter:
    adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -i recents
    Then check the LSPosed log for RecentsToolkit.
- Memory card doesn't appear: confirm the module scope includes com.sec.android.app.launcher and that the Recents activity is com.android.quickstep.RecentsActivity. Check the LSPosed log for RecentsToolkit: memory card.
- Two memory views: leave One UI X's memory line enabled and the card will sit above it, or turn that line off if you only want the card.
- Charging line doesn't appear: confirm the module scope includes com.android.systemui, the AOD plugin loaded, and the LSPosed log contains RecentsToolkit: charging info.
modules.changelog:
Adds two things to what Recents Toolkit already does: a memory card in Recents, and a live charging line on the lock screen and AOD. The existing Force stop, Restart and Screenshot rows are unchanged.

Memory card in Recents

A Device care style card now sits above the navigation bar while Recents is open.
- Used and advertised RAM, with a usage bar
- Reserved memory and RAM Plus
- Refreshes every 2 seconds while Recents is open, and stops when it closes
- If you also use One UI X's memory line, the card sits above it instead of overlapping

The advertised capacity is rounded from total memory, because the platform's advertised figure reports the wrong size on some firmware.

Charging details on the lock screen and AOD

Below One UI's own charging percentage and time-to-full, there is now a line like:

2.0W · 498mA · 4.00V · 29.6°C
- Live values. Wattage, current, voltage and battery temperature all come from the battery service, refreshed on ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED, so they track the real charge as it changes.
- Wattage is battery-side power (battery current multiplied by battery voltage), not the wattage the charger advertises. It is what the battery is actually taking in, so it drops as the battery fills.
- Matching style. The line copies the stock charging text's font, size, letter spacing and alpha, so it reads as part of the same block instead of an add-on.
- Both surfaces. The same line appears on the lock screen indication area and on AOD.

Install

1. Install the APK.
2. In LSPosed Manager, enable Recents Toolkit and set its scope to com.android.systemui and com.sec.android.app.launcher.
3. Restart SystemUI, or reboot.
4. Open Recents for the memory card, and lock the phone while charging for the charging line.

Note

This APK is signed with the same debug key as 2.0, so it updates over an installed 2.0 without uninstalling. The release keystore is still not published; if you build your own release, sign it with your own key.

modules.name: PermKeeper
modules.author: permkeeper
modules.description: Clear-data 后保留应用运行时权限/通知开关（Zygisk, 注入 system_server）
modules.readme:
PermKeeper

简体中文 | English

一个 Magisk / KernelSU / SukiSU 的 Zygisk 模块。应用执行“清除数据”后，自动把它清除前的设置恢复回来；另支持导出配置，导入后批量恢复全部应用的权限与设置。

恢复内容
- 运行时权限
- AppOps（含厂商自定义 op，如小米 MIUIOP：自启动、联网、后台弹出等）
- 通知（总开关与各通知渠道）
- 省电策略（Doze 白名单）
- 自启动

按每个应用自身已有的状态记录与恢复，不是固定清单，所以不同应用互不影响。

原理

模块注入 system_server，监听系统的 PACKAGE_DATA_CLEARED 广播；在系统完成权限重置后，按此前记录的状态回补。部分系统（如 HyperOS）会先发广播、后重置权限，模块会等权限存储稳定后再恢复，并校验重试。

环境要求
- 已 Root：Magisk / KernelSU / SukiSU，且启用 Zygisk
- 实测：一加 ColorOS 16、红米 K80 至尊版 HyperOS 4（Android 17）、小米 17 Pro Max HyperOS 4（Android 17）

安装

1. 在 Root 管理器中安装 permkeeper-zygisk.zip
2. 重启设备

使用

1. 打开模块的 WebUI（KsuWebUI，或管理器自带的 WebUI 入口）
2. 在“选择应用”里勾选需要保护的应用。默认全部保护，取消勾选即为“排除”
3. 改动即时生效并自动保存
4. 导出 / 导入在 WebUI 内：
- 导出配置：导出到 /sdcard/Download/permkeeper/
- 导入并恢复权限设置：按导出的快照覆盖各应用权限（权限集有变化的应用会跳过）

卸载

在管理器中卸载模块并重启。卸载会清除模块生成的缓存（图标等），保留 config.json 与导出的配置文件。

目录结构

zsrc/         注入 system_server 的 Java 源码
zygisk/       Zygisk 入口（C++）与 API 头
webroot/      WebUI（index.html）
module/       module.prop、post-fs-data.sh、uninstall.sh、permkeeper.sh
build_zygisk.py   离线构建脚本

构建

python build_zygisk.py

依赖：JDK、Android SDK build-tools、NDK（路径见 build_zygisk.py 顶部）。产物输出到 out/permkeeper-zygisk.zip。

已测试范围
- 系统：一加 ColorOS 16（Android 16）、红米 K80 至尊版 HyperOS 4（Android 17）、小米 17 Pro Max HyperOS 4（Android 17）
- 恢复内容：运行时权限、特殊权限（如“显示悬浮窗”）、AppOps（含小米 MIUIOP：自启动 / 联网 / 后台弹出等）、通知（总开关与渠道）、省电（Doze 白名单）、自启动

已知限制
- 上述范围之外（其它厂商 / 系统版本、未列出的 OEM 设置）未经验证，可能不生效或表现不同，请以实际设备为准。
- 无障碍服务、默认应用、通知使用权等非 AppOps 项暂不覆盖。
- Doze 白名单、厂商自启动的实现随系统而异（小米走 AppOps，一加走 XML 文件）。

第三方
- zygisk/zygisk.hpp 为 Zygisk 模块 API 头文件，版权归 John "topjohnwu" Wu，采用宽松许可（见文件头），原始版权声明予以保留。

许可证

本项目采用 GPL-3.0 许可证。
modules.changelog:
本次更新（相对 v0.2）：
- 通知：清数据后重建渠道时改用带 uid 的重载，修复渠道被建到 uid 1000、应用自己名下为空的问题
- 导出：一次请求只触发一次采集，修复并发跑两遍与进度条倒退
- 基线：剔除已移出保护范围的应用条目，避免基线膨胀、保留过期格式
- 基线：恢复过程中被打断时保留旧快照，开机后补做恢复，避免半恢复状态被固化
- 配置：WebUI 保存改为临时文件 + rename，修复写入瞬间出现 0 字节、可能导致模块回退成「不保护任何应用」
- 界面：KsuWebUI 不支持文件选择，改为列出下载目录内的 JSON 直接读取

完整对比：https://github.com/qover12/permkeeper/compare/v0.2...v0.3

PicoDockShortcut

- 🛡️ System Health Check: Built-in diagnostics detect Root access and LSPosed status, providing clear warning popups if requirements aren't met.

⛏️ Prerequisites
- Device: Pico 4 Headset (Phoenix/China firmware supported).
- Superuser: Root Access is required to apply changes to system files.
- Environment: LSPosed Framework must be installed and active.
- Permission: Grant root access when prompted by the app.
- LSPosed Scope: Ensure Dock (com.pvr.shortcut) is selected in the LSPosed module scope.

📐 How to use?

1. Install the PicoDockShortcut APK on your headset.
2. Enable the module in the LSPosed Manager.
3. Select Scope: Make sure Dock (com.pvr.shortcut) is checked in the module's scope settings.
4. Reboot your device or restart the com.pvr.shortcut process to activate the hooks.
5. Open PicoDockShortcut:
- Add App: Tap the + slot to pick an app from the installed list.
- Reorder: Long-press and drag any slot to change its position on the dock.
- Custom Icon: Tap the image icon at the top-left of a slot to pick a custom image from storage.
- Change App: Tap the app slot body to swap it with another app.
- Delete: Tap the delete icon at the top-right to remove a shortcut.
6. Apply: Tap the Apply button. The app will request Root access, save the configuration, and restart the Dock service automatically.

⁉️ Why are my changes not appearing?
- Check if the LSPosed module is active.
- Ensure the Dock (com.pvr.shortcut) app is selected in the scope.
- Verify that you have granted Root permissions to PicoDockShortcut.
- Try a full device reboot if the service restart doesn't catch the changes.

⁉️ How do custom icons work?

The app saves your chosen images to /data/user/0/com.hamer.dockshortcut/Image/Custom. The LSPosed hook intercepts the Dock's request for assets and provides these custom files instead.

🔃 Language Support

The app supports multiple languages including English, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Thai, German, French, and more. You can override the system language using the Language Selector (globe icon) in the top-right corner.

🎯 Custom Dock App List

The app intercepts com.pvr.shortcut's dock_fix_apps.json, letting you configure the pinned Dock apps through the GUI instead of editing files by hand.

🧩 Fit Center Control

Fit Center is a hard-coded Dock entry in Chinese/Phoenix firmware. This version turns it into a GUI toggle so it can be removed or kept explicitly.

🖼️ Custom Dock Background

You can set a custom image for the Dock bar, with built-in fixed-ratio cropping and a shared background for the onboarding guide bar.

🙏 Special thanks to
- LSPosed Framework - For providing the powerful hooking engine.
- Jetpack Compose - For the modern declarative UI toolkit.
- Material 3 - For the sleek design components.

SPenCursorOverlay

A Magisk module for Galaxy Tab devices running AOSP-based ROMs.
Restores a proper arrow pointer for OTG/Bluetooth mouse use, while keeping the OneUI S Pen hover dot as the tap indicator.
Requires "Show taps" to be enabled in Developer Options.

What This Module Does
- Flags the S Pen device type as a touchscreen input
- Turns the pointer_arrow image into a mouse arrow again
- Replaces pointer_spot_hover with a OneUI-style S Pen dot
- Makes pointer_spot_touch transparent, so nothing appears when your finger touches the screen

Installation

1. Download the latest .zip from Releases.
2. Open Magisk → Modules → Install from storage.
3. Select the downloaded zip.
4. Follow the instructions and select the desired cursor color theme.
5. Reboot.

Known Limitations
- "Show taps" must be on — the S Pen hover dot relies on the tap indicator system and cannot be shown without enabling it globally.
- S Pen contact hides the dot — pointer_spot_touch is intentionally transparent, so no indicator appears when the tip touches the screen.
- Finger touches are also invisible — a side effect of the transparent pointer_spot_touch; tap indicators are hidden even with "Show taps" on.
- Changing the cursor theme requires a reinstall — resource overlays cannot be reloaded while the system is running.

Compatibility

modules.name: Storage Redirect is an Xposed/LSPatch module that
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Storage Redirect is an Xposed/LSPatch module that lets you choose exactly where apps save their files, folders, and data. Instead of apps cluttering your phone with random folders, you can automatically redirect them to any custom folder you prefer.
modules.readme:
Storage Redirect

Xposed module for rootless LSPatch (also works under LSPosed). Redirects the hooked app's
storage to a custom folder on shared storage, so data is read and written there from the first
millisecond instead of the default paths.

It is generic: it redirects whichever app it is embedded in / scoped to (no hardcoded package).
Each redirect has its own fully customizable destination folder (absolute, or relative to /sdcard;
{pkg} = package name). Defaults: Containers/{pkg}/data/data/{pkg}, Containers/{pkg}/Android/data/{pkg}, Containers/{pkg}.
Inside a destination the app keeps its usual sub-folders (files, cache, databases, ...).
Don't point internal and external at the same folder: their files/cache would mix (the UI warns).

What can be redirected (switches in the module's UI)

Each app can have its own settings (open the app in the module's list and turn on
"Custom settings for this app"); apps without an override follow the Default settings.

| Switch | Redirects |
|---|---|
| Unified Sandbox | Auto-redirects all storage into one container folder chosen by user (Containers/{pkg} or custom). Reads container as /storage/emulated/0/ |
| Internal data | /data/data/: getFilesDir, getCacheDir, getDir, getDatabasePath, no_backup |
| SharedPreferences | shared_prefs (needs Internal data) |
| App external data | /Android/data/ and /Android/obb/ |
| Main storage | /storage/emulated/0 becomes a private virtual sdcard per app |
| Hardcoded paths | Rewrites raw /data/data/..., /sdcard/... strings in File(String) |

getCodeCacheDir, webview, native library directories (lib, libs, app_libs), Meta Superpack archives (.spo, decompressed/libs.spo), and LSPatch origin APKs/caches (/cache/lspatch, /files/lspatch, /lspatch, /app_lspatch, and any .apk inside private storage) are deliberately protected in real private storage so Android's noexec shared storage restriction and dynamic loaders (such as Facebook SoLoader / WhatsAppLibLoader) never fail.

Look and feel — ViviMusic & Material 3 Expressive Design

Redesigned following the signature visual design and animations of ViviMusic:
- ModernSwitch Animated Toggles: Material 3 Expressive switches with fluid spring thumb morphing (horizontal elongation during travel), micro-vector in-thumb checkmark (✓) in Vivi Coral and dismiss cross (✕), smooth ArgbEvaluator color interpolation, and tactile haptic feedback. Clicking anywhere on the item row triggers toggle with ripple feedback.
- Vivi Textbox Styling: 16dp rounded input containers with subtle idle outline and focused Vivi Coral (#ED5564) accent borders. Clean pill search bar (26dp radius, surfaceContainerLow fill, Coral search icon).
- Grouped Settings Hierarchy: Preference groups shaped with Vivi's listItemShape (24dp single card, 24dp top / 6dp bottom for first, 6dp for middle, 6dp top / 24dp bottom for last item; 4dp vertical gap).
- Color Tokens & Palettes: Signature Vivi Coral Red (#ED5564) default accent, pure AMOLED black and dark slate palettes (#0A0A0C background, #141418 low container, #18181E container, #202026 high container, #EEEEF2 text, #9E9EA8 secondary).
- Navigation Suite: 4-tab bottom navigation (Apps, Rules, Backups, Settings) with selection pill indicators and horizontal swipe paging.
- Iconography: 100% crisp Phosphor vector icons.

Configuration Storage & Architecture

Fixed Configuration Directory
The module configuration resides in a fixed shared directory:
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/config.properties        # Global defaults
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/redirect.properties      # Compatibility mirror
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/.config-location         # Location pointer
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/apps/.properties   # Per-app overrides
/storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/backup/.properties # Per-app backup schedules
- Unified Path: Accessible by both the module UI and all hooked apps across separate processes and UIDs under LSPatch and LSPosed.
- Dual Filename Support: config.properties is the primary configuration file, mirrored with redirect.properties for seamless backwards compatibility.
- Location Pointer: .config-location lives directly inside /storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/ alongside the configuration files.
- Relative Path Support: Whenever customizing any path (configuration directory, redirect rules, folder redirects, block/exclude paths, or backups), if the path starts without /, the absolute path defaults to /storage/emulated/0/*path*. If it starts with /, the full path is used.
- One-Time Migration: On first launch, if /storage/emulated/0/Android/media/uninviting/ has no configuration files, any existing configuration from legacy locations (Android/data/uninviting, CustomData/.config, or internal storage) is automatically migrated into the fixed directory.
- Portable Backups: Settings can be exported and imported at any time via the Module configuration backup feature in Settings.

Live Configuration Reload

No more force-stopping hooked apps after changing rules in the UI:
- Lock-Free Freshness Check: On entry to hooked path methods (File constructors, libcore.io.Linux, UnixFileSystem, java.nio.file, SQLite), a rate-limited freshness check stats the configuration file at most once every 800 ms per process using atomic compare-and-swap.
- Steady-State Performance: The hot I/O path executes only a single volatile read and timestamp check before proceeding, ensuring negligible CPU and memory overhead.
- Atomic State Swap: When modification or deletion is detected, a complete immutable ActiveState (including compiled Glob patterns, PathEngine rule objects, block sets, and root directories) is built before swapping a single volatile reference. No hooked thread ever observes a partial or inconsistent state....
modules.changelog:
Storage Redirect v2.24 (Release 17-2.24)

🚀 What's New & Included in This Update

📦 1. Unified Sandbox Container Redirection
- Single Root Container: Consolidates all application storage into one main container chosen by the user (e.g. Containers/{pkg} or a custom folder like .fnrod or any user-defined folder name).
- Virtual SDCard Mapping: The hooked application sees and reads the root of this folder as /storage/emulated/0/. Public folders (Download, DCIM, Pictures, Documents) are created directly inside the container, alongside data/data/ and Android/data / Android/obb.
- Integrated Folder Picker: Interactive directory browser with breadcrumb navigation, folder creation, hidden folder toggling, and instant selection directly in the module UI.

🛡️ 2. Dynamic Linker & Native Library Protection (SoLoader / Meta / LSPatch Fix)
- Linux noexec & Linker Namespace Compliant: Native shared libraries (.so), Meta Superpack archives (.spo, files/decompressed/libs.spo/), and LSPatch origin APKs/caches are strictly preserved in real private app storage.
- Fixed app_lspatch Exemption: ContextImpl.getDir("lspatch") (app_lspatch) and raw file constructors now remain in /data/user/0//app_lspatch, preventing clns linker namespace UnsatisfiedLinkError crashes in apps like WhatsApp/LiteX.

📁 3. Public Storage & Downloads Verification
- Public Directory Auto-Creation: Resolved an issue where Environment.getExternalStoragePublicDirectory(Environment.DIRECTORY_DOWNLOADS) bypassed directory creation under fake path mode. Public folders now resolve properly, exist on disk, and support persistent file writing.

🧹 4. Phantom Folder Pruning & Clean Storage Defaults
- Default to Containers/{pkg}: Purged all legacy CustomData references from defaults. Unconfigured apps now default external = false to prevent unwanted folders from being generated on storage.
- Automatic Empty Directory Cleanup: Added recursive empty directory pruning (cleanupEmptyTree) triggered during startup and path switching. Old directories like CustomData are automatically removed and will never be recreated.

🧪 5. Included Diagnostic Test Suite (Redirect Tester v1.1)
- Included RedirectTester-v1.1.apk: A standalone automated testing tool that exercises all Android storage APIs (internal files, cache, databases, shared_prefs, exemptions, external app storage, NIO file channels, random access file streams, and public storage) with one-click clipboard test report generation.

modules.readme:
Universal Refresh Rate & Thermal Dimming Fix

A userspace Android module that locks the display to its native peak refresh rate and neutralizes aggressive thermal-triggered brightness/dimming clamps. Root-agnostic implementation compatible with Magisk, KernelSU and APatch.

Architecture

[Android System]
    │
    ├── Display Management
    │   ├── Settings.System (peak_refresh_rate, min_refresh_rate)
    │   ├── DeviceConfig (display_manager namespace)
    │   └── DisplayModeDirector (API 35+)
    │
    └── Thermal Management
        ├── cmd thermal override-status (force NONE status)
        └── DeviceConfig (brightness_throttling_data neutralization)

Features
- Refresh Rate Lock: Forces display to operate at maximum detected refresh rate
- Thermal Dimming Neutralization: Prevents aggressive brightness throttling
- SDK-Aware Logic: Auto-adapts to property namespaces across Android 14-17
- Zero Partition Writes: Pure userspace implementation
- Bootloop Safe: Fully reversible on module removal

Compatibility

| Android Version | API Level | Refresh Rate | Thermal Fix |
|----------------|-----------|--------------|-------------|
| Android 14     | API 34    | ✅           | ✅          |
| Android 15     | API 35    | ✅           | ✅          |
| Android 16     | API 36    | ✅           | ✅          |
| Android 17 Beta| API 37    | ✅           | ✅          |

Root Solutions: Magisk • KernelSU • APatch
Architectures: arm • arm64 • x86 • x86_64
FBE Compatible: Yes

Installation

1. Download the latest module ZIP
2. Install through your root manager:
- Magisk: → Modules → Install from storage
- KernelSU: → Modules → Install
- APatch: → Modules → Install
3. Reboot your device

Manual Build

Clone repository
git clone https://github.com/cyberrforge/refresh_thermal_lock
cd refresh_thermal_lock

Package module
zip -r refresh_thermal_lock.zip META-INF/ module.prop service.sh

Technical Details

The module operates through three primary mechanisms:

1. Refresh Rate Lock: Uses settings put system and device_config put display_manager to set peak/min refresh rates
2. Thermal Status Override: Continuously runs cmd thermal override-status 0 to force thermal status to NONE
3. Brightness Throttling Neutralization: Clears thermal brightness throttling data maps via device_config

Debugging

Check module operation:
adb shell cat /data/local/tmp/refresh_thermal_lock.log

Verify refresh rate settings:
adb shell settings get system peak_refresh_rate
adb shell device_config get display_manager peak_refresh_rate

Source Code

Available at: github.com/cyberrforge/refresh_thermal_lock

License

MIT License
modules.changelog:
⚡ Universal Refresh Rate & Thermal Dimming Fix

Deep userspace-level intervention targeting Android 14-17 Beta display/thermal subsystems. Locks peak/min refresh rates to native panel maximum (auto-detected via dumpsys) and neutralizes aggressive thermal dimming clamps.

Core logic: SDK-aware property injection across API 34-37. Refresh rate locks use stable Settings.System keys (peak_refresh_rate, min_refresh_rate) plus device_config namespace adaptation (display_manager keys differ per SDK). Thermal mitigation runs continuous cmd thermal override-status 0 loop to force ThermalManagerService to report NONE status, preventing PowerManager/BrightnessThrottler from triggering dimming. Additional device_config keys nullify brightness throttling data maps.

Zero partition writes. Pure userspace — modifies runtime settings/device_config only. Fully reversible on module removal.

WeChat Anti-Recall

面向微信 8.0.69（versionCode 3022）的 LSPosed 防撤回模块，基于 libxposed Modern API 102。

功能
- 他人撤回消息时保留原消息，并插入“xxx 尝试撤回一条消息”的系统提示。
- 提示中的“一条消息”使用微信原生可点击样式，可定位到原消息。
- 自己撤回消息时完整保留微信原生流程，包括“重新编辑”等功能。
- 仅在微信主进程和受支持版本中安装业务 Hook。
- 不联网，不包含后台服务、轮询或常驻任务。

兼容性

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 目标应用 | 微信 8.0.69（3022） |
| Android | 8.1（API 27）及以上 |
| 框架 | 支持 libxposed Modern API 102 的 LSPosed |
| 模块版本 | 1.4.2（versionCode 16） |

模块依赖微信内部类与方法签名，不支持其他微信版本。版本不匹配时不会安装业务 Hook。

数据说明

模块使用微信自身的消息记录和 UI 组件，不读取或上传聊天内容。为了在微信重启后继续定位，模块会把原消息的本地 ID 写入新增撤回提示的内部保留字段；该元数据保存在微信本地数据库中，不会显示在聊天界面。

安装

1. 从 GitHub Releases 下载并安装 APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用模块，作用域只选择“微信”。
3. 强制停止微信后重新打开。

需要回滚时，在 LSPosed 中停用模块并重启微信，或直接卸载模块。

构建

需要 JDK 17、Android SDK 36，并可从 Maven Central 获取 io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0。

.\gradlew.bat clean :app:assembleDebug

测试 APK 输出到 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/。面向普通用户的已签名版本请从 GitHub Releases 下载。

许可证

本项目采用 MIT License。

免责声明

本项目仅供学习、研究和个人设备使用，与腾讯、微信或 LSPosed 项目无隶属或认可关系。使用前请确认符合当地法律及相关服务条款。

modules.name: xiaomi9pmroot
modules.author: EAEdward
modules.description: 小米平板 9 Pro Max (yingtian) 一键 root：CVE-2026-98260 → rootd → KernelSU late-load → 执行 /data/local/tmp/yt-scripts/*.sh。仅 root，不涉及 Zygisk/LSPosed。
modules.readme:
xiaomi9pmroot

小米平板 9 Pro Max 的 root 工具。开机自动提权，把 KernelSU 装进内核，然后执行你自己的脚本。

*One-tap root for Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max — boots rooted, loads KernelSU, then runs your scripts.*

支持的设备

| | |
|---|---|
| 设备 | Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max · yingtian · M367FC |
| 系统 | OS4.0.16.0.XBMCNXM · Android 17 |
| 内核 | 6.18.21-android17-5-g805aa6adea19 |

内核符号、slab 布局、SELinux 策略都按这一版对齐。换系统或换机型，预检会拦下来。

功能
- 开机自动 root，冷启动 1–5 秒能用 su
- 自动 ksud late-load，KernelSU 管理器直接可用
- 提权后按名字顺序执行 /data/local/tmp/yt-scripts/*.sh，每个一次，以 root 身份
- 全程静默：不弹窗、不发通知

前提

漏洞跑在 shell 身份下，所以需要 Shizuku 先起来（shizuku_server）。

AxManager 跑在 Shizuku 之上：它借 Shizuku 的 shell 起 axeron_server，再把插件拉起来。装它图的是开机自启；不装也能用，手动跑一条命令就行。

安装

装 AxManager（开机自动）

1. 装 Shizuku，用 adb 或无线调试把服务启起来
2. 装 AxManager，在 Shizuku 里授权给它，打开一次
3. AxManager → 插件页 → 安装 Release 里的 xiaomi9pmroot-v1.0.zip
4. 装 Release 里的 KernelSU-v3.3.1.apk，不要点"安装内核"
5. 重启

只装 Shizuku（手动）

adb push plant su98260 ksud ytrl.sh /data/local/tmp/
adb shell chmod 755 /data/local/tmp/plant /data/local/tmp/su98260 /data/local/tmp/ksud /data/local/tmp/ytrl.sh
rish -c "sh /data/local/tmp/ytrl.sh start"

验证

cat /data/local/tmp/ytrl.status    # {"state":"ready","detail":"ksu-online"}
su -c id                           # uid=0(root) ... u:r:ksu:s0
tail /data/local/tmp/root.log

命令

ytrl.sh start      # 提权 → rootd → KSU → 跑脚本；已 root 时只跑脚本
ytrl.sh force      # 强制重来一轮
ytrl.sh scripts    # 只跑脚本
ytrl.sh status     # root / socket-only / none
ytrl.sh check      # 预检

自己的脚本

adb shell mkdir -p /data/local/tmp/yt-scripts
adb push setup.sh /data/local/tmp/yt-scripts/
adb shell "su -c 'sh /data/local/tmp/ytrl.sh scripts'"

输出都进 /data/local/tmp/root.log。

构建

cd plant && make

plant 是 aarch64 静态程序，用 zig 交叉编译。启动器是纯 shell，无构建步骤。

打包：

cd launcher && zip -X xiaomi9pmroot-v1.0.zip module.prop service.sh action.sh ytrl.sh plant su98260 ksud

说明

提权走的是 CVE-2026-98260：begin_new_exec() 里 de_thread() 先 release_task()，之后才清 POSIX CPU timer；exec_mmap 被打断时计时器对象已经释放，而 rb-tree 还挂着它们。等父进程 reap，内核就会拿我们铺好的 rb_node 做 rb_erase。一次调用排空三棵树，三个时钟各挂一个 timer，一次回收换三次写。细节在 docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md。

KernelSU 是 late-load，每次开机重新装一次，这是 late-load 的固有开销。

致谢

KernelSU、AxManager、Shizuku、zig。

许可

MIT
modules.changelog:
v1.0

首个版本，只做 root。
- 开机自动提权，冷启动 1–5 秒拿到 su
- 自动 ksud late-load 装 KernelSU，KMI 按 uname -r 推导

- 底层要 Shizuku 提供 shell；AxManager 装上是开机自启，不装就手动 ytrl.sh start
- 静默运行；一次没命中留下的停住进程不能杀，脚本会自己重启重来（每天最多 6 次）

适用 OS4.0.16.0.XBMCNXM / 6.18.21-android17。

modules.name: XTherm (Xkyyra Thermal)

modules.description: Advanced granular thermal controller and monitoring tool for Android (Magisk & KernelSU). Bypass vendor throttling limits and unleash your device's maximum performance.
modules.readme:
XTherm Pro - Advanced Disable Thermal for Root

🇺🇸 English | 🇮🇩 Indonesia

🇺🇸 English

XTherm Pro is an advanced thermal controller module for Android users with Root access (Magisk / KernelSU). This module is specifically designed to bypass vendor thermal throttling limits, allowing your device to unleash its maximum performance without being held back by temperature-based CPU/GPU throttling.

If you are looking for a way to stop your phone from lagging or dropping FPS during heavy gaming sessions, XTherm Pro is the ultimate solution.

🌟 Key Features
- Universal Thermal Disable: Supports disabling various built-in thermal services for both Snapdragon and MediaTek chipsets (e.g., thermal-engine, thermalservice, etc.).
- The Ultimate Xiaomi Bypass: Features a specialized trick to permanently disable mi_thermald. The module uses a Magisk Overlay Dummy Script to overwrite the MIUI/HyperOS binary, completely preventing the Xiaomi Watchdog from auto-restarting the service.
- Disable Thermal-HAL: Includes an interactive installation option to permanently lock down the thermal_hal security layer right from boot.
- Interactive Installer: A smart installation process using Volume Keys to select the right configurations for your specific device brand.

🚀 How to Install

XTherm Pro is a Magisk thermal module, meaning you need Root access to use it.

1.  Download the latest XTherm ZIP file from the Releases page.
2.  Open your preferred Root manager (Magisk or KernelSU).
3.  Go to the Modules tab and select Install from Storage.
4.  Choose the downloaded XTherm ZIP file.
5.  Pay attention to the installation screen:
- You will be asked if you want to disable Thermal HAL. Press Volume Up (Yes) or Volume Down (Skip).
- Exclusive for Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO users: You will get an additional prompt to disable mi_thermald. It is highly recommended to select Volume Up (Yes) to permanently kill the MIUI thermal protections from the root.
6.  Done! Tap Reboot to apply changes.

⚠️ Disclaimer

This module disables factory thermal protections. This will cause your device to run much hotter than usual during heavy gaming.
Any risks such as hardware damage (overheating, burnt ICs, battery degradation) or bootloops are entirely at your own risk (Do With Your Own Risk). Using an external Cooler Fan is highly recommended when using this module.

🇮🇩 Indonesia

XTherm Pro adalah modul tingkat lanjut (Advanced Disable Thermal) untuk pengguna Android dengan akses Root (Magisk / KernelSU). Modul ini dirancang khusus untuk melewati (*bypass*) batasan performa dari pabrik agar perangkat dapat berjalan pada performa maksimalnya tanpa gangguan *thermal throttling*.

Jika kamu sering mencari cara mengatasi hp panas saat main game yang malah membuat FPS drop secara drastis, XTherm Pro adalah solusinya. Modul ini akan mematikan perlindungan termal bawaan sistem sehingga CPU dan GPU tidak akan dibatasi ketika sedang bekerja keras.

🌟 Fitur Utama
- Universal Thermal Disable: Mendukung pemblokiran berbagai jenis layanan thermal bawaan dari Snapdragon maupun MediaTek (seperti thermal-engine, thermalservice, dll).
- The Ultimate Xiaomi Bypass: Modul ini memiliki trik khusus untuk disable mi_thermald secara permanen. Modul akan menimpa binary bawaan MIUI/HyperOS menggunakan trik *Magisk Overlay Dummy Script* untuk menghentikan sistem *Watchdog* Xiaomi dari me-restart layanan secara otomatis.
- Disable Thermal-HAL: Dilengkapi opsi instalasi interaktif untuk menonaktifkan lapisan keamanan thermal_hal sejak perangkat pertama kali *booting*.
- Interactive Installer: Proses instalasi yang cerdas menggunakan tombol volume (Volume Keys) untuk memilih konfigurasi yang sesuai dengan merek *device* kamu.

🚀 Cara Instalasi

XTherm Pro adalah magisk thermal module, sehingga kamu memerlukan akses *Root* untuk menggunakannya.

1.  Unduh file ZIP XTherm terbaru dari halaman Releases.
2.  Buka aplikasi pengelola Root pilihanmu (Magisk atau KernelSU).
3.  Masuk ke menu Modules dan pilih Install from Storage.
4.  Pilih file ZIP XTherm yang baru saja diunduh.
5.  Perhatikan layar instalasi:
- Kamu akan ditanya apakah ingin menonaktifkan Thermal HAL. Tekan Volume Atas (Yes) atau Volume Bawah (Skip).
- Khusus pengguna Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO: Kamu akan mendapat pertanyaan tambahan untuk menonaktifkan mi_thermald. Sangat disarankan untuk memilih Volume Atas (Yes) agar perlindungan termal MIUI mati total hingga ke akarnya.
6.  Selesai! Tekan Reboot untuk menerapkan perubahan.

⚠️ Peringatan

Modul ini menonaktifkan fitur keamanan suhu bawaan pabrik. Hal ini akan menyebabkan perangkat menjadi jauh lebih panas dari biasanya saat bermain game berat.
Segala risiko seperti kerusakan komponen *hardware* (*overheat*, IC gosong, baterai rusak) atau *bootloop* sepenuhnya adalah tanggung jawab pengguna (Do With Your Own Risk). Sangat disarankan menggunakan pendingin eksternal (*Cooler Fan*) saat menggunakan modul ini.

Developed by: @clsxkyyra404

modules.name: Y700 统一温控增强+充电日志
modules.author: 酷安@妲你小己吧&Cursor
modules.description: [温控优化][亮屏快充增强][充电日志] V7.2: 修复pid回绕导致双实例; 深度定位脚本升级(全节点dump+平台证据+干预实验)。配置: /data/adb/modules/y700_thermal_boost/config.prop。制作测试不易，搬运请标明出处。
modules.readme:
Y700 统一温控增强 + 充电日志 及配套监控 App

联想拯救者 Y700 平板（三代/四代/五代）的 Magisk / KernelSU 温控增强模块，以及配套的实时充电监控 App。

| 组成 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 模块 (module/) | 温控绕过 + 亮屏快充增强 + 充电日志 |
| App (app/) | 实时充电可视化 + 每次充电自动存档（数据独立于模块日志） |
| 诊断脚本 (tools/y700_diag.sh) | 一键检测模块全部作用点 + 动态监控，社区排障用 |
最新版本：Release v7.0
—— 含模块 zip、App apk，以及可直下的诊断脚本 y700_diag.sh。

支持机型

| 型号 | 代际 | 状态 |
|------|------|------|
| TB321FU | 三代 | ✅ 已验证 40W+ 快充 |
| TB322FC | 四代 | ✅ 兼容 |
| TB323FU | 五代 | ✅ 已验证 40W+ 快充 |

一、模块

功能

1. 温控绕过：禁用充电相关温区 + 伪装温度，消除充电/游戏时的降频限流
2. 亮屏快充增强：插电时伪装温度 + 维持温区禁用，实现亮屏高功率充电；拔线后清除伪装、温控保持关闭
3. 充电日志：记录每次充电的电池功率/温度/分阶段统计/充电协议/输入电压，保存到 /sdcard/充电日志/
4. 多代适配：温区按类型自适应扫描，兼容三代 batt1-therm/四五代 batt-pack-therm 等命名差异
5. 单实例守护：开机时 KSU 与 service.d 同时拉起也不重复执行
6. 兼容性开关（V7.0）：ZONE_MODE 可选「禁用温区+伪装」或「仅伪装」，KILL_THERMAL 可开启周期击杀温控进程——
   用于解决部分四代/五代机型刷入后充电被锁在 10W 的平台差异问题
7. 运行日志（V7.0）：/data/local/tmp/y700_thermal_boost/runtime.log 落盘记录启动参数、生效模式与杀温控动作
关于「输入功率」：SDP / DCP（普通充电）下正常显示；PD / PPS 快充时平台不向用户空间暴露输入电流
（大电流走电荷泵，已实测确认），此时日志显示「不可读」并给出 PPS 输入电压峰值。
快充时请以电池功率为准（实测可达 51W+）。
关于「CCL 解锁」：模块会尝试把 charge_control_limit 写到上限。但在平台自行管控 CCL 的机型
（如 Y700 五代、部分 OPPO/一加机型）上，写入会被驱动立即改回，解锁无效（不影响正常使用，
属平台行为）。诊断脚本第 5 节会实测并明确报告「CCL 可写: 是/否」。

安装

1. 从 Releases 下载 y700_thermal_boost_vX.X.zip（或用 module/ 目录自行打包）
2. 通过 Magisk 或 KernelSU 刷入
3. 重启

配置

修改 /data/adb/modules/y700_thermal_boost/config.prop（V7.1 起改完最多 5 秒自动生效，不用重启）：

ENABLE_THERMAL_BYPASS=1   # 温控绕过 (1=开 0=关)
ENABLE_CHARGE_LOG=1       # 充电日志 (1=开 0=关)
SAMPLE_INTERVAL=5         # 采样间隔(秒)
FAKE_TEMP_CHG=25000       # 充电区伪装温度 (毫摄氏度, 25000=25C)
FAKE_TEMP_BATT=28000      # 电池区伪装温度
FAKE_TEMP_USB=25000       # USB区伪装温度
FAKE_TEMP_AP=30000        # AP区伪装温度
LOG_KEEP_COUNT=30         # 日志保留数量
KILL_INTERVAL=60          # 杀温控进程间隔(秒)

==== 兼容性开关 (V7.0 新增) ====
ZONE_MODE=1               # 温区处理: 1=禁用+伪装(默认,性能最好) 2=仅伪装(保持 mode=enabled)
KILL_THERMAL=0            # 周期杀温控进程: 0=不杀(默认,平台自管) 1=开(每 KILL_INTERVAL 秒杀一次)

充电被锁在 10W？按这个顺序排查（V7.0）

部分四代 TB322FC / 五代机型刷入后，会出现**温控全部伪装成功、CCL 也已是满值，
但充电功率仍被压在 ~10W（约 5V/2A） 的情况。这通常是平台策略**而非模块没生效，按下面 A/B 定位：

| 步骤 | 操作 | 结果判读 |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 先跑诊断脚本，确认温区伪装、单实例、CCL 均正常 | 若温区/进程异常 → 是模块问题，发报告 |
| 1 | ENABLE_THERMAL_BYPASS=0 + 重启，同电量、同温度下再充 | 功率恢复 → 确认是模块副作用，继续第 2 步；仍 10W → 与模块无关，查充电器/线材/接口/平台策略 |
| 2 | 改 ZONE_MODE=2 + 重启（仅伪装，不解禁温区） | 禁用温区后部分平台会回落到保护性小电流，此模式可绕过该逻辑 |
| 3 | 再试 KILL_THERMAL=1 + 重启（开启周期杀温控） | 排除温控服务反复重启对充电策略的干扰（该开关 V7.0 才真正生效） |
每一步只改一个变量、保持电量与温度接近，否则结论不可信。改完配置需重启或重启模块生效。
日志里会记录当前生效的模式：模块版本: V7.0 (温区模式 1)。

运行日志（V7.0 新增）

模块会把关键动作落盘到 /data/local/tmp/y700_thermal_boost/runtime.log（保留最近 200 行）：
启动参数、生效的温区模式、杀温控进程的每一次动作（含成功/被拦截）、温区禁用清单重建结果。
log_me 的输出走 logcat（容易被刷掉），排查问题时优先看这个文件；诊断脚本第 6 节也会摘录其中的杀温控记录。

二、配套 App（Y700 充电监控）

用 libsu 直读 /sys 节点，Kotlin + Jetpack Compose 实现。

功能
- 实时可视化：环形电量仪表 + 功率/电量/温度三张实时曲线（每秒刷新，每 2 秒落点）
- 实时指标：充电协议（PD/PPS/DCP/SDP…）、电池功率、输入电压/电流/功率、温度、电流、电压、CCL、输入电流上限、充电阶段
- 每次充电自动存档：自动识别充电开始/结束，全程记录采样点（功率/输入功率/电量/温度/电流/电压）
- 历史记录：列表（充入电量、时长、峰值功率、协议、能量）+ 详情页（完整统计 + 该次曲线），支持单条删除/清空
- 模块状态：显示模块版本与运行状态（/proc 校验，不依赖 ps）
- 输入不可读时如实标注：PPS 快充下输入电流不可得，显示「不可读」而非骗人的 0

数据独立性

App 数据保存在 App 私有目录（/data/data/com.y700.charge/files/），仅读取 /sys 节点，
不读取也不写入模块的 /sdcard/充电日志/，两者完全独立。

构建

cd app
./gradlew assembleDebug
产物: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

使用

1. 从 Releases 下载 y700_charge_monitor_vX.X.apk 并安装
2. 打开 App，首次会弹 KernelSU/Magisk root 授权，点「允许」
3. 即可看到实时充电信息，右上角「历史记录」查看每次充电存档

故障诊断（模块没生效时用）

社区反馈「模块没生效」时，让用户跑诊断脚本 tools/y700_diag.sh —— 自动检测所有作用点并生成报告：

方式一: 从 Releases 直接下载到平板 (最新版 Release 已附带该脚本)
下载后放到 /sdcard/, 然后执行:
su -c "sh /sdcard/y700_diag.sh"

方式二: 从仓库取脚本并推送到平板
adb push tools/y700_diag.sh /data/local/tmp/
su -c "sh /data/local/tmp/y700_diag.sh"

可选参数: 采样时长(秒), 默认 60
su -c "sh /data/local/tmp/y700_diag.sh 120"

脚本运行约 1 分钟后自动生成报告到 /sdcard/Y700模块诊断_.txt，包含：

| 检查项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 环境信息 | 机型 / Android / 内核 / root / SELinux 上下文 / 屏幕状态 / 前台应用 / CPU TOP3 |
| 模块安装 | 模块目录 / 版本 / 文件完整性 / disable 标志 / service.d 自启脚本 / 生效的 ZONE_MODE、KILL_THERMAL |
| 服务进程 | 是否运行（直查 /proc，不依赖 ps）、是否多实例 |
| 温区检查 | 设备全部温区类型列表 + 目标温区 mode/temp 与期望伪装值逐项对比（按当前 ZONE_MODE 判读，模式 2 下「未禁用」不算异常） |
| 写入权限 | emul_temp / mode 是否可写（写异值回读，避免写同值造成的假阳性） |
| 温控进程 | thermal-engine / thermal HAL 状态 + /proc 复核 + runtime.log 里的杀温控记录 |
| 充电与节点 | 充电协议 / 输入电压电流 / CCL / 输入电流上限 / 充电限流冷却设备状态 / IIO 输入电流节点 |
| 动态采样 | 每分钟 12 次采样，检测温度伪装是否稳定维持（抓「有时有效有时无效」） |
| 充电限流分析 | 按充电协议（PD/PPS 与 SDP/DCP 区别对待）分析温度、CCL、输入利用率与能量守恒 |
| 自动结论 | 直接列出发现的问题与建议 |
脚本已修正四类误报：customize.sh 缺失（管理器安装后会删除，属正常）、
「电池功率偏低」（SDP 数据口 0.5A 场景下正常）、「CCL 可写」假阳性（写入同值不算可写，现写入不同值实测）、
「温区 mode 不可写」假阳性（模块运行中会每 5 秒把温区重新置回 disabled，回读不一致不等于不可写，现按写入是否被拒绝判定）。

把生成的报告文件发出来即可定位问题（报告只含系统状态，不含隐私信息）。

版本历史

模块
- V7.1 — 配置热重载：主循环每 5 秒重读 config.prop，改配置不用重启即可生效（ZONE_MODE/ENABLE_THERMAL_BYPASS/KILL_THERMAL/伪装温度/各间隔），
  变更写入 runtime.log；关闭绕过时会清除伪装温度 + 恢复温区 + 还原 CCL（「关掉模块 = 回到原始状态」，便于 A/B）；
  配置项增加合法性校验（写错的值回退默认值，不会把模块搞坏）；新增深度定位脚本 y700_full_diag.sh（全节点 dump + 平台证据 + 自动 A/B）
- V7.0 — 新增兼容性开关 ZONE_MODE（1=禁用温区+伪装 / 2=仅伪装保持 mode=enabled，会把此前禁用的温区写回 enabled）
  与 KILL_THERMAL（周期击杀温控进程），解决部分四代/五代机型充电被锁 10W；
  修复「杀温控进程」长期静默失效——原实现用 ps -A -o PID,NAME 匹配进程名，而模块运行上下文里
  ps 列不出其他进程名（实测命中数恒为 0），V6.x 实际从未杀掉过任何进程；改用 /proc//cmdline 扫描后实测可命中，
  因该功能本版才真正生效，默认改为 0 避免升级后行为被悄悄改变；
  温区禁用清单改为开机校验后重建（温区编号每次开机变化，旧实现残留上百条脏数据 + 每 5 秒对每温区 grep 一次）；
  新增 runtime.log 运行日志；启动与充电日志打印生效模式；诊断脚本作为 Release 附件发布
- V6.9 — 上述输入功率校验收窄为仅 PPS/PD 生效（SDP/DCP 下节点可靠，避免电池读数尖峰把有效样本误剔除）
- V6.8 — 输入功率增加合理性校验：部分平台 PPS 下会返回极小垃圾值（如 17637µA → 0.1W）被当成有效样本；现按能量守恒剔除（充电时输入功率必然 ≥ 电池功率），无效时如实显示「不可读」
- V6.7 — 杀温控进程改为按进程名通用匹配（兼容 android.hardware.thermal-service@1.0 等非 .qti 命名，提升异机型兼容性）；诊断脚本增强：CCL 可写性测试 + 电池温度/输入功率/充电限流分析
- V6.6 — 修复开机多实例竞态（原锁文件方案在「创建后内容未写入」时被误判为残留锁，导致两个实例同时运行、日志互相覆盖）；诊断脚本新增「充电限流冷却设备」检查
- V6.5 — 输入电流改用 PMIC IIO ADC 节点；PPS 下输入功率不可读时如实标注 + 记录 PPS 电压峰值；新增诊断脚本
- V6.4 — 充电日志增加「输入功率」统计；修复充电协议在最终日志恒为「未识别」
- V6.3 — 充电日志增加「充电协议」行（PD/PPS/DCP/SCP 等）
- V6.2 — 修复单实例锁 pid 复用导致的偶发失效（有时有效有时无效）
- V6.1 — 三代 CCL 写入修复（单位不同导致限流 + PPS 反复重协商）
- V6.0 — 三代温区适配 + 机型识别 + 单实例锁原子创建
- V5.9 — 温区发现按类型自适应扫描
- V5.8 — 单实例锁（初版）...
modules.changelog:
🧩 模块 V7.2 — 修复双实例 + 深度定位脚本升级（含「干预实验」）

支持机型：三代 TB321FU · 四代 TB322FC · 五代 TB323FU

1️⃣ 修复：pid 回绕导致的双实例（社区报告实测发现）

四代用户的报告里出现 2 个模块实例并存（V7.0 的 pid 21429 与 V7.1 的 pid 2004 同时运行）。
根因：单实例判定原本用「pid 更小 = 启动更早」，而 pid 会回绕（21429 先启动，但 2004 更小），
导致新实例误判自己最早而启动。
- 现改为比较 /proc//stat 的 starttime（真实启动时刻，jiffies），这才是可靠的先后依据
- 遗留的旧实例仍需重启一次清掉；重启后不会再出现双实例

2️⃣ 充电日志新增「开始屏幕」行

记录每次充电开始时的亮屏/息屏状态 —— 部分联想机型亮屏会压充电电流，
有了这一行就能直接对比「同样电量下，息屏是不是更快」。

3️⃣ 深度定位脚本 y700_full_diag.sh 升级

新增【7.5】干预实验 —— 既然 A/B 已能证明「限流在不在模块」，这一节就逐个去试平台侧的开关，
看哪一项能真正把电流放出来（每项限时施加、事后自动撤销）：

| 实验 | 做法 | 若功率明显上升说明 |
|---|---|---|
| T1 息屏 | 息屏 35 秒（需加参数 --screen-test） | 这台机器亮屏限流，息屏充就快 |
| T2 关闭 ZUI 电池保养 | battery_maintenance_on=0 + zui_battery_extreme_enabled=0 | ZUI「电池保养/智能充电」在限流，去系统设置里永久关掉 |
| T3 提高输入电流上限 | 写 usb/input_current_limit=3A | 该节点可解锁，可以加进模块功能 |
| T4 解锁 CCL | 写 charge_control_limit=上限 | CCL 解锁在这台机器上有效 |

同时修复：
- grep -vE '^\s*$' 在 toybox grep 下不支持 \s → 配置内容打印为空，改用 [[:space:]]
- 输入上限功率单位算错（223800W 那种离谱值）→ 改用 µA×µV/1e12，且电压优先取 ucsi 节点
  （usb/voltage_now 在 PPS 下不可信）
- 【3】节新增：battery/power_now、power_avg 电量计口径功率 + 充电器契约能力
  （usb/current_max、voltage_max、ucsi 节点的 CURRENT_MAX/CURRENT_NOW/VOLTAGE_NOW）

su -c "sh y700_full_diag.sh"                  # 完整(快照+证据+自动A/B+干预实验)
su -c "sh y700_full_diag.sh --screen-test"    # 额外测「息屏是否更快」(会短暂黑屏)
su -c "sh y700_full_diag.sh --no-ab"          # 只抓快照(约 40 秒)

📊 四代实测数据（用户远程报告，已证实与模块无关）

| 组 | 配置 | 平均功率 |
|---|---|---|
| A | 模块正常 | 11.06W |
| B | 仅伪装 | 13.28W |
| C | 模块完全关闭 | 13.34W |
- 关模块与开模块基本一致 → 瓶颈不在模块
- 历史记录：17% 电量那次充了 92 分钟，峰值也只有 12.8W
- dmesg 实证：VBUS=[1.13A, 9.59V]（实际只抽 11W），而充电器契约是
  ucsi CURRENT_MAX=3.24A @ 9.48V（约 30W）→ 设备只用了 1/3
- 平台侧线索：battery_maintenance_on=1、charge_control_start/end_threshold=70/80、
  zui_battery_extreme_enabled=1 → 怀疑 ZUI 电池保养/智能充电 或亮屏限流（T1/T2 实验验证）

⚠️ 免责声明

温控绕过属硬件保护修改，高温 / 边充边玩有风险，自担风险。搬运请标明出处。

modules.name: 云备份助手（虚拟一个小米智能存储设备实现云备份功能）
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 云备份助手（虚拟一个小米智能存储设备实现云备份功能）
modules.readme:
XPoser_MiBackup - 小米云备份助手

源码: https://github.com/zgcwkjOpenProject/XPoser_MiBackup

通过 Xposed 模块虚拟小米智能存储设备，将小米备份 App 的 DFS 存储流程重定向到自建 SMB、WebDAV 或自定义 HTTP 服务，实现备份与恢复数据的云端存储

原理

小米备份 App 会通过 DFS 服务连接小米智能存储设备，并通过 AIDL 接口执行目录查询、文件上传、文件下载和进度回调；本模块注入 com.android.settings 与 com.miui.backup 进程，在设置页展示配置入口，并在备份 App 的 DFS/AIDL 边界将文件操作改由 SMB/WebDAV/自定义 HTTP 完成

小米备份 App
  -> 查询智能存储设备：返回虚拟设备
  -> 连接 DFS 服务：模拟在线和已连接
  -> DFS AIDL 上传：写入 SMB/WebDAV/自定义 HTTP
  -> DFS AIDL 下载：从 SMB/WebDAV/自定义 HTTP 读取
  -> 进度与完成回调：回传给小米备份原流程

主要 Hook 边界在 DFS AIDL、设置页入口和明确的备份 UI/服务事件，尽量避免直接依赖混淆业务函数

功能
- 在系统设置中注入「云备份助手」配置入口
- 拦截 DFS 连接，模拟小米智能存储设备在线状态
- 支持 SMB/CIFS、WebDAV 和自定义 HTTP 脚本三种传输协议
- 备份和恢复时将文件重定向到 SMB/WebDAV/自定义 HTTP 服务器
- 顶部“备份”按钮点击进入小米备份的智能存储备份页，长按进入小米应用商店的备份升级页
- 大文件在 Cloud 层统一切片上传，SMB、WebDAV 和自定义 HTTP 共用同一套切片逻辑
- 自动清理超出数量限制的旧备份

图片预览

更多图片：imgs

环境要求
- Android 11+（minSdk 30）
- 已安装 Xposed 框架（LSPosed / EdXposed 等）
- 支持的 Xposed 作用域：com.android.settings、com.miui.backup

配置

配置入口：系统设置 -> 云备份助手

更多请看 配置说明文档

许可证

Apache License 2.0

modules.name: 微信/QQ液态玻璃底栏
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 微信/QQ液态玻璃底栏
modules.readme:
微信 / QQ 底栏液态玻璃 · WeChat-LiquidGlass

为微信和 QQ 打造的 iOS 26 风格液态玻璃底部导航栏 · LSPosed 模块（libxposed API 102）

✨ 特性
- 🫧 单 pass AGSL 透镜管线：圆角矩形 SDF 折射、边缘色散、重力传感器高光
- 💧 玻璃滴选中动效：切换标签时液滴滑动、回弹；支持横向拖拽切换，跟手拉伸、松手吸附
- 🎯 对齐 KernelSU 管理器：悬浮 pill 宽度贴合内容、4dp 轻模糊 + 容器色垫底、
  按压时液滴放大 78/56 并淡入折射、焦点标签放大 1.1×
- 🔍 背景实时跟随：玻璃折射的是当前页面的真实内容，切页即变
- 🧩 完整保留原生功能：红点、未读数、图标渐变、长按菜单全部走应用自己的实现
- 🪟 双宿主：微信与 QQ 共用一套安装器，差异集中在 HostApp 一张表里
- 🌗 深浅色跟随：读取应用 uiMode，辅以标签色众数探测交叉校验
- ♿ 降级兜底：Android 12 保留 GPU 模糊与液滴，只少了边缘折射（AGSL 需 13）；
  Android 12 以下退化为轻磨砂；native 模糊库不可用时自动切纯 Java 实现

📦 安装

1. 准备支持 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed 环境
2. 安装 APK，在 LSPosed 中启用（作用域已限定 com.tencent.mm 和 com.tencent.mobileqq，
   只勾选想改造的那个也可以）
3. 强制停止微信 / QQ 后重新打开
已测试：微信 8.0.77 (3160)  QQ 9.2.85 (13860) 9.1.52 (9054)

🔍 工作原理

两个应用的主界面结构几乎是双胞胎——内容区铺满全屏，底栏以 layout_gravity=bottom
浮在它上面，同处一个 FrameLayout——所以安装器只有一套：

Hook Instrumentation.callActivityOnResume
  └─ 主界面 Activity：按类名定位底栏（两家资源 ID 都被 AndResGuard 混淆，不可用）
       └─ 布局手术：把底栏搬进 LiquidGlassHostLayout
            ├─ 玻璃层 LiquidGlassView（backdrop = 底栏原本的全屏兄弟）
            ├─ 液滴层 LiquidGlassView（跟随选中项，可拖拽）
            └─ 应用原生底栏（背景已清空）

应用相关的部分全在 HostApp 里：

| | 微信 | QQ |
|---|---|---|
| 包名 | com.tencent.mm | com.tencent.mobileqq |
| 主界面 Activity | ui.LauncherUI | activity.SplashActivity |
| 底栏 | ui.LauncherUIBottomTabView | widget.QQTabWidget（默认）widget.QQTabLayout（灰度） |
| 切页信号 | setTo(int) | setCurrentTab(int) |
| backdrop | CustomViewPager | tabcontent / ViewPager2 |
| 额外处理 | — | 隐藏自带的 QQBlurViewWrapper |

QQ 同一个安装包里带了新旧两套底栏，服务端开关 tab_layout_9065_116522266
默认关闭，即绝大多数用户跑的是 QQTabWidget（android.widget.TabWidget 子类）。
两套都在表里，运行时按实际存在的那个走。

日志 tag：LiquidGlass

🛠️ 构建

无需 Gradle / Android Studio：

./setup-tools.sh   # 下载 android.jar / build-tools 34 / libxposed
./build.sh

产物：LiquidGlass-vX.Y.Z.apk（自动生成 debug 签名）。

可调参数

| 参数 | 位置 | 默认 |
|---|---|---|
| 折射高度 / 边缘带 | GlassTuner.onSize() | 24dp（同 KernelSU lens()） |
| 模糊强度 | tuneGlass() | 4dp（同 KernelSU blur()） |
| 每列额外留白 | hugContentWidth() | 32dp |
| 底部抬升 | GlassConfig.barOffsetDp | 12dp |
| 按压放大 / 焦点放大 | DropletDragController / DropletPanel | 78/56 · 1.1 |
| 拖拽形变上限 | DropletDragController.STRETCH_LIMIT | 0.2 |

液滴

静止时是一层 10% 的纯色块；按住/拖拽时按 pressProgress 淡入透镜：

lens(refractionHeight = 10dp × p, refractionAmount = 14dp × p,
     depthEffect = true, chromaticAberration = 0.5)

液滴折射的是 页面 + 一份单独绘制的 1.1× 标签副本（KernelSU 的
CombinedBackdrop）。拖拽时看到的放大图标正是这份副本经折射后的样子，
因此液滴层必须压在真实标签之上，而真实标签保持原尺寸——两边都缩放会叠加两次。

动画

滑动/按压完全复刻 KernelSU 的 DampedDragAnimation：五条独立弹簧，参数照搬。

| 弹簧 | 阻尼比 / 刚度 | 驱动 |
|---|---|---|
| value | 1.0 / 1000 | 位置（以标签为单位，非像素） |
| velocity | 0.5 / 300 | 归一化速度 → 拉伸形变 |
| press | 1.0 / 1000 | 按压进度 |
| scaleX | 0.6 / 250 | 横向缩放 |
| scaleY | 0.7 / 250 | 纵向缩放 |

两处易被忽略但决定手感的细节：位置以标签为单位追踪，速度按标签数归一化，
因此不同屏幕密度手感一致；release() 会等液滴接近目标才回落缩放，
这样甩动读起来是一个连贯动作而非"滑动 + 单独缩回"。

点击切换也走同一条路径（press → 移动 → release），与拖拽完全一致。

🙏 致谢
- sjtt2/HeyBox-LiquidGlass — MIT，本项目的灵感来源
- tiann/KernelSU — 拖拽形变的速度曲线参考其 FloatingBottomBar
- libxposed/api — Apache-2.0

📄 License

MIT

修复
- 修复 QQ 底栏液滴与按钮底色偏到底栏外面（#7）。平板和展开的折叠屏上必现，手机上取决于 QQ 灰度下发的底栏样式

优化
- 减少重绘（针对 #10 滑动掉帧）：玻璃只在背后内容变化时才重新取背景，画面静止时不再持续满帧重绘；取背景时直接复用页面这一帧已经录好的绘制结果，不再把宿主页面重画一遍

说明
- 玻璃底下只在渲染线程上跑的动画（点击波纹、部分加载图标）在玻璃里可能会短暂停住，等它结束才更新

modules.name: 微信输入法下滑快捷键
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 微信输入法下滑快捷键
modules.readme:
微信输入法下滑快捷键

为安卓版微信输入法增加自定义按键下滑操作的 LSPosed 模块。

支持 26 键与九宫格，可将全选、剪切、复制、粘贴、段落定位、原生剪贴板和快捷发送绑定到指定按键。正常点击保持原有输入，下滑时执行快捷功能。

主要功能
- 全选、剪切、复制、粘贴
- 移动到段首、段尾
- 选择当前位置到段首、段尾
- 打开微信输入法原生剪贴板
- 打开微信输入法原生快捷发送／常用语
- 禁用指定按键的下滑动作
- 支持 26 键和九宫格 2–9
- 支持竖屏、横屏及横屏悬浮键盘
- 26 键与九宫格可独立配置触发距离
- 原生剪贴板与快捷发送无需显示在输入法工具栏
- 不联网，不收集、上传或保存输入内容

安装与使用

1. 在 LSPosed 模块仓库中安装最新版。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用本模块。
3. 将模块作用域勾选为“微信输入法”。
4. 强制停止并重新启动微信输入法，或重启设备。
5. 打开模块设置，配置按键并点击“保存并应用配置”。

默认映射

| 按键 | 下滑动作 |
| --- | --- |
| Z | 全选 |
| X | 剪切 |
| C | 复制 |
| V | 粘贴 |

兼容性
- Android 8.0 及以上
- LSPosed / Modern Xposed API
- 安卓版微信输入法
- 当前实测：微信输入法 3.5.0、Android 16

微信输入法升级后，内部实现变化可能影响原生面板功能。遇到问题时，请提供微信输入法版本、Android 版本、LSPosed 日志和复现步骤。

源码与反馈
- 源代码
- 问题反馈

许可

本项目基于 Apache License 2.0 开源。
modules.changelog:
WeType-Swipe v1.13.0

微信输入法滑动快捷键 · 单一内置设置 + 界面优化

本次版本的重点

v1.12.0 中，微信输入法内置设置与独立模块 App 分别保留可编辑配置。用户实际遇到“L 键下滑已经在输入法生效，但独立模块仍显示旧绑定”的问题。v1.13.0 从架构上取消两套可编辑配置：
- 微信输入法进程中的私有配置是唯一实际生效的数据源。
- 26 键、九宫格、上下滑、自定义标签/文字和手势参数均只在微信输入法内置设置中编辑和保存。
- 独立模块 APK 改为维护与恢复中心，不再展示或保存另一份按键映射；也不再依靠双向镜像广播保持两个编辑器同步。
- 内置保存失败时提示错误，不显示虚假的成功消息。

界面改进

独立模块维护中心
- 重新设计为统一的原生卡片布局，突出「打开内置模块设置」主入口。
- 分区展示「配置来源」「维护工具」「版本与恢复」。
- 提供旧模块历史配置 TXT 备份、环境诊断信息复制、桌面图标显示/隐藏。
- 支持深色/亮色、合理字体间距与更大点击区域。
- 明确区分历史独立 App 备份与微信输入法当前实际生效的配置，避免混淆。

微信输入法内置设置
- 26 键与九宫格页面显示 ↑上滑／↓下滑标签位置提示。
- 第三标签页明确命名为「选项与备份」，备份管理独立成卡片。
- 从 Activity 打开的内置设置，优先提供 导出 TXT / 导入 TXT 文件按钮；剪贴板复制和导入保留为辅助途径。
- 输入法悬浮窗口无 Activity 文件回调时，保留剪贴板导入导出。
- 应用推荐下滑键位前需要确认，避免无意改动已编辑的配置；仍需点击底部保存后生效。

升级与数据保护
- 优先保留输入法已有配置，不自动重置为推荐默认键位。
- 只有目标输入法完全没有已保存的配置时，才允许从旧独立模块数据执行一次性、有令牌校验的迁移。
- 迁移完成后旧模块数据保持只读、留作 TXT 历史备份；不执行删除。
- 导入 TXT 进行完整字段和格式验证，用户确认后写入输入法单一配置源。
- 动作 ID 0–24、手势识别、L 键下滑打开内置设置、关于页五击入口、键帽上下文字布局及密码框隔离保持兼容。

安装与使用

1. 建议升级前先通过 v1.12.0 保存一份有效配置 TXT；如两边配置不一致，以输入法当前实际生效的配置为准。
2. 安装 v1.13.0 正式 APK，无需先卸载。模块包名与长期签名证书保持不变。
3. 在 LSPosed 中确保模块启用、作用域包含微信输入法；强制停止并重新打开微信输入法。
4. 从 L 键下滑（已绑定的用户），或微信输入法「关于」页面连续点击图标 5 次打开内置设置。
5. 修改后点击底部保存。导入/导出 TXT 的入口位于「选项与备份」页；独立模块 App 仅提供维护功能。

已完成的工程验证
- GitHub CI：单元测试、Lint、Debug 构建。
- GitHub 正式 Release 工作流：clean testDebugUnitTest lintRelease assembleRelease。
- versionCode=69、versionName=1.13.0。
- 使用与 v1.12.0 相同的永久证书签名，并由 apksigner 验证。
- GitHub Release 同时附 APK、源码 ZIP 和 SHA256 校验文件。

已知限制与回退

发布时没有完整真机回归反馈。 Android 系统和微信输入法版本可能影响 Activity 页面打开、文件选择结果回调，以及跨进程首次迁移。自动构建通过不能证明这些真实设备交互都已成功。

如果遇到内置设置跳转或 TXT 文件操作异常，可以保留 LSPosed 里与 WeTypeSwipe、WeTypeSwipeFile 相关的日志；历史备份不会自动删除。Android 可能限制安装旧 versionCode，请先备份，不要无备份直接卸载降级。

版本
- Version Name：1.13.0
- Version Code：69
- Android：API 28+
- 模块签名：沿用既有永久签名，兼容直接覆盖安装

modules.name: 澎湃OS 3/4 随屏滚动壁纸设置器
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 澎湃OS 3/4 随屏滚动壁纸设置器
modules.readme:
HyperOS 3/4 Scroll Setter

中文 | English

澎湃OS 3/4 随屏滚动壁纸设置器

让澎湃OS 3/4 重新支持随屏滚动壁纸

澎湃OS 3 从官方壁纸设置界面中移除了随屏滚动功能，并在软件层面强制关闭普通壁纸的随屏滚动。

澎湃OS 3/4 随屏滚动壁纸设置器通过绕过这些限制，让小米澎湃OS设备重新使用随屏滚动壁纸。

功能
- 重新启用澎湃OS 3/4 随屏滚动壁纸
- 绕过「锁屏编辑」的壁纸裁切
- 支持桌面与锁屏壁纸同步滚动
- 禁止/对抗系统自动压暗壁纸
- 分别为浅色模式、深色模式设置单独的壁纸（仅Root）
- 支持 Root 和 Shizuku 两种模式
- 针对澎湃OS 3、澎湃OS 4 分别进行适配

使用方法

Shizuku / 免 Root

1. 启动 Shizuku，并授予本应用所需权限；
2. 从相册选择图片；
3. 设置壁纸；
4. 在应用中开启「随屏滚动」。

澎湃OS 4 平板需要在「宿主设备」中选择正确的设备类型和屏幕分辨率。适用设备可以使用 3200×2136 预设值。

Root

1. 激活模块；
2. 重启设备；
3. 使用本应用或系统原有方式设置桌面/锁屏壁纸；
4. 开启「不压暗壁纸」后，需要重新启动一次「壁纸」APP。
如果重启设备后进入桌面时壁纸短暂黑屏，可以在系统设置中手动结束一次「壁纸」APP进程。

兼容性

| 模式 | 设备 | 状态 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Root | 小米 17 Ultra、小米 17 Pro、小米 15 Pro、小米平板 8 Pro | ✅ 已测试 |
| Shizuku | 小米 17 Ultra、小米平板 8 Pro、Redmi K Pad | ✅ 已测试 |
| Root | 其他澎湃OS 3/4 小米设备 | 理论上可行 |
| Shizuku | 其他澎湃OS 3/4 小米设备 | 理论上可行，重启后可能需要重新开启随屏滚动 |

其他澎湃OS 3/4 设备也可能正常工作，但实际兼容性取决于具体系统版本及壁纸引擎实现。

从源码构建

git clone https://github.com/BlizzardAn225/HyperOS3ScrollSetter.git
cd HyperOS3ScrollSetter
在 Android Studio 中打开并构建

许可证

GPL-3.0

免责声明

随屏滚动壁纸已经不再受到澎湃OS官方支持，使用过程中可能出现：
- 掉帧
- 渲染错误
- 从锁屏进入桌面时短暂黑屏

使用本项目产生的任何问题由用户自行承担。

Make HyperOS 3/4 Support Scrolling Wallpapers Again

HyperOS 3 removed scrolling wallpaper from the standard wallpaper-setting UI and added software-level restrictions that disable it for normal wallpapers.

HyperOS 3/4 Scroll Setter bypasses these restrictions and allows Xiaomi HyperOS devices to use scrolling wallpapers again.

Features
- Enable scrolling wallpapers on HyperOS 3/4
- Set wallpapers directly without the cropping performed by the Lock Screen Editor
- Support synchronized home-screen and lock-screen scrolling
- Disable/Convert automatic wallpaper darkening
- Set separate wallpapers for light mode and dark mode (Root only)
- Support Root and Shizuku modes
- HyperOS 3 and HyperOS 4 specific adaptations

Usage

Shizuku / No Root

1. Start Shizuku and grant the app the required permission;
2. Select an image from the gallery;
3. Set the wallpaper;
4. Enable Scrolling Wallpaper in the app.

For HyperOS 4 tablets, configure the correct device type and screen resolution in the Host Device section. The 3200×2136 preset can be used where applicable.

Root

1. Activate the module;
2. Root the device;
3. Set the home-screen and/or lock-screen wallpaper through the app, or use the original system method;
4. Restart the Wallpaper app after enabling Don't Darken Wallpaper.
If the home screen briefly becomes black after rebooting device, force-stop the Wallpaper app once from Settings.

Compatibility

| Mode | Device | Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Root | Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Xiaomi 17 Pro, Xiaomi 15 Pro, Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro | ✅ Tested |
| Shizuku | Xiaomi 17 Ultra, Xiaomi Pad 8 Pro, Redmi K Pad | ✅ Tested |
| Root | Other Xiaomi devices running HyperOS 3/4 | Theoretically supported |
| Shizuku | Other Xiaomi devices running HyperOS 3/4 | Theoretically supported; scrolling may need to be re-enabled after reboot |

Other HyperOS 3/4 devices may also work, but compatibility depends on the system wallpaper implementation and version.

Building from Source

git clone https://github.com/BlizzardAn225/HyperOS3ScrollSetter.git
cd HyperOS3-Scroll-Setter
Open the project in Android Studio and build

License

GPL-3.0

Disclaimer

Scrolling wallpapers are no longer officially supported by HyperOS. Unexpected behavior may occur, including:
- Frame drops
- Rendering errors
- Temporary black screens when entering the desktop from the lock screen

Use the module at your own risk.
modules.changelog:
重大更新：
- 升级：换用 libxposed API 102，相关依赖、代码全部升级；
- 新增：Root 模式下，可为设备在浅色模式、深色模式设置单独的桌面壁纸、锁屏壁纸；
- 新增：浅色模式、深色模式壁纸预览切换时，裁剪框框选区域缓存，同分辨率下裁剪区域保持一致；
- 修改：更好地支持 DCI-P3 色域的图片；
- 修复：更新了防抖算法，适配更新的澎湃OS4。
若壁纸出现卡住的情况，请取消对系统框架的作用域、重启设备验证是否复现，如果不复现，请附带 /system_ext/framework/miui-services.jar 提交issue。

Major Update:
- Upgrade: Switched to libxposed API 102; all related dependencies and code have been upgraded.
- New: In Root mode, separate home screen wallpapers and lock screen wallpapers can be set for light mode and dark mode.
- New: When previewing and switching between light mode and dark mode wallpapers, the crop box selection area is cached, keeping the crop area consistent at the same resolution.
- Changed: Better support for DCI-P3 color gamut images.
- Fixed: Updated the anti-shake algorithm to support the newer HyperOS 4.
If the wallpaper gets stuck, please disable the scope for System Framework, reboot the device, and check whether the issue reproduces. If it does not reproduce, please submit an issue with /system_ext/framework/miui-services.jar attached.

modules.name: 贴吧静净
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: 贴吧静净
modules.readme:
贴吧静净 (TiebaQuiet)

基于 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed 模块，为百度贴吧（com.baidu.tieba）提供去广告、界面精简、功能增强与隐私保护。
- 模块版本：0.3.9（versionCode 13）
- 目标版本：百度贴吧 22.14.1.0（versionCode 370016512）
- 包名：io.github.yigenhuobah.tiebaquiet
- 运行环境：LSPosed 2.1+ / Vector 2.2+（Zygisk），API 102
- 主平台：CodeFloe ｜ 项目主页：quiet-tools.codefloe.page ｜ 反馈：Issues ｜ 通知：Telegram

更新日志见 CHANGELOG.md。
源码、Issues 与 Releases 已迁移到 CodeFloe；GitHub 官方 Xposed 镜像保留旧版本，恢复后同步。

功能

设置页按用途分组，顺序固定 AD 广告净化 → UI 界面精简 → PV 隐私保护 → EN 功能增强。编号用于文档、日志与诊断页；remote prefs 键保持不变。

AD 广告净化（默认开）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| AD-01 | 无开屏广告 | 复用官方禁开屏开关，启动不再加载广告 |
| AD-02 | 广告请求源头掐断 | FunAd/Nad/getFeedAd 三类广告请求不再发出 |
| AD-03 | 信息流广告卡 | 过滤首页/吧内/评论列表中的广告与推广卡片 |
| AD-04 | 吧页推广卡 | 过滤吧页面解析出的推广/活动卡片 |
| AD-05 | 直播卡过滤 | 信息流中不再展示“直播中/开播”卡片 |
| AD-06 | 实时热点卡过滤 | 信息流中不再展示“实时热点”卡片 |
| AD-07 | 悬浮广告 | 隐藏首页与帖子页的悬浮广告浮标 |
| AD-08 | 营销与活动弹窗 | 关闭云端下发的活动、签到、营销类弹窗 |
| AD-09 | 推荐吧卡 | 不展示“推荐吧/常逛吧”推广卡片 |
| AD-10 | 彩蛋广告 | 关闭节日彩蛋类广告弹层 |

UI 界面精简（默认开）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| UI-01 | 底部 Tab 红点 | 隐藏底部导航的红点与角标 |
| UI-02 | 更新弹窗 | 拦截“发现新版本”强制更新弹窗 |
| UI-03 | 个人中心精简 | 隐藏“我的”页的会员横幅、钱包、任务赚贴贝与游戏专区 |
| UI-04 | 底栏小卖部 | 隐藏底部“小卖部”Tab，并恢复原底栏发布按钮 |

PV 隐私保护（默认关）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| PV-01 | 剪贴板保护 | 贴吧不再读取剪贴板内容（口令/图片口令失效） |
| PV-02 | 个性化广告强制关闭 | 忽略设置项，始终按“关闭个性化广告”运行 |
| PV-03 | 保活服务拦截 | 阻止 ALa 保活服务启动，减少后台驻留 |

EN 功能增强（默认关）

| 编号 | 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| EN-01 | 频道栏默认关注 | 把“关注”频道排到首页频道栏第一位 |
| EN-02 | 强制夜间模式 | 固定使用夜间皮肤（4） |
| EN-03 | 只看楼主 | 帖子页请求始终按只看楼主过滤 |
| EN-04 | 楼层倒序 | 帖子楼层按倒序加载 |
| EN-05 | 图片去水印 | 图片加载不再附加用户名/吧名水印 |
| EN-06 | 原图入口常显 | 图片查看器始终显示“查看原图”入口 |
| EN-07 | 视频直链复制 | 播放视频时自动复制直链到剪贴板 |
| EN-08 | 一键签到 | 设置页按钮触发贴吧自带的全部吧签到 |

默认值只影响新安装；已保存的开关不会被覆盖。旧版本写在 features 分组中的配置会继续读取，新版本写入 config 分组并同时回写旧分组一个版本。

设置页状态

顶部状态卡有四种状态，用 getScope() + getRunningTargets() 判断：
- 正在连接框架…：service 尚未绑定（绑定后自动刷新）
- 未激活：已连接框架，但作用域没勾选百度贴吧
- 框架已连接：作用域已勾选，但贴吧进程当前未注入（启动贴吧后生效）
- 已激活：贴吧进程已注入，显示框架 API 版本

异常横幅只在两种情况下出现：贴吧版本不是 22.14.1.0，或已启用且明确失败的功能数 ≥ 2。框架未绑定时开关置灰，避免“改了没用”。设置页末尾提供「恢复默认」：二次确认后写入全部默认值、清理旧 group 键并回读校验，失败会明确提示。

诊断与关于
- 诊断页：逐功能显示 编号 标题 与 registered · hit N · skip 原因；无数据显示 —。页首显示刷新时间，页尾可刷新或复制全部诊断信息。诊断数据只来自目标进程回传，不包含用户内容。
- 关于页：模块版本、目标应用与适配版本、源码地址、四模块互链、免责声明与 MIT 许可证。

安装

1. 从 Releases 下载最新 APK 安装。
2. 在 LSPosed 管理器中启用「贴吧静净」，作用域勾选「百度贴吧」。
3. 强制停止并重新打开贴吧。

要求：LSPosed 2.1+ / Vector 2.2+（Zygisk），libxposed API 102；百度贴吧 22.14.1.0。

构建

要求：JDK 21、Android SDK Platform 37（libxposed 102 的 aar 要求 compileSdk 37）。

./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

产物：app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk；release 产物为 app/build/outputs/apk/release/tiebaquiet-.apk（需在仓库根提供 keystore.properties 与签名文件，缺失时 release 构建直接失败）。

完整验证：

./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:lintDebug :app:assembleRelease --no-daemon

当前共 317 个 JVM 单测（app/src/test），CI 在 push 到 main 和 PR 时运行单测与 lint。

本地预检：bash tools/preflight.sh；锚点体检：bash tools/check-mounts.sh --apk （缺省自动探测；无 DexSQL 时进入降级模式、只校验锚点表完整性并以 2 退出；确需放行时显式加 --allow-degraded）。

架构

全部为 Java 17 + XML + Material 3，不使用 Kotlin/Compose。
- TiebaQuietModule：libxposed 入口，仅注入贴吧主进程；安装完成后启动诊断回传。
- Feature / FeatureRegistry：25 个功能的编号、remote key、文案、默认值、分组与安装器。
- anchor/AnchorTable：读取打包进 APK 的 anchors.json（当前 61 个方法锚点 + 2 个字段锚点 + 13 个类锚点），运行时反射校验类/方法是否存在；缺失时只禁用对应功能，版本不匹配只告警不阻断。
- feature/phase1|2|3：各功能的 hook 安装器；CardFilter / FeedCardSweeper 为信息流过滤公共逻辑。
- Config / ConfigStore / ConfigMigration：目标进程读、模块 App 写，新分组 config 优先、旧分组 features 兜底。
- ServiceBridge：XposedService 绑定、占位 binder 过滤与 remote prefs 获取。
- HookState / hooks/Report / StatusProvider：目标进程每 3 秒检查注册/命中/跳过状态，内容变化才回传、不变时每 5 分钟心跳；模块 App 侧校验 UID 后同步 commit() 落盘，并按会话标识、10 分钟 TTL 与 critical 标记供诊断页和失败横幅读取。
- tools/gen_anchors.py：构建期用 DexSQL 校验全部锚点并生成 anchors.json。

贴吧更新后：

python tools/gen_anchors.py --apk  --out app/src/main/resources/anchors.json

锚点未命中的功能会在日志中标记为 skipped，其余功能继续工作。

兼容性与风险

| 宿主版本 | 状态 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 22.14.1.0（370016512） | 已适配 | 当前声明版本；锚点表 61 个方法 + 2 个字段 + 13 个类，静态体检 63/63 + 13/13 |
| 22.13.1.1（369950981） | 历史适配，不再保证 | 0.3.6 及以前使用；22.14.1.0 混淆名再次洗牌后需重新生成锚点 |
- 仅声明支持表中「已适配」版本；混淆类（fz8 等）通过字符串锚点在 gen_anchors.py 中定位，跨版本需重新生成。
- 贴吧业务方法普遍带 Titan 热修桩（$ic）。模块遵循：优先 replace/after，before 不 return，不 hook clinit/构造器。
- 已知暴露面：贴吧内置 sofire/weapon 等检测会随请求上报 Xposed 环境特征；本模块不做任何检测绕过，只减少主动触碰（不 hook 框架方法、不碰签名/发送层、不做设备号伪造）。
- “启动任务精简”曾 hook LaunchTask.run()，但它是所有启动任务的模板方法，跳过会导致 Fresco 图片管线未初始化、贴吧启动即闪退，已移除。
- 修改开关后需要强制停止并重新打开贴吧生效（RemotePreferences 在进程启动时读取）。

已知限制（0.3.9）
- 安装包签名校验：启动时核对 APK 签名证书与内置指纹；签名不符会首次启动警告一次（不阻断功能）。该校验只能提示二次打包，恶意修改仍可移除，请优先从 CodeFloe Releases / Telegram 频道下载。
- 22.14.1.0 锚点已重生成，已完成真机冒烟、未逐项回归：2026-11-14 基于 22.14.1.0（versionCode 370016512）APK 全量重定位 22 个锚点/类（16 个方法锚点 + 6 个类锚点，20 个 c/m/s 值变更），当前 61 方法 + 2 字段 + 13 类，check-mounts.sh 63/63 + 13/13、0 MISSING；真机 ready: 14 installed, 0 skipped, target=22.14.1.0，功能行为未逐项真机回归。
- FRS/吧内插入直播卡（AD-05）：22.14.1.0 上由 z88#s 迁到 a98#s（参数 v4f → c7f），绑定后隐藏整卡；真机已确认锚点注册、AD-05 命中 template_set_list，尚未用可复现的 FRS/吧内插入直播卡确认过滤效果。
- 信息流语音房/开播推荐卡（AD-05）：issue #3 截图里的卡片由 CardFeedVoiceRoomView#v 渲染，22.14.1.0 参数由 le9 → re9；绑定后隐藏整卡，真机已确认锚点注册，过滤效果仍需可复现卡片确认。
- 一键签到需 EN-08 开启：关闭 EN-08 时接收器忽略签到广播，设置页按钮提示“请先开启”；点击按钮不再静默改写开关。
- 签到页可打开，但本账号无法完成签到：2026-10-29 真机（0.2.1）已触发并打开贴吧签到页；页面提示「吧内等级 7 级以上才可使用」，当前账号各吧为 1–6 级，因此没有实际完成签到。这是贴吧的账号等级门槛，不是模块失败。
- 冷启动需系统确认：贴吧未运行时点按钮，HyperOS 会弹「启动应用」确认框；本次未验证人工点「本次允许」后的完整路径，先手动启动贴吧再触发是正常的。
- 25 项逐项回归未做：本轮未对 25 个功能逐项在真机做开启/关闭回归，仅完成单测、lint 与 release 构建验证。

许可证
