modules.name: AA Experiments
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: AA Experiments
modules.readme:
AA Experiments

AA Experiments is an independent, open-source LSPosed module and Android manager for discovering, inspecting and selectively overriding Android Auto experiment flags.

The manager analyzes installed or imported Android Auto APK/APKM/APKS packages locally. It identifies compatible scalar getters and only publishes active overrides for the exact installed base/split build fingerprint. It does not patch, resign, install or redistribute Android Auto.

Features
- Search and inspect discovered Android Auto experiment flags.
- Configure eligible BOOLEAN, LONG, DOUBLE and STRING overrides.
- Optional Advanced Overrides for a separately reviewed subset of getters, with explicit risk warnings, two-stage confirmation and Pause / Resume / Restore.
- View read-only getter probes and Video Timing Controller diagnostics.
- Export large catalogs as JSON or CSV and preserve normal, Advanced and Experimental settings in an exact-build recovery bundle.
- Review or suspend incompatible mappings rather than silently applying them after Android Auto updates.
- Option in Settings → Media to automatic media-app opening when Android Auto projection starts.

Requirements
- Android 8.1 / API 27 or newer.
- A compatible LSPosed framework providing libxposed API 101.
- Android Auto installed; scope the module to com.google.android.projection.gearhead in LSPosed.

Installation

1. Download the official, release-key-signed APK from Xposed Module Repo or from developer repo AA Experiments Releases.
2. Install the APK and enable AA Experiments in LSPosed.
3. Confirm if Android Auto is selected in the module's LSPosed scope.
4. Restart Android Auto process as needed and open AA Experiments to analyze installed build.
5. Make changes deliberately; no flags are overridden by default. Keep a backup and use the built-in Restore controls if you experience issues.

Safety and privacy

Eligible getters are not guaranteed to make a feature work: the Android Auto app, Google servers and the connected head unit may impose additional conditions. Advanced entries are not universally editable, and some values can affect stability or safety. Full recovery backups are not encrypted or authenticated, may include raw STRING values and should be kept private; use only matching-build backups from trusted sources.

Scans and analysis run locally. The application has no developer-operated backend or telemetry. See the main project's privacy and known limitations for details.

Links
- Source, documentation and support
- Feature catalog
- Official APK releases

Application ID: io.github.highwindbr.aaxp
License: GPL-3.0-or-later
Author: HighwindBR

This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Google, Android Auto or LSPosed.
modules.changelog:
What's New in v1.0.0 🎉

The first stable release of AA Experiments is here! This update focuses on reliability, performance, and UI improvements.
- Improved scanning: More reliable Android Auto analysis, even when switching apps or turning off the screen.
- Media auto-open: Improved automatic launching of Spotify or other selected media apps, with more reliable route detection.
- Refreshed UI: Polished light and dark themes, better colors, clearer status indicators, and improved navigation.
- Better compatibility: More resilient feature detection across Android Auto updates and improved APK/APKM handling.
- Safer overrides: Improved configuration persistence, recovery, and handling of suspended experiments.
- Performance & stability: Optimized catalog storage, database handling, and memory usage.
- Bug fixes: Various fixes, accessibility improvements, and internal cleanups.

This release builds on beta5 and brings the improvements developed throughout beta6 into a stable version.

modules.name: Airgap
modules.author: skeler
modules.description: Cut internet access per app. Dedicated iptables chain, resync watchdog, system/user filtering and backup-restore.
modules.readme:
Airgap

Cut internet access per app, on rooted Android. Magisk / KernelSU / APatch module.

Blocked apps are rejected at the kernel level with iptables UID owner matching, so there is
no VPN slot consumed, no battery-draining userspace proxy, and nothing for an app to detect.

Requirements
- Magisk, KernelSU or APatch
- A kernel with xt_owner (-m owner) support — essentially every Android kernel
- KsuWebUI or MMRL for the app picker

Install

Flash airgap-x.y.zip in your root manager and reboot. Open the module's Action / WebUI
entry to pick apps.

WebUI
- Filter by All / User / System / Blocked
- Sort by name, blocked-first, user-first, system-first or UID
- Search, with the full package name and UID on every row
- Export a backup, restore one, or paste backup JSON straight in

Toggles are batched: flipping ten switches issues one rule rebuild, not ten.

CLI

Available as airgap on $PATH under KernelSU and APatch, otherwise at
/data/adb/modules/airgap/system/bin/airgap.

airgap block ...            isolate the given packages
airgap unblock ...|all      restore internet access
airgap set [...|--none]     replace the isolated set with exactly these packages
airgap list                      show isolated packages and their UIDs
airgap status                    show rule, hook and watchdog state
airgap apply                     rebuild and reload all rules
airgap clear                     remove every rule and unhook the chain
airgap backup [file]             write a backup (default: /sdcard/Download)
airgap restore  [--merge]  restore from a backup file
airgap daemon | stop             control the resync watchdog

How it works

Rules live in a dedicated airgap chain hooked once at the head of OUTPUT, loaded atomically
via iptables-restore. Every apply rebuilds that chain from /data/adb/airgap/isolated.json,
which is what keeps the following correct without any bookkeeping:
- Shared UIDs — apps declaring the same sharedUserId share one kernel UID. Unblocking one
  of them keeps the rule as long as another still needs it.
- Reinstalls — an app's UID changes when it is reinstalled. A watchdog watches
  packages.list via inotifyd and re-resolves within seconds, so a stale rule never blocks
  the wrong app.
- netd flushes — Android rebuilds the filter table on VPN, tethering and connectivity
  changes, which silently drops rules placed directly in OUTPUT. A 60s integrity pass
  detects this and repairs the chain.
- Work profiles — secondary-user UIDs (uid + user × 100000) are covered too.

Both IPv4 and IPv6 are handled. REJECT is used where the kernel supports it so blocked apps
fail fast instead of hanging, falling back to DROP otherwise.

Backup & restore

airgap backup                    # -> /sdcard/Download/airgap-YYYYmmdd-HHMMSS.json
airgap restore             # replace the current set
airgap restore  --merge    # add to the current set

Packages in a backup that are not installed are skipped and reported. Restore also accepts a
plain JSON array of package names.

Uninstall

Remove the module in your root manager. This tears down the chain, stops the watchdog and
deletes /data/adb/airgap.

Building

The repository *is* the module — zip its contents with the module files at the archive root,
excluding the repo-only files that the module does not need at runtime:

zip -r9X airgap.zip . -x '.git/*' '.github/*' 'assets/*' 'README.md' 'update.json' 'changelog.md'

Releasing

Root managers poll update.json and offer an update only when its versionCode is higher
than the installed one, so every release must bump it.

1. Bump version and versionCode in module.prop
2. Add the entry to changelog.md
3. Update version, versionCode and zipUrl in update.json to match
4. zip -r9X airgap-.zip . -x '.git/*' '.github/*' 'assets/*' 'README.md' 'update.json' 'changelog.md'
5. gh release create v airgap-.zip --title "Airgap "
6. Push to the default branch — update.json is served from it, so the update only goes
   live once pushed

License

Apache-2.0
modules.changelog:
Per-app internet isolation for Magisk / KernelSU / APatch.

Flash airgap-1.0.zip in your root manager and reboot, then open the module WebUI to pick apps.

Highlights
- Kernel-level blocking — iptables UID owner matching on IPv4 and IPv6. No VPN slot, no userspace proxy.
- Rules that stay applied — a dedicated airgap chain is hooked once at the head of OUTPUT and rebuilt atomically via iptables-restore. A watchdog repairs it after netd flushes the filter table on VPN, tethering or connectivity changes.
- Correct UID handling — shared sharedUserId apps, UID changes after a reinstall (re-resolved within seconds via inotifyd), and work-profile UIDs.
- WebUI — filter by user/system/blocked, six sort modes, search, and batched applies so ten toggles cost one rule rebuild.
- Backup & restore — export to /sdcard/Download, restore or merge, or paste backup JSON directly.

Requirements

Magisk, KernelSU or APatch, plus KsuWebUI or MMRL for the app picker.

modules.name: AlarmShell
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: AlarmShell
modules.readme:
使用说明
原理
通过hook系统闹钟的AlarmAlertFullScreenActivity，在这个Activity启动时，根据你设置的闹钟配置来执行特定的Shell脚本。
可靠性
可靠性是开发此模块的缘由，试过很多定时任务的APP，可能因各种原因（如后台被杀）导致到点没有执行我下的任务。
我想到系统里的闹钟，它可从来没有失误过，即使你把它的后台杀了，关机也能自动开机来提醒你。再想到LSPosed可以给APP添砖加瓦，所以就有了此模块，原理见上。
应该仅支持MIUI，其他操作系统开可以试一试，要我适配你的系统可以发issues
使用与授予闹钟root权限
脚本存放目录
将Shell脚本放入/data/user/0/com.android.deskclock/files/shell/目录，如果没有shell文件夹，请自行创建一个。
如果你想添加一个名为helloworld的Shell脚本，那么你应该放到这里：/data/user/0/com.android.deskclock/files/shell/helloworld.sh
脚本文件与闹钟备注
新建一个脚本文件，假设你要创建的是"helloworld.sh"，创建完成后，再去新建一个备注与脚本文件名一样的闹钟，闹钟备注名就应该是"helloworld.sh"。闹钟应该铃声为无铃声且取消掉震动（如果你乐意也无所谓）。

授予root权限
脚本文件一律使用ROOT执行！所以必须先授予闹钟ROOT权限！
由于root的申请在闹钟响铃时执行，所以你第一次创建一个脚本后，把闹钟的时间设置在最近的几分钟后，响铃时会申请root权限，允许后就得到了root权限，后续新建其他脚本都无需授权（只要你不关闭或撤销magisk里的root授权即可），root权限申请成功后，就可以将闹钟的时间改为为你想要的时间，到点后即可正常执行你的脚本。

建议
执行脚本前，闹钟响铃的activity界面不会自动关闭，所以你应该添加一个滑动屏幕的命令，将闹铃关闭。当然我相信脚本你都会放在晚上你睡觉的时候让它执行，所以执行完关闭闹钟后，你应该再写一个解锁屏幕的命令，然后再去执行接下来的操作。
示例
sleep 3
#关闭闹钟
input swipe 500 1500 500 500
#解锁屏幕，视密码而定，下面的演示为没有密码的
sleep 3
input swipe 500 1500 500 500
sleep 1
#接下来要执行的操作
它会影响正常的闹钟吗？
只要你的闹钟备注没有对应的脚本文件，那么闹钟不会执行任何脚本，不影响正常使用。除非你故意在shell目录里放了个叫"起床"的脚本。

modules.description: BilibiliMod
modules.readme:
BiliBiliMod

LSPosed module for foreign Bilibili users (tv.danmaku.bili).

It forces Bilibili to treat the app as the CN version/region and unlocks hidden mobile video categories, similar to the category access available on PC.

Features
- Forces Bilibili region/version behavior to China (CN) for foreign users.
- Restores access to hidden video categories in the mobile app, similar to Bilibili on PC.
- Opens the category menu through bilibili://main/top_category.
- Sets Portuguese as the preferred subtitle language when Bilibili does not provide a preferred language.
- Logs subtitle and translation diagnostics with the BiliBiliMod logcat tag.
- Translates video titles in category and author-space pages through Bilibili's internal TranslationMoss endpoint.

Usage

1. Install the module APK.
2. Enable the module in LSPosed.
3. Select only tv.danmaku.bili as the module scope.
4. Force close Bilibili and open it again.

On the first Bilibili launch after installing/enabling this module, use a Chinese VPN. If the app is opened without the VPN first, Bilibili may hide the categories and they usually return only after clearing Bilibili app data.

Notes
- Title translation on category pages runs through the render path used by that Compose screen, so the first category opening may have a short delay.
- The module does not store a persistent translation cache.
- Avoid scoping Bilibili into another module that hooks the same behavior, otherwise effects may be duplicated.

modules.name: CellularPro Unlocker
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: CellularPro Unlocker
modules.readme:
CellularPro Unlocker

装一个模块，把 CellularPro 里被会员挡住的地方打开。

不改 APK，不重签名，不用手动敲命令，不绑定机型。

v3.1 更新了什么（性能修复，建议所有 v3.0 用户升级）

v3.0 里带了一套诊断用的重钩子，忘了在发布前拆掉，会拖死主线程：在 FragmentLock 和 ge 上挂了 169 个方法钩子，每次调用都走一遍调用栈；锁页一交互就开 12 秒窗口，期间每秒几十次的轮询全部走栈 + 拼串 + 写盘。

表现：锁页待一会儿，RSRP / SINR 不刷新，整个界面卡住。

v3.1 把这些全部拆掉：移除 169 个追踪钩子、移除 View.setEnabled 钩子、会员放行改成布尔标记、移除 logcat 镜像写入。功能一个没少。

v3.0 更新了什么
- 锁网页控件全解锁：锁 PCI / EARFCN / NR 小区 / NR 频点 / NR 频段 / LTE、WCDMA、GSM 频段，之前全是灰的点不动，现在都能点能填。
- 点锁网不再弹会员框：跳过点击转发器，直接调用背后真正的方法。
- 局部放行，不闪退：只在锁网页那几个方法的调用栈里临时放行会员判定，返回即恢复，App 自检看到的仍是真实值。
- 信令导出修好了：反射爬不到列表时改用 TextView 文本缓存兜底，不会再提示「没有可导出的信令」。
- 彻底设备无关：模块内没有任何硬编码地址、偏移或机型判断。
一句实话：锁网控件解锁了、会员框也不弹了，但锁命令是否真的下发到基带，取决于 App 自己的原生层。实测在这台机器上 App 只发出查询、不发写锁命令，服务小区 PCI 不会变。那部分代码在 App 的 VMP 虚拟机里，模块够不到。

安装

1. 下载 最新 Release 里的 APK
2. 安装后打开 LSPosed → 模块 → 启用 CellularPro Unlocker
3. 作用域只勾 CellularPro
4. 强行停止 CellularPro，再重新打开

要求：已 root + LSPosed（API 102）+ CellularPro 2.0.16.1（make.more.r2d2.play.cellular_pro）

兼容性

| 项目 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| App 版本 | CellularPro 2.0.16.1 |
| 系统 | Android 8.0 及以上 |
| 框架 | LSPosed（libxposed API 102） |
| 架构 | arm64-v8a |

完整说明、常见问题、历史版本见主仓库：ldxm666/CellularPro-Unlocker

卸载

LSPosed 里停用模块 → 卸载 APK → 强行停止 CellularPro。没有残留文件，也不改 App 本身。

License

MIT
modules.changelog:
v3.1 — 性能修复，建议所有 v3.0 用户升级

v3.0 里带了一套诊断用的重钩子，忘了在发布前拆掉，会拖死主线程：
- 在 FragmentLock 和 ge 上挂了 169 个方法钩子，每次调用都走一遍调用栈
- 锁页一交互就开 12 秒窗口，期间 onAutoRefresh()、ge.cs() 每秒几十次的轮询全部走栈 + 拼串 + 写盘
- View.setEnabled 钩子每次调用都要查资源名

表现：锁页待一会儿，RSRP / SINR 不刷新，整个界面卡住。

修复
- 移除 169 个追踪钩子
- 移除 View.setEnabled 钩子（真正起作用的是 onAttachedToWindow，保留）
- 会员放行从「每次拍栈」改成布尔标记
- 移除 logcat 镜像写入

功能一个没少，主线程负载砍掉一大截。

要求：已 root + LSPosed（API 102）+ CellularPro 2.0.16.1（make.more.r2d2.play.cellular_pro）

modules.name: ChargeMate
modules.author: Yash
modules.description: Limits battery charging between configurable % levels. Edit config.sh to set STOP and START values. Use Action button to reload config instantly without reboot.
modules.readme:
🔋 ChargeMate — Magisk Module

A lightweight Magisk module that automatically limits battery charging between configurable percentage levels, designed to extend long-term battery health. Supports instant config reload via the Action button — no reboot required.

✨ Features
- 🔋 Stops charging at a configurable STOP% (default: 95%)
- 🔄 Resumes charging at a configurable START% (default: 85%)
- ⚡ Action button — reload config instantly without reboot
- 🖥️ Automatically bypasses charging control during USB file transfer, MTP, PTP, or USB tethering
- 🔌 Handles power cuts and charger reconnects gracefully
- 🔁 Supports Magisk in-app updates
- 📝 Simple config file — no app required
- 🪶 Zero UI, zero bloat — pure shell script

📱 Compatibility

| Device Type | Supported |
|---|---|
| MediaTek (MTK) devices | ✅ Yes |
| Redmi Note 9 / Note 8 / Helio G series | ✅ Tested |
| Snapdragon devices | ❌ No (input_suspend node not available) |
| Exynos (Samsung) devices | ❌ No |
| Android 8 – 12 | ✅ Yes |
| Android 13+ | ⚠️ Untested |
Tested on: Redmi Note 9 (Merlin) — Android 10, MIUI 12, Kernel 4.14, Magisk

📦 Installation

1. Download the latest ChargeMate_vX.X.zip from Releases
2. Open Magisk → Modules → Install from storage
3. Select the downloaded zip
4. Reboot your device

⚙️ Configuration

After installation, edit the config file at:

    /data/adb/modules/chargemate/config.sh

Battery % at which charging will pause (50–99)
STOP=95

Battery % at which charging will resume (must be at least 5% below STOP)
START=85

After editing, tap the Action button in Magisk to apply changes instantly — no reboot needed.

Recommended Values

| Use Case | STOP | START |
|---|---|---|
| Daily driver (recommended) | 95 | 85 |
| Maximum battery health | 80 | 70 |
| Overnight charging | 90 | 80 |

▶️ Action Button

Tap the Action button in Magisk → Modules → ChargeMate to:
- Reload config.sh values instantly
- Restart the background service with new limits
- View current battery status, charger state, and active config

No reboot required after config changes.

🔍 How It Works

Boot
    → service.sh starts automatically via Magisk

Charger connected
        ↓
Fresh connection? → Reset input_suspend = 0 (charging enabled)
        ↓
Is USB data / tethering active?
    YES → Skip control, charging continues normally
    NO  ↓
Level >= STOP%  → Pause charging   (input_suspend = 1)
Level <= START% → Resume charging  (input_suspend = 0)

Charger disconnected / power cut
    → Reset input_suspend = 0  (safety reset)
    → Fresh state on reconnect

📂 Module Structure

chargemate/
├── module.prop          # Module metadata
├── service.sh           # Background service (auto-starts on boot)
├── config.sh            # User configuration — edit this file
├── action.sh            # Action button script (instant config reload)
└── META-INF/
    └── com/google/android/
        ├── update-binary
        └── updater-script

❓ FAQ

Q: Charging stopped permanently. How do I fix it?

Disable the module from Magisk → Modules → ChargeMate, then reboot.

Q: Will USB file transfer still work?

Yes. The module monitors the USB state. Whenever a data connection is detected (MTP, PTP, tethering), charging control is automatically bypassed.

Q: Do I need to reboot after editing config.sh?

No. Just tap the Action button in Magisk to reload the config instantly.

Q: How do I verify the script is running?

cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/input_suspend
Output: 1 = charging paused | 0 = charging active

📜 Changelog

v3.1 — Bug Fix
- Fixed critical bug: charging not starting when charger reconnected at 85–95% range
- Improved Action button status — shows IDLE when charger is disconnected
- Added Magisk in-app update support

v3.0
- Added Action button for instant config reload without reboot
- Added config validation with error messages
- Added real-time status display in Action output

v2.0
- Added configurable STOP and START via config.sh
- Added USB data connection detection bypass
- Added charger disconnect safety reset

v1.0
- Initial release

📜 License

MIT License — free to use, modify, and distribute.

🙏 Credits
- Magisk by topjohnwu
- Developed and tested on Redmi Note 9 by Yash

ChatGPT Speaker v1.2
====================

Experimental LSPosed module, scoped only to com.openai.chatgpt.

v1.2 tries to make ChatGPT voice output behave more like ordinary speaker/media
output instead of a VoIP/phone stream:
- force BUILTIN_SPEAKER
- replace MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION with MODE_NORMAL
- replace USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION with USAGE_MEDIA

Build:
Build -> Assemble Project

APK:
app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk

Test:
1. Disable old ChatGPT Speaker modules in LSPosed.
2. Install v1.2.
3. Enable v1.2 only for ChatGPT.
4. Reboot.
5. Test Voice Mode.

LSPosed log markers:
MODE_IN_COMMUNICATION -> MODE_NORMAL
USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION -> USAGE_MEDIA
AudioAttributes usage=
forcing BUILTIN_SPEAKER

This is experimental. If it does not change the volume, the next likely layer
is HyperOS AudioPolicy/AudioFlinger rather than another app-level hook.

modules.name: ClearApp
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: ClearApp
modules.readme:
ClearApp

一个 LSPosed 模块，用来把 app 里用不到的东西去掉：多余的 tab、悬浮球、页面组件。

不做去广告 —— 只做「界面上这些我不看」。每条规则都挂在宿主自己的开关上，关掉之后对应的视图和
请求根本不会产生，而不是事后去隐藏，所以不会留下空位或半截界面。

源码：

功能

番茄免费小说 com.dragon.read

| 位置 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 底部主 tab | 只保留 书城 / 书架 / 我的（去掉短剧、赚钱、分类） |
| 书城顶部子 tab | 去掉 看剧 / 视频 / 商城 |
| 书架顶部子 tab | 去掉 收藏 |
| 「我的」页 | 去掉 金币 / 现金余额 / 微信提现 / 福利 整块，以及底部 推荐流 |
| 悬浮球 | 金币挂件、发帖球、继续看悬浮窗、冷启增长悬浮条 全部去掉 |

红果免费短剧 com.phoenix.read

| 位置 | 处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 底部主 tab | 只保留 首页 / 剧场 / 我的（去掉商城、赚钱） |
| 悬浮球 | 金币挂件（KMP 版 + 老式版）、一键领挂件、主页面悬浮窗、冷启增长悬浮条 全部去掉 |

「我的」页的金币和提现入口没有动 —— 需求里没要求。

保留的东西

番茄听书的「边听边读」悬浮球没有拦。它是跳回阅读器继续听看的功能入口，不是引流组件。

环境

| 项 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| Android | 8.0+（API 24+） |
| Root | KernelSU / Magisk，需临时或永久 root |
| Xposed 框架 | Vector 2.2 或 LSPosed，Xposed API 101+（模块按 API 102 构建） |

实测环境：红米 K70 至尊版（Android 16）+ KernelSU + Vector 2.2。

适配的 app 版本

规则是照着具体版本的类名和方法名写的，下面这两个版本实测通过：

| app | 包名 | 版本 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 番茄免费小说 | com.dragon.read | 7.3.7.33（versionCode 73733） |
| 红果免费短剧 | com.phoenix.read | 7.3.7.32（versionCode 73732） |
app 升级后部分规则可能失效。 模块对这些情况是容错的：目标方法找不到就跳过那一条并写日志，
不会崩溃也不会影响别的规则。日志里搜 跳过 就能看出哪条失效了。

安装

1. 从 Releases 下载 APK 安装
2. 在 LSPosed 管理器里启用模块，作用域勾选 com.dragon.read 和 com.phoenix.read
3. 强制停止目标 app 再打开
装完模块后第一次冷启可能仍跑的是旧版本，框架需要一点时间重新读模块。再 force-stop 重启
一次即可，别以为是规则写错了。

排查

模块把自己挂上的每一条规则都写进日志，同时写一份到 logcat：

adb logcat -d | grep "ClearApp/"

关注三类行：
- 已挂载  -> # —— 找到了目标并挂上
- 跳过 ：目标方法不存在 —— 这条在这个版本里失效了
- 屏蔽 xxx / 保留 xxx —— 规则实际触发

说明
- 只作用于设备上已安装的 app，不修改任何 app 的安装包。
- 规则基于对目标 app 的静态分析得出，app 升级后需要跟着维护。
- 请自行确认在当地使用 root / Xposed 类工具符合相关规定。

更新日志
- v1.0.1 —— 适配番茄/红果 7.3.9.32，修复升级后失效的几条规则。详见 Releases。
- v1.0.0 —— 首个版本，支持番茄免费小说、红果免费短剧。详见 Releases。
modules.changelog:
ClearApp v1.1.1
- 模块包名：io.github.wuqiao309.clearapp
- 版本：v1.1.1（versionCode 5）

这一版为什么发

番茄和红果都升到了 7.4.3.32，混淆包号整体换代，有 5 条规则失效了。这一版把它们重新接上，
并顺手把两个「一升级就要重新找类名」的地方改成了跨版本更耐用的找法。

修了什么

| 规则 | 现象 | 原因 / 修法 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| float-pendant-attach | 番茄右下角「点击赚钱」挂件又出现了 | 挂载方法从 s/t 改名成 v。改成按形参表找 (ViewGroup, int, Context)，以后改名不用管 |
| fanqie-bookshelf-subtab | 书架顶部「收藏」tab 又出现了 | 重建方法 dh/ch → Ih；注册表类 hb6.i → af6.i（字段仍是 d） |
| fanqie-mine-coin-card | 「我的」页金币卡、「我的钱包」（含微信提现）没被拦 | 卡片分发器 sd4.c#g(sw3.d) → ye4.c#g(yx3.d)；同时把 DOUYIN_WALLET 加进屏蔽列表 |
| float-kmp-continue-attach | 「继续看」悬浮球挂不上 | 挂载方法 番茄 j(Context) → g(Context)、红果 → m(Context)。改成按形参表找 (Context) |
| float-kmp-continue-showing | 红果的显隐开关挂不上 | 开关方法红果叫 n()（番茄 o()）。改成按候选名 o/n 找 —— 都是无参返回 boolean、都在 onDestroy 前一位 |
| float-editor-ball | 信息流右下角发帖球（画笔圆钮）还在 | 球类 dd5.o → sf5.m / uf5.m。改成从 CommunityInfiniteEditorHelper#b() 的返回类型动态取类，类名不用写死 |
| float-pendant-legacy-attach | 老式「一键领」挂件（红果右侧竖排） | 控制器混淆名换到 7.4.3：番茄 m82.o / 红果 w42.o，方法都是 v。改成候选名 + 形参表查找（LEGACY_PENDANT_CANDIDATES） |

另外把 float-growth-tryShowComic7Day* / tryShowFestivalComicGuide* 两条规则移除了：
全 dex 扫描确认 7.4.3 起宿主把「漫画 7 天引导」「节日漫画引导」两个功能整个删了，留着只会永远打跳过日志。

还跳过的（不影响使用）

只剩 4 条探针：bottom-tab-add / bottom-tab-add-hg / bottom-tab-label:*。
混淆类 ig7.* / ve7.* 被整个去掉，日志里会一直显示「跳过」。只影响诊断，
判断有没有拦住看 屏蔽底部 tab：xxx 即可。

实测结果

| app | 挂载 | 跳过 | 界面 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 番茄 7.4.3.32 | 15 条 | 4 条（全是探针） | 底部只剩 书城/书架/我的；书架只剩 书架/历史/圈子；「我的」页无金币卡、无钱包、无推荐流；首页无任何悬浮球 |
| 红果 7.4.3.32 | 10 条 | 4 条（全是探针） | 底部只剩 首页/剧场/我的；无悬浮球（含一键领挂件） |

包体积：2.47 MB → 0.64 MB

包体积的大头本来是 DexKit 的原生库 —— 同一个 libdexkit.so 按 4 个 ABI 各打一份，加起来 1.44 MB。
这一版做了两步：先只保留 arm64-v8a（降到 1.32 MB），随后把 DexKit 整体移除（降到 0.64 MB）。

移除 DexKit 的原因：它只服务一条从未触发过的兜底规则（老式挂件的挂载点），而那条规则现在改用
「候选名 + 形参表」后反而真正生效了（红果实测命中 w42.o#v）。用 0.67 MB 的纯 Kotlin 包、零原生库、
零 ABI 兼容妥协，换掉一个几乎不工作的扫描器，划算。

适配版本

| app | 包名 | 版本 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 番茄免费小说 | com.dragon.read | 7.4.3.32（74332） |
| 红果免费短剧 | com.phoenix.read | 7.4.3.32（74332） |
| 智行火车票 | com.yipiao | 10.25.8（710258，规则未变） |

说明

这一版新增了 ClassResolver.findMethodByParams（按形参表找方法，不看方法名），并把它用在了
挂件和「继续看」球上 —— 这两处的方法名每次升级都在换，按形参找就不用再追了。发帖球则改成从工厂
方法的返回类型取类。剩下的维护成本主要集中在方法名和混淆类名上，升级后照日志里的「跳过」逐条
补即可。

modules.name: DLsiteFloat - DLSiteSound悬浮窗/状态栏字幕模块
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: DLsiteFloat - DLSiteSound悬浮窗/状态栏字幕模块
modules.readme:
DLsiteFloat

DLsiteSound 悬浮窗 / 状态栏字幕模块

简体中文 | 繁體中文 | English

功能特性
- 悬浮字幕窗：在 DLsiteSound 播放页挂一个与播放进度同步的字幕窗，可拖动、可缩放。
- 状态栏字幕：把当前字幕行镜像到系统状态栏（在 SystemUI 进程内注入）。支持单程左移滚动、实时让位时钟与通知图标区、流体云动态避让。
- 播放页双胶囊按钮：状态栏 开 / 关 与 悬浮窗 开 / 关，随页面自动显隐；无字幕时自动置灰或隐藏。
- 进程内悬浮窗：窗口直接挂在 DLsiteSound 进程内，与各个 Hook 共享同一份字幕数据，无需跨进程 IPC、无需独立 Service。
- 可单独使用悬浮窗字幕：未授权 com.android.systemui 作用域时，左侧状态栏 开 / 关按钮不显示。
- 自动抓取字幕：拦截 DLsiteSound 的网络响应自动解析字幕 JSON，不依赖 URL 关键词。
- 换轨智能处理：切到无字幕音轨时先挂起并提示，等新音轨的字幕 JSON —— 无缓存时等 1 秒、已有缓存放宽到 15 秒，期间可提前收窗并在字幕到达后自动开回。
- 液态玻璃：悬浮窗面板与播放页字幕按钮可切换为液态玻璃质感 —— 背景模糊交给系统合成器做，玻璃材质由模块自绘。
- 可视化设置页：模块自带设置页，可调主字幕 / 非活动行 / 排版 / 液态玻璃等参数，改完点「保存设置」即生效。
- 多语言支持：按系统语言取插件显示语言，支持简体中文 / 繁體中文 / English

适配范围

| 项目 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 目标 App | DLsiteSound（jp.co.eisys.dlsitesound） |
| 框架 | LSPosed 2.2.0+（libxposed API 102） |
| 作用域 | 需勾选两个：jp.co.eisys.dlsitesound 与 com.android.systemui |
| Android 版本 | Android 7.0（minSdk 24）起，targetSdk 34 |
| 机型 / ROM | 基于 ColorOS 16/17 测试制作，其它 ROM 理论上可用 |

使用说明

1. 下载模块

   从主仓库 Releases 或本仓库 Releases页面下载最新版本的 APK（通常情况下，两者更新进度一致，若不一致以主仓库为准）。

2. 安装并启用
- 安装 APK 到已 root 设备
- 打开 LSPosed 管理器，找到 DLsiteFloat 模块
- 勾选启用，作用域两个都勾：jp.co.eisys.dlsitesound + com.android.systemui
- 强制停止 DLsiteSound，并重启 SystemUI 或重启手机

3. 授予悬浮窗权限
- 设置 → 应用 → DLsiteSound → 权限管理 → 特殊应用权限 → 悬浮窗
- 设置 → 应用 → DLsiteFloat → 权限管理 → 特殊应用权限 → 悬浮窗

4. 开始使用
- 打开 DLsiteSound 的有字幕播放页，播放控制条上方出现两个胶囊按钮
- 左键开关状态栏字幕，右键开关悬浮窗
- 悬浮窗面板任意处拖动可移动，右下角手柄拖动可缩放

DouAi

☕ 请我喝杯咖啡

DouAi 是面向抖音的增强模块，作者 yudigaga。本仓库提供 LSPosed 模块介绍及正式 APK。

当前正式版：0.3.1 / 202。

下载 DouAi-0.3.1-release.apk · 源码仓库

本版调整抖音 41 竖屏视频铺满后的原生边缘色带遮罩，改进侧栏与控件恢复，并完善九宫格双击点赞和导航图标。手动切页偶发短黑增加诊断。详细变化与验证范围见 发布记录。

核心功能
- 推荐流与顶部标签筛选、组件隐藏及独立透明度调整。
- 播放手势、自动播放、播放速度、书签、章节字幕搜索、画面裁切与沉浸显示。
- 液态玻璃与重力感应（抖音 41）：导航、作者文案、进度区、右侧操作区及侧边栏可见项目随持机姿态轻微平移与倾斜，触摸时冻结，松手后平滑跟随。
- 原生和第三方下载扩展、自定义保存目录、下载任务进度与取消。
- 已加载评论查找、宿主语音转写、评论工具，支持系统及第三方语音、音色选择与随机音色。
- 自动回复、自动评论和续火花，支持名单范围、内容筛选及 AI 模型。
- 用户资料与聚合目录、原生用户搜索、关系筛选及群聊范围配置。
- 模型与分层提示词、素材测试、AI 消息联系人和独立对话。
- 配置导入/导出、本地数据分析与个人内容年志，支持 PNG/PDF 分享。

功能以对应宿主的适配规则和设置页为准，不保证其他版本或构建兼容。

环境与适配
- Android 9 或以上，支持 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed。
- 作用域：抖音 com.ss.android.ugc.aweme。
- 抖音 40.6.0 / 400601。
- 抖音 40.8.0 / 400801，内部构建 40809900。
- 抖音 41.0.0 / 410001，内部构建 41009900。

安装与使用

1. 下载正式 APK 并安装；后续正式版使用同一签名，可覆盖更新。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用 DouAi，作用域只选择抖音。
3. 完全退出并重新打开抖音，在抖音设置中的 DouAi 入口配置功能。

从旧 com.douai.module Debug 包迁移时，先卸载旧模块，再安装并启用正式包，避免重复 Hook。

模块应用提供框架连接、扫描诊断、隐藏桌面图标和关于入口。模块设置的“关于 → 帮助”可离线查看说明。

使用重力感应时，在“界面相关”将“界面主题”选为“液态玻璃”，再开启“重力感应”；视频、输入与字幕保持稳定。

升级与数据

当前分析数据库为 SQLite v4，分析备份导出为 v3，仍可导入旧 v1/v2 分析备份。不要用旧版程序直接打开新版数据库。

本地分析记录默认关闭；主动点击请求 AI 时才发送分析摘要。

文档

- 完整帮助。
- 0.2.93 发布记录。
- 构建与发布状态。
- 个人内容年志。

历史安装包见 本仓库 Releases，历史说明从主仓文档目录查阅。

赞助

如果你喜欢 DouAi，欢迎请我喝杯咖啡 ☕，感谢支持！

免责协议

本项目仅用于学习与技术研究。用户的应用、配置、二次开发及使用行为和结果由用户自行决定并承担责任，与本项目及作者无关。完整责任边界见 免责协议，APK 关于页也可查看。

modules.name: Enable hotspot tile and tethering settings on Leno
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Enable hotspot tile and tethering settings on Lenovo ZUI global ROMs
modules.readme:
ZUI Hotspot Fix

Fix missing Hotspot toggle on Lenovo ZUI / ZUXOS devices caused by OEM restrictions.

This LSPosed module restores:
- Hotspot Quick Settings tile
- Tethering / Hotspot settings page

⚡ No system modification required — everything works via runtime hooks.

⚡ TL;DR
- Missing hotspot toggle? This fixes it.
- Restores the Quick Settings tile and tethering page.
- No system file modification required.
- Works through LSPosed runtime hooks.

📦 Module info
- Module ID (package name): com.xeno.zuihotspotfix
- Framework: LSPosed / Xposed (classic API 82)
- Source code: https://github.com/Xeno761/ZuiHotspotFix
- Downloads (APK): https://github.com/Xeno761/ZuiHotspotFix/releases

📸 Screenshots

| Quick Settings Tile | Tethering Page | Hotspot Settings |
|---------------------|----------------|------------------|
|  |  |  |

⚠️ Experimental / device-specific

Tested only on:
- Lenovo Idea Tab Pro
- ZUXOS 1.5.10.060 (Android 16)
- China ROM manually converted to global

Other Lenovo devices / firmware versions may behave differently.

Use at your own risk.

👥 Who is this for
- Lenovo tablet users on ZUI / ZUXOS
- Users whose hotspot is disabled on global ROMs
- Rooted users using LSPosed

❓ Why this exists

Some Lenovo global ROMs disable hotspot functionality even when hardware support exists.
This module bypasses those OEM restrictions and re-enables hotspot where the UI and backend code still exist.

🔧 Features
- Forces the Hotspot Quick Settings tile to always be available.
- Re-enables the Hotspot / Tethering settings page (when present in the ROM).
- Works entirely via LSPosed hooks.
- No smali edits or system file patching required.

❌ What this does NOT do
- Does not enable hotspot if the required hardware or kernel support is missing.
- Does not recreate Settings pages that were fully removed from the ROM.
- Does not bypass carrier restrictions.
- Does not guarantee compatibility on all Lenovo devices or firmware versions.

⚙️ How it works (technical)
For developers and power users
- Hooks com.android.systemui.qs.tiles.HotspotTile
  → Overrides the availability check to always return true.
- Hooks com.lenovo.common.utils.LenovoUtils.isSupportTether(android.content.Context)
  → Forces tethering support to true, bypassing OEM region / config checks.
- Uses classic Xposed API:

compileOnly "de.robv.android.xposed:api:82"

✔ Runs fully under LSPosed
✔ No system partition changes

✅ Requirements
- Rooted Android device
- LSPosed (or compatible Xposed implementation)
- Lenovo ZUI / ZUXOS-based ROM where hotspot is disabled artificially but still present in SystemUI/Settings

🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest APK from the Releases page.
2. Install the APK like a normal app.
3. Open LSPosed.
4. In Modules, enable ZUI Hotspot Fix.
5. In Scopes, enable:
- com.android.systemui
- com.android.settings
6. Reboot the device.

✅ Expected behavior

After successful installation and reboot:
- The Hotspot tile should appear in Quick Settings (or become selectable in the tile editor).
- The Tethering / Hotspot page should be visible in Settings (if your ROM still includes that UI).

⚠️ Known limitations
- Tested only on Lenovo Idea Tab Pro, ZUXOS 1.5.10.060 (Android 16), China → global conversion.
- Other devices / ROMs may:
- Use different class or method names.
- Include additional OEM region or feature checks.
- Future firmware updates may change SystemUI or Settings internals and break the hooks.

This module cannot restore features whose UI and code have been fully removed from the ROM.

🛠️ Troubleshooting

Module not visible in LSPosed
- Check that the app is installed.
- Ensure xposedmodule and xposedminversion meta-data are present in AndroidManifest.xml.
- Reinstall the module if needed.

Hotspot tile still missing
- Confirm com.android.systemui is enabled in the module scope.
- Open LSPosed logs and look for HotspotFix / ZuiHotspotFix messages to confirm hooks ran.

Settings page still hidden
- Confirm com.android.settings is enabled in the module scope.
- Some ROMs remove the Settings UI entirely; this module cannot recreate deleted screens.

🔐 Safety
- No system files or partitions are modified.
- All changes happen at runtime in app processes via LSPosed hooks.
- Uninstalling the module and rebooting restores stock behavior.

This is still a root-level modification — use it responsibly.

🙏 Credits
- LSPosed / Xposed developers for the framework and APIs.
- Lenovo / ZUXOS firmware as the base system.

👤 Author

Xeno (GitHub: @Xeno761)

modules.name: Face Biometric Fix
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Face Biometric Fix
modules.readme:
FaceBiometricFix

一个面向 ColorOS（OPPO/一加/真我）的 Xposed / LSPosed 模块，用于修正系统人脸传感器上报的非标准强度值（4095），使其被识别为标准 Class 3（强认证）强度，从而让面容解锁能够正常用于应用的 BiometricPrompt。

背景

Android中生物识别分为三个安全级，Class1(4095,最弱),Class2(255,弱)，Class3(15,强)

ColorOS 的人脸传感器向 system_server 上报 4095。因此当普通应用通过 BiometricPrompt 请求 Class 3 强认证（如网银、密码管理器）甚至CLass2弱认证时，系统判定人脸强度不足（STATUS_INSUFFICIENT_STRENGTH），面容解锁不会被纳入可选认证方式。

功能
- 在 system_server 中hook PreAuthInfo 的资格预检流程，将普通应用请求的 4095 人脸强度修改为标准 Class 3 强度（15）。
- 仅影响普通 App 的预检调用链，SystemUI、系统锁屏等路径仍保持 ColorOS 原生实现不变。
- 排除 com.coloros.codebook 等系统应用，(尽量)避免影响系统自带的认证判定。

工作原理

1. com.android.server.biometrics.PreAuthInfo#getStatusForBiometricAuthenticator
   system_server 内部执行强度判定时无法可靠取得原始调用者的 UID，因此利用 PreAuthInfo 的参数把调用上下文（opPackageName）记录到 ThreadLocal 中，供后续判定使用。

2. com.android.server.biometrics.Utils#isAtLeastStrength
   当检测到处于普通 App 的预检查调用链、传感器强度为 4095、且请求的是强认证（15）或弱认证（255）时，直接返回 true；其余所有路径沿用 ColorOS 原生实现。

兼容性
- 系统：ColorOS（OPPO / 一加 / 真我），LSPosed。
- 框架要求：需支持现代 libxposed API 102（io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0）的 LSPosed 框架。
- 构建环境：AGP 9.3.2、Gradle 9.5.0、compileSdk 36、minSdk 35、targetSdk 36。
- 仅在 oneplus ace3v + coloros 16 测试通过

构建

./gradlew :app:assembleRelease

或直接使用 Android Studio 打开项目。

生成的 APK 位于 app/build/outputs/apk/release/。

安装与使用

1. 安装编译出的 APK（可能需关闭系统签名校验或使用支持的方式安装模块 APK）。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用本模块（固定作用域已声明为系统框架 system）。
3. 首次启用请重启系统；后续覆盖更新模块支持 system_server 热重载（autoHotReload=true），无需再次重启。
4. 在任意使用 BiometricPrompt 的应用中即可看到面容解锁选项。

说明与免责声明
- 本模块通过 Hook 系统进程实现，存在风险，请掌握基本救砖操作；
- Vibe Coding而成，能用就行；
- 不同 ColorOS 版本的系统内部实现可能有所差异，如失效可查看 Xposed 日志（Tag：FaceBiometricFix）定位原因。
- 本项目仅供学习研究使用，请自行评估风险。

许可证

本项目基于 GNU General Public License v3.0 开源发布。

CI 自动构建与发布

项目通过 GitHub Actions 在推送时自动构建：
- 推送到 main 分支：自动构建 Release APK（以 debug 密钥签名），并作为构建产物（Artifact）上传，可在 Actions 页面下载。
- **推送 v* 标签**（如 v1.0.0）：自动构建、签名，并创建 GitHub Release 附上 APK。

使用方法：在仓库页面点击 *Create a new release*，输入类似 v1.0.0 的标签，即可触发自动构建并生成 Release。

modules.name: Fermata Auto Enabler
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: Fermata Auto Enabler
modules.readme:
Fermata Auto Enabler

An Xposed module that makes sideloaded Fermata Auto
visible in Android Auto.

Android Auto hides apps that did not come from the Play Store. This module reports the Play
Store as Fermata Auto's install source, but only inside the Android Auto process. Every other
app on the device still sees the true install source, and it does not matter how Fermata Auto
was installed — pm install, a file manager, or anything else.

Tested on Android 16 (SDK 36) with Android Auto 17.5 and the Vector framework (API 102). It
should work on LSPosed too; it uses only the classic Xposed API.

Requirements
- Root, and an Xposed framework: Vector,
  LSPosed, or equivalent.
- Fermata Auto installed.
- Android Auto with developer mode on and Unknown sources enabled
  (Android Auto settings → tap the version 10 times → Developer settings).
  This module does not replace that setting; both are needed.

Install

With Obtainium

By hand

1. Open the latest release
   and download FermataAutoEnabler.apk.
2. Tap the downloaded file and allow the install.

The module is also in the module repository built into LSPosed and Vector, if you would rather
install it from there.

Enable

1. Open your Xposed manager — Vector, LSPosed, or equivalent.
2. Find Fermata Auto Enabler in the module list and switch it on.
3. Open the module's scope and tick Android Auto, and nothing else.
4. Force stop Android Auto so it restarts with the hook in place: Android settings → Apps →
   Android Auto → Force stop. A reboot does the same.
5. Open Android Auto settings → Customize launcher. Fermata Auto is now in the list; tick it.

If Fermata Auto is still missing, check that Unknown sources is on in Android Auto's
developer settings — this module does not replace it. To confirm the module loaded at all, see
the log check in CONTRIBUTING.md.

Scope

Keep this module scoped to Android Auto and nothing else. A wider scope would make other apps
believe the target came from the Play Store, which is both unnecessary and a bad idea.

Spoofing a different app

The target package is a compile-time constant, so a different app needs a rebuild. See
CONTRIBUTING.md.

License

MIT. See LICENSE.
modules.changelog:
First release.

Makes sideloaded Fermata Auto appear in the Android Auto launcher, by correcting the install source that Android Auto reads — inside the Android Auto process only.

Requires root, an Xposed framework (LSPosed, Vector, or equivalent), and Android Auto with developer mode plus Unknown sources enabled.

Install

1. Install the APK.
2. Enable the module and set its scope to Android Auto only.
3. Restart Android Auto.

Confirm it loaded:

adb shell am force-stop com.google.android.projection.gearhead
adb logcat | grep FASpoof

[FASpoof] hooks installed in com.google.android.projection.gearhead:projection
[FASpoof] hooks installed in com.google.android.projection.gearhead:shared
[FASpoof] hooks installed in com.google.android.projection.gearhead:car

Fermata should then appear in Android Auto settings → Customize launcher.

Notes

It does not matter how the target app was installed — pm install, a file manager, or anything else.

The target package is a constant in Main.java; change it to spoof a different app.

Tested on Android 16 (SDK 36), Android Auto 17.5, Vector framework API 102.

modules.name: GhostShare
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: GhostShare
modules.readme:
👻 GhostShare
  System-level privacy shield that strips tracking parameters from copied links in real-time.

✨ Overview

GhostShare is an ultra-lightweight, battery-friendly LSPosed module hooked directly into system_server. It automatically monitors clipboard operations and cleans telemetry, affiliate, and analytical tracking tags from URLs without breaking essential parameters or requiring root background services.

🚀 Key Features
- Zero Overhead ($O(N)$ fast-path): Bypasses non-URL clips instantly; zero battery drain.
- Deep System Hook: Runs securely inside system_server with zero memory leaks (ThreadLocal sanitation).
- Silent & Non-intrusive: 5-second silent notification with an instant Undo button.
- Preserves Media States: Retains crucial parameters like YouTube timestamps (t=, start=) and playlist indexes.
- Material You (Dynamic Colors): Follows system palette, dark/light themes, and edge-to-edge aesthetics.
- Per-app settings: *Enable per-app* cleans links only for the apps you choose, *Bypass Mode* never touches links copied from the apps you choose.
- My Parameters: the tracking-parameter list is data, not code. See, add and remove parameters (a trailing * matches a prefix) or restore the defaults.
- Excluded websites: links from the websites you add (subdomains included) are never changed.
- Update lists: an update button in My Parameters and Excluded websites fetches the latest lists from GhostShare, AdGuard and ClearURLs, or from a link you add yourself (parameters you removed stay removed). Sources can be reordered, and the order is remembered. The network is used only when you tap a source.
- Site rules: per-website rules to always keep or additionally remove specific parameters (for example keep t on one site, or remove foo on another). Rules cover the site and its subdomains, and a keep rule always wins.
- Link test: paste a link inside the app to see the cleaned result and exactly which parameters were removed, using your current settings.
- Quick Settings tile: add the Quick Restore Notification tile to your Quick Settings panel to turn the 5-second restore notification on or off without opening the app.
- JSON backup: export and import your parameters and exceptions through the system file picker, with overwrite or merge on import.
- Redirect links: unwraps wrapper links (l.facebook.com, google.com/url, youtube.com/redirect, out.reddit.com, ...) to the real destination.
- Live changes: every change is applied immediately, no reboot needed (after the first reboot that loads the updated module).

🌐 Supported Platforms
- Instagram: every query parameter is removed, except the functional ones (img_index, story_media_id, next, q)
- YouTube & YouTube Music: si, feature, timestamp preserved
- X (Twitter): s, t, ref_src
- TikTok & Google Analytics: _r, _t, gclid, fbclid
- Reddit & Pinterest
- Spotify & SoundCloud

📥 Installation

1. Install LSPosed Framework.
2. Download and install the latest GhostShare.apk from Releases.
3. Enable GhostShare in LSPosed Manager (Target: System Framework / system_server).
4. Reboot your phone or soft-restart the framework.

📄 License

Copyright (C) 2026 BS1388. Licensed under the GNU GPLv3.

Developed by BS1388

modules.name: GPS Setter
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: GPS Setter
modules.readme:
GPS Setter

An Xposed module that sets your device's location, built on the modern
libxposed API for LSPosed 2.x / Vector.

Fork of jqssun/android-gps-setter,
which builds on Android1500/GpsSetter.

Screenshots

Features
- System-wide spoofing on Android 12+: every location fix (GPS, network, fused)
  is replaced inside the system server, so apps don't need to be scoped one by one.
- Continuous 1 Hz fix generation, so Google Play services apps follow the set
  location with Google Location Accuracy left on, even indoors with no GPS signal.
- Real location during emergencies: while an emergency call/SMS is active
  (Android 14+), real fixes pass through untouched.
- Start, stop and location changes apply immediately, without a reboot.
- Clean stop: pressing Stop clears the fake location from Android and from
  Google Play services, so apps get your real location back straight away.
- Teleport: live status and exact coordinates, paste coordinates from the
  clipboard, a D-pad that nudges the spot by 1, 5 or 10 m, and a jitter slider.
- Routes: multi-stop routes along real roads, with numbered via stops; speed
  presets (walk, run, bike, car) or any speed up to 300 km/h, with optional
  variation; play once, in a loop or back and forth; pause, skip to the next
  stop, and slow down for sharp corners. Speed can be changed while playing.
- Saved: spots and routes in one list with thumbnails; saved routes keep their
  stops; import or paste GPX and GeoJSON tracks, and export routes as GPX.
- Targets: the framework, the processes the module is loaded in, and its
  scope, all managed from the app.
- On-screen joystick to nudge the location live.

Requirements
- Rooted device with LSPosed 2.x or Vector (libxposed API 101+).
  LSPosed 1.x cannot load this module.
- Android 8.1+. System-wide spoofing of live updates needs Android 12+.

Setup

1. Enable GPS Setter in LSPosed and tick System Framework in its scope
   (optionally also tick individual apps).
2. Reboot.
3. Open the app, pick a location on the map and tap Teleport here.

After updating the module, reboot once so the system hook loads the new version.

Notes
- Apps protected by Google Play's anti-tamper (those bundling libpairipcore.so)
  crash if scoped — don't scope them; rely on the system hook.
- Only enable one location-spoofing module at a time.

Source code & issues: https://github.com/varma322/android-gps-setter

The fix only works once you're running 0.4.1. On 0.3.0 or 0.4.0, tapping Update in the app still crashes, so get this version from here or through LSPosed. From 0.4.1 on, in-app updates work.

modules.readme:
I’m Pad / ImPad

适配徽章展示对应应用最近一次结束的正式适配流程和实际检测版本；绿色表示精确候选已通过静态回归及运行验证，不代表其他版本均兼容。

ImPad 是一个 LSPosed 模块，为微信、QQ 和企业微信适配平板登录界面。模块没有独立界面，启用后会在目标应用中生效。

下载
- ImPad 最新版
- LSPosed 模块仓库最新版

请从上述官方来源获取安装包。更新内容可查看发布说明。

安装与升级

设备需运行 Android 9 或更高版本，使用 ARM64（arm64-v8a）架构并已 Root，且已安装并正常运行支持 modern 模块的 LSPosed。

1. 安装 ImPad APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用 ImPad，并为需要适配的应用勾选作用域。
3. 强行停止目标应用，再重新打开。

升级时从官方来源下载新版并安装，然后检查 LSPosed 中的模块状态和作用域，再强行停止并重开目标应用。若安装时出现签名冲突，请先核对安装包来源和设备上已有版本。

常见问题

模块没有图标或独立界面？

这是正常情况。ImPad 通过 LSPosed 在目标应用中运行，请到 LSPosed 启用模块并设置作用域。

启用后没有效果？

检查模块是否已启用、目标应用是否在作用域内，并强行停止后重新打开应用。应用升级或热更新可能影响适配效果。

反馈

请在 GitHub Issues 提交问题，并附上目标应用名称与版本、ImPad 版本、设备 Android 版本、具体现象及相关日志。请勿上传账号凭据、二维码或令牌。

许可证

本项目采用 GPL-3.0-only。第三方组件的许可证见 第三方许可证。

开发、构建与维护说明见开发文档。

modules.readme:
JuiceSSH Offline Pro Fix

Legacy Xposed/LSPosed API 82-compatible module for keeping a legitimate JuiceSSH Pro entitlement usable offline after the original Google/Sonelli verification path disappeared.

Source / 引用来源

This Xposed-Modules-Repo entry republishes the upstream project by li-yifei:
- Upstream repository:
- Upstream author: li-yifei
- Package name: org.lyf.juicesshofflinepro
- Canonical source:

This mirror keeps the original license and source history context through explicit attribution.

中文说明

这是一个面向 LSPosed / Xposed API 82 的旧版模块，用于在 JuiceSSH 原有 Google / Sonelli 联网校验路径失效后，让已经合法购买 JuiceSSH Pro / Pro Pack 的用户继续离线使用对应权益。

适用场景：
- 你过去已经购买过 JuiceSSH Pro 或 Pro Pack
- 现在原有校验接口已经失效
- 你希望在本地继续恢复自己原本拥有的专业版能力

使用边界：
- 该项目面向归档、兼容性恢复、个人自救使用
- 适用于合法拥有权益的用户
- 请自行确认所在地法律、软件许可与平台条款

Disclaimer

This project is intended for archival, interoperability, and personal recovery use by people who legitimately own JuiceSSH Pro / Pro Pack and need continued access after the original app, backend, and Google Play purchase flow became unavailable. Do not use it to obtain paid functionality you did not purchase or are not entitled to. You are responsible for complying with all applicable laws, licenses, and terms in your jurisdiction.

This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Sonelli Ltd., JuiceSSH, Google, LSPosed, or Xposed.

License

This project is licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 or later. See LICENSE.

Release APK

Download the signed APK from GitHub Releases:

JuiceSSHOfflineProFix-v1.0-xposed82-release.apk

Package:

org.lyf.juicesshofflinepro

Compatibility:
- Xposed API 82 / LSPosed legacy module API
- minSdk 26 to match JuiceSSH 3.2.2
- targetSdk 36

Hooks

Recommended LSPosed scope is declared by the module as:

com.sonelli.juicessh

The module hooks:
- com.sonelli.oi0.d(Object) -> true (central Pro check)
- com.sonelli.juicessh.models.User.H() -> true (local user signature gate)
- User.w() -> configurable future session time (prevents dead API refresh)
- com.sonelli.pi0.m(Context) -> true
- com.sonelli.pi0.j(Context, pi0.p) -> calls the callback with the local user instead of forcing the dead network refresh path

Settings

The module includes a minimal native Android settings page with no extra UI libraries. Defaults are suitable for most cases.

After changing settings, force-stop and reopen JuiceSSH. Some LSPosed versions may require a reboot.

Install

adb install -r JuiceSSHOfflineProFix-v1.0-xposed82-release.apk

Then in LSPosed:

1. Enable JuiceSSH Offline Pro Fix.
2. Confirm the scope includes JuiceSSH / com.sonelli.juicessh.
3. Force-stop and reopen JuiceSSH, or reboot.

Build

cd lsposed-juicessh-offline-pro
gradle assembleDebug --no-daemon

This branch uses legacy metadata:
- assets/xposed_init
- AndroidManifest xposedmodule, xposeddescription, xposedminversion=82, xposedscope

The dependency is a local compile-only stub jar:

compileOnly files('libs/xposed-api-82-stub.jar')

The stub is for compilation only and is not packaged into the APK; the actual Xposed classes are provided by LSPosed/Xposed at runtime.

modules.readme:
SSLUnpinner

A LSPosed module to disable SSL Pinning on Android, featuring support for standard Java/Android SSL APIs and Flutter applications.

Support Status
Verified working on:
- Device: Pixel 8
- OS: Android 16
- Root: KernelSU Next
- Xposed Framework: JingMatrix/LSPosed v1.11.0

Usage
1. Install the SSLUnpinner APK.
2. Open LSPosed Manager.
3. Enable the SSLUnpinner module.
4. Select the target applications you wish to apply the bypass to in the module scope.
5. Restart the target application.

Features
- Standard SSL Bypass: Hooks common Java/Android SSL verification methods (TrustManager, HostnameVerifier, etc.) to accept all certificates.
- Flutter Patching: Supports runtime patching of libflutter.so to disable mandatory TLS verification.
- Automatically intercepts Flutter library loading.
- Scans for ssl_verify_peer_cert byte patterns across multiple architectures (ARM64, ARM32, x86, x64).
- Creates a patched copy in the app's cache and loads it dynamically.

Credits & Acknowledgments
- Flutter Patching: Byte patterns and logic adapted from NVISOsecurity/disable-flutter-tls-verification.
- Android Hooks: Implementation inspired by popular Frida scripts:
- frida-multiple-unpinning (@akabe1)
- frida-multiple-bypass (@fdciabdul)

modules.description: MiclawApiBridge
modules.readme:
MiclawApiBridge

把小米超级小爱 (com.aios.osbot) 的 AI 能力暴露为本机 OpenAI 兼容 HTTP API 的 Xposed 模块（LibXposed API 102）。
v2.1: 模块主动请求 root 授权 + 免重启即时生效。服务启动自动触发 su 授权弹窗；设置页「立即授权 Root」按钮 / GET /v1/admin/root 可在不重启的情况下重新请求授权。
需 root (Magisk/KernelSU)，授权 com.aios.osbot 后即时生效。

✨ 功能
- OpenAI 兼容: POST /v1/chat/completions（流式 SSE + 非流式）、/v1/completions、/v1/chat
- 多模态识图: 图片 URL / base64 / 本地路径
- 多轮会话: user/chat_id 控制上下文，/v1/chat/reset 重置
- JSON 模式 + temperature/max_tokens 映射
- 代码执行: POST /v1/exec（root，shell/python，强制 Token）
- 管理: /v1/admin/status（含 root 状态）/ /v1/admin/logs / /v1/admin/reload
- 设置界面: 端口 / Token / LLM 代理 / 路由表 / 限流 / Root 状态显示
- 稳健性: 限流 / 失败自动重试 / 端口自动避让 / 双保险启动 / 固定签名

⚠️ 首次使用必做（注入不生效的 90% 原因）

1. LSPosed 启用模块 + 作用域勾选 com.aios.osbot
2. 给 root 权限：KernelSU/Magisk → 超级用户 → 允许 com.aios.osbot（不是只装模块就行！）
3. 必须重启超级小爱：强制停止 → 重新打开（或重启手机）
- 权限刚授予时模块可能不会立刻注入，重启后才会生效
- 判断标准：打开模块设置页，看到「● 服务运行中」+「🔑 Root: 可用」
已验证：注入不了 = 权限没走通 或 权限作用了但没重启。与模块代码无关。

🔑 Root 要求
- 设备已 root（Magisk / KernelSU）
- Magisk/KernelSU 授权列表 允许 com.aios.osbot 使用 su（首次弹窗选允许）
- 无 root 时模块仍可提供对话 API，仅 /v1/exec 代码执行受限

📱 使用
1. 安装 APK（若装过旧版请先卸载，签名已变更）
2. LSPosed 启用模块，作用域勾选 com.aios.osbot
3. 打开模块图标：确认服务运行 + Root 状态
4. 重启超级小爱

🔌 接入
Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1

modules.name: NeXtep
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: NeXtep
modules.readme:
NeXtep — A Tribute to and Continuation of OneStep

  English / 中文

   
   
   
   

English

NeXtep is an LSPosed module that adds a native side workspace to ColorOS 16 / 17 while keeping the stock launcher. It provides one main window and three live task slots, with task switching, drag-and-drop, workspace monitoring, and customizable app shortcuts integrated into SystemUI.

The project primarily targets OnePlus PLK110, previously verified on Android 16 / ColorOS 16. Recent feature and compatibility testing is based on Android 17 / ColorOS 17. It relies on private Android and ColorOS behavior, so other devices, ROM versions, and vendor launchers require adaptation.

Stable channel: 2.2.1. Development builds are maintained on beta; published APKs are available from GitHub Releases.

Download and release notes · Demo video on Bilibili

Features · Energy monitoring · Requirements · Installation · Workspace controls · External commands · Behavior switches

Features

Workspace and layout
- Stock launcher: keeps the ColorOS launcher without registering a replacement HOME app, with adaptations for launcher shortcut menus, desktop search, and the assistant panel.
- One main window and three live slots: keep several app tasks visible together and move whole tasks between the main window and slots.
- Left and right layouts: switch the slot sidebar using the layout buttons in the control area.
- Portrait and both landscape orientations: keep the control area and three slots in their layout relative to the phone while the main app follows system rotation. The embedded video can follow the screen direction independently, without moving the control area or rebuilding the slot layout.
- Navigation-button adaptation: optionally fit the main window and slots around the system navigation bar. Enable it for three-button navigation and disable it for gesture navigation; after changing the system navigation mode, toggle the option again.
- Task retention: restore eligible slot tasks that remain in the system when closing and reopening the workspace. Locking pauses slot output; unlocking restores the workspace with its tasks.
- System integration: coexists with native floating windows above the workspace panels, and includes adaptations for keyboard focus, notification shade and Control Center interaction, brightness controls, and video-window sizing.

Task management

| Action | How to use it |
|--------|---------------|
| Put the main app in a slot | With a regular app in the main window, tap the + in an empty slot. |
| Add from Recents | Center the desired task card in system Recents, then tap an empty slot's +. Recents stays open so you can add more apps. Exit split screen before adding a grouped split-screen card. |
| Exchange a slot with the main window | Tap an occupied slot, or long-press it and drag it onto the main window. |
| Move or exchange slots | Long-press an occupied slot and drag it onto an empty slot to move, or another occupied slot to exchange. Drop targets are highlighted during dragging. |
| Open an app in the main window | Tap its icon in the app strip. |
| Add from the app strip | Long-press an app icon and drag it onto the target slot. |
| Move a slot app to the background | Swipe outward: left for left-side slots, right for right-side slots. No long press is needed. This gesture can be disabled in Settings. |
| Move to the background by dragging | Long-press a slot and drag it onto the control area; release when Release to move to background appears. This remains available when swipe dismissal is disabled. |

Moving a slot app to the background frees the slot while retaining its task and leaving the main window unchanged. Opening an app from the launcher when it already occupies a slot exchanges it with the main window.

The optional Park the previous main app when switching setting moves the previous main app into an empty slot when switching from the app strip. If no empty slot is available, the app switch proceeds normally. It is disabled by default.

Recent tasks
- Swipe right from Controls to open Tasks. Tap a card to restore it in the main window, or long-press and drag it into a slot.
- Swipe up on a card to close it. Swipe down to toggle its ColorOS background lock.
- Swipe up with two fingers to clear background tasks. Locked tasks and apps in use in the workspace are preserved.

Cross-window sharing

Drag text, images, or files from the main app onto an occupied slot to open the receiving app’s share screen. Return to the source app after sharing brings back the original app when the share flow ends. Block system drag suggestions in the workspace keeps the ColorOS suggestions bar from taking over the drag.

App strip and cloned apps
- Automatic ordering: arrange app shortcuts by recent usage; this is the default mode.
- Manual ordering: choose up to 36 apps, remove shortcuts, and long-press selected entries to reorder them.
- System app clones: show cloned apps in the app strip and manual selection list, with clone labels to distinguish them from the original apps.

Gestures and app exclusions
- Four-finger gesture: pinch four fingers together to enter the workspace and spread them apart to exit. It is enabled by default and can be switched independently of the status-bar gesture.
- Game exclusion: enabled by default. Four-finger gestures are suspended when a system-recognized game is in the foreground or any workspace slot.
- App blacklist: select apps by icon and name, with a checkbox on the right. Four-finger gestures are suspended while a selected app or its system clone is in the foreground or a slot. The list is empty by default.

These exclusions apply to the four-finger gesture. Other workspace entry points remain available.

Workspace monitoring

In Settings → Top content → Workspace monitoring, choose up to nine of 42 readings and use Restore defaults to reset the grid...
modules.changelog:
English

NeXtep v2.2.1 adds a way to hide workspace monitoring and improves picture-in-picture controls, Recent Tasks animations, and the icon-jumping game.

Updates
- Workspace monitoring: The new Hide button leaves the monitoring area blank and stops sampling. Select Show to restore your previous metrics.
- Picture-in-picture: The upper video area recognizes more play and pause actions. A progress bar appears when the player reports the duration and current position. Dragging is available when the player supports seeking.
- ColorOS Recent Tasks animations: Improved position and scaling when switching between the workspace main window and Recent Tasks.
- Game obstacles: Obstacle icons are randomly selected from a wider range of installed apps. Icon size and stacking have also been adjusted.

Requirements
- A supported device running Android 16 / ColorOS 16 or Android 17 / ColorOS 17.
- Root access.
- Zygisk and an LSPosed version compatible with the modern libxposed API.
- Development primarily targets OnePlus PLK110. The preceding beta's monitoring controls were tested on Android 17 / ColorOS 17. The 2.2.1 APK was built and its release signature verified.

Installation

1. Download and install the APK attached to this release.
2. Enable NeXtep in LSPosed.
3. Select the recommended module scopes for your device.
4. Restart your device.

QQ feedback group: 1128561895

中文

NeXtep v2.2.1 新增工作区监测隐藏功能，并改进画中画控件和最近任务动画。

更新内容
- 工作区监测新增「隐藏」按钮。隐藏后监测区直接留空并停止采样，点击「显示」可恢复原来的指标配置。
- 改善上方视频区的画中画兼容性，支持识别更多播放／暂停动作。播放器提供时长和当前位置时即可显示进度条，支持跳转时才可拖动。
- 优化 ColorOS 最近任务卡片动画，改善工作区主窗口与最近任务之间切换时的位置和缩放衔接。
- 障碍图标改为从更多已安装应用中随机选取，并调整了图标大小和叠放层数。

使用要求
- 已适配设备上的 Android 16 / ColorOS 16 或 Android 17 / ColorOS 17。
- 已取得 Root 权限。
- 已启用 Zygisk，并安装支持新版 libxposed API 的 LSPosed。
- 主要适配一加 PLK110。此前 Beta 的监测控件已在 Android 17 / ColorOS 17 上验证。2.2.1 APK 已完成构建并通过发布签名校验。

安装方法

1. 下载并安装本次发布附带的 APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 中启用 NeXtep。
3. 勾选适用于当前设备的推荐模块作用域。
4. 重启设备。

QQ 反馈群：1128561895

modules.name: OxygenOS 16 OTA Blocker
modules.author: XxxY
modules.description: Blocks OTA updates on OxygenOS 16
modules.readme:
OxygenOS 16 OTA Blocker

Root module that completely stops OxygenOS 16 from downloading, nagging
about, or flashing system updates — with an on/off toggle right on the
module card.

Compatibility

Device-specific: OxygenOS 16 / ColorOS 16 (OnePlus, OPPO) only. It
targets the oplus OTA components listed below; on any other ROM every
target is simply skipped and the module does nothing. Verified on a
OnePlus 15 (OxygenOS 16, ROW).

What it removes

| Component | Package | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| /system_ext/app/OTA | com.oplus.ota | The Software Update app — the only client of update_engine, i.e. the thing that actually flashes firmware |
| /system_ext/app/SystemAppUpdateService | com.oplus.sau | Silent background updates of OnePlus system apps |
| /system_ext/app/SAUHelper | com.oplus.sauhelper | Helper for the above |
| /product/priv-app/Cota | com.oplus.cota | Carrier/regional customization payloads |
| /product/priv-app/NOTIFICATION | com.cota.notification | COTA nag notifications (not present on all firmwares) |
| /product/app/RomUpdate | com.oplus.romupdate | Online configuration updates |

Missing directories are skipped gracefully, so regional firmware
differences are fine. update_engine itself is left alone — it is
passive and has no remaining client. Google Play system updates
(Mainline) are deliberately not touched.

Blocking works in two layers:

1. Mount layer — the app directories are whiteouted (KernelSU/APatch)
   or .replace-overlaid (Magisk) at boot.
2. pm fallback — service.sh disables any OTA package still visible
   after boot (e.g. com.oplus.ota surviving as an updated copy in
   /data).

Toggle from the module card

The module ships an action.sh, so KernelSU / APatch / Magisk 28+
managers show an Action button on the module card:
- Activate — takes effect immediately (packages are pm-disabled on
  the spot; mount-hiding completes at the next reboot).
- Deactivate — pm-visible packages come back immediately; apps hidden
  by the boot-time mount return after a reboot.

The card's description line always shows the current state
(✅ OTA blocking ON / ⭕ OTA blocking OFF), including a reboot hint
when one is needed. The state persists across reboots.

WebUI

On KernelSU / APatch managers with WebUI support, the module card also
offers Open WebUI: a status page showing whether blocking is on,
the live state of every targeted directory (hidden / pending reboot /
restored) and OTA package (disabled / enabled / not present), a one-tap
toggle, and the output of the last toggle run. The toggle drives the
same action.sh as the Action button, so both stay in sync.

Install

Flash the release zip in your root manager (KernelSU, APatch, or
Magisk 24+; the Action button needs Magisk 28+), then reboot.

Uninstall

Remove the module in your manager. OTA packages are automatically
re-enabled — immediately on KernelSU/APatch, or right after the next
boot completes on Magisk — and the hidden apps return on reboot.

Build

./build.sh          # produces build/oxygenos16-ota-blocker-vX.Y.Z.zip
./release.sh patch  # bump version, build, commit, tag

Pushing a v* tag triggers the GitHub Actions release workflow.

License

GPL-3.0-or-later. See LICENSE.

modules.readme:
Pulp · 番茄 UI 自定义
  Pulp 6.0 · versionCode 100 · LSPosed 模块

一款为 番茄免费小说 打造的界面优化与美化模块。

支持液态玻璃与全局分级玻璃视觉定制、精简页面模块与入口、阅读器广告与短剧推广拦截、系统级桌面卡片弹窗屏蔽、本地 VIP 状态与书籍编号工具。共提供 90 项独立可调设置（82 个布尔开关 + 8 个整型参数），默认向后兼容，可按需自由组合。

✨ Pulp 6.0 更新亮点
- 液态玻璃底栏（Android 13+）：支持悬浮、贴底、液态三种样式；液态模式具备静息柔雾药丸、整条底栏按压微膨胀、滑块果冻形变与可调 Q 弹度（0–100%），修复切页串屏、开关书闪白、隐藏 Tab 幽灵点击及书架多选编辑栏重叠穿透问题。
- 全局分级玻璃与推荐榜增强（Android 12+）：支持推荐流书卡文字区封面氛围模糊、书城/「我的」页顶部组件可选液态玻璃、推荐榜固定磨砂与自定义底图替换（支持跨进程热更新与一键恢复默认）；新增「推荐榜多列均分铺满」与「推荐榜边缘轻微羽化」独立开关，消除推荐榜左右竖状白边与顶部搜索栏下沿浅青色截断线。
- 阅读器短剧推广与桌面卡片拦截：新增阅读器内段间与整页短剧推广的排版前模型与请求门拦截（避免正文留白），及阅读器短剧推广挂件拦截；增强「禁止添加桌面卡片提示」，前置拦截宿主系统级桌面卡片创建与厂商订阅卡权限引导。
- 「我的」页面与性能优化：新增「隐藏会员中心」与平板专属「隐藏我的催更」，修复平板布局转发与 7.4.x 九宫格隐藏问题；优化冷启动与列表滑动性能（关闭总开关跳过业务热 Hook、非基线符号表按当前版本懒加载、移除全局 View.draw 拦截与滚动期全树扫描）。
- 多版本符号适配：按宿主包名与 versionCode 路由独立符号映射表，覆盖国内版 4 个版本与 Google Play 版 2 个版本。
- Compose 界面打磨：15 个功能页一级分类全部重绘独立线性图标，修复进入二级分类返回后列表滚回顶部的问题。

📱 兼容性要求

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| 目标应用 | 番茄免费小说 |
| 应用包名 | com.dragon.read / com.dragon.read.oversea.gp |
| 适配版本 | 国内 7.3.9.32 / 7.4.1.32 / 7.4.3.32 / 7.4.5.32；谷歌 7.3.9.32 / 7.4.1.33 |
| Android 版本 | Android 9 及以上（全局玻璃需 Android 12+，液态玻璃底栏需 Android 13+） |
| 框架要求 | 支持 libxposed API 102 的 LSPosed 框架（亦支持免 Root 内嵌框架后备通道） |
| 模块包名 | io.github.mianxyz.fanqiecustomizer |

适配说明： 模块按包名与 versionCode 匹配对应符号表（国内 7.3.9.32 保留原符号直通），全部已登记的类、方法、字段与资源均经过真实 APK DEX 与资源表静态核验。各版本实机覆盖与已知边界记录在 CHANGELOG.md 中；静态定义存在不代表未实测场景已 100% 验证。

🧩 功能列表

🪟 界面美化与玻璃视觉
- 底部导航栏玻璃：支持「悬浮玻璃 / 贴底玻璃 / 液态玻璃」三种形态，提供不透明度、模糊强度、圆角、左右边距、底部间距、悬浮底栏长度（50–100%）与液态滑块 Q 弹度（0–100%）精细调节，支持横向滑动切页。
- 全局玻璃：
- 书籍文字区封面氛围模糊玻璃。
- 搜索栏、卡片与弹窗分级玻璃。
- 书城搜索与分类按钮、「我的」页顶部组件可选液态玻璃。
- 推荐榜底部固定毛玻璃，支持选择自定义底图（跨进程热更新）与一键恢复默认磨砂。
- 推荐榜边缘轻微透明羽化（默认关闭，开启全局玻璃即自动清除宿主左右竖状白边）。
- 推荐榜多列均分铺满（默认关闭，平板宽屏按需开启，手机端保持原生每页 8 本横向滑动）。
- 顶部与交互：书城顶部滚动羽化、下拉刷新二次确认防误触、沉浸隐藏状态栏。

🏠 首页与书城
- 分别隐藏底部导航入口（自动保留至少一个可用入口）。
- 自定义默认启动的底部导航页。
- 分别隐藏 11 个书城频道（自动保留至少一个可用频道，单频道自动折叠频道栏）。
- 隐藏顶部搜索栏。
- 禁止添加桌面卡片提示（覆盖宿主路由及系统级创建卡片/厂商订阅卡权限引导）。
- 隐藏福利浮动图标、发帖快捷按钮、自动短剧续播浮窗。

📚 书架
- 自动展开全部书籍。
- 隐藏金币相关控件。
- 书架多选编辑模式自动暂停并隐藏玻璃底栏，确保底部操作按钮正常点击不穿透。

👤 我的页面

支持分别隐藏：
- 收益记录与收益卡片。
- 常玩游戏。
- 10 项功能入口：我的订单、浏览记录、我的消息、创作中心、我的预约、我的点赞、我的下载、游戏中心、反馈与帮助、会员中心（保留「我的书币」）。

平板布局（sw >= 600dp）还可分别隐藏 9 项专属入口：
- 视频创作、兴趣偏好、我的笔记、看过的人、番茄指南、我的钱包、活动中心、我的公益、我的催更。

📖 阅读界面与广告净化
- 屏蔽启动开屏广告。
- 隐藏已适配的阅读广告组件（含阅读器段间与整页短剧推广前置拦截，避免正文留白）。
- 屏蔽阅读页直播弹窗。
- 隐藏原生横幅广告及其占位区域（含阅读器短剧推广挂件）。
- 隐藏章节末尾免广告入口、快捷听书入口、章末小游戏入口。
- 免广告无限听书与自动阅读不中断（本地授权判断）。

🔎 书籍编号工具与实用功能
- 显示并一键复制书籍内部编号，支持通过编号搜索直达书籍及应用内工具入口。
- 本地 VIP 状态判断（仅影响本地逻辑）。
- 显示接口返回的原始阅读计数字段。
- 诊断已发现的 AB 配置名称、输出功能命中日志。
- 关闭自动更新弹窗、隐藏或恢复桌面模块图标。

💝 赞赏
- 如果觉得我做的还不错的话，就给我买杯奶茶吧(＾∇＾)🧋

🔌 免 Root 安装（LSPatch / FPA）

除标准 LSPosed 外，模块同时兼容内嵌进宿主 APK 的免 Root 框架。两条通道并存，互不影响：

| 顺序 | 通道 | 何时使用 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | XposedService 远程偏好 / 远端文件 | 标准 LSPosed / Root 环境，主通道 |
| 2 | SettingsProvider（io.github.mianxyz.fanqiecustomizer.settings） | 内嵌框架，同步读取配置与只读推荐榜底图，首启即生效 |
| 3 | SettingsResponder 有序广播 | Provider 不可用时的第二顺位 |
| 4 | EmbeddedPrefs 共享文件 | 前两者均不可用时的最后一层后备 |

Hook 侧仅在远程偏好完全为空时回退 2→3→4，避免 Root 环境下旧文件覆盖框架最新配置。全部 90 项设置均通过白名单校验同步，模块自身外观主题键 glass_level 留在本地不同步。

功能限制说明：
- 广告隐藏仅覆盖已适配的组件与推广位，不保证屏蔽全部未知或服务端新增动态广告模板。
- 原始阅读计数字段由服务器下发，不代表实时真实在读人数。
- 下架书籍能否访问取决于服务端状态及本地缓存。
- 本地 VIP 判断不会开通服务端会员权益。
- 免广告送爱发电礼物功能暂未加入。

🔒 隐私说明

模块不包含任何网络请求、数据上报或用户行为统计代码。

诊断日志仅记录受限的技术类名、已登记配置名称与布局指标，不主动输出：
- 书籍名称或书籍编号。
- 用户账号与个人敏感信息。
- 完整异常堆栈正文或原始 Intent 数据。

🎨 设置界面（Kotlin + Jetpack Compose）

设置界面基于 Kotlin + Jetpack Compose（Material 3 Expressive）构建，通过 ConfigBridge 与 Java Hook 层共享同一份 SharedPreferences("settings") 及 SettingsApp.sync() 同步通道；自定义推荐榜底图以私有压缩文件 + 内容 SHA-256 修订号形式经 libxposed API 102 远端文件（或 SettingsProvider 后备）跨进程传输，不向宿主传递相册临时 URI。

视觉规范

| 项目 | 实现 |
|---|---|
| 层级 | 页面底 surfaceContainer → 卡片 surfaceContainerLowest，无投影、无硬边框，仅靠明度差分层 |
| 强调色 | 番茄橙 #EF5B33（深色模式 #FF8A65），仅用于开关、图标高亮与激活态 |
| 圆角 | 分组卡片 RoundedCornerShape(24.dp)；徽章、标签与分段器为全圆角胶囊 |
| 异形组件 | 首页状态徽章采用 12 瓣花瓣波浪圆（ScallopedShape） |
| 进度 | M3 Expressive LinearWavyProgressIndicator 表示框架连接状态 |
| 导航 | 悬浮胶囊底栏，激活项带药丸高亮并展开文字；功能页一级列表保留返回滚动位置 |

| 界面玻璃 | 主题页提供「无 / 标准 / 极致」三档（默认「无」），基于 Haze 叠加实时模糊与高光描边 |

🛠️ 构建与测试

Gradle 构建（推荐）

$env:JAVA_HOME    = 'C:\Program Files\Zulu\zulu-25'   # JDK 21+
$env:ANDROID_HOME = ''                 # 需安装 platform 37 与 build-tools 37.0.0
.\gradlew.bat :app:assembleDebug

产物位于 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk。

Release 签名配置

Release 签名信息从本地 local.properties 读取（已由 .gitignore 忽略，密钥不进入仓库）：

tests/ 下包含 57 个独立纯 Java 测试类（无 JUnit 依赖），覆盖 90 键默认值与同步白名单契约、121 项符号解析检查、UI 图标唯一性与滚动状态契约、液态弹簧数值收敛性、多版本反射过滤以及冻结源码等价校验。

$androidJar = Get-ChildItem $sdk -Recurse -Filter android.jar | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName
$cp = "$androidJar;libs\api-102.0.0.jar;libs\service-102.0.0.jar;libs\interface-102.0.0.jar"

& "$jdk\bin\javac.exe" --release 17 -encoding UTF-8 -cp $cp -d build\classes (Get-ChildItem src -Recurse -Filter *.java)
.\test.ps1 -SdkRoot $sdk -JdkRoot $jdk

modules.name: WiFi Country Code
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: WiFi Country Code
modules.readme:
WiFi Country Code

An Xposed module to modify the Wi-Fi country code on Android devices, allowing you to bypass regional restrictions on Wi-Fi channels.

Features
- Override the Wi-Fi country code with any ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code
- Enable/disable the hook dynamically without rebooting the framework
- Real-time module activation status detection and configuration sync via LibXposed RemotePreferences
- Quick select common country codes (US, CN, JP, GB, DE)
- Material Design 3 UI built with Jetpack Compose

Requirements
- Android 10 (API 29) or above
- Rooted device with an Xposed framework supporting LibXposed API 102+ (e.g., Vector)

Installation

1. Download the latest APK from Releases
2. Install the APK on your device
3. Enable the module in your Xposed framework manager
4. Ensure System Framework (system) is selected as the scope
5. Reboot your device

Usage

1. Open the app and navigate to the Configuration tab
2. Toggle Enable Hook to activate the module
3. Enter a two-letter country code (e.g., US, CN, JP, GB) or use the quick select buttons
4. Tap Save to apply and sync the configuration

How It Works

The module runs within system_server using LibXposed API 102 and hooks into com.android.server.wifi.WifiCountryCode. Configuration is dynamically read and synchronized via LibXposed RemotePreferences.

The module overrides the following methods in WifiCountryCode:

Setter & Update Methods:
- setTelephonyCountryCode — intercepts telephony country code changes and forces the target country code
- setOverrideCountryCode — overrides manual country code overrides
- setDriverCountryCode — intercepts direct driver country code settings
- updateCountryCode — forces the target country code during updates

Getter Methods:
- pickCountryCode — returns the configured target country code
- getCountryCode — returns the configured target country code
- getCurrentDriverCountryCode — returns the configured target country code
- getDriverCountryCode — returns the configured target country code
- getConnectingModeCountryCode — returns the target country code during connection mode setup

This effectively forces the Wi-Fi subsystem to operate under the specified country regulatory domain, unlocking Wi-Fi channels that may be restricted in your region.

Tech Stack
- Language: Kotlin
- UI: Jetpack Compose with Material Design 3
- Xposed API: LibXposed API 102 & LibXposed Service
- Serialization: kotlinx-serialization-json
- Build: AGP 9.x, Gradle Kotlin DSL

License

This project is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.

Author

mirukurusan
- GitHub: https://github.com/mirukurusan
- Project: https://github.com/mirukurusan/WifiCountryCode

modules.name: x-adfree
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: x-adfree
modules.readme:
X AdFree

English

面向 X Android 客户端的 LSPosed 去广告模块，基于 libxposed Modern API 102 与 DexKit 运行时动态解析。

功能
- 去除首页时间线（For You / Following）广告。
- 去除帖子详情页和评论区广告。
- 通过目标数据模型（URT promoted metadata、entryId 前缀、应用自身广告判定）三态识别广告；不确定的内容一律放行，以此尽量避免误删正常帖子（不承诺绝对零误删）。
- 在 URT 数据层单一汇聚点过滤，所有消费时间线的界面同时受益，不依赖具体界面布局。
- 运行时用 DexKit 按字符串指纹、方法签名、类型形状多特征定位目标方法，按目标应用安装身份缓存解析结果；下一次启动直接命中缓存，无需重新解析。
- 内置运行时见证（witness）校验：钩子安装后首次真实调用必须符合 URT 数据形状，否则自动卸载自己并使缓存失效，杜绝误钩非目标方法。
- 不修改 X APK，不拦截网络请求，也不包含后台服务、轮询、WakeLock 或 Frida 代码。唯一打包的 native 库是 DexKit 自带的 libdexkit.so，仅在解析阶段使用。

兼容性

| 项目 | 要求 |
| --- | --- |
| 目标应用 | 面向 X 12.x 小版本动态适配，当前真机验证 12.17.0-release.0（12.3.1 仅作为历史兼容种子保留，未在 2.0.x 架构上重新实测） |
| Android | 9.0（API 28）及以上 |
| 框架 | 支持 libxposed Modern API 102 的官方 LSPosed |
| 模块版本 | 2.0.2（versionCode 21） |

模块按"特征指纹 + 形状校验 + 运行时见证"解析目标，而非硬编码类名表。小版本通杀的工程定义：普通 X 小版本升级不需要维护逐版本 Hook 表；当业务语义和调用结构仍可识别时，通过运行时 DexKit + Verifier + Witness 自动重新定位目标；遇到大版本或业务架构代际变化时，允许重新分析最新版并更新 Resolver/指纹。不承诺对未来任意版本零维护。若 X 未来重构导致指纹全部失效，模块会以失效安全（fail-open）方式放弃过滤并保留 X 正常可用。

X 11.82.0 之后包含 libpairipcore.so。使用本模块前，需要在官方 LSPosed 的“设置 → 还原内联钩子”中勾选 X（com.twitter.android），否则 X 可能在冷启动时终止进程。

工作原理（简述）

1. X 主进程启动时，模块记录安装身份（包名、APK 及 split 尺寸、签名证书哈希、versionCode），形成稳定 token；versionCode 只用于缓存失效，不参与业务分支。
2. 首次运行：DexKit 按 7 个 discovery 入口（5 个高熵业务字符串、结构入口、历史种子）定位 URT emit 钩子点，候选按正交特征打分；分数不足或存在歧义时，最多 5 个候选先挂只读探针，观察到 ≥2 次真实调用且元素形状占比达标才晋升。时间线模型接口与应用广告判定方法并行解析。
3. 应用自身的广告判定（boolean helper）在运行时语义见证通过之前只以低于删除阈值的权重参与评分——单个被错误解析的 helper 不可能独立删除正常内容；见证发现矛盾时立即禁用该 helper。
4. 解析结果按身份写入缓存（原子替换、LRU 上限）；此后每次启动先逐目标验证缓存仍可加载且形状正确，才复用（缓存与全新解析使用同一套验证规则）。
5. 钩子安装后由运行时见证校验首个真实数据形状，不符时真实卸载钩子并使该缓存条目失效；广告判定三态评分，仅移除确定性广告，不确定内容一律放行。过滤只替换 ArrayList 输出，未知 List 实现直接放行（fail-open）。
6. 引导状态机单线程串行化，READY/DEGRADED 终态冻结；20 秒引导watchdog只覆盖解析阶段，探针观察期有独立的 30 秒期限，互不干扰。

详细分析（指纹矩阵、状态机、discovery 矩阵）见 docs/analysis-12.17.0.md。

安装

1. 从 GitHub Releases 下载并安装 APK。
2. 在 LSPosed 的“还原内联钩子”设置中确认已勾选 X。
3. 在 LSPosed 中启用 X AdFree；静态作用域只包含 X。
4. 强制停止 X 后重新打开。首次启动会进行一次 DexKit 解析（约 1 秒），之后启动直接命中缓存（几十毫秒内生效）。

模块没有设置页面，开关、作用域和“还原内联钩子”均通过 LSPosed GUI 管理。

构建

需要 JDK 17、Android SDK 35，并可从 Maven Central 获取 io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0 与 org.luckypray:dexkit:2.0.6。

.\gradlew.bat :app:testDebugUnitTest :app:assembleDebug

测试 APK 输出到 app/build/outputs/apk/debug/。面向普通用户的已签名版本请从 GitHub Releases 下载。

许可证

modules.changelog:
Release Notes — X AdFree 2.0.2（versionCode 21）

中文

从 1.5.1 到 2.0.2：一次架构换代

1.5.1 是绑定 X 12.3.1 类名的单版本模块——X 每发一个小版本，模块就会失效并等待人工适配。2.0.x 把这层"版本绑定"整个换成了运行时动态适配：
- 安装时按"特征指纹 + 形状校验 + 运行时见证"在 X 进程内自动定位过滤点，不维护任何逐版本类名表；
- 普通 X 小版本更新（混淆名漂移）由 DexKit 指纹梯子自动吸收，多数情况下无需等模块更新；
- 解析结果按安装身份缓存，日常启动几十毫秒内生效；
- 任何时候解析或验证失败，模块都会以失效安全（fail-open）方式放弃过滤，X 本身保持完全可用。

功能与体验
- 去除首页时间线（For You / Following）、帖子详情页与评论区的广告；
- 广告识别基于数据模型语义（promoted 元数据 / entryId 前缀 / 应用自身判定）三态评分：只有确定性广告会被移除，不确定内容一律放行，以此尽量避免误删正常帖子（不承诺绝对零误删）；
- 无设置页：开关、作用域、还原内联钩子全部通过 LSPosed GUI 管理。

纯净运行时
- 模块自身零联网：无更新检查、无远程配置、无遥测，APK 甚至未声明 INTERNET 权限；
- 无后台服务、无轮询、无 WakeLock；解析线程空闲后自动退出，只保留随 X 进程存在的过滤钩子。

兼容性与验证
- 面向 X 12.x 小版本动态适配；当前真机验证 12.17.0-release.0（12.3.1 仅作为历史兼容种子保留，未在 2.0.x 架构上重新实测）；
- Android 9.0（API 28）及以上；需支持 libxposed Modern API 102 的官方 LSPosed；
- 遇到 X 大版本架构换代导致指纹全部失效时，模块会安全退避（不去广告但 X 正常），等待版本更新。

升级说明

1. 直接安装覆盖升级（签名不变）；
2. 确认 LSPosed 中模块已启用、作用域仅 X（com.twitter.android）；
3. 保持 LSPosed"设置 → 还原内联钩子"中勾选 X（libpairipcore.so 需要）；
4. 强制停止 X 后重新打开。首次启动进行一次性解析（约 1 秒），之后启动直接命中缓存。

已知限制
- 非 12.17.0 的未来小版本尚未实测（架构上可自适配，但不承诺零维护）；
- X 若删除全部已知业务指纹，模块 fail-open 放弃过滤直至版本更新。

English

1.5.1 → 2.0.2: an architecture change

1.5.1 was bound to X 12.3.1 class names — every minor X update broke it until manually re-patched. 2.0.x replaces that binding with runtime dynamic adaptation:
- Filter points are located inside the X process via feature fingerprints, shape verification and a runtime witness — no per-version class tables;
- Ordinary X minor updates (obfuscation drift) are absorbed automatically by the DexKit fingerprint ladder in most cases;
- Resolved targets are cached per install identity; everyday launches take effect within tens of milliseconds;
- Whenever resolution or verification fails, the module fails open — X itself keeps working unfiltered.

Features
- Removes ads from the Home timeline (For You / Following), post detail pages and replies;
- Detection scores semantic data-model evidence (promoted metadata / entryId prefixes / the app's own ad predicate) with tri-state verdicts: only confirmed ads are removed, uncertain items always pass through, minimizing the chance of normal posts being dropped (not an absolute guarantee);
- No settings screen: everything is managed through the LSPosed GUI.

Pure runtime
- The module itself makes zero network connections: no update checks, no remote config, no telemetry — the APK does not even declare the INTERNET permission;
- No background services, no polling, no wake locks; the resolver thread exits when idle, leaving only the filter hook that lives with the X process.

Compatibility
- Dynamically adapted to X 12.x minor versions; currently verified on 12.17.0-release.0 (12.3.1 is retained only as a historical compatibility seed, not re-tested on the 2.0.x architecture);
- Android 9.0 (API 28)+ with official LSPosed supporting libxposed Modern API 102;
- On a generational X redesign that invalidates every fingerprint, the module fails open until an update....

modules.readme:
XAi

X / Twitter 功能增强模块，使用原生 libxposed API 102。作者：yudigaga。
- 模块包名：io.github.yudigaga.xai
- 作用域：com.twitter.android
- Android 12L / API 32 以上
- 当前适配基准：原版 12.37.0-prod.01 / 312370001
- 源码与使用说明
- 模块下载

使用

在支持现代 API 102 的 LSPosed 中启用模块并勾选 X。完全退出并重新打开 X，等待首次查找及缓存校验完成，可按弹窗提示重启。后续身份未变化时复用缓存。

设置位于 X 设置 → XAi；入口暂未匹配时，可在首页顶部标题区域连点三次。首页归为内容与推荐、界面与交互、媒体与下载、分享与链接、AI 与自动化、数据与备份、高级、关于 8 组。单选设置点开选择，系统返回逐级退出，草稿返回不保存。新自动化和手势默认关闭，字体、导航和部分初始化型功能需重启 X。

独立模块页提供状态、关于和隐藏本模块桌面图标的开关；隐藏后可从 LSPosed 模块设置重新打开并恢复图标。日志入口位于 X 内 XAi → 关于 → 查看日志，支持分级筛选、复制、导出和清空。

首次从旧 io.github.xai 调试包切换，请先停用并移除旧模块，再安装正式包并重新勾选作用域，保留 X 及其数据。功能偏好存放于宿主内，避免同时启用两份模块。

功能

保留原有 43 个功能配置键，包括时间线广告/推荐与自定义过滤、界面精简、系统/自定义字体、导航与标签排序、回复与媒体排序、按钮和菜单筛选、分享链接处理以及类型化本地 feature switch 覆盖。

保留细分推荐与个人页推荐过滤、推广用户及新版 Google 广告视图过滤、已识别 Premium 提示隐藏、刷新后不自动回顶、最高可用视频轨道、自定义强调色、正文链接浏览器偏好和原版设置快捷入口。

0.4.0 / 8 新增：
- AI 模型与附件聊天、系统/GET/MiniMax 三来源 TTS、本地分析和配置备份。模型联系人位于 XAi 扩展内；语音生成本地音频供保存和分享。
- 原生文字自动评论、实时 XChat 私信自动回复，以及当前真实可见的本人帖新回复自动回复。提供固定、AI、关键词、随机四种模式、范围、额度冷却、任务预览、立即停止与持久去重；不遍历后台全部帖子通知。
- 官方与第三方下载共用来源、目录、命名及媒体类型/单项/多项/全部流程。第三方解析与媒体传输隔离凭据，解析失败或取消不会切换官方下载。
- 模块 AI 翻译，以及已适配帖子行两侧空白区域的长按和双击快捷动作。操作绑定触发时原帖，未知布局保留原生交互。
- 统一结构化日志。详细日志同时控制本地细节和 LSPosed 输出，关闭时 LSPosed 仅保留必要警告和错误。

导航、标签、菜单、认证、官方分享域名和文件名提供中文选项及预设，保留手动输入；编辑只修改草稿，保存才写入。

当前不是 Piko 全部功能的等价移植。完整动态主题、滚动锚点恢复、照片网格、内联下载图标与 HLS 合并等尚未全部实现。未知宿主版本没有唯一、安全映射的功能保持停用；不改变账号订阅或服务端权限。

AI 翻译使用已配置模块模型。自动化当前只发送原生文字，TTS 分享不等于原生语音消息。下载受宿主进程生命周期、解析服务和 SAF 提供者行为影响，中断后可能留下部分文件。完整范围见功能说明、自动化、下载和翻译与手势。

致谢与验证

感谢 Miuix 提供 UI，感谢 Piko 与 Hachidori 的功能设计和研究参考，以及 libxposed、AndroidX / Compose、Kotlin、dexlib2 和 OkHttp。

0.4.0 / 8 沿用正式版长期证书，Debug/Release 各 649 项本地全量测试通过，每个 variant 为 93 组、零失败/错误/跳过；Release Lint 为 0 错误 / 22 警告。独立 v2/v3 签名与 P16 对齐通过；真实启用 R8 压缩、优化和混淆，并核对 APK 与 mapping 的一致性。基准宿主的 11,980 条静态规则全部唯一匹配，实际宿主调用契约 308/308。

本轮未进行手机 LSPosed/ART、实际原生发送、真实模型/TTS/解析服务、CDN/SAF 或页面效果验收。JVM/Robolectric 测试不执行压缩后的 Android DEX，静态检查和 CI 不等同于手机效果。发布附有 SHA256SUMS 与公开验证清单，远端 CI 状态由发布核验记录单独报告。

modules.name: YouTube Hide Ads
modules.author: Xposed-Modules-Repo
modules.description: YouTube Hide Ads
modules.readme:
YouTube Hide Ads

Removes ads and unwanted feed content from the official YouTube Android app, skips SponsorBlock segments, and adds fullscreen brightness/volume swipes and original-audio selection. Each removal is authorized by a compiled Brainfuck policy. The host is a single XAX semantic store.

Features

| Feature | Default |
| --- | --- |
| Video, feed/search and shopping ads | On |
| Sponsored Shorts, removed before the pager is built | On |
| Premium, fullscreen and engagement-panel promotions | On |
| SponsorBlock skipping (sponsor, self-promotion; other categories optional) | On |
| Playables shelves, cards and Explore entry | Hidden |
| Preview videos, Explore more topics, posts | Hidden |
| Shorts in feeds | Shown |
| AI channels, high and medium confidence (AiSList) | Off |
| Fullscreen swipes: left brightness, right media volume | On |
| Prefer the original audio track | On |

Settings are under YouTube → You → Settings → YoutubeHideAds. Reload a feed after changing its switches.

Scope

com.google.android.youtube

Select YouTube as the module's only scope.

Requirements
- A rooted arm64 device with a framework that implements libxposed API 102: Vector or current LSPosed.
- Android 9 (API 28) or newer.
- The official YouTube app. Tested on 21.41.525.

Installation

1. Install the APK from the release attached to this repository.
2. Enable YoutubeHideAds in the manager, with YouTube as its only scope.
3. Force-stop YouTube, then reopen it.
4. Log entries are tagged:

YouTubeHideAds:

On a cold start the log reports the startup self-checks (531 in total) followed by Hook installed lines.

Validation

Measured on a Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, YouTube 21.41.525 and Vector 2.2. All 531 startup self-checks pass, every hook installs, and video ads, feed ads, sponsored Shorts and Playables are removed live. Premium, fullscreen and panel promotions passed controlled hook tests; naturally delivered positives remain unverified. Other YouTube versions and devices are not certified.

Troubleshooting

| Problem | Suggested action |
| --- | --- |
| No module log entries | Check that the module is enabled with YouTube in scope, then force-stop YouTube. |
| UnsatisfiedLinkError right after an update | Let the update settle, then force-stop and reopen YouTube. The manager can briefly keep the old APK path. |
| A self-check reports false | The module will not act on that feature. Capture the YouTubeHideAds: log and open an issue. |
| A hook is missing after a YouTube update | YouTube changed an internal structure. Capture the log and open an issue. |

Credits

| Project | Contribution |
| --- | --- |
| DexKit by LuckyPray | Structural discovery of obfuscated classes and methods. Apache-2.0. |
| libxposed, Vector | Hooking API and framework. |
| SponsorBlock | Community segment data, fetched through a privacy-preserving hash prefix. |
| Override92/AiSList | Optional AI-channel lists, CC BY-NC 4.0; not bundled. |
| Morphe Patches | Behavior reference; no implementation copied. |

Disclaimer

Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Google LLC or YouTube. The module changes the app's behavior in memory on the user's own device and does not redistribute the YouTube APK. It contacts only SponsorBlock and, if enabled, the AiSList download. Provided for personal use. YouTube updates may break hooks without notice.
